2061030.name: City Rhapsody!
2061030.about_the_game:
The city is your orchestra, you are the conductor, how should this rhapsody play?

Welcome to City Rhapsody! Instead of layers and layers of bureaucracy; we, the citizens, decided to appoint one person, you, as the city's "conductor."
Look out! We are very needy so it just may get chaotic. From everyday traffic congestion, changing power demand, accommodating our requests, and providing uninterrupted city services; to fighting out-of-control fires that threaten to wipe us out. Are you ready to take up the challenge?

City Rhapsody! is a low-poly, chill, sophisticated, and engaging city-building game with a twist of real-time strategy mechanics. The player plays the city's all-seeing "conductor" who gets to build all roads and buildings, tweak traffic configurations, open/close businesses, manage complex utility infrastructure, and command special city units. Use them creatively to solve citizens' problems.


⛰️With a fully procedurally generated, dynamic, and evolving world, choose the ideal location to start building your dream city.
  • 3 map sizes, 128x128, 256x256, and 512x512 with realistic tree-growth simulation.
  • Gain more citizens to build larger construction projects.
  • Modern, hand-crafted, low-poly style building models and structures.
  • A unique hybrid grid system that neatly stacks your buildings and roads while not sacrificing variabilities.


🛠️Control buildings and fine-tune the city's operations to make sure your city has enough money to grow.
  • Realistic utility simulation.
  • Full data visualization maps that help you manage your city.


😉Use everything at your disposal creatively to solve challenges and make citizens happy. Remember, unhappy citizens dodge taxes and will leave your city with abandoned buildings that make it unattractive.
  • In-depth traffic simulation with player-customizable roads/intersections.
  • Individually simulated complex citizen AI.
  • Situational generated challenges that are unique to every city.


🚒The world is not all roses. In emergency situations, take over commanding the first responders to save your city from disaster.
  • Realistically simulated forest fire with wind effects.
  • Player-controllable special units to change the outcome of a disaster.

2061040.name: Save Our Solar System
2061040.about_the_game:

  • Defend from endless waves of asteroids
  • Command an army of autonomous turrets
  • Upgrade and repair turrets
  • Harvest as much metal as possible
  • Build a rocket to advance into the stars

One day when she has no more food to eat, her mother tells Jack that she gives her enough cows to sell to her Jack and sells them to buy something to eat. Along the way, lazy Jack meets a stranger and trades three beans for a cow with mysterious powers. Upon returning to her home, her mother, angry that the cows had been replaced with beans, threw them away and overnight grew into a large, beautiful bean tree.
Jack reached the giant's castle in the sky riding the beanstalk that grew into the sky. But the gates were tightly shut...

the Gameplay and Features

2061060.name: The Marson Home
2061060.about_the_game:
The townsfolk talk about the strange home known as the Marson Home. Yet the stories vary, and no formal knowledge can be found.
Professor Fredrick Evans was the last person to own and live within the building after 52 years' worth of vacancy. But since his death and his son's, no one has laid claim to the home and now it's going up for auction. But of course, the townspeople, those who have heard the stories, maybe even know the truth have risen up in protest. A group of amateur paranormal investigators have been assigned to the home in a hope to lay to rest these claims and help prompt the homes eventual sell.

It's been a week since then.

After a long day of police work, you begin your drive home. Of course, unexpectedly you are driven off the road, barely surviving a huge fall.
You stumble you're way through the forest to find an old home, the infamous Marson Home.

Maybe you can discover the truth? That is if you can survive.

----- Game Play -----

The Marson Home is a single player, mystery-thriller/horror.
Explore this two-story home filled with details and history, and even a few secret areas.
As the player, you can pick up, examine, and even collect items like batteries to help your search the home.
Locate notes and letters that tell the story of what has happened here.
Locate the keys necessary to open doors, but what keys go to which doors is unknown.
But be wary for your being watched and whoever or whatever it is, it wants you...

----- The Maker -----

Thank you for your support!
I'm a new indie developer attempting to expand my career in Game Design and Development.
Purchasing this game helps me to strive towards making bigger and better games in the future!
Oh, and be honest with your review! It helps me know what to do and not to do.
Thanks again!

2061150.name: Ikki Unite
2061150.about_the_game:
Ikki Unite: The Glorious Return of the Underdog!


Yes, you read that right. No need to clean your glasses or pinch yourself—you’re wide awake! Ikki Unite is making a grand return in 2024! Face off against a locust plague threatening your very existence. Enlist up to 16 friends in this erratic multiplayer bullet hell, sprinkled with Roguelite mechanics. This isn’t just a game; it’s a rebellion bringing back the charm, the chaos, and the "What am I even playing?" vibe of the original 1985 classic.

🎮 Grab your bamboo 🎮 : Ikki Unite. Because every game deserves a redemption arc, even this one. Get ready for a journey filled with laughter, wrinkled eyes and the kind of fun that only comes when you don't take yourself too seriously. Welcome back, Ikki, we've absolutely not missed you.





Gameplay That’s Foolproof (We Promise):

Your Noble Quest: Clear the waves of minions, defeat the Boss of each area to finally face and fight the Evil Magistrate. Join forces with your friends on a challenging adventure.
Controls: If you could handle a NES controller, you’re overqualified. Arrow keys move, everything else happens like magic (the old-fashioned kind).

Key Features:

16-Player Mayhem: Ikki Unite can be played by up to 16 players simultaneously in online cooperation. Create your squad joining Gonbe, the forty-something vigilante, Magoichi, the trigger-happy legend and many others!

4 Classes: Play as one of the four archetypes: Explorers, Attackers, Enhancers and Healers!

Epic Action: So much action, you’ll forget you’re playing what was once dubbed the worst NES game ever.

Roguelite Madness: A different adventure every time you play, chose between a wide set of randomized items and bonuses! Because predictability is so 1985. [ And you don’t even have to put another coin in ;)]



Survival Tips for the Hopelessly Outnumbered:

The Buddy System: Stick with your team. Or at least try to find them before the final boss does.
There's strength in unity: Even bigger enemies can be taken down when the squad is united and working together.
Resurrection: Fallen comrades can be brought back to life, don’t leave them behind!

SUNSOFT: The Dawn of a New Era

SUNSOFT is back, dusting off the NES cartridges and leaping into the modern era with Ikki Unite. It’s a love letter to the fans who stuck by us, an opportunity to make amends with those we have tortured, and an invitation to new players to join in the fun. Because if we can’t laugh at ourselves, who can we laugh at?

2061230.name: Chasm: The Rift
2061230.about_the_game:
Prepare for terror in this ground-breaking classic old-school FPS. Following the destruction of Time you are left to battle in this horrific hellhole of multilevel interconnected missions populated by gruesome grotesque creatures.

ABOUT

Having its roots in 1997 and developed in Ukraine, Chasm: The Rift is one of the most thrilling and innovative FPS from this era and the first Eastern European boomer shooter ever made.

THE STORY

Feeling you are no longer alone, you turn, with just enough time to shoot, killing the mutation charging mercilessly toward you. You begin to sense an eerie feeling of fear in the air, but your skin crawls as you realize it's your own...What was that thing?

Again and again you shoot, battling more strange beasts; all grotesque mutations of creatures you once knew. Suddenly the inexplicable becomes clear. Time channels have formed in the Earth's atmosphere, turning once normal life forms into something they were never meant to be. As part of a special commando unit, you must not only ward off and eradicate the beasts, but destroy the time channels to finally rid the Earth of these deadly mutations.

GAMEPLAY

Along with the heart-pounding adventure through the Corridors of Time and the satisfaction of ripping limbs from hideous monsters with the iconic BladeGun and an innovative weather system, the player will now be able to enjoy this late 90’s FPS classic, which has been localized into twelve languages and which offers full 4K support, improved sound design, and multiple achievements.

GAME FEATURES

  • Blow off monsters' limbs even as they continue to attack with remaining appendages
  • Different effects including water, rain, snow, wind, smoke, dust, sparks, explosions and distant fades
  • Awesome array of weapons, including unique Blade Gun
  • Enhanced graphics
  • Improved sound design

BONUS

The original Chasm: The Rift version powered by DOSBox is included as a bonus.

2061250.name: Shin chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation The Endless Seven-Day Journey
2061250.about_the_game:
Hiroshi has to go on a business trip to Kyushu, so now the entire Nohara family has decided to stay with an childhood friend of Misae's in Assou, Kumamoto.
But when they arrive at Kumamoto Station on their way to Assou, they meet a strange man who offers them an even stranger camera on the condition that they'll act as his witnesses...
With his new camera in hand, Shinnosuke can enjoy his summer vacation in the beautiful Assou fields and mountains to the fullest. The scenery is even crawling with creatures that he would never find in Kasukabe. And there are townspeople to help and new friends to make.
That said...don't these kids look an awful lot like the ones he knows from home?

One cool summer night, Shinnosuke witnesses a giant creature outlined against the light of a full moon. Next to the creature is a strange man with a wide smile.
It's the same weird man who gave him the camera at the station...
And he calls himself the Professor Akuno. Following this encounter more and more strange things start to happen around Assou...

How to spend your summer vacation

Morning Exercise in Assou

Japanese summer vacation isn't complete without morning gymnastics! Everyone in town gets together to do these morning stretches! Sit back and enjoy the show!

Fun Meals

The Nohara and Hinoyama families eat all their meals together. Once seated, they say their thanks for the meal and dig in! The meals look amazing, but I guess you can't expect anything less when you're staying at a real café!

Explore as You Please

Run around, play, and explore in a wide variety of places. Since it's surrounded by nature, Assou is also home to all kinds of rare insects and fish! Catch fish and bugs, help the townspeople, and enjoy your summer holiday to the max!

Evening Bath

After a day of fun and exploration, it's time to take a bath with dad! You can even see the starry sky from within the traditional tiled bathtub. Wash away the fatigue and ready yourself for the next day!

Picture Diary

Record all your fun experiences in the picture diary. It's the best way to treasure your summer memories, be they the day's happenings, new things you've discovered, or the types of fish and bugs you've caught!

Become a News Reporter

When Shinnosuke visits Cap at the News Agency, he gets appointed as a child journalist! The things he reports will be printed in the paper and pinned to the bulletin boards around town! As the newspaper pulls in more subscribers, the company will flourish! Try to hunt for the hottest scoop!

Catch Bugs

Assou's rich surroundings are filled to the brim with insects. Some of them are even quite rare, definitely not the type you'd find back in Kasukabe! Ready your bug net, aim, and SWING! All the bugs you catch will be recorded in your Insect Encyclopedia!

Catch Fish

Assou's rivers and ponds are rich with fish, so you can enjoy a spot of fishing whenever you want! Ready your rod, reel it in at the right time, and you might just catch something rare! All the fish you catch will be recorded in your Fish Encyclopedia!

Grow Vegetables

You can grow healthy veggies over at the Kurokami Farm! If you bring the vegetables you grew to the Hinoyama Café or other shops around town, you can even earn a bit of pocket money ♪

Help the Stores

Hinoyama Café, the local curry restaurant, and the supermarket are always looking for more fresh ingredients. Earn pocket money by bringing them the ingredients they list on the bulletin board!

Dinosaur Showdown

Befriend the other kids in Assou and you'll be able to duke it out in Dinosaur Showdown! It's a place where both powerful dinosaurs and familiar characters collide! You can collect Dino Cards by buying Chocobi from the Kirishima Store!

Be a DJ

If you befriend the owner of the café and bar Dancing Jiro, you can become a DJ yourself! The tracks are composed of the game's background music! Mix them up however you like and play your tracks in the store!

2061250.reviews:
“Shin-chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation -The Endless Seven-Day Journey- is a refreshing adventure seen through the eyes of a 5-year-old with an incredibly active imagination. Be it normal interactions with family or friends or some of the wackier story elements further in, there is enough to keep any player satisfied. If you’re looking to escape on a whimsical trip, Shin-chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation -The Endless Seven-Day Journey- is a fantastic choice.”
9/10 – But Why Tho?

“Apart from mashing together two classic Japanese IPs, Shin chan: The Endless Seven-Day Journey mashes together some quite contradictory concepts and comes up with something special. You have the directionless, simple adventures of a child’s curiosity on a rural holiday, but they’re interrupted quite suddenly by a tightly directed (and completely absurd) plot. Wacky sitcom energy quickly becomes the drive and purpose in a game that could have been merely a wholesome meander-em-up. So there is the soothing magic of endless days running round fields and just seeing what catches the imagination, but also a heavy steer to play a story from end to end, packaging the never-ending summer into a punchy and dynamic 15-20 hours. Knowing now what Kureshin and Bokunatsu are, if you think you like the idea of mixing the two, this game is very easy to recommend.”
8/10 – Nintendo Life

“Fans of Shin-chan, Bokunatsu, Attack of the Friday Monsters, or those who just enjoy a bit of slow-life low-pressure adventure will likely appreciate Shin chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation. It could be a little fuller, and I don’t know how to feel about how it wraps up its story, but it’s unique, silly, and nostalgic in all the right ways.”
8/10 – TouchArcade

2061270.name: Alien Gladiator
2061270.about_the_game:
Have a few hours of brainless fun and break away from everyday life!

Fight your way to freedom in this fast-paced gladiator game where all kinds of aliens will try to kill you. Think fast and get the crowd excited by slaughtering your enemies with over 20 different ways. Unlock new weapons as you gain fame in arena and try to be the best gladiator in the universe.

Features
- Unlock unique weapons as you gain fame in arena
- Many unique enemy types
- Boss enemies that must be defeated
- Destructive environment
- Use the environment and traps for your convenience to kill enemies
- For each killing style, you get a new trophy on your shelf
- You can make custom waves as you progress through game

2061280.name: Monty on the Run (CPC/Spectrum)
2061280.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1985, this classic platformer for home microcomputers from British developers Gremlin Graphics saw players take on the role of Monty Mole, recently escaped from Scudmore Prison and fleeing for his life! Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Included are both the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions.

Gameplay

Choose 5 of the offered 21 items from the 'Freedom Kit' to carry with you. Make your way to freedom through many hideouts and secret locations. Can you make the cross-channel ferry in time?


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options
2061280.reviews:
“If you're a climbing game fanatic then this is the game you should get - it's what Jet Set Willy II should have been. Don't let your best friend borrow it - you will never get it back!”

“At last, the true successor to Wanted: Monty Mole, and Peter Harrap's evil sense of games humour is back at work. Whatever was mean in the first game, is now ten times so in this saga of prison escape for the hero mole”
94% – Crash! (September 1985)

2061290.name: Hauling Away
2061290.about_the_game:
Without aim... Without destination...


Alone and stuck in job that he has no passion for, protagonist Ray slowly wastes away his days working as a "Hauler".
Despite being fed up with the status quo, he has seemingly resigned himself to accepting his life as it is.

But unbeknownst to him, his next journey might change his life forever.
Will the future hold disaster or salvation? ...or perhaps, a bit of both?

Features


  • ~30-45 minutes of Visual Novel gameplay (~6k word Short Story)
  • A bittersweet story revolving around ambitions and loneliness.
  • Original art and soundtrack
  • A unique, but loving waifu

2061300.name: The Way Home: Pixel Roguelike
2061300.about_the_game:
Roguelike Dungeon Crawler

  • Procedurally generated maps.
  • Each battle has a new pattern to enjoy.
  • Strategically combine 15 or more skills every battle!
  • Defeat 80 different monsters each with unique patterns.

Party Mode

  • You can choose from 21 different characters.
  • Each character can use different skills.
  • A party consists of 4 characters who will fight together.
  • You can use different combinations of characters to play through the dungeons.

Resource collection and construction

  • You can construct buildings with resources collected from dungeons and islands.
  • Make various buildings to make it easier to escape.

Interesting story

  • Meet NPC's and follow the story as you explore 4 islands.
  • Will Kevin and Cheese eventually escape the island?
  • The warmth of lights and shadows on a classical pixel art style is waiting for you!

2061340.name: Mottia - The gem hunters
2061340.about_the_game:
Classic Roguelike (turn based, tile based) RPG with a rich character building system.

Key Roguelikes Features:
  • Random huge 130X130 worlds generation
  • Lots of spells, items, weapon, artifact
  • Free character building
  • Permadeath: Think before acting
  • NO hunger system
  • NO item identification system

All available characters have the same abilities but with different aptitudes.
You can combinate different gems to upgrade character abilities, weapons and armours stats.

2061420.name: Faceplant
2061420.about_the_game:
A difficult, pixel art platformer where your goal is to reach the top! - Inspired by the fantastic Jump King and Getting Over It with Bennet Foddy!

You embark on a precision-platforming adventure in a post-apocalyptic laboratory, the route is difficult and will require patience and all of your platforming skills. Reach new heights and restore nature to this barren world... If you reach the top, you might just save the world!

- Multiple Stage Precision Platforming Adventure
One huge continuous map!
- Difficult gameplay
You will fall and faceplant... A lot!
- Constant Action
The character runs continuously, so you'll need to be quick with your reactions or find a safe space to relax.
- 1-Button Gameplay
You only need 1 button to play, press and hold to jump higher or tap for small jumps... It's accessible and easy to pick up but challenging to master!
- Hand-Drawn Pixel Graphics
I have drawn all the content in this game myself, experience the unique world of Faceplant in full hand-drawn pixel art glory!

2061430.name: Oxygen
2061430.about_the_game:
STORY

A natural disaster hit us and brought humanity to the verge of extinction. Only a few survived because of "Large Igneous Provinces", these are volcanoes that don't explode but huge cracks open in the Earth's crust and lava just starts bubbling out, oozing across the landscape, releasing tons of toxic gases. The most dangerous thing about an igneous province is that it can keep up the oozing for centuries. With the wind effect, these gases spread all over the world and changed the atmospheric composition. One of these toxic magmatic gases reduced the oxygen level in the air. Sadly, there’s only little oxygen left in the world. Before it's too late for humanity, the Oxygen Center is invented. It generates oxygen by electrolysis of underground water, and the required electricity is generated by using coal but you should be slowly moving away from coal towards sustainable sources of energy. This is the only hope for us...

BUILD, MANAGE, and RESEARCH

The world has changed. Start a new civilization for all survivors around the globe. Fulfill your people's basic needs with a nice living place, steady water and food supplies. Research new features and buildings to increase their confidence and education level.

LEAD YOUR PEOPLE

Now it's your time, you’re the leader. Prove your worth as a leader to everyone! Coordinate and assign your people to different workplaces. Let them produce all required materials.

OVERCOME THE NATURAL CHALLENGES

Protect your people. Prepare for recurring and intense frosts and droughts, and plan ahead by stocking up water and food. Get ready for deadly winds, and generate the required energy by using coal or make your plan to move away from coal towards sustainable energy resources.

EXPLORE

Find all survivors around the globe and let them join your settlement. Detect abandoned areas and then send your team to explore the area and collect anything useful.

KEY FEATURES

  • Keep the Oxygen Center running and build your own city around it
  • Survive in a world of constant threats including deadly winds, crack explosions, frosts and droughts
  • Gather or produce many different resources and try to stock all types of food, material, and water
  • Lead your people and increase their confidence and education level for better productivity
  • Find and warmly welcome every survivor around the globe
  • Research and develop to unlock new features and buildings
  • Find all abandoned places around your settlement and send your team to collect food and material
  • Take care of the dead trees and revive them

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Hungarian, Romanian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support

2061460.name: Triennale Game Collection 2
2061460.about_the_game:
[Coming July 12th] WADE by Optillusion (China / USA) is a stroll along the shore of a wide river that flows into the underworld. As the player ventures deeper, the scenery starts to shift and they may encounter oddities or curiosities.

[Coming July 29th] We Are Poems by Fern Goldfarb-Ramallo (Argentina) is a swim through the queerest region of deep space. Its inhabitants float and gravitate in bountiful joyous explosions of light, embracing the void as a place to thrive.

[Coming August 26th] Nonno's Legend by Nina Freeman (USA) is a game about imagining places you’ve never seen. Nina's grandfather shows her that a globe has some magical properties – you can reshape the planet!

[Coming September 16th] MINE by Akwasi Bediako Afrane (Ghana) is a first-person game that ushers the audience into an “open-mine” and deals with the unknown relationship between raw materials and the virtual spaces that we inhabit.

[Coming September 30th] Contact by Llaura McGee / Dreamfeel (Ireland) is a game about the search for life in the universe and identity in oneself. Players interact with onscreen interfaces to decode and understand the signals received from outer space.

The Triennale Game Collection Volume 2 is a free virtual exhibition of video games created for the 23rd International Exhibition of Triennale Milano by five of the world’s most renowned independent game designers, showcasing these artists’ experimental approach to interactivity.

The five featured artists are: Optillusion (Moncage), Fern Goldfarb-Ramallo (Panoramical), Nina Freeman (Cibele), Akwasi Bediako Afrane (TRONS), and Llaura McGee / Dreamfeel (If Found…).

Every two weeks for three months a new game will be available in the collection. These games are self-contained takes on interactive narrative, puzzles, and exploration.

The Collection is curated by Italian game designer Pietro Righi Riva and the virtual space in which the exhibition takes place is produced by Italian game studio Santa Ragione, makers of the App Store hit FOTONICA.

2061510.name: Woodlock Manor
2061510.about_the_game:
Your beloved grandfather, Sir Issac Woodlock sadly passed away at the age of 132. In his will, he leaves all his inheritance and estate to you but under one condition. You must pass the trials of his manor to prove you are worthy of not only his vast wealth but the Woodlock family name itself! Dodge spike traps, avoid large buzz saws, and outwit dangerous laser beams in this grid-based puzzle game to reach the end of the manor to claim your grandfather's vast fortune!



FEATURES
  • Over 45+ Levels
  • Over 30-45 minutes of gameplay
  • Uncover the mysteries of Woodlock Manor

Special thanks to Darren Curtis for "My Dark Passenger", the trailer music!

2061540.name: Chompies!
2061540.about_the_game:
This game only supports local multiplayer


Chompies! is a cute couch sports game where you fight for the ball to reach the top of the level and score a goal. Battle it out against your friends or find random Chompies from around the world!

Some levels get harder to win when you play solo and aggressive, sometimes you need teamwork and betray one of the Chompies to WIN! but there is always only one winner.

Features:
  • 2 to 4 PLAYERS in Local Multiplayer

  • Juicy Chompies

  • 4 unique different environments

  • Over 20+ levels

  • Lots of cool obstacles

2061580.name: Brigadoon
2061580.about_the_game:
STORY:
The game takes place in Scotland where a visitor named Tommy Albright from New York was on a hunting trip but gets lost, and finds himself stuck in the land of Brigadoon, which is cursed to appear for one day and disappear for 100 years! Tommy must learn the secrets of Brigadoon and break the spell so he can escape before time is up!

GAMEPLAY:
This is a top-down adventure game that places you in a world that is under a time limit where you must strategize your gameplay during a cycle. It is heavily based on puzzles, so it requires a lot of brain power at times; but not to worry, as if you are running low on time, there is a way to reset the time back, but will reset any unfinished quests in the process so you will need to plan ahead for each cycle. There are many different types of quests, whether it be helping an NPC with something or playing a mini-game. Some quests are only active at a certain time, so you can also move time forward just to help speed things along. You will find many different items that will help during your adventure, such as potions, a magic candle, treasure maps, fast shooting guns, and many more mysterious items. Since a gun is your main weapon, it plays a lot like a shooter with its combat. Definitely stock up on ammo which should come in handy when you fight the bosses.

Overall, this is my first indie game I've ever created so I'm still learning and hope to hear feedback so I can improve on future games!

2061620.name: Mechanic Heroes
2061620.about_the_game:
Freshly graduated, you and your team of mechanics must work together to repair as many cars as possible before your shift ends. Take part in an intense adventure, recruit the best mechanics and become true mechanic heroes together!





Playable with up to 4 players. In local and/or online multiplayer, work together to get the highest score and unlock new levels and characters.






Get ready to become an elite mechanic! Change the wheels, repair the body of the car or recharge the battery, car maintenance will no longer have any secrets for you!





PHYSICS!

Forget the safety rules and save time with hero physics. Throw tools, wheels or lightbulbs, it's much more convenient!







Travel the world, discover unique environments and complete complex tasks that will push your coordination skills to the limit.

Over 25 levels for you and your team to discover and master!




COMPETITIVES RACES!

Play against your friends in a competitive racing mode, because a team of mechanics always needs a driving champion!

2061630.name: (square)
2061630.about_the_game:
(square) is a game where your only offense is as deadly to you as your enemies. With a lone square as your only projectile, you must eliminate your enemies by launching it around the arena. The closer you are, the more force you apply when you launch it. To help with this, you can recall the square back to yourself. But be careful not to let it hit you!



Features

- Over 45 level (takes a little over an hour to beat)
- Three distinct chapters
- Interesting and challenging gameplay
- An original soundtrack



Design and Development - Brennan Cottrell
Sound and Music - Brett Boyd
Trailer - Chase Burden

2061710.name: DO NOT OPEN
2061710.about_the_game:
WARNING: This video game may cause seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. Caution is advised.

DO NOT OPEN is a terrifying short and fast paced first-person escape-room experience, based on randomness in puzzle combinations, and classic survival-horror mechanics.




Mike Goreng is trapped in a warped version of his own home. What's going on? Where are his wife and daughter? As a scientist, Mike can't come up with an explanation for what is happening, but his instinct tells him that he is in severe danger... and something evil lurks in the darkness.
Being in Mike's shoes, you will experience tense moments where your heart rate will accelerate. Meanwhile, the personification of guilt, which Mike feels for betraying his family, will try to trap you.
Will you be able to run away from it?





The story of DO NOT OPEN takes place in the grand Victorian mansion of Mike's aunt Judith Goreng who, after committing suicide, leaves the house to her nephew.

Remember to explore every corner of the mansion and discover all its details.





DO NOT OPEN is a challenging survival-horror classic with gameplay based on escape-room mechanics. Each time the player crosses a door of the Hall of the Victorian mansion Judith's Manor, he will enter a different layer of each area, and its puzzles and riddles combinations will change randomly so that each game is different from start to finish.



To unravel the terrible mystery of the manor, the player will find different newspaper clippings, diary pages or other items in each game, making the plot a puzzle in itself. But he must do it before time runs out, or he'd better hide from the terrible threat that stalks him.

Are you ready for the DO NOT OPEN challenge? HIDE, SOLVE or DIE!

2061720.about_the_game:
Ever dreamt of being the lead character in the Jetsons, a Top Gun or in an 80s cool nightdrive? Now you can do all at once.

We've partnered with top airtaxi and aerospace firms to let you race and fly cutting-edge flying cars, well before they're commercially available. This game, crafted with insights from industry experts, promises a riveting adventure around the iconic Manhattan skyline.

2061750.name: Counterpact
2061750.about_the_game:
Counterpact is a 2D platform-shooter that pits two teams against each other, or a solo player against the tough, radiant forces the Gilded Spire has to offer.

7 Unique Characters
Each playable character comes with their own set of mechanics. If you enjoy glass cannon gameplay, try Shiniko the Reaper, who can output some serious damage despite her low health and close-ranged attacks; use her Dash to maneuver around (or through) enemies. Prefer to take a beefier approach? Try SYS.TR the Bulwark, who can use channel the damage she receives into powerful auras using her Rerouted Power.

Different Weapons to Try
Don't like how a character plays by default? Maybe the current situation calls for something different? Perhaps you're just looking for to spice up their gameplay? Each character has a variety of alternate weapons to choose from, some of which even change their role, all while keeping their core mechanics intact. New weapons will be added over time as well.

Over 200 Cosmetics to Collect
By simply playing the game (no microtransactions are involved), you can earn Eclipsium which can be used to purchase new weapons and cosmetics. Cosmetic items include different outfits for characters, little pets that follow you, chairs that you can sit on, emotes to taunt with, and more. Having a hard time getting what you want? Don't worry, you can even trade items with other players.

Enter the Gilded Spire
If you want a solo experience, the Gilded Spire awaits you. Fight through four floors of bulky enemies and traps for a chance to earn riches. If you really want to challenge yourself and reap great rewards, try conquering the Gilded Spire on the Blinding difficulty. After that, you can truly test yourself with Gilded Gauntlets.

2061780.name: Sprite Fight
2061780.about_the_game:
Sprite Fight is an action-packed 2D platform fighter with the use of long-ranged combat and the ability to battle your friends. With a series of unique game modes to brawl out together, acquire a variety of weapons through plenty of stages to fend off your opponents and come out victorious.

MULTIPLE GAME MODES

What separates Sprite Fight from the typical 2D platform fighter is the variety of unique game modes, some being king of the hill, beach ball keep-up, shotgun frenzy, gun game, disk shoot-down, and more to come.

TONS OF STAGES

With a multitude of stages, you'll be able to traverse different areas of the Sprite Fight world to battle amongst your peers.

LOTS OF WEAPONS

With over 20+ weapons at your disposal, you'll be able to quickly cycle through your gallery of weapons and attack foes with what you're given.

WACKY PHYSICS

With stages based around your skill to navigate platforms with moving chains and stages where you avoid flying platforms coming at you, the physics system in Sprite Fight is a lot to unpack.

CHARACTER SELECTION

You'll be able to navigate through different cosmetic looks for you to battle your friends with.

2061850.name: Aria and the Crystal Kingdom
2061850.about_the_game:
Explore and conquer a 100-floor roguelite dungeon in this cute but challenging card-battler RPG. Open card packs, change your class, customize your deck, equip accessories, and take on quests from quirky NPCs as you experience a charming story and engage in strategic turn-based battles against unique enemies and bosses.

Strategic card-battler combat

  • Face down a variety of enemies and challenging bosses, each with their own unique behaviors and mechanics.

  • Purchase card packs with in-game gold, then arrange your deck. The cards you choose will determine your class; Each comes with their own unique perk!

  • Customize your cards to your liking! Each card can be buffed up to three times with 15 different traits.

  • Equip powerful accessories that complement your unique playstyle.

Explore and survive a 100-floor roguelite dungeon

  • Each room is procedurally generated and changes with every visit!

  • Scour rooms for treasure chests, breakables, and hidden gold and health drops. The items you find can be used for crafting, customizing, or completing quests.

Experience a charming story and quirky characters

  • Help Aria find her older sister who has mysteriously vanished.

  • Assist the locals in rebuilding and improving the town by taking on quests that feature humorous dialog.

2061930.name: Spirits of Yendor
2061930.about_the_game:
Survive a continuous onslaught of monstrous hordes. Resurrect the heroes they have slain, who refused to join them. Hunt down Baalzebub, defeat his minions, explore the depths of his dungeon, and destroy the Amulet of Yendor, lest it trap more mortals in its thrall.

The gameplay borrows from various other bullet hell and broken build games, primarily NetHack, SNKRX, and Vampire Survivors. The item system is more loot-focused. With a 3D skill tree, a wide range of collectable characters for each run, and synergetic abilities for your resurrected ghostly followers, every run can be drastically different. Some combinations will lead to success........ Others to your deathly essence being scattered.

2062020.about_the_game:

2062030.name: Code Alkonost: Awakening of Evil
2062030.about_the_game:
Code Alkonost is a first-person, atmospheric adventure where Slavic legends come to life. Travel through a dark fantasy world and encounter the possessive spirits of the underworld. Experience authentic art styles and stories that have never been seen in adventure games before. Meet iconic figures from Slavic mythology, including the enigmatic Baba Yaga, the elusive Leshy, and many other supernatural beings that haunt the forgotten realms.

Story

Welcome to Dark Fantasy World

Two twin sisters Vera and Milena set out to leave gifts in front of the idol of the Slavic god Perun, believing that gods would give them health and peace in the Jawia world. While Vera is handing over food to the idol, Sister Milena becomes playful and hides from Vera, leading Vera to the entrance to the Forbidden. In this place, robbers are sent when they receive the death penalty, where it was believed that demons wander.

After arriving at the Forbidden Forest, she hears her sister screaming, after which she decides to enter the forest. The entrance to the forest is closed, and there is no way out for Vera; the sunset has set. Enter the dark fairy tale…

Fear effect

The fear effect can impact the game's overall audiovisual experience by adding tension and fear inside the game environment that will make you think outside the box.

Travel from Jawia to Nawia

Dark fantasy literature and culture heavily influence the game's plot. Players can traverse both the mortal realm and the underworld of Slavic mythology, encountering legendary beasts, fulfilling divine quests, and unraveling enigmas.

The game boasts dynamic and immersive environments that enable players to master using the Lada star to fend off adversaries. Players can progress to higher levels by solving puzzles and interacting with characters.

The psychological story of maturity and progression

The story follows a young girl, who embarks on a journey of self-discovery and uncovers her unique abilities and purpose in life. Along the way, she confronts the challenges of growing up and learns to assert her independence, resisting the sinister forces threatening to possess her body and soul.

Authentic music

The game soundtrack consists of ethnic and traditional folklore music but with a different arrangement. Music is accelerated in certain situations to make the player aware of approaching danger. Frightening music and sound effects will create contact tension inside dark forests and abandoned castles.

2062050.name: Our Passing Thoughts
2062050.about_the_game:
Disclaimer: OPT is not responsible for ruining friendships.


With one orb you can jump. Sometimes the simplest things can be the most difficult.


It’s like catch but the ball is your ability to do things like jump and Attack

As simple as catch, but can be as complex as baseball.



🍃🍄 You and your partner play as two creatures that awaken deep underground to a broken world. Incomplete and alone, you only have each other to rely on. Learn and grow together as you collect the fragments and make your way towards the remnants of a home you remember, but have never really seen. 🍄🍃





🐬 Communicate
Develop your own language that suits how you play the game. Challenges are designed to test your ability to make a plan, and work through problems together.

🧠 Coordinate
You are each other's guardian angel. Challenges focused on working together to discover pathways, defeat enemies and protect each other when in need.

🌊 Trust
How much faith do you really have in your partner? These challenges question a players belief in their partner. Are they there when you call? Will they catch you when you fall? Will you pass when they need the ball?




👥 Co-op for the People - A cooperative only experience designed around the different components of teamwork. A mixture of real world skills and in game mechanics makes it perfect for best friends, couples, siblings and parents to pick up and play.

🌀 Tiered Ability System - Abilities are unlocked in a tier based system. With one orb, you can jump. With two orbs you can attack. By passing orbs, players can quickly change tiers and manage who has access to what abilities.

🚩 Challenges - Explore a large variety of challenges that will push you and your partner to the limit. from traditional adventure like puzzles, intense traversal segments, daring rescues and much more. Our Passing Thoughts is designed to present a complete cooperative experience that will put your team in a variety of emotionally charged situations.

🐎 Speedrunners beware - Take the OPT challenge to the next level and see how you and your partner stack up in completing the challenges the fastest.

🐚 Enjoy the atmosphere - Sit back and listen to an original soundtrack as you explore a broken world and uncover the history of a people lost to time.

This game is far from release! But you can follow our development journey here:

2062100.name: Paper Nebula
2062100.about_the_game:
Paper spaceships... An alien infested nebula..... A sassy, yet mostly harmless A.I.
All in a Roguelike!?!

Welcome to the Paper Nebula.

Help a lone protagonist attempt to escape an alien infested nebula, with the assistance of a legacy A.I. unit.



Why is she stuck here?
How can she get home?
Why do the starships look like sea creatures, and why are they so cute?
Wait, are they stickers?!

Find out now, play Paper Nebula!



"Acquire" alien technology to unlock shiny new weapons so you always want to have "just one more go!"

Improve your ships defenses to help you survive.

Power up with ultimate abilities to inflict MASSIVE DAMAGE!



Encounter strange yet arduous bosses.
Weep as they destroy your drone - this time, but not next time.

Work with a surprisingly sassy A.I. to survive and escape the Paper Nebula.

Coming October 2022!

2062110.name: Under The Stars
2062110.about_the_game:
A space theme of a small casual shooting game

There are two perspectives, the character and the ship
The world is full of monsters and enemies
The player can control the character/ship, dodge or shoot enemies, and replenish energy and various items consumed by collecting
Collect discarded parts and items to enhance character abilities
Bullets have 5 levels, but the energy cost also increases with the level of the bullet

The story:
Due to the failure of the mission, the abandoned spaceship wandering in the deserted universe crash-lands on the planet of Pai. The player will control and lead the protagonist to face the monster enemies in the game and find a way to escape from Pai, looking for the hope of survival.

2062130.name: Fracture: City of Destruction
2062130.about_the_game:
Welcome to Fracture: City of Destruction.

The city of Fracture is in civil unrest. The corrupted government has deployed its private army, known as The Reapers, into the city to seek out and destroy the group of citizens, known as The Bandits, to eliminate any remaining threats to the tyrannical government.

Fracture is an online multiplayer First Person Shooter offering a fast paced, arcade style shooter experience. The Early Access release includes 3 primary weapons and 2 secondary weapons to choose from. Primary weapons have 8 weapon kits and 4 optics to choose from. Weapon kits and optics change your weapons recoil patterns, accuracy, and many other attributes to customize your weapon for your preferred play style. Primary weapons also have a variety of skins to choose from. Players will also have access to 2 lethal grenades and 2 tactical grenades to assist in accomplishing your objective in the game. The Early Access currently offers Team Deathmatch with one playable map. New maps and game modes will be added in future updates. A Battle Royal mode will be in development in the near future as well.

Check out the Community Hub for more information and updates about the game.

2062140.name: The Mourne's
2062140.about_the_game:
The Mourne's is my first ever game solo dev project focusing on an Endless Solo / Co-op survival experience.

Features the option to play Solo or Online Multiplayer Co-op

Since this is a solo project updates will take sometime but open to feedback / bugs or whatever you feel and you can submit them through the Discord or my email.

2062150.name: Quadrobat
2062150.about_the_game:
Quadrobat is a challenging 2D platformer, designed for anyone from beginners to hardcore gamers!

Key Fetures

  • Minimalistic level design
  • Grappling
  • Portals
  • Challenging gameplay
  • Global leaderboard

2062160.name: Hold Controller
2062160.about_the_game:
Hold Controller is a VR game similar to electric shock maze. Players can use one or two controllers to cross the designed level.
Games only run in VR.Immersive sci-fi virtual scenes, simple and easy-to-use game playing methods, and unique VR effects should bring you a good experience.

game description
Observe the entry point of the level.

Choose the side you are used to or feel simple to enter.

Keep your arms steady and don't touch the edge of the level or obstacles.

Hold on until you get out of the level.


At this stage, the game is only developed by me, and more levels and contents will be completed gradually in the future. Thank you for your support, and I hope you can give me feedback.

2062170.name: Redaction
2062170.about_the_game:
Powered by Unreal Engine 4, Redaction is the first FPS game mode of a larger project: Warscape. Set in the near-future, in a war-sundered and irradiated society divided by conflicts on multiple fronts, Redaction tasks players with joining an elite threat identification and elimination squad.

Dive into fast-paced, squad-based PVPVE FPS combat against mutated bugs, irradiated and mutated humans, and other teams of players. Choose a squad role and support your team with specialized utility items. Loot your way through the map completing objectives and defeat the stage boss to get extra loot.

Redaction is currently in its Alpha development phase. MI Studios aims to release Redaction via Steam Early Access soon. If you’re interested in testing Redaction in this early form prior to Steam release, don't hesitate to reach out to us through Discord. The address is available via the MI Studios website.

2062190.name: Oh Sheep!
2062190.about_the_game:
Oh Sheep! is an endless runner based game which has an end.

You'll be running for your life as a mysterious humanoid creature who calls itself "Shepherd" to gather a flock of sheep and protect them from monsters that have different abilities.

Gather stray sheep as much as you can to get the highest score while protecting them from sheep thirsty creatures. Gather sheep by baiting them with wheat, beat the nasty creatures with your mighty stick. Featuring 5 unique enemies, 2 unique bosses and arcade mode, with each level featuring its own leaderboard.

Shepherd: Shepherd is a creature that no one knows who it is and also what it is. It wants to gather the biggest flock of sheep but for what purpose? It has a thin long wand and a heart which can beat all the enemies he will face.



Sheep: They are helpless, lonely and fluffy little cuties that are waiting for their hero to save them from cruel monsters. But there is only one way to gather them to your flock, a wheat. Then they will be yours forever and never leave your side.



Enemies: You will face five unique enemies and two unique bosses until the end of your journey. It won't be easy to beat them until you find out what they are capable of. Some of them use their claws, some of them use explosives and some of them use TOO MANY EXPLOSIVES.



Can you save your flock against the hordes of hungry creatures in this fast paced sheep herding action game?

2062210.name: Watamari Part1 - A Match Made in Heaven
2062210.about_the_game:
A never before seen style of yuri storytelling featuring high quality, Live 2D character sprites.
Volume 1 in the Watamari series!

Spies, a school for elite, young ladies, urban fantasy, science fiction.

From Kuro Irodoru Yomiji, the developers of Ne no Kami: The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto comes this new yuri title filled with intrigue and drama.

STORY


Spring.

Hoshino Hikari is a new transfer student to the prestigious St. Leanne Girl's Academy. While her transferring in is quite extraordinary, everyone is more interested in the ritual that takes place before the opening ceremonies.

During this ritual, some students manifest signs of the zodiac, and then are given an angelic title and a blessing. These students are known as the Angels of the Zodiac, and are given the role of bringing fortune to the student body. Hikari, who is trying to not stand out in order to root out the school's secrets, is bestowed with the grace of Virgo during the ceremony and becomes known as "Exousia".

"But... but... why me...?"

What is her connection to the other Zodiac? And what are the secrets hidden within the school?

FEATURES

  • Live2D animated character sprites that brings characters to life including each of their unique and cute mannerisms
  • Yuri-focused UI that displays two character's feelings for each other as if reading a yuri manga
  • Characters in this story are unleashed by the player! Even though each of the girls have their own lives, it isn't right that the player can only control the main heroine. A "certain voice" will help you guide these girls forward. The choice is in their hands.
  • Featuring beautiful artwork by many notable yuri manga artists! Hakuishi Aoi, tokeshi, Ukani Uka
  • Full Japanese voice acting
    Voice Cast
    Hoshino Hikari: Hanashiro Kazari
    Saginomiya Konoe: Iwamoto Sayori
    Saginomiya Homare: Kanoko
    Yata Hime: Kitaouji Yuki
    ???: Kimura Chisa
    Ikaruga Gargouille Risette: Akiyama Haruru
  • English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese language support
  • Partial binaural audio support. Experience the game as if the girls are whispering into your ear.

CHARACTERS

  • Hoshino Hikari
    The main heroine of our story. A spy sent by the "Agency" to discover the secrets hidden within St. Leanne Girl's Academy.

  • Saginomiya Konoe
    The elder Saginomiya sister who became Student Council President during the Leonine Revolution.

  • Saginomiya Homare
    The younger Saginomiya sister who supports her older sister's efforts to claim victory in the Student Council Presidential Election.

  • Yata Hime
    A senior student who cares about Hikari and treats her well from time to time.

  • ???
    A mysterious existence that uses "something" to guide the main heroine.

  • Ikaruga Gargouille Risette
    A rival of Konoe's who went toe to toe with her during the Leonine Revolution.

2062220.name: HEAVENSCAPE
2062220.about_the_game: HEAVENSCAPE is a 3D Y2K horror roguelike based in the early 2000s. Play as ANGEL,  an angel, traveling home from a party at night. Find a way home, or venture off the path; connect with friends, discover secrets, and explore the world.  Be careful about staying out to late - things are pretty scary out in the dark.

2062270.name: BoxLoop
2062270.about_the_game:
BoxLoop is a Platformer MiniPuzzleGame where you have to Decipher each puzzle related to a box color.
You Have to Heavily rely on dialog and solve the riddles to progress.
The riddles have to be solved relatively fast or the evil box will cause the time to loop again.

Solve the mystery of the evil box time loop and save our hero.

2062300.name: I am Bjorn : Escape Room
2062300.about_the_game: The clock is ticking, you have 1 hour…Can you free Bjorn from his imprisoned mind? Find yourself in his deepest memory within his childhood room solving puzzles and unlocking clues to defeat his lifelong struggles. There are sights and sounds to be discovered that will reveal the past. Pick up and examine almost everything and listen CLOSELY to what Bjorn thinks about each object. Do you have what it takes to help Bjorn figure out who he is?

2062330.name: Omega Squad
2062330.about_the_game:
Omega Squad is a top down shooter with RPG elements and simple squad management. You will have to manage your ammo, fatigue and active skills in order to defeat the biological threats. Level up to increase your marines's abilities and their active skills, buy weapon's upgrades and explore the levels to collect credits,ammo and keycards. Each Marine is unique and so is his weapon, choose the right one for the job.

Features:

-6 Handcrafted levels + Tutorial Level
-7 Omega squad marines, each with a different weapon,skillset and unique active skill, size and speed.
-4 upgrade levels for each weapon
-15 different enemies ranging from robots, organics and ectoplasms.
-Choose between easy,medium and hard difficulty to adapt your challenge level.
-Level up system which allows you to grow your marines to your liking.

2062350.name: May's Mysteries: The Secret of Dragonville Remastered
2062350.about_the_game:
May's Mysteries: The Secret of Dragonville Remastered is an exciting puzzle adventure game bringing a hand-drawn storyline with four worlds, 80 locations, 50 characters, 10 minutes of animated cut-scenes, and 270 brain-teaser puzzles that allow players over 25 hours of gameplay.

Follow May, an independent and charismatic girl, in her quest to find her missing brother. Advance through the cartoon-style drawn adventures by solving over 270 logic puzzles, tricky rhythmic games, and hand-drawn hidden object scenes. Search for clues about May's brother, visit mysterious locations and meet interesting characters along the way, which will help you in your journey.

Now in a Remastered edition with additional languages and enhanced graphics!

Over 270 mini-games: 230 logic puzzles, 25 hidden object games and 13 rhythmic games.


Travel through 4 intriguing worlds with 80 mysterious locations, and discover well kept secrets.


Meet 47 curious characters along the way who can help you in your journey.


Enjoy 7 minutes of hand-drawn animated cut scenes.


Charming hand-drawn graphics.


8 music themes.


Over 25 hours of gameplay.

2062380.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2
2062380.about_the_game:
Five years.

Five years on the run, spent hiding from surveillance cameras, police checks ... and friends.

In an attempt to elude the cult that's been chasing him, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is in Italy working incognito for a security agency when his client is murdered in cold blood by a sharpshooter. As the blood stain slowly spreads on the victim's clothes, Lars realizes there is only one way to keep his past from catching up with him: solve the case before the police and bring the perpetrator to justice as quickly and silently as possible.

A senseless murder, conflicting clues and an indistinct lead will thrust the former detective on another thrilling journey around the world, from majestic Rome to the Land of the Rising Sun by way of Jordan and India. With help from an old ally he thought he’d left behind for good, Lars finds himself swept up in a case far more complex and dangerous than he ever could have imagined, filled with international mystery and mysticism. And all the while, a much more personal danger lurks close at hand, one that Lars is determined to suppress and keep hidden from the world.

A new point-and-click adventure game inspired by the golden age classics such as Broken Sword and Gabriel Knight

Compelling blend of comedy, supernatural mystery, and conspiracy-steeped intrigue

Alternate control between Lars and his returning cohort Alice

Challenging but logical puzzles seamlessly integrated into the story

Explore more than 50 stylish hand-drawn HD locations across Rome, Jordan, India and Japan

Original atmospheric soundtrack and full English voice-overs (with German and Italian subtitles)

Sequel to the acclaimed "The Hand of Glory" (95% positive reviews on Steam), though no prior familiarity is necessary

2062390.name: Clockwork Survivors
2062390.about_the_game:
Need something quick?

Tired of spending a full hour beating a single run? Just want to get a quick boost of dopamine?
You have found the remedy, beat a run with haste, never lasting longer than you have patience for.

Simon says: Don't hold forward

The clockwork robot does not stop, neither does your shooting. Forget the hard work in horizontal movement and focus on the vertical.
Surf through the platforms and place yourself in the most likely position to destroy your enemies. Ride the motion and navigate through tight spots without losing a sliver of health.

Become the Bullet Hell

Collect parts from your defeated enemies to become even stronger, level up to become an unstoppable throng of projectiles.

Master the Pattern

Lap the same level up to 6 times and gather enough steam to fill your hot air balloon. Each time you finish one lap you make your companion happier and with the release of steam gain superior powers.

2062420.name: Battle Rift
2062420.about_the_game: This is Battle Rift, a sci fi, first-person shooter. It's like Super Mario only harder and in 3D and of course with weapons. The main mode is the "Challenge Mode" where you fight your way through 20 hard levels.

2062430.name: BALL x PIT
2062430.about_the_game:
BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

Ballbylon has fallen. After a meteoric and completely unexpected event annihilated the great city, all that remains is an ominous, yawning pit. Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return.

The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon.

Fuse Your Balls

The Ball Fusion system encourages explosive experimentation with over 60 randomized balls to equip and combine during your journey. Discover overpowered combinations and unexpected synergies from hundreds of possible outcomes.

Build New Ballbylon

Expand New Ballbylon with over 70 unique buildings that provide gameplay bonuses and unlock further power-ups, new characters, and more! As your community grows, task homebound heroes with automated tasks to keep the resources coming while you dive deeper into the pit.

Discover New Realms

Face legions of diverse enemies within the pit, battling through barren deserts, frozen caverns, savage forests and more. Each region offers its own unique set of hazards on top of hordes of increasingly challenging foes and mighty, screen-filling bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters

As you explore the pit you’ll encounter fellow treasure hunters eager to add their skills to your expedition. Each character has unique, upgradable mechanics that totally change the way you play the game. Experimentation and adaptation are crucial to the success of New Ballbylon!
2062430.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Italian, Polish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian
2062430.reviews:
“This is a must-have portable game, and I can’t say that enough.”
5/5 – Steam Deck HQ

“A roller coaster ride of ball-bouncing action that loves to break its own rules.””
8/10 – PC Gamer

“It will only take a single level to make you a believer.”
8.75/10 – Game Informer

2062440.name: Course Correction
2062440.about_the_game:
Pilot an aging, unreliable spacecraft around the asteroid Ceres, in this realistic space flight simulator. Featuring extremely detailed systems modelling, simply surviving a flight will require detailed knowledge of your spacecraft, its systems and the emergency procedures. Switches, buttons, levers, checklists, procedures, and with full VR and HOTAS/HOSAS support guarantee a hands-on interactive cockpit experience like no other.

  • Features • Detailed flight dynamics – Pilot the most accurately modeled spaceship out there. Trajectories must be estimated and refined by the pilot; no magic numbers or automatic guidance are provided. Every maneuver requires attention and careful adjustment.

  • Thrusters and propulsion – Engines and thrusters produce slightly varying forces, with minor instabilities, shifting center of gravity, fuel slosh, off-axis thrusts, and uneven output, making handling a precise, and skillful challenge.

  • Extensive spacecraft systems – Power, life support, communications, propulsion, and avionics all interact realistically, degrade over time, and can fail unexpectedly.

  • Advanced radio simulation – Every antenna, transmitter, and receiver is modeled with physical accuracy. Signals vary with orientation, distance, terrain, and interference.

  • Traffic control – Receive guidance and clearances from traffic control, while struggling with signal delays, dropouts, and intermittent transmissions.

  • Cabin and life support systems – The breathable air in the cabin, including N2, O2 and CO2 levels, is fully simulated, including multiple pressurized tanks, valves, regulators, relief vents and suit loop simulation - and the consequences, should the mix go wrong.

  • Thermal and power management – Heat generation, dissipation, and energy distribution all influence performance and survival.

  • Aging systems and malfunctions – Components degrade with time and use; valves freeze and stick, battery voltages sag, gasses leak, and failures occur unpredictably. Survival depends on problem-solving, and knowing the systems and backup procedures.

  • Environmental and orbital modeling – Detailed orbital mechanics subtly affect flight, adding challenge to navigation and landings.

  • VR – Designed and built for an unparalleled VR experience from the ground up. Also supports flatscreen play.

2062480.name: Bounder (CPC/Spectrum)
2062480.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1985, this unique platformer for home microcomputers from British developers Gremlin Graphics saw players take on the role of a constantly bouncing tennis ball, trying to make its way across a surreal landscape. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Included are both the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions.

Gameplay

From a top down perspective, control the constantly bouncing tennis ball as the screen scrolls. Try not to fall off of the hexagon patterned floor sections. Land on special tiles to activate a number of effects, from a temporary glide, to teleportation, to a grab bag of bonuses or detriments.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options
2062480.reviews:
“Bounder's main appeal lies with its excellent graphics and sound: they really are quite stunning. The landscape the errant tennis ball springs over is very pretty indeed though it can get confusing as to what's dangerous and what isn't. Bounder is very neat indeed - it's fairly addictive and both pretty to see and listen to.”
91% – Amtix! (June 1986)

“I’ve got to give it to Gremlin Graphics for originality — I have never seen a game like it before. Once you start off, bouncing all over the place, it becomes quite addictive, operating your ball and dodging low flying birds and other weird looking nasties. [...] Gameplay is quite fast so you don’t get bored: there’s no way this one can get monotonous. Bounder is a game I can recommend.”
90% – Crash! (June 1986)

2062520.name: Roxy Raccoon 2: Topsy-Turvy
2062520.about_the_game:
Experience tilt maze action like never before; when a wicked witch casts her curse upon the world, it is up to one raccoon cub to stop her! Play as Roxy as she rolls through three unique worlds in order to end the witch’s evil plan!

Roxy Raccoon 2: Topsy-Turvy is a Tilt Maze/Labyrinth style game with unique mechanics, boss battles and powerups. Play through the next chapter in the Roxy Raccoon Saga, compete in various game modes and customize & create your own levels, then share them with the world!

Classic Tilt Maze Action with Powerups, Boss Battles and Creative Puzzles!

Create and Share your own levels with the world and Download others off the workshop!

3 Distinct Biomes, each with their own unique mechanics and traps!

Multiple Game Modes: Story mode, Arcade, Time Trials, Maze Generator & Custom Level creation!

Rapid Ryan’s Arcade: Experience a collection of minigames unrelated to the main experience.

Online Achievements and Leaderboards will showcase your mastery to the world!

Customize your appearance as you unlock colorful new cosmetics and accessories!
2062520.reviews:
“Fun, varied, and imaginative — Roxy is quite a fun arcade game!”
8/10 – Game Grin

2062550.name: hololive ERROR
2062550.about_the_game:
About This Game

hololive ERROR: the Game is a first-person horror game based on the hololive ERROR series of 2D story videos.
The game can be enjoyed by players unfamiliar with the story video series, but those who have seen the videos will be rewarded with deeper insights and understanding.
We encourage interested players to check out the story videos and other related hololive ERROR content.

Story

The story is set in the town of Aogami, which has an ominous reputation in many circles for the unsettling legends and events that surround it.
The main character is a journalist for an occult magazine who is following a lead left by his late grandfather, also a journalist.
His investigation takes him to Aogami, and the paranormal phenomena that await there.
One moment, he's in his hotel room, sorting through his notes and writing his article, but the next, he finds himself wandering the halls of a mysterious school building.

Gameplay

In the world of hololive ERROR, you are powerless to fight against the paranormal phenomena.
Neither do you have any way of hiding or escaping from the terrifying entities that lurk there.
Can you discover the important notes hidden throughout the levels, solve the mystery, and escape from the school?
There's only one way to find out.

2062600.name: Cable Clutter
2062600.about_the_game:
Cable Clutter is a puzzle game where objects can be connected to each other to change their behaviour. Puzzles can be solved by pressing buttons, automation, and some head scratching.



The game contains 48 levels that teach the player the mechanics and leads them to the solution of more and more complex problems.

2062610.name: Phantom Club (CPC/Spectrum)
2062610.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1988, this classic isometric game for the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC from famed publishers Ocean Software saw players take on the role of a superhero trying to defeat the evil overlord Zarg, who has infiltrated the Phantom Club, a collection of super heroes possessed with strange and deadly powers. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version, which contains both the Spectrum and Amstrad versions.

Gameplay

Make your way through hundreds of challenging rooms, dodging traps and hazards, and fighting your fellow superheroes that Zarg has turned to evil! Use your mighty 'Brainstorm' power to shoot psychic bolts to fight such fearsome enemies as the terrifying 'transforming beings' and the loathsome 'man-spiders'! Climb the ranks from Zelator (Beginner) all the way up to Ipsisimus (Overlord) - only then can you have a hope of defeating Zarg!


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2062630.name: WalkBot
2062630.about_the_game:
WalkBot is a quirky story-driven puzzle game set in a silly future - told over three exciting acts.

In WalkBot, you play as a new prototype of the product line "WalkBot." You have one purpose: to walk. Unlike other types of bots, WalkBots lack any special abilities (except for, of course, walking). Luckily, though, the head is detachable and can be attached to all types of machinery within the lab. So launch your head to move ahead!

2062650.name: Frostfall
2062650.about_the_game:
You are an experienced outdoorsman, accustomed to the Arctic North's harsh winters and rugged terrains. After a long, fruitful hunting trip, you load your catch-up and head home, but the region is deserted. Now, the icy wilderness isn't just a hunting ground – it's the only way to survive. The tranquil beauty of the tundra now transforms into a brutal battleground for survival.

In Frostfall, you must call upon all your skills and wit to endure the punishing weather, scarce resources, and the ever-looming threat of the unknown.

As the days become colder and nights grow longer, you will be forced to push the boundaries of resilience. Hunt for food, forage for rare medicinal plants, and create a shelter to endure the punishing blizzards. Be on the lookout for predators who roam the vast white landscape; they also fight their own battle for survival.

Craft tools from the resources you gather, upgrade your gear, and adapt your hunting techniques to outwit the increasingly desperate predators. Every decision counts, every step could be crucial as you navigate the intricacies of survival in this ever-changing frozen world.

In Frostfall, survival isn't just a goal; it's the only thing that matters. Explore the breathtaking, deadly beauty of the Arctic tundra and discover what you're truly capable of in the face of adversity. The hunt for survival has begun.

2062660.name: Cyber Drift

    Game Features


    • Beautiful graphics.
    • Support importing local music, local decal pictures.

    • Steam achievements, Steam leaderboards, Steam cloud support.
2062660.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil

2062690.name: Tour de France 2023
2062690.about_the_game:
Create your own cyclist and become a professional in Pro Leader mode. Choose your specialisation and physical attributes, then compete in races to upgrade your skills and ultimately become the best cyclist in the world. The Tour de France 2023 and the year's major classics are yours to win!

In Tour de France 2023, you can manage your own team over a full cycling season in Pro Team mode. Start at the bottom of the world rankings, upgrade your team and show your tactical acumen to get noticed by the organisers of the biggest international races and be invited to race against the best.

Compete against other members of the community and prove you belong among the elite in the Race of the Moment world rankings. New challenges await every week: win a race as fast as possible, claim the yellow jersey or score the most points as possible in the mountains classification. No matter where your talents lie, everyone has a chance to shine.


  • All 21 official stages of the Tour de France 2023
  • Updated rider and team ratings
  • New Medium Mountain and Agility rating added
  • New ""grupettos"" between riders added
  • New challenges added to Race of the Moment mode
  • A new mode has been introduced: Descent of the Moment
  • Distinctive bibs added for ""super combative"" and the best team
  • Improved rider behaviour and trajectories for more realistic races
  • Updated equipment items and official brands


To add more realism to races and more variety in the race to win the Tour de France, ratings for Medium Mountain and Agility have been added. Based on the rider selected, playing and controlling your rider is now different. It's easier to reach maximum speed and to take certain trajectories tightly with a rider like Wout van Aert than with Primož Roglič.

But be careful, because the lower the Agility rating of your cyclist, the more control you need!

To add more immersion to the core of Tour de France 2023, we added two new bibs this year. You can now see and wear the ""super combative"" bib and the best team bib. Prove you deserve to wear these distinctions by showing your panache!

Just like in real life, the riders now have the possibility to organize themselves in Grupetto to finish a stage quietly and keep their strength for the rest of the race. The riders also know how to regroup to form the morning breakaway and thus be more efficient to give more trouble to the teams leading the chase!

In Tour de France 2023, trajectories and collisions have been redesigned so you can navigate within the peloton more easily. Thanks to these improvements, you can reposition yourself more easily and prepare for the end of the race as ideally as possible.

All ratings have been updated based on the results of the riders' last season so that they reflect reality and the latest performances of professional cyclists.

The Race of the Moment mode has also been updated with new challenges, races and optimisations that add more variety. There's also a brand-new mode: Downhill of the Moment.

2062710.name: Drunkle Ted's Wet and Reckless

2062750.name: A Path to Light
2062750.about_the_game:
♦ One after another, each step is important.

♦ The goal is to find a way to solve the puzzle by reaching the light, in this process you need to explore the possibilities and develop your skills to discover the rules.

♦ You guide your steps in four directions, up, down, left and right.
♦ CONTROLS: WASD or Arrow Keys (grid based movement)

♦ 40 unique handcrafted levels. ( ~1 hour gameplay)
