2062770.name: Lands of Crown
2062770.about_the_game:
Lands of Crown is a top-down roguelike focusing on player-choice and replay-ability in a simulated, dynamic, and randomly-generated world. By drawing heavy inspiration from Streets of Rogue and other roguelites, the player can do what they want, how they want. Complete quests, conduct trades, gain levels, use abilities, steal weapons, all while trying to survive in a world that reacts to itself, and you.

Win the game by taking the Crown, through any way you can. Use the overwhelming strength of a warrior, the shadowy stealth of an assassin, the smooth words of a bard, or even the spells of a witch or wizard to seize the Crown. The choice is yours on how you want to play.


  • Play as any class you want. Sling around a sword or spell, or avoid combat entirely. If you can find a character in-game, you can play as them.
  • Explore randomly-generated worlds full of different environments and towns. Travel from the frozen wastes, to the humid swamps, to the enchanted forests,
  • Experience advanced AI where characters react to everything around them. NPCs will explore, investigate, follow, evict, attack, flee, and even use abilities.
  • Complete quests, trade, and fight (in your own way) to level up and grow stronger. Find weapons, tools, and secret characters to aid you along the way.

2062780.name: SharkDrag Episode 5: Uniting the 5 Kingdoms
2062780.about_the_game:
In episode 5 we join our hero, Roy, as he learns of the upcoming return of the infamous beast known as SharkDrag. New friends join the party as he works to shut down portals that have popped up throughout the connected kingdoms and slow the invasion of monsters plaguing the citizens. Tensions between the different kingdoms have only divided the land. To have any chance of survival against the great beast and his vast armies, they must fight back as one. Peace must be established once more. They must prepare, but can they do so in time? Will Roy's words of warning fall flat on stubborn old kings?

~

It's an old school pixel-styled roleplaying game made by a husband and wife team of two using RPGMaker VX Ace.
Explore the map in third person, fighting (or fleeing) any monsters that pop up during your travels. Battles are fought in first person, against custom drawn monsters.
Gather a party as you go through the main storyline and find sacred gear as you complete quests.
Mainly played via keyboard.
This "Episode 5" is the first of the series to be released, with many more planned for the future.
The game contains religious content in a positive setting found mainly through exploration.

~

A future update (2.0) to this game we plan on coming out with more puzzles, boss monsters with alternative outcomes, and village home raiding will be a choice and have an effect on morality which in turn will affect the ending.

2062790.name: C.H.A.O.S.
2062790.about_the_game:
control echo operator, a combat assistant droid that is made for highly dangerous encounters and join the C.H.A.O.S. team , a team of highly skilled Private Military Contractors who specialize in difficult missions, they are the Combat Heavy Advanced Operations Squad. follow the downfall of the C.H.A.O.S. team when greed comes into the play.

the game is VR rail shooter inspired by classic arcade rail shooters, that integrates the reaction speed and fun of the arcades and brings the movement and freedom of Virtual Reality. the game also has a energetic soundtrack provided by UAMEE.

In this game: You shoot down enemies and after you have shot down every enemy you progress to a next area. If you have progressed till the end of the level there will be display showing your time and score. Currently the game has one level but we plan to release three levels.

2062800.name: Blockhead 2D
2062800.about_the_game:
Blockhead 2D is a love letter to old school platformers starring the Blockhead family: James, Jeb, Jack & Jill, each with their own personality and special moves. Its intuitive controls and addictive gameplay were the result of 8-bit influences such as Mario Bros, Bubble Bobble, Joust and Balloon Fight. What separates Blockhead 2D from the rest of those classic but cute games of old is the violent and disgusting techniques these siblings use to stomp each other's heads in to win the bout. It's easy to pick up and play, yet requires skill and timing to master. With local LAN and split-screen, it's sure to recapture the memories of sitting on the couch and playing competitively with friends and family.

The goal of Blockhead 2D is dependent on the gamemode. For the Player VS CPU singleplayer mode, you must defeat your opponent by using your various special moves and jumping on their head. In the splitscreen and LAN modes, it's much the same, but with friends!

There are, however, unique gamemodes that were developed during certain holidays, each of them having a different goal!

In this gamemode, you are greeted by gloomy lighting and music to fit the level. The goal of this gamemode is to smash 10 pumpkins as fast as you can! Speedrun it, if you like!

Like the Halloween mode, the goal is to smash things. This time, the targets are turkeys. They like to fly away and trick the player into thinking they're going to be still. Don't let the fact that they herd around each other fool you; They scatter as soon as you approach. Play this one alone or with friends!

As the player(s) jump into a room with sleigh bells, their goal is to chase a very elusive Santa Hanz, jump on his head and make presents pop out of his bag! Smash as many presents as you can within a certain time limit.

My personal favorite due to the music and gameplay, the goal of this one is to catch Cupid (by jumping on his head) before he kills you with his homing arrows. Simple as that! However, he is incredibly difficult to catch in the air and his arrows approach the player(s) quickly.

You are not the one doing the chasing in this mode. Stay as far away from Leprechaunz, a whiskey bottle throwing, death poking gold guardian, who will also taunt you in Gaelic. In order to win the game, you (and only you) must capture the pot of gold as fast as you can!

As mentioned in the introduction, each character has different special moves and taunts!

James

This patriotic ex-boxer is still up and at 'em! In his older years, he has learned to wield his epic burps to thrust him towards his enemies! Beware of an uninjured James when he uses his incredible MEGA BURP, which will kill anyone instantly if he comes into contact with anyone.

Jeb

Brother of James, Jeb has fallen on hard times. He was hit in the head a lot and now he is slightly...slow. However, he can use his fantastic flatulence to boost him upward! Woe be to anyone above him when he uses his super fart.

Jill

Little sister of the family, Jill is colorful and vibrant! Her best qualities are her ability to evade her two big brothers. Although she does less damage, she is very fast when uninjured. However, when she is hit, Jill can activate a scream that drives her into a temporary berserk mode, boosting her speed.

Jack

I'll be honest, Jack is a psychopath. His jump is higher than his speed, making it so he can climb to better heights. If Jack is injured, he can let out a loud screech and kill anyone who dares to be near him.

If you're looking for a retro-looking, quirky fun time, check out Blockhead 2D now! Have fun. :)

2062820.name: Backroom Beyond
2062820.about_the_game:
Backroom Beyond is essentially a first-person game that mixes puzzles with platforms in a dark, harrowing environment that makes the player question the protagonist's sanity. Based on the internet myth, Backroom Beyond goes further and makes the player wonder if that journey is about something more personal than anything else.

The game basically has one objective throughout its 40 stages: place the red box over the button and open the door to the next stage. It seems simple at first, but it's not. Each environment has its own logic. If the player feels frustrated because something went wrong in his strategy, he can press the “born again” button, which will return him to the beginning of the level.

Each box has a logic.

Red: You can just push it and it's the only one that activates the buttons that open the doors.

Blue: It can only be pushed, and used to climb when it is necessary to climb to higher places.

Greens: It's the only carryable box. It is possible to throw it and also climb on top of it.

Shovel: When a box gets stuck in a corner it is possible to use a shovel to remove it from there.

The narrative has two main points. Drawings tell part of the game's story on the walls. The drawings have no defined authorship, which gives them an extra degree of strangeness. The second point is the existence of the guide, a being that instigates the player to think about his actions and even confuse his feelings with those of the main character.

Each scenario has a part of the story to be told, whether in the subway, in the snow, in the house, or in an actual backroom. Each place has its dose of tension and reflection.

The theme song chosen is Pérolas Irregulares by the band Terceiro Mundo Bom, whose clip has many similarities with the game's project.

Formation: Diogo Brandão (Voice)

Robson Riva (Drums)

Marcos Almir (Guitars)

Guga Leão (Bass)

I want to thank everyone who can have fun with this game and also who can enjoy the song Pérolas Irregulares by the talented musicians of the band Terceiro Mundo Bom.

2062860.name: Weed Runner
2062860.about_the_game:
Welcome to the big city. When the bills can't be paid, how far will you go to make ends meet? Weed Runner is a drug dealing, crime fueled, story driven, point and click adventure. Weed Running isn't just a side hustle, it's a completely new career path for Mark, who discovers just how lucrative it can be. But, is the payout worth the hustle?

Weed Runner is a point and click adventure at its core. Meet new characters, learn their stories. Discover a slice of life in the big city, from the dark alleyways to the seedy nightclub where the underground weed running begins and ends. Deliver drugs and knock one back in the bar. Navigate conflicts with rivals and in-house fighting. Being a Weed Runner can be a messy job, and sometimes deadly. But in a pursuit of happiness, was it worth it?

Features

  • Weed Runner is story driven with an eccentric cast, including your best friend who never seems to leave the bar, or the loader at the docking bay who probably shouldn't be doing drugs, but we're not asking questions, and even the Kingpin himself.
  • Deliver drugs across the city and explore every dark corner under the guise of a delivery man.
  • Highly detailed pixel art, that adds an immense amount of atmosphere to the city in crisp 1080p.

2062870.name: Fighting! Ms. Luan!! ─ Gold-digging Angelic Bitch Simulation
2062870.about_the_game:
Incapable of a loser to make a choice, I want all the money and men!

A domineering president, a gentle neighbor brother, or a handsome star, all of them are in my pocket!

The heroine Luan is a typical angelic bitch. In pursuit of profit, she is doing everything she can, her pretty face and body are her tools.

She is very good at using her innocent face and her delicate voice to cheat.

In the face of the excellent prey that she has painstakingly lured in the high and mighty elite, the gentle childhood sweetheart, and the warm and sunny idol - the cool-headed Luan carefully weaves different beautiful dreams to make the prey fall into her own net.

If it succeeds, it will be a success for all.

And if it fails to trigger the suspicion of these men, then it will become the pages of social headlines ......
Luan's happiness is in your hands!
Fighting! Ms. Luan!!

Come experience the fun of being a bitch!

2062900.name: Affinity: Fallen from Paradise
2062900.about_the_game:
Fallen from a world above, you wake up dazed in a new world. What is this world, how did you get here. With the past clawing at you're mind, you set out to learn not just about this new world, but the one you left behind.

Embark on a non-linear story where you choose where to explore, what to fight, and who to save. Gain abilities so powerful they leave you reeling, fighting the wildlife to other worldly beasts and fend off your own insanity.

Exploration of this unknown world is the main focus, direction of where to go will be given but there won't be any hand holding.
The path forward has many keys, discover your own way forward. Master the magical depths of you soul, choosing between Fire,Ice and more to learn;
Or discover non elemental ancient magic to fight againist the other worldly dangers that lie to be discovered.

Features:

A story of struggle of and hardship, surviving againist unknown threats.

Use magical abilities to survive againist your enemies.

A vast skilltree, allowing to master a element or use them inconjuction with others.

Dense side content that is as rich as the main story.

Tons of different ways to engage with the combat, fueling multiple playthroughs.

2062910.name: Just Sign!
2062910.about_the_game:
Just Sign! is a chaotic tower defense for 1 up to 4 players. You have to mine, chop, refine and craft turrets to defend objectives from fearsome enemies like ladybugs, zombies or flying whales!
In Just Sign! you not only have to overcome your foes, but also dynamic maps. While working you will have to avoid traffic, chase minecarts for resources, defend your ship from kraken and move bridges and platforms to achieve your goals!
Play solo or with someone on your couch or over the internet! You will have to build a range of turrets, but most important - work together!

Build turrets!

Build ballistae, flamethrowers, rail guns, cannons and more to deal with different enemies. Combine turrets to get best effects!

Stop the enemies!

Work as a team and stop fearsome enemies like ladybugs, ships and more, but beware different types of enemies need different tactics!

Defend the towers!

Get together and save the world or at least machinery, beehives, ships from destruction.

Co-op!

Gather your friends and play together up to 4 players on the same couch or over the internet. Gamepads and split keyboard are supported.

Solo play

Want to play solo? No problem, whole campaign is designed for solo players too!

Take on the challenge

The game is easy to pick up, but should pose a challenge for everyone. You will have to communicate, divide jobs and also strategize! Different enemies and maps require different strategies - what worked on one map may not work on another.

Dynamic maps

Maps are dynamic! Avoid traffic, falling rocks, chase minecarts for resources, get on top of trucks, move platforms and bridges!

Refine, craft, build, reload

Seems simple? Maybe, but every map will still keep you and your friends on toes!

2062920.name: TTV4
2062920.about_the_game:
TTV4 is the latest volume of the retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame series Trip to Vinelands.
Made by the same developer of the arcade series UBERMOSH, TTV4 puts your reflexes and concentration to the test.

Each run is a bit different, exit the screen avoiding vines, blades, and spikes. Beat a hundred mazes.

The maze wanderer minigame series Trip to Vinelands started in 2016, polishing the challenge with each new volume, guided by an awesome retro hardcore community and priceless players' feedback.

2062930.name: Owinka Shooter
2062930.about_the_game:
Welcome to OWINKA SHOOTER.

In this masterpiece of gaming, you play as Owinka 427, who finds himself in the middle of an action packed journey involving an escape from an evil Owinka facility. The Owinka Television Institute of Technology Televesion is not a force to be meddled with, so be prepared for a wave of bean-shaped enemies, ready to stop you at any cost.

In this game, you are mysteriously given a gun with infinite ammo. You will fight your way through arcade-like levels and solve small puzzles along the way. You may find yourself in the company of a small friend from time to time...

With slight gameplay changes from level to level, this short game is sure to provide something for everyone!

2062940.name: Territory
2062940.about_the_game:
Territory is an immersive, atmospheric, crafting and survival game.

Your squad has left you behind enemy lines. Now you have to defend yourself until you can find a way out of this mess and back to safety.

Survive, craft, farm and explore.

Build your base fortifications to defend your territory against aggressive adversaries and wild animals.

Trade with NPC traders to sell your loot and purchase essential items.

Build up your strength and weaponary to raid enemy camps for juicy loot and ultimately gain enough strength to escape the enemy territory.

Stay alert, you will be hunted.

Current Gameplay includes:

  • Single Player
  • Multiplayer
    (Hosted CO-OP or Hosted PVP via steam sessions. note: there are currently no dedicated servers only player hosted servers via steam sessions)
  • Survive
  • Explore
  • Loot
  • Trade (NPC Traders)
  • Gather Resources
  • Build
  • Farm
  • Defend your base against AI attackers (Raiders, Bandits, Vistors and Zombies.)
  • All AI enemy spawns and attacks are configurable in game settings. So you can play how you want to play with no enemies at all or lots of enemies for a challenge.

Please note the game is still in ealry access and under active development. You will need patience and be willing to communicate with the developer to help improve the game. Please do not buy the game if you are unwilling to assist.

2062970.name: Under Pretense Of Death
2062970.about_the_game:
Under Pretense of Death is a visual novel with hidden object and quest gameplay elements.

Welcome to a fantasy world! A world in which magic is as powerful as ever and technology is already able to feed the starving cities of humanity. Where on a far-off island, the Faerie and Elven aristocracy rule, and people live alongside Orcs, Trolls and Gnomes.



A half-blood elf girl, Solis, travels to the Fairy Kingdom to fulfil the last wishes of her dead friend. This event marks the beginning of a chain of mysterious events in which Solis will need to find her place in this city, make new friends and perhaps even meet the love of her life?

Solis is not a warrior. Armed only with her wits and her charm, she weaponizes these as best she can. Regardless, you would do well to be careful around her!

Find items, explore locations, learn new information from characters and make the choices that you think are right!



Make new friends… and maybe some enemies? Every choice affects not only your relationships with other characters, but the destiny of the whole city! There are 4+ different characters available for romance. Each of these characters have their own different personality, story and role in the coming conflict.

Will you choose a faction and stay with your lover, or will you set out on your own and choose to stay by yourself? The choice is yours!


- Mix of visual novel and hidden object game
- Mini games
- 4+ love interests
- Animated characters
- Partial voice over
- Original soundtrack

2063000.name: The Clown's Forest
2063000.about_the_game:
The Clown's Forest is a Survival Puzzle Horror Game made in RPG Maker MZ.

STORY
You play as Michael, an 18-Year-old College Student, who had gone camping with his friends over the weekend, although, unfortunately for them, it turned from a peaceful getaway to a fight for survival.

A Clown from the nearby closed-down amusement park is hunting them down through the forest, they say the Clown lost his mind when the amusement park started losing investment and customers. On the closing day of the park, the clown snapped and kidnapped kids and adults one by one, never to be seen again.

The Clown eluded capture and has been hiding out in the forest ever since... kidnapping those that stray too far into the forest at night.

Can you rescue your friends? or will you die trying?

Gameplay Features:

Puzzles - Simple Puzzles help break up the exploration and chases

Highly Detailed Maps - The Maps have been hand-crafted

Compelling Cast of Characters - Characters have been written to feel alive and very realistic

Intriguing Story - Unveil the Story behind the Clown, and try and rescue your friends.

Chases - The Clown won't let you win that easily, Avoid him at all costs.

Multiple Endings - Everyone's Fate is in your hands, be careful what you choose.

2063010.name: SUSHI ALONe
2063010.about_the_game:
In the year 20XX, when Japan's food culture has declined, the last remaining sushi chef rises up!
Opening a sushi restaurant with only one person!


■ Story
20XX, Japanese food culture is fading.
My father, the last sushi craftsman in Japan, was unexpectedly hospitalized.
His words to me were, "Take care of the rest!".
And then, the one-man operation conveyor belt sushi business suddenly starts!

■ Game
- Run a sushi restaurant in 60 seconds per game
- Offer sushi according to the customers' orders
- Increase your restaurant's rating by delivering fresh sushi as soon as possible
- Aim for high scores when your restaurant's rating ups and more customers come.

■ Restaurants
- Prefectures across Japan become the motif for the restaurants
- Each restaurant has a different gimmick reflecting its local impression

■ Sushi
- In addition to the basic Nigiri and Gunkan sushi, each restaurant offers sushi that looks like a local specialty.
- Level up sushi using EXP you earned from offering sushi

■ Avatars
- Change your sushi craftsman's outfit freely with avatar items available in the game

■ Partners
- Bring partners available in the game to the restaurant and activate skills that can benefit you
- A variety of local partners available

2063020.name: Sunken Sky
2063020.about_the_game:
Welcome to Sunken Sky

Our kingdom was once engulfed in a neverending conflict. We shook the very foundations of the world to end it, unaware of the consequences it would cause. Yet we had to move on. We had to rebuild. We had to forget. 

Join our unlikely protagonists in their adventure. Nameless girl seeking to traverse across the kingdoms. A survivor driven by guilt. A noble with too much to prove. Their paths will cross and, perhaps, so will their goals. 

Sunken Sky is a metroidvania mixed with a hefty dose of JRPG elements. It's a (mostly) lighthearted story of self-development, hope and discovery. 

Game features

Fend off all sorts of monstrosities in your path - ranging from the weakest and squishiest critters to ferocious and mighty bosses. 

Explore vast and interconnected world. Climb the hazardous mountains, investigate an enchanted forest, find secrets hidden deep underground. 

There might not be a fishing mechanic but there are other various optional minigames to keep you entertained. 

Hundreds of hand drawn illustrations to accompany you in your journey.

Neon-infused katana action in a fever dream Tokyo!

・Unrelenting katana combat: Slash, stab and parry your way through hordes of monsters inspired by Japanese demons

・Blood is the key to survival: Use 10 different blood skills to overcome challenging enemies, then suck in their blood to replenish your health and skills

・Fever dream Tokyo: Explore neon-drenched renditions of real places like Shinjuku, Akihabara or Shibuya

・Enjoy Tokyo's nighlife: Between missions you can relax in your own apartment in Shinjuku, buy decorations and play minigames in the city hub

2063110.name: Elemates
2063110.about_the_game:
Are you ready to find friends for life?

As the young girl Mayha breaks with the traditions of her tribe and supersedes her brother in the mystical trial of their god, Quetzal, she doesn’t expect to meet the banished god of death, Xol. She wants to prove her worth to the tribe. He wants to finally leave his prison and break free again. While they are as different as day and night, the unlikely duo has to work together to reach their goals: Finish the trial of Quetzal and face the wicked god.
Join the fantastic adventure of Elemates and accompany Xol and Mayha on their journey as they become friends and teammates during their difficult quest.

Twin-stick shooter with living crosshair

The two protagonists are linked together by the power of a magical glove called "Band of Humility" that always points at the dog guide, Xol.
Shooting from this glove means your are always shooting at Xol. While each shot he takes empowers his abilities, it also means that you have to continually watch both characters' relative positions in order to fight whatever comes your way or solve the temple's puzzles that require clever positioning and timing.
Teamwork is everything.

The power of the elements

Utilize three powerful elements with distinct mechanics to destroy walls, block projectiles and teleport across vast chasms.
In order to use the inherent ultimate abilities of Fire, Earth and Lightning, both your dog guide, Xol, and the Band of Humility need to be charged. This is done by hitting Xol himself or hitting enemies that stand in your way, respectively.

Hand-painted Aztec-inspired environment

Discover the god Quetzal's ancient temple on your way to the top of the pyramid. Within these hand-painted, painstakingly constructed environments, coordinate the two characters simultaneously to solve challenging puzzles, dodge deadly traps and fight the ancient stone guardians of the structure. This is a journey through different biomes that gradually show the growing magic influence of the old god on your surroundings. Walk from freezing water through the arid steppes, continue on through the jungle's twilight and finally face the fire of the mountain itself.




About Elemates' origins

Since 2011 the University of Applied Sciences Mittweida has been offering the degree course Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment and has been educating creative media specialists and computer scientists ever since. The goals and content of this bachelor degree course are shaped by the current job profile of the modern media informatics / game development industry. The study program aims to train graduates in both the disciplines of media technology and media management and computer science core disciplines to form a comprehensive, interdisciplinary basis.

During our fifth semester all the media informatics students of the 2015 matrikel took part in developing our very own video game within a development team of 79 students over the course of 4 months. Following the beta, our very own games conference / release event was held at our university. We are proud to present our final project of four month's work to the public. We'd like to thank our diligent team leads, our great project teams, our helping hands, friends, family and everyone else who has given us their patience, strength and trust for those four months. We are proud of our game and hope you'll have fun playing it.

2063170.name: AEGIS Kingdoms
2063170.about_the_game:
A TRUE ROLEPLAY EXPERIENCE (RPMMO)

AEGIS Kingdoms is a living, breathing world built for roleplayers by veteran roleplayers. Every choice, action, and interaction unfolds through in-character storytelling, collaborative adventures, and player-driven narratives. Here, your character’s journey is defined by your decisions, alliances, and roleplay—not button mashing, zone grinding, dailies or anything like that. There are no traditional combat mechanics.

GAME MASTERS AND DICE

Game Masters (GMs) guide the world, narrate on behalf of NPCs, and oversee situations including combat. They lead monthly episodic events for players to participate in. Dice rolling is used to resolve outcomes in a fair and immersive way, ensuring your choices carry meaningful consequences in the story.

EPISODIC CONTENT

Content (from quests and adventures, to new monsters, mounts and more) is released episodically. These can range from time-limited journeys, to entirely new continents. Temporary political alliances, to major, terrain changing updates. The episodic release cycle allows for fresh, intriguing and new content available for both veteran and fresh characters.

DEEP LORE, EASY TO LEARN

AEGIS Kingdoms is built in such a way that requires a minimal amount of lore for you to know before you login for the first time. We've created a "getting started" video to help you learn the important bits, as well as providing a wiki with literally everything else for viewing at your own pleasure. We are also active within the community to answer questions also.

We encourage players to learn the lore as they go through roleplay. This reduces the opportunities for metagaming (accidental and purposeful), allowing you and your character to learn on the go. We believe this creates much more authentic and well-rounded characters, providing a more immersive experience for everyone.

COMMUNITY AND SAFETY

There is absolutely no tolerance for toxicity, cliques, or unwanted behaviour. We've been there, done that, got the t-shirt. For too long this type of behaviour has plagued roleplaying environments, spoiling it for everyone. So we're taking a stand.

AEGIS Kingdoms fosters a wholesome, creative, and supportive environment, encouraging collaboration, storytelling, and fun for all players. Our rules strictly prohibit toxic, clique behaviour, which will result in account termination if broken.

ACCESS AND MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTIONS

The game is free to download on Steam, but requires an affordable monthly subscription to participate. Account registration is manually approved by our staff to safeguard the community from disruptive players and ensure that every participant can enjoy a high-quality roleplay experience. Approval is required before a game account & subscription can be purchased.

NOTE: There are NO other types of "micotransactions" present in AEGIS Kingdoms. There is no premium currency, ability to buy land or characters (ever, never ever), lootboxes (ew) or anything like that. Your membership is part of supporting the game alongside everyone else who enjoys AEGIS Kingdoms.

30 DAY FREE TRIAL

Gain unfiltered access to AEGIS Kingdoms with a 30 day free trial. 

A free trial allows you to play AEGIS Kingdoms without a paid subscription. It’s a non-restrictive way for you to test whether AEGIS Kingdoms is right for you, without having to pay any money.

All features are available for ‘Free Trial Accounts’. There are no restrictions. We want you to experience AEGIS Kingdoms without restraint and at your own pace. Likewise trial accounts are not treated any differently during events, sessions or the likes.

Once your trial expires, access to AEGIS Kingdoms will be restricted until a paid subscription is purchased. You will not be able to login until after this occurs. You will be able to continue playing your character once your sub is active.

WORLD FEATURES

  • Fully text-based roleplay progression with structured, clear progression pathways to avoid confusion. For too long 'progression' has been a hot topic. Now you know the clear milestones for advancing your character and gaining recognition.

  • Story-driven adventures and 'quests' managed by Game Masters who narrate and control the world around you, as well as spontaneous roleplay and adventure across the lands.

  • Always in-character world with designated hubs, to encourage characters to meet, but we encourage you to go off and have your own adventures.

  • Player-driven economy and trade to give you autonomy over your character's finances in a managed and fair way. (Yes we have made in-game features and wiki pages for item prices also).

  • Typical social systems found in MMOs such as friends lists, private messaging and forums for managing character applications.

  • Exploration and discovery of hidden locations. Some things have been left hidden for you to discover, and we encourage you to let others discover it organically also.

  • Dynamic events guided by Game Masters

Every character has the freedom to pursue their ambitions, forge alliances, and uncover the secrets of Sor'res.

We want the world to be fair and fun for everyone.

STORY PREMISE

The Realm of Men: Sor'res, has been scorched by the murder of King Arthur at the hands of his best friend Lancelot: the Betrayer. Usurping the Pendragon Throne which rightfully belongs to Arthur's young son Percival, Constantine, Arthur's half brother, has waged a 25 year war forcefully amalgamating the human kingdoms into his Grand Empire.

Fuelled by Dark Aether granted to him by a malefic force, Constantine has set his sights on the forgotten continent of Ophelia, rumoured to have an artifact so powerful that it prevents the evil force he serves from leave her infernal dimension. Guided by a clandestine cult who worships this malefic force, Constantine seeks to find the artifact so he can release his master from her prison and usher in an age of darkness.

Having mobilised the Grand Imperial Navy, many of the waters have been blockaded, especially near Ophelia. The Navy have been instructed to hunt any and every vessel that dared to sail on the sea, with limited trade routes allowed for the independent Southern Kingdoms.

Characters start off at the beginning of their journey by attending one of the Grand Empire's "Imperial Colleges of Learning" where they will learn about the world, the customs of the Empire and after graduating, the opportunity to join a Guild & conduct contracts with one of the five major factions.

The Relic Hunters

Delve into ancient ruins and forgotten corners of Sor'res, uncovering powerful artifacts that can shape history. Danger and secrets are never far behind.

The Adventurer's Guild

Explore the uncharted wilds, climb soaring peaks, and chart blank spaces on the maps of Sor'res. Leave your mark on a world waiting to be discovered.

The Mercenary Legion

Beyond the safety of cities, peril is constant. Protect travellers, navigate political intrigue, or carry out daring missions. Every choice shapes your reputation and the world around you.

The Engineer's Society

Invent, analyze, and experiment with the unique flora, fauna, and natural phenomena of Sor'res. Your creations influence not only your story but the unfolding of civilization itself.

The Settler's Union

Build, craft, farm, and shape the foundations of society. Every structure and resource you create becomes part of the shared world, impacting other players’ stories and the community’s survival.

QUICK "HOW IT WORKS"

  • 1. Join the waitiling list by registering on our forums.

  • 2. Your account will be manually verified by our staff.

  • 3. Age verify via your mobile phone. (Online Safety Act compliance)

  • 4. Watch our "getting started" lore video and write your character application.

  • 5. On approval, we will send you instructions to get your game account registered.

  • 6. Login and play.

ABOUT AEGIS KINGDOMS

AEGIS Kingdoms is designed to foster deep social interaction and collaborative storytelling. Whether through faction politics, exploration, or personal narrative arcs, every player contributes to a living, evolving world.

Key elements include:

  • Community-centric roleplay: The world is shaped by players and their interactions through roleplay.

  • Faction-driven narratives: Align with groups whose goals and ethics fit your character’s story.

  • Immersive exploration: Discover hidden lore, relics, and unique locations.

  • Character and story customization: Every choice matters; build your character’s history and legacy.

AGE-VERIFICATION

To be legally compliant with UK law, as outlined by the Online Safety Act (2023), we must conduct a free highly effective age assurance on every user that registers, including free trial accounts. Simply enter your mobile number to receive a one-time passcode. Once submitted, you'll be age verified. This is part of the account registration process.

2063180.name: The Tower on the Borderland
2063180.about_the_game:
The Tower on the Borderland is an atmospheric horror game, set in a gargantuan labyrinth.

You play as Erin, a special ops soldier who finds herself trapped in an otherworldly domain. Explore and find a way to escape from this haunted and imposing structure which looms ominously over the wasteland. The Tower is infested with grotesque insects and ghouls, as well as your demonic former squadmates. Meanwhile, a mysterious stranger is on a personal quest towards the Tower as well, carrying a burden that may aid in Erin's desperate attempt to survive.

KEY FEATURES

  • Action-horror gameplay and combat, with a careful consideration when to fight and when to flee.
  • Gather weaponry and equipment to even the odds.
  • Use your Radio to map out the Tower and make contact with your former squadmates.
  • A PlayStation 1 inspired visual style, with gritty lo-fi textures and ambience.

CREDITS

  • Designed & created by Jochen Mistiaen
  • Character models by Nic Freeman
  • Logo by C. Bedford
  • Key art by Artyom Trakhanov
  • Music & additional sound design by Fractures

2063210.name: Icarus Challenge
2063210.about_the_game:
Player is spawned on the island and can fly or walk around it.
Operation is different with ordinary VR flight games. Player has to move his arms as if they are wings. Since its flight movement is based on aerodynamics, player cannot stay same point in the air nor rise automatically. For this reason, It require a little practice to fly at first Just as need practice to ride a bike. This game is a kind of "sports" rather than "video game". It is unnatural to fly without feeling physical fatigue, isn't it.
However it makes you feel like you are really flying in the sky like a bird.

If you get to able to fly as you wish you might be little bored. Then you can try "Icarus challenge". It is very simple mission. Fly and stick your feather into the highest possible place in the monolith. You can check your ranking in the lobby. Aim to be the highest flying player!!

NOTE
If you're struggling to fly, I suggest you start by practicing gliding.
After pressing B button to correct view direction, Please jump from a high place and lean your body forward. You don't need to flap your wings to glide.

2063220.name: The Strings of Fear
2063220.about_the_game:
"The Strings Of Fear" is a first-person horror game that will shatter the boundaries of your sanity. Kidnapped and imprisoned in a nightmarish dungeon by a fanatical cult devoted to a malevolent higher entity, you must navigate the treacherous corridors and unravel the mysteries that bind you to the eldritch forces at play.

As you venture deeper into the abyss, the sinister whispers of the occult echo through the cold, damp walls, revealing a dark tapestry of rituals and forbidden knowledge. The cult's malevolent deity, a demonic presence lurking in the shadows, holds the strings of fear that manipulate your every move. Can you escape the clutches of this otherworldly menace, or will you succumb to the puppetry of the supernatural forces at play?

Key Features


IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE

Experience a truly immersive horror experience as you navigate a meticulously crafted first-person perspective, where each creaking floorboard and distant echo intensifies the terror.

Twisted Narrative:

Uncover the secrets of the cult and the higher entity they worship through a twisted narrative that weaves together elements of psychological horror and supernatural suspense. Face your deepest fears as you confront the unknown.

Eldritch Environments:

Explore hauntingly atmospheric dungeons filled with unsettling sights and sounds. The tension is palpable as you confront grotesque manifestations of the occult and witness the bizarre rituals performed by the cult.

Dynamic Gameplay:

Solve challenging puzzles and outsmart the cult's guardians to progress through the nightmarish labyrinth. Every decision you make could lead to either salvation or further descent into madness.

Eerie Soundscapes:

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric soundtrack that heightens the sense of dread. The haunting melodies and spine-chilling soundscape will keep you on the edge of your seat.

"The Strings Of Fear" is not for the faint of heart. Will you break free from the strings that bind you, or become a pawn in a twisted game of fear orchestrated by an ancient, malevolent force? Face your fears and prepare for a descent into the unknown.

2063420.name: CozyTyper
2063420.about_the_game:
CozyTyper is a new take on the typing game genre. By focusing on accuracy above all else, CozyTyper removes the pressure of a ticking clock and lets you focus on learning the muscle memory, through which you will naturally gain speed!

In order to simulate the most natural typing experience, in CozyTyper you type out full quotes sourced from games, movies, novels, famous speeches and more. As you progress through the difficulties, the quotes get longer and more technical to push your touch typing to the next level!




Anita has been an enthusiast typist ever since she received her first IBM Selectric back it ’67. Now that she has retired, she worked with her grandson to help bring her teaching technique to anyone willing to learn. Enroll in her course to and watch your stats improve! She sends you progress reports along the way so you can see your improvement in real-time. As you progress through the story, at the end of each in-game day, all of your successfully completed quotes will be unlocked for endless play in the Freeplay game mode. At the end of each in-game week you will also unlock bonus quotes at that level.



Freeplay mode allows you to practice quotes without the structure of the course, while still recording and updating your stats. You can have freeplay select between any of your unlocked quotes, or you can have it only select a specific difficulty from the settings menu.



In this page you can find graphs displaying the accuracy and words per minute of your latest quotes, as well as your daily progress reports from story mode.




Cozytyper comes with 3 different typing cursors, and 3 different typing modes. You can use either of the two color presets, of choose your own colors, to adjust the text highlighting to what works best for you!








imophi is a small game studio started by two friends with a deep passion for game development. We are so excited to bring our first game, CozyTyper, to anyone who might enjoy it. We have refined this game after a great deal of tester feedback, and look forward to continuing that work to make CozyTyper the best it can be. Thanks for taking the time to consider our game, and we hope you love it as much as we do!

2063480.name: Voltage High Society
2063480.about_the_game:
A FIRST-PERSON METROIDVANIA. NO GUNS. JUST YOUR FISTS.

You wake up on a decaying prison island overrun by cybernetic monsters. No weapons. No allies. You start with nothing but your fists and whatever you can rip from the things trying to kill you. Every ability you gain is a key that opens a new part of the world.

Voltage High Society is a Metroidvania built from the ground up in first person. Locked doors, ability gates, backtracking, shortcuts, secrets, and boss fights that test everything you've learned. Not a shooter with a map. A Metroidvania that happens to put you inside the body horror.

PUNCH FIRST. UPGRADE LATER.

Combat starts with your bare hands. Every new weapon and ability you find changes how you fight and where you can go. Melee-focused first-person combat rewards aggression and positioning, not camping behind cover.

5 LARGE AREAS. ONE CONNECTED WORLD.

Nemo Ultra is a dense, hand-crafted island built for exploration. Dead ends become shortcuts. Locked passages open when you find the right ability. Every zone connects, and the map rewards players who pay attention. Inspired by Tetsuo: The Iron Man and Escape from New York.

YOUR BODY IS YOUR PROGRESSION

New abilities are not just combat upgrades. They're keys to the world. Every power you gain reopens areas you've already explored, revealing hidden routes and secrets you missed the first time through.

BODY HORROR MEETS RETRO GRIT

PS1-era retro aesthetics meet modern lighting and creature design. Dark, oppressive corridors open into neon-lit arenas. The monsters are grotesque, the atmosphere is thick, and the world feels like a place that existed long before you arrived.

2063610.name: Pro Cycling Manager 2023
2063610.about_the_game:
Start at the very bottom or in charge of a World Tour team! Choose from 80 professional teams based on your preferred style and strategies. Contend with the attacks of the best peloton riders in over 260 races and 700 stages of the cycling calendar. From the very first race of the season to the last, your opponents are always over your shoulder.

  • RACES: 260 races and 700 stages have been recreated in Pro Cycling Manager 2023, including the biggest international races: the Tour de France, La Vuelta, Liège-Bastogne-Liège, Tour de Romandie and many more.
  • TEAMS: 80 teams are represented with over 800 professional riders (Jumbo-Visma, Ineos-Grenadiers, UAE Team Emirates, Trek-Segafredo…).

In Pro Cycling Manager 2023, you're the boss! As the sports director of a cycling team, it's your job to make the right decisions to take your team to the top of the world rankings. All the major aspects of building a winning team are there: race management, rider rotation, training sessions, recruiting young talent, upgrading equipment, defining race strategies…

  • MANAGEMENT: Consider the most important contracts and find new sponsors to help your team progress. Good financial management helps to maintain a trusting relationship with your sponsors.
  • RECRUITMENT: Monitor the transfer market and sign future riders to improve your team and take it to the top.
  • STAFF: Surround yourself with experts who know the cycling world inside out. Hire doctors, trainers and scouts to help keep your riders in the best shape.
  • SCHEDULE: Manage your riders' schedules, listen to their requests and improve their well-being to keep their morale high all season long.
  • FUTURE: Recruit cycling talent by sending staff members all over the world to scout the stars of the future.
  • STRATEGIES: Adapt your tactics based on the race, weather and your opponents to deal with the different attacks from rival teams and win the most prestigious races.
  • EQUIPMENT: Wheels, frames… Upgrade your equipment to take advantage of the latest technology and optimise your race performance.

In Pro Cyclist mode, you're the rider! Create your very own rider, show your talent to get yourself known, manage your contracts and join a professional team. Your training and first races are important and will affect your future career!

  • PROFILE: Create your own rider and select their starting physical attributes. Will you create a climber or a sprinter? It all depends on your objectives!
  • MANAGEMENT: Define your tactics with your manager to improve your skills and to try to replicate the results of the most successful peloton teams.
  • DEVELOPMENT: Improve your rider's physical attributes with the skill tree.
  • HIERARCHY: Based on race results and your performance, rise within the team hierarchy so your team-mates will help you in challenging situations.
  • TRANSFER MARKET: Listen to rumours from other teams and get yourself noticed to help your recruitment.

  • The entire 2023 season and the top official teams
  • The Tour de France route
  • A revamped Pro Cyclist mode with redesigned training sessions and progression as well as a new dynamic system for adapting to unforeseen events
  • Medium Mountain: rider ratings and stage terrain added
  • Redesigned world rankings based on the actual system and new page added
  • Candidate/selection system for the World and European Championship races
  • New race page with a search function and list of starters and winners
  • Redesigned race results page
  • Improved sprints
  • Greatly improved AI, including improved energy management for riders who save their strength in mountain stages

REVAMPED PRO CYCLIST MODE


Pro Cyclist mode has been completely revamped in Pro Cycling Manager 2023, and you now have more freedom to manage your choices. Training is now central to your rider's career and development. Determine the season's key moments and your improvement targets so you can keep pace with developments. React to every unforeseen event and make new decisions to handle your career's most precarious situations!
Physical development, specific training, special preparation for certain races, and a social life: it's up to you to find the right balance for all the different aspects under your control so you can optimise your rider's performance and guarantee success!

REDESIGNED WORLD RANKINGS


To be as realistic as possible, the rankings have been revised and are now similar to how they work in real life. The world rankings for all riders and for the season's races are now consolidated to make it easier to see individual results.
Rider rankings are based on a 52-week system, and the 2023 season will begin with the existing world ranking. There will be an update to the ranking each week, which will add and remove points from the previous version. The update will remove points from the previous year and will add points earned during the current year.
The world team rankings will begin on 1 January, and each team will start with 0 points. It's up to you and your teammates to win as many points as possible!

IMPROVED RACES


Improvements have also been made to the races to make them fairer. Sprints have been revised, mass finishes are now handled better and race endings are more realistic.
During races with stages and depending on the situation, riders may gain an advantage from the Grupetto, saving their energy for the days to come. This means some riders are fresher and more competitive during sprints and for the final stages at the end of a race.

Join the Mission

Rated 4.3/5 on mobile!

Survive, Repair, and Escape

2063720.name: Presence
2063720.about_the_game:
Presence is a Tile based Roguelike. Explore the world, fight in an engaging turn based combat system. and uncover the hidden truth behind Presence.

2063730.name: Alaryia

Step into a world forged by ancient power and shattered by ambition. Once blessed by the Immortals, the noble Mystics ruled the northern continent of Aramae’Salar, raising cities of glass and stone and commanding arcane forces beyond imagination.

But their golden age is ending. From the haunting Sea of Magic, leviathans stir—primordial horrors that tore nine great ships from existence. War looms, secrets unravel, and a fractured people must choose between pride, survival, and the shadow of their own making.

Uncover a tale of wonder, betrayal, and the fall of an empire. The first chapter of an epic saga begins here.

Features

  • Choices Matter! Your decisions will change your morality and how characters interact with you, the story, and how events play out.

  • 21 Unique Professions to level. Magic, Ranged, Mining, Woodcutting, Alchemy, Cooking, Lockpicking and more. Become the jack-of-all-trades or an advanced blacksmith, or let your combat professions do all the work.

Find your favorite city/village and create a community, and become loved by the people or raid/pillage and become infamous with a bounty on your head.

  • DnD Mechanics. As you level your professions you may get acrobatic or perception checks to find hidden treasures or navigate across dangerous objects. Sometimes you see the "roll" sometimes it happens in the background.

  • Cozy Homes! You will be able to obtain and buy houses all over the world and decorate it with your hard earned coin.

  • Arena Waves. Compete in the arena to prove you are the Champion of Alaryia!

  • No classes! Your armor and professions determine what can be equipped or what spells you will know. Become a berserker, mage, archer, or even a spell-blade. Create and mix powerful combinations for the ultimate customization.

  • Quick Travel! Learn spells as you level up magic to quickly travel around the map. Don't worry, if you would rather sport a blade or bow, local caravans will still transport you for some gold.

  • Crafting! Every main profession is paired with a profession to help you create useful tools, gear, and materials. Mining and Smithing, Woodcutting and Fletching, Fishing and Cooking, and more!

  • Customize the appearance of your character! Create the perfect character with many customization options.

  • Original Music! Our team consists of amazing composers adding custom music to fit the world of Alaryia.

2063850.name: Block Buster Billy

Combining these simple rules with carefully placed blocks leads to some very challenging puzzles.


  • Over 100 hand crafted levels
  • Turn based gameplay
  • Non-linear progress
  • Light math, but tricky level layouts
  • A goofy story about aliens visiting Billy's island

There are different paths you can take on each island, so you don't have to play the levels in some particular order. If you get stuck on one puzzle, you can go back to the island and select another level.

Levels are linked. Solving a level gives you a piece for the level you entered from.

For every new game mechanics there are a couple easy levels that serve as tutorial.

Some of the levels took me a full day to design, test and refine to perfection. I hope you'll have as much fun solving them as I did while making the game.

Who knows that the hospital is the real beginning of the nightmare, and the crazy professor will transform Zhengguangfengsha's father into a monster in the form of a Bose-Einstein condensate.

Don't be afraid, don't hesitate, don't be afraid, let's follow Zhengguangfengsha's brave progress and explore bravely. Fight against the crazy professor, save your own father, save those persecuted by the professor, save the world. For the justice and light in my heart, bravely face all kinds of monsters and fight without hesitation!

2063990.name: XanChuchamel
2063990.about_the_game:
Like in the old days

XanChuchamel is an old-fashioned puzzle-platformer, like those games from the 90's where the important thing was just to have fun. In XanChuchamel you will need skill on the platforms, it's true, but before that you will have to place them in the right positions.

How to play

The game mechanics are simple. Xan (the round protagonist) is able not only to move and jump, but he can also catch the special blocks that are within his reach. After that, that block can be placed in another position so that you can jump on it and move forward.




But that's just the beginning. Some special blocks can become a moving platform when injected with one of three movement powers: horizontal, vertical or diagonal. Xan can obtain these powers either from another block that is already moving, or from a power source.



And wait, because there is still more. In addition to the movement blocks, Xan can use other different special blocks. Each of them has different characteristics, so you will have to use all your neurons to use them successfully.

Secrets


Xanchuchamel is designed for everyone to play at their own pace. If you prefer to worry only about completing the levels, you can do it. Even if you get stuck in one of the difficult ones (and there are some), you can skip it and continue advancing in the game. If, on the other hand, you are one of those who want a bit more of a challenge, you can try to finish each level with the highest score, the Cup with Horns. To do this you will need to reach the end of the level before the clock runs down below 100%. And not only that. If you want to get the perfect level you will also need to find the three medallions that are hidden in each stage.

Worlds and levels (and bonus)


Xanchuchamel consists of 5 different worlds, each of which contains 10 levels. At the beginning, you will only be able to play in the first world, as the rest will be locked. But in Xanchuchamel the way to unlock levels is the same as always: playing. At the end of each level you will find a Orb of Power. As you get more and more, new worlds and new levels will be unlocked.
In addition to the Orbs of Power in each level, there are more of them hidden in the game. But getting them will not be easy. First you will have to find one of the Bonus medallions hidden (and very hidden) in some of the levels of the game. And finding one of these medallions is only the first step: by touching one, Xan will have to overcome a challenge against time to be able to get the Orb.



In addition to the languages listed in the bar on the right, Xanchuchamel is also available in Galician.

2064470.name: Micro Wars

Pick from 13 unique commanders, each with a special twist on gameplay and a unique ability. Maybe, you’ll pick Elias, the mechanic, who can research new units faster and cheaper than his comrades and can call down a healing beam to replenish his depleted forces. Perhaps instead you’ll choose Voltaire, the master tactician, who can leverage the terrain to his advantage and can construct a temporary bunker anywhere on the battlefield. Or, you prefer to rule the skies with Estelle, the flying ace, who’s aircraft carry heavier payloads to their targets and who can call in an airstrike to deal devastating damage in a wide swath across the battlefield. Craft a strategy suited to your specific playstyle and devastate your opponents!

With your commander, further customize your army by choosing 9 units to bring into battle. Will you keep an even mix of early and late game across infantry, vehicles, and air units or will you specialize to execute your strategy? Units follow a rock-paper-scissors model, such as flamethrower units burning enemy infantry to a crisp, but barely able to leave a scratch on tanks. With over 30 units to pick from, there's always a fresh approach to take to crush your opponents!

With a selection of armies ready to take to the battlefield, bring your friends along in online battles with up to 8 players. Maybe you'll team up to climb the ladders in the ranked matchmaking, or jump into a custom game lobby for a wild free-for-all. A builtin map editor and the Steam Workshop lets you explore endless creativity and map mode types if you aren't feeling like matchmaking. Or, perhaps you want to watch your friends and take notes on their strategies with the observer mode and replays?

Maybe you need a break from all that online gaming and you want to work through the campaign following Elias and Voltaire as they fight for the Union against the resurging Dominion forces.

No matter what mode you want to play, take Micro Wars on the go with a touch-friendly interface and an even playing field between mouse/keyboard and touch.

Micro Wars is a passion project with a small development team.

Set hundreds of years in the future on the distant planet of Aida, the shared open-world MMORPG, anime-infused sci-fi adventure Tower of Fantasy from developer Hotta Studio and publisher Perfect World Games, is now available on PC and mobile platforms globally. Players will be able to experience an anime-inspired post-apocalyptic sci-fi art style, freeform character development, and exciting combat through thrilling battles and exciting open-world exploration.

In Tower of Fantasy, dwindling resources and a lack of energy have forced mankind to leave earth and migrate to Aida, a lush and habitable alien world. There, they observed the comet Mara and discovered an unknown but powerful energy called "Omnium" contained in it. They built the Omnium Tower to capture Mara, but due to the influence of Omnium radiation, a catastrophic disaster occurred on their new homeworld.

Immersive Open-World

Experience a vast alien world full of beautiful open vistas and imposing futuristic structures.

Unique Characters

Wield the unique weapons of each character that grant different gameplay styles as you explore their compelling backstories.

Grow and Explore Together

2064670.name: Rogue Realms
2064670.about_the_game:
Embark on a quest to expand your horizons to every corner of the world and leave your mark on history. As your realm expands, you'll harness every resource at your disposal, create groundbreaking technologies, and erect towering monuments that will stand the test of time. But be warned: the clock is ticking, and time is your greatest adversary. Can you etch your emblem into the annals of history and secure your place as a legend for all time? The challenge awaits.

Rogue Realms is an empire building game in which you place tiles to expand the world and build on those tiles to gather the resources you need. Rogue Realms features full 3D pixel world to explore from any angle.

With Rogue Realms you can immerse yourself in the world exploring new biomes and building combinations to grow an empire to stand the test of time. If you are looking for a challenge to beat your high scores then you need to place your tiles carefully and build strategically.



In Rogue Realms you start with a stack of road tiles. You draw from the top of the stack, rotating each tile into place to expand your road network and reveal new lands. You will need to build on tiles to gather the resources your empire needs. Credits to pay for your expansion, food to feed your subjects, power to keep machines running and materials to construct buildings.

Growing the population of your empire will reward you with more tiles to further expand your empire. Quests such as building five mines will also reward you more tiles. If you run out of tiles it is game over!

As you expand the landscape you will discover new biomes, reveal the lore of your empire and discover new quests. Discover new technologies to access new building types and upgrade existing buildings.



Rogue Realms includes:
  • Endless 3D pixel landscapes
  • Strategy based puzzles
  • Play at your own pace with no time limits
  • Different races to play, each with unique play styles
  • Skill based placement and building to achieve high scores
  • High replay value - each run is unique
  • Many different tile types
  • Lots of buildings which can be unlocked via technological advancement
Rogue Realms doesn’t include:
  • Combat or violence
  • Multiplayer



I am a solo developer from Australia. I aim to craft experiences which immerse players into the games. Games have always played a large part of my life and I hope to makes games which play a part in others lives.

I am open to constructive feedback of any kind. I will do my best to respond to messages in a timely fashion and fix any issues which might arise.

2064810.name: CityDriver
2064810.about_the_game:
CityDriver offers you the opportunity to explore the streets of Munich with various cars. Master diverse missions and challenges, enjoy the fun of driving your vehicle comfortably or sporty and train your driving behaviour in traffic with other road users - all with authentic vehicle physics.

GAMEPLAY
In Freeplay Mode, you start exploring Munich with any desired vehicle from one of the many locations. The game options are completely customizable here: Do you want the usual traffic rules to apply? Should collisions with AI be activated? You decide! Random missions, which you can accept or decline, will be offered to you during the free play.



Prove your skills in the Driving Practice Training. Do you have so much control over your car that neither slalom nor swerving is a problem for you? CityDriver puts you to the test.

You can drive the following vehicle classes in CityDriver:
  • Sedan
  • SUV
  • Coupé
  • Compact car

The following engine and transmission types are included in the game:
  • Internal combustion engine
  • Electric engine
  • Automatic transmission
  • Semi-automatic transmission
  • Manual transmission

The cars have been recreated in detail and are fully interactive from the inside and outside.

Create your own vehicle with the modding tools! You can share your mods with the community via the Steam Workshop afterwards and thus expand the standard vehicle pool.

In-Game input will be able with the most common devices:
  • Mouse and keyboard
  • Steering wheel, pedals and gear lever
  • Game controller

GAMEWORLD


Detailed recreations of landmarks, historic buildings, statues, billboards, traffic signs and other local objects are awaiting you in Munich’s virtual replica. Explore parts of the city centre and use the Autobahn and the state road for faster rides.



  • Close to reality vehicle physics, graphics and sounds
  • Choose from various vehicle classes with electric or combustion engines, automatic or manual transmission
  • Authentic driving in a real city with actual traffic rules
  • Realistic AI behaviour with diverse vehicles and pedestrians
  • A 1:1 scale area of Munich's city centre and inner-city highway / freeway / state road
  • Refuel or charge your car at petrol stations or charging stations
  • Master various missions in driving practice as well as in the traffic training area
  • Freeplay Mode with varied missions and everyday traffic situations
  • Moddability: You can create your own cars or modify existing cars and share your mods with the community

2065520.name: Endless Nightmare
2065520.about_the_game:
game Introduction

"Endless Nightmare" is a 3D horror-based puzzle and stand-alone game. Test your logical reasoning skills by piecing together various clues found throughout the game. The connected story and horror setting will hopefully deliver an unusual game experience for players.

gameplay

This game is in first-person. You play as a police inspector James, your wife and daughter were murdered. In search of clues across various rooms of a mansion in order to find the murderer. The game has multiple endings, as you unlock them, the objective is to find the murderer who killed your wife and daughter. Don't be fooled by this plain-looking mansion, as dangers lurk in every corner, so be careful as you look for clues in the dark. Your goal, first and foremost, is to survive...

★ Investigate: Explore each room, open locked doors, search for clues to figure out the truth
★ Listen: Don't just rely on your eyes! Listen carefully to the sounds around you. Ghost will make noises when approaching.
★ Escape: Hide and seek, even if you are discovered by the ghost, but don't be afraid, you still have a chance to outlast. Run immediately!
★ Hide: You can find a hiding place, hide in closet or under table. Don't be seeked by her, or you will die, find a road to survival.
★ Strategy: Attract her by breaking vases or cups, then take the chance to explore other areas.
★ Attack: Don't want to hide anymore? Collect parts of the taser gun to assemble and let her disappear.

game features

★ Attractive scary story, creepy case, horrific truth, experience the thrill of solving a case
★ Multiple endings, unlock the different endings
★ Multiple difficulty modes, improve your guts
★ Avoid and eliminate the horrible ghost, exciting and fun
★ 3D design and exquisite graphics, give you the most realistic visual horror experience
★ Scary music, creepy sounds and atmosphere with jumpscares, please wear headphones for a better experience

story Background

The story takes place in a mansion located on the outskirts of Canada. James has locked himself in the house and vowed to hunt down the murderer who took the lives of his wife and daughter. After passing out from exhaustion, he awakes with a shock when an alarm goes off right at 10pm. When he revisits the crime scene, things get strange. The scattered documents on the floor, the locked door, the mysterious sob of despair, and a horrifying lady. An endless nightmare awaits...

2065560.name: Acanthoceras
2065560.about_the_game:
A Short wandering & running adventure inside of your own nightmare.
Everyone has already dreamed of being in an unknown place, strangely free in their movements, it was all fun and games... until "They" appears.



>_CONCEPT :

Acanthoceras is a fast-paced Horror/Parkour mixup where your only option is to repeat a cycle of fear, search, and run,
in the hope of escaping the nightmares chasing you.

The game lets you wandering in a abandoned hospital littered with puppet pieces.
A few papers on the floor are your only way to figure out what's going on.
You're free to move, run, jump, and slide...but will that be enough to escape?



Good luck and... Have fun.



"Welcome back old friend...
To come back here every night, did you miss us so much ?
Oh there is no need to answer...

You'd better start running don't you think ?"



>_TECH & HELP :

2065570.name: Silver Nornir
2065570.about_the_game:
The world has been destroyed twice by the origin of chaos. The only survivors of the catastrophe will stand again to try to stop the world's end.
Will the world follow its destiny to be destroyed?



Journey through the world with friends and allies and unfold new adventures!
Featuring a wide cast of characters each with their own story to tell, an intense battle system that includes magic gems, special moves, and combo techniques with other characters, Silver Nornir boasts of everything an RPG has to offer! Collect useful items and unlock extra dungeons for additional enjoyment!

2065580.name: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
2065580.about_the_game:
The Story

One day, a fox girl and her frog friend find themselves on a mysterious island shrouded by darkness but for a few floating lights.
Torii gates, food stall lanterns, and neon signs give light and color to the island. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

The Game

"Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino" is a 3D action/adventure game focused on the exploration of a mysterious island inspired by Japanese folklore. Kitsune, the titular fox girl, will have to go through exploration sequences and escape sequences where she is being chased by enemies.

In the exploration sequences, you will travel through the island, conversing with its inhabitants and kindling lights within shrines to reach new areas.

During the escape sequences, you will need to outrun the oni demons chasing after you. Kitsune can use light to temporarily blind these monsters, giving her enough time to find safe routes and hiding places. However, the number of times she can use this light is limited, and she has to recharge it at shrines.

Her light also allows her to banish darkness, find hidden paths, and run into more people to talk with.



Looming in the distance is the Tower of Muyo, shining bewitchingly with the lure of myriad stolen lights.
This is the tale of a long summer night, the night of the Jugoya harvest festival...

2065610.name: Rush Rush Rally Reloaded
2065610.about_the_game:
Rush Rush Rally Reloaded is a fast-paced racing game in the classic top-down style. It is an upgraded version of Rush Rush Rally Racing, which was first released on the Dreamcast and promptly sold out.

The fast-paced gameplay with precise "twitch controls" provides an intense experience for up to 4 players.

3 single-player modes
Grand Prix mode: Enter a series of increasingly challenging races. The 10+ tracks offer a variety of twists - not only in terms of road layout, but also with crossing cattle and other obstacles, jumpable ramps, shortcuts, and driving in the dark of night. This mode features multiple endings, depending on how well you played.

Time Attack: Practice all the tracks that you have unlocked in the other game modes. Complete multiple laps to see a "ghost" of your best attempt, and race against yourself.

Challenge mode: try to get enough distance between yourself and the CPU-controlled challenger to force them off the screen. But beware! As you leave your rival behind, you will be able to see less of the road ahead. Can you defeat all 4 challengers?

3 local multi-player modes
If you own multiple game controllers, you can enjoy the local multi-player modes.

Versus: Race against your friends in this split-screen mode. Supports 2 to 4 players.

Item Mode: Like Versus mode, but with a lot more mayhem. Pick up various items that enable you to shoot your opponents, drop oil slicks on the road, and more.

Get Ahead: Try to get enough distance between yourself and your friend to force them off the screen. But beware! As you leave them behind, you will be able to see less of the road ahead. Supports 2 players.

Core features include:
- Fast-paced gameplay
- 3 single-player modes
- 3 local multi-player modes
- Multiple endings
- Unlockable secrets
- 20 tracks

2065630.name: Goat's Tale 2
2065630.about_the_game:
Check new DLC, FOR FREE





Goat's Tale 2 is a game in the genre of precision platformers and is a sequel to the very well-received part one (over 40 thousand downloads and 84% positive reviews on Steam!). As in its predecessor, the player's main goal is to get to the top, but thanks to completely new mechanics as well as improved physics, this task should be a bit easier.

Overview


-New Mechanics
Many new mechanics have been added to the game, like the air current, in which our brave goat can move in 4 directions. Or special rock shelves that she can grab onto to slide down quietly without bouncing off walls. More graphic effects have also been added, for example, the player can choose between two graphic palettes.



-World Exploration
Goat's Tale 2 puts much more emphasis on exploration than its predecessor. At each stage, you can find buried treasures or npc's who will advise you on how to get over the more difficult jumps and drop a penny for their help.



-Cooperate with friends
The game features an all-new mode that allows you to cooperate together in passing levels. The second player takes on the role of a special helper, who can put up platforms that the first player can jump on, making it easier to pass the game's more difficult stages.

Goat's Tale 2 is:


  • A new bigger adventure.

  • Even more immersive gameplay.

  • Great music.

  • Fun with friends..

  • Beautiful pixel art graphics..

  • Challenge only the best players..

2065710.name: As The Light Goes Out
2065710.about_the_game:
As The Light Goes Out is an Emergency Rescue-themed Emergency Services simulation game. You will become the Emergency Services Commander, overseeing all actions and deploying teams to rescue the public from random disasters across the map. You can choose from the Police or the Fire Department to begin your career, become their top Commander and cooperate with other departments to protect the citizens and the city from danger.


As the Commander of the Fire Department, you are responsible for managing all kinds of emergencies, from small things like removing a wasps’ nest to significant matters such as a gas leak. While at the Fire Department, not only may you encounter fire accidents, but you may also come across natural disasters or emergent public events. However, there is no need to worry; firefighters with various duties and varied vehicles, as well as tools, are all at your service. You can keep the damage to a minimum as long as you reasonably coordinate the resources.




As the Commander of the Police Department, it’s impossible to maintain good public security without taking your hard work into account. From minor things like arguments in the neighborhood to major crime investigations, you must maintain public security for the area under your jurisdiction while cooperating with other departments to manage the live scenes for various incidents—for example, traffic incidents, safety precautions during the festive season, fires etc. Apart from daily responsibilities, you will also assign resources to lead crime investigations within your jurisdiction to arrest any suspects for solving the cases.




Although the Paramedics are the support unit, this doesn't mean their responsibilities are less important than everyone else. They will strictly follow your instruction to cooperate with any actions, stick to their assigned duties and do the best they can to save lives from disastrous events. They will choose the best treatment for different diseases, putting the patient’s health as their top priority. Whether it’s the burning flames or a rioting crowd, you can always find them by your side.




Whilst acting as the Commander of the fire department, you will be able to unlock wardens to help you handle disasters and ask them to investigate the scene in order to find the root cause of the fire. Once they have completed the investigation, you can also read the details of the fire on the investigation reports. Is this just an accident, or else?




As commander of the police department, you can send detectives to investigate and collect evidence on the target event. Each detective has its own strengths and weaknesses, which will bring different experiences through the investigation. You also need to make decisions based on the feedback of the detectives during the investigation process, lead the investigation to the right direction and eventually arrest the murderer. At the same time, pay attention to the safety of your detectives, it is also very necessary to dispatch back-ups in a timely manner.

Main Features

  • Distinctive maps - Every city has its own story and culture; try out the different maps and experience the unique features for yourself
  • Professional tools - Reproduce the real-life tools in-game to the best of our ability, so you are well prepared for any upcoming incidents
  • Varied vehicles - A diverse selection of vehicles,  utilizing unique vehicles for each city, allowing one of a kind experience for you as well
  • Variety of events - Random quests of all categories to avoid repetitiveness
  • Crime investigation - Send investigators to deep dive into the stories behind the crimes
  • AI assistant - All members of each department have been professionally trained and have a complete understanding of their duties and responsibilities
  • Building Expansion - Supporting the management and upgrade of Police and Fire departments, expand to unlock more vehicles with different functionalities
  • Emergency - Send orders to command firefighters in the buildings to experience the urgency of participating in rescues

2065720.name: Packed!?
2065720.about_the_game:
