Each box offers a fun, increasingly challenging puzzle to solve in as few moves as possible, as you push, slide and outsmart obstacles that stand between our friends and their path to freedom. They’re great listeners and will follow your direction in unison - for better or worse…



GAME FEATURES


* 120 carefully crafted levels of increasingly difficult puzzles.

* Rating system based on move count and elapsed time.

* A unique mechanic for each world you unlock.

* Simple controls.

2065750.name: Fogel And Porki Evil Arcade
2065750.about_the_game:
"Fogel And Porki Evil Arcade" is a game in the genre of "Match 3" with elements of a visual novel. Immerse yourself in the neon atmosphere of the arcade arcade and help the students defeat the Demon that broke into reality from the video game!
The visual style of the game is the aesthetics of retro wave - retro futuristic style of the 80s, which has been reinterpreted in modern culture.
The game recreates and ironically plays out the spirit and cliches of science fiction, action movies, horror films and arcade games of the 80s and 90s of the last century to immerse the player in the nostalgic atmosphere of the laser madness of popular culture of those years. We don't know what it is - postmodernism, post-irony or post-post and meta-meta. But in any case, do not take everything too seriously :)



Two very ordinary teenagers - they listen to metal, play video games and really like to stick their noses where they shouldn't. By chance and by their own stupidity, they free an ancient demon from a parallel space that was locked in a video game. And now they have to somehow solve this problem, so as not to remain forever in his slavery! And if we consider that the demon, judging by his appearance, is extremely indifferent to gachimuchi, then it is not difficult to imagine what can be expected of bosom friends in captivity of this fiend of the Quantum Abyss.



The main villain, evil incarnate. He is cunning, insidious, on style and pathos. As usual, he is obsessed with thoughts of world domination. The character is bad. Not married. In the distant future, he was defeated by a Warrior from the Fractal Dragon clan, locked in a video game and thrown into the abyss of the time continuum.



He's cool. Very cool. Incredibly cool. Avenges the death of the teacher and does not look back at the explosions. If we ever sell the film rights to the popular online movie theater rights, it will only be on condition that he is played by Ryan Gosling.
Waiting for you:
  • Gameplay "Match 3"
  • A story with lasers, battles and time travel
  • Bright characters
  • Retro wave aesthetics
  • Synthesizer soundtrack as if straight from the 80s
  • References. Easter eggs. References. Lots of references!
  • Irony

2065770.name: Guns and Rush

Horde Combat Shooter

Roguelike Mechanics

Bullet-Hell Intensity

20 Minutes of Thrills

Prepare yourself for an epic journey through the apocalypse, where danger lurks around every corner. Can you conquer the horde and emerge as the ultimate survivor?

2065780.name: The Gods Are Fickle

Dive into an unique experience inspired by the classics, a new take on the beloved turn-based tropes:

  • Fight off swarms, dominate in king-of-the-hill battles or outsmart beefy bosses; weigh your chances at secondary objectives that might alter the emergent story of each run.




And so does Athena, Anubis and the other entities drawn into this godly, mysterious plot.

  • Juggle your relationship with the 9 competing gods;
  • Backstabbing, politicking and roleplaying aplenty; watch the drama unfold, unveil the mysteries surrounding your patrons;

Manage your Collection through the Trials of the Host, a roguelite gauntlet experience, a blood championship of which no two runs will be alike.

  • Struggle against 11 enemy teams, randomly drawn each time from a large pool;
  • Manage your resources, your team’s Impetus & your Standing with each god;
  • Risk going on side-adventures;
  • The Souls in your team have their own personalities, backstories and traits. They develop relationships, hatreds & their own agendas;
  • Unlock new Souls & Artifacts, perks & interactions with the gods for future playthroughs

The core tactical mechanics can be at the moment played by anyone. We're constantly looking for feedback on how to improve the game and new ideas. We plan on keeping the development as open as possible and build the best tactical experience we can together with our community. Join our Discord to play with us!

2065800.name: Defending Lydia Collier
2065800.about_the_game:
Defending Lydia Collier is the story of a London-based lawyer called in to defend the wife of one of the city's most influential and wealthy businessmen who has recently disappeared.



You'll play as Mr Oakwood, Lydia Collier's lawyer and be with the defendant during police interviews through to the trial in court, working to review the evidence and help build her case. Along the way, you'll meet various other characters and experience the life of a currently single wealthy London lawyer.

Whether your recently hired nineteen year old assistant, a local police officer, or the detective in charge of the case catches your eye, you'll be able to decide who you wish to interact with and choose to pursue romantically.

Your Choices Matter!


There are dozens of different choices and decisions that you can make which will lead you to different characters, different love interests and completely different playthroughs.

As the story develops you'll choose a faction to assist you and form your team, and begin an investigate into finding out exactly what happened to the billionaire Charles Collier.

Enormous amount of content!

2065990.name: FREM Sprite32!

Play, learn, and experiment with programming in the Sprite32! 8-bit microcomputer sandbox. Use the high-level FREMScript programming language to write programs, create dynamic pixel art, and explore audio generation. Play tutorials and challenges to learn all the aspects of the system. Take a trip back in time to the early days of home computing with the Sprite32!’s 320x200 pixel display, 40 columns of text, 8-bit memory limitations, and 80s-era CPU speeds.

  • Get feedback in the status window for current system state, including program errors and highlighting.
  • Play with sprites, pixels, the color grid, and 3-channel waveform audio generation.
  • Save and load files, even swap out the default boot program with your own!
  • Challenges: Go deeper into FREMScript with specific coding challenges.
  • Discover programs and documents left behind on the drive by previous users of the system.
  • Synthesizer soundtrack featuring original tracks and music by Interface Type Seven

2066030.name: The Grizzled: Armistice Digital

Soon, they will leave everything they know to head to boot camp for training, and then, to war. Will their friendship be strong enough to survive it?

In The Grizzled: Armistice Digital, players take on the role of soldiers facing the Trials and Hard Knocks of the first World War. They work cooperatively across a campaign where they confront the major events of the war. From the introduction scenario of Boot Camp, through the nine different Missions, everything that happens carries forward and affects the next steps of the game. Players will need to make good decisions and support each other if they hope to make it to the end of the war alive.

2066160.name: SuuubWaaay
2066160.about_the_game:
SuuubWaaay is a single-player sci-fi horror game full of mysteries and monsters. You play as a detective investigating the closed yet unsolved case of the famous SuuubWaaay incident in 1991 but you end up going a little too deep. You now must defend yourself against the creatures inside the SuuubZone-how the SuuubWaaay gets around. Your main mission is to find the missing components while avoiding the creatures that are guarding them. When the machine is completed you should be able to reopen a SuuubZone and head back home. Although you should not worry, you are not alone! There are other survivors of the incident inside with you. They are counting on you to release them from the SuuubZone. Do not let them down.

TOOLS! USE THEM

Because of your past as a detective, you can use your tools to inspect and discover clues that may hold valuable information to solve puzzles or get you out of the SuuubZone. The tools are tape, a lighter, your bare hands, and more.

THE SUUUBWAAAY
The SuuubWaaay was the most popular form of transportation! It looked like your average New York Subway, but it was waaay more! With the SuuubWaaay, you could go anywhere within minutes! Unfortunately, something went wrong one day, it arrived at the designated location damaged, and everyone on board was gone.

THE SUUUBZONE
The SuuubZone. This is where the SuuubWaaay goes into and comes out of, this is how the SuuubWaaay gets around—designed by Sub Williams, the founder of the SuuubWaaay. Unfortunately, it malfunctioned one day and this is where you, and many others, are trapped inside.

THE CREATURES

Lurking in every shadow and corner of the SuuubZone are creatures. These creatures have inhabited the SuuubZone since the malfunction, now you must use the gadgets against these creatures you may encounter.

THE GADGETS
Made by other people, designed to help people like you. There are multiple of these gadgets that you will find throughout the SuuubZone. Use these gadgets wisely though, the battery life isn't longer than 3 minutes usually. If the gadgets lose battery while next to a creature... may God be with you.

2066270.name: Return to the Skyway
2066270.about_the_game:
In this 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer, you are tasked with helping Ezra, an aeronaut who has crash landed, traverse their way through a mysterious and uncharted island. Working with the local fauna to destroy obstacles in Ezra's path, you can clear obstacles littered throughout the island to progress ever closer to your crashed ship deep within the heart of the jungle. Along the way, using Ezra's high-tension leg and mechanical wing augments, you can easily jump around the environment and find three ship parts that fell off of the ship during crash landing. 2066600.name: Great Filter
2066600.about_the_game:
“Great Filter” is a 2D, top-down view, strategy game, with original mechanics. The game consists of 46 levels. Each level takes approximately 30-60 seconds to clear. The goal of each level is to get the keys on the left road within time limit. There are several steps to get the keys:
Step 1: Players should operate two characters working on mines.
 Mines are scattered in level maps. Some mines are near to characters, and some are far.
 Numbers shown on the mines indicate length of time to finish working on it.
 Of the two characters, the white one moves quickly but works slowly, and the black one moves slowly but works quickly.
 Although each character has different moving control keys, only one character can be moved at one time. While one character could continue working no matter what the other one is doing.
Step 2: When any character finishes working on a mine, it will get a diamond.
 Each mine produces one diamond once and then disappears.
 The diamond is in the same color as the mine that produce it.
Step 3: Players should operate characters to send the diamonds to “little universe”.
 When diamonds are sent to ‘little universe’, a brick will be generated immediately and automatically on the left road.
 Diamonds of red, green or purple generates a 1*2 vertical brick, and diamonds of yellow or blue generates a 2*1 horizontal brick.
 The road has 3 columns. Red bricks will be paved on the 1st column, green on the 2nd, purple on the 3rd, yellow on the 1st & 2nd, and blue on the 2nd & 3rd.
 The existing bricks can solidly support later generated bricks from below.
Step 4: Level is completed when any brick overlaps any key.
 In some levels, there are stars on the road. Every star will add 5 seconds to the time limit when it is overlapped with bricks.
 In some levels, there are black holes on the road. Bricks will be destroyed if overlapped with black holes.
To clear the puzzles, players should think about 2 strategies. One strategy is to figure out the right sequence of paving bricks which determine the sequence of characters sending diamonds. The other strategy is how to allocate 2 characters to different mines, usually faraway mines should be taken by the fast-moving character and long-working-time mines should be taken by fast-working character.

Typically, the triggers for this type of reaction are visual, tactile, or auditory sensations. In ASMR Food Experience, we will focus on combining two types of stimulus: sound and visual!

Run your own restaurant!

In the ASMR Food Experience, you play the role of the owner of a small restaurant. Some of your tasks in this simulator will be customer service. You will have to take care of proper deliveries, clean, take care of the herbarium and maintain the restaurant in the best condition. This will make a huge difference in the overall rating of your establishment, so you will increase interest, restaurant turnout and tips from guests.

Decorate and personalize

Your restaurant, your rule - would you like to have an Asian-style style? Or are you more interested in Mediterranean decor? Our simulator will allow you to run the business that best suits your taste. Decorate walls, change tables and arrange matching accessories inside and outside your restaurant! Over time, it will be more and more popular among customers, so you need to consider expanding your restaurant.

Omnipresent sounds

There will be tons of sounds in the ASMR Food Experience to help you experience the most desirable reactions - calmness, excitement, stress relief, and more. In the game, you will have full control over what sounds are in it: nature, cooking, cleaning, conversations or street sounds. Find something for yourself in this amazing simulator!

The world follows two basic rules

Rule 1: There is no physical collision between objects of the same color! And you, as a visitor into this world, also have to follow this rule.
Rule 2: Black color blocks all colors, including black color. White color can pass through all colors, but cannot pass black color!
These two laws constitute the basic logic of this world, and they make up the World-1.

In the World-2, I'll give you a wand which can paint and absorb color. This brings many interesting but difficult puzzles.

This game has three worlds and a total of 43 levels. But in order to pass this game, you are not required to pass all levels. And the order of playing them is up to you, you only need to complete enough levels in one world, then you can challenge the final-test level of this world, and after passing, you can enter the next world. In the final-test level of the last world, you will use your knowledge and skills to face the final boss.

The game has a flashback function. I will save your state after you paint or absorb color. You only need to press the flashback button to return to the previous state. You can press it unlimited times, so you don't have to worry about making mistakes.

The world's champion is dead. Guess it's your problem now.

Ragtag Heroes is a co-op roguelike deckbuilder for 1-3 players where co-op isn't a mode - it's the whole design. The real magic happens between your decks, not just inside them. Combine your heroes' abilities, set up devastating team combos, and watch your perfect plan come together - or fall apart in real time.

BUILD DECKS THAT COMBO

Every hero has their own cards, relics, and playstyle - but the best moments happen when they collide. One hero locks an enemy in place while another unloads everything they've got. Swap teammates between runs to discover entirely new strategies.

CONTROL THE BATTLEFIELD

This isn't just a card game - positioning matters. Shove monsters away from your weakest hero. Drag enemies into range of your hardest hitter. Lock them in place or punish them for moving - but watch out, they'll try the same on you.

CONTROL THE TURNORDER

Drain an enemy's initiative to zero and watch them stand there, helpless, while your team piles on. Strategically slow down the most dangerous enemies so your heroes act first — or concentrate your efforts to stun them entirely and skip their turn.

RUNS THAT FORCE YOU TO ADAPT

Worlds shuffle every run, and corruption deepens the further you go, twisting familiar stages into something nastier. The strategy that worked last time might completely fall apart this time.

BRAVE OR DEFAULT - RISK NOW OR SCALE LATER

Push your luck with Brave for extra actions now - and spend next turn stunned. Or Default to bank energy for a bigger play later. A simple choice that constantly makes you wonder: should we actually do this?

WHAT'S IN THE GAME

  • 7+ heroes with their own set of cards and relics

  • 500+ different cards

  • 300+ combat encounters and 60+ story events

  • 5+ worlds with multiple corruption stages

  • Online co-op for up to 3 players

EARLY ACCESS 

Jump in at a lower price while we're still building. Play it now, help shape it as it grows.

2067120.name: Jurassic Lab: Dinosarium DNA
2067120.about_the_game:
In the game, you will become a researcher, who has a unique opportunity to recreate the Jurassic period creatures by assembling dinosaur's skeletons from bones found during the excavation in an advanced technological laboratory. With the help of future technologies and artificial intelligence, having a skeleton and DNA, we start recreating the long-extinct creatures that inhabited the Earth.

At the start, you will find yourselves in a sci-fi laboratory with a bone collection of 7 dinosaurs.
Having collected a complete dinosaur skeleton, we start the processes of DNA synchronization with the collected material, adapting the original DNA to the new realities on the planet.

Our complex has specially created landscapes for the necessary habitat for each species of dinosaur.

After the successful completion of the dinosaur resurrection, you will go to the recreated habitat where a living dinosaur is already waiting for you.
Travel to each location is carried out with the help of a roller coaster. When you get to the locations, you will see with your own eyes each dinosaur in a natural environment adapted to the conditions of the planet at this time.

KEY FEATURES:
  • PUZZLE: Collect the skeleton of a dinosaur with our own hands.
  • ROLLER COASTER: Travel on a dynamic roller coaster through cave tunnels to dinosaur locations.
  • INTERACTIVE WITH DINOSAURS: Meet and interact with living dinosaurs.
2067120.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Ukrainian

2067140.name: AirRaid
2067140.about_the_game:
AirRaid is a fun and intense arcade shooter! It features unique models, sounds, and effects. Fight through 10 waves of ever increasing difficulty. Enjoy the satisfyingly destructive effects of taking down the enemy with fully modular enemy models.

Don't fire too much! Each bullet fired will reduce your score. Can you make it through to the end with a high score? Three soldier land and its game over. Don't let the missiles hit the ground!

Features:
- Unique, hand crafted, painted and textured 3d assets which are fully destructible
- Scored by professional beatmaker, Jonnie Baker
- Simple arcade controls
- Randomized enemy spawns ensure no two play throughs are the same!
- The background and sun angle change as you progress through the day of defending your base

2067150.name: Nitro Racers
2067150.about_the_game:
Drive the hottest supercars across 30 incredible tracks in Nitro Racers! Drift on slippery ice, slog through sloppy mud, blaze over burning-hot asphalt and a lot more! Push your way through the pack without mercy as you send other cars into walls with explosively-spectacular results!

Stop into the in-game shop with money you’ve won from races to buy better tires, faster engines, more precise brakes and speedier pit crews.

Want to get closer to the pavement? Drive in close-up mode to get a more detailed and engaging experience.

In Nitro Racers, fly off of huge ramps and under tight bridges as you use environments and self-created collisions to your advantage to slow down your opponents. Once you’ve dealt immobilizing damage to the competition, make a pitstop to improve your car‘s look and performance.

  • 30 incredible tracks that feature a variety of challenges
  • Race tracks feature ramps, bridges, tunnels and a slew of terrain to burn through
  • Inflict damage to your opponents’ vehicles as well as your own
  • Build a better car and team at the in-game shop with money you’ve earned from races
  • Close-Up Mode allows players to see more detail and feel more engaged
  • Use track environments to your advantage by creating collisions and shortcuts
  • Make pitstops during races to repair your vehicles and improve performance

    Original network multiplayer modes are included but, due to the age of this title, not officially supported for this release.

2067160.name: Simulakros
2067160.about_the_game:
Enter a futuristic world of robots and advanced AI in Simulakros, a fast-paced third-person shooter with rogue-lite elements. The CORP seeks to develop the ultimate weapon: the Simulakros unit. It's up to you and a mysterious hacker to disrupt their plans, by turning their deadly combat androids against them. Can two people take down the world's biggest corporation?

THIRD PERSON FAST-PACED SHOOTER


Defy the CORP by using their own creation against them, the Simulakros Unit, equipped with advanced weapons and abilities to wreak havoc to their facilities.

RANDOMIZED LEVELS WITH HANDCRAFTED LEVEL DESIGN


Enjoy randomly generated levels composed of carefully crafted parts. Each run the game will be different as the environment keeps changing while staying true to the designer’s vision.

3 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS


Take control of 3 different Simulakros Units, each having their own unique playstyle with unique weapons, skills and power-ups.

Sharpshooter: Sharp and deadly. Fight from a distance with this unit equipped with high precision rifles capable of charging devastating shots and time-manipulation abilities.



Barrage: Fast and ruthless. Wield a short-range SMG and a long-range pistol with this unit equipped with explosive energy-based abilities.



Rupture: Powerful and fearless. Bring the fight to them with a close-range shotgun and powerful grenades. This unit is pure aggression, capable of surprising enemies by teleporting behind them.

CUSTOMIZATION


Each run will feel unique as you gather random power-ups and upgrades that change your playstyle and improve your abilities. Will you become strong enough to defeat the CORP?

HORIZONTAL PROGRESSION


Inside the CORP facilities you will discover powerful chips that you can equip to permanently improve your ability to control Simulakros Units. Each run will grant you experience, allowing you to equip more and more!



Rise up now. You’re our only hope!
2067160.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Italian, Polish, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

highlighted.localized_name: Two blades are better than one
highlighted.name: Two blades are better than one

2067200.name: Blobble Wars 2
2067200.about_the_game:
A sequel to the 2009 Flash game "Blobble Wars". This game builds on the original adding many new levels, new tower types, and new strategic options. Through 50 varied levels your goal will be to conquer all of the towers on the map before your AI opponents can.

The controls are simple: click your tower and drag in the direction you want to aim. Hitting an enemy tower with your blobbles will capture it. Hitting a friendly tower will reinforce it.

The game has four difficulty modes. Easy mode is forgiving for a casual expereince. Impossible mode provides a challenge for even experienced players.

highlighted.localized_name: It's one small step for a Blobble
highlighted.name: It's one small step for a Blobble

2067210.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
2067210.about_the_game:
Serious Sam Stone is back, but this time he's not alone. Uber Mental's maniacal machinations have fractured the walls between universes, and now Sam's from multiple dimensions must learn to work together to repair the Shatterverse.

As part of the Serious Program, a multidimensional force opposing Uber Mental, you'll travel across shifting universes to finish battles other Sams couldn't. Mental has been hunting the hero across realities, and in many timelines, he's already won. Now, it's your turn to push back. To advance, you must bring down his five lieutenants, each a formidable boss in search of total annihilation.

Wield a relentlessly destructive arsenal of devastating weapons, unlock powerful boons, and experiment with run modifiers that reshape gameplay. In true roguelite fashion, death is never the end, and each run opens the door to new strategies and limitless possibilities across the Shatterverse.

MULTIVERSE MAYHEM

Reality cracked and now Serious Sams from multiple universes are fighting the same war. Team up across shifting worlds, collide with alternate versions of the legend, and bring guns-blazing chaos to timelines that were never supposed to meet.

BIG GUNS, SERIOUS DAMAGE

Pack the classics, then crank it into the weird. Wield a mix of iconic Serious Sam staples and brand-new toys, built for one purpose - clearing arenas when Mental's hordes decide hundreds is a warm-up. Explosive, loud, and extremely violent.

ESCALATING DESTRUCTION

A world full of unstable anomalies, hidden portals, and high-risk opportunities that can supercharge a run, or end it instantly. Push forward greater rewards, unlock powerful modifiers, and upgrades that permanently expand your possibilities.

MENTAL'S HORDE, REMIXED

Familiar foes are back, and they brought friends. Face a selection of classic Serious Sam enemies alongside fresh monsters, all under Mental's control, all engineered to overwhelm you, and all begging to be turned into mush.

ARCADE-STYLE FPS ENERGY

High-adrenaline, run-and-gun arena chaos, big battlefields, nonstop pressure, and perfectly-timed one-liners when everything's on fire. Shatterverse leans into the Serious Sam legacy and pushes it forward with procedurally shifting runs across hand-crafted arenas set in previously unexplored worlds.
2067210.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian

2067220.name: Auf Wiedersehen Monty (CPC/Spectrum)
2067220.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1987, this classic platformer for home microcomputers from British developers Gremlin Graphics follows the continued misadventures of Monty Mole. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Included are both the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions.

Gameplay

Monty, having recently escaped the law to the rocky island of Gibraltar, has now become the target of Intermole. His only hope: to trek across the whole of Europe collecting enough cash to buy the Greek island of Montos and live there in luxury. Platform across the various countries, collecting useful items and much-needed cash.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options
2067220.reviews:
“If you want a hugely challenging, addictive and entertaining platform game then, then Auf Wiedersehen Monty is the one for you.”
100% – Computer and Video Games (May 1987)

“Auf Wiedersehen? Or is this merely Au Revoir? Whichever the case, it's certainly not Bog Off, 'cos Gremlin has kept up the Monty tradition and put together a really top hole multiscreen platform game.”
90% – Your Sinclair (June 1987)

2067230.name: Skellington
2067230.about_the_game:
Skellington is a cute 3D platformer starring a goofy skeleton who just wants to go back to sleep!
Unfortunately, a child has been robbed of their halloween candy by ghosts and is crying uncontrollably in the graveyard... Our friendly skeleton hero will go on a quest to collect all of the candy, return it to the child and finally get his well-deserved rest!

The candy has been scattered around 8 different worlds, accessed by the gravestones of the ghosts.
Run through these worlds and use your platforming skills to find all hidden candies!

The pumpkins can be a tricky bunch, some are very nice, and contain lots of candy!
Others, eh... Not so much.
Learn about all of the pumpkin types and use their abilities to your advantage!

Moving platforms are often scattered around in these worlds!
Master your platforming abilities and make your way through these obstacle course-like levels!

2067240.name: 灵境三国
2067240.about_the_game:
【开篇诗】
东汉末年，战乱纷纷，生灵涂炭、民不聊生。
有一罗汉名观众，祭出无字天书，咏唱神谕。


滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄。
是非成败转头空。
青山依旧在，几度夕阳红。
白发渔樵江渚上，惯看秋月春风。
一壶浊酒喜相逢。
古今多少事，都付笑谈中。


刹那间，万物众生化作缕缕金辉飘入无字天书。
片刻后，本无一字的书页映出似幻非幻的画卷。
一卷、二卷、三卷... ... 整整一百二十卷。

幻幻真真，称之灵。
叠叠层层，谓之境。

正所谓“世间一日，灵境百年”
戏众生之苦乐，游古今于一梦，岂不妙哉！

【背景】
天书开启，灵境再现，东汉英雄们的灵识被带到了灵境世界。
嘟宝是生活在灵境中乐游幻境的至纯至善的灵宠。
灵境之门开启后会进入休眠状态变为标本，而标本会成为禁锢英雄灵识的容器，它们结合后有一个新名字境灵。
每一次灵境之门的开启都会诞生诸多神秘空间统称为山海，随着灵境之门的关闭这些山海中的神秘空间也会随之消失。
玩家扮演灵境守护者，为了唤醒嘟宝，需要在山海中寻找境灵并完成其心愿。

【游戏特色】
・源自历史的英雄之旅
三国英雄们以境灵形态登场，在亦真亦幻的灵境世界里，共同演义经典故事。
・悲悯之心的价值设定
执迷追寻境灵命运的果，亦是消解英雄苦难的因，是非成败都付笑谈中。
・嬉笑间触达悲剧之美
轻松的话语、可爱的画风、丰富的玩法，奇思妙想的设定，既是游戏也是人生。

【游戏要素】
单人模式，体验完整的一段小故事，讲述了东汉英雄来到灵境一直到达成联盟讨伐董卓。
多人模式，可以局域网联机对战、协作体验游戏中的多种游玩要素。

【游戏系统】
包括角色养成、自由拍照及相册、物品打造及升级、砍树挖矿、房屋建筑、近战武器、远程武器、魔法技能等诸多生存冒险元素。
【拍照功能】
游戏内置高级拍照功能，按【P】键激活，可以设置多种后期效果、镜头特写等，按【G】键激活相册功能便于查看图片，同时所有图片均随机播放于关卡过场画面。

2067260.name: Reflection: The Greed
2067260.about_the_game:
"Take the first step into darkness - The first chapter of terror is with you now!"





What's the worst that can happen from reading a decrepit book? Jon Oz, who's been sifting through pages of a book that shouldn't even have its cover opened, is about to confine himself into a nightmare. Will you end the nightmare when darkness falls? Or will you be a prisoner to your own reflection?
Reflection is a first person survival horror game with puzzle and parkour elements.

Synopsis
Following a traumatic shootout, police lieutenant John Oz is being treated in the Parlak Dag Hospital located in a remote forest. Jon has now unknowingly confined himself into a nightmare by giving into his curiosity and sifting through the pages of a mysterious book belonging to another patient. The orchestrator of this nightmare is a parasite who lives in reflections and empowers itself by feasting on the weaknesses and fears of its victims. Will you allow this parasite to consume you, or will you be able to bury it in the dusty pages of the mysterious book?

Features

  • First Person Horror Experience

    John Oz, who is recovering from a traumatic accident, is facing a supernatural threat in the hospital he was put in to receive treatment. Run and hide from the parasite that is chasing you!

  • Realistic Graphics and Atmosphere

    Thanks to realistic graphics and dynamic environment objects, you can interact with the objects in the environment and have a more immersive experience with the game world.

  • Transforming Rooms

    Although the lack of Jon’s sanity is up for debate, this hospital is certainly no longer a sane place. Rooms and halls move and transform on their own growing or shrinking out of proportion creating obstacles that you must overcome using parkour skills.

  • Puzzles

    You must use your cunning in other areas as well, like fixing broken electric boards and circuit breakers, moving objects, and manipulating the environment in order to overcome the puzzle-like obstacles.

  • Fear of the Dark

    Your fear gives you away... You mustn’t linger in the dark for too long as it increases your fear level, making it much easier for the parasite to find you. Keep to the light and keep your light source closer to you if you want to make it out of the hospital in one piece.

highlighted.localized_name: TRICKS OF THIS HOSPITAL IS NEVER ENDING
highlighted.name: TRICKS OF THIS HOSPITAL IS NEVER ENDING

2067270.name: Herogue
2067270.about_the_game:
Welcome to Herogue a turn based roguelike battler that lets you customize the perfect team and forge devastating strategies in tactical combat!

Build your squad of unique heroes and experiment with endless upgrade paths using EXP coins. Each character offers multiple fighting styles, letting you create powerful synergies.

Core Roguelike Mechanics:

Poison-focused strategy — overwhelm enemies with stacking damage-over-time effects.

Power builds — stack buffs for massive burst damage.

Thorns counter-attacks — turn enemy aggression against them.

Tag Team Mechanics — swap heroes in and out of battle to control positioning and turn the tide instantly.

With tons of statuses, buffs, and depuffs, every run feels fresh and strategic. Discover hidden combinations as you replay procedurally generated challenges in this party-based roguelike RPG. Whether you love turn-based tactics, deep team-building, or creative build-crafting, Herogue delivers satisfying roguelike replay ability with accessible yet complex combat.

Test different formations, master your heroes, and climb to victory one tactical decision at a time. Ready to build your ultimate team?

Wishlist Herogue today and dive into the roguelike battler that rewards creativity and strategy!

2067280.name: Devil Dead
2067280.about_the_game:
🔥 Devil Dead – Face the Hordes of Hell! 🔥

The gates of Hell have opened, and Avalon is under siege! Step into the chaos in this 2D horror arcade action platformer, where every battle pushes you closer to the ultimate showdown with the Devil himself.

⚔️ Battle Through Legendary Landscapes:
Fight across the Cemetery of the Damned, the Haunted Forest, the Doomed Ancient Caves, scorching Lava Caverns, eerie Sleepless Night Fields, the Fields of Avalon, the cursed Castle, and finally, the depths of Hell itself.

✨ Unleash Magic & Skills:
Master devastating attack spells, summon defensive wards, and unlock epic abilities to crush demons and survive the nightmare.

👹 Arcade-Style Action:
Fast-paced combat, relentless waves of enemies, and classic platforming challenges — all packed into a dark, medieval horror atmosphere.

Your destiny: defeat the demons, slay the Devil, and free Avalon from eternal damnation.

The kingdom won’t save itself… are you ready?

2067300.name: Crossfar
2067300.about_the_game:
Master the art of zero gravity warfare in Crossfar! Fight as a pilot, lead as a captain, and conquer as a general in intense PVP battles to earn your wings.



Perform spectacular maneuvers while free-floating and flying, as you zero down your aim to land your next shot center mass and reshape the frontlines of the galaxy!



Prepare for tactical decision-making and explosive reactions at any moment! Work in a formation with your squad and utilize each drone's special abilities to gain supremacy over the battlefield.



Disarm, disable, distract or destroy enemy pilots to sneak past and breach their gate. Lure your enemies into a trap to counter their offensive or keep them at bay with sheer firepower! It's up to you and your team how you address every situation!



Grab your best squadron and join the competitive community in season tournaments, or watch the best professional teams battle it out in CROSSFAR LEAGUE!

2067310.name: Neon Blood
2067310.about_the_game:
Year 2053, the world as we know it came to an end in a war lost in time. Now, only inequality remains, in the form of Viridis, the great city that encompasses the dangerous Blind City and the luxurious Bright City.

Axel McCoin, once a police detective, will become the key piece to unmask a whole plot of corruption and power that plagues the unstable peace of Viridis.

Experience the stories of the city and its inhabitants, accompanying Axel in his mission to overthrow the established order and demolish the foundations of this corrupt society.

///////////////////////////////////////

// The escaped member of the Viridis police force is extremely dangerous and a warrant is out for his arrest on sight.

Thanks to confidential sources it is known that he is assisted by a group of terrorists consisting of Varya Gagarin (Junkyard), Silver Rayner (Boxer), Basilio Tastiera (hacker)...

//////// INJECTING PAYLOAD BASILIO_THE_GREAT.BIN ////////

///██▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒ 20%///

///████▒▒▒▒▒▒ 40%///

///███████▒▒▒ 70%///

///█████████▒ 90%///

///██████████ 100%///

///DONE///

/////The Great Basilio thats is able to HACK the VPD and the fourth wall like nothing.

////Listen don't believe any of this, Axel is a liberator fighting for our rights and trying to break down social (and real) barriers and achieve REAL equality between the dangerous Blind City and the filthy rich Bright City.

//In his fight we will accompany him to achieve his goal, as well as to defeat the mysterious but powerful (not to me) Emerald Ruby. The rich girl who is determined to maintain the system that benefits her out of pure selfishness, although we believe there may be an ulterior motive...

Viridis is a living city that tells its own story, as well as keeping its own secrets. The city's inhabitants will be key pieces for detective Axel McCoin to discover how it works, the root of its inequality and how the inhabitants go about their daily lives. With richly detailed environments and hundreds of secrets to learn, players can explore freely and act as they wish as they explore diverse locations, such as the neon city of Hunter Heaven, the futuristic Bright City and the labyrinthine subway tunnels hidden in Viridis.

The city is dangerous, but Axel knows how to defend himself. You can attack, use skills and even objects before unleashing a powerful final attack where you will see the pixel art at its best in this turn-based combat system based on the great games of the genre.

Neon Blood's aesthetics feature a unique blend of 2D and 3D combining the retro style of hand-drawn and animated pixel art with highly detailed 3D environments, all with meticulous lighting that will make walking through the streets of the great Viridis a visual spectacle.

  • Elaborate and deep story with a cyberpunk theme combined with a turn-based combat style like old RPG's with strong strategy factor

  • Two different realities of the two cities with complete 2.5D aesthetic, merging cyberpunk and sci-fi

  • A big macropolis full of secrets to be solved with a complete dialogue-based detective system

  • A lot of neons
2067310.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

2067330.name: Fateless Night
2067330.about_the_game:
A mysterious castle appeared out of nowhere and spreads evil miasma all over the Kingdom! You are a young adventurer who went to solve such unusual incident. Swing your sword, dash, cast your spells and use magic items to destroy the source of evil. A long, fateless night awaits you.

Fateless Night is a 2D action-platformer with randomized enemies and a skill-based combo system. Get the highest combo in each stage to unlock new challenges and obtain special rewards! Or just beat the game with your basic equipment - it's all up to you.

Features:
- Enemies and traps are randomly generated, so each run is a bit different from previous ones;
- Combo system rewards skilled playthrough - the better you play, the more bonuses you get;
- A wide choice of magic spells and amulets. Collect them all and customize your playthrough the way you like;
- Extra stages and extra bosses for extra challenge.

2067350.name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
2067350.about_the_game:
Follow four cuties who pack a punch—Mikoto, Waka, Itsuki, and Yuzuha—as they hack and slash their way across parallel worlds to rescue Nagi, who has been spirited away by the villainous Phantom.

Battling through 8 action-packed stages, they take down the legions of Phantom’s minions standing in their way. The game features diverse combat mechanics reminiscent of a fighting game, with strategic action and intense encounters. As players defeat enemies, they level up and earn points to unlock new skills.

Level up both your characters and skills, rescue Nagi, and return to your world!

REVAMPED GAMEPLAY

Gameplay has been rebuilt from scratch in Unreal Engine 5, giving smoother gameplay, flashier special attacks, and an enhanced online experience.

ONLINE CO-OP AND VS MODES

Enjoy local multiplayer with up to 4 players in co-op or versus modes. Online multiplayer allows for up to 6 players in co-op and up to 8 in versus mode. With cross-platform online play, team up with or face off against players from around the world!

PLAY AS THE ENEMY

Take on the role of powerful adversaries from the Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds universe. A total of 38 characters are playable! Unlock them for co-op and versus modes by completing Story Mode and watching the end-roll. From the biggest baddies to minor grunts, a wide variety awaits!

REMASTERED SOUNDTRACK

Players can choose an all-new soundtrack composed by all-girl J-rock band The Phantom Breakers or the classic versions from the original games.

STORY

Tokyo―the capital of Japan.

A mysterious man named Phantom plots to regain his sealed powers.

By giving weaponry known as F.A.s (Fu-mension Artifacts) to the young with special abilities, he lures them into battle with the promise of granting the victor their wish.

However, unbeknownst to the participants, the violent clashes of F.A.s cause distortions in the fabric of space-time, creating rifts between this world and other parallel worlds―

―rifts that will ultimately compromise the seals binding Phantom's powers.

Waka, daughter of the Kumon Family―an ancient clan that has waged war against evils―along with the support of Mikoto, fights to thwart Phantom's evil plan, but despite their combined might, Phantom manages to escape just in time.

While fleeing, he kidnaps Waka's younger sister, Nagi Kumon.

Itsuki, a maid and self-proclaimed Arbiter of Justice and Yuzuha, a ninja who has resisted Phantom's temptations, join forces with Waka and Mikoto to pursue Phantom and rescue Nagi.
2067350.supported_languages:
English*, Japanese*, French, Italian, German, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

2067430.name: Deadbeat
2067430.about_the_game:
What waits when the heartbeat stills? Paradise? Nightmares? Nothing?

Only the dead know.

Rumor speaks of headphones that transmit the voices of the dead. A curious youth, Singer, receives one of these 'Deadsets' and puts it on.

A noise reaches his ears. A noise that will never stop.

DEADBEAT

DEADBEAT is a kinetic Soulslike set in the Hereafter: a surreal, quirky afterlife that some will do anything to escape.

Take on the role of Singer, a hapless youth roped into a contract with Alto, a smirking Demon with more than a few skeletons in his closet. With his voice stolen and strange new powers at his fingertips, Singer is trapped in the Hereafter until Alto's demands are satisfied... and his rivals taken out of the picture.

KINETIC SOULSLIKE

  • Engage in quick and responsive stamina-based combat, where quick thinking and patience alike are vital to your success!

  • Wield useful Constructs to gain an edge against foes-- or call some friendly Demons for help on your Hellphone:tm:!

  • Empower yourself using demonic power, in a unique progression system partially inspired by the likes of Aria of Sorrow and Paper Mario!

  • Discover the Hereafter, and its grimmest secrets that hide just beneath the weary, sardonic surface.

The sea of noise awaits. Welcome to DEADBEAT.

2067460.name: Silentium
2067460.about_the_game:
Sentenced to death in The Labyrinth for crimes you were not guilty of. The Minotaur's constructed The Labyrinth during the Primordial Age. Once seen as Eres's ultimate prison, something has gone terribly wrong with the structure. As a survivor, find terrifying monsters, and harsh experiments – or hidden oases and forgotten cities. Discover allies or foes who have shared the same fate. Be careful, not everyone will have your best interest at heart.


Turn-Based Combat:
Tactically decide how to deploy party members. Remember, once deployed that unit is placed for the battle-sequence. How units are deployed will greatly impact the conflict ahead. Pick and choose what to cast, attack, and defend with.


Choose Your Path:
Codex can stabilize The Labyrinth in sections but cannot keep each catacomb consistent. Decide which path to go. More monsters, loot, mystery, or ruins? Find the heinous monsters of The Labyrinth. Plunder for more gear and discover what was left behind from eons ago. Discover failed experiments or settlements. Uncover lost secrets, or parts of ancient cities.


Discover Different Biomes:
The Labyrinth is full of different twists and turns. Prepare for battle across different landscapes! Fight in a primordial jungle, teeming with life and flora. Wander the dark damp caves, where minerals, plants, and hidden tunnels where creatures may lurk. Discover the architecture of old Eres, where the wonders of the old world still stand. More biomes will be announced as development continues.

Build Your Own Dungeons:
Synchronize with Codex and learn to stabilize rooms. Create unique dungeon layouts, mix and match enemies, biomes, lighting – anything that can be imagined! The Labyrinth has been used for ages to experiment, now it’s your turn.


Story Ahead:
Discover lost notes, landmarks, echoes, and experiments. Every dungeon has new quests that have the possibility of unlocking new storylines in the town of Serena. Ada’s Grove will be a resourceful location to finish notes and access more stories for the truly lore hungry. Make sure to speak with your companions after each mission – they may have news quests, rewards, or intel for you.


Advance Your Relationships:
It’s impossible to survive in The Labyrinth alone. Each companion found in the town of Serena will have new questlines to discover. Everyone has a purpose down in these hellish halls, and everyone had a life before coming here.



Gameplay Features:
• Discover unique storylines with party members.
• Choose which dungeon objective, based off your playstyle or play all the ones available!
• Once you collect enough dungeon chunks, you will be able to start editing existing dungeons – or not. The choice is yours.
• Build your character. Choose from three diverse classes: The Warrior, The Mage, and The Rogue.
• Tactically deploy your units in a turn-based style grid.
• Collect materials and craft: armor, weapons, potions, and elixirs.


Survive in The Labyrinth long enough to uncover the primordial magics of these forsaken halls and discover what horrors the ancient races intended to be buried – forever.

2067470.name: Idol Hell
2067470.about_the_game:
What is Idol Hell?
🎀Idol Hell is a 2D, Touhou-like, Shoot 'em up, bullet hell game taking inspiration from Japanese school idols and anime tropes.

🎶In Idol Hell, you play as Medli, a robot schoolgirl idol set on a warpath to free her closest friend.
Fight through hordes of enemies and other cutesy robot idols in this vibrant, precision-based game.

Beginner Friendly Bullet Hell?
Our goal with this game was to make a bullet hell that newcomers to the genre and veterans alike could enjoy! Bumble, our lowest difficulty, intends to ease players in so they can become comfortable with the controls and develop their own style of gameplay through a more forgiving experience.🌸
On Humble, the game picks up what we consider to be a proper challenge for players of all levels. We encourage new players to try and try again on Bumble so they may one day play through Humble, a massive accomplishment displaying developed reflexes and coordination at a high level!🎀
Rumble is where things pick up and where long-time fans of the genre should look. Indicated with red hues, this is where the game stops being generous requiring high-speed reactions and clinical navigation to finish.🎵
For a final challenge, Crumble is our “ridiculous” difficulty popular in the genre. We do not recommend players start here until they’ve seen every pattern at least once as Crumble offers little time to learn and works to defeat you at every turn. You have been advised.🎶

Idol Hell’s Game Design
For this game, we wanted to design in a way familiar to players of the genre while still developing a unique identity. The general pacing of the game is two waves of enemies introducing you to their attacks, a mid-boss that hints at the boss’ attack, a final wave including a medley of all enemies, and the boss herself.
Each boss alternates between a Warm Up attack followed by a Performance attack. Warm Ups are simple in style, typically copying the behavior seen already in the stage, and each consecutive warm-up will be similar to the ones before it in some way. Performances follow a Warm Up and are noted by a change in the background. Performances are very unique with experimental attacks the Idol has come up with herself. This means the nature of the Performances may seem unpredictable at first but can be mastered with understanding and practice. Learning the tempo of waves, Warm-ups and Performances is key to beating the game!

The Full Game Includes:
  • 4 Difficulty Levels!
  • 4 Different Game Modes to Play!
  • 6 Chapters!
  • 7 Cute Robot Idols!
  • 14 Songs Filled With Variety!
  • Hundreds Of Bullet Patterns!

2067490.name: Competitive Checkers
2067490.about_the_game:
Competitive Checkers - Multiplayer Strategy Game

Are you ready for an exhilarating test of strategy and skill? Dive into the world of "Competitive Checkers," the ultimate multiplayer experience for Checkers enthusiasts!

Features:

Multiplayer Showdown: Engage in thrilling head-to-head matches with players from all over the globe. Prove your Checkers prowess and outmaneuver your opponents to claim victory.

Strategic Gameplay: Sharpen your mind as you plan and execute each move. Carefully analyze the board, anticipate your opponent's actions, and seize the advantage.

Real-Time Matches: Experience the excitement of live gameplay with real-time multiplayer action. Stay on your toes and react quickly to each strategic twist and turn.

Chat with Opponents: Stay connected with your rivals through in-game chat. Exchange playful banter, congratulate each other on well-executed moves.

How to Play:

Competitive Checkers follows the classic rules of the beloved board game. Start with a grid of alternating dark and light squares, and each player has a set of twelve checkers. Move your pieces diagonally forward, capturing your opponent's checkers by jumping over them. Reach the opposite end of the board, and your piece will be "crowned," gaining the ability to move both forward and backward. Outsmart your adversary, strategize your moves, and aim to capture all their checkers.

Join the Checkers Community:

Are you new to Checkers or a seasoned player looking for a fresh challenge? The Competitive Checkers community welcomes players of all levels. Engage with fellow Checkers enthusiasts, share your experiences, and learn new tactics to enhance your gameplay.

Download now and claim your spot in the world of Competitive Checkers! Challenge, conquer, and become a true Checkers master!

2067570.name: Egghead Gumpty
2067570.about_the_game:
Explore an infinite procedurally-generated abandoned juvie as you try to survive a monstrous egg with legs named Egghead Gumpty that’s hiding in the building. He can watch you from anywhere, so catch him stalking you before it’s too late in this unique horror experience.

Story:

One day a corrupt juvenile detention center with a horrendous reputation, and the next an empty building where everyone (supposedly) suddenly vanished, the now-abandoned juvie garnered the reputation of a place that no one ever exits.


The Juvie:

Hired by the father of one of the former inmates that vanished, you are sent to investigate and explore the juvie in order to find out the truth about what happened in the establishment that was once finite.

In Egghead Gumpty, you will explore the many vast hallways and rooms of the juvie, which are infinitely procedurally-generated, all while trying to uncover the truth about how everything came to be. Although the place will seem empty at first, it will quickly become clear that you are not alone, and are being stalked by a shy entity that is determined to catch you.



When the entity is stalking you, an indicator will appear on the screen informing you that you are being watched. This means that somewhere around you, Egghead Gumpty is looking straight at you. It could be him peeking from behind a door or from the ceiling, but that doesn’t matter. What matters is that you must find where Egghead Gumpty is stalking you before it gathers enough confidence to attack, and scare it away to buy yourself time to dedicate to your mission.

2067640.name: A Tragic Accidental Still Life
2067640.about_the_game:
It’s dusk again in America.

Someone is always dying — rushing from home to home through the endless suburbs, an ambulance driver fails yet again to revive the latest victim of a drug epidemic. Made numb by repetitive tragedy, he seeks excitement the only way he knows how — by stealing from the victims he’s been called to help.

Equal parts mundane and surreal, A TRAGIC ACCIDENTAL STILL LIFE is a three-act arcade adventure that unravels into a vast narrative tapestry of daydreams, prison breaks, and far-flung night flights. Speed through the sprawl. Save your neighbors. Take their stuff — and follow a path of stolen mementos through prisons and reveries across America.

  • There’s no place like home…there’s no place like home… — Explore over 50 uniquely handcrafted homes spread across a vast procedural suburb.
  • Hurry up we’re dreaming — Experience over 40 fully interactive daydreams. Are they memories or fantasies?
  • This is a long drive for someone with nothing to think about — Pinball by car and airplane over America’s 50 states and beyond.
  • The trinity test — Play through three distinct Acts, each with its own set of action-adventure mechanics and secrets to discover.
  • The first time as tragedy, the second time as farce — An undemanding hour-long loop with a wealth of new content poised to reveal itself on each successive playthrough.

  • Chess Puzzles:

2067760.name: Trash Bomber

• Feeling Tired? •


Trash Bomber is a relaxing "hidden object" game, suitable for people of all ages!

• Gameplay •


You are tasked with overseeing the process of turning trash into ashes inside an incinerator. Due to poor sorting, each batch of garbage that's poured into this machine comes with objects that aren't allowed to be recycled in it. Your job is simple: find every object that can't be incinerated (represented by the icon in the middle of the screen) and blow them up!

• Endless Supply of Puzzles! •


Since there's no way to know what people will throw into their garbage bins, every heap of trash is randomly generated based on the chosen difficulty.

2067820.name: RetroSpace
2067820.about_the_game:
RetroSpace is a love letter to the immersive games of yesteryear, with a modern sensibility and some unique, genre-bending twists.

IMMERSIVE DISCO-PUNK SPACE-HORROR!

You were but a simple janitor, now you are the last hope of all humanity! A space station has been swallowed by a sentient black hole, weird animal and plant hybrids roam the corridors, and even time itself has gone completely mad around you. Navigate with stealth or unleash a blast-tastic odyssey through the cursed station. Will you be the hero Earth needs, or are you groovin' to save your own soul? The choice is yours!

SURVIVING AURORA 5

The enemies on the station of Aurora 5 are completely different from each other, so you've gotta channel your inner mad scientist to outsmart 'em. Survival ain't just luck; it's about cracking the code on their behavior, special abilities, and weaknesses. You will also have to deal with a variety of environmental factors. Security systems - for example - can be extremely deadly unless you find a way and turn them into traps or even unlikely allies...

STEALTH VS ACTION

Don't like conflicts? Would you rather hide in the dark or find a way around your enemy? Or are you the kind who goes completely mental and attacks your opponent with its own flaming body part? The choice is yours, janitor! RetroSpace allows you to solve situations in many different ways. Total avoidance is as legit as a diversion, trap setting, or full-on "balls-to-the-wall" action.

THE STATION

Aurora 5 is a massively interconnected and open station, that you are free to explore. As you discover new and new areas, shortcuts, and secret paths will open up to previously visited locations. This can be accessed through a (mostly) peaceful central HUB area, where you can return anytime when you can't take the madness and horror any longer.

MUTAMODS, DEATH, AND REBIRTH

Mutamods™ can make your life much easier and enhance your combat and stealth skills. Want to become a tentacle-armed, mind-controlling, shadow-lurking mutant madman? Be our guest. BUT BEARE! Mutamods™ may have unexpected and irreversible side effects...

Death will be integral to your journey, but don't worry! Aurora can produce an infinite number of clones of you. But here's the hitch – cloning ain't all sunshine and rainbows. You should be prepared for some severe cloning degenerations, and of course, it is highly recommended to get your stuff back from your former self. (and always carry a mustache! - thank us later) Get ready for a wild ride through the psychedelic unknown, where every death is just another funky twist in your interstellar journey!

BLURB

2177 - Humanity's last hope is the AURORA fleet, a convoy of floating space stations searching for a new home.

On this century-long mission, humans spend their lives in deep sleep, while robots, androids, and a dedicated team of chosen janitors guard their dreams.

Until one of the gigantic city-ships derails off its course...

Sucked into a black hole...

And now it drifts in the void, lost in the infinite blackness of space.

The corridors are infested with mutants, and the ship is constantly jumping between two time periods.

Is there a way home? Will the madness ever end?

A nameless janitor is looking for answers and a way out.

A way out of the endless loop, the evil void, and the cosmic madness...

This is... RETROSPACE!"

KEY FEATURES

  • - Narrative-heavy, humorous, and dark story - aka "disco-fever space-satire" with a surprising amount of depth and twists.

  • - Immersive sim elements - choose how to solve problems and deal with obstacles. Take advantage of light and shadow, lure enemies into traps, hack turrets, and security stations, find hidden routes, and create diversions.

  • - Mutations (Mutamods™) are at your disposal to enhance your average stealth-shooter experience with juicy superpowers. BEWARE: With great power comes great responsibility (and unexpected side effects).

  • - Modernized retro feel with low poly aesthetics, infused with the 60s and 70s retro-futuristic setting and atmosphere.

  • - Metroidvania-like, interconnected level design, and a meaningful death/rebirth system with a unique twist.

In space, no one can hear you groove!

2067890.name: CACTUS

2067930.name: Never ends acT
2067930.about_the_game:
このゲームはウェーブ制で出現する敵を倒し続け、より多くのウェーブを突破することを目指すバトルアクションゲームです。全100ウェーブの突破を目指しましょう。

3種類の武器と衣装チェンジ

このゲームには「双剣・大剣・両刃剣」の3種類の武器があります。
武器は戦闘中に切り替えることが可能で、武器に合わせて衣装が変わります。
好みの武器で戦闘を楽しみましょう。

4つのスキル

武器ごとに通常攻撃と4つのスキルがあります。スキルは発動時にSP（スキルポイント）を消費します。
SPは通常攻撃とジャストアクションで回復することができます。
スキルの配置はメニュー画面から変更でき、同じスキルを配置することも可能です。

ジャストアクション

このゲームの重要な要素として、「ジャスト回避」と「ジャストガード」の2種類のアクションがあります。
敵の攻撃がヒットする瞬間にそれぞれのアクションを行うことでジャストアクションが発生します。
2つのジャストアクションにはそれぞれ以下の効果があります。
  • ジャスト回避
    　→SPの回復＋すべての敵を一定時間スローモーション状態にする
  • ジャストガード
    　→一定時間クリティカル率が100％になる
ジャストアクションを使いこなし、戦闘を有利に進めましょう。

コンボ効果

100コンボごとに、プレイヤーの周囲に強力な攻撃が発生します。積極的にコンボを重ねていきましょう。

アイテム

アイテムにはぞれぞれプレイヤーをサポートしてくれる効果があります。
戦闘にはいくつかのアイテムの中から1つのアイテムを持ち込むことができます。
アイテムには一部を除いてクールタイムがあり、一度使用するとしばらく使用することができません。アイテムを使用するタイミングには注意しましょう。
アイテムの開放には実績の報酬であるポイントが必要です。

実績

様々な実績を達成することで、アイテムの開放に必要なポイントを入手することができます。
実績はメニュー画面から確認することができます。
全100ウェーブの突破と合わせてすべての実績の達成も目指していきましょう。

スコア

戦闘画面右上に現在のスコアが表示されます。
スコアは突破ウェーブ数、敵の撃破数、ジャストアクションの成功数など、様々な項目で決まります。
現在のスコアランク（F～S）は同じく右上に表示されます。
より多くのウェーブを突破する中で、ジャストアクションをより多く成功させるなどしてハイスコアを獲得し、Sランクを目指しましょう。

KRING is a wacky clicker-arcade-adventure game with over 10 different games inside.
CLICKER: basically, you have to click-click-click as much as possible, all the time, everywhere.
ARCADE: in the various sections, you'll play lots of different arcade mechanics (always with the clicker-game 'twist')
ADVENTURE: you'll go on an incredible adventure, raising the KRING army and then leading them against the Legendary Gods, to get your revenge!



You'll play CLICKER, BULLET HELL, TOP-DOWN PLATFORM, SIDE-SCROLLER PLATFORM, SHOOT'EM UP., BEAT'EM UP ... and other games where it's really hard to define the genre!

Meet the developer's demon

.When a video game is created, the smaller the development team, the easier it is to enter the "Identity," the soul of the developer.

Kring was made by one person, one Ivan Venturi, an old-but-very-experienced Italian game developer.

You play Kring and enter his Developer Identity: Dev.Id.
Dev.Id is the developer's demon that unlocks Cheat Mode, the alternative game mode.
To summon it you will have to type something in the main menu, but what?
Perhaps this demon has released a game, perhaps on Steam, and is waiting for the game name to catch up with it.

Learn about Random Design

Kring was built piece by piece without following any initial blueprints or designs, and every part of the game was made following what was going through the head of an old guy who has been making games for a while.
Crazy, psychedelic mini-games and off-the-wall game design.
Read the instructions eh, be sure to read them!

Raise, Feed and Protect the Kring breeds to unlock the next ones (there are 9, will you be able to unlock them all??)

2068100.about_the_game:
Ultimate Fishing® Online is a free-to-play multiplayer fishing simulator focused on fishing, realism, fun, and seamless social gameplay. Whether you're a solo angler or teaming up with friends, this immersive fishing experience lets you fish, compete, and explore in a living world packed with dynamic AI fish behavior and environmental effects.

Play with Friends

Choose between first-person or third-person views and join public or private multiplayer sessions with up to 16 players. Cast your line in diverse fisheries worldwide, each featuring unique species and conditions. Use techniques like float, spinning, casting, bottom, fly fishing, and even trolling once you're on the boat!

Fish AI

Fish AI behavior changes based on time of day, weather, bait type, and angling style. Whether you're trying to outsmart wary predators, observe massive schools of fish, or manage your gear to avoid breakage during a high-stakes catch, each moment is driven by skill and strategy. Underwater life feels alive with enormous shoals of up to 5,000 fish moving as a group.

Each fish scatters when disturbed by boats, casts, or predators, and regroups over time, creating a living, reactive fishing environment that constantly changes.

Even your bait landing too close can ruin a perfect catch, so timing and positioning matter.

It's all about Fishing

With a deep inventory system, gear customization, in-game economy, and realistic water physics - including tension-based line mechanics and damageable rods and reels - you’re not just playing a fishing game. You’re living the angler's life.

Game Features:

  • Free-to-play multiplayer with support for up to 16 players

  • Realistic fish behavior, including predators and school reactions

  • 45+ species including perch, zander, trout, pike, bass, catfish, and more!

  • Float, spinning, casting, bottom, and fly fishing

  • Boat travel and trolling

  • Underwater camera to observe bait and fish reactions

  • Vast fishing gear catalog

  • Equipment wear and tear system with repair mechanics

  • Dynamic weather and day/night cycle that impacts fish behavior

  • Global maps (USA, Europe, etc.) with unique species per location

  • First-person and third-person camera options

  • Player customization and emote system

2068180.name: Containerphobia
2068180.about_the_game:
The protagonist wakes up inside a container with a lamp, a flashlight and a video surveillance point. How did he get there? Unknown. There are plenty of other containers outside. And around the darkness, in the distance you can see the walls. It all looks like someone's crazy experiment. We need to get out of this strange place! But if only it were that simple. It seems that the main character is not alone. Somewhere in the dark, something lurks...

Containerphobia is a horror game in which you need to look for items on the map. Items will help the player to escape. Some of them will be able to temporarily delay the mysterious ill-wisher while you seek shelter.

The main goal of the game is to get out of a large dark room with containers. And in no case should you fall into the clutches of a mysterious creature.

Items. On the map you can find many different items that you can pick up. From a flashlight to useless bottles. Although... no, the bottle can be thrown, creating a noise that will definitely attract the creature's attention.

VR-mode. If you have a virtual reality helmet, you can get a completely different experience. Distract the creature by tapping the containers with your fists. Throw objects as if you were doing it in real life. Wear two items at the same time.

A mysterious creature. Either the consequences of a scientific experiment, or a summoned being from another world. It feels fear and likes to play hide and seek with the victim.

The following mechanics are currently implemented:

  • Items can be picked up and interact with the environment through them. A flashlight illuminates the surrounding area, and a fire extinguisher gives a chance to escape from the creature.
  • In the container where the player spawns, there is a video surveillance point. 4 cameras are connected to it randomly scattered around the map. Cameras turn from time to time in different directions.
  • Electrical appliances go crazy if a creature is nearby.
  • At the beginning of the game, the player appears in a random container on the map.
  • The creature is very curious. It can walk up to any container and open it with its nasty hands. And if a player is inside... Only a miracle will help him.

2068190.name: Almost My Floor: Duality
2068190.about_the_game:
Almost My Floor: Duality is a horror game with decision-making mechanics similar to "Dark Pictures" but in 2D. Endless subway mazes, cramped courtyards of high-rise buildings, and dark floors await a new victim. The game features multiple main characters, each capable of experiencing the story differently, or even not surviving at all.



The heroes will face both internal and external threats simultaneously. Their inner demons grow stronger, engulfing their minds in depression and pain. Meanwhile, the city sinks deeper into chaos, with people vanishing without a trace, and the police seem powerless. Rumors circulate about a growing anomaly. But who believes in such things?

Personal experiences of battling depression are woven into the game through images, stories, and thoughts. The characters, each with their own destiny and sorrow, fight differently for the right to live without the perpetual internal struggle with themselves. You must uncover the mysteries in the city, save loved ones, and not lose to your own demons.



In a world on the edge of imagination and reality, you will have to unravel all the mysteries of a provincial town before horror consumes your mind and body. More and more inexplicable disappearances flicker in the news reports, leaving the town's residents frightened by the unknown.



  • Personal experiences of battling depression, transposed into the game. The heroes will have to confront the growing hopelessness both within themselves and from the outside.
  • Variability in gameplay. The heroes can experience the story differently, and they might not even survive at all.
  • Multiple main characters, each with their own perspective on events and unique abilities. Whether everyone will stay alive by the end of the game depends on you.
  • A combination of several genres and gameplay styles. The blend of visual novel, horror, action, and adventure will keep you engaged throughout the playthrough.
  • Storytelling in a comic style.
  • Action elements that will test your speed of reaction and sharpness of thinking.
  • For the game locations, we gathered numerous photo references. The landscapes, interiors, and characters are recognizable and colorful.



Main characters:



Chloe Freudgel - the daughter of a brilliant psychiatrist and scientist, who is remarkably intelligent for her age. To clear her father's name, she embarks on her own investigation.

Masha - a simple girl from an even more provincial town. To save her beloved, she will have to unravel the city's secrets.

Adam Trust - a private detective famous throughout the city thanks to the Freudgel case. He thought he had solved all the mysteries of House No. 9, with the criminal behind bars. But, as it turns out, not everything is so simple. The most important case in the detective's career is still unsolved.

Snack on the secret DNA formula and mutate into a frenzied burly bro. Scatter the other chickens around, unleash the ultimate massive attack ability, destroy everything within your reach - feel the power of being a gigantic freak.

2068210.name: Alongside
2068210.about_the_game:
Brief introduction: The kingdom is under the threat of attack by hordes of evil. You and your units need to protect it from orcs, goblins and other monsters. Use a tactical approach to survive and win.

Gameplay: The Tower Defense Strategy game invites players to place fighters on the field, each of which has unique attacking or defensive abilities. You will be attacked by waves of enemies and the further you advance in the game, the greater the wave and the level of their strength. In later levels, players can acquire stronger units to counter armored enemies.
Each unit can only attack or defend on the track it is on. Gather food and use it to buy new units while maintaining game balance. Use the hero and his abilities to save the day in difficult times. If the monster reaches the end of the track a second time in a level, you will lose.

Visual style: The game is made in a 2D hand-drawn style. The world of the game is fabulous, inhabited by various animals. Weapons and other elements used in the game will be created in the same atmosphere, which will give the game a unique visual look.
The game is suitable for fans of the genre of strategy and tower defense. Also, the game will be interesting for those who love games in a fairy tale and fantasy world.

Game Ending: To complete the game, you need to defeat the final boss, which is located in the last level of the game.

Conclusion: Alongside is a fun game in which players must use their tactical skills to defend the kingdom from the consequences of horrific attacks. As you progress in the game, players will gain new levels and unique heroes with unique abilities.

2068220.name: Rampage Ball 2048
2068220.about_the_game:
In this exciting game, players have the opportunity to earn experience points and level up as they progress through the levels.
As you level up, you'll earn ability points that can be used to upgrade your ball and unlock new abilities.

Game features:

Arkanoid RPG mechanics

There are three ways to upgrade your ball:
Damage
Critical
Split

As you progress through the game, the blocks will increase in life every three levels, adding an extra layer of challenge.
The game has an idle arcade feel as you continue to level up and become more powerful.
Have fun and see how far you can go!

2068230.name: Sex and Zombies
2068230.about_the_game:
What would you do if you spend another boring summer in the city, when everyone has gone on vacation, and the only entertainment outside is a zombie apocalypse? Of course, arm yourself and go shoot your new brainless friends before they get to your brains!

Features

  • 12 different weapon types - from revolvers and assault rifles to sniper rifles and grenade launchers
  • Fast dynamic runs
  • Apple or zombie liver? The answer is not so obvious - collect items that give you various bonuses and power-ups
  • Waves of enemies, each is longer and more violent than the previous one. How long will you stand?
  • But you don't fight only for yourself, do you? 6 beautiful girls who will thank you for saving them

2068260.name: Brutal Chase Turbo
2068260.about_the_game:
Brutal Chase Turbo is an arcade racer inspired by the classic late 80s cop chasing games. Get into your police car and ram your enemies until they give up!



Brutal Chase Turbo features:

  • Easy control.
  • 5 different cars.
  • 9 different cities with a total of 108 levels.
  • Collect credits by ramming enemy vehicles and completing levels.
  • Upgrade your cars in the garage.
  • Classic arcade feeling with great sense of speed.

2068280.name: Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok
2068280.about_the_game:
Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok, is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle. Upgrade your characters’ stats with Constellation Ability Trees, equip yourself with powerful relics and slay your enemies before they surround you, or it may be too late…

During Ragnarok, Yggdrasil, the Tree of Life, lost almost all of its energy to sustain the Nine Realms. Only a few heroes will be able to survive the End of the World. Play as Axeldör, a Viking warrior; Thyra, a fierce ranger; or Hafgrim, master of the elements, among many other charismatic survivors.

  • 9 maps, inspired by each realm of Norse mythology.

  • 10+ characters, with exclusive skills and weapons.

  • Skill tree in the form of character constellations, to improve the stats of each survivor.

  • Yggdrasil as a meta-progress tree to boost different features that will make you feel more powerful in your adventure.

  • Character Masteries to upgrade your characters to their maximum potential.

  • 5 game modes: Adventure, Ragnarok, Daily Challenge, Custom and Nightmare.

  • Very replayable.

  • Alternative character skins for every character.

  • Elites and Bosses with their own behaviors to make battles more epic.

  • Reward Shrines scattered throughout the realm to always have quests or challenges to complete during a run.

  • Ascensions of each character's relics to boost them even more.

  • 150+ Relics.

  • 150+ Achievements.

  • Secrets.

  • Twitch integration to make streamings more fun.

  • Ready for PC, Mac, Linux and Steamdeck.

2068350.name: My Sugar Mommy is a Futanari
2068350.about_the_game:

2068380.name: SCP: Directive Nine
2068380.about_the_game:
In SCP: Directive Nine, step into the boots of an elite team deployed into hostile, anomalous territories where reality twists and dangers lurk at every turn. Combining intense cooperative gameplay with tactical depth, your squad must rely on strategy, communication, and specialized tools to survive unpredictable threats. Face off against mind-bending entities, navigate environments warped by unknown forces, and uncover mysteries that challenge your understanding of reality itself.

In our game, anomalous utilities offer players intriguing new methods to interact with the world around them, blending unpredictability with strategic depth. These peculiar tools defy traditional logic, creating opportunities for unexpected solutions to puzzles and unique combat tactics like this bear you can use to revive teammates. Each anomalous item comes with its own set of mysterious rules, inviting players to experiment and discover unconventional ways to overcome challenges, significantly enhancing immersion and replayability.

Face off against bosses unlike anything you've seen before—massive entities that demand precise teamwork and strategic execution. Each boss battle delivers a distinct experience, pushing your squad's coordination and adaptability to the limit. With unpredictable attack patterns and unique abilities that will test even seasoned players, overcoming these monstrous adversaries grants rare rewards, deepening your journey into the unknown.

2068390.name: Axis of Power
2068390.about_the_game:
Axis of Power is a 3D Fighting Game that aims to bring the thrill of tight controls and fresh mechanics to veterans of the genre, and a vibrant cast of expressive characters baring differing personalities, playstyles, and powers to all. It is unlike any other fighter, though it shares important fundamentals with industry giants. AOP is built from the ground up to be technically and visually unique, and it is perfect for players that wish to take on a true challenge with unrivaled branching options between animations.

Game Features
  • 10 playable Fighters
  • Dynamic stages
  • Customization Mode - change clothing, colors, and companions!
  • Online and offline modes
  • Special Fighting modes
  • Cutscenes detailing motivation and story
  • & Endless replay value!

Note: This game is still in development. Designs & animations are not finalized. Feel free to follow this project on Discord & Wishlist it!

Disclaimer: this game will not release in 2023. It is and will remain in development until it is ready to be enjoyed properly. Your patience and understand is VERY much appreciated!

2068400.name: Radiant Cell
2068400.about_the_game:

in the world of radiant cell, get ready to defend yourself as you wall run, shoot,

slow down time, and of course grapple. Be prepared to quickly adapt to new enemies and

new environments in every level.

This is a fast-paced, parkour, shooter with inspiration from games like Ghost Runner,

Titanfall and many more.

This is an easy game to pick up and play but hard to master. There are many routes to take to

escape each level but not all of them will be the fastest.

You will want to replay the levels multiple times until you find the best gun and the best route

to kill the most enemies in the fastest time!

2068460.name: Last Of Ark: Prologue
2068460.about_the_game:
