2071540.name: Timmy Types
2071540.about_the_game:
Don't swipe - type! Improve your typing speed with this endless runner game.

In the 2010s the world went crazy for mobile endless runner games like Subway Surfers and Temple Run in which you swipe your away around obstacles and try to see how far you can make it before crashing. Timmy Types is a creative twist on the genre in that you type words to navigate your environment.

The only interesting typing game I've found on Steam is Typing of The Dead: Overkill. The game is a great arcade experience that you navigate using your keyboard instead of a gun, and I really want to play other similar games. Unfortunately Typing of the Dead isn't really suitable for kids and there aren't really any other comparable games out there.

And this is why Timmy Types was created. It is our first experiment in developing a fun family-friendly typing game.

We appreciate your support of our game! We're working tirelessly, creating new prototypes and always thinking of ways to breathe life into the typing game genre. Hope you enjoy Timmy Types and please stay tuned because there's more to come!

2071550.name: Pencil Case TD
2071550.about_the_game:
Pencil Case TD is a tower defense game with a pencil case and stationery as the theme. In the beginning, there are only pencils. You can go to the hall to earn money, learning points, talent points, certificates, etc. Use the money to buy and upgrade different stationery, Learning points strengthen your ability, talent points and certificates can enhance your talent ability, and you can complete all courses by continuously improving yourself.

Game Features

Pen holder

Each defense tower also needs a pen holder to place, and each pen holder can also give the tower a different ability bonus or weakening. How to make the defense tower maximize its power depends on how the player combines the pen holder and different stationery.

Stationery

Just like different tower defense games have turret archers, etc., but now they are all stationery, and different stationery has different functions.

Learning points

At the end of each class, players will get learning points, and how to distribute them will become the key to customs clearance.

Talent

Talent can be improved through talent points and certificates, and improving different talents can also enhance your strength. It is more useful than learning points, but for the time being, it can only be obtained by passing quizzes or exams (of course, you have to get good grades on the test to get ^o^).

pen case

Of course, players also need to buy a new pencil case to store the stationery.

2071560.name: Modern Fantasy - Urban Legends
2071560.about_the_game:
Gameplay

• Aid your lost friend on an island inhabited by hostile animals, unfriendly people, the living dead and mutant abominations in this turn-based RPG with action elements as you sneak through enemies while timing and scoring pre-emptive victories with the action meter!

• Observe a digital world where NPCs have a daily agenda tied to a time system where every real second is an in-game minute!

• Utilize the power of psychic abilities, martial arts skills and animal companions to overwhelm your foes!

• Complete dungeon-styled caverns by defeating unique bosses and learn new abilities!

• Increase your fishing proficiency level and compete in fishing tournaments for unique rewards!

• Grow and harvest 16 different crops on an abandoned farm!

• Engage an intense main story with a good and bad ending!

• Roll the dice and roam a digital game board for extra rewards & experience!

• Manually level up your character and distribute stats to your liking!

Story and Features:

On a remote rural island somewhere in North America, an infectious disease has sprung into existence causing an isolated zombie epidemic in the City of Tanopah. As you assume the role of a lone pixelated survivor you are tasked with aiding your family and friends against a hoard of evil in the form of undead zombies, hostile animals and relentless people as well as dangerous mutant abominations.

Can you find the cause of the Zombie Epidemic, save your childhood friend from impending doom and defeat the waking embodiment of evil?

"Modern Fantasy - Urban Legends" is a turn-based gore and blood modern RPG with action elements that centers around the Player trying to locate their childhood friend. Tag an enemy's back side to score a pre-emptive strike indicated by a green swirl animation effect, if you time your action meter accordingly then you will instead score a pre-emptive victory ultimately skipping the battle. If you run into a hostile NPC's line of sight, it is possible for the enemy to score a pre-emptive strike against the Player indicated by the red swirl animation effect. If the Player and enemy are both facing one another while within each other's line of sight, then a normal battle will occur indicated by a blue swirl effect. *Please note that it's possible to bring up the menu and heal with psychic abilities & items during the swirl animation sequence before battle.

*Please note when using a gamepad to plug in the controller before starting the game client!

Features include but are not limited to (new features will be added based on feedback on the Community Hub on Steam):

• A Time System with 7 unique days and nights that utilizes dynamic soundtracks and weather particle effects.

• Many NPCS have Day and Night based agendas such as the Travelling Merchants and the Fishing Guru with unique move routes, dialogue and quests.

• A Fishing Mechanic where the Player can increase their fishing proficiency level by acquiring fishing experience with each fish caught as well as a fishing tournament against NPCs with different difficulties and lower/higher tier rewards.

• A Turn-Based Battle System with an action timer and meter for pre-emptive strikes and victories (the agility stat determines how often the Player and enemies can perform actions in battle).

• Animal Companions (as the Player explores and defeats hostile animals, they may recruit them after battle. There are 4 recruitable Animals each with their own unique attacks and stats in battle.

• 64 Steam Achievements (earning Steam Achievements will reward the Player with in-game content)!

• Character Creation Aspects and Stat Distibution Points via Manual Leveling (by starting a new game you will be brought to the character creation event after the initial prologue cutscene. Here you can choose a Male or Female character, your favorite color and your preferred Animal Zodiac Sign. There are 12 different Animal Zodiac Signs to choose from which will benefit your class in a variety of ways. Manual leveling can be performed in the menus under the "Level Up" option when you have reached the required amount of experience, here you can distribute stat points to your liking).

• Psychedelic Seamless Battle Background Animations (during battles there are a variety of background animations that are made of patterns of pixels that loop for a more engaging atmosphere.

• Animated Battle Sprites (enemies in battle are animated differently depending on the actions performed, status ailment afflicted and health).

• Inverted Realm (every exterior island map has an inverted parallel map which can be accessed through various portals found only on exterior island maps).

• Map Generator for the Trials of Madness (when the Player learns Psychic Teleport IV from leveling up, they will have access to the Trials of Madness. Here the Player can choose and generate an island map by timing the action button accordingly to trigger and mix & match different map chunks to form different shapes.

• Underground Arena Betting Grounds (bet on arena combatants or participate and fight for glory as you climb the ranks, earn unique items, credit and fast experience through pre-emptive victories if you time your action meter properly else you will have to grind out a turn-based battle.

• Quest Log (keep track of all your quests with a journal-like menu feature for when you save your game, come back later and forgot what you were doing).

• Soul Slots (each enemy you defeat will grant the Player soul coins. Acquiring 9 soul coins will cause the soul slots to materialize which require the Player's input to stop each slot. Match 3 slots in a horizontal row for extra credit currency and or rings but beware of getting 3 X's as you will lose credit).

• Digital Board Mini Game (roll the dice with an action timer to land on your desired tile for a potential reward but be weary of enemy and status affliction tiles).

• Dynamic Player Sprites (the Player's character sprite will change depending on what hat is equipped).

• Good Ending & Bad Ending (two outcomes).

• Grow and Harvest 16 Different Crops (depending on how many times you water your seed/sprout/plant, the better the harvest as you will earn a higher tier crop).

• Buy and Run a Gas Station Convenient Store (after you have acquired the land deed from the Tonapah City Hall you can begin selling products to individual customers at the price of your choosing. Some customers will not accept the deal and walkout on you if the price is too high and other customers will try to sell you rare items).

• 5 Story Oriented Dungeon Styled Caverns (along your journey to find your missing friend you will come across the Dungeon Styled Caverns which will require a light amount of puzzle solving as far as progressing the areas. Completing these dungeons are required to complete the main quest).

• 20+ Non-Story Oriented Dungeon Styled Maps and Caverns (these caverns are completely optional and give the Player an opportunity to find unique Player Moves, Companion Moves as well as Guadian Moves).

•16 Bit Chiptune Soundtracks/Retro Styled Soundtracks (a wide variety of high-quality soundtracks that have been handpicked over the years that are in some ways reminiscent of some of the chiptune songs you'd hear back on 16-bit 90's consoles as they had 16 different memory channels that produced the low memory bandwidth audio samples.

• Unique Pixelated Font and Graphical User Interface (menus and sub-menus have been arranged and textured in favor of being user friendly).

• Breathing Map Sprites (the maps sprites appear as though they are breathing, each NPC with their own breathing rate.

• Blood and Gore Cutscenes (in the name of unexpected humor the Player will encounter these cutscene as they explore the island).

2071600.name: 大宋广记
2071600.about_the_game:
本作品以北宋仁宗嘉佑元年至神宗朝熙丰年间的历史为背景。
宋夏庆历和议后，大宋四海稍安，仁宗英宗奉行祖宗法度谨守河山。
浮华背后，天下财力日穷而风俗日衰，一切或许到了不得不变的时候......




本作品试图深度解读宋代历史，除部分美术素材外（后续希望有机会替换），正史剧情部分若有与历史记载出入较大之处，还望大家斧正。个人能力有限，希望有幸与大家一起学习、积累、成长。




目前版本只开放做官的从文线，涉及玩法多有考据，尽力贴合宋代历史。
科举玩法：
随机题目皆为宋代省试或殿试真题。
断案玩法：
涉及案件均为宋代真实案例，大多出自《名公书判清明集》。
榷货务：
入中贸易为宋代特色，是朝廷调节各地资源分配的重要手段。
著书玩法：
多数灵感来自《全宋文》，希望能捕获宋代士人精神世界的吉光片羽。
漕运玩法：
北宋定都开封，与当时开封水系网络发达密不可分，漕运实乃大宋命脉所在。
海运玩法：
宋元海运兴起，市舶司为国家创造了大量财富，同时民间海外贸易业十分发达。从宋人赵汝适的《诸蕃志》中可以看到当时人们对海外诸国的认识。




个人认为熙丰变法是中国古代历史的转折点，唐末至五代以来，租庸调制度崩溃。赵宋终结五代之乱象，立国而不抑兼并，世人开始注重物质享受和个人财富积累。宋人迫切需要全新的思想和法度来建立新的天下秩序。
神宗和王安石力图建立一个外向的刚健政府，最终功败垂成。宋学慢慢转向，进而朱子之学占据主导地位，后世文明走向内向。
如果熙丰变法能够重来，宋代学术可以被重新塑造，一切又会怎样？




游戏中收录了《夷坚志》中的近百个小故事。
个人很喜欢《夷坚志》这本书，此书为洪迈毕生心血，洪迈幼年时北宋灭亡，后在南宋为官五十余年，履历丰富。他每与朋友相会，便闲聊各地风物见闻，最终汇编为《夷坚志》。
书中虽多有鬼神记载，看似荒诞，各类细节却具有很强史料价值，也实实在在反映了一千年前各类人物的精神世界和生活状态。




根据玩家剧情中的选择以及最终国家属性，游戏会迎来多种不同结局。

2071630.name: ExpressLane: Not a Battle Royale
2071630.about_the_game:
Not a Battle Royale. Not a looter shooter. This is ExpressLane!

A high-stakes first-person extraction shooter where you bring your own island into battle. Build a fortress, loot everything in sight, raid your enemies, and escape before they take what’s yours.

Your island is your stronghold. Construct walls, place deadly traps, and upgrade defenses to protect your incubator—the key to your survival.

Scavenge floating islands for rare gear, resources, and weapons. Every match is different, and the best loot won’t wait forever.

Attack rival players, break into their bases, and steal their wealth before they steal yours.

When you’re ready to cash out, call a flying whale to extract. But be warned: extraction is the most dangerous part of the match.

No two matches are the same.

Fight against other players and AI threats, from deadly ghouls to colossal boss battles.

Use grappling hooks, wingsuits, and jetpacks to navigate the skies.

Set deadly traps to defend your base, control chokepoints, and ambush raiders.

Think fast. Fight hard. Get rich.

If you hesitate, someone else will take what’s yours. Will you make it out alive?

Here's how it works!

The Match Loop:

  •  Enter a live 30-minute match in the sky

  •  Explore floating islands for resources and loot

  •  Build and upgrade your island during the match

  •  Raid other players’ islands for valuable loot

  •  Defend your island from incoming raids

  • Extract with what you can carry

  • Everything you build and bring back stays

Your Island

  • Your island is your base.

  • You build it during matches.

  • Other players can raid it.

  • You can raid theirs.

  • You upgrade it with resources you find or take.

  • You can fortify it with traps and defenses.

  • It is the same island every match.

  • It grows as you get more powerful.

Exploration & Risk

  • Everything you carry is at risk.

  • The deeper you explore, the more valuable the loot.

  • The more valuable the loot, the greater the danger.

  • If you extract successfully, you keep what you found.

  • If you fall, you lose what you were carrying.

The World

  • The map is different every match.

  • Island layouts, loot spawns, enemy encounters, and objectives change each time you play.

  • Hidden underground cities, powerful boss fights, and rare discoveries are scattered across the sky.

  • No two matches unfold the same way.

Play Your Way!

You can explore casually, focus on building, hunt bosses, raid other players, or chase high-risk loot runs. How you grow your island is up to you.

There has been litany of improvements made to the game so far. In addition to setting up the private API to manage cross-play matchmaking, I have been completely rebuilding the game to incorporate many more components and streamline action using Unreal's Gameplay Ability System. 

I'm hoping to do a release in the coming weeks, in Alpha. All the improvements I've incorporated are building the groundwork for swift character development when ready.

Incorporate IK and advanced Animations on the Sheriff character.
Rebuild the Card System using GAS.
Updated map and other visuals.
Build the character leveling and GAS based ability system. 

BETA TODOS:

Complete Steam/Epic/PC Matchmaking on Dedicated Servers.
Player accounts for game stats on official website.
6 complete characters.
Deck Builder.

RELEASE TODOS:
10 Complete Characters.
Character customizing.
Map creatures and events.
Console Feasibility Study.

POST-RELEASE:
Single player character DLCs (story driven).
More maps,
More characters,
More gamemodes!



5/16/25

Well its been two years without much development since I was working two jobs and have a family to look after. I was laid off a couple months ago due to the tariff war and now I'm back on the game development.

The original alpha could never be competitive because it was self hosted. That was always a glaring problem. I am currently building an website and API to handle player accounts and matchmaking using dedicated servers. You can check out the "coming soon" website at the website listed to the right in "Visit the Website," there you can subscribe for promotional updates. 

I am a software engineer and this is the first fully featured online game I have made. I am working solo and I have zero budget. Adding characters, special abilities, a card deck maker, a character customizer, custom banners, and cross-play are all on the agenda. But I'm starting at the backend bottom and working back up to the game state where I'm building Unreal blueprints in C++ to handle the API authentication and other calls.


(5/22/23 - First released version has some glaring bugs! I'm sorry but some sound effects are not being heard on all clients, and some bugs with point capture are present)

Dawn vs Dusk is a 3v3, PvPvE, asymmetric, hard-point capture, styled, brawler.

Featuring Unreal Engine 5 and Paragon assets, this game is a re-imagining of what that franchise could have been. There are no lanes, there are no towers to destroy; only three capture pads.

When a team captures a pad they get Gold points to spend on card upgrades. Cards change the game by giving health, mana, or damage boosts. Each player receives 5 lives with no respawn timer, so play smart! Last team standing wins!

As of today, May 22, 2023 the game is still a baby. Please be patient as I work solo to build and update this game.

Early access, pre-alpha gameplay is not representative of the finished product, but comments and constructive criticism are welcome.

2072540.name: icosi-do
2072540.about_the_game:
This minimalist puzzle game is as much a game of logic as it is of patience. The objective of each puzzle is to swap pairs of colored rods such that all four rods that meet in any of 30 corners have different colors - a problem known as "edge coloring" in mathematics. The catch is to solve each puzzle with a limited number of swaps (unless you deactivate that limit).

The game offers thousands of procedurally generated puzzles in dozens of difficulty levels in various single-player modes as well as shared-screen cooperative and competitive multiplayer modes. The four single-player modes are: with and without limited number of swaps, and with the different kinds of rods visualized as colors or as rotations. The puzzles range in difficulty from very easy to extremely difficult. The most difficult puzzles will test the patience even of hard-core puzzle fans.

Inspired by a fictional game of a popular sci-fi TV series, the puzzle design combines a mathematical problem (edge coloring an icosidodecahedral graph) with a comfortable learning curve and extra challenging modes for the most devoted fans.

Other Features

  • Players may use keyboard, mouse, Xbox controller, or any combination of them. Remote Play Together is supported.
  • Settings are provided to customize sensitivity and rotation directions of controls, as well as many other aspects of the game.
  • The innovative game menu is an unusual visual treat as all text is formed by the same 60 swirling rods that also form the puzzles.
  • Each puzzle is represented by a 6-digit code such that it is easy to replay and share any puzzle.
  • The background music consists of procedurally modified versions of three preludes by Johann Sebastian Bach in dozens of variations - from dreamily slow piano to blazingly fast guitar.
  • The game offers 29 achievements and 3 leaderboards.
  • Tilt Five™ Glasses are supported but not required. A second pair of Tilt Five™ Glasses may be used by a spectating player.

The Tilt Five™ holographic gaming system transforms video games into 3D vibrant holographic environments directly on your tabletop. Using the Tilt Five™ augmented reality (AR) glasses, Gameboard, and Wand controller, you can immerse yourself–and friends–in experiences like never before. Share and enjoy holograms together locally, remotely, or even stream them to your favorite social platforms.

Visit Tilt Five's franchise to find out more and to order your Tilt Five system.

  • Co-op Mode: Play with friends up to 4 players or team up with other gamers on online servers within the game. Teamwork makes tackling tough challenges easier and more fun, and the built-in voice chat helps you coordinate better.

  • Game Map: The map has been designed in a way to continuously enrich your gaming experience. Exploring the map will lead you to discover various strategies for completing missions.

  • Rising Challenge: The further you advance in performing the ritual, the game conditions grow increasingly perilous.

  • Nightmare Mode: A hardcore test for dedicated gamers. The game conditions are at their most treacherous.

  • Single Player Mode: Brace yourself! Study the rules, pick up on the subtleties, and stay vigilant for dangers.

  • Replayability: Each gaming session offers a unique experience. The locations of ritual objects, locked doors, traps, and the behavior of the possessed are randomized.

2072660.name: Voidborn
2072660.about_the_game:
Voidborn is a fast-paced roguelite FPS set in a crumbling dark fantasy world where the player takes on the role of a Voidborn - a powerful being created for one purpose; kill.

Dash, slide, and wall-run through ancient underground cities, lava filled caves, blood soaked ruins, dark castles, and massive tombs. Slay demons to receive themed powerups to your different weapons and follow their upgrade paths to create devastating builds.

  • Use a wide variety of movement abilities to platform and avoid attacks.

  • Create devastating weapon- and character builds.

  • Face hordes of many different enemies and challenge tough bosses.

Grow stronger with every rebirth with permanent abilites and weapon upgrades as you face inevitable death. Challenge the demi-gods and avenge god to fulfill your destiny as a Voidborn.

  • Evolve after each death with permanent abilities and weapon upgrades.

  • Journey through a vast and varied dark fantasy world with unlockable shortcuts.

  • Take on the Trials of the Scarlet Curse, a custom difficulty system that ramps up the intensity to game-changing insanity.

2072680.name: Jack the Nipper
2072680.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1986, this classic game for home microcomputers from British developers Gremlin Graphics saw players take on the role of toddler terror Jack in his quest to be as naughty as possible! Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Included are both the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions.

Gameplay

Toddle throughout the town, bringing your own brand of baby bedlam. Jump on things, pick up objects and drop them where they will be the most annoying, find and use a wide variety of items to raise your naughtyness as high as possible! But be careful: many enemies roam the screens looking to give you a nasty nappy rash.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2072690.name: CYCLEBREAKER
2072690.about_the_game:
CYCLEBREAKER is an arcade style top-down bullet-hell where you deflect bullets and take down invading minibosses with just your laser sword, in pursuit of the highest combo!
Missing your attacks temporarily stuns you, so be swift yet precise as the onslaught of bullets and robots try to take you down!

Features

  • Reach the highest round you can by charging Uplinker zones.
  • Attain the highest combo! Every multiple of 10 you reach heals you.
  • ...and have fun! CYCLEBREAKER is designed to be fun whether you play for just a minute or for hours at a time!

2072730.name: Chyss
2072730.about_the_game:
Chyss is a turnbased, tactical 1vs1 game based on chess.
You can move, attack, and consume your mana to spells and use items when it's your turn.
Your goal is to destroy your opponent's Leader!

The year is 12022.
Number of civilisations evolved from primitive life to being able to travel the universe.
In this universe, a game has evolved to become essential: The Chyss.

The Chyss has its roots in chess, but many have added to the rules in order to create its successor. A timeless, universal, and balanced game, allowing interplanetary competition, where fair play, game intelligence and risk-taking are the traits of legendary players.
Young children want to become great Chyss players, the vast majority of adults play, whether to have fun, relax, explore the possibilities, or to pursue their childhood dreams.

In this universe, a phenomenon affects about a third of the people...
About a third of people become incarnates overnight. Falling asleep as themselves, they wake up controlled by different, higher forces.
These forces do not want their loss, but simply direct their steps, their actions.

You are this higher force which is going to take control of an inhabitant of this universe.
You, and all the other players of this video game...
You will embody an incarnate.

This incarnate is now you.
Your goal will be determined by you. You can become the best Chyss player in the universe, but there are many pitfalls along the way.
There are many extremely strong, clever players in this universe.
The best Chyss player in the universe is anonymous. She is only known as "The Galaxy Queen".
Good luck! And battle with pride.

2072780.name: Sex Adventures - The Office Slut
2072780.about_the_game:
About the game
A visual novel about a hot sales agent who faked her sales reports to get a bonus. Once her colleague finds out about it, he starts blackmailing her.

Visual Novel Description

Cindy is a hot sales agent working for a successful real estate company.
Blonde, tall, and with enviable shapes, all she has to do all day is to look good and conclude contracts by phone.
Even though her boss didn't want to hire her initially, after looking at her cleavage once more, she gave her a chance.
Now she’s competing for the annual bonus, but behind her outstanding results lies a little secret.
During the year, she managed to falsify some sales reports, hoping that no one would ever check on them.
Her biggest competitor, Lucas, eventually finds out about her maneuvers and starts taking advantage of her situation.
How will Cindy solve this problem? Will she be able to keep her job? How far is she willing to go? Let's find out together.

- Animations

2072820.name: Book Quest
2072820.about_the_game:
Embark on a medieval adventure to reclaim a family heirloom of great power!



Take the role of a young man who witnesses the theft of his family’s magic book, which leads to a visit by his grandfather’s ghost compelling him to embark on a dangerous journey to retrieve it. Explore the surrounding towns and wilderness, gather information from townsfolk, strengthen your character with new weapons and gear, track down the culprits who stole the magic book and discover the truth behind it all!



Book Quest is an action adventure RPG presented in retro pixel art style featuring cinematic cutscenes and dialogue. Throughout this medieval fantasy, gameplay alternates between top-down and side-scrolling perspectives. Dodge roll and execute melee attacks, collect key items, solve environmental puzzles, equip new gear as you progress and engage in unique mini games as you travel between map locations! This is a nostalgic adventure suitable for all ages, whether you’re a long-time gamer who recalls the genre classics or a newcomer just learning the ropes.



Features:

  • Explore a medieval fantasy world in top-down pixel art style!
  • Run, dodge and attack in real-time combat.
  • Equip new weapons and gear to strengthen your character!
  • Solve brainteasing puzzles and play side-scrolling mini games.
  • Enjoy charming cutscenes and dialogue that drive the narrative.
  • Discover the truth behind your family’s stolen magic book!

2072830.name: Dr.Pumpkin Chapter 2: The SCP hunt
2072830.about_the_game:
Dr. Pumpkin Island is shrouded in mystery and intrigue, with its inhabitants being some of the most unusual creatures you'll ever encounter. From the moment you step onto the island, you'll feel like you've entered a different world, with strange noises and peculiar sights around every corner.

The island is home to a variety of puzzles, ranging from easy to mind-bending difficult. The inhabitants of the island seem to take great pleasure in devising these puzzles and watching outsiders struggle to solve them. Some of the puzzles are physical, requiring you to use your strength and agility to get through, while others are more mental, requiring you to use your wits and intellect to unravel their mysteries.

As you explore the island, you'll encounter a variety of strange creatures that seem to have evolved in ways that defy explanation. Some are small and nimble, darting around your feet as you walk, while others are massive and lumbering, capable of crushing you with a single swipe of their enormous claws.

One of the most fascinating aspects of Dr. Pumpkin Island is its flora. The island is covered in lush, vibrant vegetation, but many of the plants seem to possess strange, otherworldly properties. Some plants glow in the dark, while others emit a strange, hypnotic scent that can put you into a trance-like state.

Despite the many dangers that lurk on Dr. Pumpkin Island, there is something undeniably alluring about the place. Perhaps it's the sense of adventure that comes with exploring uncharted territory, or maybe it's the thrill of solving puzzles and unraveling mysteries. Whatever it is, one thing is for certain: those who dare to venture to this strange and mysterious island will never forget the experience.

2072840.name: Word Factori
2072840.about_the_game:
Word Factori is a word-building game where your only resource is the letter "i". Build a chain of factories to bend, rotate, reflect, and merge "i" into more complex letters. Discover secret letter recipes, unlock hidden word art, and optimize your factory chains for high scores.

BUZZ


"Might be the best brain-teaser since Wordle"
PC Gamer

"Done with alarming proficiency"
Mark Brown (GMTK)

"A short factory game with a beautiful concept"
Aliensrock

CHAIN FACTORIES

Connect factories to bend, merge, rotate, and reflect the letter "i". Bend "i" into a "C". Reflect the "C", and merge it with another "C" to make an "O". Use your intuition to build the full alphabet.

COMPLETE YOUR RECIPE BOOK

Many letters have multiple recipes. Experiment with different factory chains to build letters (and more?) in new ways. Discover all of them to fill your recipe book!

COLLECT STICKERS

Building certain words will unlock stickers to fill your scrapbook. Play the word of the day and try typing your own words to discover letter art, built entirely from the game's font.

OPTIMIZE

Optimize your factory chains for high scores, competing on 3 metrics. Or, ignore optimization and focus on the visual aesthetic of your builds.


FEATURES

  • Build entire words with nothing but the letter "i" and a chain of factories
  • Conquer unique challenge levels that restrict your resources
  • Play player-shared words, build the word of the day, or type your own words
  • Fill your recipe journal by discovering new ways to make each letter
  • Collect stickers in your scrapbook by building special words
  • Optimize your builds, competing on three metrics

StarGazers is an interactive experience that allows players to explore a magical forest from the perspective of three different creatures.



A mind-bending ‘Alice in wonderland’ troupe experience where the user journeys through an enchanted forest that isn’t what it seems. Players transform into the various life forms they interact with, taking them deeper and deeper into the layers of the experience as the world gets progressively stranger. The environments react to the player’s movements and actions for added immersion.



KEY FEATURES

  • Transform into four magical creatures.
    Bringing out your wild side has never been easier than in StarGazers. Through use of the constellations, change your form into multiple different animals. Each animal comes with a separate movement mechanic, from jumping to flying. You must use your new found skills as an animal to traverse the diverse and colorful environments around you.

  • Explore four drastically different environments.
    Deep dive into dark and twisted forests, rocky swamps, an underwater chasm, and a cloudy escape from reality. In this VR experience, discover the vastness of the world animals live in.

2072890.name: Foster: Ghost Child | 養小鬼
2072890.about_the_game:
Story
Yun Xiu court, located in a remote mountainous area, was once a bustling casino and hotel. However, it was forced to close overnight. The truth behind it is chilling. Liu Xi must explore this mysterious haunted hotel to solve the case of her parents' disappearance and the ghostly apparitions that have been haunting her. How will she survive in this ever threatening environment? Help her unravel the layers of mystery and return to safety.

“Ever since my parents' bizarre disappearance, I've been having nightmares about a group of pregnant women in cheongsams and a scary woman draped in thorns.” Liu Xi


The Gameplay
Foster: Ghost Child provides an atmospheric horror that incorporates East Asian elements rarely used in games. The game makes use of Chinese traditional elements to convey a distinct and frightful storyline that incorporates Taoism, Buddhism, and Chinese mythology.

You had to explore the otherworldly rooms and find objects to interact with while escaping from the vengeful spirit. A cursed, sinister past will eventually surface as further mysteries are solved.



Key Features
-Foster: Ghost Child is solo developed by one person
-First-person with a spine-chilling atmosphere
-Immersive gameplay and puzzle-solving experience
-Eastern cultural references
-Unique and appealing graphics

2072980.name: Final Knight
2072980.about_the_game:
Final Knight is a strategy-driven action RPG inspired by the world of Dungeons & Dragons.
In a classic fantasy setting, players form a party using a wide range of weapons, spells, artifacts, and items to face massive bosses that threaten the world.

Combat

Outside of your directly controlled character, allies act automatically.
Take advantage of the Tactical Command (time-stop) system, inspired by CRPGs, to pause the battle and issue orders with precision.

Seamlessly switch between characters in real time—taunt enemies as the Warrior, unleash Meteor as the Wizard, perform a Backstep as the Rogue, or cast healing spells as the Cleric—chaining them together into powerful combos.

Party Building

Choose 4 characters out of 9 distinct classes to form your party.

Each class fulfills a fundamental role—Tank, Damage Dealer, or Support—and can further specialize through leveling, advanced job changes, and stat growth.

With unique feats from equipment and the Formation system that alters party positioning, you can craft and execute your own strategies.

Growth Paths

Every party member can progress in multiple ways:

  • Advanced job changes

  • Unlocking unique feats

  • Mastery upgrades

  • Crafting and fusing equipment

  • Gear enhancement

  • Discovering bonds between characters

Your team evolves endlessly along the paths you choose.

Endless Gameplay Loop

Take on raid-style battles against powerful bosses.
Break their weak points, harvest materials, and forge new equipment.
When enemies are staggered, unleash devastating combos by combining strategy with precise controls to bring them down.

Local Multiplayer

■ Play offline 2-player co-op, experiment with skill synergies, and discover new ways to combine abilities with a friend.

Earth's Center of Gravity is an interactive visual novel with multiple endings. The game's story is about fate and revolves around an antique shop called "Tower Antiques."

2073050.name: Emma's Armaments
2073050.about_the_game:
Our father has disappeared, leaving us with a huge debt!
The only way to pay this back is to successfully run the store!

Let's help the two manage the store successfully!

●Game Flow

・ Go to the dungeon and defeat monsters. You can get items by defeating monsters. You can "Sell" items or use them for "Alchemy," in which two or more items are combined to create a new item.
・ If you run low on energy during a dungeon, press the [Return] button to go home. You can bring back the items you acquired in the dungeon. Note that you cannot bring back items if your energy reaches 0.
・ Items can be refined through alchemy to make them even more powerful and valuable. Since powerful items make dungeon conquests much easier, be proactive about refining items.
・ Items and monsters have attributes. There are four attributes: None, Fire, Grass, and Water. The none attribute has no particular effect, but fire is strong against grass, grass is strong against water, and water is strong against fire. Properly accounting for attribute compatibility increases attack power and decreases damage received, so be mindful about the attributes of items you equip.
・ The game is cleared when all dungeons are traversed and liberated, and finally when the asset reaches 10 million gold.

The greatly increased volume version "1.1.6" is now available!


After the first release, we have responded to requests for "more volume! we have also introduced an "additional implementation" that can be enjoyed after the 10 million gold achievement. (2/7/2023)
Please enjoy the completed version, which includes a major update on the scale of the main game.
This is also already available in English.

2073150.name: Eldritch Empathy

In this Lovecraftian rogue-lite, you’ll use your research notes and tools to learn the language of the great beyond. Learn to understand the ancient horror that roams the earth– or kill its offspring, and face the consequences. What matters is that you act fast: if their influence is left unchecked, the world will succumb to chaos and corruption. Your decisions will determine the fate of humanity.

Talk to an Ancient Being

Mere days ago, an otherworldly behemoth pierced the veil of our reality. Looming over your homeland, it corrupts the minds of both the people of your village and the wildlife in the surrounding forests. Only you seem spared from its influence… until feverish nightmares begin to plague you. The entity in a sea of white– It tries to communicate, but the strange symbols it reveals have no meaning to you. To understand why it’s here, you first need to learn its language

Survive and Explore the Wilderness

Your first expedition is bound to fail, as is your second. But with some practice and research, you may just find yourself deeper and deeper within the chaos and corruption. What will you find at the root of it all?

Time-based Combat

Rely on your notes as your sanity wears thin. Being face to face with these horrors takes a toll on you as well.

Game Features:

  • Study the eldritch language: Use your steadily growing research notes to understand the horrors and learn how to communicate with them.
  • Uncover a mystery: Find out who - or what - unleashed these horrors upon our reality.
  • Choose your destiny: Will you save your village, or watch it succumb to madness? Join a cult, or weaponize the monsters? The fate of humanity lies in your hands.

2073220.name: Outland Kingdoms
2073220.about_the_game:
Congratulations and Good Tidings! You have been selected by the Eternal Emperor to lead an colonial expedition into the dark continent of Arkana. Rich new deposits of the most sacred Arkanite has been discovered, and it is up to you to claim it for the Holy Human Empire.

BUILD


Expect challenges the moment you set foot on your new settlement. Design and build shelters for your people, grow crops, tame and raise animals, produce goods for trading, craft weapons, armor and items. Prepare for changing seasons and varying weather. Start from a humble hut to a sprawling trading town. Build mansions and castles protected by our most advanced towers, powered by Arkanite mana. Just make sure to pay the Emperor's taxes, or else. Rebellion will not be tolerated.

FIGHT


Peace through Power! Nowhere is that more true than Arkana. Our rivals and enemies are abound; the mercenary armies of the Serene League are on the prowl for slaves and plunder. Bloodthirsty Orc warlords are always looking to turn us into meat. The ever-hidden elves scheme in their nests, sharpening their arrows to hunt our people. And above all, pay no attention to the rumors of the Necromancer Kings returning. The undead were all exterminated in the Great Crusade, taking their dark arts with them. The howls and screams you hear at night are just were-beasts, nothing more.

EXPAND


In His Divine Grace and Wisdom, the Eternal Emperor has decreed that non-humans are now welcome amongst us. Balance the needs of a growing population. Every single one of our subjects have their own wants, needs, and favorites. These outlanders are notoriously prone to bouts of emotion, and gain friends, enemies, and lovers. Make sure everyone is eating healthy food and entertained with drinks and fun activities.

DEVELOP


The ship-borne journey from the Imperial Capital to Arkana is long and dangerous. You will have to make do with what you have and rediscover our old technology. Craft Legendary items for your people. Devise ingenious new ways of using Arkanite mana. Read ancient books to learn new skills and abilities. But remember: stay away from the forbidden magica you might find in the dark continent. The punishment for treason is swift and severe!

CONQUER


Once your settlement is fully developed, you will be able to send out your own expeditions into the dark unknown. Explore ruins. Go on scouting missions. Tame dragons and other creatures. Accomplish quests for our Holy Empire and whatever 'allies' you might meet.

This is a brave, dangerous new world out here. It is up to you to raise our banners from here to the ends of this land. Glory to the Holy Human Empire and Praise the Eternal Emperor!

MAIN FEATURES

- Detailed building system. Build houses, courtyards, towns and castles. Be careful about fire or the defensive layout of your settlement. Power your settlement with mana.

- Day and night system. Weather and seasons affects gameplay in a major way

- Play how you want. Choose to have a peaceful trading settlement, settling conflicts through bribes. Or maybe have a slaver camp? Or what about a necromancer's enclave?

2073420.name: Paresis®
2073420.about_the_game:
*10% of all proceeds will be going to our local homeless shelter. I encourage anyone to do the same in their local area.

*Headphones are crucial for beating some of the harder phases within Paresis's endgame.

PARESIS® takes place within a small house in the middle of nowhere. Here you will be faced with numerous challenges.

GAMEPLAY

You will have to survive 5 minutes to complete each Phase. In Paresis® you are surrounded by 4 rooms. These rooms will unlock throughout each phase and will have a new unique enemy you must encounter. In Paresis®, these enemies are called Morphs and they have their own positives and negatives. For example, one may be faster then another but they will have fewer hiding spots. On the other hand, you, the player, have zero movement and must use your lean and flame energy to survive the phase. However, each phase will become harder and you must undergo new obstacles. Once you complete a phase you will be able to make a choice between faster leaning speeds, or extra energy. Flame energy will scare away the Morphs and leaning helps you locate Morphs faster.

HARDCORE MODE

Hardcore Mode is obtained after you complete Paresis's main Phases. Completing the ending Phases within Paresis's main game can serve as a real challenge even for some of the best gamers. If you do beat the final Phase within Paresis®, you will unlock the option to play Hardcore. This adds even more challenge to the existing Phases but also changes up some gameplay elements as well. However, in this mode you will not be able to upgrade your lean speed or energy. This mode is targeted for anyone who wants the hardest challenge possible within a horror game experience.

STORY

Paresis® has plenty of lore for those interested in the game's story. If you beat a phase, you will be able to listen to radios that can help you understand more of the game's secrets. These radios are extremely important to the game's overall plot. Although, there are plenty of little easter eggs hidden about that also carry more of the game's overarching narrative. However, some things are better left unsaid.

CHALLENGING

Paresis is a very challenging game once you reach some of the ending phases. This will test your listening, logic, and timing skills. In order to beat these phases, you will have to dig deep and figure out what is the best strategy moving forward. Whether that is picking certain rooms to check at specific times or making sure you pick the right combination of lean and energy in order to survive.

ENTER AT YOUR OWN RISK!

故事背景：
圣主建国之初，中原之地民生凋敝、土地荒芜；内有贼寇肆虐之忧，外有四夷犯境之扰。圣主遂定下休养生息之策，轻徭薄役，鼓励农耕，经过一番励精图治，终于建立了一个强盛的王朝。之后西讨羌胡，南平六诏，逐瓦剌于阴山之下，驱流寇于东海之滨。此后的十余年里，天朝对外则兵威所向，四夷臣服；对内则政治清明，百业兴旺，天朝之名遂播于海外，隐然有天下霸主之威。之后燕然一役，大败修罗大军于燕然山下，虽然国力大伤，却也为天朝赢得了十余年的和平与安宁。

　然则物极必反，盛极必衰，天朝的继承者并没有圣主那般经天纬地之材，他们沉迷酒色，在奢靡的生活中醉生梦死。朝中宦官趁机把持朝政，假天子之名横征暴敛，戮害忠良，一时间流寇四起，民怨滔天，天朝国力空前衰弱。

危难关头，公主菲雪挺身而出，诛杀奸佞，重振朝纲。她不拘一格启用年轻有为的将领稳住战局，同时号令天下武林共同抵御外侮，并宣称若有人能救万民于水火，扶社稷于将倾，则自己愿意下嫁与他，并且可以成为下一任的天朝帝王。在江山美人的诱惑之下，武林人士人人振奋，中原形式为之一新，虽然天朝尚不能收复失地，却也令修罗大军无法再西侵半步，双方开始进入僵持阶段。

　　然而就在这时令人震惊的消息先后传来！江湖上失传已久的绝世秘笈“轩辕录”再现江湖，而公主菲雪却在七侠镇一带神秘失踪。江湖传言只有“盗圣”白展堂知道“轩辕录”的下落，而后者竟然委身于七侠镇的同福客栈中担任杂役！于是有心者浮想联翩，“轩辕录”将在七侠镇出世的留言不胫而走，这个原本平凡的小镇一夜之间成为江湖风暴的中心！

　　得轩辕录者得武林，得轩辕录者得天下！传说中轩辕录中不但记载着轩辕那足以横行天下的绝世武学，更隐藏着一个巨大宝藏的秘密！

有人说，公主一定是微服出访，寻找那足以拯救天朝的绝世秘笈；有人说她厌倦了血腥的争斗，为了一个凄美的爱情誓约，远走他乡；还有人说，这一切的一切，无非是修罗族的阴谋，他们掠走了公主，杜撰轩辕录的谎言，目的就是动摇中原武林的团结局面。

　　不过无论真相如何，天朝都陷入了一次前所未有的危机之中，人们在窒息般的绝望中默默祈祷，但更多的人却又憧憬着成为主宰乱世的英雄！江山美人的诱惑让无数人义无反顾投身于暗潮汹涌的江湖之中，于是一个欢乐的、奇异的、动荡的、浪漫的江湖向你敞开大门，等待着你的探索！

2073620.name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
2073620.about_the_game:
Arena Breakout: Infinite is a high-stakes tactical extraction shooter where every decision matters. Fight, loot, and extract alive—or lose it all. With realistic visuals, true-to-life sound design, and unforgiving PvPvE combat, every raid is a gamble between glory and ruin.

Arena Breakout: Infinite has meticulously crafted 6 distinctive maps, with each demanding a radical shift in raid strategy. Sprint through the tight Valley corridors for hit-and-run strikes or plan a tactical siege in the Armory’s block-by-block warzone. But pay attention, nature doesn’t play by your rules - everchanging weather in the Dark Zone can alter every extraction into a new desperate gamble. Outthink, outgun, and extract - before the zone swallows you whole.

Arena Breakout: Infinite welcomes military enthusiasts with our Ultimate Gunsmith System. With the arrival of Season 5, we’re expanding your arsenal with the all-new FAMAS and T192. Choose from over 75 guns and 900 weapon mods across 20+ attachment slots to craft your ultimate tactical masterpiece.

Anomalies have consumed the distorted valley, warping the battlefield with every ominous toll of the bell. Within this volatile expanse, triggering interactive forces instantly betrays your position to lurking monsters and rival players alike. Stay alert and adapt to the evolving distortions—surviving the valley requires constant vigilance.

Arena Breakout: Infinite welcomes all players with rich QoL features like Quick Equip and Map Pinging. This commitment to accessibility continues with proximity chat and fine-tuned balancing—ensuring a fair, optimized, and intense extraction experience for everyone.

Your Trophy Room is more than a display—it’s the heart of your progression. Proudly showcase your hard-earned loot while crafting high-performance ammo and advanced armor. With fresh seasonal challenges and rewards, your tactical advantage grows every day. Don't forget the crown jewel: a free 3X3 Titanium Case to secure your high-value gear in every raid.

Arena Breakout: Infinite offers a variety of game modes for all operators - Tactical Ops, Solo Ops, Covert Ops and fast-paced 4v4 Deathmatch modes. Whether you prefer tactical teamwork or going in alone, you decide how you take on the fight.

In Arena Breakout: Infinite, fair combat is a guarantee with our ever-improving, anti-cheat system. This includes Killcam Replays that allow you to submit a one-tap report whenever you flag suspicious activity. Moreover, if you’re confirmed to have lost a match due to cheating, automatic in-game compensation will hit your inventory.

2073710.name: Tomb of Mask
2073710.about_the_game:
《面具古墓》是由《隐秘的原罪》系列原班人马打造的一款民国风悬疑解谜游戏。核心元素依然是我们最拿手的悬疑解谜加剧情推理。同时，得益于《隐秘的原罪》系列作品积累的经验，这回的《面具古墓》，我们有了更多的进化！

这次的进化包括但不限于以下几点：
  • 更诡秘曲折的剧情故事！
  • 更精美的国风美术风格！
  • 更考究的人物、道具和场景设计！
  • 更有氛围感的剧情动画！
  • 更丰富的民俗典故！
  • 更有沉浸感的第三人称视角！
  • 更便于操作与细节表现的横屏构图！

再次感谢粉丝们一直以来的支持，你们的陪伴是我们成长的动力！



人与妖岂能相恋！
报恩？牺牲？救苍生？
能救回那一段刻骨铭心的爱么？
你做了那么多，你可知道，这世间最大的恐怖，到底是妖怪，还是……

— · 故事背景 · —

上古时代，共工氏撞倒不周山，天塌南北，地陷东南，大地洪水泛滥，民不聊生。
女娲补天，大禹治水，救天下苍生于水深火热之中。大妖巫支祁于淮源兴风作浪，被大禹擒拿镇压在龟山之下。大禹之妻涂山氏授青丘胡族以宝物“青丘之面”、“涂山镜”，看守被镇压的巫支祁，其地诡秘莫测，被称之为“巫陷墓”。转眼数千年时光过去，巫陷墓中的镇压封印渐渐松动，导致巫支祁一丝邪力外泄。
胡、黄、白、柳、灰五族内乱，胡族族人举族携带“青丘之面”来到人间。
时光荏苒，数百年后，我们的故事从南华城里一栋名为“天狐大厦”的建筑中开始了……

诡秘大厦中，流传着入夜不可外出的规则，究竟是有人作祟，还是……
美人拜月，帝流浆，梦魇幻境……
重重迷雾掩映之下，隐藏着怎样一段纠葛数百年的爱情故事？
五仙家的命运究竟如何？
巫陷墓的封印究竟会否解开？

2073790.name: HeadHorse Legacy
2073790.about_the_game:
The most diabolical killer from smartphones is now on Steam. You have 5 days to survive and escape from the lair of this horrifying kidnapper with a horse's head. But don't think it will be easy. HeadHorse is a highly intelligent assassin with an unparalleled thirst for blood, and he is tracking your every move. No place is safe in this game, and at any moment you can be caught by HeadHorse or his dog, Grinder. Solve puzzles to escape and survive in a dark and terrifying scenario.


Try to escape from HeadHorse and Grinder in the liminal world of the Backrooms. Solve puzzles to open the door and escape, but it won't be easy. The scenario of HeadHorse in the Backrooms is challenging, and you will need to create strategies to succeed.


The game offers 6 difficulty levels, ranging from Ghost, which is the easiest where the player is not seen by the enemy, to Madness mode, where escaping is nearly impossible. Play and put yourself to the test. Will you be able to escape?


In addition to the default skin, you can play with 6 skins from alternative universes:

HeadHorse Animatronic: Rumor has it that he is an animatronic toy in a themed restaurant, and one day, after a short circuit, he killed several children during a birthday party.

Jason HeadHorse: A cunning killer who would eliminate anyone who approached his lair.

HeadHorse Nemesis: A bloodthirsty monster who hunted down survivors during a zombie apocalypse.

HeadHorse Dr. Salvador: Straight from the distant villages of Spain, this assassin will dismember you using his chainsaw.

Pyramid HeadHorse: From the depths of a macabre universe, he is one of the guardians, punishing all who end up there for their sins with his enormous blade.

HeadHorse Sushiman: He only wanted to be a sushi chef, but after criminals destroyed his restaurant, he swore revenge against all who ruined his dreams.

2073850.name: THE FINALS
2073850.about_the_game:
GOT WHAT IT TAKES?

Viewers at home, here's the news you've been waiting to hear: THE FINALS is accepting new contestants, and that means YOU! That's right, soon the world could be watching YOU tear apart our newest dynamic arenas and seize everlasting fame!

As you know, THE FINALS is the world's greatest free-to-play combat game show! Our contestants plug in to our virtual world and join teams in escalating tournaments. They fight it out in our beautifully-rendered arenas based on real-world locations that they can alter, exploit, and even destroy.

Sure, you can aim and shoot, but contestants that add our carefully curated virtual environments to their arsenal are more likely to advance, so do anything you can imagine in the name of victory! Burn arenas to the ground! Send wrecking balls crashing into your opponents! Don't just pull triggers - pull down buildings!

THE WORLD IS WATCHING

THE FINALS thrives on spectacle, so drive your fans wild with thrilling combat and your own personal flair as you compete for worldwide fame and the support of our discerning and stylish sponsors.

Play Your Way - Whether it’s sneaking up on enemy squads with a katana in hand or ripping an entire building out from under their feet with explosives, THE FINALS lets YOU make the call! With different skills across body builds and a wide array of weapons and gadgets, you'll have all the tools to make your playstyle your own!

The World Is Your Weapon (And Enemy) - A skilled contender might go in guns blazing, but with environmental destruction in your arsenal, that’s just the start of what you can wield against your foes! All of our arenas can be altered, used, or reduced to rubble - and not just by you.

Your Rising Star - Ready for your close-up? Standing out in THE FINALS means the eyes of the world will be upon you, so you’d better look your best! Gather fans and fame as you craft a unique avatar with the help of our generous sponsors and dazzling customization options!

GET FAMOUS

This is the opportunity of a lifetime. Arenas based on iconic places, unparalleled destruction, and endless tactical possibilities await - make them your own, and the floodgates of fame will open. Your competition will have the same opportunities, so it’ll be up to you to be more clever and attention-grabbing. Are you up to the challenge? Are you the world’s next all-star?

Can you reach THE FINALS?

2073910.name: A Webbing Journey
2073910.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE HOUSE  🏠

You're a tiny spider in a big home. Climb anything, swing everywhere, and weave webs across entire rooms. The humans are out. Now it's your time to get to work.

Every surface is yours to explore: walls, ceilings, furniture, even the aquarium. The house is enormous from Silky's perspective, and every room is packed with secrets to uncover and plenty of opportunities to make a beautiful mess.

BECOME A WEB DESIGNER  🕸️

Stretch your webs from wall to wall, lift objects, build bridges, and create structures nobody asked for. Your webs, your rules.

Whether you build a carefully engineered web to transport objects across the room or fling your webs at everything in sight, the physics system responds to every decision you make. Connect objects, suspend them from the ceiling, and use your webs to swing yourself to new heights.

CHORES HAVE NEVER BEEN THIS FUN  🧼

The humans are out fighting the mysterious mortgage. Now it's time for Silky and the Web Scrubbers to pick up the slack, tackle chores, solve mysteries, and make the house their own. One web at a time.

Each room is home to a cast of new spiders with their own personalities, tasks, and problems that need solving. Cook breakfast, fix the aquarium, chase down runaway balloons, or help Vera crack the case of the mysterious Prof. Quack.

No two quests are the same, and most of them can be solved in more than one way.

EXPERIENCE LIFE AS A SPIDER  🕷️

  • Climb any surface, even upside down and underwater

  • Build intricate web structures across entire rooms

  • Swing freely with precise, responsive web mechanics

  • Interact with hundreds of physics-based objects

  • Customise Silky with hats, shoes, and various levels of fluffiness

  • And cause as much chaos as you want

2073950.name: Hotel Simulator
2073950.about_the_game:
long


In Hotel Simulator, you are a young businessman with a vision. After taking a loan, you buy a once-famous, forgotten hotel. Roll up your sleeves, clean up the place, renovate it and furnish it to your liking. Your goal is to pay your loan and achieve that five-star rating you’ve been dreaming of!

clean


Like they say: the first step is the hardest to take. Your newly acquired hotel is a pitiful sight. Start by taking the trash out, then clean all the dusty surfaces. The forgotten glory will start shining through!

renovate


It’s time to make your hotel livable. Fix the electricity, deal with leaking pipes, or rebuild destroyed walls. You’ll encounter different problems along the way, many of them surprising and demanding a bit of ingenuity.

decorate


When it comes to interior design, your imagination is the only limit! Choose any color or pattern for the walls. Adopt a consistent style, from art deco to modern! Alternatively, you can make it a fun mish-mash. Countless decorative items are available, so don’t rush it and have fun!

manage

Your guests will vary in personality and expectations. You can and should cater to them personally, but a thriving hotel needs staff. Hire employees, from room service to receptionists and stewards. Don’t forget to keep a close eye on their performance! Make sure you also have all the necessary foods and detergents in stock.

improve


You will start humbly but with a grand vision. Those five starts won’t be easy to earn! Balance your prices, give your patrons everything they demand, and your income will grow. Spend it on more luxurious equipment, new staff members, and more. Walk the road to success one step at a time!
Key Features
  • An easy-to-pick-up game that rewards your creativity.
  • Interact with your hotel in numerous meaningful ways, from moving items to changing the look of every room.
  • Choose from countless decorative items and utilities.
  • Meet distinctive hotel guests with unique personalities and expectations.
  • Manage everything: hire staff, assign hotel rooms, stock minibars, and set your prices.
  • See how rewarding it is to make change a dusty, forgotten building into a thriving hotel!

2073980.name: SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite
2073980.about_the_game:
Just 10 minutes per run! A casual roguelite RPG!

"Auto-Battle" x "Gear Swapping" x "Roguelite"

Combat is automatic—just change out weapons and outfits to build your team.

Each 10-minute run changes based on routes and events.

A nostalgic 2D RPG charm, reimagined in 3D with a fresh yet familiar feel.

Made for those grown-up players who once dreamed of adventures like these.

One summer day, a mysterious creature—Mogmo—appears in a quiet countryside town.

Three children set off on a journey to find where Mogmo truly belongs.

Together with new friends, they cross forests and deserts in a small yet grand adventure.

And what is the place Mogmo is meant to return to…?

Mogmo has a special ability: it can eat gear to combine skills.

Depending on how you feed it, you can create a one-of-a-kind skill set.

The game alternates between "Town Phase" and "Adventure Phase."

In town, you can explore freely, enjoy the story, and interact with the locals.

あああ

The "Adventure Phase" features auto battles as you journey toward the next town.

Gear found in battle can be swapped instantly.

Depending on the combinations, unique combo actions emerge.

Changing gear also changes your look, letting you enjoy styles that match your skills.

2074000.name: One Eleven
2074000.about_the_game:
Twelve individuals with deeply developed characters, whose destinies are intertwined in one terrible night that you have to endure.

Every decision you make, every carelessly thrown word, changes the course of events. Any of the twelve can become a victim and anyone can turn out to be a killer, which means that every time a new adventure awaits you.

However, catching a maniac, unraveling his secrets and motives is not all. Initially, you came to the meeting with a specific purpose. Find yourself a mate. And perhaps it is in such a critical, terrible situation that your hero will be able to find love.

Just try it!

  • How long to beat: 3-5 hours (main story) / 12-15 hours (achievements);

  • Original, pleasing to the eye design and art;

  • Enchanting voices of voice actors;

  • The game is entirely voiced;

  • Dark, noir-depressive atmosphere complemented by its own musical design;

  • Huge variability, allowing for high replayability;

  • A randomly generated beginning, coupled with many decisions affecting the plot, will each time lead to new, different situations;

  • The game has more than half a million words - which is comparable to a full-fledged fiction novel, the main character of which you will become.

2074010.name: Koa: A Gluttonous Wizard
2074010.about_the_game: Koa: a gluttonous wizard is a dungeon-crawling platformer full of elements to challenge your concentration, focus and reflexes. A wonky wizard, slave of his past, has decided to redeem himself and face one of his worst sins: Gluttony. Fight monsters and creatures created by your own fear, use magic and your willpower to defeat the beast that has kept you prisoner for decades. Overcome darkness in this tiny and quirky adventure full of fantasy, mystery and a lot of bitter sweet challenges.

2074050.name: A SIMPLE REQUEST
2074050.about_the_game:
In the quiet town of Morton, Louisiana, rumors of strange occurrences and incidents have been circulating among residents for years. Despite the efforts of the local police department to suppress rumors and reassure the community, rumors of the supernatural continue to spread.

When a series of mysterious deaths and disappearances occur in Morton, the police are at a loss to speculate. In desperation, they turn to Detective Thompson, an experienced investigator with a reputation for solving even the most difficult cases.

As Detective Thompson begins to look into the strange incidents in Morton, he realizes that there is more behind the incidents than meets the eye. The town hides a dark past, and something sinister operates beneath the surface of the earth.

As he delves deeper into the mystery, Detective Thompson finds himself drawn into a twisted world of horror and madness. He must confront his own demons and confront the evil lurking in Morton's shadows if he hopes to solve the case and bring peace to this troubled town.

MAIN FEATURES

A horror game about the small town of Morton with low-polygon graphics in the style of PS1.

The game has settings for colorblind people. The most common types of colorblindness are supported and you will be able to feel the colors in the game comfortably.

The game also uses the most simplified control system with controller support. For convenience, the game is already set up for optimal settings to go with the story and not have to mess around with the settings. But if you want to customize it to your liking, there are many options available to you with support for changing the control buttons to the ones you want.

No small amount of time has been devoted to sound, sound effects and intuitive sound events will add even more atmosphere and life to the small town of Morton.

There are many mysteries in and around Morton, find them, I'm sure you'll enjoy them.

2074120.name: Drive
2074120.about_the_game:
Illegal Racer

During the day, he works at a popular taxi company, and at night he turns in a risky game. In this situation all things may be crashed by one dangerous contract - after it his name will be blacklisted. Now, in order to stay free and maintain his reputation, he must do what he does best - masterfully escape from the chase.

An illegal racer has no goal, only a path

The elaborate open world in Night Drive gives you complete freedom of movement. Crime in the city is on the rise, corruption is on its hight. You were too visible and at one moment got on the first line of the "black list", now you cannot stay here. There is only you, the night and the road.

Police never sleep

After another dangerous contract, you failed to hide all traces behind you. For now you forced to leave this city before dawn. But the cops are on the alert and declare a hunt for you. Patrol crews blocked all possible escape routes. Only the speed and skills of the racer can save you.

From this game you can expect a lot of driving a car, some achievements by hidden objects that you can find on map if you will be very clever.

-many objects hidden on the map

-ability to drive a car

-interesting physics of the world

-magnificant buildings on the map

2074130.name: Binary: A Puzzling Platformer

🎼 Exciting metal riffs in the background - like a proper boomer shooter!

2074150.name: Sophonce
2074150.about_the_game:
Sophonce is a science fiction action horror first-person shooter that relies on philosophical undertones as the primary focus of the plot.

Features

  • Wide array of telekinetic abilities and elemental weaponry at your disposal.

  • Reflex Mode (Slo-Mo).

  • An impressive arsenal of weapons with each having unique attributes to them. Many different ammo types specific to each weapon such as stasis ammo, pyro ammo, gravity ammo, shock ammo, and rift ammo.

  • A riveting story that keeps track of your choices/actions that will ultimately determine the ending of the game.

  • And....more to be disclosed in the future!

Story Plot

At the beginning of the year 2222, a revolutionary technological device proved the existence of a soul which solidified proof of a higher power. The year is now 2973. The vast majority of humanity has been tank-bred over the past centuries due to a highly contagious otherworldly virus that permanently altered reproductive genomes and therefore effectively sterilized most of humanity. A dire consequence of this artificial breeding is that those who are tank-bred are soulless. You are Matthew, one of the soulless, an experimental tank-bred super soldier part of the royal regime task force division. You are sent on your lonesome to investigate a distress signal from a research facility located in Poseidon, a water-rich planet found in "The Black-Eye Galaxy". Luna, who is the Royal Protector of Mars, and her team were sent days before to investigate but communication with them has been lost. This is where your adventure begins.

It will be not easy. Skeletons, ghosts, vampires and other devils spawns will try to stop and kill you! But you have in your inventory all you need to take the victory: saint cross, sharp sword, censer with herbs and the holy book! Learn and compose the words to make the miracles! Any word - is your way to win! Villagers will help you to by selling different potions and items!



Death - is just beginning. If the evil will kill you - dont worry! The Underworld will glad to open the doors for your hero! Here you can upgrade the health or stamina and return to life to try win the creatures of the darkness!

2074310.name: Blocks of Nature
2074310.about_the_game:
Blocks of Nature is a casual puzzle game. The objective is to combine three or more cubes of the same color and to keep scoring until cubes build up too high.

Beware of the cold

Winter has come. Cubes that fall on the ice block on the ground or touch other frozen cubes will freeze over time. Once frozen, they cannot be broken unless they are melted with lava cubes. However, lava cubes are rare, so use them wisely...

Lava cubes cool over time and turn into rocks. These rocks can be removed by combining atleast three of them together, like normal cubes.

Temperature falls as you gain levels, so cubes will freeze faster and lava cubes cool down faster too. For unknown reasons, as the temperature drops, it conveniently also makes cubes to drop faster. Maybe it´s the magic of Lapland?

Rainbows to the rescue

Rainbow cube is a special, but unfortunately a very rare cube. It will destroy every unfrozen cube of the same color that it lands on. It works for lavacubes too! Extra 100 points are granted if you are brave enough to land it on frozen cube or on the ice on the ground (It won´t do you any good, but hey, 100 points!).

Casual or competitive?

Seemingly so casual game can find itself being quite competitive if you challenge your friends in this game! There is an ingame online leaderboard too!

2074360.name: The Obsessive Shadow
2074360.about_the_game:
The Obsessive Shadow is a short survival horror game set in 1986 American Suburbs. You play as 9 year old Liam Robertson. While watching tv, the power mysteriously goes out. You quickly find out that your mother is missing when a strange phone suddenly call becomes your only hope at surviving the night. While only armed with a flashlight and a familiar voice on the phone, you must rely on your eyes, ears, and pure instinct to keep whatever is hunting you away.

Every hour that creeps by, the rules for survival change. You must adapt and overcome whatever the night throws your way. IT. IS. HERE. With 3 different endings and multiple achievements to unlock, you must push through and face the darkness. Will the increasingly odd instructions keep you alive? Or will this monster catch you when you least expect it?

Created by

Pablo Heckman

2074370.name: REPLAY BOYS
2074370.about_the_game:
REPLAY BOYS is a visual novel with multiple endings including both romantic and platonic routes. It features wild characters, vivid CGs capturing moments of romance and chaos, and an exciting pace. Your decisions guide the outcome, choose carefully!

Can You Manage?

You play as Hannah, video editor for up-and-coming boy band The Replay Boys. When their manager calls in sick right before The Replay Boys’ first big concert, Hannah is the only one who can fill in and save the day. Help the band through their arguments and uncover their fears and anxieties, while dealing with crazy fans, a cult, and time loops!


  • Jax: Dancer and chaotic womanizer with a huge ego and a knack for causing problems.
  • Tyler: Producer and leader under a lot of stress. He might snap and do something unexpected.
  • Niko: Singer and a bit of a weirdo. He has a thing for conspiracy theories.
  • Caleb: A recent addition to the group. Bubbly, sweet, and never picks a fight. Watch out for hͪ҉͈̣̗ǐ͐͆s̷̊ͅ ̆̔̍mͮ̊̔o̷̟ͩm̶ͥͧ,̎̾̑ ̆ͮ̚t̬ͮ͠hͣ͋̾o̸̿̐u͌̀̿g͇̽͝hͭ́͒.̎͏̠

2074390.name: Soul Maze
2074390.about_the_game:
About the Game:

Soul Maze is a 1-3 Player Horror game. Use your flashlights to help guide your way through the mazes and collects parts of the souls to of the monsters in the mazes.

Features:
. Flashlight: This will be used to help you see in dark areas of the mazes
. Blue Flashlight: This will be used to stop the monsters for a short period of time

2074400.name: Moving Shadows
2074400.about_the_game:
Moving Shadows is a fun, fast-paced, horror game with a twisted hand-painted art style. Get thrown into a creepy maze and collect all the flowers before the monsters get you!

Moving Shadows aims to bring you a self-aware horror game that is actually FUN to play, offering lots of scares that will make you jump - and laugh!

Throughout the seven levels, you will have a different maze and more creatures trying to find you. Your goal will be to find all the hidden flowers as quickly as possible.

Featuring 6 Different Characters! Please welcome...

Mr Audrey - is blind and cannot see you while your torch is off. You can always hear his footsteps as we walks around the level. Run, hide and turn your torch off to dodge this character!

Noir - will creep up closer to you whenever your torch is turned off. Make sure you don't hide in the dark for too long!

Scratchy Smile - dangles from the ceiling as it follows you, but it is scared of your torch. Flick your light up at it to stay safe from this creature!

Puppety - sits in his small box playing music, when the music stops - he jumps out! Turn to face him and don't move to survive!

Audrey Smile - plays the same rules are Mr Audrey, only moves faster and keeps chasing you for longer!

Slaughtered Smile - will stand there completely still, staring at you menacingly. Slaughtered Smile will only ever move while you are not looking at him...

Shop

Every 5 flowers = 1 token! You may use these tokens to buy yourself some dandy upgrades that will help you through your horror filled journey! Upgrade your torch, battery life and even enable glowing flowers, keys and batteries to help make them less hidden in the levels!

Minigames

Between some levels there will be some minigames with some hidden meanings behind them. Plus, this game has some extra bonus levels for you, though they are hidden VERY well!

2074440.name: Master of the Tattooverse
2074440.about_the_game:
In a universe full of extraordinary characters and mysteries to discover, play as an apprentice tattoo artist disguised as the legendary Master. What can possibly go wrong?



Well… Not to mention that you will be surrounded by some exceptional and self-absorbed clients like vampires, internet celebrities, and possessed Viking warriors that each need a unique tattoo only a Master can handle!



During your sessions, you are armed with nothing but a mysterious mask, your tools, and your inspiration. Use and unlock different equipment like tattoo machines, needles, and various colors to experience being a tattoo artist in this wacky Tattooverse.



Unleash your imagination, give your clients the "ink" they want, and prepare yourself for a one-of-a-kind adventure in Tattooverse!





Master of the Tattooverse's gameplay is structured around interacting with various clients with diverse backgrounds and giving them the tattoos they desire. Each session is a different stage and during each session, the player holds a tattoo machine ( a Tatgun in Tattooverse terms ) in one hand, and another instrument named BucketBoi9000 ( BB in short ) that contains miscellaneous materials like needles and colors. Players can use 3 different Tatguns with different stats and properties to suit their needs. Both the Tatguns and BB Tool are specially designed to optimize for VR ergonomics to suit our player’s comfort and give them the most relaxed gaming experience.

As for the clients, there are two kinds of them: The ones the player works on location, and the ones that come to their Tattoo Parlor to get their ink done. Each client has a distinct personality and traits like being overly talkative, friendly or annoying. As they are responsive to the interactions of the player, players must act according to each client’s needs and tastes while taking their pain tolerance into consideration.

Every stage contains corresponding setups and level designs to help or guide the players, and in some stages-thus customers- provide special kinds of Tatguns to the player to help their adventure.

In terms of ergonomics and accessibility, Tattooverse can be played standing, sitting and even lying down and/or with both hands or just one. Every inch in the X, Y, Z axes can be reached with easy locomotion options, including dragging yourself around by using grip-drag-release, guided teleportation with the right thumb stick, or normal movement.



  • Teleportation: Changing the POV instantly without nauseating motion
  • Dragging movement in 3D space with the grip button
  • Traditional analog movement for walking



  • Tattoo Guns
  • Erasing Needle
  • Camera tool for taking in-game photographs
  • Overlay tool for template tattoo stencil
  • Relief needle&spray for helping customers with pain



  • Shade needle
  • Thick shade needle
  • Wide needle
  • Regular needle



  • Dominant hand selection
  • Tattoo gun grip angle option
  • Color blindness options

2074460.name: One Night at Barneys 3
2074460.about_the_game: One Night at Barneys 3 is a continuation as well as a reimagining of the series started on Scratch four years ago. Based off of the wildly popular horror game, Five Nights at Freddy's, you will spend one night trapped in a prison, forced to defend yourself against Barney and many of his colleagues. Spend your night checking the hallways, vents, and cameras, collecting materials to craft and upgrade the tools at your disposal, and discovering secrets to alter the endgame. However there are no doors. Instead you are equipped with a EERG-15 Shotgun. Works like a charm...until you run out of bullets.

2074470.name: Ourlands
2074470.about_the_game:
Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes. In Ourlands, it's up to you to build cozy and unique little islands free from objectives or restrictions. With dozens of items to discover, your islands can become whatever you need them to be! From chill beachside campfire cookouts to lonely rocky hilltops, items will help you fully explore your creativity.

The more you build and play, the more items you'll find to collect! Who knows what you'll stumble upon while poking around the environment. Whether it's variations on the things you've fallen in love with, or brand new things you wouldn't have even expected, there's tons to be surprised and delighted by.

You've heard of photo mode. Well, Ourlands has a postcard mode. Use the postcard mode to capture your favorite creations, decorate them to make your own custom postcards, and share them with the world.

Key Features:

  • Build cozy islands

  • Unlock dozens of items

  • Share beautiful creations

2074480.name: Sunset Routes
2074480.about_the_game:
Sunset Routes is a simple seafaring rouge-lite game.



First, you need to select your destination, which determines what character you will get and the chance of getting it.





Then you have to select a character, which appears randomly depending on a variety of factors, including the destination itself, characters that can help you get a rare character, etc. The characters you own will determine how much cargo the ship can carry.





There are many kinds of interactions between characters, and you need to either manage your characters in the best way or kick them out from your ship in some way to make the ship carry more cargo.





The money you can earn depends on the amount and types of cargo in the ship and your next destination. Of course, your next destination also determines what cargo you'll be loading onto your ship.





There is a demand for a certain amount of money every 5 turns. How far you will go depends on how quickly and clearly you manage your characters and make a good combination out of them.





There will be multiple endings and achievements, and some of the choices you make during the voyage will affect your final ending.





Hope you enjoy this game.
