2074490.name: MOAR - Appeteaser
2074490.about_the_game: The Appeteaser offers endless fun with wave and arena shooters spiced with mini games. You will fight a horde of various zombies with different kind of ranged and melee weapons. You can collect points to unlock new guns, levels and power ups.It is an easy going fun in which you can jump in any time and enjoy a bit of mayhem.

2074500.name: OrbiTank
2074500.about_the_game:
Tanks! Space! Tanks in space!
Does much more even need to be said? OrbiTank is a local-multiplayer tank game with a fresh spin on projectile combat. Use gravity to your advantage to shoot your shells in and out of orbit, hop from planet to planet, and dive bomb your enemies. Explore a vast variety of arenas which feature several gravitational mechanics such as planets, orbiting moons, spinning space stations, and even treacherous black holes.

Classic
The classic game mode is good old reliable. You can't go wrong! It's just you, a friend, and the most balanced version of the game that has been experimented with. Players have three lives per round, and in order to win it all, you must rack up five points. Points are collected by winning levels, and levels will continue to be generated until either player wins the game. Usually a game in the classic game mode will last about 10 minutes, or until your friend starts to call your mother names.

Tournament
With the tournament game mode, you can challenge a whole group of friends to your mega epic gamer skills. Winner gets to not be made fun of for playing MOBAs. No, but seriously. Although no more than two players will ever be hashing it out on the screen at once, tournaments can be generated with up to eight contestants. This is a great game mode for parties and does not disappoint as a fun time sink. Expect hoots and hollers.

Custom
Trying to shake things up? Then this is just the game mode for you! You can modify several balancing settings using the custom game mode. This means if you want a really long game but it switches levels after every time a player is killed, you can do that. If you want to speed or slow down the fire rate to make the game more arcade-like or more tactical, you have the options. And, finally, my favorite, you have the ability to turn the planet movement up to like, a lot a lot. Prepare yourself for ludicrous speed.

2074520.name: Captain!
2074520.about_the_game:
You play as a pirate captain navigating the Caribbean to exploit all of its hidden plunder. As the captain, you can order those you command to do your dirty work for you, but don't be fooled you will have to take matters into your own hands from time to time.

Embark on the open world of the Caribbean. There are many opportunities for those who seek them during the Golden Age of Piracy. What will you do? Perhaps, become a privateer and work for the crown and hunt down notorious pirates, including the infamous Edward Teach more commonly known as Blackbeard! Or will you become a pirate yourself and plunder the Caribbean for all it has to offer. On the other hand, you could always become a simple merchant travelling port to port acquiring the best deals, until your coffers are full to the brim. Maybe the sea life isn't for you there is plenty to explore on land as well, cursed temples, dangerous caves, treasure filled beaches. Whichever you choose, I'm confident you'll make the right choice.... Captain!

Features:
-Open World
-Character Customization
-Ship Customization
-Naval combat
-Questing
-Trading
-Treasure hunting
-Third Person Combat
-Bounty Hunting

2074530.name: SHAFTED
2074530.about_the_game:
SHAFTED is a micro-mining simulator with an emphasis on letting you quickly build out your colony. Single rounds are fast and short. The alien clients swoop in to extract contract payments. Clear out those clients and call it a day.

Mining Colony Management


  • Expand your colony with mining equipment.
  • Build a variety of harvesters, each providing a unique production bonus.
  • Manage 4 primary minerals: Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold.
  • Each resource has a special purpose in your colony.

Optimize


  • Each mineshaft has a new optimization challenge.
  • CONFIGURE optimal paths to maximize profits.
  • SPEND from your bank to upgrade equipment.
  • PRIORITIZE or else you'll get SHAFTED!

Turn Based Tactics


  • PLAN the placement of your units every day.
  • No time limit.
  • REACT to the alien client's attacks. (RUDE Clients!)
  • Manage grid expansions on future stages!

2074540.name: Ocular Deprivation
2074540.about_the_game:
You wake up in a cell, the smell of dust fills your lungs. You try to look around and get your barring, but can only see the inky blackness of the void surrounding you. The holes where your eyes should be begin to tear, as you scream out for help. Will you be able to escape and solve the mystery, or will you be doomed to join the other's fate?

Ocular Deprivation is a game (go figure) where you, the character, are blind. You need to make it through a labyrinth that you captors have put you in through the use of echolocation-type seeing. Move through the labyrinth that you have mysteriously found yourself in, and attempt to unravel the mysteries hidden throughout it.


Ocular Deprivation provides a unique gameplay experience, in that YOU, you as in you the person not the player, are able to see all sound produced in the game through balls that appear at the origin. These balls then proceed to bounce off every wall and surface, allowing you to understand and get your bearings.

While this may seem beneficial on the surface, they may just lead to you downfall. The reasoning for this being enemies may just be attracted to the origins of these sounds, meaning you have to choose, either get complete understanding of your environment and lure your captors towards you, or stay hidden in the shadows, but not know what surrounds you.

2074550.name: Silent Seeker
2074550.about_the_game:
Welcome to Silent Seeker, the exciting multiplayer prop hunt game where you'll experience the thrill of hiding and seeking with friends! Become either a crafty Prop or a relentless Hunter and test your skills in an intense battle of stealth and strategy.

BEING A PROP


As BRUMBLE, your task is to blend in seamlessly with the environment by disguising yourself as everyday objects. Transform into furniture or household items scattered across carefully designed maps. But beware! One wrong move could give away your position and alert the Hunters.

As a Prop, finding a smart hiding spot and staying perfectly still is essential. Utilize your surroundings to outsmart the Hunters and survive. Will you manage to stay hidden until the time runs out, or will you succumb to the Hunter's keen eye?



BEING AN HUNTER


On the other hand, embrace the role of a determined Hunter with FURY! Use your sharp senses to track down and eliminate the elusive Props. You have three different attacks at your disposal, each with unique damage and cooldown times.

Coordinate with other Hunters, communicate effectively, and devise clever strategies to corner and eliminate the Props. Props can use the environment to their advantage, making every match a thrilling test of skill, teamwork, and deception.



Silent Seeker also features a chat system, allowing you to communicate with your teammates and opponents. Additionally, immerse yourself in the action with a proximity voice chat, where you can strategize with teammates or taunt your opponents in real-time.

Are you ready for an exhilarating multiplayer prop hunt adventure like no other? Gather your friends, sharpen your senses, and dive into the heart-pounding world of Silent Seeker. The clock is ticking, the Props are hiding, and the Hunters are closing in. Will you be the master of deception or the ultimate seeker?

2074560.name: Mr.Brocco & Co
2074560.about_the_game:
Mr. Brocco & Co

is a classic 2D platform game set in a fantasy world where junk food is trying to take over! Choose one of two characters (Mr. Broccoli or Super Asparagus) to save the city!

Mr. Brocco & Co

is not just a game. It is a reminder that junk food can often be very dangerous! Next time when your parents make you eat broccoli and asparagus, keep in mind: they are preparing you for the battle with junk food!

Mr.Barocco & Co

is a charming platformer that brings up the important topic of the battle against junk food. Pleasant gameplay, exciting boss fights and loads of positive emotions await you.

2074580.name: Millie's Adventure
2074580.about_the_game:
Millie, a shy and reclusive Bovian girl, was living a peaceful and reclusive life until a thief stole her treasured magic staff! She forced herself to go on an adventure to find the thief. She will to do anything to get her staff back...

Millie's Adventure is a hardcore hentai 2D action adventure game with sexual events not not in your average adult game.

= Simple 2D action adventure
With no complicated controls to remember or get use to, you can start exploring right away.
There are several different magic attacks to collect.
Millie is not a fighter so watch out for her stamina and run away when necessary.

= HARDCORE hentai for the experienced...
There are more than 40 unique hentai events for you to discover hidden in many unique locations.
Lewd arts are a mix of pixel animation and hand drawn CGs.
Expect fantasy hardcore plays and unrealistic anatomy.
If you are bored of the same hentai situations in other adult game and want something more spicy, this is the game for you.

= Multiple Endings
Explore the world, help other people, and train Millie's body to see how Millie's adventure end in different ways.

= Body status
Show the lewd progression of Millie's body parts as Millie continues her adventure.

2074600.name: Pentacore
2074600.about_the_game:
- Story -
After extensive searching deep within the vast regions of uncharted space, the federation finally found what they were looking for. An unclaimed planet rich with natural resources.

Not long after the discovery, scientist started to really take interest of the planets ecosystem. After a short time, the federation granted funding for a scientific research expedition.

You have been assigned as security for the scientific team. You will be placed in a stasis pod until your set awakening time. After that,
fulfill your duties as security.

The Pentacore, an emergency escape ship, is located on the surface of the planet. As per security protocol, five key cards are required to start the ships engines. If anything goes wrong, find those keys.



-Features
  • Explore a large world filled with terrifying enemies!
  • Find and collect many upgrades to expand your arsenal.
  • In-Game timer for those who want to attempt a speedrun.
  • Many ways to play through and explore the world.
  • Unlockable secret ending!

-Note to players
Pentacore can be played with both a keyboard or a controller. For the best experience I recommend using a controller. Selecting the 'Help' option on the pause menu will show you what buttons do what. Using the 'Select' button will bring up a map. Rooms on the map will only be displayed as the player discovers them. Important rooms will have markers on the map but it will be up to the player to determine which markers mean what.

Pentacore is a love letter to my childhood. A time period when games were in pixels and a true challenge. Thanks for taking the time out of your day to check out the game!

2074620.name: Ars Notoria
2074620.about_the_game:
Ars Notoria is an open-world survival crafting game set in a rich fantasy world. Blending classic gameplay elements like building, crafting, and survival, it invites you on a journey filled with wonder, mystery, and discovery.

Venture out alone or team up with friends to explore a land full of secrets and danger. Build your base, gather resources, expand your influence, and stand against the ever-shifting threat of the Enthralled. Whether you prefer to go solo or fight alongside allies, the game delivers a complete and rewarding experience.

Vast World, Survival Evolved

  • Explore a dangerous open world filled with forests, fields, dungeons, and more, where breathtaking landscapes shaped by magic await discovery.

  • Delve into shadowy depths and frozen caverns, traverse ancient magical ruins and the hidden lairs of bandits, confronting a wide variety of Enthralled along the way.

  • Face intense boss fights against colossal, corrupted creatures that threaten to bring ruin to the world.

Master Magic, Lead Your Squad

  • Learn six distinct schools of magic: Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Chaos, and Holy. Each brings unique spells and playstyles.

  • Combine magical sigils and traits to craft spells that suit your fighting style.

  • Imbue your gear with magic and elemental powers to enhance your effectiveness in battle.

  • Build a team of adventurers with varied fighting styles, weapons, and roles. Switch between them during battle for fluid, tactical combat.

Join Factions, Grow Your Influence

  • Align yourself with various factions and rise through their ranks to expand your influence across the kingdom.

  • Assign faction members to handle essential tasks like gathering resources, guarding outposts, crafting equipment, or researching new technologies.

  • Each faction offers unique questlines and branching narratives, with your choices shaping the future of the kingdom.

Gather, Build, and Prosper

  • Build and upgrade your base using a wide range of structures and materials. Customize patterns and colors to create your ideal refuge, fortress, or outpost.

  • Streamline routine tasks with automated systems that help your settlement grow while you focus on exploration and combat.

  • Use global resource storage to keep materials without overloading your inventory, and access what you need anytime, anywhere.

  • Tame wild creatures or summon arcane companions using magic or skill, and gain allies that aid you in harvesting, defense, or battle.

Adventure Together, Fight Side by Side

  • In online co-op mode, team up with friends to explore the world of Ars Notoria.

  • Share the journey as you experience story quests, conquer dungeons, build a dream base, and shape your own epic tale together.

2074630.name: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland
2074630.about_the_game:
A Colorful Metroidvania Adventure

Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland takes the retro NES-era platformer gameplay of games you know and love, and brings it to a vast, non-linear world that has been lovingly hand-animated frame-by-frame. You’ll explore as you collect new ability-granting toys and PJs, discover enchanting lands inspired by Winsor McCay’s Little Nemo comics, and encounter a colorful cast of characters — all through the nostalgic lens of an ‘80s/’90s kid.

Whether you're looking for a hand-animated love letter to your NES platformer favorites, or have been considering trying your first metroidvania, this is for you!

Key Features

  • An original soundtrack composed entirely by Peter Berkman of Anamanaguchi.

  • A lush, hand-animated world, composed of many distinct thematic domains, all seamlessly connected.

  • Defeat challenging bosses, discover collectibles, and unlock new abilities to progress.

  • Tight and responsive controls for retro-inspired platforming action.

  • Designed with approachable and accessible baseline experience, that can be ranked up for more skilled players.

  • Finish in roughly 10 - 15 hours, or spend even more time to fully explore and find everything!

Upgrade your PJs

While you're awake in Nemo's bedroom, you can change out which pajamas you're wearing using the dresser. Each pair will empower your toys and abilities in different ways as well as change Nemo's appearance.

Find new Ability-granting Toys

In Slumberland all of Nemo’s favorite toys bestow new abilities! Use them throughout your adventure to fend off enemies, traverse hazards and open new pathways to different domains.

Be careful or you'll wake up!

If you take too much damage, you'll wake up back in Nemo's bedroom. While in your bedroom, take a moment to change your PJs and Little Buddy before hopping back in bed to head back to Slumberland. You won't lose any progress if you wake up, but you will drop your candy, so be careful!
2074630.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2074630/Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland/

2074690.name: Loplight
2074690.about_the_game:
You are Edda, a young girl lost in a dying world.
The elements of the world have been unleashed, ancient demons stalk the lands.
Collect the pieces of Quintessence, ascend to a divine power, defeat the elder god
harvesting the souls of the world.



  • Short but replayable story
  • High intensity combat, Dodge, Slash, and Shoot your way to victory!
  • Story Rich experience, explore the morality behind ambition and loneliness

2074700.name: Bloom: Roots of Renewal
2074700.about_the_game:
The mystic forest is blooming and ancient evils have returned. Only the Tome of Power hidden in the ancient Archives contain the answers to how to defeat these forces. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures.

Game Details

Thrilling Old School Combat
Fight foes big and small as you navigate the forest in search of the Tome of Power. Evade tiny spiders, out-maneuver teleporting magicians, and find the perfect vantage point to take out your air-based foes.

Unique Magical Environments
From an overgrown forest to a forgotten library, from the depths of the caves to the heights of the mountains, navigate through the magic-infested world. Enjoy exploring a rich and varied landscaped filled with secrets and treasures to collect.

Wide Arsenal of Weapons
Battle your enemies with a wide selection of eight unique weapons, including shotguns, snipers, and heavy machine guns. Switch between them as you manage your ammo and find the right weapon for the job.

About This Game

Bloom: Roots of Renewal is created by the WolverineSoft Studio at the University of Michigan, a voluntary student games studio. It is an educational case study on Bethesda's Quake, and takes inspiration from its game mechanics as well as other games in the genre. Bloom: Roots of Renewal was developed by a team of 20 students. The development took place over a period of 8 months.

2074710.name: Microbes and Machines
2074710.about_the_game:
Microbes and Machines is a game where you control a little bubble robot that fights against the forces of evil.
The machines were corrupted by the monsters and only one sector was unaffected. The little bubble robots are ready to restore balance.

  • Explore the map to find special chests...but wait...?


  • You'll need a key, of course!


  • Improve your weapon's attributes by collecting marbles in strange machines like this:


  • Reach the next level.
  • Get stronger.
  • Destroy your enemies.


  • Create your own build in this fun and satisfying roguelite.

2074740.name: Particle Hearts
2074740.about_the_game:
Particle Hearts is a 3rd-person adventure game where you explore a world made entirely of particles. Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and navigate this sinister and beautiful land.

Along the way, meet various creatures, some of which will help you understand your purpose and others who are tasked with hiding it from you.

Collect memories, find hidden paths, and piece together your connection to this land that isn’t always what it seems.

  • ■ Gain multiple abilities that allow you to manipulate the particles around you.

  • ■ Use your abilities to solve puzzles, evade enemies, and gain access to hidden areas.

  • ■ Freely explore open environments any way you’d like.

  • ■ Experience a story where the line between friend and foe is often blurred. Meet various creatures that help you unravel your purpose in this land.

2074750.name: All-In-One Summer Sports VR
2074750.about_the_game:
Welcome to All-In-One Summer Sports VR! We've gathered 10 summer sports for you in one game. Go to a hot tropical resort and enjoy dizzying sports games. You can compete online with friends or other players from all over the world, train on different difficulty levels and win challenging competitions. Create your own character and start mastering 10 types of summer sports games!


FRISBEE

Frisbee is a sport with flying disks played on the beach. Throw the disks at differently difficult targets and achieve new records. Realistic physics engine including drag, lift and spin.[/b]

SWIMMING

Experience swimming in virtual reality! Move both hands the way you do in the pool and defeat your opponents. You will be able to compete with up to 5 players on different distances!



BEACH VOLLEYBALL

This is a 2 vs 2 game with a ball on the beach sand. Play with friends or realistic AI bots that won't be inferior to you to win. Toss the ball, shoot, receive and block your opponent's attacks!

JET SKI

A high-speed jet ski racing game. Ride around a tropical island with your friends, dodge obstacles and use different items to prevent yourself from being overtaken.

CYCLING

Take part in exciting bike races. Enjoy the beautiful scenery of the island as well as the speed. Spin the pedals and use objects to stop the opponents behind you.



FISHING

Enjoy comfortable fishing with your friends! Learn basic fishing techniques and catch up to 50 species of fish!

AND OTHER GAMES

Water Basketball, Gun Shooting, Water Polo, Clay Shooting and Water Park will also be waiting for you! Discover many exciting challenges and activities with All-In-One Summer Sports VR!


TIPS FOR NEW USERS

2074760.name: Star Boss
2074760.about_the_game:
Star Boss is a simulation game where you can manage space base.
You can make robots and spaceships,explore the space and fight with aliens.

Backgound Story
In 2400, Earth civilization's started interplanetary exploration, building Star Union.
With exploration further, Star Union finds alien civilization too powerful.
To accelerate civilization development, Star Union determines to begin "Star Boss" project.

Making Robots and Vehicles
You can recruit team members, creat robots and make spaceships.


Exploring Space
Your team can be arranged to explore space, collect resourses and defeat monsters.


Defending Alien Creatures
Occasionally alien creatures will invade your base, which you need dispatch your team to defend.


Command System
You can enter commands to manage everything of your base, and you can even write javascript code.


Ultimate Weapon
science and technology: Anti-stealth, Tractor Enhancement Beam, Super Torpedo
ultimate weapon robots: collecting 4, you’re invincible.
godlike command: space command, time command, power command

Plot and Events
Main Line：
A mysterious child looking for parents
Two tragic ultimate BOSS

And various random events, like using Time Command to win the lottery.

Conclusion
20+ human members can be recruited
10+ robots and 9 spaceships can be made
70+ monsters、10+ stages、alien creatures of 10 levels can be challenged
100+ tasks、50+ achievements

The game has supported MOD, you can make your own robots, spaceships and events, etc.

2074780.name: 焰色方糖 flamed sugar
2074780.about_the_game:
Flamed Sugar is a visual novel with light puzzle solving elements, which tells several independent stories.
You can usually drag the components in the game to a reasonable position, and all puzzle solving methods are included in the game.
We focus on the beauty and harmony of the writing style and the open freehand brushwork of the art style.
We are very sorry that this game only supports Chinese for the time being.

2074790.name: What's your emergency
2074790.about_the_game:
What's your emergency it's single player story game where you take the boots of a 911 operator.

The story takes place on the fictional city of New Yaka where crime rates are sky high due to poor management of the city's mayor.

During the game you will be presented with different emergency situations, your job is to help those people in need sending the correct emergency department, to do that you will gather information talking with the victim and once you have enough information you'll be able to send aid using the new computer application called "Emergency_Manager_2.0" in wich you will be able to choose which emergency department to send to the rescue. Be carefould with your choices tho becasue a wrong decision could make the difference between life and death.

Every day that passes you will recive new orders that you must fulfill in order not to be fired, making your job more and more difficult as it progresses, the first of it beeing daily task you must complete every day.

Not only this, but your position has caught the attention of various factions in the city and they will try to "persuade" you to help them in their interests. Will you be a good operator and save everyone? Or maybe you will help some faction take control of the city?

2074800.name: Richman 11
2074800.about_the_game:
Richman 11 supports multi-controller, online and offline modes to choose. Players could create either free play or challenge play, all the parameters could be set based on players minds as well. In the game, players roll the dice and it determines the steps they could move on the map, earning money by investment on properties, buying stocks or using cards, when the game ends, the only player who are not broke or owns the most in finance wins the play.

Free Play

This is the classic mode in the series, all the players have the same initial cash, deposit and cards at the beginning, and all these could be set freely, players even can set, the price increase days, play time, player number, group play, etc as much as they wish.

Challenge Play

This is a new play mode. Players are facing the challenges from the landlords. There are 3 difficulties: easy, normal and hard to choose for each landlord. Players need to win them in different levels in the circumstance with short of talents, initial cash and properties to get their special achievements.

Classic Maps

The franchise was known to the public in 1989, classic maps take the torch from its predecessors, using tiles to link small and large properties, banks, lotto's, shops, news and magic house. Investing small properties is the main way to gain the profits. Other than this, players needs to keep and eye on other players and NPCs like gods’ movements. Using large properties, cards, banks and magic house to increase their income and face the emergent affairs or sabotage opponent’s plans.

Brawl Maps

It starts in Richman 10, in this mode, small property tiles is replaced by mines, missiles and bombs, using attack cards could bring damage to opponents’ finance and that is the core to win the play. In this franchise, brawl maps have different routes from classic maps. Maps on brawl mode are more complicated, why not using missiles to attack the opponents on the road, or place the mines at the corners.

Property Investing

Buy empty land, build houses or chain stores on it, receive rentals from players who pass by. Buy properties as many as possible, and level up the buildings hard for large amount of rentals. When in group play, the properties could be leveled up by teammates.

Stock Buying

In the play, players could adjust the proportion of cash and deposit when passing by banks. Cash is the key to invest properties and card purchase, deposit could bring a considerable interest from banks monthly. In offline mode, deposit could be used to buy stocks, be smart and earn some extra financial income.

Card

Cards are the original content in this series, and it is the most strategic system in game, also the unique feature different from other monopoly genre games. Players could buy limited cards in shops by cash. There are different kinds of cards, some of them could level up the buildings, some could control others movements and summon gods. In this franchise, we add some new features, hope players would enjoy them. Tip 1: Don’t miss the guy who wears white suit and a masque. Tip 2: A penny saved is a penny eared.

Mechanics

After this series develops 30 years or so, we add a brand new feature - mechanics. It is a special tile in the maps, having different effects in different maps, when it’s on, it could probably change the direction of the road, may turn on or off the banks and shops and even mess up the location of mines and bombs.

Characters

Each character has their unique transit vehicles. They are even variable with many kinds decorations. Xiaomei, October, Miss Money, etc. Many well known Richman characters are confirmed to join this play.

2074810.name: 8-Bit Farm
2074810.about_the_game:
Farm management simulation game!
Create the most awesome farm!

This humble little farm desperately needs a new manager, such as you! Start out by getting some livestock, grow flowers, fruit and vegetables, gradually expanding your fields and increasing the number of staff until you're ready to open for agritourism.

As your farm's Appeal grows, you will be able to enter a variety of contests. The key to winning is raising the levels of your produce and skillful placement of farm facilities so that they work together as combos. A prize-winning farm is certain to attract even more visitors!

Receive photos as gifts from happy visitors or for completing achievements, and exchange them at the FarmMart to obtain a wide range of installations for your farm. Photos can also be traded at the Odds&Ends Shop for handy items such as gadgets which influence the weather.

More fun awaits at festivals, where you can try your skill in minigames like Tug of War, Outdoor Sports or puzzles. Apart from getting monetary prizes for winning these, you can also get cool hats for your staff.

The end of each year is a thrilling time, as that's when the National Farm Ranking is announced! Challenge yourself and see if you can top all rankings for sales, number of visitors, visitors satisfaction and number of staff!

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

2074840.name: Jasper's Island
2074840.about_the_game:
Jasper's Island is a 2D-platformer where you play as a cat and lighthouse keeper. Both have different abilities to negotiate obstacles encountered when exploring the island's caves, forests and shipwrecks.

This hand drawn island is full of secrets and the story is told though symbols that can be enjoyed by anyone. You'll water the garden, repair the lighthouse, and investigate the mysterious spores.

Key Features:

  • Jasper’s Island is a wholesome game involving light puzzles, platforming elements and a whisker of combat (mostly scratching and popping things!)

  • Beautiful painted environments with hand crafted lighting from morning to night

  • Creatures and characters animated with traditional frame-by-frame drawings

  • Explore the mysterious island at your own pace

  • No AI generated assets including text, images or code
2074840.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

2074850.name: Foklor
2074850.about_the_game:
You are a Foklorian, stranded in a world full of danger and excitement. With only your wits, reflexes and natural good looks, you set out to explore this weird and wonderful world, uncovering the secrets of Foklor! Build, farm, tame and battle as you and your friends survive the open world of Foklor. Discover treasures, items and magic of great power while defending against evil creatures. Your legend awaits!

Features:
Multiplayer Co-Op. Survive with 1-10 players. Build together, battle together, die together. Everything is better together!

Single player Gameplay. Foklor can also be good fun solo!

Casual Survival. You will need to manage your hunger, water, and hygiene as you venture out into the wilds.

PVE focused gameplay and lore. Fight through the hordes of dangerous creatures while uncovering the mysteries of Foklor.

Big open world. Discover all the different biomes with biome specific creatures and plants.

Stat and Skill Based System. As you progress on your legendary adventure, your skills and attributes will progress depending on how you play.

Taming and Breeding. Numerous creatures can be tamed to aid in battle, provide faster travel or help with farming. Taming pairs of creatures allows for breeding so you can find the ultimate generational beast!

Gardening and Farming. Kick back and relax while tending to your garden. Plant crops, cultivate herbs and grow fruit to provide extra ingredients for cooking and taming.

Base Building and Base Defense. Build an epic base or a shack. Though you never know when the creatures will come together and attempt to destroy everything you have worked so hard to build, so be prepared!

2074870.name: A Rum Case in Fogtown
2074870.about_the_game:
Guide the brilliant (but easily distracted) Sherblock and his stalwart companion Blockson through a madcap mystery where you control the outcome! Will you solve the case or plunge the city of Fogtown into hilariously unbridled chaos?

When Mrs. Hud is beset by mysterious sabotage against her beloved pub, she turns to Fogtown’s finest to sort it out. But little is quite as it seems as Sherblock and Blockson tackle one of the most baffling crimes of their careers — all while navigating the early stages of a friendship meant to last.

A Rum Case in Fogtown is a modern take on the old-school interactive movie genre (aka FMV!), and the first of its kind made with puppets.

Rather than directly controlling the characters, you'll regularly pick from a series of options that branch the story into fun (and surprisingly deep) new directions, all leading to multiple different endings... some satisfyingly conclusive, and some absolutely bonkers. The result is a raucous and rollicking family-friendly adventure that feels like an interactive, replayable episode of your favorite comedy television show. (No wonder Fogtown is being made into a TV series too!)

Don't tell Sherblock and Blockson... but you're secretly in control of their fates from the beginning to the end! Make choices that solve their mystery, or leave them scratching their blocks!

Created by a team of comedy veterans at Hapstance Films, A Rum Case in Fogtown features a voice cast of renowned adventure game actors such as Dean Erickson (Gabriel Knight himself from The Beast Within), Lenval Brown (narrator of Disco Elysium), Cissy Jones (the BAFTA-winning actress who played Delilah in Firewatch), Paul Morgan Stetler (Curtis Craig in Phantasmagoria: A Puzzle of Flesh), and Rupert Booth (Inspector Jenks from Contradiction and DuPont from The Shapeshifting Detective) — plus Austin Hillebrecht as Blockson and the one-of-a-kind Chris Yamez as Sherblock!

FEATURES:

  • Elaborate hand-crafted backgrounds and puppets

  • Loving homage to the world of Sherlock Holmes

  • Zany, fast-paced antics unlike any FMV game you've played

  • A prequel to the Fogtown TV series (which has a pilot episode on YouTube now!)

  • Unlockable achievements for multiple story paths — even the ones where you didn't achieve much of anything!

夜を越えられない街、超常多発都市「レデルリン」。
探偵業を営むジェニファー・サイレントフォールは、毎朝発見される身元不明の異常遺体と、発見すらされない行方不明者の調査を生業としています。

ランダムに作られる状況を何度も攻略し、不可思議な「探偵道具」を集め、自分なりの推理方法を見つけて下さい。
難易度が高いと感じるのであれば、強力な探偵道具を見つけて持ち込むことで、強引に全てを解決することも出来るようになっています。



常に変化するシチュエーションが、遊ぶごとに異なる困難とそれに打ち勝つ楽しさを作り出します。
回廊に流れるPM0:00からAM0:00までの「12の時刻」。
写真の力で時間を支配し、レデルリンの夜を越えて下さい。

2074920.name: The First Descendant
2074920.about_the_game:
The First Descendant is a free third-person cooperative action RPG shooter featuring high-quality graphics. Experience the fun of strategic boss fights through 4-player co-op and various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting. A variety of equipment is necessary for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses.

The player becomes a Descendant in the game and is given a mission to fight against the invaders for the survival of humans and to protect the ‘Ingris continent’. The player can experience a spectacular story by growing stronger through various missions and stories to finally discover the Descendants' secret. You can also feel the First Descendant’s unique atmosphere through high-quality fields developed with Unreal Engine 5 and gain a new experience of reality and SF fantasy coexisting in one place.

Charming and Unique Characters

You can play various characters with distinctive concepts and battle styles. We plan to add various customizable elements such as skins for each character to support character decoration.

Exciting Battles and Dynamic Action Using Various Skills and Firearms

Experience the First Descendant’s exciting battles composed of various characters with unique skill sets, free movements, and chain actions through Grappling Hooks, colorful firearms, and additional effects. With these, the player can create any battle style they desire.

Battles With Huge Boss Monsters Through Cooperative Play

You can target huge boss monsters with different appearances and abilities through 4 player co-op play. The various difficulties will stimulate your competitive spirit, and you can destroy or extract various parts of the huge bosses through 4-player cooperative play. By targeting the huge boss’s gimmicks, you will be able to experience a more compact team play.

Motivating Play and Growth

You can equip a character with 3 guns, 4 secondary accessories, and various sub-weapons. Of course, there will also be items to enhance a character or their firearm stats or add a new ability all together. A variety of equipment is a necessary element for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game, or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses. We provide equipment so you can develop the characters to play continuously through character growth and acquiring and combining the various equipment. Use it to challenge yourself with more difficult tasks and enjoy the thrill of clearing them.

On foot, on the back of a bumblebee, or even in a wagon hurtling down a snowy mountain at full speed, Red and Birdy will go beyond the forest, cross a frozen world and the depths of a volcano, meet fairies, trolls, and much more fantastic still... In order to save his grandmother, Red will have to show courage and surpass herself. Through hardships, she will eventually discover her own story. 2075100.name: Chernobylite 2: Exclusion Zone
2075100.about_the_game:

Play as Cole Gray - an experienced Planewalker, who sets off on a journey to the unknown and undiscovered regions of the Chernobyl Zone in the search of cure for his daughter.

Explore vast, dark, gloomy and mysterious world of Chornobyl, created and developed in detail on the basis of the real life locations.

Cautious stealth or guns-blazing action? Classic firearms or cold steel? TPP or FPP Camera? How you approach things is entirely up to you. Use this to your advantage.

Develop your character, unlock valuable new skills, form strong alliances, and make decisions that will affect the whole around world.

The choices you make in the game will allow you to discover a non-linear story and experience one of the several possible endings. Everything happens for a reason and has its price.

A clumsy flight is a 2D action-roguelike with a focus on dodging enemy planes and upgrading your equipment.



Each time you play A Clumsy Flight your experience will be different and your playstyle
will change. Along the way you will get the chance to upgrade your gear and defeat the
danger lurking in the air. Make the right choices on your journey or the never ending
flood of danger will snowball faster than you think into an inevitable dive into the ground.

After each adventure you will be able to customize/upgrade your tools for the next flight
and getstronger, faster and moreskillfull each run.



Customizing your tools can be done in terms of a new plane with different stats and quirks.
Such as a very fast plane being able to dive through small gaps or a bigger tougher build
that can resist alot of incoming shots and not be bothered by it.

Besides a new plane you can change your firearm. Inside the full game there will be lots
of different weapons to choose from that fit your playstyle. All of these weapons will also
have different stats, bullets and other unique possibilities.



Upon destroying different airplanes you will automatically gain a certain amount of xp
that will give you the ability to upgrade some of your equipment or choose to add new
modifications to your weapons. Upgrades can also give you different perks, new abilities,
new friends/helpers and tonsmore crazy upgrades that will help you in your journey.


Destroying bigger types of enemies(bosses) allows you to upgrade your plane in a different

2075210.name: Silent Bloom
2075210.about_the_game:
the Soul Is Like A Flower, The Body Is The Garden For It To Grow...

Silent Bloom Is A Solo-Developed, Hand-Drawn, First Person Swordplay, 3d Action Adventure That Combines Puzzle Solving With Dungeon Crawling Gameplay.
Explore Through Multiple Environments Faced With Dynamic Enemies And Puzzles That Grow Challenging As You Go On.
Uncover The Dark Mystery That Dwells Within The Walls Of An Old Lost Forgotten School University Campus, While Diving Deep Into The Soul Labyrinth Of Another Life, Left Forgotten By Time. Discover Different Paths As You Shift Back And Forth Between 2 Diverse Puzzling Atmospheric Worlds. You Are Tasked With Building A Bouquet, A Tool Used By Floral Exorcist To Exorcise Lost Stranded Spirits.

Features

Exploration
-As You Travel You Will Explore The Remnants Of An Old University Compass And The Purgatory World Of An Evil Spirit. Travel Through Atmospheric Worlds

2075220.name: HXH
2075220.about_the_game:
"HXH: Battle All One" is an exciting fighting game that allows players to experience intense boss like battles and utilize unique abilities of each character. Players can choose from a variety of characters, each with their own distinctive fighting styles and special moves.

The game's mechanics are fast-paced and action-packed, with intuitive controls that allow players to unleash devastating combos and powerful special attacks. In addition to the traditional versus mode, "HXH: Battle All One" also features a story mode that follows the events of a anime and manga series coming soon, as well as a survival mode where players must battle increasingly difficult opponents to see how long they can last.

One of the standout features of "HXH: Battle All One" is the unique "magic/kai" system, which allows players to unleash powerful special abilities based on their characters' individual strengths and weaknesses. By mastering the magic/kai system, players can create devastating combinations of attacks that can turn the tide of even the toughest battles.

Overall, "HXH: Battle All One" is a must-play for fighting game enthusiasts. With its thrilling battles, diverse cast of characters, and innovative gameplay mechanics, this game offers endless hours of entertainment for players of all skill levels.

2075230.name: Witch girl got killed.
2075230.about_the_game:
Witch girl got killed. is a first person fantasy horror action game inspired by Japanese anime.

Features:

∙Your mission is to infiltrate a labyrinth that has appeared in town and destroy its brain.
∙The town and the labyrinth are crawling with troublesome monsters. If you stumble upon one, run away as fast as you can.
∙The monsters respond to footsteps and light, but are particularly sensitive to magic. Exercise caution when using your powers.
∙The game’s total play time is between 40 and 60 minutes.
∙Your progress is saved automatically.

You are a witch girl in training.

Your magic abilities haven’t yet matured.
Still, you can use basic magic.
Traces of sigils drawn by a predecessor are scattered throughout the town and the labyrinth.
Use magic atop one of these sigils and you’ll be able to warp to a new location.
Moreover, while using magic, you’ll be able to see things that aren’t of this world.
Do your best to make effective use of your magic, escape from monsters, and conquer the labyrinth.


Controls:
Movement : WASD
Jump : Space
Options : Tab
Dash mode ON/OFF : LSHIFT
Action (Get/Use Item) : Left Click
Select Item : Mouse wheel
Sights in the center of the screen ON/OFF : R
Flashlight ON/OFF : Right click
Use/stop magic : E

2075240.name: Baby Shark™: Sing & Swim Party
2075240.about_the_game:
Get ready Shark Family, we’re going on a rhythmic adventure in Baby Shark: Sing & Swim Party! Swim across the wide waters with Baby Shark, Mommy Shark, Daddy Shark, Grandma Shark, and Grandpa Shark to enjoy the Fin-tastic Festival. A spectacular festival where performers gather every year, from all over the sea to sing, dance, and rock!






Road trips don’t have to be long and uneventful. They can be fun, engaging, and action-packed! Especially if you sing a song or two. Serenade your friends and family with your fin-omenal voice singing songs from original videos like Disco Sharks, Baby Mermaid Shark, Chumbala Cachumbala Skeleton Pirates, Shark Dance Party, and Baby Shark Dance, among others. Doo Doo Doo Doo Doo Doo!






In Baby Shark: Sing & Swim Party, you will journey through seven different locations in the ocean. You can swim through Tropical Bay, party in Ocean City or dive into the dark Kingdom of the Deep. With that many places to visit, you are bound to get a rumbly tummy, so make sure to stop by the Blue Pirate Ship to gulp down a couple of kelp sandwiches. And don’t forget to go to the Opera House to enjoy an exotic sea-mphony of sounds.



Baby Shark: Sing & Swim Party lets you choose between five different playable characters from the Shark Family that are customizable in various costumes, clothes, and skins. Play in two game modes: you can either go on an adventurous quest collecting stars while dodging blowfish or take on the waves and test how quick you are with your pectoral fins following the music. You will be rewarded with tons of musical cards that can be added to your album!

Are you ready to make new ocean friends and journey across the amazing sea? Jaw-some, pack your salty snacks and leeeeeeeettttt’s go!

This is going to be fun. I can feel it in my fins!



  • HELP THE SHARK FAMILY – Swim through iconic ocean locations and get them to the greatest festival.
  • SCORE STARS – Dodge obstacles or tap to the rhythm of the music to earn points.
  • SWIM, SING, AND SWING – Sing and dance along to jaw-some songs like Baby Shark, Doo Doo Doo Doo Doo Doo.
  • STRENGTHEN YOUR FINS – Collect stars whilst dodging blowfish or tap to the rhythm of the music to earn points.
  • YOU CAN DOO IT! – Collect tons of musical cards to add to your album.

2075250.name: ESCAPE IT
2075250.about_the_game: Somewhere in the galaxy, a man has been trapped in a house. He doesn't remember anything, but he knows that he should leave the house as soon as possible. He encounters many challenges, brain breaking puzzles, mind boggling riddles and much more. The game offers a unique experience of escaping an abandoned house. The house is fully interactable, meaning that you can pick up, open, close, turn on or turn off almost anything that you see in it. That and much more is waiting for you in the mysterious world of ESCAPE IT!

2075260.name: Cities Restored
2075260.about_the_game:
A brand new, interesting take on city simulation, where you attempt to rejuvenate abandoned cities and populate them with families ready to prosper and enjoy life.

Features:

  • Stunning top down displays.
  • Captivating game mechanics, highlighted by unique upgrades for the restoration of your cities.
  • Single player campaign with dynamically created cities that make every game feel unique.
  • Leaderboard to conquer.

2075280.name: Street Artist Simulator
2075280.about_the_game:
Street Artist Simulator is an open world action game where you’re a writer. Find spots, draw graffiti and become a legend. Just remember, don’t get busted.

In this game, you will play as a street artist whose only dream is to become a street legend. You will create your own graffiti to decorate the city with it. Unfortunately, not everyone will like your action, you will also have to do it when nobody is seeing. When someone sees you, you better run away. You can fight, but your chances are slim against everyone else. In addition, you must also eat and sleep, if you cannot afford food, you can always rummage in the trash, but this is not the best diet. You can always take a job for cash, or use your hacking skills and wipe someone's account. You just have to remember that your choices will always have consequences.

Draw


In Street Artist Simulator you can design your own graffiti from stencils and then place it in the game world.

Don’t get caught


Become a writter where spray is your weapon, choose escape in close combat. Befriend the city, use parkour to escape law enforcement officers more efficiently.

Find spots


There's a bunch of places waiting for you in Clean City, only your imagination will determine how to get there.

Be famous


Become a street art legend.Draw in a spot where the most people can admire your graffiti.

Hack


Hack environment to gain an advantage over an enemy. The entire city infrastructure at the touch of a finger!

Features

  • Unique graffiti painting mechanic
  • An open world filled with people who will react to your behavior
  • Parkour, move around buildings to get to your destination faster
  • Get food, money, shelter to survive in the city
  • Sneak up to avoid getting caught
  • Use the phone to hack the environment

2075340.name: Eo
2075340.about_the_game:
The world always changes.

Join us on discord: (Updated link)

Eo is the goddess of Creation. She created all the gods: Maritros, Noctarion, Ankarum, Maeve, Terraflora, Fulguris, Temporos, Tempestor, Sapiara, Phantamos and many others.  In Eo, the gods are watching you, and they want to be worshipped to be more powerful. So, choose a race, find others, survive, explore, build and change the world. We are trying a new concept where the players will take part in adventures that will actually shape the world and change it - maybe you will destroy and entire village for your god Murder or because Terraflora fears their advances will destroy a sacred forest. Find a way to communicate with the gods and they will help you with what you desire.

Playable races:

- Humans - We are the most common race on Eo. We are also called The First Sons, because we were the first people created by the goddess. We are hard workers and we can learn any skills with ease.

- Elves - We were the Second Sons of Eo. Upset with all the flaws she saw in Humans, Eo created us to be faster, lighter, more intelligent and able to brighten the dark with our inner light.

- Orcs - We were not created by Eo. We are born from curses cast on elves and humans by in the Divine Wars. Our deformed shape is part of the trauma of that time.

- Fey - When Eo created Terraflora, she immediately spawned us, the Fey. We are Terraflora's little helpers, her Archdruids. We protect the forests from devastation, plant trees and even defensive vegetation that help keep men and ravenfolk away. Unfortunately, some of us are dissevered from this way, falling in love with humans, even corrupting animals with orcs and ravenfolk.

- Catfolk - When Noctarion fell, he created Demons and us. We were born to follow the Dark Prince and eradicate all evil. The Prince created all felines to be agile, fast and precise in our fight for Justice. We are the superior mortal beings, in service of the Prince that Brings Light, Noctarion, as well as Murder and Chaos. We will bring torture and damnation to all those who are weak and fall to the pleasures of the flesh.

- Ravenfolk - We were not created by the goddess Eo. We were born from the mockery of Phantamos and Maeve. Defiants, they looked at the humans and elves, their beauty and perfection, and created us to laugh at Eo. However, we became wise, centered and in many aspects, superior.

- Demon - We are also called Children of Noctarion. Men follow Eo because she forgives. We don't. We don't forgive murderers, thieves and traitors. Men are evil and these men will find only torture when they meet us. We are the true Warriors for what's good and pure.

- Dark Elves - Disgusted by the weakness of elves, our people devoted themselves to Murder. Our Lord Murder purges the world of evil and in his trail of blood leaves only the honest and good behind. That is the true meaning of Good. In murder, we found strength, not weakness.

- Maritrian - We were created by Maritros, Lord of the Seas. We were tasked by Him to create Maritros, a mighty underwater city. But some of us gave up the Ocean to live among humans, even using magical means to breathe out of the water, which was impossible before.

- Goblin - We are the true children of Maeve. In the darkness, we do his bidding and from sunlight we hide. We trick, we lie and we find precious things for our Lord. She hates us and she loves us. Our existence makes as much sense as she wills it.

2075370.name: Old Tunnel
2075370.about_the_game:
The game takes place in one of the tunnels where there is a mythical spring that restores the youth of anyone who drinks or swims in its waters. A group of archaeologists, having found it, find themselves in a dangerous situation from which only a guard armed to the teeth can pull them out.

Old Tunnel is a runner and platformer with a side view. Despite the fact that the character moves through the tunnels automatically, you still have something to worry about. Every second your hero has to make decisions: jump or roll under an obstacle? Or maybe to shield yourself from the threat? Solutions, solutions… There are plenty of traps and troubles in the dungeons that will finish your race ahead of time. Are you sure that you are ready for a new batch of tests?

The main feature of Old Tunnel is stylish, pixel graphics, unusual gameplay, which together with music conveys the atmosphere of the mysterious and gloomy corridors of the old tunnel.

2075390.name: Super Geisha Neon
2075390.about_the_game:
Super Geisha Neon combines the platforming experience with arcade puzzles just like they did in the 80’s. Trust us, it’s old school all the way. Players will need to time their jumps, coordinate their actions and use their wits to solve some interactive puzzles. These goodies are packed with comfy pixel art that is basically infused with 8-bit nostalgia. Do you remember the times of epic retro games and chiptune music? You’ll find them in our newest title as well!"

The main feature of Super Geisha Neon is stylish, pixel graphics made in neon colors, unusual gameplay, which together with music conveys the atmosphere.

2075410.name: 初夏倾语 - Summer Whisper
2075410.about_the_game:

2075460.name: They Speak From The Abyss
2075460.about_the_game:
THEY SPEAK FROM THE ABYSS is a twisted homage to classic dungeon crawling RPGs. Explore beautifully gruesome environments, solve sinister puzzles, and confront the woeful souls and frightening demons lurking throughout the Abyss.



Step into the shoes of Vanessa Rivera, a young woman who feels lost in her life. After moving to a new city to be closer to her partner, a feeling of dread overwhelms her. Is this a fresh beginning, or the start of something more terrible beyond imagination?



Delve into the Abyss and confront terrifying demons, twisted manifestations, and malevolent devils. Choose your words carefully, as some inhabitants can be reasoned with. But when talking isn’t an option, be ready to engage in heart pounding active-time battles. Practice haste, as blood thirsty beings tend to grow impatient and attack before you’ve made a decision. After all, your flesh is precious…



THEY SPEAK is about overcoming fears and trauma, and trying to become a stronger person. Players must explore and confront many personal, mature, and often dark themes; themes of body horror and psychological struggle emerged through an expression of hate and anger. The journey of the player is designed to reflect real-world trials and tribulations.

Key Features:
  • Twisted homage to classic dungeon crawlers
  • Heart pounding active-time battles
  • Horrific hand-crafted pixel art
  • Grounded psychological horror narrative experience
  • Demonic creatures inspired by Clive Barker and Junji Ito
  • Sinister puzzles to solve throughout the Abyss
  • Literal nightmares
2075460.reviews:
“Everything has this beauty and level of disgust, from the Swan lady to the vagina dentate monster two feet away from it.”
DreadXP

“It’s a capitaving experience exploring the surreal nightmarish world of They Speak From The Abyss.”
Alpha Beta Gamer

2075470.name: Abloom
2075470.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in Abloom, an atmospheric exploration and puzzle game set in a once vibrant forest, now lifeless and consumed by a black hole. With the power of flight and swift ground movement at your disposal, navigate through this desolate landscape to solve enigmatic puzzles, lighting up the flora and fauna, and bringing back the radiant life that once flourished.

Witness a unique transformation as you move through the game. The forest, once dead and monochromatic, blooms back to life with vivid colors and vibrancy with each solved puzzle. Your journey is a cycle of death and rebirth, a testament to the enduring spirit of life in the face of adversity.

Abloom is crafted to be as accessible as possible, featuring a movement system that effortlessly merges simplicity and dynamism, making it equally engaging for both leisure players and gaming enthusiasts. Abloom is committed to inclusivity, with puzzles that emphasize shapes and logic, ensuring enjoyable gameplay beyond the boundaries of color perception.

Experience the rebirth of a world in Abloom. The forest awaits your touch to spring back to life.

2075480.name: Power of Petanque
2075480.about_the_game:
Compete against your friends in the traditional sport of petanque to determine who is the master of petanque.

The Petanque


A simple and intuitive game, throw your ball to be closest to the cochonnet(the little golden pig). The furthest players take damage until they are eliminated.

A Revisiting of The Petanque


Use various magical powers to gain an advantage over your opponents and turn the tide of the game. The last one standing wins!

Everyone For Himself Or As A Team

Compete against your friends alone or in a team.

Customize yourself


Change your colors and outfits to differentiate yourself from others !

2075490.name: Catch Royale
2075490.about_the_game:
Conquer the Catch Royale's everchanging seasonal maps as a hunter and catch them foxes or flip the coin, show your inner escape artist, and choose to be part of the foxes team.

The concept is plain and simple: The hunters' task is to tag them foxes, aka catch them, as the name indicates. However, the longer you survive as a fox, the higher your reward is.

Various settings, various parameters:
  • Try out Party mode, in which, instead of the standard 100-player mode, you can battle amongst 250 other fighters.
  • For the full experience, we added an optional Smart AI mode, in which you can set the other AI-handled foxes and hunters to find the optimal route to simulate the best experience.

What can I do with my XP?

The game offers 20 skins you can earn as you go up the staircase of experience points, each with a 5000 XP gap.

Future features that are yet to come:

  • Plain multiplayer mode
  • Replay mode
  • Create and publish your levels

2075510.name: AIXIN: Goddess' Love
2075510.about_the_game:
Aixin: Goddess’ Love is a short visual novel about the intertwined destinies of a goddess and a warrior in a world inspired by ancient Chinese mythology. 

Aixin is a young goddess whose purity and virtue seem boundless.

Wen Yang is a seasoned warrior whose past has left him deeply scarred. 

An unexpected event becomes a test, forcing both to doubt eternal truths. What is stronger: duty or feeling? Can love atone for sins? And what will remain when all principles collapse?

FEATURES

  • Short story (6800 words). 

  • One decisive choice that determines the ending. Two alternative endings. 

  • We’ve tried to create a charming audiovisual atmosphere that will highlight the drama of this story.

2075540.name: Valete vos viatores
2075540.about_the_game:
Valete vos viatore is a first person video game where we will manage a workshop, talk to clients and learn scriptor titulorum techniques throughout more than 5 locations.

The video game Valete vos Viatorians! proposes a journey from the very center of the Roman Empire to its westernmost point through various cities in Italy, Gaul, Hispania and Lusitania, in the person of a scriptor titulorum (sculptor specializing in the carving of inscriptions). The player will be able to learn the techniques that were used for its realization (writing, composition, choice of material, cutting, carving, decoration, painting). But above all, he will know the concerns and desires that drove people to leave his legacy written in stone, and he will be able to interpret its deepest meaning.

The ancient Romans erected their tombs and mausoleums along the roads and causeways so that travelers could read the inscriptions on their tombstones. Thus, being remembered by the reader, they believed they could endure in his memory. And grateful to those who took time to read their epitaphs, they dedicated this formula to them: VALETE VOS VIATORES, good luck to you, travellers!

All this in an adventure in which you will lead the protagonist through realistic environments recreated with historical and archaeological rigor that will allow you to explore the most characteristic areas of Roman cities, as they would be seen in the 1st century, and learn more about the most varied aspects of Roman civilization (daily life, society, institutions, professions).
A journey through the ancient Roman world that is also a journey through time through the fascinating world of inscriptions. To those of you who decide to undertake it, we can only wish you: VALETE VOS VIATORES!

2075580.name: Under A New Sun
2075580.about_the_game:
The plan was simple - the ship would wake you from your cryocapsule before you arrived at a potential new home. A planet for humanity to start a new life on. But when you awaken, you are already on the ground amongst the wreckage of your ship with no one else in sight. Stranded and surrounded only by debris, you start your journey under an unfamiliar sky.

The planet has a breathable atmosphere, which is a good start. Surprisingly, the area is already filled with a lush flora and fauna — some of which seem familiar, others completely alien. A few of the old seedlings from Earth must have survived the crash somehow, building a new kind of ecosystem.

What happened to the ship? How long have you been frozen in cryo since your arrival? You don't have the answers, but...for now, you have more pressing concerns.

You must find a way to survive and make this foreign planet your new home!

Survive

Face hunger, thirst, weather, and hostile fauna while the days pass by. Treat your wounds and keep your eyes open, some old machines still roam the landscape. The scorching sun above is unforgiving.

Explore

Discover various islands, underwater locations, old wrecks, and more. Find out what happened to your crew, where you are and what went so horribly wrong with your ship.

Craft and build

Harvest the resources of your new surroundings, refine materials and craft new tools. Find your way to the top of the food chain and build yourself a new home!

Sail the sea

Adjust the sails and follow the wind! Just like our ancestors sailed over the seas of our old home to discover new land.

Gather electricity

Scavenge wrecks and whats left of your old ship. Harness the power of nature and generate electricity to power advanced technology's.

Interact with the world

Interact with several different types of workstations in a unique and immersive way to refine resources and take your next step forward. Instead of navigating endless menus, you physically interact in-game with your items.

For example:

• Make cloth on a loom

• Split wood into planks

• Process raw hides into usable leather

• Smelt ore and forge it into tools

• Potter and fire clay into usable objects

...and more!

Team up with your friends

Challenge the world alone or explore, build, and survive with up to three friends by your side (4 in total).

2075590.name: PASSAGE
2075590.about_the_game:
PASSAGE is a challenging horror game about solving puzzles and surviving from the various beasts in the chamber. In this prison, quick thinking, knowledge and strategy are vital if you want to escape.

PUZZLES


There are 3 types of puzzles, with each one testing you in distinct ways. Do not get distracted and do not linger, as the stakes for solving these puzzles are high. Even the slightest mistake can, and will, kill you.

BEASTS


There are # distinct monsters in the chamber. The moment you step foot in it, they will be on the hunt. Knowledge, experience, skill and focus are required to evade each one. Get distracted even for a second, and they will catch you.


Only the worthy will pass. Are you ready to prove yourself?

2075600.name: Jump Among Stars
2075600.about_the_game:
Jump Among Stars is a challenging 3D platform game where you will face a series of escalating challenges. Each level is a thrilling adventure through an intergalactic portal to a new star system to race to the center, collect energy from the stars and return it to the space station.

You will need to master precision jumps, calculate the correct time, face platforms with different mechanics and find the correct path in the most diverse star systems

The player is Lieutenant Thrina Torres of the MD-P9 troop and together with soldier Rilke H. Kenze travel to the abandoned space station Phoenix Beta 3 of the interspace organization HiperPortal to recover a capsule with the energy of a rare star.


In Jump Among Stars the player needs to explore the Phoenix Beta 3 space station, accessing different rooms after collecting star energy. For this, the player needs to travel by teleportation to a star system, reach the main star, collect the energy...



...and reach the teleport again to return to the station.



Each star system has a unique challenge, beautifully crafted with different platforming mechanics and challenges



While facing the 3D platforming challenges, the player can also enjoy stunningly beautiful intergalactic landscapes.

The game contains

  • Space scenery
  • Challenges with 3D platforms
  • Different environments and scenarios to explore
  • Linear progression
  • Third-person character
  • Stories and secrets to discover
  • Immersive soundtrack
  • Beautiful 3D artwork

2075630.name: Enelia: Dawn of Madness
2075630.about_the_game:
Important: The game is in Early Access

Chapter 1 is now available.

Chapter 2 to be released in Q4 2025.

All Game Features listed below are already implemented into the game.

Both minor and major gameplay improvements are planned for the future.

Price of the game will increase with each released Chapter.

We read all your feedback and are very grateful for your help! <3

Enelia: Dawn of Madness is a mysterious adventure in a madness-infested world where every choice draws you deeper into the embrace of darkness. While the druids search for the heart of the world, the hearts of the Za'ani are shrouded in darkness, and madness takes on human forms.

Desperation brings you closer to enigmatic characters whose encounters change you. Each of them will lead you to answers, but will you want to know the truth?

How far will you go to touch the madness?

Game Features

- Enchanting Atmosphere: A stylish world inspired by "Avatar" with animated backgrounds and comics.

- Parallel Narrative Branches: Play as different characters and journey to distant corners of the world.

- Cinematic Storytelling: A manga-style novel filled with tension, mysteries, and dramatic events.

- Astral Vision: Explore hidden layers of reality and face madness.

- Dynamic Choices: Your decisions will influence the story's outcome and can lead to at least five different endings.

The world of Enelia, inspired by "Avatar" and "Stranger Things," contains countless mysteries and secrets, each of which can lead to unpredictable turns.

Enelia is a mystical adventure set in a vast, advanced bio-magical world with its own rules and laws, where love and madness are intricately intertwined by the thread of fate.

Every choice truly matters and has consequences.

Forge a strong bond with a beloved character or become their sworn enemy, do good and maintain harmony or embrace the path of darkness and plunge the world into chaos!

The choice is yours — flee from madness or delve into its very heart?

In search of salvation, Enelia explores a mysterious world with incredible natural phenomena, mythical creatures, ancient secrets, and dark cults. Embark on an adventure with Enelia and her pet Shio to gain the power of a druid and ascend to the top of the Dre'we.

Enelia: Dawn of Madness is an exciting adventure where your choices will determine whether you become a victim of madness or stop it. Along the way, you will encounter and build relationships with mysterious characters, face and fight mythical creatures, solve puzzles, and undertake quests leading to new revelations, but whatever you do, a confrontation with madness is inevitable.

We have poured our heart and soul into creating this game, striving to make it unique and memorable. We want every player to experience the heroes' stories alongside them and to be moved by the themes presented in the narrative.

2075660.name: Evil Bird Simulator
2075660.about_the_game:
Evil Bird Simulator is a light and funny casual cartoon 2d side scrolling game where the main player is a bird that poops on people and cars. This is a casual game with simple controls and gameplay, and will make you smile and laugh at some of the interactions. If the main player dies in this game, they will go to hell, and the player must fly their way out of hell as a skeleton bird, and then they will be able return to the main game.

This game consists of 7 unique levels in 7 different scenarios with unique enemies and interactions in each level. The player must earn enough points by crapping on people and cars to complete the level. Once the level is complete, the player will unlock the next level until the player reaches the end of the game. The player has only a limited amount of crap and must collect food for additional ammo. The player also has hearts, and when hurt will lose a heart.. When the player runs out of hearts, they will die and go to hell, where they must fly their way out of hell. When a player gets hit in hell, they will lose their points and will not be able to escape hell until they earn enough points to get out of hell.

This game is story based, and there is a story and screen shots between levels. The story is light, funny and mildly crude. This game does not contain any blood or gore. It is strictly a cartoon game that is light and funny.

2075820.name: Controller Sync
2075820.about_the_game:
Description

Controller Sync is an arcade-style reaction game that lets you practice and compare your controller-skills with all other players.
In order to play, you have to have an X-Box- or Playstation- like controller installed on your device.

Gamemodes

There are two main gamemodes in Controller Sync: Solo and Duo
The Solo gamemode lets you focus on reaction speed and correct key usage,
while you have to focus on good communication and synchronization in the Duo gamemode.
You can play together with anyone!

Leaderboard

You can see the highscores of all players on the ingame-leaderboard.

How does the game work?

When starting a new game, you got 60 seconds to collect as many points as you can.
Points can be gained by controlling a cursor with your joystick and pressing the right button for the nearest dot.
Dots can either have the color blue or red. To collect a blue dot, you have to select blue as your controller color (The opposite with red dots).
The collected dots are then stored in a blue or a red bar depending on the dot color.
You can consume these bars to get one of three values increased:
Blue bar - Time
Red bar - Score (x2)
Both Bars - Multiplier

When you got no time left, the game is over and you see your new leaderboard-rank.

So what are you waiting for?
Practice your skills and prove them to others!

2076030.name: THE FATE OF MIRADOR CHAPTER ONE
2076030.about_the_game:
STORY:
You are a prince of (Mirador) in a medieval-era fictional world that is full of danger, dangerous, and even magical creatures. Orcs, elves, and fairies, just to name a few. Yet many other to-be-discovered species and creatures exist outside of your realm. Currently, the world as you know it is at peace. But some things are just not meant to last...

GAMEPLAY: You are the prince, and as such you do whatever your royal hiney desires. However, nearly everything you do as a royal will be watched, judged, and in many cases even remembered forever.

The world itself will change based on your choices. IE: You do good in the world. The world will start to notice you, senpai. The same could be said if you happen to be the undecisive type of person who can't make up his mind about staying Good, Neutral, or even possibly more... The game, based on your choices, will take one of the three preset paths for an ending that will not only be suitable to the character you have built, but the entire story itself will change (drastically) based on the path. In short, no rewriting the same lines for another path. Each path will see different characters, and even the same ones who are considered the main cast(many of them will be a part of your team/harem/dungeon...), act accordingly. Based on your player build/choices you make, shape you as a leader.​

WORTH POINTING OUT:
- You can name your own character.
- You can name all the main cast characters.
- Your choices shape the world and story you want.
- You can replay the game and choose different choices to not miss out on any of the content.

FOM will be delivered to you chapter by chapter. Chapter two is currently being worked on, and is coming soon.


MAC USER PLEASE READ HERE.

THE FATE OF MIRADOR Has been tested and does run on a MAC, with the same exact build that runs on Linux and Windows. However, since "apps" on Steam are required to be notarized, FOM will not work within Steam for MAC.

But you’re no ordinary barkeep. Be it a potion of seething fury or prancing swords, the drinks you serve can change your customer’s destiny forever. You can also turn the rumours you hear at work into intrepid quests for your patrons!

Befriend a colourful cast of adventurers as they brag about their latest triumph – or commiserate an utter failure. Whether it’s relaxation or a fresh thrill, you’re on hand to give each patron what they need.

Beyond the walls of this cosy tavern, a world-threatening danger is brewing. Every quest, rumour and conversation is intertwined with the ultimate fate of the land.

You will...

Find Your Family

The Wayfarer's Inn is a safe haven to a colourful cast of characters inspired by TTRPGs. Get to know their unique personalities, and help them find a place that feels like home.

Brew Up A Storm

Serve an ever-growing menu of magical drinks to your patrons, but choose carefully, as your choice will alter their fates.

Whip Up Some Quests

Gather rumours from the tavern-goers and use them to create quests for your adventurous guests.

Connect the Dots

Piece together the fragments in your little study and uncover the secrets of an ancient evil threatening the land.

Cherish the Space

Page localized by LocQuest

Like in every good Pen & Paper campaign, Tavern Talk touches topics that may hit right in the feels. Please be aware that there will be mentions of death, grief and violence.

2076150.name: Pizzaïolo-Ninja

You play as Tony Tribbiani, an Italian guy that's half-pizzaïolo, half-ninja (and 100% pissed off).

Your mission?

Climb to the top of Bartony Tower, put an end to his reign of terror, and save pizza’s honor before it’s tainted by… pineapple.

Your superpower?

You’re a ninja—on top of legendary flexibility, you’ve got killer agility, a must-have for scaling the tower and dodging the many traps in your way! Or for falling… but in style.

Ready to fall… but not to give up? Let’s go!
