English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support
2080820.reviews:
“It’s got the spirit of Overwatch and CS:GO, but all excitingly represented on a 2D plane.”
VG247

“SquadBlast: 2D Overwatch meets Quake — and it’s really good”
Dexerto

“The secret lovechild of Metal Slug and Super Smash Bros.”
GameSpew

2080880.name: Farmhand Go!
2080880.about_the_game:
Farmhand Go! is a casual and easygoing game about growing and selling crops. In this active farming game, your goal is to pay off your farm debt by growing seeds and selling the harvested crops. Days move quickly in Farmhand Go! and the crows are always waiting and watching for some tasty crops to nibble on! Buy low, sell high, and try to keep the crows at bay in this brand new farming game unlike any other you've played!

"Wonderful premise, it was really fun to play!" - Generic Games

"This was really fun! Great job!" - ilovedolphins7313

2080890.name: Gem Venture
2080890.about_the_game:
A wandering miner named Axel is destined to restore the Sacred Gems that maintain the world's life energy, or else it will become a land of nothingness under the rule of Tourmaline. Restore the Sacred Gems across 8 different areas while jumping, dashing, and mining your way through obstacles and enemies.

Along with your partner Bixbi, you will meet various characters and help restore the Sacred Gems in each area. Use your trusty pickaxe or well timed jumps to defeat Tourmaline's henchmen and the negative creatures at his disposal.

  • Over 40 levels of platforming goodness.

  • Travel across 8 different areas and meet the inhabitants along the way.

  • Utilizing well timed jumps, slides, and dashes will allow you to access different paths and hidden secrets.

  • Unlock abilities and increase your maximum health and attack power by leveling up! To level up, you will need to defeat several enemies and collect gems to increase your experience points. After leveling up multiple times, your Attack Power will increase as well!

  • To gain even more experience points, perform Stylish Moves by pressing the jump button again after bouncing off an enemy. Try to reach the maximum level if you can!

  • There are numerous Character Cards scattered throughout the land. If you're a completionist, try collecting them all!

2080900.name: Starry Navigator 星际领航员
2080900.about_the_game:
Create your own planet in the immense starry sky.

Starry Navigator is a role-playing recreational farming game. You can build your own planet with adorable animals. Planting flowers and breeding. Gaining starry energy to repair the interstellar train system. When the interstellar train starts, it will take you to explore the unknown universe and weave new stories with your animal friends on other planets. Pushing the story forward by diligent planting. Reopen the ancient galaxy routes, and try to make the desolate universe prosperous again!

Have you ever imagined a planet of your own?
Have you ever imagined meeting the fox that belongs to you in the long universe just like the little prince?

What will happen to the earth in 1000 years? The ability of humans to live in space without the support of the earth 1000 years later gave rise to a new occuption- interstellar navigator- to direct travelers between the stars. In the cosmic age, driving interstellar spacecraft or trains will no longer require human labor. However, every interstellar train requires a navigator to ensure the correct in the event that the driving machinery fails for safety reasons. In this era, humanity discovered a new energy known as "starry enery", which serves as the fuel for the interstellar train.

By understanding the speed of light, humans have discovered a new way to prodyct energy_ starry energy. This kind of energy can be found in biological processes. Huamns invented robots and other machinery, as well as mechanical devices that can collect and transform energy into other forms. The period of peace, however, is only temporary, as the majority of the universe's inhabited areas are now under attack, and you are one of them...

Fortunately, you finally woke up after a long darkness. What unexpected encounters will you have next?

2080930.name: Whispering Abyss
2080930.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO DULUTH.

After watching her mother get dragged underneath the surface by something terrible, a young Grace Havenshroud was left scared and alone. 10 years later, Grace returns to her hometown of Duluth, Minnesota. Equipped with her dual revolvers and the sun necklace gifted in her mother's final moments, Grace is determined to find out what took her mother.

Use your run and gun-style skills to navigate the treacherous abyss and rid Dululth of its monsters! The abyss features tons of items that drastically impact the way the game is played and will aid in the increased difficulty per level. Using random generation, each level of the abyss is unique and rewards different styles of play. Whispering Abyss also features collectible journal entries that help Grace uncover the mystery of what happened all those years ago. Will Grace discover Duluth’s secrets, or will she meet the same fate as her mother?



  • Lore-enriched gameplay shown through unlockable journal pages, secret lore bits, and much more.
  • Exotic items that drastically change the way the game is played.
  • Randomly generated levels that make each run new and exciting!
  • Beautiful environments and distinct enemies with special attack patterns!
  • Enemies, items, and special NPCs inspired by Lovecraftian lore!



Traveler’s guide to the Whispering Abyss

The Wandering Eyes
Half of a deadly pair and one of the more common enemies found in the Abyss. These eyes like to hunt in packs to overwhelm their prey rather than take it on alone. You should have nothing to worry about if facing one of these creatures, but be careful and don’t dawdle on taking them out because they can very quickly become a problem. Take your gaze off a wandering eye, and the next time you spot it, you’ll have way more than one to worry about. Standing and fighting a horde is a death sentence find a way to thin it out or take them out in bottleneck areas.

Tendrils
The other half of a deadly pair and a common occurrence is the tendrils in the Abyss. Like the wandering eyes, these tendrils are weak, especially alone, but the danger lies in their ability to corner you. These tendrils occupy valuable space and rely on their friends to push you towards them for the kill. The easiest way to deal with a tendril is by being aware of your surroundings so as not to get pushed into their range. Tendrils cannot move horizontally, only lunge, and using this against them is paramount to your survival down there. Do not underestimate them or suffer the consequences.

The Forgotten
Once humans just like you, the forgotten are special because they’re the only monsters that can hit you from range. They want your attention elsewhere, so they get a perfect shot at you with the massive rocks they hurl. The forgotten have buried themselves in the ground, rooting themselves for greater durability and the ability to attack from range. Use this against them, as long as you keep moving, they won’t be able to target you accurately. Don’t ever double back against a forgotten, or you’ll find yourself waking up at the pearly gates a bit too soon. If you’re fast enough, you can get away with leaving them for last, but be warned, these creatures will take any chance to strike you with a lightning-quick boulder to the head.

The Stalker
Stalkers like to watch their targets, then charge up a dash attack that only matches its power in speed. They say if you listen close enough, you can hear the huffs of a stalker tracking you at some points in the Abyss. Their tough hide makes them harder to take down than most enemies but not impossible and if it bleeds, it dies; remember that. Stay light on your feet, traveler, and never stay in the same place too long lest you want to feel the fate of the many unfortunate victims before you.



  • Ritual Consumes hp, enter a very strong berserk mode, increased dmg, speed, fire rate.
    Picking up this item consumes some of the user’s hp to enter a beserked state, granting her increased dmg, speed, and fire rate.
    “Just because I use some of their enchantments doesn’t make me comparable to them.”
    “This is a necessary evil. I can tolerate it this once.”
    “Breathe Grace it’s just a little pain for a lot of damage.”
    “Blood Magic, the most painful of magics.”

  • Ricochet Chance for bullets to bounce to a nearby enemy
    Bullets have a chance to bounce to a nearby enemy causing damage.
    “Mom always knew I was a great shot. This just proves it.”
    “Efficient… Perfect.”
    “A bouncing bullet eh? I can work with this.”
    “What makes it bounce? Magic! Definitely magic.”

  • Tentacle Summons a tentacle that rotates around the player dealing a chunk of damage to the first enemy hit; tentacle then despawns and respawns after a short duration.
    Summons a friendly tentacle that will deal damage to enemies around the user.
    “Turning them against each other… I never even thought to try that.”
    “Time for them to get a taste of their own medicine.”
    “Finally they get to feel my pain!”
    “I don’t care if you help me, you won’t be spared in the end.”

  • Double shot % chance to fire two bullets.
    Gives a chance to fire two bullets for the price of one.
    “Two is always better than one. Unless you ask my mother who would say one is plenty.”
    “Two bullets to the face are better than one. Good riddance.”
    “My revolvers never cease to surprise me.”
    “A surprise to be sure, but a very welcome one.”

  • Gambler’s Choice A huge stat up for a huge stat down (randomized)
    Grants a random large stat up and a large stat down.
    “It’s not gambling if you’ve already made peace with everything you’ve lost.”
    “Go on. If you give me something bad I’ll make that work too. I’ve had worse”
    “Time to be a god or time to run?”
    “Don’t mess with a girl who’s got nothing left to lose. She’s crazy.”

  • ... And so many more to discover!

2080940.name: Turbo Force
2080940.about_the_game:
Turbo Force is an ultra fast anti-gravity racing game with online competitions, deep gameplay mechanics, and a track editor. Use your momentum to solve unique platforming challenges and gain an edge over your opponents!

Key Features

  • High Risk Gameplay: Out-race your opponents by sacrificing your ship's energy for speed or go all in with dangerous aerial stunts.
  • Grand Prix Racing: Race against AI controlled vehicles or other human players in thrilling, high stakes matches.
  • Survival Racing: Survive to the finish line in treacherous, hazard filled tracks.
  • Online Multiplayer: Play online with other racers in the Versus, Time Trial, and Survival racing modes.
  • Leaderboard + Replays: Compete against the ghosts of your rivals for the fastest completion times on tracks.
  • Level Editor: Create and share custom levels with the racing community on the Steam Workshop.

2080950.name: Rawbots
2080950.about_the_game:
A universe where you can play with amazing robots that are designed, built and even programmed by you.

Everything is a robot, doors, roads, walls, bridges, safes, traps, turrets, surveillance systems, etc. Build forts, towers and architect impressive structures to protect your planets and resources. You may play solo or with friends to infiltrate, conquer planets and gather resources.

The Rawbots universe has a unique set of matter, energy and physics laws. These laws are engineered to serve up fun emergent gameplay that is different every time you play. Everything you would expect from a sandbox game and more. We are taking this to the next level with gameplay that truly emerges beyond imagination and defined contextually by the type of robots you build. On one planet you might experience a first person shooting experience, go into a space battle in 3rd person, and down into an RTS offensive on another planet.

An intuitive and streamlined graph system will bestow the power of visual programming into the hands of creative minds. Under the hood, the latest in signal processing, inverse kinematics and PID controllers, will breathe life into your creations. From geeks, to tinkers, to grinders, there is a creation path for everyone.

And while you are building and tinkering around, we will also be busy developing story campaigns, random missions, battle tournaments and creating new and impressive bot parts.
2080950.reviews:
“We’ve all wanted to build our own robot fighting machine at some point in our life; usually a lack of university level robotics education tends to get in the way. Well you can kiss that lame excuse goodbye when you get your hands on the robot building sandbox game, Rawbots.”
The Indie Game Magazine

“If you were ever a fan of RobotWars or just remember the TV show, then this game will give you a damn good robot creation treat.”
IndieRetroNews

2080960.name: Phijkchu Quest
2080960.about_the_game:
At least 7 Months in the making, the elusive PHIJKCHU Quest is here to change everything.
Finally an RPG where you can make the choices that matter in ways that matter.
Finally an RPG with multiple Funny's.
Finally a Quest... of PHIJKCHU.


^ picture of Rusp and his friends! (some of them are not really friends but for the sake of clarity they can basically be considered friends (within reason))


Join the questionably heroic protagonist Rusp and his gang on the quest to go on a quest.
Meet many exciting and normal foes & friends as you explore gamemode after gamemode, map after map, song after song, all unified by a genre hallmark RPG engine handbaked by our skilled programmer.

Defining Features!!
> Over 2 hours of gameplay
> Walking engine
> RPG Engine
> Music
> Sound effects
> Graphics
> Animated sprites
> Skill system (vaguely)!
> Naval Combat
> Various Minigames!!
> and...
> more...

2080970.name: Ducky's Delivery Service
2080970.about_the_game:
Propeller-powered duck delivery action! In Ducky's Delivery Service, you are a duck who uses a propeller backpack to fly around and deliver mail. Master the flight physics, grow your delivery business, fulfill special delivery requests from other ducks, and earn time attack ranks and high scores.



Master the controls of your propeller backpack and discover the fastest routes between destinations in your quest to become the best delivery business around.



Grow your delivery business from its humble beginnings and explore increasingly dangerous areas, while avoiding hazards such as windmills, seagulls, falling stalactites and wandering ghosts.



Help other ducks by fulfilling their special delivery requests. Deliver their one-off items to their destinations, while making sure they don't get damaged.



Earn time attack ranks by discovering the fastest routes for delivering flyers, and earn high scores by quickly delivering packages without damaging them. Throw packages into mailboxes from a distance for even higher scores!

Features

  • Master 20 stages of propeller-powered duck delivery action
  • Grow your delivery business from its humble beginnings, as you improve your skills and unlock new areas
  • Help other ducks by fulfilling their special delivery requests
  • Earn time attack ranks by discovering the fastest routes for delivering flyers
  • If you would rather play at your own pace, Relaxed Mode removes all time limits
  • Use the comprehensive Assist Mode to adjust the game to your liking by tweaking health, score multipliers, game speed, or outright skipping troublesome stages
2080970.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Japanese, Russian
2080970.reviews:
“You can choose to be competitive or you can simply let the wind flow beneath your wings.”
Eurogamer

“Although I tell myself that I'll be playing the relaxed mode, I'm very likely to get addicted to trying the highest score, and I'm all for it.”
GameGrin

“I'm telling you, that's gonna be one of the new hot speedrunning games out there.”
Spikevegeta

2080980.name: Mono Playground
2080980.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mono Playground! This game is a basic 2D platformer adventure, where you can run up walls, eat cookies, and earn a high score! You play as Mono Kitty, an intrepid adventure in search of something to nourish his cravings of adventure, and stomach!

Hope y'all enjoy the experience.

2081080.name: Capes
2081080.about_the_game:
Twenty years ago, the supervillains won.

Since then, they’ve created a dystopian city where developing super powers is a crime. Nobody has managed to slow them down, until now.

Capes is a turn based superhero strategy game where you build a team of heroes and fight to take back the city.

Played across a series of campaign and patrol missions, choose to push forward with the story or take the time to explore the side missions and unlock more heroes, earn skill points and complete challenges, and learn more about your heroes lives.


Recruit new heroes with a range of unique powers and abilities. Every hero plays differently, and requires a fresh approach to their powers and abilities.

Learning and exploiting each hero's unique play style will build their power in combat allowing them to unleash their personal tide turning Ultimates.



Exciting, heroic, turn based combat to test your strategic skills. Team ups and positioning matter, unlocking new ways to approach every enemy type and supervillain you encounter.

Capes combat isn't based around random numbers or lurking behind cover. Power doesn't make you invulnerable, far from it. Your choices will make the difference between victory and defeat.



Take up to 4 heroes to work together in each mission. Each hero gains a unique team up ability from each of their allies, allowing them to work together to take advantage of their unique powers.



Level up your heroes to gain access to new abilities and powerful upgrades.
Use Skill Points acquired from completing objectives and challenges to unlock their powers.


Complete collections of hero specific challenges during missions to earn bonus Skill Points and unlock optional missions that give a deeper insight into each of the heroes.
2081080.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
2081080.reviews:
“Capes is a clever and challenging tactics game with a clear love of the superhero comics that inspired it.”
8/10 – IGN

“Every hero has their unique super-strengths in this wonderfully intense turn-based strategy game.”
8/10 – PC Gamer

“Strategy system that doesn't rely on percentages is a highlight. Great worldbuilding. Top character design. Awesome presentation.”
8/10 – Gamereactor

2081090.name: 4 The Elements
2081090.about_the_game:
4 The Elements is a 2D Action Platformer inspired by the best games of this genre from the 90s. Switch in real time between the four elements of nature to overcome challenges, acquire new abilities and defeat powerful bosses in beautifully crafted thematic stages.






You control each of the four elements of nature, Fire, Earth, Air, and Water, that for some mysterious reason find themselves trapped inside a magic crystal and forced to share the same body. By switching between the characters on the fly, you will be able to use their different attacks, movement and abilities to face enemies, solve puzzles and unveil the truth behind their mutual predicament as they fight to escape from their imprisonment.




Walk beautifully crafted environments that were formed by the elemental chaos raging within the crystal, each created from the clash of two of the primary elements. Traverse through Ice, Magma, Mud and Smoke as you face the challenges each of these stages present.








The 4 elements have much of their power sealed away and scattered across these hostile domains. Look for the runes that contain their essences to empower the elements with new abilities. They will be essential to conquer the obstacles that stand in your way, both environmental and foes alike.






Speaking of foes, at the end of each stage, a massive creature awaits. They serve as guardians to the 4 crystal keys the elements need in order to release themselves from their prison.





Like the places they inhabit, these mighty beasts too were birthed from the coalescence of elemental forces and wield that power with unbridled fury. As such, each will present challenges that match and make use of their domains. Combine your skills with the knowledge and abilities acquired on the path to their lair to fell these giants and claim their keys.
2081090.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*
*languages with full audio support
2081090.reviews:
“AlchyScore: Visual: 8; Playability 9; Sountracks 8.5; Story 10; TOTAL 9”
9 – Alquimia Game

highlighted.localized_name: Not a Hedgehog, By the Way
highlighted.name: Not a Hedgehog, By the Way

2081170.name: Loose Life
2081170.about_the_game:
One moment, and the world changed. The same houses, streets, the same sun in the sky. But they will never be the same again. With the first explosions, the lives of millions of people changed, and you are among them.

Scenarios

Thousands of fates, thousands of stories.
Dive into new plots time after time. Characters, goals, possibilities, everything is different from scenario to scenario. What they all have in common is one terrible event. It affected all of them, but in different ways. It's up to you not only to figure out how but also to influence everything.

The decisions you make will impact the entire gameplay

From the smallest to the largest.

Any, even the most insignificant decisions, can affect your story and possibilities. A series of choices can lead you to completely unexpected places. How to respond in dialogue? When to use an item? Should you take this action now? All of it carries weight!
No one is going to tell you how to resolve the situation, you are on your own to find solutions for all targets.

Explore the map

History on every corner.

At each location, you'll find many interesting places. Are there any traces of someone? What was here before? And what should you do now? Each such place contributes a piece to the overall picture. Explore locations, discover new ones, and more!

Collect useful items

Put everything useful in your pocket.

Collect, use, sell dozens of different items. From food to tools. There's even beer! It's up to you to decide how and where to use all this goodness.

Cook food

Where can you go without a snack?

Cook meals of varying degrees of difficulty. Each of them will give you unique properties with which you can control the story even more.

Keep an eye on your status

Sleep-eat-sleep-eat-sleep-eat-ah-lolable!
Monitor not only your physical needs but also your moral and even social ones. Any slight fluctuations in status can either give you new opportunities or limit you. Anything can be a resource here. Whether it's smiling at a stranger or even time.

Create your own story

It's all in your hands!
Using everything mentioned above and much that hasn't been described, you get a small but vivid story in your hands. It's up to you to decide what it will grow into.

Based on horrifying events

No more tears.
There are things that leave scars on people. There are such scars that stay with entire nations. The pain from them may never fade away. Healing them is not possible either. But we can try to understand. Because if you understand all the pain of a person, then you can truly offer your shoulder and share that burden. Is that something a little person can do?

2081180.name: SquishCraft
2081180.about_the_game:
SquishCraft is a puzzle game where you push and squish blocks.

Solve over 60 puzzle levels.

2081220.name: OVERTOP
2081220.about_the_game:
Overtop is a platformer combining cute cartoon graphics and hardcore gameplay. You play as a little owl that has fallen from its nest on the top of the mountain to the very bottom. You have only one goal – to climb to the top, overcoming cliffs and precipices. No one will lead you by the hand here, every failure is your personal miscalculation, however, every victory, every successful jump is your personal achievement. It all depends on you!

Gameplay

There is only one rule – the higher you rise, the more painful it is to fall.
  • Immerse yourself in a real platformer, where the stakes increase with each jump
  • Carefully assess the situation and calculate the distance, any mistake can cost you dearly
  • Learn to control your anger
  • Duration of the game from 15 minutes to ∞

Atmosphere

The audiovisual style of the game does everything for your relaxation so that you don't break anything in the process.
  • Relaxing and soothing music, as well as background sounds of chirping birds
  • Bright stylized graphics that pleases the eye
  • Juicy effects and volumetric lighting

2D Artist - Elizaveta Norkina
3D Artist - Sergey Abanin
2081220.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Russian, Ukrainian

2081230.name: Parry Nightmare
2081230.about_the_game:
Easy to pick up, and hard to put down! Parry Nightmare is a one-of-a-kind "parry heaven" action game where the best offense is a good defense!


Use your nightmare's strength against it with your trusty parry move! Stun foes, send away projectiles, and stop threats right in their tracks by chaining parries!


Honno-chan will defeat any foes you stun automatically. Leave them to her and focus on the defense!


Parrying grants your soul more and more courage to face the night! Heal up by continuing to parry! Spend excess soul to unleash a powerful Burst move to wipe out hordes of enemies at once!


Collect powerups from rare foes to supercharge Honno-chan! Breathe fire, deploy orbital pain, wreak havoc, and more!


Defeated enemies drop light. Collect light and the darkness of the nightmare abates, giving you a clearer view of the chaos. Max out your light meter to beat the nightmare!


Will you be able to escape the nightmare and greet a new day...?
2081230.supported_languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

highlighted.localized_name: A Sigh in the Dead of Night
highlighted.name: A Sigh in the Dead of Night

highlighted.localized_name: Snug as a Bug in a Rug
highlighted.name: Snug as a Bug in a Rug

highlighted.localized_name: Remove What's Left of the Nightmare
highlighted.name: Remove What's Left of the Nightmare

2081240.name: 幻恋逢星之时
2081240.about_the_game:
基于文字和图片呈现的角色扮演类游戏，通过鼠标点击选项推进剧情，完成动漫式校园中主人公与美少女们所发生的故事。

这是一个关于爱与梦想的故事。
想要造出火箭飞上天的少年，追逐着星星，大声许下了誓言：
我们之所以要飞上星空，绝非因为此事很简单，正相反，是因为它难以做到，才更值得去追逐！
梦想随着时间蒙尘，流转到浑浑噩噩躺在社团活动室的午后。
神秘出现在社团门口的美少女，钻进你的怀里，痛哭着称呼你为“爸爸！”
打破了平静日常的她，却从此刻起一时失去了踪影。追逐她，重新找到她，询问其哭泣与称呼父亲的含义，对她发动复仇！
神秘记者侦探美少女星岛，帮助寻找美少女之间，揭露这一切背后蕴藏着的阴谋——
反派……竟然是我自己！？
欢迎打开《幻恋逢星之时》，与美少女一起体验这浓缩了阴谋的校园故事。

大家好，我们是名不见经传的小独立游戏开发者风月同天工作室，今后会继续

2081290.name: Battle Survival in Space
2081290.about_the_game:
The rules are very simple: kill enemies, jump on platforms, collect money and experience. Experience will allow you to pump LVL. Each level you will be able to choose a weapon/skill. In total, you can collect up to 5 skills. Each skill will constantly attack enemies, you just have to not fall into the abyss and not let the alien get too close.

This game combines different genres: Platformer, Shoot 'em up, Roguelike and even RPG.

2081300.name: Bartox
2081300.about_the_game:
Bartox is a linear adventure puzzler with a great emphasis on sound. The protagonist, Bart is not enjoying his office job at a large company. He buys a violin from and gets it shipped from said company, and to his great amazement realizes that this is no standard violin, but a magical artifact transporting him to another world filled with fun and engaging challenges for him to solve. All seems great, but after some time the joy seems to fade from this magic world and one can see the rest of Bart's life slowly altering this dream world.

What can Bart do to save himself and bring back the magic like it was in the beginning?

The game focuses heavily on music and audio for solving the puzzles. You use your violin to ricochet sound waves and can do all sorts of other things too. Keep your wits about you and your violin at the ready.

2081310.name: TOBOR
2081310.about_the_game:
You are TOBOR — a surveillance unit observing 16 real-time CCTV feeds. Watch, record, and decide who lives in Undercroft as paranoia spreads.

Key Features:

1. Explore 16 Surveillance Feeds: Delve deep into the heart of Undercroft as Tobor, the spy robot, and uncover the truth hidden within its surveillance feeds.

2. Shape Multiple Endings: Your choices shape the fate of Undercroft and its inhabitants. Will you uncover the truth or succumb to the mysteries that lurk within?

3. Collect Clues: Gather text dialogues scattered throughout the game world to uncover the secrets of Undercroft and unlock new insights into its characters and lore.

4. Immersive Storytelling: Immerse yourself in a rich and atmospheric world filled with intrigue, suspense, and unexpected twists at every turn.

Why Tobor:

  • Engaging Gameplay: Tobor offers a unique blend of exploration, puzzle-solving, and narrative-driven gameplay that will keep you hooked from start to finish.

  • Dynamic Characters: Interact with a diverse cast of characters, each with their own motivations, secrets, and hidden agendas waiting to be uncovered.

  • Stunning Visuals: Experience the haunting beauty of Undercroft through stunning visuals and atmospheric sound design that will draw you into its mysterious depths.

TOBOR is a text-driven interactive fiction set inside real-time surveillance feeds.

Experience Tobor Today:

Join Tobor and unravel the mysteries of Undercroft today. Your adventure awaits!

2081340.name: KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -
2081340.about_the_game:
Mapcrafting x Puzzles x Battle x RPG!?

Repair the fragmented land through puzzles, and rid the world of darkness by defeating monsters. All resources obtained through repairing the land can then be used to design the world to your liking! The medley of genres in this RPG is surprisingly accessible to players of all types, but there's no shortage of challenging elements, too! A variety of activities and a vast world lie ahead. It's up to you to repair what has been destroyed and restore peace.

A Sprawling Overworld

Our adventure takes place in the distant continent of Noahtun, a region rich in land and sea with various seasons. As you move through the overworld, the land will materialize where you advance. What awaits in the untouched regions of the world? New encounters? Battles? Perhaps an instance of fragmentation? Find out for yourself by traveling to every corner of the land.

Puzzles

Restoration Puzzles are a mission exclusive to the Restorer. By clearing the puzzle, the fragmentation of the land is then eliminated, restoring the land to its former state.

"Map-Crafting"

If the land has not been afflicted with fragmentation, it can be developed to have farmland, buildings, and other facilities so you can harvest crops and various resources. As you develop the land, more resources can be obtained and even stores can be accessed. Once a certain number of facilities have been established and the area is enclosed by fences, walls, or gates, it will become a village or town and you can give it a unique name.

Battle

A variety of monsters may appear in the land you explore. They can harm or damage the land they occupy, so be sure to take care of them with the help of your teammates. When battle commences, your teammates will attack automatically. Your role as the Restorer will be to grant Mana to them throughout the battles duration. Through granting them Mana, the skill sets in their weapons will be charged, eventually allowing them to perform an extra powerful attack.

Story

Long ago...

Seemingly out of nowhere, the world suddenly began to fall to pieces, fragmenting into cubes. Amidst the disaster many lives were lost, and spawned from this calamity came natural disasters, decimating all land and water.
The balance of the world was offset, and people's lives were forever changed.

The disastrous phenomenon that reduces the land to cubes, what became known as the "fragmentation",
continued to spread throughout the world with no signs of stopping.

To restore the order of the world, the goddess Chroem selected an individual to fulfill the role of "Restorer", the one who would restore the lands. They were tasked to journey across the world and rebuild all that had been destroyed.

The tale of our Restorer, begins now.
2081340.supported_languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

2081350.name: Summoner Tale
2081350.about_the_game:
A World Divided Monsters and humans once lived as allies, bound together by ancient pacts. That era is over. War has shattered the old bonds, and the truth behind the conflict has been buried. As a young summoner, you'll journey through a world still scarred by betrayal, piecing together what really happened and fighting to restore what was lost.

Four Monster Classes

Four Ways to Fight Every monster belongs to one of four classes, and each one changes how you play:

  • Companions: Follow and fight beside you until their energy runs out.

  • Attackers: Appear briefly to unleash devastating attacks.

  • Supporters: Provide instant support with special skills, then vanish.

  • Enhancers: Give you new mobility options and special enhancements to conquer your journey.

Build a squad that matches your style by mixing classes for different strategies.

Tame Monsters In Many Ways

Earn Their Trust Taming isn't just about winning fights. Each monster has its own trial: battle a fierce challenger, outrun a speedy rival, solve a puzzle, track down rare items, or complete a unique task. Every recruitment feels earned.

Level Up & Evolve

Evolve and Transform Your monsters grow alongside you. Level them through battle and watch them evolve into new, more powerful forms with expanded abilities and a completely transformed look.

Development

Stay updated on Summoner Tale! Fresh content, progress insights, and weekly sneak peeks shared on X @NegmWorldGames Follow along and join the journey!

2081360.name: Humans Are Useless
2081360.about_the_game:
An arcade game based on shooting three types of enemies.
The story is about a gang of aliens from another galaxy that were put to community service, so they will clean the universe from what they think is the worst garbage: humans! Since is just arcade, the story is not that important but we are planning on use the same characters in our next releases!
You have three hearts in the beginning of every play, and after some kills you can obtain some hearts from the enemies. You have an unlimited amount of time and you have to get the highest score possible before losing all your hearts.
There are nine characters (one of them is locked, so you need to unlock them!) in total, everyone has a different and unique skill that you can use to kill enemies in a easier way!

2081390.name: Forbidden myths
2081390.about_the_game:
You are the most ordinary warrior who wants to snatch the prince's daughter from the clutches of Koshchei the immortal, and in order to defeat him, you will have to turn to Baba Yaga and the Cat Bayun for help, but what is the price of their support?


  • The main part of the game is boss fights. Each opponent is a creature of Slavic mythology.
  • Bosses are unique, both gameplay and visual. Among them there are both familiar ones, like Likho or Koshchei, and the iron man present only in Belarusian mythology.
  • One of the features of opponents is the adaptation mechanics. This is an ability that allows the enemy to react to the player's actions. It is present in half of all bosses, and it is unique for everyone.
  • The action movie is a cross between Dark Souls 3 and God of War 2018. There is the usual souls-like endurance and pace of the game, but the counterattack is like in the god of war.


  • It is based on the Slavic religion and a classless system. Several gods are available to you, each of which gives you certain skills.
  • Buying skills - you pump God, learning information about him and getting additional characteristics.
  • Abilities also have customization. If desired, you can sacrifice one skill property for the sake of another.
  • You start playing as a warrior, but, if you wish, you can invest in Semargla (the God of Fire) and become a Pyromancer.
  • Each skill is useful and allows you to change the whole process of combat.
  • Different ways of pumping give a completely new gaming experience.

Unreal Engeen 5 engine.

2081400.name: Gal Guardians: Demon Purge
2081400.about_the_game:
When a demon's castle darkens the land, two sisters challenge its halls.
Together they can break the curse.

In order to save their school after it turns into a massive demonic castle, two "Demon Hunter" sisters slash and shoot their way through this 2D action adventure.
Players can swap between control of both characters on the fly, each with entirely different skillsets. Proceed through the castle while confronting the demonic bosses that await deep within.
Each boss yields new weapons to wield, allowing for more varied exploration and opening up new routes.


■Swap out on the fly as you traverse through the demonic castle!

Take control of both the tag-team Kamizono siblings. Make the most of long-distance focused Shinobu and close-range brawler Maya Kamizono as you make your way through the castle.
Each sibling has a range of unique sub-weapons, giving you a wealth of options to switch your strategy up whenever the time calls for it. Don’t hesitate to make use of them so long as you have Weapon Points in stock!
In the event that one of the siblings falls in battle, they can be resuscitated freely with "Sister Rescue"—provided you can make it back to where they fell.


■Defeat bosses to obtain new sub-weapons, opening up a whole new layer of exploration!

Defeating bosses will yield new sub-weapons, providing the siblings with exciting new abilities.
These sub-weapons also open up new routes and means of exploration in the castles.


■Enjoy the story your way with "Pure" or "Refined" voice tracks!

Gal Guardians' story focuses on two main aspects: the mystery behind the school's transformation, and the whereabouts of the other students.
Enjoy the original experience in "Pure" mode with all of the original Japanese voices for story mode, or choose “Refined” for English voice acting focused on the action, tailored for fans of the genre.


■Adjust the difficulty to your playing needs with the unique Style system!

A total of 3 different styles—"Casual", "Veteran" and "Legend"—are available for selection, allowing players to adjust the difficulty to their needs. This can be changed at any time after beginning the game with no drawbacks.

What's more, co-op with both Shinobu and Maya will be possible should two controllers be available. It's possible to jump-in at any time during the game, so don't hesitate to invite friends along on your journey to conquer this mysterious demonic castle.

You're shown a mix of photos & have to decide if it needs to be removed, according to the strict guidelines the prudish SelfieBook bosses have given you. You’ll see lewd illustrations mixed in with selfies.

2081460.name: Breeze
2081460.about_the_game:
Far away, at the foot of the snowy mountains, there is a village called Ereb. There is a rumor about this village, it says, "devouring everything, there is no return".

A sugar glider detective ignores the advice and goes to the Ereb Village alone. In addition, to finding the truth, she is looking forward to getting someone's clues.

Ask the villagers, get clues and get closer to the truth. But before that, why are all the villagers falling asleep?

Let's find a way to wake up the villagers first. The detective launches a search in Ereb Village.

Short branch, looks like it'll work. Little windmill, why are the blades loose？ Does the round sun blink its eyes just now?

As the villagers wake up, the truth about Ereb Village comes to light. At the same time, the detective's own memory is gradually awakened...










About Mouse

During the game, when you see the mouse cursor change from an "arrow" to a "paw", the area that is currently pointing at is interactive! You can click on this area to pick up items, talk to characters, or get information about the environment.

About Inventory

The inventory has a fantastic "combination" function. Enjoy combining item with environment, item with item, item with character.

About Magic Magnifying Glass

Inside the inventory, the magic magnifying glass is placed in the lower right corner of each item. Click on the magnifying glass to get more details about this item.

About Detail Page

When the mouse is hovering over the item, more information about this item will be displayed. Some items contain interesting puzzles, so make sure you interact with them on the detail page.

2081470.name: Red Matter 2
2081470.about_the_game:
Red Matter 2 is an immersive, puzzle-adventure game that will transport you to the far reaches of space in a dystopian cold war setting. Step into the shoes of Sasha, an agent awakened in a lunar base by an undercover operative and tasked with uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Red Matter. As you journey through the solar system following a trail left behind by someone from Sasha's past, you'll be challenged with mind-bending puzzles, stealth and platforming mechanics, and even intense combat sections. Explore visually stunning Volgravian bases, and experience a spine-chilling atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

About VR Gameplay:

Embark on a journey of discovery and adventure as you explore a fully interactive world designed to enhance the feeling of immersion in virtual reality. Solve environmental, physics, and logic puzzles with the help of your tools, and be awestruck by the beautiful, fully physicalized environments that surround you. Use your jetpack to soar through the skies and move without limits as you traverse platforming sections, and hack into terminals to uncover secrets and clear your path. But be prepared for the unexpected, as Volgravia has taken great measures to protect the secrets you seek. Expect thrilling combat and unexpected encounters as you uncover the mysteries of this fully-realized world. Red Matter 2 is the ultimate VR adventure, and a must-play for anyone looking for a thrilling, immersive experience.

About the PC version:



The PC version of the game features:
  • High-resolution textures
  • Highest polycount mesh is always visible. No mesh lodding.
  • Dynamic shadows
  • Indirect Shadows
  • Valve Index Controllers: If the game detects Valve Index Controllers being used, you will see a custom-made controller in-game.

2081470.reviews:

“Red Matter 2 is a gripping sci-fi experience that blends together satisfying puzzling and beautiful visuals into one mighty fun package. I was constantly in awe of the sights I saw in the game, the puzzles were head-scratching without being frustrating, whilst the narrative kept me intrigued right until the very end. It betters the standard set by the original game in almost every way, with the experience a more varied and meatier one overall.”
9/10 – Use A Potion!

“There have been some great VR games over the years but Red Matter 2 is, simply put, a must-have.”
9/10 – Press Play Media

2081600.name: THE STARFIGHTER
2081600.about_the_game:
INTRODUCING THE STARFIGHTER VIDEO GAME

WHAT IS THE STARFIGHTER?

1. THE STARFIGHTER is a thrilling, fast, big, very 3D, realistic, Full HD and real-time 3D graphics combat arcade game in which you must be a heroic extra-terrestrial starfighter pilot, fly the two-seater Griffin Starfighter with a Radar-Intercept Officer and wipe out the evil robot extra-terrestrial King Nimrod, his buildings, spaceships, submarines, frigates, boats, rocket launcher equipped armored buggies, combat drones, aviation containers, etc. and restore peace to the universe.

2. THE STARFIGHTER video game is 2 games in 1-- it is a 3D combat flight simulator and a 3D space flight (astronautics) simulator.

3. THE STARFIGHTER is a kids' and college students' game.

THE ORIGINAL SPACE STORY IN THE GAME:

You are Paladin, a heroic starfighter pilot who flies the legendary Griffin Starfighter. You are from a fictitious exoplanet called The Hive which is located light-years away from the Earth. The evil King Nimrod and his forces from an undisclosed exoplanet in a galaxy somewhere in the universe are conquering the universe. The leader of The Hive, Queen Crusher, opposes King Nimrod. You and your Radar-Intercept Officer code named Wizard now have to fly in the Griffin Starfighter and restore peace in the universe by vanquishing King Nimrod, all of his forces and all of his assets wherever they may be. The despicable King Nimrod and his forces are mechanical extra-terrestrial (E.T.) lifeforms known as the Raptorbots, while you (Paladin), Wizard and Queen Crusher are insectlike extra-terrestrial (E.T.) lifeforms known as the Hivians.

THE GRIFFIN STARFIGHTER SPECIFICATIONS:

The Griffin Starfighter is a sleek gold colored near-mirror surface finish two-seater in tandem, twin-tail, single rocket engine, extra-terrestrial multirole starfighter with control-canards, and double-delta wings. The Griffin Starfighter can indeed glide in Earth's atmosphere. During spaceflight, the Griffin Starfighter uses an Attitude Determination & Control System (ADCS) to change its attitude. The Griffin Starfighter is equipped with a spaceworthy Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) dual axis multi-beam technology radar which gives its pilot instant situational awareness of the battlespace. The Griffin Starfighter also has Regenerating Shields and a Turbo Speed Thrust Level rocket motor. The Griffin Starfighter's canopy is an all-plastic design. The angled airframe of the Griffin Starfighter also has radar stealth (low observable) characteristics, like the Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptor and the Lockheed F-117 Nighthawk, to deflect radar signals. The design of the Griffin Starfighter is such that it has a low radar signature. Moreover, it is equipped with wingtip mounted High Energy Laser Cannons directed-energy weapon and Fire-And-Forget Missiles. The current Griffin Starfighter models have no flare and chaff dispensers.

THE FIRE-AND-FORGET MISSILES OF THE GRIFFIN STARFIGHTER:

The Griffin Starfighter's Fire-And-Forget Missiles are beyond-visual-range missiles. They have warheads that produce more than 300 pounds penetrating blast fragmentation explosive force. The missiles' engines are solid rocket motors. The fuze type of the missiles is impact fuze.

KEY FEATURES:

· There are 10 massive combat missions for you to fly so that you will never be bored to play the game over and over again.

· THE STARFIGHTER video game is a Full HD video game. It has crisp, real-time 3D graphics and there is a lot of detail in the 3D graphics.

· You can replay a mission whenever you want to.

· There are enemy waves in the game; there is a climactic battle at the end between the villain, King Nimrod, and the hero, Paladin. 

· The space combat in THE STARFIGHTER is visually stunning like in the Star Trek: Picard science fiction/drama TV series.

· THE STARFIGHTER is a smoothe, very pretty, highly realistic and real-time 3D combat arcade game. Being an Epic Games's Unreal Engine 4 made game, you get to fly a winged spaceship through photorealistic skies with moving clouds and be in environments that have winds when you are fighting on Earth. When you are in space you get to fly in a dusty spaceflight environment, fly under light-emitting stars, fly close to 3D revolving planets, large spaceships and 3D orbiting satellites.


- Rendering effects such as emissive color, translucency, etc. are used all throughout the game. There are other unique real-time 3D visual effects/post-process effects used in the game such as explosion flashes, smoke plumes, sparks, lens flare effect, transparent flames, fog, camera shake, real-time reflections, exposure, etc. Experience 3D explosions, 3D smoke, 3D sparks, 3D flying missiles and 3D lasers in real-time in THE STARFIGHTER video game.

- Moreover, real top quality National Aeronautics & Space Administration (NASA) satellite images of the planets in the Solar System were used to make this game.

- The jet exhaust of the Griffin Starfighter is like the real life jet exhaust of a jet fighter.

- THE STARFIGHTER game correctly simulates the missile firing of an U.S. Air Force Thunderbolt II attack aircraft.


- THE STARFIGHTER game correctly simulates the terrain and landscape at Stonehenge in England, the United Kingdom and at a lake, light forest and hills location on Earth.

· Some of the enemies in this video game are Artificial Intelligence (AI) controlled enemies. Therefore, you will have to fly defensively all throughout this game to avoid enemy laser fire and enemy Hydra 70 surface-to-air laser guided missile attacks.

· You can change camera views in this action video game. You can look backwards (Check Your Six), have a Zoom-In camera view and have the Normal (Tail-To-Nose Cone) camera view.

· You can do Stationkeeping (keep your spacecraft in the same orbit as the target spacecraft) like Astronaut Neil Armstrong, chase enemy spaceships that are orbiting planets in deep space and then wipe them out.

· You can fly the Griffin Starfighter in circles around the planets in this video game. Experience what it's like to fly in a spaceship in the eclipse of a planet and what it's like to fly in a spaceship in the Sun.

· You can perform an aileron roll (spinning maneuver), like Padawan Learner Anakin Skywalker does in the Hollywood movie Star Wars: Episode 1-- The Phantom Menace.

· This video game is thrilling, fast and it has non-stop action.

· THE STARFIGHTER has a low FPS (frames per second). The action in the game is smoothe.

· THE STARFIGHTER has an Autolevel Feature which allows you to fly level with the local horizon. This feature is useful when you are flying in space.

· Every time you play THE STARFIGHTER, it will be slightly different from the other times you play THE STARFIGHTER.

· No game manual is necessary to play THE STARFIGHTER because all of the important information is put inside of the game. For example, THE STARFIGHTER has an Enemy Designation Guide which allows you to quickly know your enemy before you fly the Griffin Starfighter.

· As Paladin the heroic starfighter pilot, you get to fly (soar in) an aeroplane looking spaceship in the Earth's atmosphere and also in outer space.

· You can fly the Griffin Starfighter using a gamepad.

· There are clues for you to play this game, and they are found in the Steam Guides in the Community Hub.

· The laser fire of the Griffin Starfighter in THE STARFIGHTER is like the real-life firing of the Rheinmetall Lynx KF41 infantry fighting vehicle.

· THE STARFIGHTER has all original weapons systems design (spaceship design).

· THE STARFIGHTER is an immersive game, with cinema quality sound effects and tunes, 3D sound, rich sound experience, etc. Audio digital signal processing (DSP), audio effects and audio modifiers were used in THE STARFIGHTER. This gives you a first-rate quasi-VR experience.

· THE STARFIGHTER has a pause button like a highend Sony PlayStation 5 game so that you can pause the game while you are playing.

· THE STARFIGHTER has instructions made available in the Main Menu so that you know which gamepad button, keys, etc. to press to play the game successfully.

MORE ABOUT THE STARFIGHTER VIDEO GAME:

This video game is a Linked Missions Action Game. The player must complete each combat mission before advancing to the next one. In each mission the player must destroy all enemy targets. This game has a non-linear option, which means you can start at any of the 10 missions and you don't have to start at first mission (the Stonehenge Mission).

This video game is like Epyx's Blue Lightning for the Atari Lynx, Cinemaware's Wings, Cinemaware's Rocket Ranger, Nintendo's Star Fox, LucasArts's Star Wars: Rogue Squadron, LucasArts's Star Wars: Starfighter, LucasArts's Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter, LucasArts's Star Wars: X-Wing, Electronic Arts's Star Wars Battlefront II, Star Fighter for the Sony PlayStation 1 (PS1), Namco's Air Combat and Sega's After Burner: Climax.

The storyline in THE STARFIGHTER is similar to the storyline in the Starcom: The U.S. Space Force cartoon series which was produced by DIC Animation City.

One similarity between the Star Trek: Picard TV series and THE STARFIGHTER video game is that there is a mission in THE STARFIGHTER in which you (Paladin) fly to Jupiter in the Solar System.

Some elements in THE STARFIGHTER game are the same as in the American TV series Space: Above And Beyond, such as wormholes, extra-terrestrials and exoplanets.

Furthermore, this video game was designed and developed based on the actual Saab JAS 39 Gripen E light single-engine multirole jet fighter, the Saab JAS 39 Gripen E-simulator in the Swedish Air Force Museum (Flygvapenmuseum) in Malmen Airbase in Malmslätt in Sweden.

Fly in a spaceship to the prehistoric monument Stonehenge in England in the United Kingdom on Earth, a rampart fortified airport on Earth, a battleships and submarine defended island on Earth, majestic Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury the fictitious exoplanet known as The Hive, beautiful Neptune and a nearby cigar-shaped asteroid known as 'Oumuamua in this exciting, and very fun winged rocket/aeroplane video game.

THE STARFIGHTER has arcade video game fun in the vein of Blue Lightning, Gates of Zendocon and Toki for the Atari Lynx platform, and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles for the Commodore International Amiga 500 platform, LucasArts's Star Wars: Rogue Squadron on the Nintendo 64 home video game console.

THE STARFIGHTER is a Malaysian Malay made video game.

THE STARFIGHTER is a war game. The battles in this video game are intense, Star Warslike and Star Treklike. The aerial combat in THE STARFIGHTER is like in the movies Top Gun and Top Gun: Maverick.

This video game was created in more than 1 year's time-- it took more than a year in total to make this arcade game.

The gunsight or crosshairs in THE STARFIGHTER does not move. This is unlike Electronic Arts's Star Wars: Battlefront II and Sega's After Burner: Climax.

PLAYING THE GAME:

Game Controllers:

You can use a Wireless/Wired XBox Gamepad/XBox-compatible Gamepad and Mouse & Keyboard to play THE STARFIGHTER.

For Gamepad Control:

Use the Left Thumbstick/Gamepad D-Pad to change the flight direction of the Griffin Starfighter.

Use the Right Thumbstick to speed up or slow down the Griffin Starfighter.

Pressing the Left Trigger fires the Laser Cannons.

Pressing the Right Trigger launches the Missiles.

Pressing the X-Button changes the view to Looking Backwards View. 

Pressing the Y-Button changes the view to Zoom View. 

Pressing the B-Button changes the view to Normal View. 

Pressing the A-Button pauses the game.

For Mouse & Keyboard Control:

To fly the Griffin Starfighter, you must move your Mouse to change the pitch, roll and yaw angles of the spaceship, and press the Spacebar/Control keys on your keyboard to speed up or slow down the spaceship.

You can zoom in to a target by pressing the 2 key on your keyboard. This features helps in the shooting of small targets.

You can look backwards of the Griffin Starfighter by pressing the 1 key on your keyboard. This feature helps you make a judgement if you have destroyed a target that you have flown by or you haven't.

You can pause the game while playing the game by pressing the P key on your keyboard. You can quit the game by clicking on the Quit button with your mouse once you have paused the game.

To shoot the Griffin Starfighter's laser cannons, press the Left Mouse Button.

To launch missiles, press the Right Mouse Button.

In this video game, you must be flying all the time. If you have stopped flying by crashing into an object (such as the ground), you must uncrash yourself so that you are flying again.

You are given 3 lives for each combat mission, and unlimited fire-and-forget missiles. Moreover, there are no power-ups in this video game because the Griffin Starfighter has regenerating shields.

At the start of each combat mission, you will be given orders from the Command Center.

You must destroy King Nimrod, his Runway 34, blast pad, hangars, large parabolic satellite communications (SatCom) antennas, submarines, frigates, boats, water reservoirs, Nimrod Armada Fighters, gigantic Spacecraft Carriers, large Transport Spaceships, gigantic Nimrod Cruisers, brick walls, lightpoles, huge Fletcher Laser-Guided Rocket (LGR) Launcher equipped Armored Buggies, Nimrod unmanned combat aerial systems (NImrod UCAS's), taxibots, large aviation containers, air traffic control tower with weather radar, buildings, etc.

There are lots of enemies both combatant and non-combatant for you to shoot at in this game.

You must also avoid shooting friendly sensors-equipped satellites that are orbiting the planets in LEO.

At the end of each combat mission, except for the Jupiter mission, you are required to fly through a Portal. You have to cause the Portal to materialize in each combat mission. The Portal will materialize when you destroy all enemies and all man-made structures (constructs) in each mission. You will be transported to another location in the universe when you fly the Griffin Starfighter into a Portal. The Portals are Wormholes that transport the Griffin Starfighter and its occupants Astronomical Units (AU's) or megaparsecs from its current position in deep space. You must fly into the Portal to advance to the next stage/mission in the game.

Onscreen, you will find the Griffin Starfighter's Velocity Indicator, Horizon Bar, Pitch Ladder, Heading, Direction Indicator, Vertical Speed, Regenerating Shields Indicator, Gunsight, Enemy/Friendly Targeting Indicator, Current Mission Display, Starfighter Pilot Information Display, Your Score and the Lives Left. This is the Helmet-Mounted Display (HMD) or HUD of the starfighter.

If you are able to vanquish King Nimrod and his forces, you and Wizard will be summoned by Queen Crusher to her Royal Palace on The Hive planet. There Queen Crusher will reward you and Wizard with medals and knighthoods.

To pilot the Griffin Starfighter, you need to have marksmanship skills and good hand-eye coordination. You must aim and then shoot at all enemy targets in the battlespace. Some of the enemies in this game are petite.

In the video game, you can change the attitude of the Griffin Starfighter remotely in the, "3D Viewing Room."

In THE STARFIGHTER video game, you have to be accurate in your aiming of the Griffin Starighter's laser cannons and missiles. If not, the onscreen targets will not be destroyed. Remember that you are always moving in this video game. Due to the fact that you are always moving during missions, THE STARFIGHTER has a video game difficulty level. It is harder to shoot at a target while you are moving than shooting at a target while you are standing still.

Only two outcomes are possible in THE STARFIGHTER game-- either you defeat the evil King Nimrod and his forces or you are destroyed by King Nimrod and his forces.

STRATEGY:

· Put your crosshairs or gunsight on the enemy and fire at will.

· Configure your starfighter's velocity setting and get the aerial attack angle to pulverize your adversary in mid-air.

· Come up with tactics to win every combat mission. There are plenty of missions in the game. 

· Destroy all enemies and all man-made structures (constructs) in the Earth-- The Airport combat mission.

· In all space missions, search and destroy all enemies in the mission.

STATS:

· Approximate Period To Complete All Missions: About 1 hour

· Approximate Period To Complete 1 Mission: Approximately 6 minutes each

DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO BE A HEROIC EXTRA-TERRESTRIAL STARFIGHTER PILOT?

2081610.name: The King's Tournament
2081610.about_the_game:
The King's Tournament is a party game playable with up to 4 players in Online and Local Multiplayer. TKT is a fun party game, with a replacement of the board game phase by transforming it into an intense combat phase where they fight for the throne !!

COMBAT MODE

A dynamic gameplay that replaces the usual board game phase where you will face off against your friends with an arsenal of various bullets. Inflict as much damage as possible to win. Destroy your friends with well-placed cannon balls, create alliances to prevent the first to win by joining forces against him.

MINI-GAMES

Challenge yourself to multiple mini-games in order to win various bonuses from the octopus merchant, and grant yourself powers that can give you victory.

CUSTOMIZATION

Change your appearance with a variety of wacky options and dress up your character as you see fit.



for any request, use our pro mail : Surltekostudio@gmail.com

2081630.name: To Be A King - Volume 1
2081630.about_the_game:
So many choices but only one general - you. Romance one, multiple, or perhaps even all of the fairest ladies in the kingdom! …Or maybe ride solo?



Choose your political allies and enemies, make strategic decisions, and navigate royal politics as you meet the most interesting people in the kingdom.



Help tip the scales in your or someone else`s favor. Who is guilty and who is innocent? Uncover conspiratory plots and use them to your advantage.



Will you command respect or fear?
Intellect and charm or deception and cunning. There are many ways to outplay your opponents and attract the maidens



Take your rightful place on the throne and bask in love or lust. Find your true love or enslave all damsels to endless lustful nights. With over 5800 renders, 36 lewd scenes and 10 love interests you can re-experience the game in multiple ways. The power is yours, the choice is yours.

2081640.name: The Voices Games 3d Collection
2081640.about_the_game:
A collection of 4 small games from The Voices Games

Ayleouna:

A combination of 3d and 2d platforming where you jump between planets and gravity pads with their own gravity in space with twin stick shooting.

Lizard Lady vs The Cats:

Lady in a Leotard With a Gun

Spectrewoods:

2081670.name: CALAMITY CREATURES
2081670.about_the_game:
Abstract
CALAMITY CREATURES is a 2D action game in boss rush format, in which players dismantle giant mechanical creatures. In this game, mechanical creatures of overwhelming stature stand before you.
In order to overcome the desperate gap in strength, you will need to use gadgets in the prosthetic hands, the surrounding terrain, and sometimes even the habits of your enemies.... You will need to make effective use of everything.
Find their weaknesses points and dismantle the living calamity.

Mechanical Creatures
Hostile creatures have a wide variety of characteristics.
They range in size from large animals to skyscrapers, and their habits vary.
To defeat them, you must sometimes perform difficult actions and sometimes use your head.

Various Actions
The character can perform various actions with the gadgets in her prosthetic hand.
A variety of actions are possible, such as clinging to enemies, turning bolts, shooting bows, and ejecting wires.

Others

2081720.name: Epic Hero Game
2081720.about_the_game:
Epic Hero Game is a physics-based roguelite / soulslike where you play as a superhero and its your job to save the world from an alien invasion where the world is getting totally destroyed!

As you fight through enemies, player gets stronger during the fight by absorbing energy of slain monsters

The game uses physics as a backbone for ridiculous anime powerscaling, where you can physically see a difference in the combat, the more stronger you get.

Build your own superhero and fight off against an alien invasion on the world.

Defend the fully destructible map using a variety of skills, moves and abilities.

Avoid the destruction of the Map as best you can however more powerful abilities will be more risky.

Epic Hero game will take you on a vast journey through themed worlds where your new unique abilities will help you defend them all or not....

2081730.name: Vestige Memoria
2081730.about_the_game:
Vestige Memoria is a single player, psychological horror game, in which you play as both the storyteller of a horror-based memory, and then you also play as a hunter, bent on eradicating the spirit that has tormented the survivor. During these, you will unravel deep lore about what has happened in the mansion, and why the spirit has decided to haunt the house. This game will play on paranoia of the player and making them question everything going on in the mansion and throw you into athrill filled adventure.

Immersive: There will be plenty of lore based things to find around, detailing why this has happened and give the player an insight into the world.

Unique Episodic Game: This game will be episodic, with each being a new story told by real life experiences that are taken from the players who have stories to share.

Ghost investigation: Explore the mansion and investigate the history of the spirit. When you are ready, take on the ghost as the hunter, bent on eradicating the spirit from the house.

2081760.name: The Pale
2081760.about_the_game:
The Pale is a tense and atmospheric survival horror, inspired by classic 90s PSX titles.

You play as Arthur, a deadbead dad who's just got the job of the new lighthouse keeper on the Pale, a remote island off the coast of Maine. As the new keeper, Arthur is responsible for upkeeping coastguard property... until he makes a horrific discovery. Now you must fight to keep Arthur alive and survive the horrors of the Island.

The dark history of the Pale is waking up. Can you survive long enough to unlock its secrets?

Game features:

  • Tank controls
  • 3rd person, cinematic camera angles
  • Body horror
  • Multiple endings (choices matter)
  • 4:3 aspect ratio
  • Melee and ranged combat
  • Manual saves
  • Puzzles
  • Karma system
  • Retro PSX era graphics

2081770.name: Northern Kingdoms
2081770.about_the_game:
Northern Kingdoms is an all new strategy city-builder game focused on survival and expansion. Your job is to guide a chosen few citizens in the beginning, to a few thousand later on.

Your kingdom will require resources. Build quarries, mines and forest industries to get resources. Use the resources to either build new buildings, or sell them to other kingdoms for gold. The gold in turn can be used to buy unique items to strengthen your city, or tropical crops to make sure your citizens get a healthy diet.

It is a harsh world, and there are plenty of challenges for your city. Your citizens require food, housing, entertainment and security. There’s also threats from outside the city, from other kingdoms wanting to grab your riches. These kingdoms might act on these interests and send raids to your lands, or they might go another way and try diplomacy.

2081790.name: Cards from the West
2081790.about_the_game:
This game adds a twist to the Rogue-like Deck builder genre by separating the combat in two phases.

In the first phase you will load your revolver with the cards you want to use.

Then, the shooting begins, where you will "shoot" your cards one by one, while the enemy "shoots" back in-between.

Each game takes place in a new unique map where cards battles won't be the only way to progress and upgrade your deck.

You will find duels, where the faster shooter wins!

Saloons were you will find good deals on cards to add to your deck and have a drink to help you recover some health (don't drink too much or you will get dizzy).

And more...

Your goal is to beat the boss at the end of the level to go further into more complicated and fun encounters as your deck of cards evolves.

2081800.name: Khemia
2081800.about_the_game:
Khemia is a 2D puzzle-platformer with a technological medieval fantasy theme where you play Oti, a little kid who mysteriously has been turned into a goat. The game takes place inside the alchemist's tower, yes, the one who turned our little guy into a goat. You will have to jump, kick, dash and ram the enemies who will block your path!

While trying to go up the tower you will find difficulties, as the tower is alive and has the mision to hinder your way up. To avoid it, you will have to set up your own map! Slide, rotate or move the different rooms you find inside the cauldron to get to the orbs. Once you obtain an orb, move around the rooms again to get to the door to the next level.

If an enchanted tower and heavy horns weren't enough, you will have to run for your life while escaping from an evil shadow. Who is that shadow? Will you be able to reach the end with an enemy that will chase you to the end of the world?

THE STORY

A village gripped by fear. A little kid. Alchemy.

Twenty years have passed since the incident. No one talks about it, but everyone knows. Oti is a little kid who lives ignoring the truth, he just wants to help his friend who got hurt, but his momma told him he can do no good by picking flowers in the forest. However, as a little kid he is, he ignores his mother’s words to get what he wants and suddenly… he turns into a goat! The curse is upon him!

To help little Oti get his human body back, you will guide him through the alchemist tower while kicking (literally) the enemies of the room and playing puzzles in a cauldron. This element will help Oti to navigate through different levels the alchemist has prepared, to ensure you escape to the next floor, move around the rooms and get the orb to open the door.

But beware! A shadow will follow Oti to ensure you both fail!


GAME FEATURES

  • 2D Puzzle-platformer with a technological medieval fantasy theme.
  • The cutest protagonist you have ever seen.
  • A not-so-evil antagonist and a shadow who creeps around.
  • Great soundtrack.

2081810.name: Orion's End
2081810.about_the_game:
Orion’s End is a space adventure life sim, with a strong focus on adventure, exploration and forging friendships amongst the stars. After years of dreaming of travelling the spacelanes, you are finally the captain of a small space freighter. You are now free to build your fortune as a law-abiding trader or courier. On the other hand, with a few upgrades your new ship could probably pack quite a punch, so you could clean up the star systems by hunting pirates and reap the bounties available.  Alternatively, you can step outside the law and try smuggling goods or even be a pirate yourself.

However, you won’t want to spend your whole time in space. There are planets to explore, each with their own residents who you can do jobs for or even become best friends with. Some of these people might even have skills that will complement your own, and you might be able to persuade them to join your crew.

How ever you choose to live your life, be it hero, rogue or reputable businessperson, the stars will hold adventures aplenty.

PLANETSIDE

While on the planets or on board the space stations, you can buy and sell commodities, refuel, or repair and upgrade your ship. But there's more to do than that. There are many residents who have their own stories to be explored. You can talk to them, do quests for them, or give them gifts - all of which will progress (or perhaps regress) your relationships with the characters. You might even make a special friend - or maybe even one in every port. It's up to you.

Each settlement has unique activities to undertake and unique stories and locations to discover, giving you an opportunity to have further adventures: old ruins, bandit camps, abandoned mines. You need to learn about these locations through talking to residents, doing quests or exploring the zones outside the space ports.

SPACEWARD HO

Once you first take to space you will be met with a star chart with the core settled worlds. Each one has its own economy and risk level. Warp between systems and traverse the sometimes-dangerous path to the systems space port - which can be either planetside or on a space station if the planet is a less hospitable one. But prepare to defend yourself against pirates, especially in the riskier but more lucrative systems. On the other hand, if you engage in piracy yourself, the local police ships will be only happy to put an end to your illegal activities. Additionally, most systems also have an asteroid belt that needs to be successfully navigated through (never tell me the odds), and can provide some additional income from mining for rare commodities.

 

HOME IS WHERE YOUR SHIP IS

Your ship is your home. You can upgrade some of the systems to get better combat performance, or speed, but it is your only ship. You wouldn't trade it for all the coffee on Ryser. However, you have your living quarters on board, which you can customise to suit your style. Collect various decorations and artefacts, or a new bed. Make your home the comfiest place for you.

ECONOMY

The economy within the system is simple but dynamic. Events beyond your control can have a temporary impact on the prices in a system. A pandemic on one planet may cause an increased demand for medical supplies, while a recession on a high-tech planet could cause cheap prices for their manufactured medical supplies. You can take advantage of the situation and ferry supplies between these two planets. But these conditions are only temporary, so you need to act fast.

THE OUTER REGIONS

The outer regions of each system are worth exploring too, but it is a gamble. You might find valuable resources to mine, or an old wreckage of a cruiser to explore, or a strange but beautiful space oddity that can be scanned for research data to be sold, but be careful, because you could just easily find yourself ambushed by pirates.

CHARACTER CUSTOMISATION

The player character is completely customisable:  facial features, hair, skin colour, clothing, name and pronoun. Their custom portrait appears during dialogue sequences in the game, and the in-game character also displays the changes.

THE PEOPLE YOU MEET

There are two types of people you will meet in the game. Some of them are custom hand designed characters with unique stories to explore. As you get to know them better, and become friends, you will learn more about their stories and help them achieve their goals. You can track your relationship level as it grows.

There are hundreds of other characters to meet though. Using the same character customisation system you used to create your character, these people are also provided with their own unique appearance and name. You can also talk to them, learn about secrets within the world, and become friends with each of them if you choose to. You can track your relationship level with hundreds of characters, each one with their own personal preferences. Some like honest law-abiding travellers, while others like people who aren’t afraid to walk their own shady path. Some like the taste of exotic fruits, while others collect artworks from distant world. You need to uncover what each one of them likes if you are going to win them over.

GAMEPLAY

The gameplay in Orion's End is designed to be very diverse but uncomplicated, incorporating gameplay from retro games but with more modern influences. Shoot 'em up gameplay in space, and shoot outs on planets. Minigames at settlements, and life sim social encounters with the local residents. All of the mechanics are designed to be simple enough to just pick up and play. There's no steep learning curves or complicated systems. There are lots of things to do, but not all of them are necessary to enjoy the game. Do what you enjoy doing most.

THE DEVELOPER

Hi, I’m Dave Stein, the solo developer or Orion’s End. I’ve been working on the game since 2022. The game was initially inspired by classic games from the 80s and 90s and was an attempt to combine various minigames into one cohesive whole. Games like the original Elite, Space Invaders, Spy Hunter, and Berzerk!. Orion’s End began as super low resolution that harked back to retro game consols like the Atari 2600. However, as the game concept grew, my ideas changed and so did the game. It incorporated many other ideas, the resolution of the graphics was upscaled twice and it developed it’s own identity. While I say I’m a solo developer, I must also acknowledge the support and encouragement I’ve received from my family, who have helped me in numerous ways, such as being a sounding board for ideas, providing gameplay testing and providing their own creative ideas that I’ve incorporated into the game and its world.

WHEN WILL IT BE RELEASED?

That’s a tough question, and it doesn’t have an easy answer. However, my current goal is to complete a playable demo and make it available some time in 2025. Stay tuned, and I’ll update you as this gets closer.

Embark on an epic journey in Kathana and immerse yourself in a world brimming with adventure!

Join forces with friends and connect with adventurers from around the globe in this captivating classic MMO. Set out on shared quests, overcome formidable challenges, and experience everything Kathana has to offer.

  • Epic Boss Hunts: Face off against powerful bosses in thrilling encounters.

Are you ready to write your legend in Kathana? The adventure awaits!
