2081970.name: Swirl W@tch
2081970.about_the_game:
Context
Swirl W@tch takes stealth infiltration to a fresh new setting. In the dense atmosphere of Cloud 2, ships can only detect each other by laser light or by listening to engine noises and sonar echoes. The perfect environment for sneaking past security and sabotaging cloud-refineries, as a desperate final attempt to bring down your corporate oppressors.


Action
Play with your prey as you and the guards slip in and out of stealth. Tail ships, intercept communications, set traps and ambush unsuspecting vessels with precision strikes. Or incapacitate and board them to gain intel, funds and captives, to be exchange for new Swirl W@tch members. Counter and exploit complex guard behaviors, all generously telegraphed by your ships predictive tactics AI. Complete different objectives across multiple zones, but always watch your noise circles and lidar profile. Unlike you, CorPo doesn’t take prisoners.


Devices
Gain public support on Cloud 2 by capturing crews and freeing their servants from “mandatory internships” (indentured servitude). Grow the Swirl W@tch movement to unlock new weapons, gadgets, upgrades and ships. Spend your deployment budget on custom loadouts that can include any of the 160+ items you have available, or go in with less equipment and raid production facilities for cheaper, random gear.

2082000.name: WORMWOOD
2082000.about_the_game:
“All that a man could win in the game of plague and life was knowledge and memories.” — Albert Camus.

STORY


Something is not right in the small mining town, lost among the endless frozen wastelands. Play the role of a Lord Arbiter that has arrived from the far away Metropolis, and put an end to the mysterious epidemic.
Give out orders, forge alliances, and conduct your own investigation. What if the inevitable calamity may yet be stopped...?

KEY FEATURES

⠀
  • Shroud Of Mystery:
    Go to a place at the edge of the world, and acquiant yourself with its peculiar inhabitants and traditions. Investigate the cause of the epidemic, research dark mysteries and reveal ancient secrets.

  • Advanced Strategy:
    Balance on a knife's edge bewteen life and death. Make strategic decisions that can benefit you in the long run or lead to a catastrophe.

  • Difficult Choices:
    Give out orders that doom hundreds, but save thousands. Persuade the infected to follow quarantine measures or just burn down their homes while they're inside.

  • Charismatic Characters:
    Build relationships with your four advisors. Make loyal friends or spiteful rivals that could betray you at any moment.

  • Branching Plot:
    Be cruel, or be charitable. Let your duty guide you, or show sympathy in secret. Which ending you get depends solely on your actions.

A former military man, he volunteers at a biotechnology clinic, where he experiments with human DNA, but the truth is that these experiments have bizarre and obscure purposes. After waking up from a long coma, he finds himself in the middle of a totally different place from which he entered.

This is just the beginning of a battle to survive from bloodthirsty creatures and escape this damn place.

▇ Be fast and attentive! Creatures don't give you a second chance.

▇ Save your ammo or you won't have enough...

▇ Find the access items to proceed.

▇ Discover the terrifying truth of this shocking thriller.

2082060.name: My Furry Stepmom 🐾
2082060.about_the_game:
My Furry Stepmom is another short novel in the "My Furry" series, telling the story of a guy who works as an actor. One day, he is offered a role in an unusual movie where he has to play the part of a stepson. He agrees, and on set, he meets a girl named Mila, who plays his stepmom. You cannot control other NPCs, however you can assign them jobs and give them orders and dress them however you want. You play the leader of a tribe and if they should die before naming an heir you can select an NPC to play.

A year in game is about three hours of play time so you have plenty of time to develop your characters. As your legacy continues, you pass on traits through your genealogy and through training. In Legacy you live as the king or queen in your kingdom. You make the rules and your citizens do your bidding. As more options get added your control will span across the people through laws, edicts and even through judgements made. Exploration, city building, character development, combat and diplomacy how you play is how you build your legacy.

In time as your kingdom grows you will discover fascinating places in your land. You can train your troops, outfit them it the best gear you have and set out for adventure with dreams of great spoils and better gear. Losing people in battle however, can have devastating consequences. A good soldier might take days to condition and train.

Similar to other RPGs you need to make or loot better and better gear to take on bigger bosses. Some bosses require you to have help. So you will need to gear out your citizens and build an army. Although multiplayer is intended down the road, early on you'll be building raiding parties to lead into battle.

This game is being made available in the pre-alpha stage for you who like the medieval city building genre so you can enjoy the game as it progresses at a lower price than the finished version. Each major update will be adding more buildings, gameplay, races, mobs and bosses.

As the game develops past the initial release of version 1.0, updates will bring more expansions to the Legacy universe. The overall idea is to have a game where you start with a few people in the stone age and advance them all the way into a futuristic space age. Along with free updates we also plan to release DLC packs that offer different styles and types of objects that will appeal to different genres.

2082570.name: SCP - Containment Breach Reborn
2082570.about_the_game:
Introduction

SCP - Containment Breach Reborn is an explanation focused horror game with lite survival elements. You assume the role of a class-d personnel trapped by the SCP Foundation. Lacking weaponry, you must employ stealth, problem solving, and quick thinking to make it out alive. The facility houses an array of deadly and uneartly entites known as SCPs. These entities wield powers ranging from reality-bending abilities, to sheer physical destruction, to minor quirks of nature. The ultimate objective is to escape the facility and reach the surface, facing increasingly seemingly insurmountable challenges for any normal human being, and the ever-present threat of SCPs, and those who wish to silence you. This game is a brand new ground-up reimagining of the classic game "SCP - Containment Breach" released in 2012 by Regalis.

Story

Set in 1998, the Foundation is under more strain than ever. Unable to hold up against the constant attacks from a splinter group, the experimental Modular Site Project has been fast-tracked. This site picked for it? 19, a remote research complex primarily dedicated to the study and organisation of SCP data and analityics. The number of specimins being shipped in and the amount of staff displacement are too much, however, and on the morning of the 17th of May, 1998, all hell breaks loose.

Gameplay

SCP - Containment Breach Reborn unfolds within the SCP Foundation facility, currently only featuring a single zone. Your goal is to reach the exit and escape the facility alive, whilst getting past any barriers you may face along the way.

Gameplay mechanics encompass exploration, puzzle-solving, and stealth. Players interact with various objects and structures within the facility, including buttons, gates, and keycards, in order to progress through each zone. Players can also pick up and inspect various items for clues and facility-related information. Inventory management has been refined, featuring a reduced number of slots and a dedicated documents slot or clipboard for efficient organization.

Primary Mechanics

SCP - Containment Breach Reborn is a horror exploration game. The player must navigate through the various zones of the SCP Foundation facility, using a variety of tools and mechanics to survive and achieve their ultimate goal of escape. The following mechanics will be included in the game:

  • Inventory Management: You will have a limited inventory space, with slots dedicated to documents and utility items.

  • Object Interaction: Players will be able to interact with objects in the environment, such as doors, gates, buttons, and items they can pick up and examine.

  • Stealth Mechanics: SCP - Containment Breach Reborn will feature a stealth element, where players must avoid the hostile SCPs or face serious consequences. This creates a sense of tension and danger as you move through the facility, requiring you to be mindful of their actions and surroundings.

  • Puzzle Solving: While SCP - Containment Breach Reborn is primarily a horror exploration game, there will be various puzzles for you to solve along the way. These puzzles will require you to use your problem-solving skills to progress. The puzzles will be designed to be challenging, but not overly difficult, allowing you to focus on the story and progression without halting the game entirely.

SCP Types

The following is a breakdown of the different types of SCPs that you may encounter in SCP - Containment Breach Reborn:

  • Interactable SCPs: These SCPs serve primarily as objects to interact with. They may provide clues, information, or puzzles to solve, but they do not pose a direct threat to the player.

  • Full Experience SCPs: These SCPs are full-fledged experiences, providing unique gameplay scenarios and challenges. They may be more difficult to evade or overcome than other SCPs, but they offer a deeper and more engaging experience for those who are interested.

  • Quests: These SCPs are secondary objectives within the game, often requiring the you to undertake tasks or solve puzzles in order to progress. They may be linked to other SCPs, or exist as standalone experiences.

  • Roaming Threats: These SCPs are unpredictable and often hostile, roaming the zones and presenting a threat to you. They may be neutralized by certain items or mechanics, or simply avoided.

  • Neutral Threats: These SCPs are neutral, not actively pursuing or attacking the player, but still dangerous if provoked. They may have specific requirements or triggers that cause them to become hostile, and the player must learn how to avoid these triggers in order to avoid danger.

2082580.name: Come Together
2082580.about_the_game:
Dive into the adventure of 2 squares! Help Blue and Pink find each other in the world of Come Together. Find the right path or solve the puzzle and make players meet! Keep track of each square and don't let things get out of control.

Features

  • 5 unique Stages and 40 hand-crafted levels are available to you in Early Access: explore a vast variety of atmospheric locations and overcome different challenges.
  • Lots of game mechanics: unlock new ones as you progress, use your knowledge to lead your way to success.
  • Collectable items and valuables: make new Inventory entries and put them to a good use.
  • NPCs and side quests: meet new friends, trade for resources and help locals to get cool rewards.
  • 3 game modes are available to you in Early Access: it's not just about changing the playfield, it's the complete overhaul of your playstyle.
  • Co-op: grab a friend and enjoy the game together. Control two players as a united force.
  • Level Editor & Custom Levels: build your own levels and play community-made ones.



It's not just about solving puzzle levels. The game is filled with dialogues, interactions and other listed features, including different challenges and difficult mechanics that will put your skills and precision to the test.



Who said that all the game modes have to be based around one specific rule or theme? New game mode = new game! Just imagine a situation where you’ve been playing a simple puzzle level with 4-directional movement, and the next second you are in the Platformer with big constructions and moving platforms, or even in a remake of a popular mobile title.

2082620.name: Loot Express Delivery Service
2082620.about_the_game:
A Brief Introduction


In Loot Express Delivery Service, a top-down 2D pixel art game, you will take on the role of a commander tasked with capturing valuable items from an alien planet. As the founder of your own company, you will lead a team of mercenaries and utilize drones to deploy turrets, rocket launchers, and other equipment to complete your missions. However, be sure to keep an eye on your expenses as everything comes with a cost.

Gameplay


As you begin the game, you will start with a small team and give commands to the different team members. There are a total of 3 unit types at your disposal.

The Team

Meet the Commander, the fearless leader of your team.
He gives orders and guides to success, but doesn't fight on front lines. He carries a rifle as a symbol of his authority. With experience and a sharp mind, he holds the team together. Calm under pressure, he makes clear decisions that impact the mission's success. He's the key to victory.



The Worker, a crucial member of the team.
Follows Commander's orders, versatile with skills like building, starting fires, and combat. Resourceful and dedicated, he's a valuable asset. Not a leader but still crucial for mission success with his hardworking attitude.




Introducing the Soldier, a brave defender of the team.
Following the Commander's orders, the Soldier protects the team and their surroundings with weapons at the ready. Fearless in combat, the Soldier is a vital asset to the team, always on the front line to ensure their safety. With unwavering dedication and loyalty, the Soldier is essential in the team's journey to success on this dangerous planet.




The Scientist, a smart and crucial team member.
Figures out puzzles and unravels mysteries. Weak and needs protection, but a brave explorer. Only one who can do research, crucial to mission success. Valuable with his intellect and dedication, a key player in the journey to success.




Additionally, you can use drones to deliver equipment such as turrets, rocket launchers, and mobile lamps for defending your base or providing support in the field. Explore the environment, establish a secure base, locate valuable items, and complete your mission.

2082650.name: Dodge Mania
2082650.about_the_game:
Dodge Mania is a simple game made by Unity.
You will control different charracters in different levels and your goal is to dodge objects falling to you.
This game will test your reactions , dodging ability and quick thinking.
while first two levels are just about dodging nexrt levels have mechanics such as collecting potions or flying enemy chasing you.

2082690.name: The Human Story
2082690.about_the_game:
Explore miniature worlds depicting different cultures throughout human history:



Find characters, objects and stories about our ancestors and learn about their lives:



Unlock new worlds and progress through time:





The Human Story is a relaxing, colorful hidden object game in which you explore historically accurate miniature worlds. The game is capturing a big picture view of how human societies and cultures evolved over time from the very first humans in the Old Stone Age until the present day.

I am a solo dev with a big curiosity for history and creating this game is my way of making sense of the world we are living in today.

In the first release I am focusing on the Old Stone Age, the New Stone Age and the Bronze Age. Later ages will come with future updates.

欢迎加入我们查阅MONA百科全书！官方QQ群：816557926

几百年后的地球是什么样的景象？仿生科技的发达让地球成为了人类和仿生人共同的家园，这些科技产物的的制造初衷便是永远地服从于人类。

平凡的女高中生MONA和妈妈、姐姐生活在一起，妈妈是WHW的科学家，姐姐也是隶属旗下的执法者。
姐姐的失踪打破了MONA平静的生活，由于某些原因，她接替了姐姐的工作......

游戏特色
通过进行各种实战，提升自己的能力。你需要在这座危险的大楼中穿梭，进入各个门收集此次行动的目标机密。

除了敌人，这里还存在着更多隐藏的危险，快速移动的压力锤、监视楼内动向的飞行器......请务必保证自己的安全！

2082720.name: Quick Pleasure
2082720.about_the_game:
When you need it, right here, right now! Experience a woman's day of dirty public pleasure in this fully animated and voiced ASMR Visual Novel experience.

Quick Pleasure is a fully animated and voiced ASMR erotic adventure. Sit back, relax and progress through a linear story and immerse yourself with all your senses. Please use headphones for the perfect experience!

2082730.name: Empire of Empires
2082730.about_the_game:
Have you ever thought about what it's like to defend your territories from enemies?

Start building your own empire right now. As the King of the Castle, you will be respected among the shores, using towers and barrack to keep others in fear.
By expanding your territory, you will gain a reputation and you will have every chance to become a true king just like Arthur. Put your tactics in motion and be ready for enemies from everywhere! Your mission is to expand your empire as much as possible and to resist as much as possible!

Game features :
- Upgrades, coins & much more upgradable items
- Expand your empire limits
- Day/night system & fast time

2082790.name: A Town Called Happenstance
2082790.about_the_game:
Where to start my story? A simple Missing Person case, I thought. I’ve solved a hundred of them. Why should this one be any different? If only I had known how wrong I was, known how high the stakes were and how the fate of every man, woman and child would rest on my actions.

Sure, I thought I had seen it all in my time–betrayals and revelations, signs and wonders!. When you have been doing this as long as I have, you learn to roll with the punches, expect the unexpected. At my age, I didn’t think it was possible to surprise me anymore. Nothing new under the sun and all that.

I could have walked away. When I started to suspect who was involved and what it would mean, I could have bowed out. Saving the world is a young man’s game and I’ve already paid my dues. The “30 Years Meritorious Service” medal I have in my sock drawer says so. I should just let this one go.

But the truths and lies I have uncovered in the last few days have opened my eyes to something sinister. Something evil lurking just below the surface in this town I love, this town I thought I knew.
This town called Happenstance.



A Town Called Happenstance is a (fairly) traditional point and click adventure, in a stunning cel-shaded style and built in Unreal Engine. Set in a fully 3D world, with a traditional side on fixed camera view, you'll play an adventure in a way like never before!



Join the world's premier septuagenarian freelance detective as he uncovers a conspiracy that goes all the way to the top!

Oh, one last thing before you start; Carter is well aware that he's inside an indie game, and he's not at all happy about it. Not one bit.

A Town Called Happenstance also includes a Monochrome mode:





- Solve puzzles, riddles, and conundrums
- Unique 'point & drag' control style.
- Beautiful Cel-shaded graphics
- Monochrome mode
- Huge cast of memorable characters
- Even huger list of places to explore.
-Even hugerer stack of items to discover, pickup and combine.
- Original soundtrack music
- Some things might be funny, IDK.
- No deaths, no surprise game overs. It's you against the machine.

2082840.name: Jasper and the City of Lights
2082840.about_the_game:
On summer vacation Jasper and Nora were separated, when one of them carelessly decided to enter the forbidden forest in front of their grandparents farm all alone.

Jasper, Nora's young brother, gathers courage when he sees a star falling out of the night sky and takes on the quest to find and bring back his beloved sister and reunite the family.

Features

Survive the Cold!

Something is going on in the depth of the old forest in front of grandma Sophies farm: Snow and ice, in the middle of summer?

Don't venture too deep into the icy cold of the whispering forest or you will join the freezing souls of Myr!

Bring the World to Life!

A shooting star crashes inside the very forest where Jasper's big sister is thought to be missing. Where will it guide Jasper?

Light up candles and lanterns and experience the forest coming back to life!

Complete your Collection!

Document the mystical nature of the forest and its inhabitants and present your findings at the Library of Myr.

Find Nora’s treasures and other collectables and showcase them back at the Narrator’s home.

Collect Soul Dust to strengthen Jasper's fallen star and increase your power!

Make Friends!

At first glance only the whispering masks live within the shadows of the woods.

But wait, is that light in the distance? The deeper you go, the more you will learn about a civilization that only a few people ever got to tell stories about.

Reveal the Mystery!

Ice and snow in the middle of the summer. The stars are falling out of the sky. Whispering masks lurk in the shadows. The lights of a city on the horizon. And a name that makes the people of Myr shudder: Svangur

Stay Warm <3

Many cozy features are coming to Jasper. This is a game that can be explored in your own pace. We do try to invite you to stay for a while and enjoy the atmosphere. Wholesome features that are planned for the future include:

  • Jasper’s analog camera

  • A library that you can upgrade and fill with knowledge

  • Fishing

  • (Soul flower gardening?)

  • (Just sitting down near a warm candle and taking a break from the long journey?)

  • ???

About

We started working on Jasper with a vision of what we would love to play, today we are proud and happy about what we created.

After we worked so long on Jasper, it's sometimes hard for us to keep focus on what matters. For us this is not just a game we love to play anymore but a passion project that we poured our heart into and at this point we constantly get lost in little details.

So for the next step we are moving to a community-driven approach. We need to continue work on this openly and with your opinions, wishes and criticism!

If you are into games that are fully about immersing yourself into mystical worlds, cultures and heartwarming stories, please join us on this journey. Jasper is our framework to build a world about love, kindness and slowing down.

Join us on the Weasel Club Discord to discuss with us about the City of Myr that is hidden within the Whispering Forest.

2082860.name: Hue Hills
2082860.about_the_game:
Let your imagination run wild and 3D paint an infinitely generated world or challenge your friends in guessing or strategy games.

Alone or with friends, choose from the three game modes that Hue Hills offers:
  • 3D Draw

    Roam around an infinitely generated world and shape it the way you like. You can choose from a variety of colors for every line. Use flying mode for a more accurate design. Give your lines colliders or walk right through them!

  • Guess Draw

    Challenge your friends to a draw guessing battle. Each player gets to chose their own word and has 1 minute to show off their drawing skills! The chat is where everyone takes their guess. Be quick! The earlier you answer correctly the more points you get!

  • Paper Soccer

    This strategy game will put your brain to a challenge up against your friends. Take your time and think at every step! Each move could lead you to either victory or loss.

2082880.name: Neural construct
2082880.about_the_game:
Neural construct is a 2-4 player educational online party game that allows you to construct a neural network (AI) that you can change and customize to compete with other players.

Gameplay :
  • Try to construct a neural network with the resources and intel that you have.
  • Try to accomplish the given task to gain points.
  • Sabotage the other players.
  • Adapt quickly!
  • Win by completing your given task and having the most points.

2082900.name: Star Devil
2082900.about_the_game:
Star Devil is a Sci-fi Station Survival Roguelike Game with dynamic alien infection.
Playable in both single-player and split-screen co-op.



In Star Devil you will try to escape an increasingly alien infected space station.
To escape you will need to pass through the various different levels of the space station.

Fast and Deadly combat


You need to master your weapons and stay focused.
Because one hit can mean your doom, so keep moving.

Procedural generated space station


Procedurally generated space station to keep each playthrough fresh.

Dynamic alien infestation


Escaping the space station is not an easy feat. The space station will get more and more infected by the aliens the longer you spend roaming it.
You can counter this by eliminating the aliens and their eggs to slow down the infestation.

But you can only slow down the infestation, not stop it. So be swift because otherwise the aliens will corner you fast.

Single-player or Split-screen Co-Op


Playable in both single-player and split-screen co-op.
You need at least one controller to play split-screen co-op.

2082940.name: Swords and Sorcery - Sovereign
2082940.about_the_game:
Swords and Sorcery - Sovereign is the sequel to Underworld, a party-based, first person view role-playing game with turn-based combat and a square grid 3D environment. The art was made by a professional comics illustrator.

Abstract yet deeply tactical combat, with distance and timing management. Your characters can evade or enter the melee, wait and take their turn a little later, hide, order the group forward or back. Many combat options will depend on positionning choices you make.

Characters will develop a variety of abilities and strengths that depend on their class. Ambidextria, Powerhouse, Taunt, Bleed, Assassinate...

80 spells (Priest and Sorcerer, outdoor and indoor, combat and non-combat).

Over 200 hand-drawn enemies, many with a variety of special abilities and spells.

hundreds of items, many with magical or otherwise valuable properties.

Dozens of towns to discover and travel back to for food, equipment, healing, and other services offered by NPCs..

Many unique NPCs that will offer quests, help your party gain in strength, guide you or deceive you.

Traps, puzzles, slides and teleports add a variety of non-combat challenges. Puzzles are largely integrated in your interaction with the game world.

Large, seamless overworld.

Dozens of fullscreen story illustrations.

Find books to read that contain clues for quests and flesh out the backstory.

A bestiary allows you to collect notes on monsters containing clues for quests and occasional indications as to how to defeat the monster described.

2082950.name: Hansel And Gretel
2082950.about_the_game:
Play as Hansel And Gretel in a puzzle-adventure game based on the fairy tale by the brothers Grimm.

Key Features:
- Play Single-player or Local Multiplayer.
- Unique puzzles.
- Classic-Inspired Pixel Graphics.
- More than 40 types of items.
- Hidden Secrets & Magical creatures.
- Enjoy beautiful soundtracks.
- The game is about 1 hour long.

2082960.name: Freed Software
2082960.about_the_game:
Free Soft is a simulator in which you have to create your own IT company. In this world, you will have to compete with other IT companies for a marketplace in the software industry. Create your own companies, become a leader in the field of IT.

You will have to:
Start your own IT company.
Collect a lot of items.
Create and improve software.
Build and develop your own office.
Hire employees and build teams.

2082980.name: Persist Online
2082980.about_the_game:
SOME SURVIVE. THE BEST PERSIST!


Persist Online is an MMORPG with zombies, so you better grab yourself a gun. Level up in an unforgiving open world where you can enter every building. Form a deadly team with friends to claim what’s not yours. Take your loot to the Safehouse and craft perfect gear. Some survive. The best persist!

FACE HORDES OF ZOMBIES AND RIVAL PLAYERS


Join forces with other survivors to keep the zombies at bay and take on mutated bosses in an open world that gets deadlier the farther you go. Beware of other players looking to relieve you of your hard-earned loot on the way to safety. Form a guild and conquer strategic sectors on the map to stockpile resources faster. Survive in a living world full of the undead!

WIELD FIREARMS AND MELEE WEAPONS


Unlike in fantasy MMORPGs, waving a magic wand won’t help you in Persist Online. Instead, you can choose from a variety of firearms. However – even though going in guns blazing is fun, be aware that zombies and mutants are drawn to loud noise. By bashing zombies with a hammer you might live to see another day, which is a smart move in any apocalypse.

EXPERIENCE A TRUE HARDCORE GAME


The company behind Persist Online operates one of the longest-running MMORPGs ever: Tibia, released in 1997. True to that legacy, Persist Online is a tough old-school experience. You can lose everything you’ve looted, so be careful when someone seems a little too friendly. Or let your best shotgun do the talking and walk away with their loot instead.

CRAFT WEAPONS AND ARMOR


Sure, you can fight your way through hordes of zombies to find a rifle that rolled with exactly the right mods. Or you could craft one from scratch and forge it into a gun that perfectly fits your playstyle. To unlock the full potential of its mods, you’ll of course have to leave the Safehouse and kill plenty of undead – only now, you’re doing it with your new favorite weapon.

BUILD PERFECT CHARS AND TEAMS


There are no classes in Persist Online. Just play your character however you want, and invest the points you earn in one of the many available skill trees. For example, progressing in Mechanics not only lets you dismantle washing machines more efficiently. It also lets you place a distracting robot and use it to save teammates who didn’t level as cleverly as you did.

PERSIST IN A DYNAMIC OPEN WORLD


Explore an open world that’s not only grand in scale but also big on details. Every building can be entered, but it might become a deadly trap. Since the post-apocalypse isn’t all sunshine, expect dynamic weather and a meaningful day-night cycle. Nothing is stopping you from riding into the sunset – except for everything in this world that wants to kill you.

2082990.name: The One Penny Adventure
2082990.about_the_game:
You start the game with one penny, you have to find the person who is interested in trading your penny for anything more valuable then the penny for example a Pen, then sell the pen for a Coin, then buy a water bottle with that and sell it double the price, continue the cycle until you have enough money to afford the plane ticket to the next city,
You also have side quests like walking the Dog, collecting plastic trash and selling it, finding golf balls and starting a bid and food deliveries, Once you buy or rent any of the vehicle, You start getting food delivery orders. 2083000.name: My Newspaper
2083000.about_the_game:
About this game

Before you buy your first place to grow your business, you have to work hard for it. But don't worry, you already have all the necessary tools for the job in your apartment, because you have completed a certain journalism project for which they were needed. As you develop your career path, you will be moving to larger and larger offices that you need to clean and renovate first, and then hire employees with the appropriate qualifications to help you expand your business and earn more money for yourself. Remember to be careful when publishing your articles about individuals around the world, because in the future, positive or negative relationships with those individuals can bring both advantages and disadvantages.


Play your way

It is YOU who choose your career path and YOU decide what direction it will take. When building articles, you can choose the type of your statement, whether it will be negative or positive, everything depends on you. Be sure to publish your newspapers wisely as they may have different results in the future.


Build your empire

With the right amount of money, you will be able to move to your new dream office, which you first need to clean up and renovate to be able to start working there properly and hire your employees.




Think, then do

Try to work smart, not hard. Leave trivial and easy articles for your employees to work on, and choose the heavy ones, which can directly and strongly affect your career and opinion in the world, for yourself. Remember that the chosen path has given perks, so think twice which direction you will choose. In one, you have a chance to earn more money, and in the other, fans, while the decision is up to you and your preferences, which in your opinion is more important and has greater potential.


Rest

Later in the game, rest will become your job, so you can focus on other activities. Employed employees will start making various articles for you, and thanks to this, you will have free time for yourself, which you can spend on managing the company, developing it with new opportunities, or leaving time for rest or entertainment, which will make your time spent more pleasant.

2083010.name: Another World Quest
2083010.about_the_game:
Build Your Deck


At the beginning of the game you need to choose one of the three camps to build a powerful deck (a deck must be full of 30 cards before it can be used).
The three camps represent three different ideas of card sets, three leaders, and three different traverser paths.
Players can freely choose to use cards from the camps or neutral cards depending on the effects of the cards.
【Wolfraid Clan】A fast attack deck consisting of a large number of cheap, high-quality creatures and spells that deal direct damage.
【Church of the Holy Blood】A midrange deck that focuses on strengthening the attack and defense of quality creatures, specializing in group enhancement spells.
【Aurora Fleet】 A fast summoning high cost creatures through creature acceleration or spell acceleration.
The remaining four camps will be unlocked as the plot progresses.

Enhance and fight


Each time you get a victory you get gold and pieces. Gold can be used to buy supplement packs in the store to enhance your deck.
Shards can be used to generate the cards you need directly, or you can get shards by destroying cards you don't need.
Even if you fail, you can still get a lot of Coin.
Try to build a powerful deck!

Tales from the traveler


The continent of Fran is a land of perennial comet falls.
These comets bring powerful magical power to enhance the monster, resulting in the human living in this land suffered the end of the disaster.
At the same time, the comet also has the energy to open the portal. Many travellers were thus transported to this other world.
Of course, the portal can not only transport travellers, but also transport those other world's frightening monster ......
As a traveler, you will choose to lead the people back to the original world? Or stay and build the other world? ...... or use the power of the comet to rule the world?

2083030.name: The Sheriff
2083030.about_the_game:
In a small lost village in the Far West, the Sheriff is on the alert! An unknown outlaw is committing crimes at different locations in the city. Who could it be? Will the Sheriff be able to catch him before all the villagers pass by?

Compete against a friend and play as the Sheriff and the Outlaw respectively in various matches. At each game, choose a new power to add some diversity to the game !

The Outlaw

Take on the appearance of a simple villager and reach your targets without being spotted by the Sheriff. Once the objective is reached, try the ultimate jackpot, and kill the Sheriff without him realizing it!

The Sheriff

Open your eyes and ears, the outlaw is somewhere in town. Monitor the behavior of the villagers and react as fast as possible when an incident occurs to catch the criminal! But be careful, it could be anyone...

Multiples powers

Each round, choose 1 power out of 3 to make each game unique. Each player has a total of more than 10 powers to make a hundred of unique different game. Use smoke bombs, get the vision of animals or even place decoys on the ground to mislead your opponent... It's up to you to understand as quickly as possible which power your opponent has chosen!

2083060.name: Furry Femmes: Making an Obedient Bitch
2083060.about_the_game:
Furry Femmes: Making an Obedient Bitch is a fascinating visual novel from the creators of the "Stories of Submission" series. Dive deep into a truly fantastic kinky story of love, passion, jealousy and submission.

Summary



Kara was always the girl of Mike's dreams: beautiful, smart and ambitious.

She moved away to go to university, but Mike was convinced they were destined to be together and followed in her footsteps.
Years have passed and now they work together in Kara's laboratory where she wants to splice animal DNA into humans to start the next step in human evolution. Unfortunately, they're no closer to succeeding in their research and Mike is no closer to seducing Kara.

With the looming threat of bankruptcy and complete failure, Kara decides to accept the aid of Kevin, a scientist who has been attempting similar research abroad. He claims to have the missing piece of the puzzle that will allow Kara and Mike to succeed; not to mention an anonymous sponsor who will fund the project. Who is Kevin Sanders really? What is the mysterious sponsor hoping to achieve by funding this research? What will happen to Kara when she becomes the first test subject?

As their research takes several unexpected turns, Mike will be confronted with the answers to these questions and more.

Ultimately, he'll have to answer the most important question of all: what kind of person is he willing to become to get what he wants?

Features



■ A fantastical story about science gone crazy.
■ A main character who's a hopeless romantic, pervert and socially awkward loser struggling to get the girl of his dreams.
■ A female lead who goes from a cold, cruel, professional scientist to a wild, insatiable doggirl.
■ Numerous sex scenes with gorgeous art, featuring both human and furry Kara.

2083100.name: Megafortress Collection
2083100.about_the_game:
Take to the skies for gripping air-assault missions with the Megafortress Collection. This complete package includes the original 1991 DOS classic Megafortress, the Operation Sledgehammer and Operation Skymaster expansions, and the Mission Editor for Operation Skymaster.

The Megafortress is a radically modified B-52 bomber with advanced stealth capabilities and enough firepower to destroy heavily fortified enemy installations. It’s a huge, complex aircraft that demands attention to a dizzying array of tasks. The original Manual and a new Quick Start Guide are included with this release of the game to aid those who would seek to master control of this devastating aircraft, precisely simulated by the visionary developers of Artech Studios.

Assume multiple roles, including Pilot, Navigator, Electronic Warfare Officer, and Offensive Weapons Officer as you conduct air assaults on historic battlefronts around the world.

The first expansion, Operation Sledgehammer, adds 25 new missions in Iran and Libya, with new enemy targets including terrorist training camps, port facilities, submarines, nuclear research facilities and more. It also adds new SAMs to enemy weaponry and new ordnance to the Megafortress such as the CBU-95 FAE and Penguin MK 3 anti-ship missiles.

The second expansion, Operation Skymaster, includes 21 missions in the Korean peninsula and the Philippines, with new targets such as Chinese amphibious vessels and North Korean fat attack craft flotillas. New enemy tactical aircraft and defenses also appear, such as the Chinese HQ-61 SAM system. It also includes the ultimate challenge campaign in Dragonslayer, where the Megafortress must take down a North Korean nuclear doomsday device.

  • Includes the original Megafortress game and two expansions, Operation Sledgehammer and Operation Skymaster
  • Fly missions in locations such as Iraq, the USSR, Iran, Libya, the Korean peninsula, the Philippines, and the USAF training area in Nevada
  • Fight your way past enemy defenses as you view the action from multiple camera angles
  • Helm the ship safely through enemy skies as the Pilot
  • Plot your course with the onboard 3D terrain mapping computer as the Navigator
  • Hunt for threats and jam enemy radar as the Electronic Warfare Officer
  • Acquire enemy targets with infrared imaging, then fire your payload at will as the Offensive Weapons Offices
  • Customize the challenge with the Mission Editor for Operation Skymaster

2083120.name: Car Jump Challenge
2083120.about_the_game:
Jump over various obstacles to reach the finish line.
There are many challenging levels waiting for you.
Activate platform triggers to complete levels.

KEY FEATURES

Disfigure is entirely free to play for the time being, so please consider supporting us through the donation DLC!

Gameplay

In an arena shrouded in darkness, pay close attention to your surroundings—monsters could be lurking anywhere. Swap between Circle and Cone Vision modes: one lets you see around but not far, while the other lets you see far in one direction. Fight escalating horrors, level up, and survive!

Build Variety

Choose from over 200 upgrades and 100+ weapon perks to create limitless build possibilities. Shoot lightning, fire thousands of bullets—every upgrade tree changes the way you play. Control your vision sources: will you sacrifice visibility for strength, or harness light to destroy your enemies?

2083180.name: Cat Herder
2083180.about_the_game:
Cat Herder is a cute and chaotic little puzzle game about literally herding cats! Pick them up, entice them with toys, and learn their preferences as you wrangle them into the target zones as quickly as possible.

Toys, Toys, Toys

From laser pointers to bouncing balls, from cat treats to catnip, use a variety of toys to guide your feline friends and keep them in check! Each type of toy has its own unique interactions and effects, so use them wisely.

Varied Homes and Levels

Your services as a cat herder are in high demand! Solve forty different puzzles across four different homes, some with their own unique environmental challenges.

Accessorize

Unlock all sorts of cute accessories and equip them to your cats. Finish each puzzle quickly to unlock them all!


Expected play time: 2.5 hours.

2083220.name: Alchem It
2083220.about_the_game:
Start your new journey as an alchemist! Open your own potion shop and start brewing all kinds of potions for your dear customers. As a new alchemy apprentice, you will learn about plenty of different ingredients and all the brewing techniques needed to make your customers happy. Work hard and earn coins to upgrade and decorate your shop!



Brew potions
Customers will need different remedies depending on their needs, so be ready to brew all kinds of potions and elixirs. Check the scroll and follow the recipe shown in the book to pour the correct ingredients into the cauldron. Once the potion is done, choose the correct bottle size, fill it and deliver it to your customer. If you mess up while making the potion and don't meet the customer's expectations, you'll lose coins, so aim for perfection!



Master your workflow
Harvest the plants from your outdoor garden, take them to the seed extractor to get their pure element, use the mortar to boost the element and pour them to the cauldron. Certain customers may request for additional effects on potion, so be sure to add the special ingredients that will create these desired side effects. Also, you will need to investigate the



Decorate your store
Earn coins for each potion you sell! With your earnings, you will be able to decorate your shop and buy new optional tools to be more efficient and brew even more potions in less time. You will also be able to customize your hands, decorate your shops with all kinds of objects, and more.

2083240.name: Asterogues
2083240.about_the_game:
Beat up planets in this cosmic bullet hell shoot-em-up hybrid! Pick your character from a band of outcasts banished to the Asteroid Belt, and take revenge against the Solar System!

Cast out by the Sun itself, each rebel must use their unique power along with the items and weapons they collect to beat their way to the center of the Solar System and get revenge. Across various zones, swarms of asteroids, aliens, and stars attempt to crush the rebellion - and only the most adept fighter stands a chance of avoiding their endless onslaught. And even then, the 8 planets stand vigilant over their territories, ready to destroy any tresspassers that dare to pass. Are you strong enough to deliver retribution?

Each character has their own bone to pick with the Sun, and their own special ability to turn enemies' bullets against them! Unlock and master each character!

Find dozens of unique passive and active items during your run, create powerful synergies, and get a new experience each time you play!

The Solar System is packed full of loyal Sun-worshippers firing their own unique projectiles! Learn each bullet and each enemy pattern to stand a chance of winning!

The 8 planets control the Solar System under the Sun's command. You'll have to take them down before you get a chance at the Sun itself!

2083250.name: RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure! ~SHOBOMI AND THE PHANTOM RUINS~
2083250.about_the_game:
Action game suitable for live game play and streaming, which looks cute but full of unreasonable traps!
「RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!」

"RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!" series is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which you control Shobomi, a cute cat character, and aim for the goal!
The second in the series!
Join the "Shobomi Expedition" and explore the phantom ruins full of traps!



Unpredictable traps everywhere! A lot of unpredictable traps that will make you shout, "How is this possible!!?" were prepared.
For example, when you try to pick up a coin, you are trapped in iron bars, and when you are stuck, spikes fall on you, or when you pick up a key, you are crushed because you cannot bear the weight of the key. The game is full of traps that you cannot even imagine.


We assume that the main target players are live game players and streamers.
As a secondary target, we are targeting players who like to play 2D platformers with high difficulty level.


We want the game to be delivered and played live, and for the audience to get excited by enjoying the reactions of the distributors.

In addition, we hope that the distributors and the audience will cooperate with each other to find solutions by communicating and thinking of ways to avoid the traps together.

2083310.name: Motel Styx
2083310.about_the_game:
Welcome to Motel Styx!

In this narrative fiction exploration game, alternate between three playable guests, each with the ability to influence the life of the charismatic yet guarded manager, Charon, and alter the fate of the once popular and beloved Motel Styx. Uncover the motel’s (and its manager's) past and secrets through puzzle-solving mechanics specific to each guest, while traversing their interwoven narratives. As you play each character, you'll encounter key decision points that will alter not only Charon's life but the future of the rundown motel.

Three playable characters and their tools:

  • The Lost Traveler - lockpick
  • The Intrepid Tourist - camera
  • The Ghost Hunter - audio recorder

Features:

  • Explore a rundown motel in the middle of Styx, Nevada and interact with its charming manager
  • Check out the lobby + bar, the adjoining motel hot springs, and the abandoned (haunted???) Styx silver mine
  • Pet the cat!
  • Three intertwined, alternating narratives that lead to different outcomes

2083320.name: Omega Warp
2083320.about_the_game:
Omega Warp is a 2D single-player action-adventure that takes place aboard ISE Horizon Prime interstellar freighter, orbiting the planet Tau Verge in the constellation HH Andromedae, serving as a base of operations for building an outpost. Play as Lana Winfort or Stean Redfire belonging to the repair team sent to investigate the interstellar freighter's loss of communication with the base of operations on Earth that occurred a year earlier.

Incorporating metroidvania elements into the gameplay, Omega Warp offer a blend of exploration, skill upgrades, and equipment customization, enhancing the player experience with interconnected world design.

Exploration: Progressively access the interconnected decks of the interstellar freighter, discover its mysteries, acquire new upgrades, find secret areas and understand what caused the freighter’s loss of communication with Earth.

Customization: Find and equip upgrades that will add news functionality to your space armor, making your journey easier or allowing access to new areas. Fight enemies, complete missions, discover secrets to accumulate experience and improve your skills according to your style of play.

Arsenal: Use an arsenal of long-range energy weapons, which don’t use ammo but use a battery that recharges over time. Find and equip new energy charges that deal more damage to organic or synthetic enemies. Unlock and collect ammo to use in the explosive launcher built into your space armor.

Datalogs: Access datalogs on computers scattered throughout the freighter and discover the daily life, history or secrets left behind by the crew.
2083320.reviews:
“Cian Games’ Omega Warp is a fun and polished sci-fi Metroidvania that’s occasionally let down by a few odd design decisions. It’s a celebration of science fiction, and fans of the genre will find themselves at home while exploring the derelict halls of the ISE Horizon Prime interstellar freighter.”
8/10 – SimpleGamer

“Omega Warp is a new addition to the metroidvania genre that takes players into an exciting sci-fi setting aboard an interstellar freighter. With an immersive atmosphere and impressive art design, the game stands out in many aspects, though there are a few areas that deserve attention (translated from Portuguese).”
FinalFaqs

2083330.about_the_game:
An old school adventure fps - Go To Hell.

Go to hell is an adventure FPS with a pixel art style, you have to find items to advance in your quest and fight against angels.

Game included :

Story :

One day and without warning hell is unleashed on humanity, the armies of the devil quickly besieged the cities of the whole world plunging the earth in the most total chaos.

Before the flood of demons, god in person sent his armies of angels on earth but the war did not stop and the fighting raged even more.

Seeing the demons gaining ground the humans committed the irreparable : the creation of super humans, hybrid half human half angel ; the Nephilim.

With them they finally won the war but god realized this and while he had formally prohibited the hybridization of humans and angels he sent a final message to humanity.

His anger was immense, humans did not know how to defend himself and above all had disobeyed his orders his decision was made he will trigger the judgement day, the end of humanity.

You are the last alive Nephilim and the last hope of humanity because only an angel or a Nephilim can kill god in person.

A passage was opened towards the paradise your mission is : eliminate god and stop the end of the world.

2083360.about_the_game:
Drifting in cold space
Awake to nightmares near
Survive to safety


Spectre of Eternity is a game about waking up in worlds you don't recognize, and trying to survive. Fly around space, avoiding the dangerous enemies and collecting upgrades to your mech. Make it to the end of each level to find your way back home to hopefully find safety.

The game includes three levels with gorgeous art, with each level having different groups of enemies to try and best! Pilot your mech expertly and dodge all the projectiles being hurled at you by your enemies. Strategize how to best deal with your enemies by using your target picker and choose between five different modes of firing to blast them out of space! Choose your favorite weapon out of the seven different types and learn how its upgrades effect it! Maneuver your mech to get in the perfect position to deal maximum carnage!

2083380.name: Heartbite: Dating in Daylight
2083380.about_the_game:
You wake up early, and the sun is already beginning to shed its rays over the skies. But this time you won’t hide away from sunlight. Food’s out after all, and who knows what (or who) you’ll encounter out there? Maybe there is hope for a nocturnal creature such as yourself to find what you’ve been looking for?

Get to know a unique cast of characters as you go through your day in Heartbite: Dating in Daylight! Escape from a dire situation, collect candy and witness a decisive battle as you get closer to them. Behold stunning locations, uncover secrets and get a taste of different genre minigames in this dating sim!

These mini games are a platformer, a physics playground and an old school RPG battle!

2083410.name: Aria's Melody
2083410.about_the_game:
Aria's Melody is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by retro classics. In this game you will travel across a vast world in search of answers to the darkness that plagues the lands.

  • Travel through an open world on foot or on horseback!
  • Experience a day/night cycle combined with dynamic weather that will provide a truly immersive experience.
  • Push, climb and swim! There are many options for engaging with your environment.
  • Discover a multitude of secrets - hidden caves and dungeons offer rare rewards.
  • Immerse yourself in a variety of mini-games and side quests.
  • Become a true hero by earning new items and abilities!

Aria's Melody intends to have a large overworld that will consist of several interconnected maps. Each region of the game will have varied biomes and unique elements to differentiate them. Planned regions include: Forest, Desert, Ice/Water, Mountains, Swamp, and others. There will be unique characters to interact with, quests and mini-dungeons in each region.

One of the standout features of Aria's Melody is the horseback riding gameplay.

You will be able to ride horses around the world, make travel much faster and give you a unique gaming experience. Eventually you will be able to whistle for the horse to appear on the map and run towards you. The horse will also serve as an additional game mechanic while exploring the overworld. There will be certain obstacles and dangers in the overworld that you can only overcome by riding the horse!

The game will feature a full day/night cycle system as well as weather cycles. During a normal day, you can see cloud shadows moving across the screen. Later, a rain storm may appear, and the day will eventually turn to night, bringing the environment of nocturnal creatures.

The meaning of weather/weather in gameplay is that certain NPCs, events, wildlife and even monsters will spawn depending on the time of day/weather conditions. Daytime gameplay can be described as a casual experience. However, when night falls, the monsters become much more dangerous.

Aria's Melody's Bread and Butter is the action-adventure battle system. You will be able to roll to avoid enemy attacks, block with a shield, and use various items to destroy enemies.

2083540.name: Disc Golf Online
2083540.about_the_game:
Online Multiplayer

Play Disc Golf with people all around the world! Challenge your friends, play a round with strangers. Play for fun or strive to become the best player in Disc Golf Online.

Community Made Maps

Create your own Disc Golf courses, and play them Online with your friends! Build the perfect course and upload it for other players to enjoy. Disc Golf Online has steam workshop integration, which makes it easy to browse, download and play community maps. 

Procedural Generation

Never run out of courses to play! A smart algorithm creates new course layouts and builds interesting terrain around it. Just enter a seed and the algorithm will produce a unique course from it. You can always save your favourite courses to play them again later.

Physics Simulation

A flying disc is no easy physics problem, and a lot of simulations get it wrong. Disc Golf Online uses an aerodynamics-based approach that tries to mimic how the disc interacts with air around it. The physics model is carefully calibrated with real disc flights, to ensure the most realistic disc physics.

2083560.name: Eva：Final Mission

Well, I hope you get a chance to finish this last assignment with Eva!

2083600.name: 梦蝶
2083600.about_the_game:
在游戏中你能感受到“庄周梦蝶”的中式浪漫，在一幅幅水墨画卷般的关卡中，将“汉字”释义与场景、物品相结合，创作出饱含五千年中华文化底蕴的特色谜题。

【脑洞大开的汉字谜题】

游戏场景中许多物体可以转化为对应含义的字，通过汉字结构的拆分与重组，变为新的字。
新的文字，又意味着可以成为新的物品。
通过操作，玩家们可以改变游戏中原有世界的构造，突破原本不可能逾越的障碍。

【趣味横生的语文课】

在解谜的过程中，重新领会一个个汉字背后的含义，一个个典故所蕴含的古老文化思想，重温在儿时学习汉字、诗词、典故时，因五千年悠长岁月沉淀所带来的感动。

【文艺而充满回忆的山水画】

在学生时代的语文和历史教材中，有许许多多的国画插图，都成为
在《梦蝶》里，各种美术设定忠实重现了那种泼墨山水的氛围。
无论是总角之龄的孩童，还是绿丝万条的垂柳，都让人不禁回忆起童年。

【藏于梦中的奇幻隐世】

游戏描绘了一个名为“栖云洲”的神秘奇幻世界，蝴蝶指引，仙人隐居的背后，存在着不为常世所知的秘密。与制作组另一款游戏《栖云异梦》共享世界观，在穿梭古今的不同故事中，一起还原幻境真相。

SobokoSnake is a relaxing puzzle game where the goal is to eat all the food in the level. Completing a level may be easier said than done however. Explore the levels and see if you can eat everything without getting stuck.

There is beauty in simplicity. Both in looks and mechanics. By taking a minimalist approach in graphics, the focus is shifted to the puzzles. Without any distractions you can fully focus on finding the answers. And as you find them, be amazed at what level of complexity a simple set of rules and mechanics can achieve.

Features

  • Snake! You play as a snake that grows every time it eats. Navigate the levels trying not to get yourself stuck.

  • Boxes! As in Sokoban, but instead of being the goal they get in your way. But maybe you could find a way to put them to good use?

  • Pits! Our snake friend isn't the best at climbing, crossing these obstacles may prove to be a challenge.

  • Doors! Some people really don't like snakes and placed doors to keep them out.

  • Switches! Using door handles proved to be too difficult for the snake. Introducing floor switches to open the doors solved this.

  • Undo / redo system. It's okay to make mistakes. Having the ability to undo your actions will help you in finding the solution.

SobokoSnake was favorably received in /agdg/'s 45th demo day. Providing the motivation for a full release soon to follow. As one person put it: "It's like Snake and Pacman had a baby, and oh my god I don't know how to raise this child."

2083660.name: Littlelands
2083660.about_the_game:
Please note: Littlelands is a title that is in early development, any information provided here may be subject to future changes. This page will be updated with more information, details and content as development progresses. Thank you for your understanding.

Experience the daily life of the Littlelands at your own pace, exploring all its mysterious nooks and crannies as you get to know and help the region's quirky inhabitants. Grow berries, hunt for treasure, fish or just sit on a wooden bench and watch the sunset.

ADVENTURE
Your spirit of exploration will lead you to venture into dangerous places, discover new areas full of challenges, interesting characters and curious objects, but be careful, some regions can prove to be too dangerous even for the bravest of adventurers, stay away from the region of the looting goblins!

MAKE NEW PALS
The world is a big place for a little creature like you, luckily it seems you won't be alone. Engage in conversation with the different characters that populate the region, discover their stories and help them with their tasks. Some of them can teach you new skills or clues that will lead you to new adventures if they like you.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Go on adventures in the dangerous lands of the "goblinetes" or relax in the safe areas of Littlelands farming berries, crafting your own dishes, fishing, catching insects with your net or searching for hidden treasures with your shovel.

2083670.name: Cats Yakuza - Online card game
2083670.about_the_game:
In this strategic card game, you battle with adorable yet quirky cats!
The rules are similar to mahjongg and poker, with a new tactical sense you'll love!
Even though the rules are simple, the game is surprisingly deep, so the battle of wits and psychological strategies are so fun!

[Rules]
The basic objective is a build stronger three-card hands than your opponent's.

However, cards are dealt one at a time back each round.
In addition, battles can progress simultaneously in multiple locations.

As a result, the strategy is not so simple as building a single strong hand.
"My opponent's hand seems stronger here, so I'll give up this battle."
"I'll put together a hand that can just barely beat my opponent and hang onto my other cards."
These are just some of the different tactics you can employ!
(*Note: For more information about the rules, see the "How to Play" section within the game.)

You can also use "special cards" with unique effects to turn the tables!

[Game Modes]
Includes two different game modes, "Naughty Mode", which is a quick and simple game with more elements of luck, and "Yakuza Mode" which is a more advanced battle of wits challenge that requires more than luck alone to win!

[Online Battle]
Your opponent is another player somewhere in the world!
This game offers unlimited battling against other players all over the world!
It also features a cute cat stamp function for sending messages back and forth!

[Rates and Rankings]
Features a ranking system: win and your rank goes up, lose and it goes down!
Aim for the top in winning rates and total victories against players all over the world!

[Friend Battles]
We recommend using the friend battles function to play with your friends!
If you invite them to a game, it'll be even more fun!

[Cross-Platform (Cross-Play) Compatible]
You can also play with users on different platforms!


*Note: Any user found to have committed the following types of actions may have a part or all game functionality restricted.

2083680.name: PegSoli+
2083680.about_the_game:
Overview


"PegSoli+" is a game based on the rules of the classic board game Peg Solitaire (or Solo Noble), with some modifications. This game includes a "Problems Mode" to solve preset problems, an "Arcade Mode" to compete for speed with automatically generated problems, and an "Edit Mode" to create original problems.

Basic Rules


A peg (piece) can be moved by jumping over one other adjacent peg, and the jumped over peg is removed from the board. No more than a peg can be jumped over, and no pegs can be moved if there is already a peg at the destination. The game is cleared when there is only one peg left on the board.

Once you have one peg remaining, the problem is clear, but it can be completely cleared by meeting the following requirements.

  • Solve problems within the specified number of steps: Steps are not counted if the same peg is moved consecutively. The key is to move as many consecutive pegs as possible.
  • Centering: It is achieved when the last peg is placed in the center of the board.

Some problems have a set stock of pegs. The stocks can be placed anywhere on the board, and all stocks must be used up to complete the problem.

Board Types


"PegSoli+" has 3 types of boards.

  • English style
This board consists of 33 holes. Movement is limited to four directions: up, down, left, and right.

  • French style
This board consists of 37 holes. Movement is in 8 directions: up, down, left, right, and diagonally.

  • Gunma style
This board consists of 45 holes. On this board, only continuous moves can be made in diagonal directions.

Game Modes


"PegSoli+" has 3 modes.

  • Problems Mode
This mode consists of 120 problems for each board type, for a total of 360 problems. Hints are provided for difficult problems, and hints can be unlocked by using hint points. Hint points are earned through game play.

  • Arcade Mode
This mode challenges you to see how many automatically generated problems you can solve in a given amount of time. Depending on your performance, you will earn hint points that can be used in the problems mode.

  • Edit Mode
This mode allows you to create your original board. The created problems can be output to a password and passed on to other players.

2083690.name: universe treasure
2083690.about_the_game:
The story of《Universe Treasure》take place in the exoplanet era. The expedition will make the journey to the unknown planet to rescue their companions.
This is a barrage survival game with roguelite elements.
You can select four beautiful warriors to defend against thousands of monsters on the unknown planet
As you explore the planet, you will find more evolved weapons and unlock more powerful genetic armor.
If you are defeated, your female team members will face the humiliation of alien creatures.
