2087230.name: Big Boss: A Villain Simulator
2087230.about_the_game:
YOUR DUNGEON. YOUR BUSINESS.

Step into the shoes of a franchisee owner of an Exemplary Villain Industries L.L.C. Lair, and be a part of a leading enterprise in the hero killing business. Your mission? Build your malevolent empire, defeat pesky heroes, and maximize profits through cunning schemes and shrewd negotiations.


Manage your lair, hire minions, and kidnap members of royalty for lucrative ransoms. Tax evasion? Negotiating with hero-slaying unions? It's all in a day's work for a true villainous entrepreneur.

With consistent progression, your lair becomes a formidable force, and it's your business acumen that will lead you to the top. Big Boss is not just about being a villain; it's about being a savvy CEO of your own villainous enterprise. Embrace your inner tycoon and conquer the world, one hero at a time!

Becoming a Boss

Being a boss is more than just defeating heroes. It's about the kind of heroes that are defeated, and how much cash you can get after defeating them. To defeat heroes, though, you need a dungeon. You decide to form your own Hero Defeating company and franchise a location from Exemplary Villain Industries LLC. They help you lure heroes and assist with payroll and you have a place to defeat heroes.

Managerial Duties

As a boss, having minions under your command is a perk, and keeping them on payroll is in your best interest. Minions risk their lives with Royalty Acquisitions, as any good evil doer needs to have a couple lures for heroes. Depending on the Royal acquired, new, stronger heroes will attempt to challenge you, leaving you more money as they're defeated. Minions also construct traps, and if you give them some armor and a sword, they'll stand guard at checkpoints, too. Minions are not little playthings, however. They have feelings and mouths to feed as well. Pay them well and they will treat you well, else you might have to negotiate with union leaders.

Managerial duties goes beyond just the first lair your company owns. As you grow, your company grows as well. Becoming the final boss is a matter of rising through the ranks of EVILLC through the purchasing and managing of new boss lairs, eventually creating a network for heroes to challenge in order to save their royal. Interview and assign mini-bosses to take control of other lairs and pose as mid-dungeon threats, and establish corporate connections in the underworld to increase profits and influence corporate decisions.

Post-Partum Estate

Not everything lasts forever, and that includes your duties as a boss. In the event that a hero defeats you, your company must find another boss to take the reigns as Chief Executive Overlord. Defeat means your company has no head, and heroes will take anything they can get their hands on that their inventory slots will hold. Everything in the dungeon is gone. Everything out of the dungeon will be liquidated in order to keep the company afloat. People still have mouths to feed, after all. If the company goes under, then it's game over.

2087260.name: Living Legends Remastered: Wrath of the Beast Collector's Edition
2087260.about_the_game:
Friendly Fox breathes new life into a classic tale in Living Legends Remastered: Wrath of the Beast!

It’s been three years since your mother Goldilocks lost her life protecting your town, and you’ve been left to carry on her heroic legacy. But when bear attacks suddenly spike in number, you quickly find that the stories you were told aren’t entirely true. These bears have strong ties to magic, and there are darker forces at play than the beasts that plague your homeland! Can you traverse a treacherous terrain and uncover the truth about your home and family in time to save the day? Find out in this spellbinding Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

• Save your daughter from an evil wizard in the Bonus Game!
• Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games and earn achievements!
• Tons of collectibles and morphing objects to find that unlock more games!
• Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, videos, and more!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

2087290.name: BVOVB - Bruising Vengeance of the Vintage Boxer
2087290.about_the_game:
Your glory days as a boxer are long gone. Once champ, now bum. All you care about is beer and your faithful dog - Rottweiler Max.

You play as a retired boxer who is looking for his stolen dog. The game follows a classic arcade brawler so prepare to face lots of enemies. Characters and backgrounds are based on old pictures from 1910s, 20s and 30s so this is a true retro game. Play to find:

  • 22 enemies & 3 bosses
  • 16 levels
  • 37 unlockable achievements and backstories
  • 1 car, 1 dog and 1 boxer with 2 fists

2087300.name: Rocketeer
2087300.about_the_game:
You - as a skillful space rocket pilot - have to survive in space. Use all your talent to pass through meteor fields or find your way out from a giant asteroid. None of the levels are impossible, everything depends on your talent! Keep an eye on your lights and once you passed a level, ask yourself: "Can I be faster?"
Use left and right arrows to turn your rocket, and give a boost with the up arrow. You can shoot projectiles with the spacebar, but you can destroy only the golden rocks and meteorites.
Your score is based on your speed, your accidents, and destroyed meteorites.

2087320.name: Nara: Facing Fire
2087320.about_the_game:
Nara: Facing fire is an upcoming fantasy metroidvania focused on exploration, fluid and responsive movement, difficult boss fights and thrilling escape sequences.

Game Features
- Exploring an enchanted and diverse fully connected open world full of secrets and unique characters.
- Learning and mastering powerful spells and abilities that will allow you to reach new areas,
dodge and block attacks or completely obliterate your enemies.

2087350.name: Climb and Fight: Mafia
2087350.about_the_game:
In Climb and Fight: Mafia you control one of the Tornelo brothers, Hector or Florinda, in the quest to avenge the death of your family in the city of Sdonro. In the 4 districts of the city you must eliminate many enemies and collect money to be able to face the leader and reach the big mafioso of the city.

A 2D platform action game where you collect money, face dangerous enemies with different weapons and shoot (shoot a lot) to reach the top of buildings. You will need to have a lot of skill in movements, quick reflexes and know how to use mechanics and weapons with precision to get your revenge in the city of Sadonro


Game world
The game starts with three open neighborhoods and you need to eliminate the boss of each neighborhood to gain access to the fourth neighborhood. The neighborhoods and levels have a characteristic setting in retro fine art. To access them, you scroll through the city map and mobster gaming tables.


Enemies
The game has a variety of enemies and each neighborhood has its unique enemies, with different mechanics and degree of difficulty.


Weapons
To face enemies you have access to weapons at the beginning of each level. There are more than four types of weapons to help you.


Platform mechanics
Inspired by the classic 2D platform games, the game has several types of platforms and mechanics spread throughout the levels.


Objective
Climb, fight, collect money and reach the top of the buildings to escape with the money and advance through the city of Sdonro until you get your revenge!

The game contains

  • Lots of action
  • Challenges with 2D platforms
  • Different environments and scenarios to combat
  • Enemies with different mechanics
  • Bosses
  • Various types of weapons
  • Collectable objects
  • Characters to interact
  • Exclusive soundtrack
  • Fine art in pixel art

2087360.name: Wilderness Game Stalker VR: North America
2087360.about_the_game:
Disclaimer

This product was designed and intended for use with the Oculus Quest 2. Functionality with other VR headsets cannot be guaranteed.


Stalk and hunt North America’s most iconic game species in virtual reality through woodland, prairie, and lakeside vistas. Approach as close as you dare to line up the perfect shot on a trophy buck, and experience the fear of becoming the hunted as dangerous predators turn the tables on unwary hunters.

Utilize three distinct weapons with unique hunting styles as you aim from afar with a rifle, from close range with your shotgun, or make a precision strike with the bow! After a successful hunt, harvest your trophy and mount it in your trophy lodge with a variety of dynamic poses, capturing the tranquility or ferocity of a given creature.

Horned and Antlered animals feature dynamic racks that ensure each hunt leads to a different prize. Will you find a small horned target, or a mighty trophy specimen? Even for creatures without such obvious display features, animals will also vary in size, giving fearsome predators a chance at becoming impressive collections to your lodge. Your targets include:

American Bison
The largest land mammal native to North America, in size alone this creature makes an excellent trophy, but this creature also has Dynamic Horn size as well, so hunters may wish to focus on getting not just large body size, but large horns as well! This species can be dangerous if provoked, so caution is advised.

Bighorn Sheep
A thick-bodied mountain sheep, with impressive winding horns. This species has Dynamic Horns, and hunters should focus not just on the length of the horn, but the curl as well. This creature does not present danger to the hunter, but care must be taken for good shot placement.

Rocky Mountain Elk
With elegant and iconic antlers, and being one of the world’s largest deer species, the elk is undoubtedly the crown jewel of many hunters’ trophy lodges, and fittingly has Dynamic Antlers as well. Elk naturally exist with a wide variety of body sizes, and hunters may wish to focus on trophies on both ends the spectrum.

Moose
The world’s largest deer species, and often considered the most dangerous of North America’s game animals, the moose is a challenging but incredibly rewarding prey species to tackle. Found alone or in pairs, the moose is more elusive than other game species, but can turn aggressive in an instant if threatened, making caution important when at close range. Fitting of a creature with impressive palmate antlers, this animal has Dynamic Antlers.

Mule Deer
One of the continent’s most widespread and commonly hunted species, don’t let that make this creature seem any less enticing. With Dynamic Antlers and a swift escape at the first sign of danger, this animal is best downed in a single shot even more so than your other hunting targets, for if it escapes you might never see it again.

Feral Hog
A nuisance throughout the country, hunting this animal is often seen as an ecological service. Crosses of escaped farm pigs with wild stock, or even simply loosed boars themselves, these animals breed a masse and dominate ecosystems they colonize. Despite this, they can make for impressive trophies with their Dynamic Tusks, and they come in a great variety of body sizes as well, ranging from smaller, natural sizes to monstrous creatures taking on their domestic proportions. Don’t be fooled, these animals can be dangerous when provoked, so make shot placement well.

Grizzly Bear
When it comes to ferocity and terror, few animals have the iconic American Grizzly Bear beat. Solitary by nature, the Grizzly can be trickier to approach than other animals, and when threatened becomes extremely aggressive. If not subdued quickly, this animal is very likely to down a would-be hunter. The ultimate trophy of a large individual can reach 9 feet or more when rearing up, making it a perfect addition to any hunter’s collection.

Cougar
One of the most widespread of the cat family, ranging from Canadian snowscapes, to temperate woodlands, down to arid desert and tropical rainforest, and even to the swamps of Florida, the accomplishments of this predator are clear to see. It may lack the size of the Grizzly, but more than makes up for it in stealth and speed. A deadly prey species, this animal will likely only give a single chance to take it down before it turns the hunter into the hunted. Most of these cats weigh under 100 pounds, but a true trophy can exceed 200, an excellent and formidable trophy.

Neon Fighter is a tiny arcade game packed with lasers and explosions, in which every few seconds you are forced to switch weapons automatically, making you have to adapt quickly to the new situation and re-evaluate your perspective.

2087430.name: Sneaky IT Support
2087430.about_the_game:
Sneaky IT Support is a puzzle simulation game where you find naughty secrets in employee computers. Find their nudes and uncover their stories! Every person has a laptop which needs to be fixed and it is your job to do so - why not to also snoop around while you can!

Browse the computers and look for sexy photos and juicy information! Read their chat messages and emails, and see what sort of person they are. Most importantly, look for any naughty secrets they might be hiding. Every person has a secret. Some are better at hiding them than others.

2087440.name: Hentai Tentacle Survivors
2087440.about_the_game:
Hentai Tentacle Survivors is a top down action shooter where you defend against waves of horny enemies attacking you from all sides. You'll need quick reflexes and a steady hand to survive. Tentacles have no mercy, and they won't stop until they've had their way with you. Good luck!

Your mission is to find out what happened and put a stop to these creatures before they can escape and spread their tentacles all over the world.

- Intuitive controls
- Gorgeous pixel art
- Retro sound effects and music
- Leveling up and upgrades

Every enemy is ready to ravage you. Take them down before they can get their slimy tentacles on you. As an experience fighter your reflexes are sharp, and your pelvic muscles are strong. Let's see if you can survive this slippery onslaught.

2087450.name: BOOOOOOOOOOBS
2087450.about_the_game:
Meet Alice and Emma, your two new clients. Your job as a plastic surgeon, is to keep them satisfied. Before you get to touch their boobs, you first need to examine them and answer all their questions .. It is simple, they will ask you and you need to reassure them that they come to the right place and to the right person - you! Your reputation precedes you as someone very skilled with you hands - so don't let anything to ruin it!

- Match anywhere to swap two adjacent pieces and make 3 or more in a line to clear them and complete the level.
- Take an appointments with your clients, both before and after their desired boob job and make them happy!
- Feel free to stare at the boobs as much as you want, and wipe away all your stress!



Features:

- Almost 40 unique rewards - now featuring also a few animations!
- Hyper-polished match-3 gameplay with a custom built-from-scratch implementation.
- 60 mins of gameplay total, possibly more
- Beautiful boobs of all shapes and sizes.
- Clearing a level unlocks a reward - picture, series of pictures or a video
- Relaxing soundtrack.
- Visual novel elements before and after each game.
- Choices during dialogue affect gameplay.

Rules of the match 3:

- You must match 3 or more of the same gems in a row or column.
- Each gem type has a different meaning and effect.
- You must keep an eye on your exam points as well as remaining turns counter.
- You must "defeat" the opponent - your examiner - by matching heart symbols and seducing her.
- You can also use skills to alter the game. But be careful, they only have limited amount of uses!

2087460.name: Ruff Ghanor
2087460.about_the_game:
Get ready to embark on an epic and challenging journey, where you will become Ruff Ghanor, the young cleric destined to confront the tyrant Red Dragon, Zamir, and free the kingdom from his relentless oppression. Trained by the monks of St. Arnaldo Monastery, Ruff will face the forces of the fearsome dragon to protect his people while discovering the truth about himself.

Master the Deckbuilding Strategy!

Each collected card represents a crucial action. Build the perfect deck, strategize your moves, and create powerful synergies as you progress. Show your bravery and cunning in a game that combines strategy, adventure, and narrative in an unparalleled way.


The Magic of Ruff Ghanor!

Step into a captivating world inspired by a bestselling fantasy novel, facing various types of encounters, from intense battles to moments of exploration and storytelling that bring to life the pivotal events of the book. Gather loyal allies, each with their own special deck, and take the dynamics of combat to a whole new level.

2087470.name: I commissioned some bees 5
2087470.about_the_game:
A hidden object game where you must find all the bees to complete each level.

Key features:

⁍ 1000+ bees
⁍ 10 unique artworks
⁍ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
⁍ Restore a small number of bees to a painting so you can find them again!
⁍ Additional bee related objects to find
⁍ Music and ambiance for each artwork
⁍ Achievements
⁍ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scrollwheel
⁍ 3 save slots
⁍ Reset progress entirely and play again
⁍ Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level

Context:

The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

Controls:

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a bee, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.

Difficulty:

A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.

Get immersed:

Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for all the bees.

Replayable

You can restore a small number of bees back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few bees left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

2087500.name: Death of Eternity
2087500.about_the_game:
You were created to purge all that defile. Slaughter hoards of such filth during your ascension, gaining powerful items and abilities with every drop of blood. Forge your own path through the heavens fully customizing your level of challenge and reward. Share in this virtuous crusade with up to three friends in Online multiplayer co-op!

Born of the divine and locked away, you know only of killing. Instilled with some form of morality, you must rise above your creator to protect the crumbling world around you. Something or somethings have trespassed on this holy ground, and it's your responsibility to see to their removal. Starting weak and frail you must hone yourself and your surroundings to benefit your hunt. Craft powerful weapons and abilities, and build up the land you stand on to suit your strengths.

Key features

  • Unlimited Potential
    With tons of customizable items, abilities, and passives there's endless room for character improvement! It's not just about leveling up or finding new items, it's about using the games systems to create truly unique and game breaking synergies! With so many options to choose from and an ever evolving landscape, make sure you can adapt to the harsh demands of Eternity quickly!
  • A Class Of Its Own
    What items and modifiers you'll be able to encounter depend on which player Class you pick. This allows for a much larger and easily expandable base of content. You may however find items that allow for certain item types or modifiers to appear that normally wouldn't for your chosen Class. Each Class behaves entirely different from one another both in strength and weakness. This variety also serves multiplayer very well, where you'll be able to share items from each other's Classes and make up for each other's weaknesses!
  • Forged By Gods
    Death of Eternity features a unique and deep item system. Nearly every item you'll find has the ability to be enhanced and made stronger. From weapons and armor, to your own body and the very land you stand on - Everything is fully customizable to fit your character's needs. A modernized ARPG design philosophy ensures an item system which allows you to easily craft your equipment, while also making sure that you'll stay excited for newly dropped items.
  • Eternity Is What You Make It
    Customize not only your character, but also the land around you! That means that the types of enemies you'll encounter and how difficult / rewarding they are to fight is all completely up to you! Forging the land is intuitive and works exactly the same as enhancing every other item in the game. There's full agency over exactly what content you want to engage with, as well as what types of rewards you'll receive for your efforts! Make sure you're fighting in a world that benefits you the most, and if you're not, just change it!
  • Online Multiplayer
    You don't need to take everything on your own! Team up with your friends in up to four player online multiplayer! Multiplayer invites a whole new level of depth to character customization with the addition of out of Class items and modifiers! All content is fully playable both in Singleplayer and Multiplayer!

2087510.name: Amazon Quest
2087510.about_the_game:
In the Amazon Quest game the player will explore the great Amazon River and its affulents, managing and trading resources. The goal is to map all the Amazon region in a boat that reachs many cities, villages and tribes along the Amazon basin. The player must clear match 3 levels in order to get valuable resources that will be used during the journey to reach further places. The jungle won’t make the exploration any easier, the player will face dangerous animals and some tropical diseases.

Amazon quest is an educational game full of history. The game’s journey is placed around 1910, and brings many historical elements that are greatly inspired by the Roosevelt–Rondon Scientific Expedition in 1913. All this historical background is wrapped in game by many cultural, anthropological and echologial components. The player will gather all those informations in a journal by interacting with people, animals and plants.

Features:

- Match 3 Puzzles: get valuable items such as fruits and relics by solving fun match 3 games, but watch out for animals hidden in the tall grass. Some are harmless but others can be aggressive.

- Resources Management: keep your items at hand in order to reach further locations in your journey. Trade fruits and plants for medicine and other goods. Keep an eye in your bag for the jungle is no place for beginners.

- Level Exploration and Discovery: Navigate along the Amazon River and its affluents discovering new cities, villages and tribes. New places will bring you new animals, plants and people so keep your journal updated.

- Education: Amazon Quest brings many historical elements from the 1913 Roosevelt–Rondon Scientific Expedition. Also, player interactions with people, plants and animals grants a lot of learning about culture, fauna and flora from Amazon region.

- Paper Craft based beautiful graphics: All those fun explorations will happen inside a pop-up book with dynamic scenarios. Have fun exploring the pages while learning about the Amazon region.
2087510.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian

2087610.name: UFO: Unidentified Falling Objects
2087610.about_the_game:
Unidentified Falling Objects is a unique mashup of platforming and puzzle destroying gameplay. Players are dropped into the puzzle where they must dodge the falling obstacles and destroy blocks to make big combos. Many different things will fall from above, and the player must act quickly to remove them to level up and get the highest score. Compete for highscores or play with friends in local and online multiplayer modes.

PUZZLE PLATFORMING
• A literal puzzle platformer, where you can move around the puzzle, kicking and dodging blocks to match big combos all while avoiding many other types of obstacles, leveling up, and collecting powerups

SOLO OR MULTIPLAYER
• Challenge yourself to complete all the objectives in single player or challenge others for the best score in multiplayer with local 1 vs 1 or up to 20 players in online

CUSTOMIZATION
• Upgrade your way to the ultimate puzzle platformer, with unlockable equipment you can change your weapon, movement style and special kick powers. Changing the way you shoot, jump, and kick will help you get better scores and defeat other players

RETRO STYLE
• Retro graphics and a synthwave soundtrack across 6 different worlds

COLORFUL CAST OF CHARACTERS
• Meet several eccentric characters when you progress the single player campaign. Each new character will offer new unique challenges for the player to complete
2087610.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

2087630.name: Umbra Sepulcri
2087630.about_the_game:
Umbra Sepulcri is an action game inspired by metroidvania genre, featuring a necromancer and his struggling with greed and death, you need to gather the souls of the dead, witness their last moments of life and summon them, unleashing their power to defeat your enemies. Collect the souls of your enemies and get new weapons that match your fighting style. Live a deep story and face the consequences of your choices.

Features:

  • Metroidvania: Discover a corrupt world full of enemies, traps and puzzles, unlocking new areas and abilities along the way.
  • Non-Linear Storytelling: Unravel the mysteries of the world depending on which path you choose to take, will you be able to change your destiny?
  • Fighting: Tough combat, opt for weapons that suit your play style and perform devastating and spectacular combos.
  • Right Hand of Charon: Unleash the power of souls against your enemies or release them into the river of the dead.
  • From pencil to screen: Hand drawn 2D animations, in illustration style and dozens of Comic Book stories.
  • Spine-tingling story: A deep and captivating story, delivered in Comic Book style.


Unlock new primary and secondary weapons each of which has its own unique attack range, speed and power. Acquire devastating new skills and special moves to slaughter your foes. And don't forget the souls, they are always at your service!




Souls stagnate in the world, corrupting it. Give peace to these entities before their torment turns them into dreadful creatures. Discover their story by reliving their last moments in life and use their power to smash some heads.




Overcome the challenges before you, reading the attacks of the opponents to survive formidable battles. Defeat these powerful enemies and subdue their souls to take them by you side. Vae Victis!




A deeply emotional story about greed and sacrifice will unravel as you tangles with strong bosses and environmental hazards, traversing forests, mountains and deserts in search of the cause that dried up the stream of souls of the Styx, the river of the dead.

2087840.name: Neon Cyber Samurai
2087840.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Fracture, a dimension where everything ever lost throughout time and space can be found.

Neon Cyber Samurai is a futuristic survival game with roguelite elements where you must survive against and defeat ever-increasing waves of foes, steal their strange technology to upgrade yourself, and inevitably fight their leaders in hopes of finding a way to escape this forsaken dimension.

CHOOSE YOUR SAMURAI

Select one of many adventurers dragged into the Fracture from their worlds. Learn their combat styles, understand their weapons of choice and dive into enemy forces with nothing but your skills and the experience you get as you eliminate anyone bold enough to try and stop you.

DISCOVER MYSTERIOUS ARSENAL

Dash, shoot, and slash your enemies to salvage their technology and use it to upgrade yourself. Get faster, grow stronger and evolve your fighting style to uncover combinations of powers and abilities that can turn you into an unstoppable force.

KEY FEATURES

No instructions. No easy way. Start with nothing and discover yourself, meet the enemy face to face, obtain new abilities, grow stronger, and always fight to survive.

2087850.name: Tribe War
2087850.about_the_game:
It is a strategic card game (SCG) that combines the genre of card game and chess.
Create original decks, summon monster cards, and use magic cards to target your opponent's stronghold

In a chessboard-type field, summon a monster card around the base camp and move the object to break through the opponent's defense and destroy the base camp.
Each object is different from the way it moves, and there are some objects with special abilities. The magic card can neutralize the opponent's defense or strengthen your own defense.

Stores, card packs, and new species will be added in the future.

2087860.name: The Lost
2087860.about_the_game:
Welcome to the uncertain world of The Lost, an immersive survival game where your instincts will be your greatest asset. Stranded in a vast, lost world of wilderness, you must navigate through diverse landscapes, endure harsh weather conditions, and outsmart the relentless challenges nature throws your way.

You are stranded, lost on an island. After surviving an aerial bombing on board the ISS liberty you make it on the lifeboats but quickly get knocked out and are stranded on an island. Survive, craft, defeat bosses, and more. Join or host a multiplayer server with your friends and try to survive together. With plenty of new features unseen in any other survival game you will have to explore what this game can offer.

Key Features:

1. Realistic Survival Mechanics: Manage your character's hunger, thirst, temperature, and stamina. Collect resources, craft tools, and build shelters to stay alive in the unforgiving wilderness. Make crucial decisions about what to eat, where to rest, and how to stay warm during the cold nights.

2. Wildlife Interaction: Encounter a variety of wildlife with their own behaviors and territories. Some animals may be a source of food, while others could pose a threat. Be prepared to face predators, but also learn to read the signs of approaching danger to avoid unnecessary confrontations.

3. Day-Night Cycle: Survive in a dynamic world with a realistic day-night cycle. Utilize the daylight to explore and gather resources, but be cautious as nightfall brings increased danger and challenges.

4. Weather Challenges: Face extreme weather conditions, including rain, snowstorms, and heatwaves. Adapt your strategies to overcome these challenges, and use the environment to your advantage.

5. Mystery Events: Encounter unexpected events that add an element of unpredictability to your survival journey. From sudden weather changes to mysterious landmarks, be prepared for anything.

"The Lost" offers a thrilling and realistic survival experience that will push your limits, challenge your decision-making skills, and reward those who can adapt and thrive in the untamed wild. Can you conquer nature and emerge as the ultimate survivor?

2087880.name: Ending Tau
2087880.about_the_game:
Ending Tau is an action roguelite where curses morph your body changing the core mechanics of your journey. Combining unique mechanics with a fresh setting, Tau brings a new tone to the roguelike genre's experience.

EVERY UPGRADE IS A GAME-CHANGER

Every curse drastically changes your gameplay in each run, from how you fight to how you walk (or fly) around the world.


ENDLESS MIX AND MATCH

Combine upgrades in whichever way you like. Stack them on top of each other and break the game's combat with insane builds. The unique upgrade system was designed to be simple yet meaningful. Combinations are endless.


UNIQUE LANDSCAPES

Wander through a procedural world inspired by unique landscapes. Battle dozens of deadly folkloric creatures in a fast-paced combat system where any mistake is fatal. Unravel new secrets every time you enter the jungle.


MASSIVE BOSS FIGHTS

Legend has it that Tau fathered seven sons: the seven Godfiends. Defeat them in grandiose boss fights that will require skill and strategy from every player.

WORLD-BUILDING

Rebuild your village, unlock dozens of unique relics and skills and find powerful allies to aid you in your journey.


MYSTERIOUS LORE

Why are you the only being capable of resisting curses? What is Tau's true intent? Who's waiting for you in the depths of the jungle? Discover a refreshing story inspired by a legend from ancient Native American Folklore.

2087910.name: SOULVARS
2087910.about_the_game:
SOULVARS takes deckbuilding combat to the next level with the innovative Soulbit system.
Combine Soulbit actions and use deck-controlling Abilities to pull off 100+ breathtaking moves.

Tactically counter powerful attacks and debuffs from enemy "Dominators," and time your counterattacks for maximum effect!

Enjoy the best of both worlds: deep deckbuilding strategy and high-speed RPG battles!

◆ A future where human souls can be digitized...

Humanity faces the consequences of its technology with the sudden appearance of grotesque Dominators. Elite units consisting of Soulbearers, next-generation humans born with alternate Souls, are dispatched day and night to intercept and counter Dominator attacks. The story follows Yakumo, a freelance Soulbearer, as he handles assignments from private military contractor "DDO" (Dominator Disposal Organization).

◆ Deep, exhilarating battles and character growth

Experience the best of both worlds - dynamic pixel art animations and turn-based tactical planning. Each enemy is a puzzle to solve, a challenge to overcome!
Identify their weaknesses and combine Soulbit actions to unleash powerful finishing moves! Explore the cityscape and hunt unique Dominators for rare and powerful gear on your path to mastering the ultimate Arts!

◆ Super-enhanced port of acclaimed mobile original

The original mobile version, released in January 2022, soared up the rankings to #1 for paid RPG apps and #2 for paid game apps on both Google Play and Apple App Store (in Japan) and continues to garner wide acclaim (4.6 score average on App Store, 4.8 on Google Play as of Sep 2022). The Steam version offers an enhanced horizontal UI and intuitive controller input, combining the speed of SOULVARS with full dynamism on your favorite display!
2087910.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi
2087910.reviews:
“The game might have had a rough start with laying out the story and explaining the gameplay mechanics, but SOULVARS quickly smoothed out and got in its JRPG groove thanks to a good mix of deck-building and turn-based action. Additionally, it let its retro vibe personality show and it quickly became a pleasant experience.”
85 – digital chumps

““SOULVARS is a fantastic pixel-art arcade action game. It has very few problems, surprisingly, for being the first title released by ginolabo on Steam. Developers have done a wonderful job in streamlining both the combat and the adventure.””
82 – GamesCreed

““SOULVARS uses a retro Japanese role-playing game look that suits the theme and the gameplay well. It's classic pixel art, with a focus on interesting designs for the player-controlled characters and the many cool moves they can execute. It is nice to watch the action unfold but the variety of locations and enemies is limited. More energy has been used to create bosses and their unique moves. The interface is easy to navigate and offers plenty of information for players to process.””
80 – Softpedia

2087920.name: Wispera
2087920.about_the_game:
Inspired by many crafting survival games, Wispera is a procedural generated, open-world sandbox survival crafting game. Fundamentally Wispera is similar to games like Minicraft and Terraria.



Explore the vast infinity generated world. There are plenty of opportunities to be had when searching for the perfect base location.



Delve deep underground to collect rare materials. I’d recommend you be careful though, you never know what might be lurking deep in the dark.



After a long spelunking trip deep underground, you can use the furnace to smelt down your valuable materials. Use these newly processed materials to craft better armor, tools, and many other items!



Wispera has been designed with a highly efficient tile based world. With the materials you collect you can build walls and floors to create any structure you desire. Among many other items to decorate and outfit your base.



Using your newly crafted tools and armor, fight dangerous monsters to collect rare items!

Some Key Features Include

  • Sandbox survival gameplay with building mechanics.
  • A multitude of unique items to collect and craft.
  • Infinite procedural generation with multiple layers of underground depth.
  • Day and night system.
  • (Coming Soon) Crops and farming.
  • Many unique monsters to find and collect rare items from.
  • Hand written game engine made on top of LibGDX specifically for Wispera.
  • Custom shaders with dithered cloud shadows and lighting effects.
  • ...and many more!

2087940.name: Non-Stop Raiders
2087940.about_the_game:
In this infinite side-scroll runner play as different raiders, run and jump across areas. Pillage gold from either your enemies or chests across your journey to upgradeabilities or unlock new charecters.



Use the gold you collected to unlock new abilities like your Shield which protects you from obstacles or attacks. Unlock and use Dash to reach further distances or recollect the speed you lost. Increase your durability to endure even more injuries or you could increase the gold you get from plundering so you can unlock more content quicker.



Start off as Redmane the barbarian, as you pillage and collect more gold unlock different raiders such as deformed version of Redmane as Big Head, ate too much Chunky, not so sneaky Sus Knight or coming from the oriental middle east with it’s pocket knife Coffee Hunter and much more.

Traverse across different areas like the Green Forest with colossal trees, Catacombs of The Old Warriors burried deep in the caves, Dungeons of The Condemned and the Floating Towers Castle. Run, jump, defeat enemies and plunder gold across different biomes.
2087940.supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

2087960.name: CustomBullet
2087960.about_the_game:
This game was created as part of BYKING Inc. newcomer training program.
Depending on your PC environment, the game may not run properly.
Also, unforeseen problems may occur during the game.
Please be aware of this.

*Although it is a local play-only title, it is possible to play online by using Steam Remote Play Together.
*Requires 2 controllers

Endless customization and exhilarating robot action!
Speed, power, size, all at your own will.
An overwhelming sense of speed that runs through the body.
Huge craters and concrete jungles create high-speed battles.
Game for Robo-Game Fans.

Experience custom robot action second to none...!

About the game


''Custom Bullet" is an action game in which players customize a high-speed machine called a "grit slider" and "left and right weapons" to fight 1 vs. 1.
Go hot in a classical split screen match!

Exhilarating robot action.


Using jumps and boost dashes, move freely around the field
Dodge their attacks, run across the vast stage, and win!

High flexibility in customization.


Weapons are customizable by attaching custom items, such as bullet speed, power, size, firing method, and whether or not they explode.
Depending on the combination, it could create a monster.
MAKE YOUR OWN MOST POWERFUL WEAPON!

2087980.name: Project BS
2087980.about_the_game:
The island of the spirits. A place that is beautiful but at the same time dangerous and mysterious.
From there, the adventure of Sienna, a dragonewt girl, begins.
Fight against formidable opponents and deadly rivals,
and gather the power of the spirits to restore the balance!


===Attractive yet Deadly Rival Characters===
Sienna, the protagonist, is not alone in her quest for the power of the spirits.
Visitors, who have come to an unknown place for their own reasons, won't simply give up.


===Various and Powerful Elemental Skills===
Through the power of spirits, you can acquire elemental skills and even enhance them in your desired style.
Utilize the elemental skills effectively to gain an advantage in battles.

2088000.name: 亂噏三國
2088000.about_the_game:
漢末三國亂世, 群雄割據, 充滿野心爭霸天下。你身為現代人, 穿越來到這個時空浪跡天涯, 遇上各種人和事, 他們到底是朋友還是敵人? 打倒他們以後又當如何處置? 是要釋放或是斬殺, 都由你來決定。
出發去冒險吧! 三國時代最聰明的那幾個人正在計畫著甚麼, 而你正正就是他們計畫的一部分, 想要配合抑或反抗? 好好想清楚你在這個世界的角色到底為何? 然後, 你將要為你的決定負上責任。

穿越時空 亂噏三國
你來到了漢末三國時代, 不同時期的歷史事件加上虛構情節-赤壁、官渡、虎牢關, 各大小戰場全面開放, 過五關斬六將!

善與惡 殺與不殺
善惡值將會反映你的所作所為, 殺戮值將會記錄你手上流過的鮮血。三思而行, 是我給你的忠告。

能力培育 戰無不勝
透過消耗能力果實提升個人隊員實力, 將能為你扭轉局勢。 不要吝嗇, 好好培育你的角色, 打造出屬於你的天兵神將。

紅顏知己 結伴行
你將結識最多八位三國時代的女性, 根據你的表現, 或者……她們都是你的?

2088020.name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
2088020.about_the_game:
A young man named Albert Hartree, or "Al," suddenly teleports to the unknown planet Voltissia and gains superpowers. Having always admired heroes, he stands up to save its people.

Freely fly across the vast world and take down powerful enemies! A new superhero action game is born.

Your Superpowers. Your Hero.


The Superpowers and Abilities you acquire will significantly expand your options in both exploration and combat.

Face the Calamity on Voltissia!


Five hundred years ago, a mysterious explosion shattered the world of Voltissia, and with it, civilization. The aftermath changed everything, twisting most of the planet's life into brutal mutants who torment the few remaining survivors, the Enelf.

Onto this desolate world, a lone young man named Al suddenly appears.

He decides to join forces with the Enelf and confront the looming threat.

2088030.name: Long Dream
2088030.about_the_game:
Zhao Sheng, a retired postman, has been suffering from dementia over the past years. But for some reason, the image of the peach tree in his dreams lingered in his head. He insists that his partner Qi Mei is waiting for him under the tree.

This image of the peach tree woke his remaining memories. The little things between him and his family after retirement, the interactions with the villagers when he was delivering their mails, the time when his children were born, and his days spent in the army are all returning to him. In each and every one of those memories, he was always with Qi Mei.



As his illness worsened, Zhao Sheng became unconscious of the difference between memory and reality, the difference between day and night, and unable to recognise his friends and families, but what hadn't changed was that he always remembered Qi Mei, who waited for him beneath the peach tree. Zhao Sheng’s family didn't want him to leave with any regrets and decided to go and find that peach tree he had been talking about, the place where he and Qi Mei made a promise to each other. Can he meet with the love of his life, who passed away a long time ago, underneath the peach tree of his dreams?



  • A story from a few decades ago exceeding time and space, bringing you a uniquely reminiscing experience.
  • A story filled with twists and turns and humorous dialogues.
  • Pixel art that is crude and simple but enough to deliver the gaming experience.
  • The entire game takes about 3-4 hours.

2088070.name: Zombie Hunter
2088070.about_the_game:
[Game introduction]

"Zombie Hunter-Survivor" is a Roguelike casual game with the theme of hunting zombies in a doomsday environment. The initial character has only one ballistic trajectory, and the attack attribute is not very good. Choose a Buff to strengthen the character in each level of customs clearance, match your own skill combination route, from weak to invincible! The monsters in the level will continue to rush towards the characters, the number and strength of the monsters will increase with the level of each layer, and each difficulty level needs to clear all zombies within 3 minutes! It is said that no one can challenge the difficulty level of more than 200 layers. . . Golden 3 minutes, what level of difficulty can you stick to your limit? ? !

[Skill operation]

Active skill Q : Rage burst, it can be released when the rage bar is full. After each release of rage, the next rage base damage will be stacked!

Active skill E : Death Acrobatics, expand the attack range of the darts around the character itself and keep it for a certain period of time. You need to collect all 3 darts to learn this skill. 3, 5 can unlock the speed stunt!

[Game Features]

Each buff type has different grades, namely: green, blue, purple, orange, red, rainbow, grade order from low to high, rainbow grade is the highest grade and the rarest Buff.

Every 5 layers, there will be super bosses, kill super bosses to get extra skill chests, the more skill chests you get, the richer the attack methods and unlock more extreme decompression experience! !

Thoughtful collocation

After clearing each level, Buffs will be generated for players to choose freely, especially the idea of ​​matching Buff attributes in the early stage is extremely important.

(When you select a Buff for each level of clearance, you can use gold coins to refresh the Buff with a higher level, or you can choose any previous level in your personal attributes to reshuffle to cover the Buff)

Easy and fun gameplay

The game is mainly based on the battle of quick refresh and quick attack, so that every level of the player is a fun experience of Roguelike+ shooting!

Unique style

The game has a horror atmosphere of zombie theme, the difficulty level is 300 layers, each layer is 3 minutes, with epic and soundtrack, and the personality is outstanding!

Game Background

in 2065 A.D., Dr. Hardt, the evil biological research doctor, extracted biological genes from the legendary vampire prince Phyllis for scientific research, and achieved amazing results three years later. The effect of the immortality gene of the research results slowed down the aging rate of cells, which attracted rich people everywhere who were worried about the end of their lives. Therefore, Dr. Hardt won the star research award of that year, which was unmatched at the moment.
But Hardt was not satisfied with this. He wanted to further improve the effect of perfectionism. Gradually out of control, he began to use living people for research and mastered the mystery. He thought it was the most perfect dose of genetic medicine, but there was an extremely terrible side effect, that is, out of control and infection. Hardt could no longer control out of control of genetic medicine, and finally jumped on an assistant and bit him, The assistant who should have died immediately stood up again in 3 hours and infected more people...
As the captain of the security team, Lehman was ordered to block and clean up all the zombies in Normandy, and his technical supporter Ellie continued to provide genetic drugs to enhance human life activity, so the battle began!
2088070.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, Hungarian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal

2088080.name: KEEK
2088080.about_the_game:
KEEK is a pixel 2D platformer that you could use a special force to change the dimension of objects. Overcome obstacles, disable traps, collect items and face the final challenge.

Feature

  • Fine and detailed pixel art
  • Change dimension, play through impossible levels

  • Hidden elements

This game was originally created for GCORES BOOOM Challenge 2021. A full release version is under development.

2088120.name: Bloodwatch
2088120.about_the_game:
Welcome to Bloodwatch, a short horror survival game developed by Gamingscape.

When going out in a solo adventure, your ship has been sunken by an unexpected storm. You have been washed ashore by a wave. Waking up, you have realized you have been stuck in an unknown island. You search around to see is there any animal or people living in here. After a while, you see a group of people are torturing and beat one of the person to death. They have caught you watching them. You run away as fast as you can, hiding behind a lighthouse. You can hear the cult leader ordering every of his soldiers to find and kill you. You open your backpack, equipping the nightvision.

Now you must plan a tactics, find the weapons on the island, kill the cult leader and all of his soldiers to escape this place.

Find 5 types of weapons scatter around the island : Knife, Axe, Baseball Bat, Handgun, Crossbow.

Each types of weapons have different amount of damage.

You can be tired when running and attacking with melee weapons, so be careful.

Enemies are very strong, don't fight them if there is 2 or more.

Collecting apples to restore your health, each will restore near 1/3 of your health bar.

Finding batteries to replenish your nightvision.

Ammo and arrows are scarce, use it wisely.

Finding 3 types of keys to open locking doors.

Controls:

I for Inventory, click on the weapon icon when you find them to equip or changing them.

E to pickup items.

Reloading gun and crossbow: I to Inventory, click the gun and the bullet magazine icon to reload with gun, click the crossbow then the arrow icon to reload with crossbow

Replenish batteries: I to Inventory, click on the battery icon in the Batteries.

Heal health: Go to Inventory then click at the apple icon.

O for Ingame options, save and exit game.

N for Nightvision, can clear a good amount of heavy fog.

F For Flashlight.

Left and Right Mouse for attacking with melee weapons, shooting gun, crossbow.

W+ Shift to run, W, A , S, D to move.

The saving system: After save, if you die or exit the game, you will be back from the beginning, but still keep all your weapons and items.

If you die without saving, the game ends.

Press ESC to exit the game immediately.

Use the tiny dot in the middle of the screen for easy pickups.

2088160.name: 天外武林 (Traveler of Wuxia)
2088160.about_the_game:
Traveler of Wuxia is a deck-building rogue-lite game that combines the plot twist from the Wuxia novel and the variety of martial arts. This game allows you to explore a Wuxia world that you never experience.

Deck Building and Combo Plays
In this vast Wuxia world, there are hundreds of cards to explore. It may be challenging to learn them all, so choose wisely. In every adventure, you'll encounter new events and martial arts moves to discover. As you find new cards, you'll uncover hidden combos between different cards. Only a true master who learns the martial arts combos can become the champion of the Wuxia world.

Memorable Teammates
In this chaotic world, the young hero must find the lost relic. It's a difficult journey, but you will encounter teammates with different features. Learning your teammate's moves may make the battles easier.

Various Events and Characters
In the Wuxia world of Heluo, hundreds of mysterious events and a diverse array of characters await your exploration. You'll be faced with difficult decisions that influence life and death. However, be cautious, as your teammates may have their thoughts.

Death is only the Beginning
For the hero who possesses the blessing, death is not the end but merely the beginning. With this blessing, you will grow stronger after each demise, even bringing something back that can impact your next adventure.
developers: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司
publishers: 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司

2088170.name: Medal of Guardians
2088170.about_the_game:
For video creators and streamers
STP WORKS permits the use of our games for video distribution to YouTube and other sites, and monetization through video distribution platform partner programs.

Game Overview
In a world where medals have power, players can choose from a variety of jobs, including knight, mage, priest, and archer, to fight monsters and strengthen their characters to their liking. This is an online action shooting game that can be enjoyed alone or with others.

Online Multi Play
There is auto-matching and friend-matching where you can play only with your friends. With auto-matching, you can enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime experience, with friend-matching, you can have fun with your friends, or of course, you can play solo, so you can enjoy the game in your preferred play style.

Job system
You can select a job at any time according to the battle situation from a variety of jobs, such as a tank who serves as a shield for fellow soldiers, a healer who is good at providing support, a job specializing in single attacks, a job specializing in ranged attacks, etc. Select the most suitable job for your battle.

Medal
In this world, power resides in medals, and the power of medals is used to use skills. Medals can be acquired by defeating enemies. Medals are also used to strengthen weapons and armor.

Sphere system
There are two types of spheres: passive spheres, which enhance status, and active spheres, which enable the use of special skills. Each sphere has a level, and the higher the level, the more effective the sphere.

Growth
Each job grows six statuses. In addition, weapons and armor can be strengthened to enhance attack and defense.

Character build
Each of the ten different jobs has different abilities and three unique skills; you can combine the 18 different types of spheres to create a character of your own choice, whether you want to compensate for your weaknesses or enhance your strengths.

2088210.name: Toon Team
2088210.about_the_game:
Toon Team is a multiplayer online 3rd person shooter game with RPG elements, made in a "cartoon" style.

RED or BLUE?

Choose a side of the conflict. And decide who is right.
In one of the many game modes: Team DeathMatch, Classic DeathMatch​, Capture The Flag​, Co-op Base Defense vs. Bots​..

In the game you will find:

  • 20 — types of weapons
  • 4 — classes of fighters
  • 4 — game modes

GameModes:

  • Team Deathmatch
  • Classic DeathMatch (One vs. All)
  • Capture The Flag
  • Co-op Base Defense vs. Bots

Other:

  • Map Editor — create building your maps and playing friends.
  • Text chat — share useful information with the opposing team or write a good joke for your team.
  • Voice Chat — Tell your team about combat tactics or sing them a song.
  • Voting system — if a player on your team violates the rules of communication or behavior, create a vote to decide his fate. Or create a vote to change the map.

Single-player (play the GameModes against/with bots)
Online-Multiplayer (Host and join your friends servers online).
2088210.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Armenian
*languages with full audio support

2088230.name: Ultimate Fishing® Simulator 3
2088230.about_the_game:
Explore open waters, remote rivers, and wild coastlines across five detailed maps. From the slow-moving backwaters of the Mississippi to the dense, unpredictable Baltic Sea, each location offers a unique fishing experience shaped by local species, weather patterns, and the time of day.

Choose from multiple fishing techniques, including float, feeder, spinning & casting. Set up from the shore or cast off from a boat. Track fish with sonar, monitor conditions, and respond to their behavior in real time.

Over 70 species are featured, each modeled with natural movements, random length & weight, and unique traits - some shy and cautious, others powerful and aggressive. Alligator gar? Largemouth bass? Yangtze sturgeon? We got them, and more!

Switch between first - and third-person perspectives or dive below the surface with an underwater camera. Customize your equipment and appearance, level up skills through use, and unlock new options as the journey unfolds. Whether fishing solo, joining a tournament, or building a club with friends, there's always another cast waiting.

Features

  • Float, Feeder, Spinning & Casting
    Core techniques with their gear, strategies, and handling.

  • Play as you like - Freeform Camera System
    Switch between first-person, third-person, and underwater lure view.

  • Rod Handling Modes
    Use Free Mode to stay mobile, then shift into Precision Mode for full control over your rod during the fight. Seamless transitions make fishing feel smooth and responsive.

  • Five Large Maps
    Fish in the Mississippi River (USA), the Yangtze River (China), Stolsko Lake (Poland), Lough Melvin (Ireland), and the Baltic Sea. Each map includes local species, different weather, and distinct spots to discover.

  • Career Mode
    Start from scratch and work your way up to legendary status. Develop your character, train for tournaments, and keep an eye on your calendar to earn serious money efficiently.

  • Dynamic Weather and Seasonal Changes
    Real-time systems affect water conditions, fish behavior, and ambient visuals.

  • Multiplayer and Fishing Clubs
    Team up with friends for casual fishing or form clubs with other players and complete daily, weekly, and seasonal quests to earn club XP. Leveling up unlocks new perks, higher member limits, and XP boosts for playing together on the same server.

  • Season Quests and Events
    Rotating content with time-limited challenges, cosmetic rewards, and progression-based goals. Catch a rare Sichuan taimen? That’s a bonus. Complete seasonal tasks or long-term career quests to unlock gear, upgrades, or new areas - sometimes it’s about landing fish, other times just showing up and getting things done.

  • Tournaments
    Event-based fishing with live leaderboards, rewards, and varied formats. Catch the biggest fish - or the smallest. Compete with others and reel in the prizes!

  • Property Ownership and Customization
    Buy a Lodge! Customize it and use it for storage, travel, or passive income.

  • Functional Sonars
    Use sonar to locate and follow fish beneath the surface in real time.

  • Boats & Customization 
    Use and upgrade boats to access remote areas and deeper waters.

  • Character Customization
    Includes outfits, hairstyles, and tattoos with visual presence in gameplay and multiplayer.

  • Advanced Fish AI
    Species react to bait, line tension, and environmental factors with lifelike responses, from cautious strikes to full-on fights.

2088400.name: Fast Royal
2088400.about_the_game:
High Intensity Battle Royale Experience

Fast Royal is a battle royale game that distills the adrenaline of traditional titles into their most intense final moments. You drop straight into the action, with the storm already closing in. There's no time to waste! Run, gear up, and fight to be the last one standing.

Fully Destructible Arena

In Fast Royal, everything around you can be destroyed! Walls, cover, and even the ground beneath your feet. There’s nowhere to hide for long. The battlefield is constantly changing, forcing you to stay on the move, adapt, and fight in the open.

Upgrade System – Weapons & Characters

Fast Royal features an advanced upgrade system that allows players to enhance both their weapons and their robotic character during matches. Instead of relying on traditional loot mechanics, players collect "mechanical points" by opening loot crates or defeating enemies. These points can be spent in real-time to improve:

  • Weapons – Increasing damage, fire rate, ammo capacity, and efficiency.

  • Character Stats – Boosting health, shields, speed, agility, energy, and overall performance.

This mechanic adds a RPBA progression (Role Playing Battle Arena) within a battle royale setting, offering deep customization and adaptability mid-game.

Energy Management – The Key to Survival

In Fast Royal, robots run on energy, which is essential for all functions, including movement and combat. Energy must be replenished using batteries, which can be found in loot crates or dropped by defeated enemies.

Energy serves as the core survival resource, meaning that players must:

  • Strategically manage movement and abilities to avoid running out of power.

  • Prioritize collecting batteries while securing kills and loot.

Balance offense and defense to conserve resources.

Q: Will the game be updated with more content in the future?

Q: I've encountered some issues or bugs in the game, what should I do?

4 characters with different combat styles: the balanced Buckler, ranged Archer, heavy hitting Claymore, and agile Assassin. Each has unique attacks and abilities as well as robust action mechanics like dodging, gurading, and parrying.

Up to 4 player online Co-Op. Play with friends or use matchmaking to team up with random players. Special co-op tasks and items provide a more fun experience.

2088710.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1984 for the ZX Spectrum, this classic surreal platformer saw players take on the role of Pud Pud, a bizzare yellow ball-like creature with wings and a giant chomping mouth, trying to survive in the appropriately named Weird World. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version.

Gameplay

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options
2088710.reviews:
“At first glance this looks like a platform game but it isn't really. True, there are platforms around, but they are really there to create a simple form of maze. The game is simple too, flap or walk your way round until you find a randomly hidden pudding, eat it and another will appear somewhere else in the maze of interlinked screens. Keep you energy up by eating flying things, whilst avoiding eating anything else as that just decreases your energy. As a result the game is very playable [...] Graphically it is very good with nice animation and the large maze characters add to the atmosphere. Sound, too, is good, with a powerful synthesiser tune at the start. I enjoyed it”

2089250.name: Alpha Response
2089250.about_the_game:
From Gooseman, the inventor of the original Counter-Strike mod, comes Alpha Response, a fast paced singleplayer / co-op experience that puts you in the boots of elite police forces worldwide. Inspired by arcade action games from the 90s, such as, Virtua Cop, Time Crisis, the firefights in Alpha Response are very dynamic and will push the player to their limits.

Respond to critical situations requiring surgical precision to save innocent lives. Every decision matters in a world where threats lurk around every corner. Bring justice to criminals and terrorists that are bringing chaos to the streets using a wide arsenal of weapons and equipment.

Join a global police initiative battling cross-border criminal syndicates. Choose your elite unit and take the fight to the enemy.

Team up with 3 friends in explosive 4-player co-op or take on the challenge solo with AI controlled teammates. Coordination and fast reflexes are key - your survival depends on it.

Alpha Response features heart-racing dynamic missions from hostage rescues to bomb threats with multiple approaches to tackle each mission. Enemies spawn differently each time and can enter the mission by vehicle or on foot and the player will need to be aware of his surroundings at all times.

Fight across massive, detailed environments from city streets and massive metro stations to towering cathedrals and industrial complexes. Navigate indoor and outdoor battlegrounds teeming with civilians who need your protection.

Face a lethal variety of opponents - hardened criminals, attack dogs, flying drones, armored vehicles, and helicopter gunships. Each threat demands unique tactics to overcome and you'll always be kept on your toes throughout the mission.

Dominate with an extensive arsenal from sidearms to heavy weaponry. Deploy shields, grenades, and vehicles to gain the tactical edge. Every tool is essential for mission success.

2089280.name: Noisy Neighbor
2089280.about_the_game:
For a while, your downstairs, noise-sensible, irate neighbor has been turning your life into a living hell. At the slightest amount of noise he just happened to end up hearing, he assumed you as the culprit, with furious complaints and violent threats.

As of now, you finally managed to be able to move out into a new apartment. But before that happens you decided to give a little farwell “present” to that infamous neighbor of yours: the biggest, noisiest party you’ve ever seen, something to seriously push his buttons.

Between you and him, who’s to end up being the noisiest neighbor?

IT’S TIME TO PARTY!
During daytime you must set up your apartment to turn into the greatest party kingdom ever. Stock up on food, add some ornaments and select from a wide variety of gadgets to spice up your place.

Time and resources are short though. Each time you play there’ll be different challenges and conditions to meet.

Put balloons, boomboxes and karaoke machines at the most appropriate spots around your home as quickly as possible, thinking how the best the party flow can be. And don’t forget to add as many noise makers as possible!

PARTY ALL NIGHT LONG!
As nightfall approaches, your guests will begin arriving at your apartment to have a good time! But so will your neighbor to ruin the fun.

It’s your job to walk around your apartment to keep your table filled with refreshments and music loud and clear. Greet and dance with your guests and make sure everyone is happy. The more people are enjoying your party, the more will come to check it out. The famed Party King might come for a visit if you're worthy of it.

That grumpy neighbor won’t have any of it, though. He will be roaming around your home, breaking your equipment and attempting to scare away your guests. You better not forget to gather your arsenal of traps to halt his movements. Because if he catches you, you’re gonna get it. And nothing ruins a party more than a series of serious concussions and a broken leg.

Azami Fukurai

Ayumu Meguriya

Center Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center, and Level S psychic. Avoids onsite research due to his wheelchair, but can divine oddities' true forms with his clairvoyant abilities.

Jasmine

Real name: Yasumi Tomarigi. Onsite investigator at the Urban Myth Dissolution Center. Her unmotivated part-timer attitude hides an unexplained wealth of skills including driving, close combat and surveillance ops.

Hakaba-Bunko

A game creator team based in Japan, whose core members are long-time aficionados of mystery-themed content. The team creates adventure games that explore innovative forms of pixel art, and is renowned for their game series, "Makoto Wakaido's Case Files".

Winning the Shueisha Game Creators CAMP award at Google Play Indie Games Festival 2021 led to a close collaboration with Shueisha Games and the birth of "Urban Myth Dissolution Center".

[From the Creators]

Do you believe in urban myths? Some of them may be mere rumors, but some might just be true. It's that ambiguity that keeps us coming back. We've tried to recreate that feel for this game itself, aiming to create a game that spreads through word of mouth and lives on in the public mind, beyond individual lives and memories.

Do you enjoy exploring urban myths? Do you have what it takes to uncover the truth? The Urban Myth Dissolution Center would love to hear from you! COme join our fun and friendly teaM. Prior ExpeRIence optional. Great welfare perks! Just sHow up and smile! TraiNing sessiOns Widely available.

Hear the voice in your head that haunts and tortures you. Follow its commands to the edge of the world. Embrace the darkness in Dark Atlas: Infernum, a first-person horror experience where you must remember who you are, stop the apocalypse, and face your demons.

As Natalia Asensio, Grand Master of an ancient esoteric order, society collapses around you with the appearance of ghosts and the shattering of dimensional barriers. Trapped in a dusty basement, drugged and barely remembering your identity, you must engage in a battle of wills that could open the gates of hell.

• Psychological Survival Horror: Navigate intertwining physical and mental realities as you embody Natalia, a leader with deep esoteric knowledge, not a soldier. Be cautious and cunning to survive.

• Immersive Terror: Experience terror in various forms—hide in shadowy corridors, listen for footsteps, watch flickering lights, and analyze every room to stay hidden and safe.

• Rich Narrative: Engage with a complex and independent story, part of the expansive Radiata Saga transmedia universe, which includes books, podcasts, and more.
• Stunning Artistry: Enjoy meticulously crafted graphics and immersive audio designed to captivate and terrify.

2089640.name: Lost Color
2089640.about_the_game:
Lost Color

Developed by indie game development team Aleph Studio, Lost Color is a 2D flatformer action adventure metropolitana genre game that tells the story of a Synus continent that has lost its color under absolute king rule.

Stepping into the world of Lost Color, the player opens his eyes on the Synus continent with no memory and goes on a journey to regain his or her memory, encountering various characters, hearing their voices suffering from repression of freedom, fighting against the king with unique and unique monsters, and writing a moving adventure to reclaim lost colors for all.

Game Features

  • The free movement of the protagonist, such as movement, jumping, rolling, rushing, and grappling, shows the experience beyond the manipulation you want.
  • The protagonist's beliefs that change depending on your choice will affect his skills, appearance, and story in the future. Find your own beliefs!
  • Explore more than 10 unique villages or regions of the Sinus and become a wonderful explorer of the Synus!
  • There are more than 35 different monsters and about 15 bosses waiting for your battle on the Synus continent.
  • The delicate narratives and conversations of more than 50 NPCs provide a rich game story and immersion.
  • You can mount a wide range of weapons, from melee to long range weapons, replace them in real time, and create your own style of combat!
  • Survive in a combination of more than 15 different mounting items.

2089710.name: A Most Extraordinary Gnome
2089710.about_the_game:
A short adventure awaits!


Waking up every day as the forest's only protector is not an easy job for anyone. There's not only every animal's personal problem a gnome has to deal with — as mysteriously dark, unprecedented things start happening in the forest; the source of which no one really understands. Fear, escaping and destruction taint the previously peaceful life of the animals. Seemingly only one can stop this — but what can a single gnome really do to save the world?

A Most Extraordinary Gnome is a short, narrative-driven game, which combines challenging and unique 2D action with complex storytelling. You control a small gnome, who uses his hat to defeat the dangers he encounters in increasingly intense stages.

The features of the game


  • Unlike anything you've seen in indie gaming!
    A colorful and vibrant 2D world, made entirely out of hand crafted paper cut-out elements
  • Gameplay tailored just to you
    Whether you're looking for a laid-back experience or a harder challenge, gameplay settings are there to accommodate your needs!
  • A deep story!
    There's more than what just meets the eye. Embark on a short journey which will lead you to unexpected places.
  • Confront the dangers facing the forest!
    Fight multiple distinctive bosses, each with its own challenge!
  • Meet the dwellers of the forest!
    Your house is home to a diverse group of animals, each with its own look at the world and you.
  • A memorable score!
    The game features a unique, Eastern-European inspired soundtrack, which dynamically changes based on the level of threat your character is facing at the moment.

A world made out of paper


As a rare sight in gaming, the entire adventure comes alive with the help of paper. Anything you see in the game is made by hand, stacking layers of colorful paper on each other to create this flat, but heavily detailed aesthetic the game. Utilizing traditional stop-motion techniques wherever necessary, the movements also get a unique flair specific to this game.

We hope you enjoy this hand-crafted adventure!

2089750.name: Super Spyroxo Adventures: Island of Dnfoo
2089750.about_the_game:
Classic side scroller arcade adventure retro 2d game "Super Spyroxo Adventures: Island of Dnfoo" . This game brings back memories of old school arcade games with numerous adventure. World of this game contains well designed levels, various enemies, bosses, simple gameplay, nice pixelart graphics fun music and sounds.

On beautiful sunny day our hero Spyroxo Jack and his wife Jill were eating apples together and enjoying life and suddenly bad cavemen called "DNFOO" group appeared from deep jungles of the island. These evil mosters captured Jack's wife and ran away. Jack is on adventure to rescue his wife by defeating cavemen & dinosaurs and teach them a lesson.

To bring Spyroxo Jack's wife back he needs your help. Run ,shoot and jump through the different island environments, avoid traps, clear all enemies in your way and defeat all bosses. This game will give you classic feel with side scrolling view, with classic gameplay, simple yet beautiful pixelart graphics, easy and intuitive controls, many weapons to unlock, each level with unique graphics and epic boss battles.

The game use Steam Leaderboard to save players scores, you can see it in the game community, so the high score you will see in the game is the top score found in that leaderboard, make sure to try to defeat that score with yours, the final boss will gives you 10000 score points if you can defeat it too, and once you have finished the game you can click on new game to restart and guess what, you can keep all the weapons you have unlocked even in very first level, so you can get a better score this time.
