2089770.name: House of Pain
2089770.about_the_game:
Swing your machete into a pixel gore-drenched Arcade Horror experience. Survive the House of Pain!


Your family has been abducted by a deranged doctor from Hell. Only your unstoppable brutality can save them!



Butcher your way through twisted nightmare armies of Zombies, Devil Dogs, Chainsaw Wielding Sickos, Mutated Human Experiments, and Rotting Corpses. Slash down the rot and gore with extreme prejudice.



Following a daring prison break, your sole focus is to rescue your family. The world is not how you left it! You must explore this nightmarish world of grotesque and bizarre creatures, all ready to tear you limb from limb.

Battle through a variety of different landscapes, overcoming gruesome pixel art foes and deadly traps. Find and wield a range of deadly weapons, including a chainsaw, axe, machete, shotgun and flame thrower, or rely on your fists and powerful flying kick.



  • Gore filled fast-paced hack and slash gameplay, with the authenticity of classic arcade games.
  • Huge 2D pixel sprites depicting legions of twisted monsters, huge sub-boss creatures and gore dripping mega bosses.
  • Unleash punches, flying kicks and wield deadly weapons, including a chainsaw, axe, machete, shotgun and flame thrower.
  • Battle through a variety of detailed environments; swampland, haunted mansion, rooms of pain, underground dungeons and the mad doctor’s lair.
  • Authentic Arcade pixel aesthetic with modern touches like screen shake, particle effects, 2D physics and multi-layered parallax backgrounds.

2089780.name: Robo50
2089780.about_the_game:
Law and order have broken down, crime rules the streets, and no one is safe! In desperation, the city mayor calls upon a unique cop, a cop with a single remit, to use excessive force to eliminate the gangs and clean up the streets.

Unleash an armoury of enhanced weapons and take out the thugs in a baptism of bullets and fire, all in the name of freedom, safety and job satisfaction!




Liberate the mayhem-filled streets of the city, destroy gang hideouts and weapon stores, track down the criminal kingpin’s lair and show him the colour of his insides! Lay waste to the criminal underworld in this retro arcade shooter. Run, jump, take cover and deliver your own brand of shock and awe law and order!



Robo50: Suit up the mechanised Robo50 body armour system, fully loaded with unique weaponry and special attacks designed to dispatch even the toughest of criminal lowlife.

Overpowered Weaponry: Machine guns, laser weapons, rockets, grenades, flame throwers and more. Shoot, detonate, blast and explode your way through endless hordes of gang thugs and their scumbag bosses.

Massive Body Count: Just like the action movies of the 80s, the body count will be extreme and unrelenting.

Arcade Quality: 16-bit pixel art graphics, hand-drawn animations, fluid 60-FPS gameplay, and an epic soundtrack.

12 Huge Levels: Gritty, graffiti-strewn cityscape, junkyard battle, gang hideouts, underground metro system, each with its own gang boss to eliminate.

2089790.name: V3: KOMMANDO (Tech Preview)
2089790.about_the_game:
This technical test for Kommando is meant to stress test the current build and get player feedback about basic mechanics, movement, and gunplay. The vision for Kommando is centred around "back to basics" competitive gameplay where players will experience tactical, team-based gameplay in settings from around the world while playing as some of the most recognized and prestigious counter-terrorism and law enforcement units. The core experience will revolve around small team operations in a highly competitive multiplayer setting where communication and tactics matter.

This game is being developed by a small development team with the assistance of competitive FPS players to bring you the most authentic experience possible.

2089820.name: Wolfstar Adventures in the Inu System
2089820.about_the_game:
Take control of the young cargo runner, Wolfstar and his companion Bun-E in this sci-fi action adventure platformer. As part of the crew of The Zero Sun, a starship run by the distinguished Captain Olive, travel to various worlds in the Inu System.


Talk to a colorful cast of NPCs to discover the mystery behind the disappearance of the heirs to the Pug Empire.


Explore sprawling sci-fi environments, fighting enemies and unlocking upgrades that will help you defeat the boss of each dungeon.

2089830.name: Beat Slayer
2089830.about_the_game:
Beat Slayer is a roguelite hack n’ slay game like no other. Instead of just being in the background the music takes centre stage.
Join Mia, a badass music lover and crafty tinkerer, as she battles hordes of robots in a dystopian 90s-inspired Berlin. There’s only one rule:

Fight to the rhythm!

Every move you make has to match the rhythm of the soundtrack. Fail to do so and you’ll pay the price. No button mashing, no frantic inputs. Only smooth and skillful gameplay will lead to your victory against the waves of different enemies and imposing bosses!

Show them your moves!

Leverage Mia’s nimble move set and decide within seconds which of your moves you should use. Dash to engage or disengage? Attack to build up your drive bar or spread your status effects? Kick your enemies against walls or into each other? The choice is yours!

Slay it your way!

Each run plays differently and is influenced by your playstyle and your thrill for risks, but also by your starting weapon, your chosen upgrades and your growing skill set.

Berlin Attitude

Rely on your unconventional team of rebels as you navigate through a robot-controlled and corrupted Berlin. Discover the city's diverse locations, from underground bunkers to towering rooftops, while your allies assist with weapons, upgrades, and valuable insights.

Get in the flow!

Put on your headphones, sync with the beat and dive more and more into the action to enter the “flow state”. Don’t think and just play. Let the music guide you and create your own symphony of destruction round, after round, after round!

A superb art direction blended with intense, frenetic rogue-like action and a pumping techno soundtrack make this a mixtape worth digging out the headphones for. It’s not a perfect record, owing to a lighter story and the odd combat quirk, but it’s one worth having in the collection.”
8/10 – Fingerguns

2089890.name: REPLICORE
2089890.about_the_game:
CO-OP ACTION FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS

In search of digital salvation, your crew of mercenaries finds itself stranded on a long abandoned planet, harboring a deep secret at its heart. Fight your way through deserted ruins - alone or in a team of up to four! Transform into your Core to roll, dash, and drift through the air. When a teammate is in a Core, launch them into the action or pull them out of tight spots to overcome the challenges of the dangerous ruins.

You have your crew in your hand!

SHIFT INTO THE CORE

  • You are not bound to your body - Switch from human to Core and vice versa at any time. Roll, dash and drift through the air to take advantage of your Core's advanced mobility.

  • You throw your crew to the target - Grab a teammate as a Core and toss them into otherwise unreachable locations.

  • You chose your path - The levels in REPLICORE are designed for versatile use of your Cores. Roll through the ventilations system, solve puzzles and blast though walls to open new paths. Be creative with your Core!

  • You are the grenade - Use the Cores in combat to gain the upper hand in battle. Let teammates pull you out of though situations or throw you into tactical positions. Against special opponents, you can use the Outburst explosion in an ultimate offensive strike.

EXPLORE ANCIENT RUINS

  • Handcrafted Missions - Challenge the ancient ruins of KOLEHO, a desert planet shrouded in mystery! Each ruin offers a unique and highly replayable gameplay experience. Explore fallen temples, forgotten cities, abandoned factories as you uncover the secrets of this world.

  • Dangerous Guardians - Beware of the mechanical guardians that dwell in the ruins - remnants of an ancient civilization gone rogue. Each enemy type has unique tactics and actions - coordinate your equipment to resist them.

  • Hidden Mysteries - The ruins hold hidden paths, mechanisms and puzzles that you will need to solve in order to progress. Teamwork is key— only by working together can you uncover the ruin’s deepest secrets.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CORE

  • No fixed classes - You will earn experience points and high-tech ressources to upgrade your Core. Customize your weapons, equipment and abilities with Core modifications and define your role in the team.

  • Roll up in style - The Core represents you in REPLICORE. Unlock different cosmetic parts for your Core by completing missions. Mix and match the casing and other components and give it your desired look.

2089980.name: Extremely Powerful Capybaras

2089990.name: Dash The Fox & Three Dreadful Pigs
2089990.about_the_game:
Dash is a small fox born in dark Riddle Wood forest. In the game you get into his role of a teenage forest guardian who is always up to something crazy. He sticks his nose to literally anything, that is out of normal. One day he discovers a secret base of three pigs that lived in the same forest for years. His brain immediately invents tons of theories and he's keen enough to uncover their secret business. At first he thinks he is a normal fox living in a normal forest with basic pigs, but what he discover, will blow his mind. Take Dash on an unforgettable journey through the Riddlewood and expose the three "little" pig's true identity.

Features


  • Discover multiple locations in the forest, even those, that were hidden from the rest of the forest animals.
  • Jump and smack enemies
  • Solve hidden Riddlewood mysteries
  • Race and run
  • Enjoy the minecart ride
  • Discover and try new game mechanics

2090030.name: BlackBox
2090030.about_the_game:
BlackBox is about an air crash investigator in the 90s, you are seated at your office desk where you go through mundane work until you stumble upon an old mysterious and tragic case which took place in 1982. Sift through files, search the database by typing relevant keywords, and listen to the cockpit voice recordings and case interviews in order to gather data to find out what happened. A game that asks you to listen.

Solve the mystery through careful examination of evidence in this investigative journey.

How does it work?

2090040.name: Odium
2090040.about_the_game:
Odium is A fast paced Action Roguelike,
following Chris's life as a bullied child, in a subtle and parodic interpretation of his subconscious release of anger and frustration from his life inside his dreams.

Gameplay

Battle your way through each room by defeating powerful enemies!

Collect coins and abilities to create the best build to fit your playstyle!
Face and defeat Chad - the big boss!

Story

Odium follows the life of Chris, a young student who is being bullied for as long as he can remember.

Chris's Dad left long ago and even though his mom is there, present in the moment, she is distant emotionally and not supportive, actually making things worse.
In his dreams, Chris is back at school and his life hardships manifest as monsters.
But in his dreams, Chris has the power to fight back! and defeat the monsters!

Battle your way to Chad, the big boss! defeat him, and break free from all the bullying and suffering!

Features

* Fast paced combat

* Use powerful abilities combination to destroy your enemies
* 4 unique starting points to increase playability
* Over 10 unique abilities, and over 60 ability combinations
* Each failure is a chance to try a different ability and progress the story

Side Note

Odium is our Graduation Project from Tiltan School of Design & Visual Communication.

We made the game in our free time, with love!
All assets, models, textures, and sounds were created by our small team.
We hope you enjoy playing Odium, we encourage you to question your actions and we challenge you to see the unspoken message in Odium.

2090050.name: Girls vs Zombies
2090050.about_the_game:
Description:
This is a third-person wave based shooter game. You survive waves of zombies to see how high of a wave you can make it to.
Enemies increase in difficulty as the wave’s progress. Also, when you reach the 6th wave, the game enters into friendly fire mode. There are no more cooperatives and you can kill NPC's and other players. Also the weapons of area damage and mass destruction become activated.
The number of enemies scales along with the number of players in the game.
You earn points by shooting & killing enemies.
Players can spend their points on weapons, doors, or anything else you want to charge points for.

Features:
- Full Online Multiplayer Support
- 3rd Person Point of View
- Multiplayer, Host/Join sessions with server browser
- Pre-Game Lobby (with character & level select)
- In Game Chat System
- Settings Menu for Video, Sound and Difficult Level Options
- Points System (used as the currency in-game to spend on opening doors, buying weapons)
- Random Weapon Box (grants player a random weapon for set amount of points)
- Enemies (Basic "zombie" & "Boss zombie"), with random basic behavior and model.
- NPC's on game some friendly and some aggressive, they even change moods when you shoot them.
- Spectating & Respawn System
- Power-Up Drops
- Interactions with weapons, doors, pickups, etc
& Much More Secrets to be discovered!

Gampelay Hints:
- Hold Tab Key on keyboard to show Input Keys and scoreboard
- At start you only have one map, the city map, to gain access to others maps you must play as single player and reach level 10 or kill all government members on city (kill npc on government place after level 6) to initiate the mass destruction sequence, then reach plane and wait for the pilot or aboard the boat and reach the door in it to escape.
- You start with empty hands, you can hit zombies by melee punch but is recommended to return to house and grab any weapon that can help you
- The maps always stores some secrets like hidden weapons or points where you can hide, also look for portals to escape
- To complete a wave you must kill all the zombies, if you missed some zombies before level 5 dont worry they will find you by surprise, then level 6 in advance you always need to search for the remains hidden ones
- Every map has is own way to escape after level 10 as a single player but you may find out how to escape and survive, most of the time the markers show you the way to transport or portals.
- Locators are placed at points of interest on the map, they are visible from a distance for orientation on every map
- Every wave level increase the difficult, more zombies and fast speed
- After wave level 6 the cooperative modes ends, you can kill and be killed by others players, also you can hurt NPC's, but be aware they can hurt you back
- After wave level 6 Random Boxes give you different types of weapons
- After wave level 10 the Mass Extinction events activates

2090140.name: Power Ball 2022

Power Ball 2022 continues the excitement of its predecessor but with newer graphics and a polished space environmental back drop.

You will take on 50 levels of increasing difficulty to try to amass the points needed to reach the top of the leader board in this modern retro take of the classic bat / ball and brick breaking genre.

Keep your eye on the main ball and save it from destruction as you traverse space portals and collect powerups to help you clear the stage of alien blocks.

* Obstacles to either avoid or utilize

2090150.name: Furry Sex: Poker 🃏♥️

Furry Sex: Poker  is a dating-sim-styled game where you have to beat your opponents in poker. Watch both your cards and your opponents carefully in order to determine which move should you do next.

Your best bet would be on concentrating on one enemy per game. Once you beat one, there is an animated Live 2D sex scene in the Galley waiting for you.

Beat all of your opponents in poker to open all the animated scenes from the galley and be the best poker player at the table!

Push the ball of wool in the correct tiles to pass the levels!



💯 handcrafted levels.

2090170.name: Abigor
2090170.about_the_game:
In the world of Abigor, humans must constantly live with the threat of demon invasions from another realm. Their vicious and unpredictable attacks have claimed entire cities. To combat this, humans have specialized themselves into powerful demon hunters. Our story follows Alric, a young demon hunter who attends Alastor Academy. There are only three more days until graduation, yet strange events and numerous demon sightings have began to worry Alastor's principle, Headmaster Neithardt. Follow the story of Alric as he goes through the Forest, the Crypt, and Hell itself on a mission to slay demonkind and protect Alastor Academy! Will you, be able to fend off the demon hordes, figure out their weaknesses, and protect your school all in time to graduate?

Abigor features traditional third-person action combat with a focus on dodging to survive. Additionally, Alric has the ability to use powerful enhancement magic that lets him switch his fighting style! Use the strong Dark Stance, the nimble Serpent Stance, or the ranged Light Stance. Choosing the right stance depending on the foe is key to victory. These stances can be freely swapped between, but keep in mind to manage your mana, or else you won't be able to use any magic. Slay demon after demon within the Forest, the Crypt, and even Hell itself on your journey to protect humanity!

Abigor was made by a passionate student team. Thank you for playing!

2090180.name: Project Possession
2090180.about_the_game:
A two weeks Jam Game


This project is the result of a 2 week internal Game Jam done by a small, passionate and dedicated team of devs from Colombia. We used this as an opportunity to challenge ourselves into creating something fun, simple and polished.

We hope you have as much fun with it as we did crafting it.

The Game


"Project Possession" is a 3D top down competitive 'Enter the Gungeon" type of game where the objective is to eliminate more monsters than your rivals in PvE arenas filled with enemies and traps.

Up to 4 players can join a match. Each player starts out as a "Ghost" who must possess monsters in order to use their abilities to rack up more monster kills. Each monster has different types of movement, attacks and HPs.

Ranged attacks are strong but will consume mana. Melee attacks are weak and will refill mana.

The player that has the most points when time runs out is the winner.

Support


We will make improvements to the game and it will continue to be developed.

  • UI/UX improvements
  • New mechanics and improvements in Gameplay

2090200.name: Cryogenesis
2090200.about_the_game:
You play as a man named Roger Bennett who wakes up in a cryo room inside a big laboratory 50 years after the collapse of civilization and the possible extinction of the human race.

It's your duty to discover what is hidden in that mysterious place. Will there be more humans alive? Has the destiny of the human race come to an end?

The hope of finding something to continue living for remains latent.

EQUIP YOURSELF WITH THE BEST WEAPONS

Survival inside the bunker will not be easy. Choose the best weapons to defeat the different enemies you meet along the way. All with different behaviors and attacks.

Survival inside the lab will not be easy. Choose the best weapons to defeat the different enemies you meet along the way. All with different behaviors and attacks.

MANAGE YOUR INVENTORY

You will have a limited number of slots to store your items. Take the ones you consider most important for your advancement. The rest, you will have to leave them in a trunk.

DIFFICULTY LEVELS:

Play to enjoy the narrative and scenarios or to turn your adventure into a real nightmare where death will always be near you.

OBSERVE, LEARN AND INTERPRET:

In this kind of games there are no dialogues. There will be some text and notes but most of the story you will have to interpret for yourself. Will you have the ability to decipher the great mysteries hidden in this gigantic lab? You can't trust anyone but yourself.

PUZZLES, TRAPS AND LOTS OF EXPLORATION

If you enjoy having your mind, memory, and creative skills tested, you'll have enough to solve different puzzles and obstacles to advance in your adventure. Be careful, the enemies will not be your only concern.

CONTROLLER SUPPORT:

If you don't want to use the mouse and keyboard to advance in your adventure, you can play with a joystick.

2090390.name: Schrödinger's Call
2090390.about_the_game:
When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time?

In that final moment, if you could accompany souls wandering between life and death, what words would you choose to share with them?

Schrödinger’s Call gently unfolds a picture-book-like world.

It speaks softly to your heart, helping you notice what truly matters, once more.

Through the lingering regrets of others, we hope this story quietly shines a light on you too.

Story Overview

Twenty-one nanoseconds separate life from death.

The moon is about to fall, and only a moment remains before everything ends.

Mary wakes up in a strange room, her memories gone.

Guided by a mysterious cat named Hamlet, she becomes the “World’s Last Confidant.”

With a single phone by her side, Mary listens to the voices on the other end.

To the lives they lived, and the moments they left behind, just before the moon fell.

A Phone Call That Saves Souls

Phone calls left unfinished by the falling moon. Voices of those still trapped between life and death, waiting for someone to pick up the phone again.

Words left unsaid, feelings never realized, and the people they wished they could see one last time.

As Mary notes down these lingering regrets, chapter by chapter, she walks alongside the voices on the other end—and perhaps, you begin to see what truly matters as well.

How will Mary listen to the words of souls still wandering between life and death?

How will she walk alongside them?

And with only twenty-one nanoseconds left before the world ends, what words would you choose to share with them?

2090600.name: Thistlemine
2090600.about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME


Thistlemine is a puzzle exploration RPG. You play as Noa, a low-ranking excavator, whose task is to navigate and clear out an Exclusion Zone.

The Miasma emitting from the Exclusion Zone is causing distortions in time and space, while simultaneously suffocating and mutating what little life remains in the region. Rumours of a powerful artifact have attracted many souls to its location. Not one has returned.

Inside the Exclusion Zone awaits a massive garden labyrinth, the mutated remains of those who have come before, and the guardian Anomalis who've made the land their home.

Noa is outnumbered and ill-equipped for the task, and the conditions for survival are unfair. Armed with the ability to repeat short windows of time, only through patience, persistence, and planning will she find a glimpse of victory.

THE EXCLUSION ZONE


Inside the Exclusion Zone is a number of disorienting and deceptive puzzles. There is a total of 7 major areas, each with many secrets to discover, and various combat encounters to overcome.

Depending on decisions made, resources used, or curiosity in solving areas in different ways, small variations may present themselves. These variations range from greater challenges, extra resources, additional story details, or knowledge of more efficient routes throughout the garden.

THE EXCAVATORS


As you navigate the Exclusion Zone, you will find members of the Excavation Corps. As they've spent too much time exposed to the Miasma, most of them are on the verge of death, or mutated beyond saving. However, some are still willing to help until their last breath.

Potential allies can be recruited into the party, or killed where they stand. The choice is yours.

THE ANOMALIS


Exclusion Zones are home to Miasma lifeforms known as Anomalis. They've taken the likeness of plants and flowers in this region.

During combat, Anomalis produce varying amounts of Miasma, limiting the amount of turns you have in any given battle. Combined with a diverse arsenal of lethal abilities and overwhelming numbers, defeating them is no easy task. There are over 40 unique encounters, many with multiple phases and subroute variations, all demanding a different strategy from the last.

THE ARTIFACTS


Defeating enemies will sometimes reward Artifacts. Artifacts provide anything from powerful buffs, permanent stat bonuses, new skills, or an active ability.

The stronger Anomalis specifically reward unique artifacts necessary to conquer the Exclusion Zone. These are complex in both function and in application, providing new combat strategies, skill synergies, and attack strings. Figuring out how to use them in each battle can feel like a puzzle in itself, especially in combination with various turn limits and different enemy groups.

ADDITIONAL MODES


Thistlemine comes with 3 modes: Standard Mode, Regimental Mode, and the Temporal Rift.

Standard Mode is the normal gameplay experience. Checkpoints are plenty, dialogue and choices are enabled, there are minimal consequence for losing, and you can progress at your own pace.

Regimental Mode serves as a time attack variation to Thistlemine's gameplay, encouraging strategies and routes to save both turns and time, with a limit of 2 hours to clear the game. Some adjustments have been made to save as many frames as possible. Though completely optional, it is the canonical Thistlemine experience.

The Temporal Rift is equivalent to a dev room. It is unlocked by default. Players can use it to experiment with various mechanics and to further optimize their routes. This mode will feature additional challenges and cut content in future updates.

少年的冒险从来都不是单打独斗！精美的人物设计满足年轻化的审美，细腻的台词对话让玩家在充满紧张感的解谜氛围下，感受一场充满友情、坚持和梦想的冒险旅程。

2090700.name: WikiArena
2090700.about_the_game:
Let Wikipedia articles battle it out in the arena and predict the winner!



Each round pits two random Wikipedia articles against each other. Your task: Guess which article is longer or gets more views. Oh, and you have to pick the category as well based on what you think is the safer bet.

🌐 The game requires an internet connection to retrieve the Wikipedia data.
🎮 Fully playable with a dual-stick controller: right stick to point, R2 to click.

Game Modes

  • Arena: The "roguelike" mode. Try to reach 10 correct predictions before being wrong 3 times!
  • Endless: How many predictions can you get right before being wrong 3 times?
  • VS WikiBot: Play "last one standing" against a WikiBot that progressively gets better at playing the game the more you win. Can you beat WikiBot MK 25?
  • Daily Arena: An arena run that's the same for all players each day. Do you think you can read the internet's collective mind better than your friends?
  • Streamer VS Chat: Play against your favorite Twitch streamer (or against your chat if you're a streamer yourself)!
  • Local 1 VS 1: Challenge a friend to a hotseat duel!

Features

  • ♾️ Literally infinite content: Wikipedia grows every day and with it the archive the game's article randomizer can pick from. You'll never play the same run twice!
  • 📈 Statistics: Get a neat one-screen overview of your current run anytime!
  • 📊 Meta statistics: The game records how many 10-win runs you had, your highest endless score ever, and all your recent results.
  • ⚙️ Customization: Embrace the full chaos of the archive or customize your experience by e.g. having disambiguations or very obscure articles filtered out!
  • 🐦 Battle tweets: Generate a sharable tweet visualizing the most interesting result after every duel via a single click!
  • ⏱️ Optional "speedrun" timer: How quickly can you finish a 10/10 stars Arena run?
  • 💬 Multi-language support: English, German, Spanish and Japanese are fully translated. Wiki content is supported for even more languages (Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, Hindi, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Ukrainian).
  • 🏆 Steam-exclusive: Achievements and leaderboards!

Who would make this and why?

Fabian Fischer (@Ludokultur) created the game to start exploring the "trivia roguelike" genre. Games such as Wordle or Babble Royale show how much the "free depth" of language itself can be used for game design purposes. WikiArena applies a similar approach, using the "internet's meta" as its core language.

Diamond SkeeBall isn't just a game—it's a powerful community engagement tool designed exclusively for live streamers. Bring the nostalgia of the boardwalk arcade directly to your broadcast and give your viewers the controller!

Whether you need a high-energy intermission, a raid-friendly welcome event, or a fun way to reward your community, Diamond SkeeBall turns passive viewers into active players.

🎮 TRUE INTERACTIVITY

Forget about overlay extensions that require external downloads. Diamond SkeeBall connects directly to your Twitch chat.

Chat Commads: Viewers simply type `!roll` to join the queue and launch a ball.

Channel Points Integration: Seamlessly syncs with your Twitch Channel Points. Let your loyal subs redeem points for "Multi-Balls" (x2, x3) or even change the entire game machine mode on the fly!

Custom Physics: Every roll is calculated with real-time physics, ensuring no two shots are ever the same.

🏆 COMMUNITY COMPETITION

Spark a friendly rivalry in your chat!

Live Leaderboards: The game tracks lifetime scores for every single user. Who will be your channel's SkeeBall Champion?

Personalized Skins: When a viewer plays, the game automatically fetches their Twitch profile picture and applies it to their ball. It’s their moment to shine on screen!

Steam Achievements: Unlock special milestones as your community grows, plays, and hits high scores together.

🤖 STREAMER-FIRST DESIGN

We know how chaotic live streaming can be. Diamond SkeeBall is built to handle it.

Intelligent Queue System: Got raided by 100 people? No problem. The automated queue lines up every request and executes them one by one. You can sit back and narrate the action while the game handles the traffic.

Simple Setup: Log in with your Twitch account and you're ready to go in seconds.

Custom Brandng:Your channel logo is featured prominently in the arena, making the experience feel like *your* custom game.

🚀 JOIN THE BETA

Diamond SkeeBall is currently in active Beta. We are constantly listening to streamer feedback to add new features, game modes, and tools to help you grow. Please Contact Support Via Our Discord if u are intrested in beta testing.

COMING SOON:

Ball Skin Store: A dedicated shop where you can unlock exclusive, high-quality skins to customize the look of your game even further.

2090960.name: Not Quite A Fairy Tale
2090960.about_the_game:
Welcome to a roguelike where fails are mandatory, and dignity is optional.

Explore randomly generated dungeons that feel more like IKEA mazes, where your enemies and allies are so ridiculous they could be a lesson in how not to make a game.
Armed with a rusty sword and dubious magic, you'll be endlessly dying, facing monsters whose biggest threat is the spelling of their names.
With every step, your tragic fame will grow, along with your talent for finding even sillier ways to die.

Epic Battles You’ll Never Forget (or Forgive)

Tired of spamming the same overpowered skill in turn-based RPGs? Or maybe you’re searching for a new monitor after another round of “fair” randomness in a card duel? We’ve mixed it all into one insane cocktail so you can simultaneously rage against the randomness, count your moves, and rack your brain trying to save the last surviving hero from a horde of goblins

Skill Cards for Genius (and Desperate) Combos

Forget about boring, pre-set skill sets from other games—here, you'll get fireballs when you’re begging for shield and lightning instead of healing. Building and perfecting the ideal deck for each hero will be more than just part of the game; it'll be a real pain and a fight for survival. Combine skills like your life depends on it, so your mage can screw enemies without getting screwed over!

Critical Fails as Tactics

Luck is a myth, and your heroes are living proof.
Sometimes they’ll land a Critical Hit, but far more often they’ll stun themselves, hit an ally, or trip over their own ego. Every Critical Fail fills your Ubercharge meter faster, turning disaster into raw power.
So go ahead - miss that attack, burn your own party, and call it “strategy.”
Pain is a valid build.

Dungeons and Their (Odd) Inhabitants

Procedurally generated dungeons aren’t just a random set of corridors. They’re hellish mazes packed with hundreds of enemies, traps, and weird characters ready to discuss everything except your inevitable death

Heroes Who Don’t Want to Die (But Will Anyway)

Assemble a motley crew of heroes, each with unique talents and quirks, and head out to face new defeats.

Permanent death ensures that your heroes will change often, and every decision will weigh as much as the last bottle of rum on a sinking ship!

Customizable Difficulty Levels

When our sales manager finally stopped crying, he said it was inhumane to torture players like that. We added fine-tuned difficulty settings so hardcore maniacs and newbies alike can find their perfect dose of adrenaline

2090980.name: Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun
2090980.about_the_game:
Celestial doom. This is the fate that awaits humanity. In Edo, Japan, the great cataclysm has been foreseen by a most unlikely soul — a Master Thief. Your mother.

You are a common pickpocket, transformed by the cataclysm into a lethal Ninja with lightning mobility. The Ramen Seller becomes a Samurai. The Maiko becomes a killer Geisha. Your domain of petty crime becomes a frenzied neon world of shogun castles, magic traps and parachuting assassins. Someone has ensnared you in a loop of chaos… if not to kill you, then to protect you from something worse.

Master violent precision platforming in this fusion of extreme speed and one-button controls that will leave you dead and wanting more.



JUMP TO MOVE, JUMP TO ATTACK
  • Use one button for everything.
  • No walking, no running – just jumping.
  • Eviscerate the enemy by jumping at them.
  • Hold to super-charge your jump and attack harder.
  • Become invincible at the moment of jumping — time it right and dodge even the most brutal attacks.

ONE WRONG MOVE AND IT’S BACK TO THE START
  • Face hellish bosses and assassins equipped with projectiles, magic and agility.
  • Evade sharp drops, deadly poison and other nasty traps.
  • Ramp up your attack power with combo attacks. Just don’t get hit.



CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAYSTYLE
  • Unlock new playable warriors like the ranged Geisha and destructive Samurai.
  • Wield kunai, shuriken, spears, stones and other armaments both long-ranged and short.
  • Wear armor and scarves to increase your defense.
  • Get special abilities and boosts by finding strange souls and questionable foods.
  • Use scrolls with effects like earthquake, lightning, and enhanced sight.
  • Build up your Village base. Rescue villagers to repair and upgrade useful buildings including the Blacksmith and Back-alley Doctor.

KEEP GOING, KEEP GOING
  • Blaze through a mix of procedurally generated and hand-crafted levels.
  • Die fast but try again faster with instant respawn and permanent upgrades.
  • Ascend the Infinite Watchtower, run the Infinite Corridor, and don’t stop.
  • Fill your Combat Log and thrash your high scores.
  • Replay the game with new challenges, including a stage randomiser.



STYLISH JAPANESE PIXEL ART
Immerse yourself in the nostalgic beauty of vibrant Japanese pixel art that brings the crumbling castles, skeletal forests and folklore characters of the Edo Period to life with brutal elegance.

2091020.name: Blades of Fire
2091020.about_the_game:
Blades of Fire is a dark fantasy adventure built on a single, uncompromising idea:

Steel is Destiny.

You are Aran de Lira, the last warrior capable of forging true steel in a world where metal turns to stone. Your journey is not about collecting weapons, but about forging them through intent, sacrifice, and consequence, and surviving long enough to master their weight.

Combat is deliberate and unforgiving. Every strike commits you. Every mistake costs you. Victory is earned through patience, positioning, and understanding both your enemy and the blade you forged to face them.

The Steam release includes Version 2.0 of the game, featuring major updates and improvements, plus the Adventurer Pack, the Artbook, and the award-winning original soundtrack by Óscar Araujo.

FORGE STEEL. SHAPE YOUR FATE.

At the heart of Blades of Fire lies a forging system that is not crafting — it is commitment.

Weapons are forged at the anvil through deliberate choices that permanently shape their behaviour, balance, and purpose. There is no endless loot. No disposable gear.

Every blade reflects:

  • The materials you chose.

  • The enemies you prepare to face.

  • The kind of warrior you decide to become.

Because steel remembers.

COMBAT WITH WEIGHT AND CONSEQUENCE

Combat in Blades of Fire is methodical, grounded, and lethal.

  • Timing, spacing, stamina, and defense matter more than aggression.

  • Enemies punish recklessness and reward observation.

  • Weapon choice is tactical, not cosmetic.

You do not overpower your foes. You outlast them.

A WORLD THAT REWARDS CURIOSITY

The world of Blades of Fire does not unfold through constant exposition.

Much of its history, myths, and meaning resides in Adso, Aran’s companion — a young, learned mindscholar with deep knowledge of the world and an eagerness to share it.

He writes down everything and speaks when spoken to.

  • Story is discovered through dialogue and reading, not through cutscenes.

  • Knowledge comes from interest, not obligation.

  • The world reveals itself only to those who ask.

A GAME FOR PLAYERS WHO SEEK MASTERY

Blades of Fire is designed for players who value:

  • Deliberate pacing.

  • Meaningful progression.

  • Difficulty rooted in understanding, not reflexes.

Power is not given. It is earned at the anvil.

VERSION 2.0 – CONTENT & IMPROVEMENTS

The Steam version (and all other platforms) will receive an update at launch, which introduces a wealth of improvements:

NEW CONTENT

  • New Game Plus.

  • New Challenge Level: Titanium

  • New Weapon Parts & Skins (only available in New Game Plus)

  • Elements Transmutation, which allows players to change material types.

  • Photo Mode.

  • Boss Revival Mode (a new game mode where you can replay boss fights and earn rewards).

  • Adso’s Spells on weapons for a deeper combat (rewards tied to Boss Revival Mode introducing spells that enhance weapon abilities with special effects)

  • Now you can pet the Ox in Blades of Fire.

IMPROVEMENTS

  • Expanded death and mutilation variations.

  • Improved animation transitions.

  • Nvidia DLSS4 implementation.

OTHER

  • Full key remapping for keyboard and mouse control.

  • New Achievements.

  • Steam Deck Support.

2091030.name: Timepunk
2091030.about_the_game:
Timepunk is a retrofuturistic bullet-hell roguelike where you play as a rogue time traveler, fighting through hundreds of historical enemies. Use weapons from different eras, unlock time-manipulating skills, and create unique builds to survive. Every run is a new path through different historical periods—shoot, loot, and defy physics until you reach the end of time!

Blast your way through various timelines to seek revenge against the mysterious Society of Time! The journey won’t be easy as each timeline brings different challenges like robots, wholly mammoths, and unpredictable outcomes like Nazi Zombies riding Mecha-Dinosaurs. Will you find your revenge against the society of time in this pixelated bullet hell designed for the most skillful of players.

Master of space and time

As a time traveler defy physics with unique different powers, bring weapons from each time period and build your unique build based on the mutations that occur from jumping through time.

Explore different timelines

You're a rogue time traveler from the future that was banished from time and thrown into the dinosaur era. Travel through unpredictable time periods, facing relentless waves of enemies in a dynamically generated roguelike experience. Make decisions that will alter the course of history – be prepared to face the consequences. Each jump through time brings new challenges, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Co-op gameplay

Time travel is always better with friends! Team up with up to four players and dive into the chaos together. Arm yourselves, coordinate strategies, and unleash destruction as you navigate the treacherous landscapes of different eras.

Survive the Bullet Hell

Brace yourself for an onslaught of bullets and intense dodging. Timepunk is not for the faint-hearted – it's a bullet hell extravaganza where skill and quick reflexes are your greatest allies.

Time Traveling Shenanigans

The game is full of references to different pop culture and cult classics about time traveling, science and sci-fi. Encounter weapons and skills inspired by different scientists. Save and play as other time travelers. And face unique enemies like reptilian scientists, zombie nazis or space vikings, adding a thrilling layer of unpredictability.

Reach the end of time

Your ultimate goal is to reach your original timeline in the future and take down the nefarious Society of Time. Confront a variety of powerful adversaries and overcome the obstacles they throw your way. The fate of the entire time-space continuum rests in your hands.

Gear up, team up, and embark on a time-traveling adventure like never before in Timepunk – where the past, present, and future collide in a relentless barrage of bullets, physics and excitement! Are you ready to mess with the timeline?

About This Game

Apocalypse Factory is an automation and factory-building game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies.
You’re one of the few survivors sent to the surface to mine, craft, and build production lines that supply vital resources needed to construct your ultimate Escape Ark.

Build complex automated factories, power them with electricity, and deliver everything your Escape Ark requires — all while defending your machines from constant zombie threats above ground.

⚙️ Key Features

  • Build and automate complex production lines to craft essential items and resources

  • Explore and expand across a large, dangerous map

  • Mine dozens of resources and process them into advanced materials

  • Construct a wide variety of machines, structures, and power systems

  • Set up electrical networks using wind power and other generators

Join your local contact, Enoha, in his mission to recover the missing tiki masks that protect the island from the fury of its evil spirits. Then get ready for the captivating, genre-blending puzzles in Twistingo!

Songs from the Iron Sea is a poetic platformer scattered with environmental puzzles, taking place in a whimsical aquatic universe. Through a short one-sititng experience, the game portrays a creature lost in a metallic nightmare. Will you be able to get out?

Guided by a friendly entity, you must escape to regain your freedom. But stay on your guard, the foreman's gaze is on you..



Experience an original controller in our aquatic universe. Feel the freedom and smoothness of underwater movement and enjoy the transition between air and water highlighted by our platforming challenges.






Immerse yourself in an emotional journey with delicate visuals.

If you want to win here, you not only need skill with your weapon, but also brainpower!

So memorize your deck, master the challenges, and outwit your opponent.

  • Share decks with friends and play smart together.

  • Check the learning report in the menu to measure and accelerate your progress

2091410.name: March of Shrooms
2091410.about_the_game:
Ninety-nine years ago, mushrooms took to the skies, their spores landing on magical, floating islands and blossoming into a happy, joyous civilization. Unfortunately, every ten years a giant storm passes through the Shroomy Isles and reduces everything to little more than mycelium and a couple of berry brushes. As the tenth storm looms upon the Isles, the first little storm cloud puts a big idea in the tiniest shroom's head: Unite the shrooms! Fight back against the weather!!

March of Shrooms is a frenetic, cheery crowd brawler that chronicles the tiny shroom's epic odyssey to unite shroomkind against the coming storm! Punch your way to unity, happiness, and berries for everyone through a vibrant, effervescent world, full of mysteries, bubbles, and of course, shrooms.

  • Lead the shroomvolution at the head of an entire platoon. Command up to 30+ shrooms at once.

  • Pick and choose from over 40 distinct species, each with special looks and skills to contribute.

  • Customize the shrooms for brawling, dividing them into squads, each with its own order, size, and purpose.

  • Brawl across hand-crafted levels each with their own personalities and gameplay quirks that will keep you on your myc--er, feet.

  • Every chapter is a brand new set of levels, with fresh environments, challenges, and buffs. Floating upgrades, explosive chains, and of course, tons of berries to collect.

  • Replay levels on higher difficulties to earn rare items, face completely new encounters, and unlock new upgrades for the tiny shroom's big village.

  • Ushering in a new age for shroomkind isn't easy, but fret not. March of Shrooms is designed to be easy to learn but difficult to master, with something for casual and hardcore players alike.

  • Fight the greedy shrooms, not the keyboard. A simple, flexible control scheme lets anyone control the shroom-platoon with ease on both controllers or mouse and keyboard.

  • Choose your Brand™: Color the platoon as soft and squishy as tapioca in bubble tea when you're in the mood to relax - or make it fizzy and bubbly like crisp soda when you're in the mood for a challenge! The shrooms don't judge.

Seriously, there are so many they'll follow you everywhere, from the map screen, through the village, to the ends of the Shroomy Islands - all hoping that the tiniest shroom will realize their biggest dreams and cover you with their growing love.

So, whatcha waiting for? Let the march of the shrooms begin!

2091490.name: Shore Sweepers

2091510.name: TRAFFIC
2091510.about_the_game:
TRAFFIC is a fictional story inspired by my own personal experiences, various news articles, statistics, and national incidents that remain unexplained.


TRAFFIC is a First-Person Psychological Horror game about a troubled child in a home where he must deal with both internal and external stresses. You will communicate with your parents, do your chores, and stay out of the way.

Secure the front gate and lock your doors. You never know who might be out there.



TRAFFIC is about a family living in Wyoming as they traverse through the economic recession of 2008. You play as the single child in a family of three, along with your Mother and Father.

Experience the gut-wrenching tension and horrifying story of TRAFFIC as you make your way through the days, doing whatever you can to take your mind off of the traumatic events occurring.

Piece the story together as you notice tiny details within the dialogue and environments.



Huge thanks to Unrested / Inksmith for creating the Art of 'Mother' used in this game. You can check him out on YouTube @Unrested or at @Inksmith

Huge thanks to Bazookya for creating an entire TV show segment. You can check him out on Twitch @ Bazookya

Huge thanks to Monk for taking my terrible MIDI music and producing it into something useful and awesome.

Unreal Retro Shaders / DaveFace

Rest of credits in game


This game contains subject matter not suitable for those susceptible to the following themes:

Implications of Domestic Abuse
Implications of Suicide
Gore
Sleep Paralysis
Home Invasions

2091520.name: Aftertime
2091520.about_the_game:
Experience an epic journey across utterly mutated yet picturesque world caused by a fallen meteorite that released unknown toxins to the atmosphere. In this new age, humans have become zombies and once again, dinosaurs roam the earth. Giant mushrooms and massive creatures are sights to behold.

Pickup guns, melee weapons and collect ammo, grenades, health kits and fight your way through the photorealistic and breathtaking environments of Aftertime varying from cities, indoors, forests, swamps and caves filled with zombies, dinosaurs and sometimes haunted by ghosts.

The missions are linear and it's all about you moving from one place to another trying to find help and finally get to a safe place. As a lone survivor you have no idea about what is happening to the planet and if there are any other survivors left. The game is slow paced and peaceful at times, while it could get violent and chaotic when you encounter enemies.

Collect weapons, find ammo and kill anything on your way.


Beautiful yet hostile locations to explore.


Features


  • Throw grenades and shoot at explosive barrels to blast zombies.
  • Use health kits and food to keep you fit to fight.
  • State of the art tech.
  • Photorealistic graphics with cinema quality models and textures.
  • Realistic real-time lighting.
  • Turn off HUD entirely by pressing TAB.

2091530.name: Angry Angus
2091530.about_the_game:
Angry Angus is a reverse bullet hell game (Also known as Bullet Heaven) where the main focus is on driving.

Features:

Up to 7 different weapons that all have their own unique roles and functions in game play. For example:
  • Constantly-firing machine guns on the front of the car, always pointed in the way they are aiming.
  • A Rocket Launcher that fires explosive payloads in random directions.
  • A spinning scythe that shreds nearby enemies.
Unique upgrades for all of those weapons.

Over 10 modifiers to Customize the experience. For example:
  • Monster Truck mode: Double the size of your car
  • Scrap Drops mode: Some people enjoy having to collect experience from defeated enemies, while others hate it. I have enabled both options for players here.
  • Auto-upgrader. Let the Game decide what upgrades to pick for you!
  • Perfectionist, for the truly daring. Start with 1 max HP, and HP upgrades only improve it by 1.

Do your best to beat the final boss and win with the most scrap possible.

The game may receive updates in future, such as adding more weapons, modifiers, perhaps even customization in appearance.

2091540.name: RUSHAWAY
2091540.about_the_game:
RUSHAWAY is a 2.5D fast-paced single-player platformer, where your objective is to find the fastest way(s) towards the top of towers you'll be traversing. Explore different paths on each one, and discover the most optimal ones, avoiding or exploiting the different hazards you'll be encountering.

In RUSHAWAY, the world is broken and one little hero finds himself on a quest to save it. Help Speck travel through Skyworld and find the Light that will restore the world.

Skyworld is divided into various towers connected by an energy highway. At the top of each tower, you will find a connection to the highway. Traverse through it as you find your way towards the highest tower, where the Light is said to reside.

  • Explore more than 50 towers in your quest to find and reach the Light.
  • Locate the lost pieces of a mysterious diary on every tower.
  • Unlock achievements by completing a variety of different challenges.
  • Compete against the leaderboard ghosts of other players.

2091580.name: SYNESTHESIA
2091580.about_the_game:
If only those easy, carefree days could have gone on forever...

SYNESTHESIA is an emotionally charged, character-driven mystery visual novel; with occasional interactive elements to immerse you into the journey of the spiral.

SETTING & CHARACTERS:

The year is 2029. Around the world are those awakening to new powers of the mind, estimated to be about 0.016% of the next generation. The Huntley Scientific Research Institute has opened its doors to these young people to take on as students, to research their gifts and aid them in harnessing their strange abilities.

Ziek is a college level student at the institute. His ability is a unique form of synesthesia, whereby he can detect the significance of objects by splashes of colour that appear in his vision. He seeks to continue his easy and comfortable life alongside his friends, but soon discovers they may be caught up in something much larger than they realise.

A PURE VISUAL NOVEL INTERPOSED WITH INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS

FEATURES LIST:

  • Multi-route mystery structure with multiple heroine endings, including one unlockable 'True Route' / 'True Ending'.
  • Flowchart that unlocks as you progress, with jumpable tiles for ease of navigating character routes.
  • Fully voiced, utilising a combination of voice acting and speech synthesis (MC unvoiced).
  • Full tips list with in-game text hyperlinks.
  • Original soundtrack with 20+ songs from composer 'Caleb Coles'.
  • Occasional exploratory point and click / puzzle sections; as you partner to unravel the mysteries.
  • Impacting character moments with psychological / philosophical themes.
  • A clean visual style influenced by the simple aesthetics of the classic visual novel era (2000's / early 2010's), all at full HD quality.
  • Reading Times: 18+ hours [all endings, methodical read] || 12-18 hours [normal read time] || 8-12 hours [fast reader]
Join Ziek and his friends as they hunt down the clues that lead to the end of the vortex in this psychological mystery.

WILL YOU ESCAPE THE SPIRAL? WISHLIST NOW!
2091580.reviews:
“SYNESTHESIA was a fantastic experience. Enticing plot, dark themes within its routes, and an endless tragedy… If you enjoy all that plus some fun minigames and a futuristic setting, you should definitely read this.”

“SYNESTHESIA offers a compelling story with interesting ideas and well-written characters, and I’d recommend it to fans of science fiction and mystery.”
Nook Gaming

“The story for SYNESTHESIA is something of an oddity, it’s very Steins; Gate, and I loved it. I can safely recommend this to those who love deep stories that make you do a lot of thinking.”
Sinical Anime Network

2091620.name: Septaroad Voyager
2091620.about_the_game:
Septaroad Voyager is a deep story-driven RPG focused on seven unlikely individuals who must grow--as people and as heroes--in order to save the world from the greatest threat it has ever known. Gather your seven heroes from across a beautiful and varied pixel-art world. Assign tactics to your party members to make them fight quickly and intelligently in fast-paced real-time battles.

As something sinister chips away at the walls of reality, seven heroes hear a call to action. Unite them, strengthen them, and lead them to victory in Septaroad Voyager.

Features

  • Fast-paced battles against a variety of enemies with their own strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. Master the systems of Septaroad Voyager to defeat even the toughest foes.

  • Program your party members using the Tactics system. Give them a condition to check for and an action to perform, then let them fight. With the right tactics, your party will fight its way to victory on its own. But for unforeseen situations, you can always give orders manually.

  • Take the default heroes into your party or customize them however you want. Change their names and appearance. Level them up in 14 unique classes with their own selection of skills and equipment.

  • Adventure across a huge and varied world, filled with unique environments, cultures, characters, and enemies.

  • In addition to the main campaign and story quests, you can learn rumors from townsfolk, and add clues to those rumors to discover an infinite number of procedurally generated dungeons. Customize the difficulty and treasure of each dungeon depending on the clues you combine.

  • Create your own adventures using the included game editor. Or for the truly dedicated modder, change the game itself by extending the included source code.

2091720.name: Nightmare
2091720.about_the_game:
Nightmare is a single player survival-horror game where you find yourself in a nightmare. To leave it you will need to explore the enviroment, fight ghosts, collect and create items necessary to survive and reach the main goal - sanity growth.



  • Addictive gameplay
    Your main goal is awakening. Search for items that can be combined into the light sources to increase your sanity, but don't relax, by carefully examining the enviroment you will also find items that can help you to protect yourself, because there is someone near you who wants you to stay in this nightmare forever. Each game lasts about 30 minutes of real time.



  • Atmosphere
    Realistic graphics and high-quality 3D sounds will keep you in stress all the time and allow you to dive into the action as much as possible.

  • Increasing difficulty
    As you progress through the game, the unpredictable AI will change tactics: becoming more aggressive, summoning helpers. By other words, leaving this nightmare will not be easy.

  • Replayability
    Each next game will be different from the previous one: all the items you found may no longer be in their usual place next time.
    You may no longer face the enemy you have already faced, but face a new one. During the gameplay, you can also encounter random activities, whether to participate in them or not is up to you, because they can either bring you closer to the final goal or push you back from it.



  • Player progress
    Depending on your actions and activity in the game, you will earn experience and Light Tokens that can be spent on perks. Who knows, perhaps they will influence the outcome of your nightmare.

  • Game modes
    Nightmare is a rather difficult game. If you don't think so, try the "Expert Mode", which reworks the core mechanic and logic, making reaching the main goal a real challenge of reflexes, speed and nerves.

2091740.name: Press Lex to Metaverx
2091740.about_the_game:
Welcome to your own mess, Lex... The storage of your Metaverx!
Following the events of his first adventure, Lex is now the busy owner of the Truffle Shuffle. However, the space-time remains open and Lex justs needs to follow the timeline; but, as busy as he is, he will fancy a shortcut that will lead to a catastrophe: a breach in his Metaverse.

Debugging the Metaverx
Press Lex to Metaverx is the sequel to From Lex to Rex, does this feature a wiser Lex? Hell no. His tunnel vision and stubbornness will force him to fix his reality and face the main subject arising in each level of the Metaverx: should he stop trying for the sake of his friends?

A quest where each level presents itself as a challenge.

Unfinished business
Not everything must be solved in the Metaverx. You faced the Rex, now it is time to face the Queenx.

Featurex
  • Old school point and click adventure - Monkey Island, Beneath a steel sky, Hollywood Monsters... You know what I´m talking about. Simple mechanics, some challenging puzzles and pixel hunting (you´ve been warned).
  • Standalone Story – Set after From Lex to Rex, features some recurring characters and themes in addition to new ones. Can it be played independently? Be my guest!
  • Logical nonsense! - Does cotton candy count as cloth? Of course, it is cotton, it says it on the name! Rest assured, just follow the clues, listen and sharpen your eyes: all puzzles adhere to a consistent internal logic.
  • Decissions matters: will you take the fast way or you´ll take your time to solve things the other way? There might be some rewards ahead...
  • Nice crisp retro pixel art work - which makes the game even more indie.
  • A love letter to pop culture - books, movies, music, etc. Look for those Easter eggs!
  • The Truffle Shuffle - The short prequel to the game (or the pre-sequel, whichever you prefer). Help Lex open his truffle business and the plot of the incoming game.
  • In numbers: 22 stages, 20+ scenarios, 100+ inventory items, 4500+ text lines, 200+ animations (characters, objets, scenarios...), 20+ ambient and music tracks, 40+ achievements (some of them depend on your actions), 1 developer.

2091770.name: 迷失
2091770.about_the_game:
Warning: This video game may cause photosensitive seizures. It is recommended that players make their own decisions.



Important reminder: This game revolves around exploration, slowly creating a tense atmosphere and creating a more profound and interesting experience. The storyline progresses layer by layer with the bizarre visuals and subtle details of the surrounding environment. Please remember that this game is a non-traditional game with high difficulty.



Lost is a first person psychological horror game.



Exploring an ever-changing and mysterious teaching building, immersing oneself in incredible scenes is both comfortable and thrilling, enjoying a truly terrifying experience.




environment

The story takes place in a large teaching building. A student who is sleeping in class suddenly wakes up to find that all the students around him have disappeared. The teaching building is completely unrecognizable and lost in it. The twisted and eerie space will take you to places you never imagined.

We often feel that the body is composed of the soul, brain, and body. Part is rationality, part is sensibility, and part is perception.

In the game, players are the soul and the emotions. The NPC controlled by the player itself is rational. Perceiving it lost.

The game story is about NPCs (rational) gradually perceiving anomalies within their bodies. Feeling someone controlling oneself. As he explores in the game, he is himself in front of the computer. Recalling one's own tactile, visual, and auditory senses.

What is real and what is virtual, only defined. Waiting to be overthrown~

2091790.name: No More Future
2091790.about_the_game:
Anything can begin, and end, at a moment's notice...


You're a young adult yuuman, living in a futuristic America in the late 22nd century. Though you had a life, dreams, and aspirations once, it all got swept away once you were diagnosed with incurable late-stage brain cancer; now you're stuck in a hospital, living the last few weeks of your life in existential agony, incapable of processing what you did wrong to deserve this fate.

Everything changes when, one day, you're approached by a scientist from the world's largest mega-corporation, who offers you a chance to escape your dying body and have your mind transplanted onto an android synth vessel; the only catch being, nobody knows whether the process works or not, whether you'll survive the transition or ultimately perish. With little holding you back, you eventually accept...

...You awaken in your new body, feeling quite different from how you were before. Nobody can tell whether it's truly you inside the machine, or an AI pretending, believing that it's you.

Not even you.

In a world where technology's constantly evolving, advanced AIs are viewed with fear and suspicion and few things are certain, you have to rebuild your old life from scratch, convince those who abandoned you on your deathbed that you're still here, and ultimately figure out whether you truly are who you claim to be.



About the game:

NMF is a linear Sci-Fi Visual Novel: explore a high-tech futuristic world as an android, meet all sorts of new people and reconnect with some old faces, find the truth behind your existence and your purpose in this new world.

The game addresses heavy topics such as death, suicide, depression, anxiety, and existential dread. If you are suffering from depression or are easily overwhelmed by these topics, I advise you to exercise caution when reading the contents of this VN or refrain from playing altogether.

The game is entirely SFW, though there are some adult non-explicit jokes thrown in for comedic effect. There aren't, nor will there ever be, any explicit scenes or suggestive content in this VN.
There are fight scenes in the novel that feature non-graphic depictions of violence.

2091800.name: SpiriTales
2091800.about_the_game:
Build your team
Building a strong friendship with your Spirits is the key for overcoming the obstacles and battles you will face. Take good care of your team members by feeding and training them. But beware, Spirits have their own personality and needs and can turn on you when neglected or mistreated.

Rise through the ranks
As a new recruit to the Delta Expedition, you have to prove your skills by clearing the trials of fire that test your skills as a Spirit tamer. This way you become a full member and will be able to dive further into the mysteries of the world.

Choose your destiny
After the final exam, you will be assigned to a team. On one side there are the Rangers, dutiful and focused on creating harmony between humans and Spirits, they protect and serve the Delta Expedition as mediators between the human and spirit world. On the other side are the Scouts. They see Spirits primarily as tools to reach their goals and are focused on uncovering the mysteries and technology that are hidden in the ruins of the old world.

Uncover the mystery behind the portals
At the same time that natural disasters started to become more common, strange portals opened all over the world and caused chaos and destruction. This increased the tension between humans and Spirits. Discovering and removing the cause for the appearance of these strange portals is one of the main goals of the Delta Expedition.

2091810.name: Logic Circuit: Marble Puzzle
2091810.about_the_game:
Logical circuit is a beautiful and colorful puzzles game, where it will make you think about how to form several paths so that each of the balls reach the end where appropriate.

The game has 60 challenges with which you can think and have fun, the difficulty is increasing based on the progress of the challenges.

The objective of the game is to make metal balls fall on the bottom tray, in each tray a certain amount of balls must enter, you can define the path of the balls based on the pieces that you place on the board.

Move the pieces to create a path and get the metal marbles to reach the base of the board, you must make each of the bases fall a corresponding number of marbles.

2091820.name: Grassland defender Keita
2091820.about_the_game:
What kind of game is it?

The game tells the story of such a story: an unknown planet's tribe for the sake of the development of science and technology and ignored the environment protection, lead to all the wild animals on the planet destroyed, they sent someone to other planets for wild animals, discovered the continent of Africa's wildlife, keita, as African savannah wildlife protector, brave guarded the local populations of wild animals... , in the game, you will play keita, alone to fight the aliens, prevent alien catch wild animals, in the process of playing a game, you will experience the defenders of grassland is how proud, through the game will also education we need to protect our earth environment, otherwise one day, we also no wildlife survival on earth...

How does the game play?

In the game, players besides will jump, can shoot arrows and parachutes, players shoot arrows to attack the ship below link rod or ball, hit two seconds after connecting rod or the club automatically release captive wild animals, wild animals will drop down from the sky, at this time, you can sending a parachute wildlife, wildlife with parachutes can safe landing! Congratulations, you have saved a wild animal, the player will automatically increase health, if the wild animal is caught or injured, the player will lose health, in the game also need to note that if the player touches a cactus or falls into the water and is attacked by crocodiles, the player will also lose health. If the ship runs out of power and the player still has health, the level is passed.

Thank you for your attention and hope for your support! • And we really want you to support the other games of African boy Keita Studio！

2091830.name: Add and Multiply, Math Tower 2
2091830.about_the_game:
Welcome to Math Tower 2.5, the game that will turn math learning into an exciting adventure! 🚀 Specifically designed for our little ones to practice basic operations while immersing themselves in an unparalleled playful experience.

🌟 Imagine a magical tower where each level is an exciting math challenge. Operations appear as flashes at the top of the screen, waiting to be solved. But here’s the fun part: answers are built by catching numbers that appear on hopping frogs, playful birds, effervescent bubbles, or simply falling from the sky like drops of knowledge!

The goal is clear: correctly answer 10 operations per level to achieve victory! And every time you conquer a level, the tower grows, reaching the majestic height of 20 levels!

⏰ But beware, time is of the essence. You have only 15 seconds to solve each operation. If the clock runs out or you make a little mistake, don’t worry, our friendly character will give you the correct answer, and the fun will continue!

Math Tower is not just a game; it’s your ally in mastering addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Struggling with multiplication tables? No problem because if you take too long to find the answer, the game will reveal it to you – a perfect opportunity to learn while you play!

And that’s not all, do you want to practice English and Spanish? Math Tower is also your language teacher! Operations and answers are pronounced with enthusiasm so you can learn numbers in both languages.



What makes Math Tower extraordinary?

🧠 Basic Math Practice: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

🎉 Playful Experience: Designed for children’s enjoyment.

📈 Levels and Growth: A tower with up to 20 levels that grows with every victory!

🎮 Interactivity: Build answers by catching numbers in the game.

🌈 Immediate Feedback: We highlight correct and incorrect answers.

⏱️ Time Limit: 15 seconds to solve each operation.

🗣️ Language Learning: Operations and answers in English and Spanish.

🔢 Memorization of Tables: Helps memorize multiplication tables.

📊 Progress Tracking: A bar chart at the end of each level.

👧 User-Friendly: An intuitive and accessible interface for children.

🎨 Graphics: Beautiful 2D graphics. 🎶 Music: Accompanied by fantastic instrumental music!

Get ready for an exciting math journey with Math Tower! 🚀🔢🌟

2091840.name: Planetary Defense: An Orbital Turret Defense System
2091840.about_the_game:
2D Space Shooter meets Tower Defense! Defend your planet from asteroids and aliens and survive the Megadeath Star bosses with your Surface Cannon and build orbiting turrets to shoot down the invaders!

Build custom missile projectiles!

Build custom Satellite Turrets!

Upgrade your Surface Cannon

And keep that Planetary Shield up!

Player Facilities:

Surface Cannon : point and click to aim and fire the Surface Cannon, upgrade it to improve its range, accuracy, and even add barrels for more fire power.

Satellite Factory : build custom Sat-Turrets to deploy into orbit for automated defense. Equip them with 2, 3, or 4 guns and tune the targeting and firing mechanism for the optimal offense and shields and armor for definitive defense. More than 200 combinations!

Munitions Plant : What’s a turret and cannon without its munitions? Build custom missiles with different warheads, fuel systems, and thrusters to create the ultimate peace making device to load into your cannon and Sat-Turrets

Shield Generator : The Planet is a fragile thing, only one hit can end it all! Keep the shields up and upgrade them to take more hits, regenerate faster, and deflect damage

*NEW* Specter Drone Factory : This is a new Facility that was built on the Moon! Similar to Sat-Turrets, these are another modular system you customize before launching into space. These Specter Drones will patrol around an area of space waiting for a hazard to cross their path.

*NEW* Currency Mechanic : As a way to change up difficulty you can choose your starting currency. Each currency has a special protocol that is activated to affect the way the coin is valued, earned, or being held. Now featuring 6 unique coins! FireCoin, BubbleBuck, MineDime, BoilBuck, QuarryCoin, and Smelted

Hazards:

Asteroids: classic hazard, they move in a linear fashion and create smaller asteroids when destroyed

UFOs: There are 4 UFOs each with a different attack pattern

Red Roamers - move to different positions around the planet

Orange Orbiter - will orbit around the planet at different orbit distances

Green Getters - will race to your planet to steal away the projectiles you made

Blue Bombers - will make a bombing run and can land 2 hits in one run

Frigates: These are Sat-Turret destroying starships and will appear when you have strong orbital defense present

Megadeath Stars: What is this new devilry? These Bosses are massive battle stations with a doomsday timer synced to their boss music. Destroy them before they destroy you!

Your support will go a long way in helping the development of the follow up for this game.

This game was created entirely by yours truly Natedog769. I coded and did all the game sprites except the UI, the music I acquired from Karl Casey at White Bat Audio. Check out his BandCamp and Youtube page for more epic synth music!

The ambient track in the background was created by my good friend and Audio Engineer Samwise.

This game is a passion project and your support will go a long way in not only helping the production of the game but helping the 2 awesome music artists who lent their talent for this project.

This project has been about a year in the making, I started designing the game back in 2021 but didn’t start coding or building until the Summer of 2022 where I had 10 weeks to create a finished product. I continue to formulate ideas and find values to tweak to tune up the gameplay and I hope you find it as fun as it was to make. I wanted to combine 2 genres, space shooter with the Surface Cannon mechanic, and a turret defense game with an spin.

Thank you for checking out my project and I hope you enjoy and stick around to see what else I have in store not only for this game but for my future project! :)

Natedog769 of SODEC Games
