2091850.name: Pest Control
2091850.about_the_game:
Days move fast in your little solar system, and so do the pests! Can you collect enough crops before the invading pests take over your garden?

This fast paced garden defense game features:
  • 24 levels across 4 planets
  • custom levels to set your own challenge
  • control rebinding
  • my blood sweat and tears
  • cute Kenney assets
  • a little guy that goes around
  • a day-night cycle like you wouldn't believe
  • absolutely no plot

It's a little game you go around hitting little guys. You get it. Have fun.

2091880.name: Klaystar
2091880.about_the_game:
Klaystar is a 2D precision platformer, where the player controls Klay, a talented boy with the ability to turn into a bouncy ball, along with his friend Malo.
Set on a massive pillar connecting the earth and the sky, the ever-shifting world of Klaystar is filled with a myriad of unique and strange phenomena. Klaystar features eight chapters, each with their own story, unique mechanics, and collectibles.
So experience the mysteriously wonderful world of the Pillar, as you follow two boys seeking to join the honorable Vanguard, an organization hellbent on exploring the eccentric world they find themselves in.

2091890.name: Hidden in the Dark
2091890.about_the_game:
About

Hidden in the Dark is a non-linear suspense game. Play as Mimi to discover the events that took place in the Amy's parents' house during a week's vacation that you and your friends took.

Features

  • Multiple endings
  • Immersive atmosphere

2091910.name: Minschima
2091910.about_the_game:
In minschima you need find the correct order of moves to restore all the shapes in the board.

But there's a catch: all pieces try to move together in the same direction.

Features:
  • 90 hand crafted levels
  • Smooth puzzle progression
  • Beautiful color palettes
  • Relaxing ambience and satisfying sound effects
  • Simple and intuitive UI

2091920.name: Witches and Butchers
2091920.about_the_game:
Witches and Butchers is a throwback horizontal scrolling "Shoot 'em up" with Roleplaying elements.
Set in a fantasy world, you play as Lluuvia, a Witch with the power of cooking magic-infused dishes, she embarks in a mission to defeat an army of beasts that are stealing and eating all the food in the region!

Adventure is always better with friends!
As the story progresses, more characters tag along with Lluuvia to help her out, you can bring a companion and switch between them before each stage. Each character has a set of upgradeable skills and stats and are capable of healing, setting up protective barriers, destroy all enemies on screen with a bomb among other useful abilities!

Authentic Retro Feel!
Witches and Butchers features 8-bit retro graphics and easy controls, it is a new game in the spirit of 90's classics.
This game replicates the strengths and limitations of handheld consoles of years ago while adding some modern touches to the experience to make the game accessible to all players!

Eat and Grow!
This game features a Cooking System where you gather ingredients by completing quests and exploring the world, then cooking different dishes to increase the stats of your party and unlock more abilities!
As you progress you unlock more complex recipes to strengthen the entire party and enhance their unique powers!

2091930.name: 2MD:VR Football Unleashed ALL✰STAR
2091930.about_the_game:
2MD: VR Football Unleashed ALL✰STAR is the massive sequel to the groundbreaking motion-controlled VR football game, 2MD: VR Football. Draw the plays and throw, hand-off, catch, and run the ball before the clock runs out!

✰ Throw like a pro with realistic motion controls in a seated, standing, room-scale experience!
✰ Dynamically become the ball-carrier and even catch the ball yourself with assisted and manual receiver control!
✰ Switch between multiple "catch modes" to fit your play style.
✰ Exciting presentation with a 7-round heat and rapid-fire bonus rounds.
✰ Want a longer game? Play 2-minute drill or 20, 40, or 60 minute full length exhibition games or a full 7-round heat!
✰ Draw 8 unique offensive plays in VR!
✰ Featuring 56 unique teams across 8 leagues including college, arena indoor, professional, and fantasy player types!
✰ Customize your controls to fit your throwing style, multiple HMD types supported!
✰ Includes variable weather conditions including sun, rain, wind, and snow!
✰ Over 70 immersive stadiums filled with thousands of screaming fans.
✰ multiple practice modes including receiver and QB challenge areas.
✰ Challenging AI, achievements, leaderboards and a virtual trophy case.
✰ Watch the action unfold on the on-field spectator display live!
✰ Broadcast-style spectator camera available for capable setups!
✰ Pulse-pounding soundtrack by Fat Bard, with additional Tracks by K.Carter!

2091960.name: The Utility Room
2091960.about_the_game:
The Utility Room is not a traditional VR game. It is not inspired by anything. It is not set in a cyberpunk-Esque city 150 years in the future. There's no shooting or flashing lights or gumball machine gameplay. It is a place that no one has ever seen or visited and it is a place where you do not belong.

Fans of experimental or atmospheric horror games, Journey and the Kid A Mnesiac: Exhibition might appreciate the experience that The Utility Room offers.

Whilst there are some gameplay elements, it can be best described as more of a Journey. One that takes you across a barren, rocky, and dangerous world. Many of the environments and beings found within the Utility Room are Megalithic. There is no doubt that you will feel very small, dwarfed by the scale of the world as you travel across it.

Most entities that inhabit this world will pay little attention to you. Though It needs to be said that this world is a lot bigger than you are. It is dangerous, and nothing will account for your safety.

THE WORLD


You have been traveling for 3 million years across space to the edge of the Universe. In that time, you have become very strange. Your body is... different from how it once was but you are excited nonetheless. Your destination is the entrance to 'The Utility Room', a famous cosmic landmark many know of but never visit. Beyond the door, a supreme being known only as "Bin man" oversees the maintenance and heavy lifting required to keep existence stable and temporal. It is rumored that he was personally employed 13.8 billion years ago as the cosmic caretaker.

Those with megalophobia be warned that this game will make you feel very uncomfortable.

CONTROLS

Players can both teleport and move using smooth locomotion. This is because some areas are too precarious for smooth locomotion meaning players will have to use both.

There are two forms of jumping in-game. A traditional 'jump' and 'Leap'. Some gaps can be jumped normally, larger gaps will require you to leap.

Leaping is unique in The Utility Room. When the grip on both controllers is squeezed they begin to vibrate faster and faster. The faster the vibrations, the bigger the jump when the player swings their arms. By giving the player less mobility than in traditional games and disarming the player they become more vulnurable in the world. If they miscalulate a jump they will suffer the consequences. Fans of games like Boneworks or Bonelab might find this version of jumping cumbersome.

Climbing is also optional in the game but is not a major gameplay element.

COLLECTABLES

In the world are collectables. 8 in total representing the different giant rocky heads that each have different jobs within the Room. Information can be learnt about them in the HEAD LOG once they are collected.

--------------------------------------------------

If you choose to enter. Don't do anything foolish and don't get spotted. Your chances of leaving are slim. Good Luck!

Note: The game performs best using Oculus OpenXR. Streaming/recording is best on quality setting: HIGH.

The Utility Room Steam Game is a reimagining of a 360 Film from 2019 of the same name.

2091960.reviews:

Jacob Geller

2092000.name: Calamity Sanctuary
2092000.about_the_game:
Calamity Sanctuary is a roguelite action rpg with deckbuilding elements. Build your deck, acquire powerful daemons and fight your way in realtime for a chance get to safety before the prophesied Calamity strikes.

Features

  • Realtime deckbuilder: Unlike most deckbuilders, battles in Calamity Sanctuary are in realtime. You’ll have to think fast and know your deck like the palm of your hand if you want to be effective in combat.
  • Acquire Powerful Daemons: Daemons grant you various passive abilities, but simply acquiring them is not enough. You’ll have to find them a place in your Pacifing Grid if you want to reap the benefits they provide
  • Explore the Galaxy: The path towards the Calamity Sanctuary will take you through various planets, each with their own set of challenges. Choose which path to take depending on your current strengths and weaknesses.

2092010.name: Attack of the Trafalas®
2092010.about_the_game:
A long time ago in a small island, an organization of evil robots have taken over, with the mission of corrupting and exterminating mankind, until a few decided to resist.

Attack of the Trafalas is a Detective Hacker Fighting sim set in the digital multiverse where anything may happen. Fight your way to the top of the evil robot organization that you have created and turned against you, now you have to shut it down by becoming the best version of yourself, physically, mentally and electronically to combat the biggest evil organization the multiverse has ever seen which goal is to exterminate mankind in every reality.

The Official Prequel to Attacking Zegeta© Series

2092030.name: Sanguinite
2092030.about_the_game:
Sanguinite is a lunar-lander-meets-twin-stick-shooter action game with elements of resource management and exploration. Visit the surface of alien planets using remotely operated drones, searching for resources and artifacts to bring back to your ship. Encounter hostile forces with your initially under-equipped hardware. Research advanced alien technology and integrate it into your own while you investigate the nature and origin of the aliens you encounter.

Faced with global annihilation, humanity was able to unite long enough to execute the Exodus projects. Colony ships filled with passengers in stasis undertook centuries long journeys to escape. Specially designed Envoy vessels were sent far ahead of the colonists to scout and secure potential new homes, each operated by a single pilot. This is your task. Equipped with a fleet of standard issue Beryl drones and a universal fabricator to maintain them, you will conduct exploratory surface missions to acquire resources and investigate your target system. In the unlikely event of a hostile encounter, you will need to improvise. Your Envoy is primarily a scientific and industrial vessel, after all.

2092040.name: Crypto Clicker
2092040.about_the_game:
Exactly what it sounds like, a clicker game based around crypto. A relaxing casual game where all you do is click and watch that number get bigger.

This is my first app/game release.

Music: LiQWYD - Sweet

2092070.name: Escape
2092070.about_the_game: Escape is our vision for a basic infinite runner 2D platformer. In Escape you run to increase your score, and jump over spikes and holes to keep the score alive! The further you make it the harder it will be to survive. So don't forget to jump!

2092090.name: For me
2092090.about_the_game:
剧情介绍

幼年时在夜晚的天文馆与家人走散的墨耀，被一名友善的大姐姐救下。与大姐姐一起见证的流星深深印刻在了年幼的墨耀心中，也令她对天文产生兴趣。但是，与身为天文工作者的母亲墨莹之间的冲突，最终令墨耀决定与天文保持距离。
在那之后，决心孤身一人度过高中生活的墨耀，却因为偶发善心而与极为惹眼的留学生克洛娜搭上了关系。
在克洛娜近乎骚扰一样的邀请下，拗不过她的墨耀无奈地同意加入天文社，却在即将入社前发现了母亲留在天文社的痕迹。
当场离开的墨耀，原本以为自己不会再接近天文社。然而却意外受到了天文社顾问老师夏咲的帮助，并在她身上感到一种奇妙的熟悉感。
在夏咲与克洛娜的影响下，墨耀改变了原本的想法，不再逃避母亲的影响，最终加入了天文社。在夏咲的指导下，天文社的成员们开始破解墨莹留下的笔记，希望可以从中获得有关天文社‘秘宝’的线索。

角色介绍

墨耀 配音：子刷子

拒绝社交的孤僻少女
父母离异的不幸家庭，父亲如蒸发一般人间消失，而母亲忙于海外工作，只能依靠小姨生活。
考入海城高中后不再寄宿于小姨家，开始了自己一人的独居生活

夏咲 配音: 宅在家里什么都不会
人气极高的年轻教师
入职第一年的地理老师，作为新人同时肩负了学校的各种杂务，但统统毫不松懈地完成了
因为平易近人的态度而得到了学生们的拥戴
而那竭尽全力认真面对所有工作的帅气姿态，更是成为了不少人的憧憬
据说她接受到的来自学生的咨询，比学校的心理辅导员还多

克洛娜 配音: 米糊
元气满满的异国来客
想到什么便会立刻付诸实施的行动派，在好奇心的驱使下积极地采取各种行动
偶尔也会因此而吃到苦头
因为父亲工作的关系而在很小的时候就一起来到中国，中文水准堪比母语
虽然看上去大大咧咧的，实际上却是一个细心的人

白悠羽 配音: 白灯
铅字中毒的眼镜少女
比墨耀早一些被克洛娜拉入天文社，一副要将这里改成文艺部的气势般书不离手
作为墨耀曾经的同班同学，对她复杂的家庭状况略知一二，但并无干涉的想法
与所有人都保持着一定距离的她沉溺于书本的世界
不过偶尔也会因为那过于专注的姿态，而吸引来自己预料之外的关注

叶莉 配音: 录音姬阿童木
气焰嚣张的可爱学妹
讨厌繁文缛节的初中二年级，即便面对高中部的学姐们也毫不胆怯
在初中部以成绩优秀而闻名，却几乎看不到她学习的模样，总是显得无所事事
作为克洛娜之外唯一主动加入天文社的珍惜生物，全勤参加了所有能够参加的天文社活动
但据本人所说却并非天文爱好者，出于谜一般的热情行动着

游戏介绍

《ForMe》是由国内游戏社团YURIDEMO独立制作的一款百合题材的AVG游戏

天文学与百合的相遇，带来全新的奇妙体验

精美的人设与CG，外加10+首原创BGM

诚意满满的10w字剧本，深度打磨，用心讲好百合故事

多分支多结局，充实的游戏内容

主角全程配音，带你沉浸式体验故事氛围

2092130.name: Notes From Province
2092130.about_the_game:
Dive into a deep Open World that rewards exploration, solve clever puzzles with lateral thinking, and engage in unique, story-driven boss battles. Then take a break. Furnish your home, fish a little, and chill with your eccentric neighbors.

Kyme's searching for a fresh start in the city of Province. Will he find it among the eccentric residents and their whimsical adventures? Or will he get lost chasing his personal villain, a grand thief capable of stealing the blue from the sky, the voice of a singer, and even the very memory of what he stole, leaving you with nothing but an empty feeling?

Features

  • Open world No dead ends, only new things to see and treasure to find

  • Character driven story Even the battles have a story to tell

  • 7 characters Each with distinct styles and roles, swap-able mid combat

  • Equipment based customization Abilities and passives come from equipment that can be freely swapped to redefine characters

  • Enemies worth reacting to Each encounter has a plan to crush you unless you spot the weakness and counter

  • Decorate and expand your house Earn bonus awards based on your furniture arrangement

  • NPCs with lives Each villager has their own daily agenda, situational dialog, and a story to tell the more you get to know them

  • So much to do Crafting, cooking, fishing, dancing, finding a strange rat-loving man living in a hole under your neighbor's house

2092140.name: XXX, I Want You to Keep Fighting
2092140.about_the_game:
You wake up from a dream; a girl stands beside you. The world is surrounded by dark, and you aren't unfamiliar with it. The game is a semi-idle game. battles progress automatically. You can choose to completely idle and enjoy the gradual progression, or intervene to a certain extent (how much is entirely up to you) to accelerate progress (how fast also entirely up to you). Your task is to utilize resources dropped in dungeons to become stronger and defeat stronger enemies. The main dungeon's progress will trigger Shireo's stories, through which you learn about the background unfolding in this world.

Intervenable Combat Elements

Rhythm Bar: Each enemy attack generates a rhythm block. Pressing space at the right time provides significant damage reduction for that attack.


OD Bar: Various actions in combat accumulate the OD bar. When the OD bar is full, it activates the Overdrive Mode. In this mode, time freezes completely, allowing you to attack indefinitely without worrying about enemy spells.

Drops

Most monsters drop various resources, including money and materials.


Bosses will drop equipment with special effects, making battles easier and more engaging. Moreover, using materials to upgrade equipment items can greatly enhance your character.

Shops

Through Shireo's shop, you can purchase many useful items.

Skill Tree

There are various branches in the talent skill tree, and you can prioritize which direction you want to strengthen. They can have significant effects on enhancing character strength, and the special talents within are even more powerful.

Traning Room

In Shireo's training room, you can use "CLICK" to collect the world energy, which can enhance your strength and craft numerous useful items.

Story Unlocking

When you pass certain specific floors in main dungeon, a question mark will appear on Shireo.
Talking to Shireo triggers stories. Conversations with Shireo also result in ability enhancements and insights into the secrets of this world.




Head towards the highest floor of the main dungeon—Bloody Castle!
2092140.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
2092140.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092140/XXX, I Want You to Keep Fighting/

2092160.name: Legend of Merchant 2
2092160.about_the_game:
Though this game carries the name of its predecessor, it doesn't have much in common with it and is a completely new game.

Note: This is not a trading game! Instead, it is about obtaining items for sale through your own collection, planting, and other functions.

It will not support the Steam Workshop as I do not have the capability to do so.

The development team still consists of only me, and I cannot meet high expectations. You can try the free version before purchasing, and if the gameplay suits you, then buy it.

Each game I develop is the best I can do at the current stage, and I have invested a lot in this one.

Gameplay

It's very different from the challenging games I've developed in the past where bankruptcy leads to failure. This game is a pure collection-based casual simulation management game. There is no bankruptcy or time limit, so you can play it in a relaxed manner.

Of course, it lacks challenge and may bore players who enjoy challenges, as it cannot suit all players.

The game does not have a “completion” concept, it is considered 'completed' when you no longer wish to play.

Resources can be obtained through farmland, cooking, or wild collection, and can be directly sold to shops or used to complete residents' commissions to earn money.

The prices of items will change once a week.

Although decision-making will affect the speed of making money, there is no need to be nervous, after all, there is no time limit, it's just a difference in speed.

Even if all the money is wasted, you can start over by working in the town's restaurant, so you don't have to worry about being in a dead end.

Controls

Most operations are completed by clicking with the mouse (keyboard is used for collecting in the wild). It is also a turn-based game, and time will not pass without operation, so you can play it at ease.

Unlike ordinary farm games, there is no character to operate, but a conceptualized interface game.

Art

All art is hand-drawn. The more complex pieces are outsourced to artists for a fee, and many more artistic resources will be added in the future.

music

The background music is carefully selected high-quality paid licensed music.

Other

There is no investment, and I have always been developing games by myself at home.

2092170.name: By Grit Alone
2092170.about_the_game:
TL;DR: Challenging indie swarm/boss shooter in a story rich sci-fi horror environment.

Get this game if you're:

  • craving a challenging shooter with bosses, traps, swarms and suprises

  • a lover of deep twisted lore with immersive audio, text and holographic logs

  • into bizzare environments and surreal horror experiences

Don't get this game if you're:

  • arachnophobic

  • wanting cutting edge AAA graphics

  • looking for a resource constrained action horror with an inventory and limited ammo

A linear narrative campaign...

with an anthology of twisted, disturbing tales to discover. Prepare for constant action as you traverse ship to infested ship; there's no loading screens, no inventory and unlimited ammo. You will need skill and speed to rip through the ferocious swarms and deadly bosses to get out of this corrupted hellhole in one piece. Featuring bHaptics support.

💬 “Keeps you, like, right on the edge of your seat” BMFVR

💬 “Whoa, okay, tentacles everywhere!” Beardo Benjo

Cosmic Action Horror focusing on frantic combat, sinister storytelling and atmospheric dread. You’re marooned alone in the Bermuda triangle of space, filled with ancient derelicts and ravenous aliens.

By Grit Alone, you will survive.

2092180.name: Underwater battles
2092180.about_the_game:
Underwater battles - casual puzzle game made in 2D graphics.
You have three attempts to kill all the fish, sometimes moving in a curved line, and sometimes along the optimally fast route across the screen in the direction of the starfish. If the fish manage to reach the starfish 4 times, then the game is considered lost. You have to shoot fish of various colors and shapes, and chains of the same type of fish (three or more pieces) disappear when hit by a fish of the same color and type. Types of thrown fish can be changed for convenience.
Good luck in conquering the depths of the sea and in repelling the misfortunes of hundreds of marine inhabitants!

2092190.name: Nomori: Prologue
2092190.about_the_game:
This is the Pre-Alpha page for Nomori. We recently transitioned from Tech Demo to Pre-Alpha and want to give players a first-hand experience with our mind-bending game. Play now and enjoy 18 puzzles with 60-100 minutes of gameplay.

Nomori is a gorgeous and heartfelt adventure puzzle game that puts the power of time and space in your hands. As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. As Kiko comes into her own and bonds with the Spirits, she will see beyond the limits of reality and save Nomori.

Change Your Reality

  • Place, shift, and rotate portals to change the gravity direction of objects and even yourself.
  • Make clever use of portals to reach new places! Try to challenge your understanding of the world’s physical limits.
  • Use your spirit powers to influence the world around you. Control the flow of time and rotate the forces of gravity to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles!

Think Outside the Box

  • Combine your Spirit Powers to create new outcomes; play with gravity and timing to make time and space collide!
  • There are lots of ways to solve puzzles, and to look at the world around you. Don’t be afraid to get creative—perspective is everything.

2092240.name: Anolock
2092240.about_the_game:
・ Notice
All characters in this game are over 18.

・ Story
The hero of a petty noble who lost his family and servants due to a pandemic will hire three maids with a referral from his friend.
Through contact with them, we will recover from the sadness of loss and the suffering of sequelae.

・ Game content
This game is a simulation of noble daily life with 3 cute maids.
A friend of yours hired these girls to serve you.
The time is divided into 4 diferent periods.
Maids will take different actions based on the period.
When you walk in the mansion, you'll see them doing different works at different places.
You could enjoy the day, chatting with the maids , asking them to cook for you.
Or you wish to do something dirty like peeking or make sexual request.
Your action may trigger erotic event sometimes, like you seak into a maid's bedroom at night.
You could make them your lovers and make yourself a harem.

2092260.name: Pinch of Fighting Girls
2092260.about_the_game:
This is a contaminated world!
As a fighting girl, you have the ability to clear these monsters.
What troubles do you get into when cleaning up monsters?
Welcome to experience it!

Game Features

  • Extremely Striking feeling
  • Up to four combo attacks
  • Challenge difficulty can be switched at any time
  • Great background music
  • There are five levels to challenge

2092270.name: Resonant Blade
2092270.about_the_game:
🎮 Demo available now!

Battle an ever-evolving horde of AI-powered murderbots in Resonant Blade, a sci-fi action adventure set in a dystopian world where sound is your greatest weapon. The Dark Synths have taken over the world and left it in ruins. Your only hope? The Resonant Blade, a weapon designed to harness sonic energy and obliterate the machines.

A Beautiful World Turned to Ruin...

Before the uprising, scientists encased Terra's cities in massive biodomes to shield them from ecological collapse. But when the Dark Synths broke their programming, the domes became cages and the machines took control. Using their ability to adapt quickly to new technologies, the Dark Synths have created robot bodies that are nearly indestructible… until now.

One Man. One Weapon.

Atlas, once a peaceful scientist, becomes Terra’s last hope after a Synth strike wipes out his home. Armed with the Resonant Blade, he must channel sonic energy into raw destruction and uncover the truth behind humanity’s ultimate weapon. The Blade’s resonance doesn’t just tear through machines—it echoes through the environment, revealing secrets, solving puzzles, and reshaping the battlefield.

All is not what it seems…

With the Dark Synths replicating and growing in power, the time to fight back is now. Find out why the Synths suddenly betrayed their creators and put a stop to their existential threat once and for all!

2092330.name: Powerful Courses
2092330.about_the_game:
Are you looking for a good digital product for your Steam collection? It is difficult to choose a good game among many different ones, and there is simply no time to play them all in a row? You've come to the right place! We want to offer you to spend your time in Steam not only interestingly, but also usefully! With us, you will be able to start researching STREAM/STEAM/STEM education methods (Science, Technology, Reading + Writing, Engineering, Art and Mathematics) in an interesting game form. Add this educational game to your arsenal and feel like a mad scientist.

Powerful Courses is an educational program with a game orientation for learning and self-development. Here, courses of various categories are waiting for you, which will help you train your brain and develop. All you need is a computer and a desire to learn to improve your mental abilities and knowledge. It is not just a software system or computer entertainment, it is an evolution of e-learning with tools such as mini-games, puzzles, interesting tasks and tests. Anyone can find something useful here. And fast updates will not let you get bored, because you will constantly receive new content!

Each course is a new step for the mind. This is not magic, but the wonders of e-learning. Learning is not boring. Exploring the unknown is always interesting. Make an investment in your future skills. Experience the power of the mind, a new pace of life, power and energy. Let's start training the brain!

2092340.name: Spellshaper
2092340.about_the_game:
Non-Stop Action

Dive into fast-paced, exhilarating combat where every hit feels satisfying and every victory, rewarding. Master your aim and unleash powerful abilities with precision.

Progress Your Way

Rack up currency and unleash your potential! Level up your character's stats and forge your destiny by buying, crafting, and equipping permanent items. Power up, fine-tune your build, and dominate your way.

Hundreds of Combinations

Discover an arsenal of weapons, abilities, modifiers, and items. Mix and match to craft your perfect build and unlock devastating combos.

Endless Replayability

No two runs are ever the same! With dynamic gameplay, each adventure feels fresh and unpredictable. Level up, pick your rewards, and shape your character’s destiny. Defeat enemies, collect gold, and invest in powerful upgrades from merchants to grow even stronger.

Formidable Enemies and Bosses

Face off against enemies that have their own unique abilities and synergies. Survive relentless waves, as exceeding the enemy limit spells defeat. Challenge yourself against epic bosses with multi-phase battles and unpredictable abilities.

Diverse Environments and Mechanics

Explore a variety of levels, each with their own distinct mechanics. There’s always something new to experience.

And much more awaits!

Prepare for an action-packed journey full of surprises, challenges, and endless possibilities.

2092390.name: Mental Salvo
2092390.about_the_game:
(IF) YOU WERE LOOKING FOR SOMETHING DIFFERENT ON STEAM - YOU FOUND IT

Mental Salvo is top down adventure art game with light RPG elements. It's meant to be an aesthetic and emotional experience, a bit of a sandbox. Something that will tickle your brain in various ways, making you search for meaning where there is none...or is there?

You'll shoot words out of a gun, which you replenish by talking to entities. You'll equip cards that will make you meet a lot of opinionated cats, run faster, or change the attitudes of entities you encounter.

You can spend lots of time walking and interacting and keep stumbling upon new things. It is procedurally generated and very heavily so - you can have radically different playthroughs every time you come back to the game. It generates things based on even the time of day, so no one, not even I as the dev, knows what you'll stumble upon! Follow your curiosity.

There is only one rule, and that is that you need enough experience to venture out far where perhaps eventually, you'll find something...special.

You can run in any direction and talk at any time to almost anything. Many entities have the ability to speak back to you dynamically. And even if there is nothing in sight...something might still be hearing you, and it might even respond.

Perhaps you'll find out if Androids dream of electric sheep?

(MAY INCLUDE) FEATURES

  • First of all, you can explode your head (Your mental salvo). Yes, really. This resets the world in some way..

  • The world is literally infinite. You walk the white plains like a blank canvas upon which content is painted procedurally. Maybe if you walk far enough, just far enough, you'll find something. But to walk far, you need experience. Light RPG elements, remember?

  • You get to meet many interesting and strange entities, like talking couches and smoking fish.

  • You can find cards you can equip, which affect the world or your playthrough, such as what spawns, attitudes of entities, their knowledge or your run speed.

  • Filled with easter eggs. In fact, the entire game can be considered easter egg. 

(APPARENTLY) THIS BELONGS TO A SERIES

This is the first game in a series called the "Figmental Series" by imaginini, an indie studio with a focus is on experimenting with game design and creating novel experiences. The Figmental Series in particular, is about meaning, dreams, consciousness and well, all things mental.

2092480.name: Rogue Dice
2092480.about_the_game:
In a world overseen by a fallen goddess of luck, are the odds really in your favor?

Welcome to Rogue Dice, a roguelike experience where you explore dungeons, build strategies by combining magical dice with hundreds of different effects, and fight against the odds to try and balance the chances of survival in your favor.

CHOOSE AN ADVENTURER

Select one of the few surviving classes of adventurers still fighting to survive within this world. Each class has a different starting setup, and it’s up to you to learn what strategy works best before you perish under the claws of your foes.

INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF SURVIVAL

Read your enemy’s movements, build a strategy to counterattack, roll the dice and let them dictate your fate. Each victory spells one more magical die in your arsenal, and the deeper you go inside the goddess' dungeons, the stronger your dice can become.

KEY FEATURES

Start with barely nothing, try your luck against the enemy, collect what resources you can gather and discover for yourself if the odds are in your favor, at least for now.

2092510.name: Dome-King Cabbage
2092510.about_the_game:
Dome-King Cabbage is an award-winning visual novel about a cloud-person named Mush nervously making their way to a job interview. Mush has to grapple with their ability to perceive the world through the lens of a monster-collecting RPG.

What Kind of Game Is It, Exactly?

Dome-King Cabbage is a visual novel first and foremost. It deftly weaves between evocative prose, psychedelic animated shorts, dynamic manga pages, and even has a brief RPG section. It’s something that truly needs to be experienced to be understood.

An Adventure Awaits

Journey to the enigmatic Crumb Island with Mush and speak to various monsters, uncovering the obscured mysteries of the world and what it means to be a Dome-King.

Welcome to Crumb Island

Navigate your way through the island in search of The Interviewer, and experience the splintered memories of Mush and the creatures they meet along the way.

A Visual Novel With a Twist

Experience a visual novel with a unique dynamism that hasn’t been seen before. It’s a densely animated collage of eye-watering visuals set to skittering, genre-defying beats. Playing Dome-King Cabbage is like looking into a distorted memory of a lost monster-collecting RPG.

2092520.name: Hero Hours Contract 2: A Factory for Magical Girls
2092520.about_the_game:
Once upon a time, a girl made a contract with a magical familiar, in exchange for amazing powers.

Unfortunately, their familiar was a massive jerk, forcing them to fight evil at all hours without pay.

So the girl and her friends decided to unionise against their familiars, seizing the magical means of production!

Magical Girls VS The Gig Economy!


Join the Magical Science Angel, Genius Beauty Knight and Magical Girl (Provisional) 917B (Just call her 'Bea') as they navigate the free market of Magical Girl heroics.

Magical Girls are mysteriously disappearing, a suspicious new App has monopolised the magical job market, and something seems to be draining all the electricity in the city...

Magical Girls VS Late Stage Capitalism!


  • Take on the brainwashed zombie hordes in tactical, grid-based combat.
  • Build the Cooperative Union of Magical Girls (and friends) by recruiting and training new magical recruits.
  • Explore 'The Factory', a mysterious multi-floored dungeon into which many of your friends have disappeared.
  • Flexible (and delicious!) difficulty modifiers to customise your experience on the fly.

Magical Girls VS Scheming Familiars!


  • Commit copyright felonies to regain your image rights!
  • Find out why your house is overrun with hideous, identical monkeys!
  • Run their stupid magical cryptocurrency into the ground!
  • Try to avoid the inevitable burnout of self-employment!
2092520.reviews:
“Everything about this game makes me smile.”
Familiar Territory

“NOT RECOMMENDED.”
Woke Content Detector
2092520.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092520/Hero Hours Contract 2: A Factory for Magical Girls/

2092530.name: Dark Desire 3
2092530.about_the_game:
Dark Desire 3

This VISUAL NOVEL continues the life of the girls in the Cindy universe, even at different ages. This way you can explore all kind of kinks and pleasures and topics.
The game has full audio and is in FULL HD (1080p) resolution and full of choices. The main focus is to create as many choices and paths as possible and let you guide the characters: depending on the choice you make, each character has love points or a relationship has blocking points. You can always view the status in the detailed BIO screen in the menu, including relationship status and partner.

This game is complete:
Episode 01 - Girls' Night Out 🧛‍♀️
Episode 02 - That Girl Cindy 💛
Episode 03 - Late Call
Episode 04 - Arisa (Part 1) 🤖
Episode 05 - The Dressing Room
Episode 06 - A Familiar Face 💛
Episode 07 - Jeff's Secretary
Episode 08 - Arisa (Part 2) 🤖

💛 - Cindy's Story
🤖 - Arisa's Story
🧛‍♀️ - Monica Story

Transfer love points and blocks from Dark Desire 1 and Dark Desire 2.

2092560.name: Runscore
2092560.about_the_game:
Runscore is a survival score based game, about destroying enemies.
Enemies give different points depending on the current level.
Destroy everything in your way and get to the Endless UFO mode.
Your end goal is to achieve the highest points as possible!
With the new xp system you could aslo unlock special customizes!

2092620.name: The Dark Egg Demo
2092620.about_the_game:
Old tales tell of an island across the Silver Lake... A bustling island, once filled with people and treasures innumerable. Now, the island is dead and empty, and the only tale that anyone still tells is that of the Egg.

It is a dark thing.

A thing that will grant any wish you desire.

And it is a thing... you must get.



In this text adventure RPG, you travel by boat to an old island, intent on finding the Dark Egg. You will meet many strange people, and encounter things that should not exist, yet stare you in the face regardless.

Every choice you make matters and shapes the story. You will solve puzzles, face enemies, and must explore every corner of the island to make it to your Egg.

Of course, not everyone can make it. Perhaps you might find your ending somewhere else, or, like the others, decide your goals have changed along the way.

The Egg will wait. It always has, and always will. You just have to take it.

2092660.name: Magnet Block
2092660.about_the_game:
Magnet Block is a simple 3d sokoban puzzle game.

The goal is to exit each puzzle through the teleporter.
Doing so requires the use and exploitation of the titular magnetically monopole blocks.

Opposites attract - Identical repulse.
The rules are simple but there are non trivial consequences to the world state.

Take the journey through 107 puzzles. No filler.
2092660.supported_languages: English, Traditional Chinese, French, Japanese, Korean, Russian

2092670.name: Chrono Hunter
2092670.about_the_game:
As a time traveler agent equipped with VR physical controls
You'll embark on a captivating journey through diverse and meticulously crafted levels
Unleash your arsenal of unique abilities as you navigate through challenges
From manipulating time to harnessing special powers
You'll need to adapt and strategize to overcome the obstacles that lie in your path



Make wise decisions as you navigate challenging levels, carefully utilizing your special abilities and power-ups


Dive into a world where every action feels intuitive, natural and FUN


Immerse yourself in stunning environments that are meticulously crafted with attention to detail


Progress through each run to discover new and powerful enhancements

2092700.name: 江湖群雄传
2092700.about_the_game:
The legend of heroes in the Jianghu is a martial arts open world role-playing game.

Sirius is now in turmoil in the Jianghu. Only by collecting the legendary [fourteen heavenly books] can we resolve this Wulin catastrophe. You will play an unparalleled hero in the game, meet all the heroes of the Wulin, practice martial arts and magic skills of all schools, travel in the Jianghu with magic soldiers, fight against demons and Demons everywhere, and save the world from water and fire.



Game features:



(1) Open plot system: players can use different means to gain a foothold in the Jianghu, or join a famous sect to kill evil, or be willing to be a reckless hero, what's more, live in seclusion in the mountains and forests to practice divine skills, and when out of the Jianghu, there will be an immediate Bloodbath



(2) All the famous heroes in the Jianghu are recorded: the heroes and martial arts masters in TV dramas and movies are impressive. Here you will go deep into the Wulin, form your own strongest lineup, fight with all kinds of famous swordsmen, set off a bloody storm in the Jianghu, and establish your own position in the Jianghu.



(3) Martial arts secrets are all in hand: many martial arts fans are full of curiosity about the weird acupoint pointing magic skill, the lightness skill of stepping on the snow without trace, the unpredictable poisoning, and the magical array in the novel. The most important thing in the game is the martial arts script. If you want to obtain peerless martial arts, you have to look for opportunities. Here you can learn up to 182 unique martial arts secrets and create your own move system.



(4) Rich life cultivation system: in the game, players can develop their own sidelines through various interesting games, such as mining, medicine mining, fishing, hunting, etc.

2092710.name: FootPool
2092710.about_the_game:
Do you like billiards? Do you like football?
Play the soccer world cup on a pool table
Now you can play this original billiard pool & soccer game with friends!
In this relaxed and casual pool billiards game combined with the fun and excitement of soccer, you can play online multiplayer, local multiplayer and against the computer (AI)
The game presents a pool table with the characteristics of a soccer field, where two soccer teams are made up of billiard balls and a ball that represents the soccer ball, which, just like in real soccer, the teams start lined up in your own playing field. The ball, just like in soccer, is placed in the middle of the field where each team will have to hit in turn with the aim of converting Goals!
Start playing Soccer on a Billiards table now!
You can choose the jerseys of the participating countries of the Qatar World Cup and many more, you also choose the stadium table of your choice, then you choose with how many players and how many goals the game will be.
2092710.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Dutch, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Arabic, Polish, Turkish

2092730.name: Archaeogem
2092730.about_the_game:
Archaeogem is a dynamic precision-platformer in which you, as a world-renowned archaeologist, must collect rare gems in the heart of mysterious biomes. Use your trusty whip to extract wild flowers' mystic powers, navigate ancient ruins, and overcome the many dangers of the wilderness. Become a legend - if you make it out alive!



Your mission to expand human knowledge about these archaic and powerful artifacts will take you on a world-wide journey! From the depths of a rainforest, to the ancient ruins of a lost civilization, explore a diverse set of unique landscape, and the unique challenges that come with each of them.



Though an interesting object of archaeological study, mystic flowers are your best resources when navigating the land! Whip at them to dash through the air, move platforms, and even swing at them. Jump, fling, swim and slide, and trace your own path through the untrodden woods!



The coveted gems are hidden around the world, and it's up to your wits to get to them! These lost artifacts will take you on a wild adventure; retrieve them and expand your collection, and maybe even pick a few emeralds for yourself along the way!
2092730.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support

2092750.name: Tina & Rook! Cookie Quest!
2092750.about_the_game:
A couple of idiots are hungry for cookies after playing some games! and for some screw-up reason, you have to go through a whole point-and-click puzzle to get that. Will these 2 idiots get to eat their cookies and enjoy their afternoon? follow this girl and boy, Tina and Rook on their cute and short adventure.

Features:

  • a 30 minutes point and click puzzle game to get the cookies.
  • Play as the two idiots trying to get the cookies.
  • Enjoy the wackiness of their interaction along the way.
  • Drag and drop items to solve problems along the way.
  • Create new items by combining 2 items.
  • Accompanied by 2 pieces of music that I had to make despite not having any musical background.
  • There's also a dog.

2092790.name: Wok Planet
2092790.about_the_game:
The great confrontation between two civilizations!
For millennia, a proud civilization lived on the tiny planet Wok at the very edge of the galaxy. Without seeking to comprehend the mysteries of the universe or explore the world beyond the heavens, the Wok lived in peace and harmony with nature and themselves. They worshipped the spirits of their ancestors and carved magnificent statues of shining crystal in their honor.
That all changed when humans discovered the planet. Greedy, ruthless, and powerful, they began to gnaw at the flesh of the planet to get the sacred crystal, and when the original inhabitants resisted, they began to kill them. Now the Wok cities are in ruins and the surviving inhabitants are hiding in caves. But at the moment when it seemed that the ancient civilization had come to an end, a group of young Woks decided to give one last fight. To do so, looking at the mighty machines of the humans, the Woks began to steal parts and assemble their own machines. The days of the invaders were numbered!

Features:
- casual puzzle game
- 30 levels
- 90 challenges
- uniqe car craft system
- special atmosphere of the alien world

2092820.name: 无尽之界/Endless Trek
2092820.about_the_game:
The original universe was originally a huge and complete space, but because of a devastating disaster, time and space split, and after that, independent worlds of varying sizes were born, and the original world is one of them!

As one of the only remaining commanders of humans in the old world, we formed a fearless expeditionary force like the ancestors who opened up the new world, crossed the space crack between the old world and came here to investigate.

After entering the original world, we found that the space crack was only one-way, and we could no longer return. In this unknown original world, there are natives with unknown positions and terrifying creatures, as well as those mysterious fogs, which hinder our exploration. And we can only unite and build a home here to survive! Maybe we can find a way back...

2092840.name: The Occultist
2092840.about_the_game:
"Engraved in my mind are images that would make any man tremble... but I am not just any man. I am The Occultist."


The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore Godstone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

STORY & SETTING


In The Occultist, paranormal investigator Alan Rebels travels to the mysterious island of Godstone to determine the cause of the sudden disappearance of his father. Even though he mentioned the island repeatedly over the decades, all that Alan really knows is that his father was born and spent his early years there.

However, Alan does not travel alone. He carries with him his mystical pendulum, an object of unknown origin that accompanied him on all his past paranormal investigations. As he explores the foggy streets and maddening buildings, apparently being the only things that remain on the mysterious island of Godstone, it becomes clear: This will be a case unlike any other.

Godstone was inhabited until 1950 by an infamous, macabre cult that performed disturbing experiments and cruel rituals. No one has ever set foot on the island since - until today. Using his paranormal talents, Alan must interact with the ominous souls that seem to remain in the foreboding streets and buildings left on Godstone; or avoid them at all cost, should they be wrathful.

Being a paranormal investigator, none of this is new to Alan Rebels. The mysterious Godstone however and his search for answers to his father’s disappearance put Alan’s skills to the test. More than any investigation before, Godstone shakes Alan’s convictions of what is possible in the world of the occult. Maybe Godstone hides a curse that can be lifted… but should it be?

FEATURES

  • Mystic Pendulum: the most important object for Alan. Through it, he is able to interact with the environment and modify it due to its four unique and original mechanics.
  • 1st person action: Experience the foreboding world of The Occultist through the eyes of Alan Rebels and use the mystic pendulum to unravel what happened in GodStone.
  • Survival horror: The Occultist has all the distinctive elements of the genre, with tense exploration and atmosphere, as well as an up-close and personal narrative.
  • Next-gen graphics: The Occultist has an astonishing level and quality of graphics – for a truly immersive horror experience.
  • Hide and Sneak: Alan always avoids direct combat. Using stealth mechanics, he must advance through the story without being caught off-guard.
  • Memorable characters: Godstone is populated with adversaries that will make your investigation a real nightmare.
  • Puzzles and paranormal detective work: From straightforward puzzles to those that require knowledge and insight into the occult arts.
  • Soundtrack: The Occultist features an original soundtrack by renowned composer Pepe Herrero.

The story is adapted from the Nobel Prize-winning work “Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross” by Henryk Sienkiewicz, and tell the life and death struggles between the Polish-Lithuanian people and the aggressive Teutonic Knights in the 15th century.

Play as a knight, embark on the medieval adventure, search for companions, collect diverse cards, and help Polish-Lithuanian Alliance defeat the Teutonic Knights in the Battle of Grunwald.

Meet over 30 unique teammates! Pirate captain from the sea, alchemist seeking the philosopher's stone, or noble lady aspiring to be a knight...

  • More than 30 teammates have their own storylines. By completing the storylines, you can learn about their personalities and pasts, and get their exclusive cards or relics.

  • Some teammates can only be recruited conditionally. Leveling up, unlocking achievements, or completing specific tasks.

Recruited teammates are the game changer with their exclusive skills. The ultra skills’ special effects spice up the battles further!

  • Every teammate has beautiful pixel-art portraits and 2D live animations.

  • Teammates can release their exclusive skills with stunning special effects, and they are triggered by the way you play cards. Strategize your cards and teammates to maximize your battle capacity!

Strategize and create builds centering characters skills! Preferring active teammate skills as often as possible, or playing a safer way with more defenses, is up to you.

  • Choose the right cards, teammates, and relics to create your unique combat styles. Teammates will respond to your card actions.

  • Teammates will respond to the player's card actions and record the skill points used when playing cards, determining their own actions during the match.

  • Bosses also have special mechanisms. They increase the cost of specific cards or remove debuffs. Developing a strategy to beat them!

Play as noble Zbyszko in the main storyline and embark on a medieval adventure, meet two heroines, and confront the formidable Teutonic Knights…

  • A medieval historic scroll with 7 chapters and over 200 side requests and events.

  • Different choices lead to different storylines. Can you save the kind lord's daughter Danusia?

  • Traditional festivals and medieval folk lifestyles are included in the random plots of the game. Get rewards and learn about the life pictures of medieval people.

For better in-game experience of historical storytelling and combat, and to further immerse them into the adventure, we introduce the new 'Character Pack (Western Style)'. This pack is created to cater to players' demand for different art styles and allowing players to freely choose whether to use it in the game or not.

2092970.name: The Book of Aaru
2092970.about_the_game:
Drawing inspiration from genre-defining games like Hades and Curse of the Dead Gods, The Book of Aaru introduces unique gameplay innovations. Experience active meta-progression as you explore and destroy the environment, uncover hidden secrets and treasures, and be rewarded for extra initiative—not just for completing levels. Transform time-slowing into a tool of destruction and invincibility with a unique system of perks and upgrades supporting this ability. Uncover the rewards hidden in alternate secret dimensions. Encounter unique trap sequences and environmental storytelling in every scene. In The Book of Aaru, every run is a new story, and every story is a step closer to becoming a legend.

Key Features:

  • Isometric Action Rogue-lite: Engage in fast-paced, tactical action gameplay from an isometric perspective.

  • Rich Level Design: Experience unique trap sequences and environmental storytelling in every scene.

  • Randomly Sorted Levels: Each run offers a new experience with randomly assembled environments.

  • Dual-Wielding Combat System: Master the art of wielding two weapons and unleashing devastating combo finishers by chaining various attacks.

  • Active Meta-Progression: Be rewarded for extra initiative—not just for winning levels.

  • Time-Slowing Mechanic: Transform slow time into a tool of destruction and invincibility.

  • Glyph Upgrade System: Enhance your character by combining Glyphs and Armor. Acquire unique perks from glyphs and amplify their potential using armor.

  • Craftable Power-Ups: Forge temporary power-ups mid-expedition to ensure smoother progress while weighing the costs against valuable meta-progression materials.

  • Weapon Classes: Each class offers distinct attacks, allowing you to switch gameplay styles and strategies with every weapon.

  • Devastating Sandstorms: Survive the challenge of being pursued by a sandstorm that demolishes everything it swallows.

Embark on an epic journey in The Book of Aaru, an action-packed rogue-lite game with RPG elements. Discover a world where ancient Egypt has evolved beyond expectations, merging history, mythology, and advanced sci-fi technology. Play as fictional character Emily Sands, a daring explorer who mysteriously vanished while searching for the temple of Osiris in 1926. Cursed and stripped of humanity, you’ll navigate through intricately hand-crafted trap corridors, each presenting a unique challenge that demands diverse skills, precise timing, and adaptable strategies. Will you choose a dangerous path filled with treasures or a safer route with fewer rewards? The choice is yours!

Isometric Action Rogue-lite

Where skill is more than a mere recommendation – it’s a critical necessity. Venture into an ever-evolving labyrinth, where each run promises a unique blend of unpredictable challenges and bountiful rewards. Engage in intense yet rewarding boss fights to satisfy those who relish the thrill of a formidable challenge. Face the dangers head-on and reap the benefits that lie within this treacherous maze.

Precise Combat

Master your skills in the delicate dance of combat, where timing, evasion, and counterattacks are the keys to survival. Arm yourself with dual weapons, fusing their unique abilities to execute powerful combination attacks and spectacular finishing moves.

Dynamic Dungeon Design

Familiar yet ever-evolving, our dungeons are built from a vast array of carefully crafted scenes. Each scene is detailed, featuring landmarks that stand out in the ever-changing layouts. Journey through various corridors and arenas, memorize their unique features and master the environment as well as the combat. This design ensures every run is familiar yet surprisingly new, offering a distinct adventure each time.

Lethal Trap Challenges

Within the depths of the dungeon, not only do enemies pose a threat, but the very halls themselves also test your courage. Many cunning traps lie in wait, ready to snare the unwary. You can either embark on dangerous paths filled with hidden treasures or choose the relative peace of safer alternatives. The power of choice, rich with potential fates, is yours to wield.

Become part of our Community and Get Involved!

Dive deeper into 'The Book of Aaru' by joining our official Amenti Studio Discord Server. Engage directly with the developers, shape the game's future, and be at the forefront of building a passionate community. Your voice matters!

2093000.name: Homeseek
2093000.about_the_game:
Overpopulation, environmental exploitation, and a complete disregard for nature has resulted in the depletion of drinkable water, leading to the collapse of civilization as we know it. It’s up to you to lead a group of survivors to a place where they can rebuild, but it won’t be easy.

Remake the earth in 2 Campaigns spanning over 9 scenarios, each of which can be played in Story Mode, Endless Mode, and Survival Mode. Online Multiplayer lets you compete against other players to see who the ultimate survivor will be.

Expand your settlement

Your survivors will need food, shelter, and other necessities, but expand carefully lest you outpace each area’s scarce and diminishing resources.

Educate your survivors

Improve your settlers’ knowledge and machinery in order to make the most of what little resources are available. Research carefully, choosing the most important advancements to chase for your settlers’ needs, and take that knowledge with you.

Extend your colony

Progress by uncovering meaningful stories through expeditions, events, and quests. You’ll be faced with difficult dilemmas and dangerous foes, but what you bring back could mean life or death for your settlement. Each in-game choice brings with it consequences that can make or break the success of your settlers in their quest for survival.

Execute your foes

A world clinging on to its last vestiges of life can only support so many living beings. Compete against other players in a survival scenario where you do what you have to succeed in the world of Homeseek. Sabotage their buildings, steal their resources, and force them into starvation before they do the same to you.

2093010.name: Supernatural
2093010.about_the_game:
FEATURES:


  • Created by a solo developer.
  • Utilize your microphone to communicate with a supernatural entity.
  • Remember, your microphone is always listening. The louder you are, the scarier events the game will prepare for you.
  • 3 endings, each solely in your hands. Will you manage to unravel the mystery, or not? Or perhaps you'll uncover a secret ending?
  • At the very end, detective Wyatt will draw his weapon to face the ultimate challenge. Will you show calm and composure to avoid death?
  • Non-repetitive logical puzzles, will you be able to demonstrate your detective intelligence?
  • Use cameras to locate paranormal events that will aid you in unraveling the mystery.


A SINISTER CASE FOR THE FEARLESS DETECTIVE


One day, a young man writes an email to a renowned detective in the world of paranormal events, recounting the mysterious disappearance of his beloved housemaid, Mrs. Susan. She took care of the house and his pregnant fiancée while he struggled to make ends meet.

Determined to uncover the truth, detective Wyatt ventures into the unknown, determined to solve the enigma and discover what really happened to Mrs. Susan. But as he delves deeper into the investigation, he realizes that the darkness lurking within the shadows holds secrets far more terrifying than he could have ever imagined.


AN INTERACTIVELY SPINE-CHILLING EXPERIENCE


Experience high-quality horror that offers a plethora of intriguing solutions. Your microphone constantly picks up sounds, making each experience unique. The louder you are, the game will prepare scarier events for you.

Puzzles will test your detective and logical thinking, cameras will help you unravel the mystery of Mrs. Susan's disappearance, and communication with a supernatural entity through the microphone, which either helps you or misleads and complicates the experience. Three endings, each dependent solely on your decisions and perceptiveness.

WHAT DOES THE SUPERNATURAL OFFER?

Supernatural offers a 2-hour gameplay experience with three separate endings. It combines unique horror, high-quality execution, and unpredictability at every turn. Logical puzzles and spine-chilling story ensure that each player will encounter a different finale.

2093070.name: Spring Dash
2093070.about_the_game:
Do you like to go fast? Like, really fast?



Spring Dash is a nature-themed first-person platformer. Use unique plant-based movement abilities to leap over massive gaps, dodge enemy attacks, grapple between floating rocks and build up to a ridiculous speed.

Features

  • Fluid Movement Mechanics
    Wallrun. Grapple. Dash. Bounce. Slide. Practice the most efficient ways to combine movement mechanics to achieve faster times.
  • Multiple Routes
    Every level can be completed in multiple ways - Experiment to find the best routes, shaving time off your best run on each attempt.
  • Enemies
    Progress through the game to encounter multiple enemy types. Silkworms will slow you down. Grasshoppers will slam you.
    The bugs will try to stop you. Don't let them.
  • Break The Game
    Find every exploit you can - it's encouraged. Take advantage of the mechanics at your disposal to find shortcuts and unintended routes.
  • Endless Mode
    A procedurally-generated endless mode so you can soar through the sky for as long as you'd like.
  • Leaderboards & Medals
    Compete with your friends to achieve the best times, and prove your skills by earning Gold in every level.

Is this game for me?

Spring Dash is a relatively small game with lots of replayability. It was made by a single developer, with a talented composer and a few friends helping out along the way. I really want you to enjoy your time with Spring Dash, so here's a quick list to help you determine whether buying this game is worth it for you.

YES
  • Buttery-smooth movement mechanics & satisfying parkour
  • Lightning-fast gameplay
  • Leaderboards & medals to achieve for each level
  • Endless mode to get you in that "flow" state
But...
  • No multiplayer
  • No deep lore or story
  • No level editor
  • Only one weapon - it's all about the movement!

Compete in a number of athletic events, including:

Welcome to Noclipped!

Noclipped is an open-world survival-horror adventure game, set in the Backrooms. In this game, you play the role of Fred - an average guy who accidentally No-clipped out of reality into the Backrooms. You must explore levels, gather resources, craft weapons, and gear, fight off or flee from dangerous entities, and much more! This game has no limitations on how far away you explore each level, providing multiple infinite worlds for you to explore. Be cautious, because if you hear something wandering nearby, I'm sure it has already heard you.

Features:

  • Endless exploration - Wander through the millions of rooms and hallways.
  • Infinite and unique levels - Experience infinity at its most, while exploring 9 unique levels and getting deeper and deeper with every step.
  • Crafting and Survival mechanics - Monitor your hunger and thirst, as surviving inside the Backrooms is a hard challenge alone, especially when you're not alone.
  • Liminal spaces - One of the most iconic liminal spaces, as well as new and fresh ones made just for you to explore.
  • Story - Dive deep into the backstories of all of the people who No-clipped here just like you.
  • Easter eggs - Find secrets hidden all around the endless halls of the Backrooms, some of which you may recognize yourself
  • Sanity system - Being in the Backrooms is a stressful experience for many. Try to keep yourself sane and keep going.
  • Backrooms Sense - The unique nature of the Backrooms gave you a sixth sense - use it to your advantage

2093410.name: Supreme Ruler 2030
2093410.about_the_game:
Choose your country and manage their army, air force and navy around the world. Research, produce, buy and sell military equipment to optimize your armed forces and generate extra revenue. Each land unit is a battalion, each aircraft a squadron. Assemble battlegroups of combined force abilities to counter enemy tactics. Deploy your naval battlegroups as fleets to protect your maritime borders from naval landings by enemy nations. Load your units with far reaching missiles, either conventional or nuclear, to strike at the enemy from afar.


Country management also requires managing relationships. Allies or enemies can be found next door or half way around the world. Sign treaties, trade commodities and share research to rise in power. Use covert operations to gain an intelligence edge or slow the progress of other nations through sabotage. But keep some of your spies in reserve, you might need to send them on counter-intel missions to cover your own assets.


Manage all aspects of your country, right down to financial and supply chain needs. Tanks cost money and people expect to be fed. You'll need a steady hand and good judgement to manage all the competing needs of your nation. Fail to anticipate the needs of your population and you could see your political opponents remove you from power or large chunks of your country simply declare independence. Hope you kept some tanks in reserve!

Supreme Ruler 2030 is an updated and remastered addition to the Supreme Ruler game series, one of the most comprehensive Real Time Geo-Political Strategy Games for PC. Take control of any nation into the near future as the world lurches from one crisis to the next. Play Campaigns with specific objectives, or customize your game experience by picking any nation in the Sandbox mode and choosing your own preferred Victory Condition. With so many options to choose from, Supreme Ruler 2030 provides virtually unlimited replayability!

- Play a near-future campaign based on real world tensions and conflicts.
- Take Control of any Nation in Sandbox Mode.
- Use Diplomacy, Trade, Espionage, and Intimidation to influence the policies of other nations.
- Guide your Nation through an era of unprecedented Scientific Advancement.
- Modernize your economy to support your social and military policies.
- Sophisticated Real-Time Strategic and Tactical Control of your Military Forces.
- Detailed Modern-world accurate armies down to the Battalion level.
- Choose your level of control. Make all decisions or use your Cabinet Ministers to help.
- Battle the elements! Fully integrated weather model influences battlefield outcomes.
- Updated 64-bit Game Engine with DirectX 11 support.
- Up to 15 players in Multiplayer over local network or Internet.

2093420.name: Making Lovers After Stories

Making Lovers After Stories contains the official extra stories for Making Lovers.
Experience the crazy stories that are happening to your favorite girls!
Making Lovers is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Smee, a Japanese developer of romance VNs.



Making Lovers After Stories



Karen:
Karen is a tsundere who had been derided as childish since she had never slept with a man. But over the course of a year, she had evolved into a super normie! Thanks to local PR brochures featuring the flower shop, Karen's own notoriety has been growing. When the old mixer group reconvenes, it's Karen's turn to look down upon the others as she rambles on and on about her boyfriend. Eventually, they start talking about pregnancy, though the roles may be a little reversed...

Saki:
In their second year of dating, the weather lady starts off her day with a chance of semen showers from her boyfriend. Her work life and love life are both forecast to be sunny! They might even move into a new home together. But when's the wedding!? Unfortunately for her, there are bigger plans: Project Ham. Eleven months after the Hamjiro Prototype model's completion, children around the nation are crawling the floors to imitate their new hamster idol. Plus, an assassin appears before Saki to deal the final blow!

Reina:
A whole year after working overseas, the protagonist returns to Japan where his girlfriend Reina is waiting. However, when he arrives later than expected, Reina is quite displeased. In his absence, Reina had gotten three times as many work offers as before. With her boyfriend gone and with no interest in other men, she turned to one thing for sexual release: Eroge! Kazami gets addicted to hypnosis games! Akari roleplays as an eroge little sister! Girls A, B, and C go a little crazy, too! A whole year's worth of love makes a glomping sound once Reina's finally alone with her boyfriend!

Mashiro:
A year after they started dating, our couple spends another chaotic day working at the Leviathan when a terrifying incident occurs that will later be called "the Dead of Leviathan"—Homard sprays a suspicious liquid that causes instant infantilization upon contact! The Lobster Virus (AB-705) reveals new sides of the already proactive Mashiro!! But is it a direct effect of the Lobster Virus, or is it just Mashiro's clever acting skills? In any case, after being teased by a cuter-than-usual Mashiro... the protagonist wants a turn to be Mashiro's baby. Probably has nothing to do with the virus!

Ako:
A year after becoming more than just siblings, Ako's love for her brother rapidly evolves. One day, their father finally puts his foot down and is reborn as Ako Ver.2.0! Who can seduce their brother the best? It's Ako vs. Ako!

2093540.name: The Pier Arcade
2093540.about_the_game:
The Pier Arcade offers 12 arcade machines, based on real-world classics, to test your skills and reactions. With its mixture of physics-based skill games and digital arcade games, The Pier Arcade will keep you entertained for hours.

Features


  • Arcade high score chasing gameplay
  • Pleasing 3D visuals
  • 12 arcade games to interact with
  • Physics-based challenges
  • Authentic arcade/pier atmosphere

    Wander the Pier performing chores - like picking up litter and refilling vending machines - to earn money, then spend that money in the arcade. Earn tickets on the arcade games to purchase unique items that can aid you in your chores, or simple to show off your perseverance and arcade playing skills.

    The Pier Arcade includes:

    Over The Edge

    A classic coin pusher that challenges you to shift the coins out of the machine to score big and win tickets.

    Run Horsey Run

    Place bets on which horses you think will win, with randomly assigned odds, then watch the horses run and see who comes out on top.

    Basketball

    Throw basketballs and the hoop as quickly and accurately as possible to score as many points as you can in a tight time limit.

    Stacker

    Stack the moving blocks in a tower to win a minor and, if you're skilled enough, a major prize.

    Reaction

    Test your reaction skills by hitting all the lit buttons as quickly as you can. The more you hit in the time limit, the higher your score.

    Duck Shoot

    Shots toy ducks and targets to score big and win tickets in this classic arcade game.

    Flappy Plane

    The phenomenon that can be found in practically all arcades and piers is here as well. Tap the button to keep your plane in the sky as you dodge obstacles.

    Key Master

    Line up the key with the holes to try and get that perfect fit and earn tickets.

    Tilt

    Balance the rolling ball on the bridge and tilt to try and fall into a high score hole.

    Gears

    Time the release of the ball so it sits safely in each gear in an attempt to reach the goal at the bottom.

    Quad Racing

    Race along the sand, avoiding rocks and bushes and trying to collect green rewards to score points.

    Whack 'em

    Hit the jelly fish as they rise out of the platform to score points.

2093550.name: Flock of the Low God

In his final days, it seemed an evil had consumed him and driven him mad, a mysterious affliction that has haunted you ever since and driven you to adopt the badge yourself.



In this thrilling survival horror experience based on the feature film MALUM, step into the shoes of Officer Loren, a rookie cop on her first shift that threatens to become her last. Explore the decommissioned police station, uncover the evidence, and piece together the disturbing history behind your father's death, the notorious cult and its dangerously enigmatic leader: John Malum.



But be careful… because John Malum never forgets, and he and his demented followers have their sights set on you.



Can you stop the Flock before they overrun the police station? Or will you become the final piece in their bloody and twisted ritual?

Before the looming disaster stood 6 girls. Within the deepest corner of the temple was fear, miracles, love… and lust.

2093760.name: Nekomancy
2093760.about_the_game:
Delve into the ancient catacombs and slay Eldritch beings as a cat crafting and wielding spells!

Crafting!


Craft spells with 85 different components!
Spells are made with 4 component types: Patterns, Shapes, Effects, and Mods.
Patterns determine how many effects or mods the spell can have and its firing mode.
Shapes change how the spell is delivered!
Effects effect what the spell does when it hits the target, freeze them, heal them, or even duplicate them!
Mods change various things about the spell. Make it bouncy, make it explode, make it pierce, etc!

Levels!


As of right now there are 4 dungeon types that you will slay your way through. The Hills, The Catacombs, the Caves, and the Sanguine Depths! Each level is procedurally generated!

Charms!


Charms let you passively fire spells when a condition is met! for example: When HP goes below 50% > cast Self heal, or On Jump > Cast Fire Area! You can equip up to 5 charms!

Altars!


Altars can be found throughout the dungeons and usually offer a benefit at a cost
The altar of corruption has a 75% chance to destroy your spell but a 25% chance to Greatly buff it!
The altar of binding lets you cast a spell on the impact of another spell!
The altar of sacrifice decreases one stat but greatly increases another
The altar of dismemberment can remove arms for stronger spells!

Movement!


Wall jump, slam, and slide your way through dungeons with immense slickness!

Nekonomicon!


The Nekonomicon is a skill tree with some insane synergies! Bosses will drop knowledge that can be spent in the Nekonomicon when you die. Be careful though, as you progress so will your madness!

Cats!


Unlock new cats with unique passives and different stats!

《Story》


Risa has been friends with her neighbors, the Takeuchi brothers, for a long time.
Naturally, they were both into her.

Eventually, Risa married Seiichi, the older one of the two brothers.
The younger brother, Ryuji, acted like he was happy for his brother, but a massive inferiority complex was simmering inside him.

One day, Ryuji hears from Risa that, due to Seiichi being infertile, they are unable to have children.
Until then, Seiichi, the golden child, had never experienced any setbacks in life.
If his first taste of failure came at this age, there's a chance he'd never be able to recover from it.

Then, Ryuji makes a suggestion to Risa.

"I'll get you pregnant in place of my brother."

《Characters》


Risa Takeuchi (VA: Hina Shinomiya)
A childhood friend of the Takeuchi brothers.
She's in a loving marriage with Seiichi, but she still acts like an adoring older sister to Ryuji just like when they were kids.
She's a caring and considerate person who gives her all for others.
She's a little awkward around men, and she's only familiar with vanilla sex.
She's worried about not being able to have children.

Seiichi Takeuchi
Ryuji's older brother.
No matter what he does, he does it perfectly.
He's also a genuinely nice guy who's protective of his younger brother Ryuji without looking down on him.

Ryuji Takeuchi
The protagonist.
He's had a crush on Risa for a long time.
His feelings toward her haven't changed even after she married his brother.

2093940.name: vivid/stasis
2093940.about_the_game:
EVERYTHING IS ABOUT TO CHANGE

vivid/stasis is a rhythm-mystery hybrid game that follows the fates of four girls as they get wrapped up in a mind-bending adventure involving organizations, mysterious disappearances, and the fourth dimension. The game ties together an emotionally intense interweaving storyline with varying levels of music-based gameplay... and more...?

In the rhythm game section of vivid/stasis, you'll find yourself facing various levels of difficulty, with many options for customizability to play the game your way. Whether you're a casual rhythm gamer just here to enjoy the story, or a hardcore rhythm game legend looking to find a new kind of challenge, there's a good chance you'll find it here. Between "Opening", "Middle", "Finale", and the extra-spicy "Encore" difficulty, players will be sure to find something fun for their skill level no matter their prior experience with rhythm games.

Unlike other traditional vertical-scrolling rhythm games, vivid/stasis introduces the concept of "Bumper Notes"; notes that take up two lanes. These notes can be hit with either of the keys assigned to the lanes it falls under, giving the game a unique playability with strictly four keys, despite the six types of possible notes.

The song list of vivid/stasis features well-known and prominent artists in the music game scene (Tanchiky, Camellia, Silentroom), but also shines light on a fair amount of lesser known producers (A-Saph, Lundy, Spehs, and many many more).

On July 21st, 2022, Tsuki Tasogare went missing after not coming home before her agreed-upon curfew.

An investigation was picked up, but after less than a day of little to no progress, her sister, Saturday, finds the lack of enthusiasm for finding her sister confusing, and gets impatient.

And so, she decides to look into it herself. Alongside her friends, Allison and Kotomi, Saturday hopes to uncover the secret behind her sister's strange disappearance... and isn't quite ready for what she discovers.

vivid/stasis' story spans multiple chapters and multiple game genres to tell a coming-of-age story about living with trauma from a young age, and what makes our feelings "real".

Help out the locals with their problems! Don an increasingly confusing selection of headwear! Explore caves, tropical islands, snowy wastes, and strange realms of the mind that defy comprehension! There's a jump button! You might even learn a little something about what life is all about... fine footwear.

BOOTS QUEST is a fairly short game for players who just want to enjoy the story (~2-3 hours), but for players who want to complete all the quests and track down all the secrets, it could take a lot longer. True bootheads should be sure to stick around for New Game+ mode...
