2094000.name: Buddies in Boxes
2094000.about_the_game:
Buddies in Boxes is a quirky turn-based strategy game where adorable characters race for points to earn the title of Most Appealing. Outplay your opponents by developing your buddy through a careful selection of foods, skills, and jobs.



The game can be setup in many different ways, with each setup containing 2 - 6 players (Human or AI), 3 - 4 jobs allowing access to new skills, and a market where players can spend their coin and buy various foods.

Each game setup is its own puzzle, with every particular skill or food presently available being a piece that pushes the game in different directions and opens up new strategies. Picking from a wide variety of game pieces and combinations, there are countless possible setups offering refreshing and intriguing experiences. In addition, a game can be set up with Conditions that can vary how the game is played. From extending night rounds to boosting each player's starting coins, Conditions bring another twist into the fold.

Features

  • Hotseat Multiplayer for up to 6 Players.
  • Single player Scenario Mode with pre-selected balanced setups to gradually introduce mechanics and progressively challenge the player.
  • Free Play Mode with adjustable game setup options, playable with friends or varying AI difficulties.
  • 8 different buddies to play as, or play against, each with their own unique ability.
  • Over 20 different types of food to grow your buddies in a myriad of different ways.
  • 7 different jobs for buddies to promote to, each having at least 4 unique skills to change up the game.
  • 9 neutral skills that anybuddy can use.

Promote and Play

When your buddy promotes to a new job they gain powerful skills and a matching new look! Surge ahead with the Scientist's intelligence or keep the competition in check with the Robber. Play the field, though, as jobs can potentially counter one another. Too many players promoting to Cop can discourage a Robber, and too many Spies can steal intelligence from a Scientist, literally!

Night and Day

Rounds progress through day and night which affects the usage and availability of certain skills and foods. Time your strategies carefully to get the most out of the day or prepare for the night.

2094070.name: Quest Master
2094070.about_the_game:
In Quest Master, your wildest dungeon designs come alive and beckon adventurers from around the globe to test their mettle. It's a world where your imagination reigns supreme, and every challenge you craft is a siren call to glory-seekers eager for the thrill of your creation!

MAKE YOUR OWN DUNGEONS

An endless canvas. Add additional floors to your dungeon and make them as big as you can imagine.

Cycle between unique dungeon themes with the click of a button to give your dungeon a fresh coat of paint. Set your dungeon in a sand temple, a fiery cavern or in a lush forest. All components of the dungeon swap on the fly -- you're never locked into just one.

INTERACTIONS

Creating interactions is as simple as drag and drop! Place items in chests or make an enemy ride a minecart.

Use the context menu to change properties and add conditions using shape matching or predefined conditions.

IT'S DANGEROUS TO BUILD ALONE

Have some inventive friends? Round them up and work together to build and explore in local co-op with up to 3 friends.

Don't have friends? Use puppets to swap between other characters so you can play multiplayer dungeons even while alone.

SHARE YOUR CREATIONS

Built the perfect dungeon? Upload it for other players to test their mettle. Need a new challenge? Dive into another dungeon from the ever-growing list of community-uploaded creations and compete with other players for the world record.

EXPLORE CASTLE TOWN!

Take a break from dungeon creation and diving with side-activities and mini-games in Castle Town like Lucky's Locks.

Train your combat abilities at the dojo!

JEWELRY

A variety of rings can be equipped before tackling dungeons that give player various benefits like health regeneration or improved combat abilities!

THE STORY SO FAR...

In the verdant kingdom of Aetheria, beneath its serene landscapes and bountiful prosperity lies a hidden network of Aetherial Veins, mystic channels of magical energy that weave through the earth like the veins of a gigantic, slumbering dragon. These veins energize the Great Barrier, a mystical shield defending the realm from darkness. However, when a vile poison begins to corrupt the veins, monsters assail the kingdom, and the Great Barrier's weakening sends a shadow of fear across the land.

Step into the boots of Lanze, a fledgling Quest Master tasked with engineering intricate dungeons to protect his kingdom. In your journeys, ally with the Princess Javelyn and Shiv, the Rabbit Thief, to embark on a journey across six unique biomes to battle the corruption that threatens to infect the veins beneath their homeland.

A perilous and wondrous adventure awaits the trio - from the fiery depths of the Emberstone Quarry to the sun-bathed dunes of the Sandswept Ruins - as well as the signs of greater ambitions that taint Aetheria.

2094210.name: SCP: The Paranormal
2094210.about_the_game:
STORY BACKGROUND
Nobody knows what they are, or from where they come from. All we know is that they pose a threat to humanity, this new world.. It's not suitable for humans anymore. All around earth these paranormal creatures just.. appeared. Well, what if I told you there are people who can save humanity. An agency committed to save this world and free it from the paranormal. Meet the S.C.P Foundation. They are here to free us and investigate the paranormal activity. But little do they know, soon, everything will collapse.

YOUR JOB

You get put into the shoes of Agent Spring, a rookie SCP agent who is at his first day on the job. Your job is to investigate paranormal activity. As you progress through the game, your vision of the world is slowly changing, the paranormal slowly corrupt your mind.

MISSIONS

The story is split up into missions. Once the player starts a new game they will be spawned into a large open-world map. There are NPCs scattered around the map, once the player approaches an NPC they will enter a conversation. NPCs will describe a paranormal activity report based on a specific SCP entity. Your mission is to investigate the paranormal artifacts that NPC's describe. The player will have have an option to either begin the NPC's mission or continue exploring the map. Every mission will have it own map and paranormal artifact you have to investigate in order to complete the mission. Missions will have it's own mechanics, characters, enemies and locations. Every mission will also have a piece of the story. Once all of the missions are complete and you combine all of the story pieces you will get a truly fascinating and horrific story. Specific missions differ from gameplay, some missions are about parkour and puzzles. While some are about gunfights, fighting, running and hiding.

SCPs
SCP objects are anomalous entities, objects and phenomena that The S.C.P Foundation currently has under containment. In the game the player will find a lot of SCP objects they can encounter and interact with.
Current SCP objects featured in the game are:

SCP-008 (by EstrellaYoshte - )

SCP-527 (by Djkaktus - )

SCP-999 (by ProfSnider - )

SCP-1004 (by AdminBright - )

SCP-1437 (by Tanhony - )

SCP-4231 (by thefriendlyvandal - )

SCP-127 (by JackalRelated - )

SCP-2955 (by MrWrong - )

SCP-2317 (by DrClef - )

More to be added soon...

GAMEPLAY AND MECHANICS

The majority of the gameplay consists of: running from enemies, hiding from enemies, solving genius and frustrating puzzles, talking to NPCs, shooting enemies, doing detective work, parkour and fighting. Although most of the gameplay is a walking simulator, these gameplay features are still present in some missions.
The mechanics are very similar to your basic FPS. Basic FPS movement such as: crouching, walking, running, jumping, etc. It also has horror game mechanics such as: hiding, survival, etc.

FEATURES
The game contains features such as: Interactive NPCs, a semi-linear story with levels and voice acting, boss fights, an open-world hub map, various SCP entities, enemy AI, multiple endings and more...

2094220.name: Bless Global
2094220.about_the_game:
HIGH QUALITY, ENHANCED IMMERSION
An aesthetically immersive magic world is presented through the grand stories and console-level graphics in BLESS GLOBAL. The exquisite medieval architecture, subtle facial animations, and stylistic outfits with intricate designs all contribute to a visually convincing world. With the help of the dynamic lighting and real-time weather system, every tree and blade of grass in this fantastic world is filled with vitality.

TEAM UP, BE STRATEGIC, AND ENJOY THE ADVENTURE
To deal with various combat situations, characters of each class have an infinite number of skill and inscription pairing options. They may also change their combat stance to a different class position in the meantime. The Crusaders, for example, are designed to charge forward in battles, yet when changing for a different stance, they may also heal allies at the back of a team, opening up a greater variety of strategies and providing each player with a distinctive combat experience.
When it comes to dungeon challenges, both Team Dungeons (5 players) and Group Dungeons (10 players) in this game require coordinated efforts among players. Since each class has its unique position, players are encouraged to cooperate. Each stage of the progression is made interesting by the game's intelligent Bosses, trigger-style level mechanics, and interactive cutscenes.

DESIGN YOUR OWN CHARACTER
The game offers a highly free character customization system, allowing you to create a unique character from dozens of tweakable facial characteristics. You won't find another character identical to yours in this game! On top of that, you can make your characters even more unique by giving them different outfits and mounts.

YOUR BEST BUDDIES: PETS & MOUNTS
The game offers a wide variety of pets and mounts with distinctive looks. Be it adorable, majestic, or cyberpunk, you will surely find a style that suits your taste. Meanwhile, pets and mounts are more than just ornaments. They can significantly boost your character’s stats after proper cultivation. Being the embodiment of strength and beauty, they are the most trustworthy companions on your adventure!

FOLLOW THE GUILD AND BE SOCIAL
In BLESS GLOBAL, players from all around the world are connected through the Guild & Social system, which promises interesting Guild Missions and exclusive Guild Skills to help members of a guild grow stronger. You can also farm awesome rewards through Guild Dungeons or join your teammates to fight in Guild Royale!

A RESTRICTIONS-FREE OPEN ECONOMY
The game is built upon an open economy without the traditional rules regulating player transactions. All types of tokens circulating in this game are not bound to the characters, so players can trade among them to get the items/tokens they need. In this game, anyone has the potential to become a business tycoon! The Free Duel option may also be manually toggled on and off, allowing players to engage in dueling whenever and wherever they like! It's time to explore this massive open world for hidden treasures and have a blast playing this mobile MMO!

2094350.name: Soulforged
2094350.about_the_game:
Soulforged is a passion project of one developer aiming to create a game where players become a part of a living and breathing fantasy world. What makes Soulforged different is how your character is part of its persistent world at all times. As you go about your day, your character earns action points that you can then spend when it's convenient for you on a variety of tasks like travelling, gathering, crafting or fighting. The game focuses on the important moments and does away with needing the players to spend hours upon hours every day to progress your character, like almost all other MMORPG games do.

Game pacing

This is a slow-paced game and playtime is limited by Action Points that regenerate very slowly in real time. Travelling, crafting, gathering and recovering from wounds all require Action Points. There is also no way, in-game or outside the game to get yourself more Action Points or have them regenerate faster. There are however in-game means to help yourself by making actions faster, meaning they take fewer Action Points to complete, enabling you to achieve more with the same amount of Action Points.

Pricing

The entire game is completely free to play. On top of that I am committed to having no other monetization tied to the game. There will be no upfront cost, no micro-transactions, no macro-transactions, no in-game purchases, no purchasable cosmetic items, no loot boxes, no expansions nor "DLC". You simply get access to the entire game for free and whatever you attain in the game - that'll be all through in-game means.

Feature list

While the game is currently under development there's already a large number of features included in the game. The list below is not meant to be exhaustive, but more to outline the current state of the game.
  • A starting location which includes some guidance
  • Multiple large and distinct areas
  • Resources, items and monster names all dynamically named by the players
  • Hunting, fishing, mining and other gathering professions
  • Robust research & discovery system
  • Crafting & equipment management
  • Building construction, including player housing and housing decorations
  • Player-made towns, roads, bridges and other infrastructure
  • Meaningful character skills and statistics
  • Complex and involved wound and healing system
  • Farming - grow and harvest plants on your own farm
  • Hostile creatures and combat system

F.A.Q

Q. How do I get more Action Points?
A. You need to wait. You don't need to keep the game running - you can close it and just check later to use the Action Points you get.

Q. So there's only so much I can do in the game every day?
A. Yes, there's a limit, but you have a lot of control over how much you can achieve in a day. Most important is your character's mood - the better the mood the fewer Action Points each action will take. Avoiding injuries and pain, making sure you are well fed, hydrated and clean - all this will help your character keep your mood up and do more with their Action Points.

Q. I am joining late and everyone has better gear and tools than I do. How can I get those?
A. The game is designed so that all content, crafts and monster remain relevant throughout the game. Even starting resources are worth collecting and many players will be interested in exchanging them for some more advanced equipment and support.

Q. My character is weak compared to other players. How can I level my skills to compete with older players?
A. Characters in Soulforged age and die. Dying means all the skills and attributes are lost and that player will then need to create a new character. No single character can provide a high quality crafts forever.

Q. So if my character dies I have to start all over again?
A. When your character dies the skills and attributes they had are all lost. But there are things that carry over! Your Essence (in-game currency), discovered recipes and powers carry over. You also retain ownership of your buildings and will have access to all items that are stored there.

Q. What is Essence and how do I get it?
A. Essence is an in-game currency used primarily to empower and develop your character. There are two main ways to gaining essence. You can trade with other characters and get essence from them. But the main way to gain essence is by creating items and infrastructure that are used by you and other players and you will generate essence on a daily basis. The amount depends on how many items, how valuable and how many players were benefiting from what you contributed.

Q. Can other players attack me? Can they rob me or my house?
A. No. There is no interactions in the game that enables other players to harm your character or to claim any items in your possession without your explicit consent.

Q. How do I know what to use for crafting? Is there a wiki I can use?
A. The discovery process in the game is costly and that's very purposeful. There is no official wiki, the intent is to use the in-game research system. However, the community did discover multitude of recipes and they often share many of their findings. Check out our Discord server for a link to the document that players put together.

Q. Action Points limit me too much. Can I just play using multiple accounts?
A. Each player is only permitted to use a single account to play the game. Playing using multiple accounts is a violation of Terms of Service and risks getting your account banned.

2094380.name: Chai
2094380.about_the_game:
In Chai, you will step into the shoes of a tea merchant, combining tea flavors to make a perfect blend. Specializing in either rooibos, green, oolong, black or white tea, you will buy and collect ingredients to fulfill your customers’ orders.

Each turn you can choose to either visit the tea market, the pantry or to reserve a customer and use an ability.

Visiting the tea market
There are 6 different tea flavor tiles. Mint, Jasmine, Lemon, Ginger, Berries and Lavender.
When you choose this action you will gain a gold coin with the value of three.
Spent at least one coin on the market to purchase tea flavor tiles. But you can only have 12 of them stored in your tea house!
If the flavor tile is touching tiles of the same type these tiles are also taken (only vertically or horizontally).
Think strategically! After each purchase the remaining flavor tiles will slide to the left.
After the turn the market will get refilled.

Visiting the pantry
The pantry offers you Milk, Honey, Vanilla, Chai Spices and Sugar to refine your tea orders.
If you choose this action you can pick up to three items that are currently available, or/and blindly draw a random tile from the pantry bag.
If your tea house has more than six pantry items you will have to discard them down to this number.
After the turn the pantry will be replenished.

Reserving a customer and using an ability card
Do you have a customer order from the visible customer pool in mind that you would like to take on and don’t lack many ingredients to fulfill it? Maybe choosing to reserve this customer would be a good choice! You can also reserve a customer blindly from the deck. Either way, up to three customer orders can be reserved for your tea house.
After reserving a customer you may choose to use one of the ability actions. For example, to take one pantry item from the pantry for free.

At the end of one of these actions you may fulfill one customer order from the customer pool or from the orders you reserved. Check what ingredients they want and use your tea house stock to fulfill it! If your tea house specialization doesn’t match the customer orders color (e.g Rooibos = Red but you are specialized in Oolong = Blue) you maybe need to buy a tea token from one of your opponents with this color to fulfill it.

The game ends when 5 rounds have been completed.
Add your money and points from completed customer orders to determine the best tea merchant!

2094480.name: Senet
2094480.about_the_game:
Step back into ancient Egypt and experience Senet, the legendary game once played by pharaohs, brought to life in 3D.

  • Senet combines strategy and chance in a timeless race across the board. Outsmart your opponent, survive the whims of fate, and reach the afterlife.
  • Challenge yourself, a friend, or an AI opponent to a game of turn-based strategy and luck as you navigate the game's unique 30-square layout.
  • Your goal is to ascend all of your pawns off the board before your opponent to reach Sekhet-Aaru, the kingdom of Osiris, known as the Field of Reeds.
  • Our boards authentically replicate those found in ancient tombs and exhibited in museums around the world, and feature four throwsticks or two knucklebones as dice, along with the cone-shaped and spool-shaped pieces.
  • This version of Senet uses the well-known Kendall's rules, allowing players to make strategic move combinations. The rules are simple and easy to learn.
  • Ideal for fans of historical board games, ancient Egypt, or anyone seeking a quick yet engaging challenge.

  • Modern Enhancements: Designed for players of all skill levels, from beginners to seasoned pros. Senet is truly family-friendly, playable with children as young as seven, yet challenging enough to keep adults interested too.
  • Small Campaign: Twelve games against an AI opponent to unlock all the boards and achievements at your pace.
  • Custom Mode: Allows custom games, local multiplayer, shorter games using 5 pieces instead of 7, and mixing all unlocked game pieces.
  • 3 Difficulty Modes: Easy provides a more forgiving AI. Normal provides the most balanced and enjoyable experience, allowing players to face reasonable challenges without becoming too frustrated or bored. Hard hides the UI, creating a more immersive and authentic experience that forces players to rely on instincts and memory.
  • Controls: You can play using a mouse, gamepad, or even the Steam Deck touchscreen.
  • Two View Modes: Play with a classic static top-view or a dynamic view that follows your ankh-shaped cursor.

  • Senet was created as a way to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the discovery of Tutankhamun's Tomb on November 4, 1922.
  • His tomb contained no fewer than four Senet boards. The boy king's treasures spurred renewed interest in Ancient Egypt, and after a century, it is still one of the most famous discoveries in modern archaeology.

Every creature has individual skills that can be upgraded for gold dropped by enemies. Once unlocked you can switch between the creatures on the fly, each featuring a devastating Power Dash!

A MYSTERY STORY! Saga of Sins is a thrilling saga with surprising twists, inner conflicts and multiple endings. Enter the mind of all the villagers - whether sinner or innocent - and be amazed by the scenarios and secrets that await you. Will you be strong enough to discover the truth?
ENHANCE YOUR SKILLS! Upgrade your demonic creatures by spending gold dropped by enemies. Climb the Skill Tree faster by looting all hidden treasure chests and by defeating foes with your Power Dash so they drop double the amount of gold!

2094580.name: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe
2094580.about_the_game:
We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe is an interactive fiction adventure game about refugees, set in contemporary Europe and North Africa. Illustrated with dreamlike comic-book graphics. Inspired by true events - the creators actually visited a refugee camp, interviewed dozens of refugees and made their stories the foundation of the game.

Key Features

  • 5 to 10 hours of gameplay in a single playthrough
  • About 30 hours of content in total
  • Thousands of dialogue choices!
  • Great replayability - multiple paths allowing for up to 3 unique playthroughs
  • Hundreds of tags describing your character & items
  • Over 100 Achievements - special Notes to collect and then use in your reportage
  • About 20 NPCs to meet & learn their stories
  • 5 countries to visit & a sea to cross
  • 90 minutes of original soundtrack
  • Almost 100 hand-drawn illustrations

Story
It’s the beginning of the year 2020. You are a frustrated thirty-something wannabe writer from Warsaw who decides to make something out of himself. You will amaze the literary world with your earth-shattering book about refugees. It will inspire crowds and galvanize hearts, and expand minds, and change the world in all the right ways.

Before you prepare your Pulitzer Prize acceptance speech, there is only the trivial matter of actually travelling to Africa to gather some notes for the story. You have an ingenious plan to smuggle yourself onto one of the illegal boats that travel to Europe from the shores of Africa while pretending to be a refugee yourself. Surely nothing can go wrong and you are NOT completely out of your depth. Surely.



Developers support the refugee cause

5% of We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe profits will be donated to charities helping refugees. The first 2.5% goes to the Hope Project - Greek volunteers who helped us meet refugees in person during research. The other half will go to other humanitarian organisation we will choose together with our community.

The uniqueness of We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe

A Modern, Relevant Setting
The game concerns the refugee crisis at Europe’s southern borders, a very real problem we have been facing for several years.

A Richly Woven story
The complex, multi-layered script comprises nearly 2 million characters, the equivalent of 3-4 novels. Meaningful choices and consequences split the plot into parallel paths, which enables players to meet new characters and discover new storylines during their second and third playthroughs.

A relatable perspective on a complex topic
The protagonist is a European who tries to enter the world of the refugees as an outsider. The game deliberately plays on the cliché of “a white male’s journey to an exoticized world” and subverts it.

Multi-level, original narrative
The game is metacontextual - it is not only a reportage about refugees, but also an interactive fiction game presenting the very process of creating a reportage. This way, the player discovers both the player discovers both the refugees’ journey and a writer’s challenges of exploring the subject.

Authenticity and Factuality
Based on true events, the writing process was preceded by a series of interviews with refugees who were familiar with the concept for the game. To make this possible, the writers team visited the Moria refugee camp on the Greek island of Lesvos, where the prototype of the game was presented to refugees and volunteers. The script was also reviewed by experts from relevant NGOs.

2094600.name: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts

Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts Set in September 1993, the first episode begins with four friends heading into uncharted territory, searching for a mysterious artifact. It doesn’t take long to realize something is wrong, as this is the site of the Root Experiment, famed for its stories of those who enter and never return. There is no other option but to survive, and not be afraid of the impossible…

Survival is all that matters




Explore a hostile environment, build a shelter, and survive in a place unknown to man. Make your life here easier by improving your living conditions, upgrading your shelters, and protecting yourself and your friends against the dangers that lie ahead. Don’t forget your sanity and your health, however, as it is all that keeps you alive...

Discover-Loot-Craft


You are in a world full of secrets. Everything around you contains traces of the past. You can wander through these areas and learn recipes that will allow you to craft new items. Discover unique places in Root Mountains which is all of these places has so many unique Items!

Seamless Weather Conditions that alter the way you play



Our game’s unique weather variations give players the chance to create their own dynamic stories of survival. Gain an advantage in challenging conditions, choose when to head out and how the weather might affect your journey. The Day and Night cycle plays an integral part in the game too, with the environments, enemies, and strange anomalies all affected by this system.

Solo and Coop



In Nowhere, you can explore and survive as a lone wolf, or team up and experience the whole adventure in co-op, with up to 3 of your friends!

2094610.name: Magocracy: Experimentation
2094610.about_the_game:
Enter a world where mages fly and fight in the sky, unleashing powerful spells and devastating the landscape. Customize your mage with dozens of attributes to suit your playstyle and strategy. Whether you prefer speed, size, or sheer firepower, you can fine-tune every aspect of your character and become the ultimate mage. Every change you make affects the power level of your mages, forcing you to spend your points wisely.

Arcade/Tower Mode:

Start from the bottom and rise to the top of the tower, facing a new challenge at every stage. Each opponent is randomly generated and requires a different approach to defeat. You can also adjust the difficulty, speed, and power levels of both you and your enemies to create your own arcade experience. From a low power level and speed where mages travel as fast as a car and can only shoot through a single wall, to high power levels and speed where mages travel at the speed of sound and each shot can level a city block, the arcade mode has it all.

Tutorial/Campaign:

Learn the ropes of flying and shooting in this mode, where every attribute and power is explained and tested. With over 10 hours of gameplay and more than 400 levels, your experimentation to see how your choices affect the outcome of each battle. You can also customize some aspects of this mode, such as the AI type, number, and health.

Skirmish Mode:

Create your own custom battles in this mode, where you have total control over both sides of the conflict. Choose the map, weather, units, and powers in the Skirmish Editor. Experiment with 9 Unit Variables and 3 Shot Modes, each with 33 variables to fine-tune your mages’ abilities. Skirmish Mode is a sandbox for your creativity and strategy as the power level has no restraint here. Recreate your favorite aerial superpowered battles from anime or movies here.

Curated Battles:

Want to jump straight into fight without having to think about your mage’s loadout or points value, you can with over 200 hand crafted curated battles. These battles will take you through the most obvious shot combinations of special abilities. So, while you will start with a basic homing, explosive, or cube shot in the beginning, by the end of the curated battles you will be using a normal shot that is explosive that has a cube form with a scale of 64 and a homing acceleration of 4 with a projectile lifetime of 4. You can also take parts of these battles and use them in the skirmish mode or use the skirmish mode to change aspects of the battle you don’t like.

All Skill levels welcome:

  • Too Hard? You can increase your power level relative to the AI 10 times, 100 times, even 1,000 times or more. If flying and shooting at the same time is too difficult you can turn on player auto aim and focus solely on dodging enemy shots. You can even un-possess your character to hop into another one or just watch the battle unfold as simple RTS.
  • Too Easy? Increase the speed from 30m/s to 60m/s, or even up to 300m/s. Decrease your power level relative to the AI so that it’s 10% or 1% or less. Increase the AI Difficulty from 0.1 to 1, which will make it 10 times harder to hit or change the AI Type to GroupUpRatio which is 20 times harder to hit with non-laser/non-homing shots.

2094620.name: Noblesse Oblige
2094620.about_the_game:
Spark romance amid secrets in a crumbling mansion! What will you sacrifice for love? Can you trust your own heart?

Noblesse Oblige: a Crème de la Crème Adventure is a 137,000-word interactive Gothic romance novella by Harris Powell-Smith, a standalone story in the Crème de la Crème universe. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

On a windswept island, far from the mild shores of Westerlin, stands the estate that is your new home. You have been hired to work as a conversation partner for a lonely aristocrat. It is a profitable opportunity, and your impoverished upbringing and middling university education leave you few others.

But secrets lurk in every darkened corridor, and nothing is what it seems. Why does your young charge go wandering in the middle of the night, haunted and mourning? What is in the letters that the charming new secretary constantly writes? Why is your employer so intent on keeping outsiders from prying into the family’s business?

Attend grand balls, ride through fast-paced fox hunts, spend jovial evenings with the servants, teach diligent lessons to your charge, and observe - or take part in - this northern land’s religious rituals. Meanwhile, there are webs of deceit for you to unravel, and deep mysteries to explore. When you reach the end, will you bring justice to those who deserve it, or keep their secrets buried forever?

And, of course, there is love: midnight trysts, stolen moments, and sweet warmth amid the cold. Your job on this remote island has just begun: will you work hard for a secure future or abandon everything to follow your heart?

  • Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, or bisexual; monogamous or polyamorous; asexual and/or aromantic.
  • Romance the forthright, flirtatious housekeeper who works hard and plays hard; your intense, zealous conversation partner desperate for tales of the outside world; or a charming, cultured stranger offering excitement and luxury but risking danger.
  • Connect with those outside the estate to make a future elsewhere.
  • Secure a shining reputation in your household, or shroud yourself in suspicion.
  • Build steadfast bonds of loyalty - or shatter them.

Can you trust your own heart?

2094740.name: Dead Heat
2094740.about_the_game:
New York, 2082


A haunted Gothic metropolis perched on the razor-thin line between life and death, and fractured into tiny shards of neighbourhoods, dead zones and ivory towers. An ancient city with a living, breathing mind of its own, that slowly climbed its way out of the pits of death and morph itself into a grand Art Gothic metropolis, cocooned behind a chitinous wall of ruined buildings and trash-filled rivers.

Its cold streets are sparsely populated with shell-shocked survivors of a nightmare war, slowly eking out a new life while their greatest fear lives among them. Zombies; moving on crippled cybernetic limbs and suffering the pain of guilt for their past, the living dead slowly piecing together the remnants of their lost lives.

Some have managed to move on and prosper in this great city. Others have not.

Murder, slander, prejudice and plight plague the city. The lives of citizens are destroyed seemingly at random. And now by cruel fate, two women are next in the firing line.




Immerse yourself in the detailed gothic metropolis of 2082 New York as your investigations take you from the ruins of Harlem to the gothic spires of Midtown, to the mean streets of Hell's Kitchen and the lights and lust of Little Tokyo.



Using a purpose-built conversation system, your words are your best weapon! Direct the flow of conversation towards character-specific angles of manipulation to make you feel like a Femme Fatal detective. An RNG-assisted case-building system that will let you construct the case against your suspects yourself. Ensuring no two playthroughs will be the same, Dead Heat aims to be a fun & faithful love letter to both the Noir genre and classics of the late PS1 era.

Features:

  • It's your investigation: Experience a non-linear narrative directed by your actions and performance.
  • Comamand the Conversation: A unique dialogue system that allows you to naturally direct the flow of conversation.

  • Leathal Force Authorized: Fight off the Killers, Gangs and creatures of the undead city with an arsenal of weapons. Collect upgrades and ammo types for your weapons but be warned. Your detective may not be suited for a pitched fight!



Follow Detectives Sonja Vargas & Lilith Troy as they delve into a post-apocalyptic world of paranoia and murder! Using their talents for deception and manipulation to scrape out the truth from New York's colourful denizens, Sonja & Lilith must race against time to stop the Machiavellian schemes of shadow dwelling death cults before they enact their twisted justice on what's left of humanity!

2094930.name: Farm Wars
2094930.about_the_game:
HOW TO PLAY

Farm Wars is a real-time PVP strategy game where farming meets fierce competition. During the day, you purchase seeds, plant crops, and prepare your defenses. At night, you transform into animals to sabotage your rivals' fields, while they attempt to disrupt yours.

EARLY GAME

At the start of the game, each player sets a price for their fields. These prices are compared, and half of the difference between the highest and lowest prices is added to the starting gold of the player with the lower-priced field. This ensures a strategic balance from the very beginning.

DURING THE GAME

During the day, players can purchase seeds and defensive items from the shop, plant their crops, and prepare for the night ahead. Strategic planning during the day is crucial for withstanding attacks and executing undermine missions at night.

ANIMAL SELECTION

At the beginning of each night, players choose an animal to attack their rival's fields. If a player fails to make a selection within the allotted time, an animal will be randomly assigned. Selecting the same animal for two consecutive nights locks it for the next night, encouraging diverse strategies and adaptability.

NIGHT

During the night phase, players raid their rivals’ fields as their chosen animals. They can attack unprotected areas to destroy crops, but stepping on a hidden mine will kill their animal, preventing further attacks that night.

END GAME

The game ends when a player’s gold reaches the field price set by their rival at the start. If neither player reaches the target by the 10th day, victory goes to the player whose gold is closest to their rival’s field price.

2095300.name: Breakout 13
2095300.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a game-loving teen, sent to a harsh correctional institute by Principal Yang for your supposed internet addiction. Inspired by a real-life figure, Dr. Yang, a controversial psychiatrist who advocated for electrotherapy to "cure" troubled teens. You will navigate a branching narrative and make choices that impact your fate.

Unravel the truth behind the institute, disguise yourself, protect your friends, and terminate this notorious real-life event. But watch out, as the villain of the story still holds power in the real world. Will you triumph against the odds?

The complete game is comprised of two parts: 'Part I: Gratitude' and 'Part II: Fight'.

Gameplay

This game offers you thousands of storylines and multiple endings, allowing you to do what is right and just within the game. In this game, you will experience unique gameplay elements rarely seen in FMV games, such as QTE (Quick Time Events), scene exploration, clue gathering, deduction, puzzle-solving, and real-time surveillance monitoring. You will be granted more freedom to imbue your story with personal significance.

Story

Immerse yourself in a thrilling adventure where you excel as a skilled gamer in the virtual realm. Yet, in reality, you're a teenager grappling with internet addiction. This lands you in the infamous behavior correction center headed by the enigmatic Principal Yang. Brace yourself for a rollercoaster of experiences as you undergo the notorious "Gratitude" therapy, a harrowing journey of transformation involving verbal abuse, corporal punishment, psychological pressure from mutual accusations, and electroshock treatments.

Escape , if you have the agility;
Investigate , if you can find the concealed truth;
Scheme , if you can win your companions' trust;
Uphold justice , if you are certain about your choices.

Seize control of your destiny, as well as that of your companions and the entire correction center, as the power to shape the future rests firmly in your grasp.

Feature

  • Engaging, branching storylines - Delve into a rich narrative with hundreds of captivating branching paths, eight unforgettable major endings, and countless hidden plot twists, creating a unique hero's journey tailored to your choices.
  • Cinematic audiovisual mastery - Immerse yourself in the authentic emotional turmoil of the characters, unraveling the enigmatic "transformation" plan and exposing the shocking truth concealed within the correction center.
  • Diverse interactive gameplay - Dive into a plethora of interactive gameplay experiences, including gripping story choices, heart-pounding QTEs, true-to-life interactions, intriguing clue collection, intelligent deduction, real-time eavesdropping, multi-angle surveillance, mysterious escape room puzzles, and electrifying electroshock challenges.
  • Unpredictable allies and adversaries - orge complex relationships with companions whose loyalties remain uncertain, navigating the ever-shifting dynamics between characters to unlock exhilarating team showdowns.

About us

We are ALT Lab, a dedicated team focused on creating interactive narrative games. We firmly believe in the unyielding power of stories to touch and change lives, and we aspire to carve out our generation's unique story through a diverse array of captivating media formats.

A little more to say

If there's a story that embodies the frustration that has been locked in the hearts of our generation of gamers, it's the one we're about to tell. Reality is often more fantastical than fiction. In the early stages, we conducted extensive research and interviews with various parties, including internet addiction schools and academies, and the staggering absurdity of reality left us in awe. We found that much of it stems from the malice of unscrupulous institutions, misunderstandings from parents and society, and our own inability to express ourselves when we were young. We hope that our game can foster greater mutual understanding.

After more than two years of development and overcoming numerous challenges, we completed filming in various locations during the pandemic and went through multiple rounds of game polishing. We are acutely aware of the sensitive nature of this subject matter and have been relentless in our pursuit of staying true to our original intent. We are honored to bring this game to life. May all parents and children be understood, and treated with kindness and gentleness.

Follow us

More about the game? Please follow us here:
■ Twitter

The music is composed of Japanese and Chinese instruments with modern melodies and rhythms.
You will surely feel the unique world view.

Story

　Utsushiyochigai
　It is a world that exists parallel to the present world in which we live,
　a world inhabited by gods and Yokai.
　It is a parallel world that was once connected to this world, another Japan.

　This story is a new generation Urashima Taro*,
　in which two girls confront yokai in order to solve
　the cursed beach incident in Utsushiyochigai!

　*Urashima Taro is a Japanese folktale.

Prologue

　I. About the Utsushiyochigai
　Utsushiyochigai
　It is a world that exists parallel to the present world in which we live, a world inhabited by gods and Yokai.
　It is a parallel world that was once connected to this world, another Japan.

　The inhabitants of the two worlds have long held traditional festivals and events,
　and humans, gods, and Yokai have shared civilizations. However, with the passage of time,
　interaction with the Utsushiyochigai decreased and their culture became obsolete.
　Eventually, humans forgot their boundaries with the Utsushiyochigai and lost their relationship with the gods and Yokai.
　In this way, the gods and Yokai became a part of this world.
　Thus, gods and Yokai disappeared from our world and were treated as phantom beings.
　They are now treated as phantom beings.

　Ⅱ. About "KIK”
　Setsuna is an office worker.
　Through a certain event, she meets the Yokai Tsukumo and is able to travel between the two worlds.
　Tsukumo is a clock Yokai and can use the power of "Kokuikkoku(KIK)" to manipulate time.
　Setsuna, too, has learned to use her Yokai powers through her encounter with Tsukumo,
　and has gained the ability to fight Yokai.
　Tsukumo is bored.
　Tsukumo offers Setsuna an interesting proposition.
　The two of them then go to Utsushiyochigai to exterminate Yokai, which is their daily routine.

　Ⅲ. The Beginning
　There is an abandoned house on a secluded beach in Utsushiyochigai.
　Once upon a time, there were many houses near this beach, and the area flourished as a fisherman's village.
　One day, however, a young man who went fishing suddenly disappeared.
　People gradually moved away from the beach,
　thinking it was the work of a terrifying Yokai, but the young man's family did not leave the beach and continued to wait for his return.
　In the end, however, the young man never returned home.
　One day, several hundred years later, an eerie voice could be heard coming from an abandoned house in the middle of the night.
　It turned out to be the family of the young man who had become a Yokai out of hatred for the sea that had kidnapped their son.
　Day by day, the voices grew louder and louder.
　The voices grew louder and louder day by day, and more and more Yokai began to appear on the beach. Soon,
　the sea became rough on many days due to the influence of the Yokai, and no one went out to fish.
　People were afraid and prayed to the gods for the Yokai to subside.

　Ⅳ. Beginning of Journey
　Having overheard the whole story about the incident on the beach,
　Tsukumo was gathering information in Utsushiyochigai.
　Tsukumo's preliminary investigation had led him to the existence of an abandoned house
　that had fallen into disrepair, but he did not know why it had fallen into disrepair.
　Back in our world, Tsukumo happily told Setsuna about the incident at the beach.

　"Setsuna, I know you've been wanting to go fishing lately."
　Setsuna knew what Tsukumo was going to say.
　
　Setsuna says,"What do you mean? I'm not interested in fishing."
　"There are beaches where you can catch a lot of fish!"
　"Tsukumo doesn't want to go fishing, does he? Besides, I've never been fishing."
　"Hmmm...then...maybe if you solve the case on the beach, the snapper and flatheads will dance for you!"
　"That would be Urashima Taro*. I'd rather eat fish than watch them dance."
　"It would be more interesting if the fish danced."
　"Calm down. Fish can't dance."
　"Are you going? You're not going?"
　"Yes, yes. I'm going."
　They thought that there was a powerful youkai in the abandoned house,
　so they set out on another journey to Utsushiyochigai today.

2095620.name: Exodus of Souls
2095620.about_the_game:
Exodus of Souls is an action-adventure RPG, based on Nordic/Baltic epics. It is being developed by a souls-like lover team with dedication and love!

STORY
After the Great Hilleviones War, Kalev, The King of Kalevia, stopped the war and ruled the 7 Kingdoms of Hilleviones with the sword Magnus Gladius, forged with 7-kingdoms’ soil. He knew that any peace cannot last forever, he sent his newborn son Sohni, to Valjaran.



Sohni grew up as a blacksmith and he has never been told that he was the heir to the throne of Kalevia until the time came.
After 48 years of silence, the fight between Ungannians and Tariens sparked the fire and spread the disorder to the other kingdoms.

Sohni, as an heir to the throne, needs to get the Magnus Gladius and rule the 7 Kingdoms of Hilleviones again.

GAMEPLAY

  • Upgrade your character
  • Rebuilt your kingdom
  • Intense swordplay
  • Clash with epic enemies in epic atmospheres
  • Gather souls and unleash your wrath on your enemies

2095650.name: Sakamoto Dangerous Barrage
2095650.about_the_game:
Story

.Ryoma Sakamoto, the leader of the Satsuma Clan and the Choshu Clan, has set up an alliance between the two clans in order to bring them together and defeat the Shogunate.
However, in the middle of the Satcho alliance, a wormhole suddenly appears and those present are transported to “Fluffy Land!
Find the scattered greats in Fluffy Land and bring the Satcho alliance to a successful conclusion!

Game Features

A look-down type bullet-hell shooter!
Ryoma Sakamoto has the power of time stop & instant movement (not in the textbooks).
You can't avoid the bullets! When you think you can't avoid the bullets, stop time and move to a safe place!

While time is stopped, Ryoma Sakamoto's gun powers up when the cursor touches a bullet!
Absorb the energy of the bullets and launch a powerful attack!

Familiar greats appearing in the game

.Ryoma Sakamoto:
A samurai of the Tosa Clan at the end of the Tokugawa Shogunate in Japan who possessed the ability to stop time and travel at a moment's notice.
During the Satcho alliance, he is transported to “Fluffy Land”, but he still hasn't given up on the Satcho alliance.
He does not speak at all.
.

Saigo Takamori:
Leader of the Satsuma clan who can stop time.
He believes that the Choshu clan is responsible for the wormhole that appeared during the Satcho alliance.
.

Eiichi Shibusawa:
The man who recently became the 10,000 yen bill in Japan.
He was on the side of the Shogunate, but was caught in a wormhole while investigating the Satcho alliance.
.

Matthew Perry:
An American who came to Japan on a black ship.
Unrelated to the Satcho Alliance.
He is pressing “Fluffy Land” to open its doors to the Japanese.
.

Dear video contributors and distributors

.Please read the [烈帝国]Game Live Action Guidelines carefully.

2095740.name: Survivor Of The Journey
2095740.about_the_game:
Survivor of the Journey is a survival game with rogue-like elements that start with surviving and eventually defeat monsters.

A journeyman who has not survived must gain wealth and be strong, and must defeat the boss who guards each stage.

You need to organize the stage and secure more weapons and characters

* Features

- a light twenty-minute game



- Boss battle



- Variety of weapon
- Variety of skill



- Character of special ability



- Upgrade character





Make your own build And survive

And Enter the last stage.

2095770.name: Pipes Puzzles
2095770.about_the_game:
Pipes Puzzles is a casual puzzle game. You must move the pipes in such a way that water can pass through them from beginning to end.
The game has 3 difficulty levels, each of which generates a random set of pipes that you have to deal with.
The absence of a timer will give you enough time to solve the puzzle and will not annoy you.
Also for a better experience, a soothing soundtrack.

2095800.name: Nude Crisis
2095800.about_the_game:
Nude Crisis is a Stealth Puzzle game.

Hina is an office worker who finds her clothes missing after showering at work.
To get home safely, she must circumnavigate bitchy co-workers, salarymen, and the police without being seen, lest they snap photos of her in the buff.
She must escape her office building, streak through the park, and sneak back to her apartment if she is to keep her reputation intact.

Features

  • Cute Chibi-styled graphics
  • Minimalist art style
  • A short and sweet game filled with puzzles
  • 8 nude photos of our blushing heroine
  • 1 lewd image of the culprit's punishment
  • A gallery of everything unlocked upon completion.


Expected completion time: 40 Minutes.
testers first clear times: 51 minutes, 56:54.

2095830.name: Crisis of DreamCell
2095830.about_the_game:
Crisis of DreamCell is a survival horror game that challenges you to solve puzzles, manage supplies, and escape a nightmarish world.

After an outbreak of experimental creatures, the bio-organic research facility of DreamCell is now on lockdown with the deadly experiments attempting to escape. Take on the role of the head scientist as he tries to escape in this cinematic third-person survival horror game. Equipped with a prototype suit and a newly developed gun that can take on these foes. Solve puzzles, keep an eye on your supplies, and watch for dangers around every corner to try and make it out alive.

Survival Horror Gameplay


Face horrific experiments with a prototype weapon where you can change ammo types depending on your situation. Manage limited ammo and healing supplies around you as you try to survive DreamCell's most dangerous experiments.

Challenging Puzzles


Find clues within notes and discover items left behind in the world to solve puzzles ranging from simple to complex, that will aid you in moving forward and discovering more about the dark secrets DreamCell aims to keep hidden.

Immersive Environments


Explore the many floors of DreamCell as you discover the remnants of the test subjects and scientists. Find notes and clues left behind from dark offices to the horrid test chambers discovering the story behind the incident. Traverse around the world fighting for your freedom from this nightmare.

2095840.name: Death by Begonia
2095840.about_the_game:
Death by Begonia is a surreal LGBTQ+ Southern gothic murder mystery Developed by a wife/wife team, Begonia follows Riley's attempts to reconnect with old childhood friends in a town haunted by annual serial murders. Will you fall in love and unlock the mysteries hidden in your friends' hearts? Or will you die trying?

After a ten-year absence, Riley Airhart returns to their hometown of Begonia, Arkansas and meets up with old friends, only to find that a serial killer has been plaguing the town ever since Riley disappeared. Rekindle old flames, explore Begonia, and solve the mystery at the heart of the town's serial murders.

Part 1 contains both Regression (Aidan's Route) and Repression (Lucia's Route). Part 2 coming soon.

Regression, or Aidan's Route, is the first part of Riley's narrative. It introduces Aidan Frost, son of the late mayor, as you fall in love with him, discover his dark secrets, and find the person who murdered his father.

Repression, or Lucia's route, is the second part of Riley's narrative. It follows Riley's rocky relationship with Lucia Lyga as you attempt to reconcile your differences, dip your toes into the conspiracies surrounding the town, and uncover some of her dark secrets as well.

Developed by a wife/wife team, Death by Begonia: Part 1 is over 100k words, with 8 different endings, 20+ unique songs, 50+ unique CG's, and 30+ hand-drawn backgrounds.

2095870.name: Expense
2095870.about_the_game:
Expense is a first-person adventure/escape room game about intuition, strategy and exploration, with simple controls and hand-made animations that surround and immerse the player. Puzzle your way through carefully or try your luck with random chance, but always remember to follow your pendulum.

Controls:
Tab to think / leave console
WASD to move / navigate within console
Space to jump / press console button
Ctrl+0 to reset all progress

In Expense you can expect to:
  • Traverse a procedurally generated maze with new challenges behind every door
  • Use movement controls to bet on and compete against AI opponents in games of prediction and luck
  • Play minigames at in-game consoles to progress towards your final destination, unlocking clues and lore along the way
  • Take risks and learn through trial and error, guided only by the voice in your head when you close your eyes and think...

2095880.name: Air Splitter
2095880.about_the_game:
It's all about speed!



Air splitter is a single player racing game where you don't steer your vehicle, it's all about managing your speed!
Your vehicle will automatically try to follow the track, but the faster you go, the less that will work. Only the most intrepid drivers will win, but be careful or you'll end up spinning off the road!

Race through a Breathtaking Environment!



In a retro-futuristic universe inspired by the 50s, pilot your unparalleled vehicle on holographic tracks and admire the breathtaking views of Cloud City!




  • A student game with ambitious controls!
  • A first track and vehicle to play with
  • Qualifiers and time trial modes available to challenge yourself!
  • ...It's free! So what are you waiting for to race a few laps?

2095890.name: Black Gunner Wukong: Prologue
2095890.about_the_game:
Black Gunner Wukong is a Rougelike type shooting game.
In the game, the player takes on the role of Goku, who enters a U.S. military base to rescue his master who has been captured by Biden.



A very rare TPS+Vampire survivor!
Can use 6 big guns to crush your enemies!
Can fly using the Nimbus Cloud!
Rich build options, gun bonds combinations.
Play as different forms of Wukong, with various active and passive skills.
Bullet storms, a true bullet hell!
Collect peaches from each round of battle, purchase enhancements, and ultimately engage in a showdown with the boss.
A comically themed background storyline.
2095890.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
*languages with full audio support

2095900.name: This Girl Does Not Exist
2095900.about_the_game:
This Girl Does Not Exist is the first game of its kind. It is a game full of beautiful girls .. and none of them exist! They were not made by a human but generated by an AI. Dive into this vibrant colorful puzzle game and add girls to your gallery! Relaxing gameplay with beautiful artwork and relaxing music will help you calm down after a hard day at work or study

Everything you will see in this game, including all the art, all the characters, story and even a voice acting - was generated by an AI.

Your task is to put together puzzle pieces of beautiful girls as you progress through dating them. In each stage you choose which girls you like and would wish to progress with further. Every girl has her personality and unique information to uncover. The more stages you complete, the more girls are revealed in your gallery!

- Unique and beautiful AI generated artwork
- AI generated voice over, which you wouldn't tell it isn't real
- Relaxing and addictive gameplay.
- Easy and fun puzzles that won't take much time.
- Lots of cute characters to unlock!
- The whole game is a showcase of current AI possibilities!

There is no time limit or a way to lose. The game was designed to be relaxing and beautiful, and you will enjoy every minute of playing it.

2095910.name: Kyivan Rus
2095910.about_the_game:
Kyivan Rus is a turn-based strategy game set in the ancient times of Kyivan Rus. As one of the pretenders for the throne of Kyiv, you can be smart and cunning, brave and honorable, or whatever tactics you want to pick to bring your country to grow and prosper.

During the historically-inspired campaign, you will be able to pick one of the Great Princes of Kyiv, with his unique traits and skills. Develop your character, make decisions and deal with consequences.
Pick Askold to found the Principality of Kyiv, Helgi to conquer Kyiv with Varangians, Olga to build the economy and strengthen the country, Svyatoslav the Brave to conquer and expand, Volodymyr the Great to baptize the country, or Yaroslav the Wise to bring the Kyivan Rus to its golden age.

Evolve as a leader, gather armies, research technologies, found cities, build the economy, unite the tribes and expand your lands to strengthen your country! Play in a single-player campaign or skirmish against AI.

2095930.name: Horny Witch: Hunt
2095930.about_the_game:
Once in a generation a mage is born who is so powerful they can't be beaten by ordinary force, they are called nymphomages, and they get their force by engaging in sexual acts. You are the only last living nymphomage, and the whole world is against you, luckily they don't know who you are (yet).

Play as Adria, a powerful nymphomage who is struggling to find her purpose in this world and who has a dark past. Your lust is increasing day by day and you are trying to do whatever you can to get satisfied.

Features:

- Engaging storyline with meaningful choices
- Explicit sex scenes with multiple people
- Intriguing story about power, evil forces and sex
- Beautiful realistic graphics with dreamy backgrounds
- Engaging sound effects and medieval music which will pull you right into the action!
- About 60 minutes of gameplay for the main storyline, much more if you want to explore every branch
- 10 Steam Achievements

Gameplay:

You will be presented with a story of Adria and you will be able to make choices, which will affect the interactions and sex scenes you see.

2095960.name: Isostasy
2095960.about_the_game:
Beihnn wants nothing more than to live a quiet, uneventful life in a cabin in the forest. Alas, adventure calls! Take control of Beihnn and attempt to discover the origin of the force that poisons the land in this NES 2D side-scrolling MetroidVania platformer. Explore eight different zones and traverse various types of terrain in search of the power-ups that will allow you to proceed on your quest. Solve puzzles and discover secrets. Fight nine unique bosses. Talk to other characters for hints.

Isostasy began its life as an indie NES game. This is the PC version. It is essentially identical to the NES version, but also includes the ability to save game data to a file in your documents folder automatically upon viewing your password (to continue a saved game, select Password on the title screen, and if you have a valid save file the password will auto-populate, then press Start or Enter), and configure settings such as controller input (press Select or the D key while the game is paused to view Settings). If you would like to access the NES rom file, it is included in the files for the game. After installing it, navigate to the directory in which it is installed. Find IsostasyVer2.2.nes and copy it to your desired directory for play on an emulator or flash cart (do not move it, be sure to leave the original file in place).

Isostasy is designed to be played with a monitor refresh rate of at least 60 Hz. Playing with a refresh rate below 60 Hz may result in a sub-optimal experience. If audio or video issues are encountered, please check your monitor's refresh rate and increase it if necessary. Also note that in a multiple monitor setup, the refresh rate of all monitors may be limited by that of the slowest monitor, depending on your hardware. Try turning off or disconnecting the slower monitor and see if that resolves any issues.

2096020.name: Viral Reload EX
2096020.about_the_game:
In the year 2063 the evil Kyle Kaboom has begun kidnapping the former members of his band Chainsaw Cannonball and infecting them with deadly viruses! Strapped into the Viral Unit, Bimmy and Octo must fight these infections all while trying to track down Kyle and stop him before he destroys the moon!

- Gameplay -

Blast away at deadly viruses and mechanical hybrids as you fight for the future of mankind! Dash through bullets, lasers, and even enemies to stay alive and rack up points.

- Features -

Play through the Story Mode, defending earth from Kyle Kaboom at your leisure, or rack up a high score in the no frills Arcade mode. If you're up for some competition, see if you can be the top player in the world on the Online Leaderboard!

Grab a friend and fight for the high score with Alternating V.S. Multiplayer, or carry each other through the story!

Customize your visual experience with a selection of borders, the gorgeous Lottes CRT filter, and full Tate support for your vertical monitor.

Own an Arcade Cabinet in your home running a PC? Viral Reload can be taken off of Free Play and assigned a credit button for a more authentic arcade experience. (You could even get quarters out of your friends!)

2096030.name: Snow Plowing Simulator
2096030.about_the_game:
You start your adventure in the middle of a town with one simple shovel, manually clearing the snow from sidewalks and garage driveways. Once you've made some extra money, it's time to buy more and more serious machines and vehicles.

The more efficient equipment you have, the more sophisticated tasks will be available for you to do in more and more interesting places. Explore the town and its surroundings while admiring the breathtaking scenery.

Remember, however, that the weather in the mountains can surprise you and from sunny in the valley it can turn into a real mountain snowstorm in a few minutes, which will keep you overnight in hostile mountains.

Always check the weather forecast, choose the right clothes and take energy drinks with you.

Just in case.

Always work hard. Not only can a satisfied customer pay you extra money, but he will also recommend you to his friends. And nothing develops a business as good as good contacts.

Features:

  • several dozen different levels to be passed, including properties, parking lots, alleys, roads,

  • an open world with a small mountain town and varied mountain terrain with many narrow and steep mountain roads,

  • a dozen or so different tools for manual snow removal, with different work efficiency and operating systems,

  • various vehicles for more demanding tasks (tractors, pickup trucks, trucks)

  • a system of interchangeable plows for vehicles that completely change the operating characteristics,

  • advanced weather system, day and night system,

  • 3 game modes: linear leveling, open world and RPG for the more inquisitive players!

Each town has its secrets. But only the most observant and inquisitive players will learn the mysterious history of our neighborhood ...

Raptor

“"...this is so satisfying guys..."”
Vebv Gaming

2096040.name: VIRUSUM
2096040.about_the_game:
As a friendly bacteria, you must fight a new dangerous virus in the body. Destroy all the infection save the body from complete infection.

• 10 random generated levels
• Unique hardcore gameplay
• Funky physics without brakes
• Handcrafted levels
• Psychedelic artstyle
• Original old-school soundtrack

There are two ways to die in this game, touch the deadly foci of inflammation or getting infected by a virus. If you die on a level you will restart that specific level. There are no checkpoints within a level and all levels generating randomly every time, which provides a challenge and more satisfaction when you win!

It's quite topical game in our current real world. So consider wearing a mask to play. And please, wash your hands after playing.

2096050.name: Warrior Maiden
2096050.about_the_game:
Warrior Maiden is a colorful and enjoyable side-scrolling platform game.

The heroine can wield a sword, cling to walls in certain places, press buttons, move barrels, throw them on the heads of enemies, which leads to their instant neutralization. Also in the game there are puzzle elements, from the banal task to find a key, and to more difficult moments!

- Nice bright graphics
- Gamepad support
- 15 levels
- Puzzles
- 2 locations
- 3 types of enemies

2096070.name: Neverwards
2096070.about_the_game:
Prepare to embark on a dark and thrilling journey into Neverwards—a sprawling action RPG where danger lurks in every shadow, and the world shifts with each step you take.

Explore the ever-changing lands of Nevafall, from the scorching sands of burning deserts to the frozen wastelands of the icy west, and dense, ancient jungles brimming with untold secrets. No two journeys are alike, thanks to a procedural world generation system that ensures endless discovery and adventure.

Forge your destiny as a Paladin, Arcanist, Hunter, or Brawler, each boasting unique abilities and combat styles. Master powerful spells to adapt your strategy to any challenge. Dive into the depths of infinite loot possibilities, where every chest, drop, and encounter holds the promise of game-changing gear.

Face relentless hordes of grotesque enemies, uncover long-lost relics, and unravel the dark mysteries of a cursed world where every choice shapes your fate. Neverwards is more than a game—it’s a test of courage, strategy, and resilience. Will you save Nevafell or let it be consumed by the very forces that created it?

In Neverwards, the adventure never truly ends—it only evolves.

Some Notable Features:

  • Procedural world/dungeons generation

  • Infinite loot with +7 item rarities

  • 4 playable classes (with more to come)

  • Unique spell-crafting system (coming soon)

  • Dark, immersive world setting

  • Responsive combat (not click spams)

  • Many Different Monsters

  • Unique Bosses

  • 4 Distinct Biomes

  • Rich lore collection to discover and read

  • +30 different types of Monsters

  • Full 3D World, and much more!

Will you become a champion in Nevafell? Try out the fun before the gates to hell open in the free demo version avaliable above!

Don't forget to Wishlist! Every wishlist helps us reach wider audiences and develop Neverwards into an even more better game.

2096080.name: Agent in Depth
2096080.about_the_game:
Agent in Depth is a daring action-platformer featuring fast-paced action and instant-death combat. You’ll run, jump, aim, and deflect bullets with your katana to blow up your enemies. No checkpoints, no upgrades: just pure skills. Deflect, die, learn, repeat. Be better, be faster.

In Agent in Depth, you’ll play as agent Randy: the security specialist of this underground facility. Just like any cool agent, you wear a fancy black trench coat and pair of red sneakers. You also ditched firearms and suited yourself with a shiny katana.

Unconventional Combat:

Your katana can’t damage the corporation's belongings directly. Overcome your enemies by deflecting their bullets towards them. Watch your enemies explode as you deflect their bullets in the air. Be stylish, fast, and cool!

Hand-Crafted Levels:

Each level is uniquely designed for you to experience a different sequence of gameplay through its 15 levels. Can you finish the game in split seconds and see your name displayed to everyone inside the game?

Daring Gameplay:

You get hit, you die. Your enemies get hit, and they die. You also can’t save the game, you have to finish in one sitting. No power-ups and upgrades. It’s the ultimate skill test for your reflexes. Do you have what it takes to finish it?
2096080.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish
2096080.reviews:
“Agent In Depth feels hard, it feels cruel, and it certainly feels punishing at first, but it doesn't feel unfair. Your man is nimble and responsive, and the timings on parries feel fairly generous.”
RockPaperShotgun

2096120.name: ALIEN INVASION
2096120.about_the_game:
Join the battle to save earth from aliens and robots. Choose to play on the side of humans or aliens in battle.

1. Choose a side whether humans or robots/aliens
2. Choose a main weapon, secondary and lethal options to optimize your chances of success
3. Play alongside up to 100 online players
4. Choose various levels
5. Play in various modes such as capture the king, rush, team deathmatch, conquest.

2096130.name: Adventure's Calling
2096130.about_the_game:
Travel the world, study, and test your geography skills by flying around in your house held afloat by balloons!

Test your skills by exploring the world with two different modes: normal and aviation. In normal mode, you fly with a top down view, and can see almost half the earth at any given time. In aviation mode, you can test your skills as if your were a pilot, seeing only a narrow view of the earth and seeing countries from far more obscure angles.

Study by flying around the world with country labels, and even find the shortest path to the country.

Check your progress by monitoring the Atlas to see which country locations you are particularly strong strong at, and which need some work.

Play with your friends and compete to get the highest score on the leaderboard!

I hope you enjoy my passion project, which involved figuring out the best ways to 3D model the planet to make a beautiful experience! I know some of the datasets containing country data might be slightly outdated, so please leave feedback and I will do my best to adjust the numbers. Thank you!

Credits:
Major credit to Lee (@kirbeedia) for the box art and Victoria Tan for the store asset art! You all are amazing, thank you for helping me out! :)

2096150.name: BANG
2096150.about_the_game:
This is a realistic real life simulator where you can go to office talk to an npc.
Interested in playing a real life simulator. This game is for you


1. Walk around a office setting
2. Ask different questions and chat
3. Meet NPC
4. Experience a 3d Realistic game in first person

In this game you are with your AI girlfriend in an office. You can see the ai dance, workout, and you can do adult only activities such as sex in various position like doggy style and others.

Our team has several small time developers, many who have disabilities and who are giving it their best. We are unable to always product AAA standard games. But any support will be used to make the game better and improve it over time. We have put many hours into this game and it was hard work to develop this. We absolutely will be improving it more and more.

2096170.name: Furry Superstar 🌟
2096170.about_the_game:
Furry superstar is a short visual novel (yep, again) about a guy who meets a formaly famous model Linda, whose career is at the bottom. However, thanks to his skills and knowledge, they might have a chance to bring her back to glory, but first they have to resolve the biggest problem Linda has - her very own personality.

Furry Superstar is a story about love and self-improvement, about dealing with midlife crisis and its consequences, about the problems of being a celebrity. Help Linda, try to know her better and become the person who'll make her happy.

2096180.name: A Hero's Quest pt1
2096180.about_the_game:
A Hero's Quest pt 1
RPG with turn-based game-play

In a fantasy world once known for peace was shattered by a catastrophic war. An age of enlightenment and progress was halted.

After the war had ended, humanity and all other creatures began to rebuild.

You and your friends have been sent to a small village to help the locals with their problems.

Little did they know what would happen.

Features
Fight monsters with your faithful sidekicks in turn-based battles.

Master new moves and dominate on the battlefield.

Fight or run away from monsters or bandits in the wild.

2096190.name: Temporian Tale
2096190.about_the_game:
Temporian Tale is a linear action-adventure game. As you progress through the story, you will have to obtain new gear around the world and in monster filled caverns to aid you on your quest.

Features

  • Four unique areas for you to conquer on your quest.
  • At least 5 unique items for you to obtain.
  • At least 15 unique enemies and 5 unique bosses.
  • Minimal instructions with a simple control scheme.
  • Various secret areas containing small goodies to aid you on your journey.

2096210.name: Gloop
2096210.about_the_game:
Gloop is a semi open-world platformer, where you play as a parasitic slime. Use your tendrils to infect a wide range of creatures each with their own mechanics, to traverse and take over the landscape.

-Explore an alien world with a living ecosystem

-Traverse a unique set of biomes, in non - linear progression using creatures you infect.

-Survive getting eaten by the locals

Gloop is Currently in an early stage of development.

2096220.name: Last Chance in Xollywood
2096220.about_the_game:
Live the life of an extraterrestrial movie director in the intergalactic future. You work for Last Chance Productions, a low-budget movie studio full of sleazy, desperate, and eccentric aliens. Will you risk your health, sanity, and ideals to get the movie done on time and under budget? It's a living! Sort of.

Last Chance in Xollywood takes place in Ingress, an alien metropolis orbiting Earth and populated by people from across the galaxy. Beneath its shiny, cosmopolitan surface lurks inequality and corruption on a galactic level. At least the rent is cheap! (It's not.)

Make movies, make money, make friends, or fail spectacularly in this highly interactive RPG/visual novel.

Last Chance in Xollywood is completely free. Although the Special Edition DLC adds another playable character and some additional scenes, the base game can be fully experienced for free without the DLC.

Features
  • 3 playable characters, each with their own story: Be a grizzled movie-making veteran, an idealistic kid fresh from art school, or a family man trying to support his twenty-three kids.
  • RPG skill system with 9 stats: Use your persuasion, creativity, technical knowledge, connections, or financial know-how to overcome challenges.
  • Relationship system with 8 characters to befriend or antagonize: You can't make everyone love you, and you probably won't even want to.
  • 6-8 hours and 100,000+ words
  • Countless choices and endings! (Seriously, there are a lot.)

2096250.name: Machine Gun Mages
2096250.about_the_game:
Machine Gun Mages is a game where you must venture into the realms of Hell and survive an endless horde of demons!

Diverse Hero Builds

Choose your hero's class, weapons and magical abilities that offer a variety of different gameplay experiences as you tinker and test which builds of your machine gun toting mages can survive the longest in Hell.

Actual Physics

Feel the power of your magic and the weight of your bullets as they hit and throw enemies across the hellscape

Meaningful Magic

2096260.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
2096260.about_the_game:
The alien hordes have arrived, and only your mini-tank and your one-of-a-kind deck stand in their way. Mini Tank Mayhem is a unique blend of deckbuilding, tower defense, and roguelike elements, where strategic maneuvers meet tower defense chaos. Shape your deck from hundreds of available cards, acquire powerful artifacts, and upgrade your mini-tank to get rid of the aliens once and for all.

With roguelike progression at its core, each battle increases your most valuable resource – knowledge. Tweak your deck on the fly, adapt to enemy patterns, and discover powerful synergies as you fight to protect the Earth.

Pick from a roster of unique commanders, each bringing a different playstyle and starting deck to the battlefield. Wanna focus on the pure strength of your tank? Or maybe you want to play tricks on your opponents and focus more on the poison build? No matter what your preferred playstyle is, in Mini Tank Mayhem you will always find your cup of tea. 

Mini Tank Mayhem offers endless possibilities to break the game or, essentially, survive one more wave. And that is where the true fun and mayhem begin. Combine hundreds of cards and artifacts to create game-breaking power to eventually obliterate your enemies. 

  • Tactical deckbuilding meets tower defense with roguelike progression

  • Unique commanders with different starting decks and abilities

  • A variety of different cards and artifacts to discover and combine to annihilate your enemies

  • Deep replay value

  • High replayability and never-ending combos to uncover
