2096400.name: TAMAKAGURA: Tales of Turmoil
2096400.about_the_game:
Slay monsters and summon spirits in this turn-based tactics RPG!

FEATURES

  • Turn-based combat.
  • Shop, upgrade, and top up your powers.
  • Master and summon youkai with unique abilities.
  • 10+ hours of story and gameplay.

SUMMARY

Yuuma Nagumo, a freelance exorcist, struggles between his own ideals and the harsh reality of life around him. When his childhood friend Yukari Kaburagi suddenly gains exorcist powers of her own, Yuuma at first tries to keep her out of the fray... but after some unexpected twists and turns, the two agree to fight youkai side-by-side in Inakibi Village. Soon another priestess—Chihaya Inudoh, from Kijimori Shrine—joins their party to complete her exorcist training, and the trio set out on their journey together! As more and more urgent quests pour in, they protect the peace of the land from evil, but a terrible threat rises to stand in their way...

GAME HIGHLIGHTS

- TACTICAL SRPG BATTLES

Defeat youkai with your own demon-vanquishing powers, or summon friendly youkai allies to your aid. Explore and master a sophisticated battle system featuring five unique attributes, character compatibilities, and more.

- NEW “EXORCISM SKILLS” SYSTEM
Release accumulated Karma to activate powerful, demon-vanquishing hidden arts—use these as your trump card when the going gets tough.

- "RAGE" SYSTEM
When your party members fall in battle around you, you'll become enraged and more powerful than ever. Unleash your hard-won wrath wisely—you might be able to save your friends yet!

- "YOUKAI SYNTHESIS"
By combining captured youkai with each other, they'll inherit unique attributes, powering up their stats and battle potential.

CHARACTERS

Chihaya Inudoh (Voice: Tsuruya Haruto)


An exorcist priestess from Kijimori Shrine who sees her training as her purpose in life.

She is a friendly and cheerful person, but is also a girl who acts on her beliefs.
Kijimori Shrine has given her a few years off.
Thus, she travels to Inakibi Village to pursue her childhood rival, Yuuma, whom she'd been training with for a certain purpose.

She meets her best friend, Yukari, during this visit. She now hangs out at Inakibi Shrine, where Yukari lives, whenever she's completed her duties.

Currently, she helps Yuuma and Yukari with their work as part of her training whenever she's free.

Yukari Kaburagi (Voice: Haru Aoi)


A cute and petite freelance exorcist priestess.

She is the only daughter of Inakibi Shrine, which originally had nothing to do with youkai.
Her way of speaking and gestures are childish, making her appear carefree and naive.
But at her core, she's quite tough.

Currently, she is working as a youkai exorcist with her childhood friend, Yuuma--a secret she keeps from her parents.
Because she wishes to protect everyone's lives, she can be a bit reckless.

She's insecure about her height and appearance.

Yuuma Nagumo


A freelance youkai exorcist.

Yuuma previously trained at Kijimori Shrine, but after a certain incident took place, he left the shrine and now earns a living as a freelance youkai exorcist.

He now works alongside his childhood friend, an exorcist priestess named Yukari, in Inakibi, the village where he spent his youth.

2096540.name: Tennis the Menace
2096540.about_the_game:
A Tennis game with Flash - tick. ✅
A Tennis game with Slomo - tick. ✅
A Tennis game with Rafa Nadal - cross. ❌
Three distinct player styles - tick tick tick ✅✅✅

Flash
So you've just chased down a drop-shot with your greatest effort and you're happy just to get the ball back into play. You find yourself off to the side of the court watching as your opponent is left with an easy shot into an open court. What to do?

Option 1 - Throw your racket at the ball. This might work 1 in a million times if you're lucky and it's against the rules: Bad option.

Option 2 - Call the ball out. Good luck convincing your opponent their shot went out when it was not even within a meter of the nearest line: Bad option.

Option 3 - Un-literally, instantaneously teleport into a position where you can hit the ball: Best option. Flash is the ability you need. It's annoying for your opponent as well. And why would you not want to annoy your opponent?

Slomo
There's no getting around it - your opponent is hitting the ball too hard. Why do they have to hit the ball sooo damn hard? Wouldn't it be nice if you could just slow down the course of time itself? Then you would have plenty of time to hit the ball. Then your opponent could hit the ball as hard as they like for all you care... Then this is the ability for you: Slomo. Who needs quick reactions when you can just sit back, relax and hit the perfect shot. Life's too short? With Slomo it's about right.

Three Distinct Player Styles
  • Baseline Blaster
  • Attack the Net
  • Pusher/Counter Puncher

Tennis the Menace
Tennis the Menace has a mouse and keyboard control system that is unique for a tennis game...

Use the mouse to aim a 'skill-shot' at an invisible vertical plane above the tennis net. You can also directly target the court to place your shots. Left-click to generate spin, hold left-click to generate power. The more top-spin you apply to the ball, the harder you can hit it. In Tennis the Menace you do not click to hit the ball, you click to control power and spin and use the mouse to direct your shot.

Use the 'QWER' and 'ASDF' keys to activate your abilities. Build your abilities for power, speed, a bit of both or something else entirely.

Positioning is usually automatic: you automatically assume the optimal position to return the ball. This allows you to concentrate more on hitting the ball.

2096630.name: Pipeline Panic
2096630.about_the_game:
In a not-so-distant yet dystopian future the world's energy crisis has only worsened and the few remaining resources still available to be harnessed are in remote and inhospitable locations. The world has switched from oil and gas to a new resource pumped up from deep under the earth's surface. Albeit this highly radioactive gas is far more powerful then other fossil fuel sources it has a nasty side effect. Toxic and deadly to humans without hazmat suit it also caused mysterious and grotesque mutations in previously harmless species. These critters grew to enormous proportions and developed a crude form of intelligence bent on destroying all of the human efforts to turn the radioactive gasses into usable fuel.

Here comes the solution: risking the lives of too many heroic young technicians already the humans started to train and arm the pipeline crews to defend & repair the instalations. With the help of a potent arsenal of destructive weapons and precision engineering resulting in deadly gun towers, the brave technician-soldiers can do their job with at least a healthy 2% chance of survival... (up from 0,000002% before).

Good old fashioned 2D arcade fun with tons of upgrades and fast paced action where taking risks is rewarded with a higher score. Defend humanity's last source of energy: wrench in one hand, laser gun in the other!

2096640.name: Super Sean 007
2096640.about_the_game:
Super Sean 007 is a platform game with a great world. The world consists of various beautiful sceneries of nature: forests, caves, mountains, and abandoned ruins telling the stories of when there used to be a civilization there.
  • Players will defeat various types of enemies.
  • Players will go through the level until all the main quest requirements in that level are finished.

2096650.name: CrashOut Xtreme
2096650.about_the_game:
Crashout Xtreme is a casual arcade game with a unique combination of Pong and Brickout gameplay. Break the blocks using the bat and ball with a new and fresh design. Various gameplay experiences await with power-ups, and so the challenging enemies.

Game Flow
● Players will start the game and play a new game
● Players must destroy all the blocks using the bat and ball
● If the player wins the level, they will continue to the next level immediately
● The level progress will reset if the players lose or exit the current level

2096660.name: Pogo Joins The Circus
2096660.about_the_game:
Pogo Joins The Circus takes the role of the eponymous Pogo Joe, a boy on a pogo stick. To complete a level, Pogo Joe must jump on every barrel. Holding the joystick button lets Pogo Joe jump over a barrel or empty space the width of a barrel. Falling off is impossible.
  • Play 65 levels with three maps of variations
  • Jump to all barrels the s and avoid the enemy to go to the next level
  • Barrels type:
    • White: The default state.
    • Red: The barrel has been jumped on.
    • Cyan: The barrel has been jumped on twice (required on some levels).
    • Purple: The barrel has been jumped on three times (required on some levels).
    • Flashing Green: A "smart bomb" barrel. Jumping on this kills every enemy on screen, and creates the barrel to red.
    • Flashing Black: A teleport. Pogo Joe falls into the hole and rises onto the linked black flashing barrel. This action repeats, going from black-tipped barrel to black-topped barrel until Pogo Joe jumps away.
  • Some enemies change red barrels back to white when jumping on them. These enemies are not fatal to Pogo Joe.

2096670.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Belgium Through The Lens
2096670.about_the_game:
Jigsaw Puzzle: Belgium Through The Lens is a relaxing yet challenging puzzle game for PC and Mac. Gizmo the globetrotter dog is visiting his friend, the well known Belgian photographer Nano. Through the beautiful pictures Nano took over the years of his home country the player will get an impression of the wonders Belgium has to offer. From people, animals and objects to art, culture, history and architecture. There are 34 categories with 10 different puzzles each with the number of pieces ranging from 4 (very simple) to 625 pieces (puzzle expert).

Enjoy a personal zen moment filled with casual gaming by solving easy, intermediate and more challenging digital jigsaw puzzles with an ever increasing number of pieces to puzzle together. Accompanied by relaxing music and at a leisurely pace you will find bliss in this adventure through one of Europe's most beautiful countries.

2096680.name: Lightspeed Dating
2096680.about_the_game:
How well do you know your friends really? How well do you know their mannerisms, their speech patterns, their secrets? If they were replaced by a shapeshifting monster, becoming indistinguishable by sound and appearance alone, would you still be able to tell them apart? And, if you were to be that shapeshifting monster, do you know them well enough... to become them?

Features

  • Endless, chaotic fun, best enjoyed with 4 - 8 of your friends
  • An AI-powered voice scrambler, that makes voices almost entirely unrecognizable
  • Take on your friends identity as a shapeshifter set loose in a dating show
  • Pay attention to word choices, opinions and speech patterns to figure out your opponents identity in tense one-on-one conversations



Lightspeed Dating is primarily intended to be played with friends or acquaintances and requires at least 4 people to be played properly. At this point there is no public matchmaking. If your friends are sick of playing weird indie games with you, you can join our super cool Discord server and find some new, better friends to play with! The invite link can be found in the box to the right.

Social Deduction - Reimagined

It's the year 20XX. In a future devoid of societal empathy the only path left to true human connection is through violence. Five of the universes hottest bachelors have been acquired from around the galaxy and as a shapeshifting alien is set loose upon them they have been given only two options: truly understand one another or die.




In this revolutionary new kind of social deduction game players voices become indistinguishable from one another thanks to a new machine learning powered voice filter. Each round players get paired up in rooms together where they have to closely inspect one anothers "realness", as one of them has taken on the role of a shapeshifting monster and disguised themselves in the skin of their friends, trying their best to emulate their speech patterns and opinions.

Easy to Learn - Hard to Master

As your voice chat partner judges you by your every word choice, claimed opinion and speech patterns, you have to both convince your opponent that you're the person you're disguised as, as well as that you're earnestly examining them on their own realness. Many strategies can lead to victory, but all require acting skills, smarts and, most of all: confidence.

  • Hours of replayable fun. No round is the same!
  • Intense, hillarious gameplay.
  • Several question packs available in Deluxe version for different kinds of friend groups

2096710.name: I Can't Hear Your Words, So I Want To Listen To Your Heart
2096710.about_the_game:

一如既往地上学

2096720.name: ARCHETYPES - The Rite Of Passage
2096720.about_the_game:
About

"The journey is awaiting you - only one step of courage away! An initiation into the spirits of warriors, chieftains, lovers, and druids - a ritual of transformation and a test of integrity, courage, wisdom, and strength. The journey is dangerous and will confront you with many challenges and choices that will test your character and give you insight into the brightest and darkest corners of your psyche. Are you ready?"


Discover the depth of your personality, the wisdom of your clan's elders, and the guidance of your intuition, while journeying along the path of initiation.
Every choice you make will impact your environment and your fate - and every choice will reflect on your archetypes map.

ARCHETYPES is an experimental visual novel, with elements from RPGs, adventures, and other influences.

Features


  • Explore a beautiful world and progress with your choices along a multilinear storyline
  • Discover the different qualities of the archetypes warrior, lover, chieftain, and druid
  • Make strategic decisions that impact yourself, your village, and the whole clan
  • Engage in many ways with the world around you - communicate, fight, flirt, trade, lead your way, and discover the light and shadow aspects of your interactions
  • Enjoy rich atmospheric cutscenes
  • Take reflection time after each chapter and see how your choices have changed your character

2096730.name: Peebi
2096730.about_the_game:
Prepare for adventure in a world of inconvenience

The annual "Resurrection Party" at Club Deviation is on tonight and Peebi has one problem: she is trapped outside her apartment! Her night will be in jeopardy unless she can find a way to get back in to get her stuff for the night.
In this point and click adventure, take Peebi through a city full of mild inconveniences, puzzles and hidden paths.
Deal with all kinds of odd characters; from demanding influencers and uppity baristas, to cults and a swarm of bees.
Finding ways around problems can be difficult, but Peebi will do what she must to get home: Combine unlikely objects for unlikely solutions...and a little petty revenge.
With locations inspired by the city of Melbourne, Australia and an originally composed alternative soundtrack; Peebi sinks slowly into the subcultures of the city.

Carry what you can!

Your carry capacity may change during your adventure.

No fast travel

With no car keys or change for the bus; Peebi
will have to travel on foot, hopefully she can find a short cut or two.

2096740.name: Paraopticon
2096740.about_the_game:
Paraopticon

is a Spot the Difference / Puzzle Game, where you are a security guard that is task to
compare camera feeds and spot and report different events to survive the night shift.

Gameplay:

The rules are simple:
You have 15-30 ingame-minutes to memorize the rooms.
At 12:00 AM Anomalies will appear; You have to report them;
Too many anomalies unreported will have you killed.
You have to make it to 6:00 AM.

Keep your eyes peeled

Be aware: hundreds of anomalies per level and thousands of possibilities.

Be scared: special events an entities to observe and save yourself from.

Be prepared: use different items to help you find the anomalies.

Features:


  • HD Graphics.
  • Many different Items.
  • Alot and i mean aaaaalot of Anomalies.

2096780.name: CRT7
2096780.about_the_game:
An impossible object lost to time. An eerie basement hiding an untold story. A seemingly innocent game begging to be played. That's what greets you when the elevator doors open and you stare into a room you've been trying to find for years. Just what happened down here? Only you can find out by exploring this abandoned room and unlocking the devices strewn around it. Point, click, flick, and rotate your way through a huge variety of different types of puzzles safe in the knowledge there is an in-built hint system if you ever get stuck. That old monitor glowing in the distance looks like a good place to start...

Welcome to CRT7, an escape room puzzle game about power, obsession, and regret from the award-winning creator of SOLAS 128.

The core loop is simple:

  • Figure out how the monitor works

  • Play games to generate power and bring the room back to life

  • Explore the room and decypher mysterious devices to progress

  • Uncover why you are here...

Features:

  • Procedurally generated music which reacts to you playing

  • A dark narrative about creation to piece together

  • At least one (1) fully rendered 3D room to explore

  • Strange retro devices to prod and poke

  • A state-of-the-art* in-game phone with hint system

  • A challenging mystery for fans of escape rooms

  • An immersive creepy atmosphere with no jump scares

*for 2010

Accessibility Features:

CRT7 has been made with consideration of accessibility from the ground up. Below are the major features, but please try the demo to make sure the game is playable for you!

  • No reliance on colour alone for any puzzle

  • No musical ability or tone recognition required for any puzzle

  • All speech is subtitled by default

  • A full hint system including text hints and hotspot identification

  • Rebind the mouse clicks to keys, or controller buttons

  • Change movement modes to help with motion sickness

  • Override monitor colours and/or add extra light to help avoid eye strain

  • Change in-game written text to printed format

  • Change the size of the cursors to make them more or less visible

  • An option to reduce flickering light effects

  • Some games have timers, but you can play games multiple times to progress

Creators:

Amicable Animal – Developer & Designer

Luci Holland – Additional music & sound
2096780.reviews:
“I really, really enjoyed playing CRT7 and cannot wait for it’s full release. It’s part escape room, part detective game, part procedural music game and part Y2K retro goodness.”
The Escape Roomer

“Behind the brilliantly done atmosphere of the game you can find lots of clever puzzles, from simple games you can play on the old computer, cryptic ciphers hidden in notebooks, escape room style physical puzzles, and many more”
Thinky Games

2096800.name: Steel Saviour Reloaded
2096800.about_the_game:
Many years after a global war humanity is close to extinction because of lack of water. You’re the young pilot who finds a flying war ship and travels into inner earth to discovers machine creatures who are responsible for humanity's suffering. Take control of the flying ship and fight the machines to save the world.
Avoid enemies and walls and use different weapons to destroy the big bosses. A combo system will lead you to beat the ranking. Interact with different environments with water and fire, adopting different strategies from time to time.

★ Artistic and original graphics
★ Exciting soundtrack
★ Huge bosses to defeat
★ A challenge to reactivity and concentration
★ 4 levels of fun and action inspired by the golden age of shooters.
★ New edition of Steel Saviour!

The return of a classic.

*To play in cooperative multiplayer a controller is required.

2096820.name: Dama Hame Tosatsu Nikki
2096820.about_the_game:
ストーリー

ヒロイン八坂響希は夫・和樹と息子・護の3人で慎ましく暮らす主婦。

響希は父子家庭で過去に父親からＤＶを受けていた。
夫の和樹は代議士の息子で、将来のレールを引かれた人生の重圧に負けていた。
二人は悪い友達と交流する内に出会い、交際するようになった。
だが、互いに愛を深める事で、真剣に将来と向き合うようになる。
父親の跡を、地盤を継いで代議士になろう！そう決意した矢先。
同じ不良グループに属していた一人が殺人を犯した。
和樹の父親は不良と交流していた事に激昂し、息子の和樹を勘当する。
その後、結婚し子宝に恵まれ、和樹は定職を求めて中小企業に就職。
慎ましくも幸せな生活を送っていた。

だが、それから９年の時を経て一人の男が現れる。
義父からの勘当のキッカケ‥‥９年前に殺人を犯した男、相良龍二。
龍二に打ち明けられたのは、殺人を犯したのは和樹で自分は身代わりに捕まったというもの。
そして身代わりになった報酬を受け取りにきたのだと。
支払える大金はなく、勘当されて頼りもない。だが公表される訳にもいかない。
龍二の言葉が嘘とも知らず、響希は体で支払わされることに。
響希は快楽の騙ハメ地獄へと堕ちていく。

ゲームのポイント

謂れなき夫の罪を背負った妻の肉体は淫らに堕ちる
  • 偽りの罪の代償を肉体で支払う羞恥の日々…
  • 犯されることで刺激される淫らな肢体
  • 盗聴、盗撮…隠しきれない牝の本性
  • 堕ち続ける若き子持ち妻の末路は…

仕様

  • クリックで読み進めるノベルゲーム
  • フルボイス（女性キャラ）
  • CGモード
  • シーン回想

2096860.name: Reclaim The Sea
2096860.about_the_game:
Reclaim the Sea is a roguelike strategy and adventure game, set in a naval pirate fantasy world. Your goal is to lead your pirate crew through dangerous seas, keep your ship in one piece and save the World. Face tough decisions, manage resources, spend gold in equipment, upgrades and new crew. You will encounter different ships from many factions each time and face tough decisions. Will you be a good pirate or reckless buccaneer? Will you defend this civilian ship attacked by thugs? Or will you take advantage of its weakened position? If you engage in a fight, you will have many options: taking down the enemy crew, burning or sinking their ship, staying at long range and playing defensively or engaging at close range… Each run is unique thanks to randomly generated ships and maps.

Command your crew

Order your crew to move in the ship to accomplish all the required tasks : charge weapon, pilot the ship, board the enemy ship, repair the ship and many more!

Set weapon targets

Choose your ship weapons and set their targets. Will you reduce enemy fire power or manoeuvrability? Will you try to kill the enemy crew, destroy their ship or overwhelm it under fire?

Improve your ship

Gain power through the game with new weapons, devices, ship upgrades, and powerful unique figureheads.

Upgrade everything and sharpen your builds among thousands of possible ships to create synergies and be able to defeat the final boss.

Choose your path wisely

Explore randomly generated maps in different regions.

Seek support or opt for the confrontation, manage risks and rewards, continue sailing or take a break to refuel. Set your destination and face the consequences!

Will you reach the final zone and beat the boss?

2096930.name: The Folk
2096930.about_the_game:
Unique Crafting Mechanics: Build, upgrade, and optimize your crafting stations to maximize efficiency. From simple woodwork to complex metal forging, everything is created by hand, one piece at a time.

High-Stakes Survival: Fail to meet your daily emerald quota, and it's game over! Each day the quota will increase, so you need to craft more complex items to keep up.

Resource Management: Raw materials drop from above, leaving you to sort through the chaos and figure out the most profitable crafting combinations. Think fast and make every resource count.

Dynamic Crafting Recipes: Discover and unlock new crafting paths as you progress—wood, stone, iron, and beyond. Invest wisely in your crafting skills to survive the ever-increasing demands.

Roguelike Progression: Each run is unique, with permanent upgrades that carry over. Spend earned diamonds on essential bonuses like starting with a furnace or access to better materials from the start.

Real-Time Manual Smelting: Control your smelter by feeding it fuel to manage the heat. Too cold, and nothing cooks—too hot, and you risk wasting precious resources. Everything is done in real-time and you can't look away for a second!

Intense Pressure: With time ticking and a looming deadline, every second counts. Boost machines manually or risk falling behind—each decision can mean survival or doom.

Hectic, Physics-Based Chaos: Toss resources, scramble to build new stations, and handle crafting in a confined space while trying to keep up with increasingly complex recipes. Every action has real-time consequences.

Steven's Demands Increase: Steven will ask for more Gems each time he visits. Stay ahead of his greed by crafting high-value items and trading up to survive.

2096960.name: Roll On Dice
2096960.about_the_game:
"Roll On Dice"!





Roll On Dice is a pretty simple puzzle game, where you just have to roll on other dice with a 6 sided dice. But it can become quite tricky if you don’t know well your faces. Indeed, in order to beat a dice, you will need to have your top face superior or equal to the one that you are rolling on, otherwise you will break your own…

  • The game has over 50 puzzle levels to beat with this main rolling mechanic
  • The rhythm is pretty relaxing, take your time to solve each level
  • Enjoy the colorful graphics

2096980.name: Sam Stoat: Safebreaker
2096980.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1985, this fiendishly difficult platformer for the ZX Spectrum from British developers Gremlin Graphics saw players take on the role of the malefactorous mustelid Sam Stoat. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version.

Gameplay

Select one of 4 houses to begin (each is of increasing difficulty). Collect a bomb and a match, and jump across a difficult set of moving platforms to reach the house. Find the safe and blow it open to claim your prize!


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2097030.name: Union of Gnomes
2097030.about_the_game:
Behold a quirky fairy tale set in the revolutionary times of a far far away kingdom.

Embark on the challenging journey to lead the gnome’s uprising, stand against Snow White’s oppressive rule, assemble your liberation forces, and bring freedom to this land.

Free your gnome comrades to bolster your squad with the best freedom fighters. Experiment with the lineup to reveal powerful synergies and combos with 130 cards that will either hit, poison, weaken, blind your enemies, or get your gnomes drunk…

Pick one of three plucky gnome heroes with unique traits, distinctive decks, and special abilities to slay the slavers. Enhance them between game runs to perfect your build.

Take down the ferocious enemies from different fairy tales, including the Red Hood, Wizard of Oz, Pinocchio, or Snow White herself. Mind your foes' positioning and get the upper hand by using devastating effects, like destroying their spirit by showing them a tiny gnome’s butt.

In Union of Gnomes, there are…

  • 3 gnome heroes, 130 cards to use in your deck, and 24 different effects to throw into your enemies or gnomes' faces.

  • 19 fairy-tallish bosses to beat, and dozens of regular enemies to slay.

  • 6 acts of pure revolutionary story with quirky quests and hidden stories.

  • Story mode, along with the infinite gameplay of Endless mode.

  • ONE HUGE MYSTERY TO UNCOVER!

2097030.reviews:
“This is honestly one of the best deck-builders I've played.”

Wanderbots

Retromation

2097090.name: Snow Problem
2097090.about_the_game:
Snow Problem is a game in which you collect snow. There are obstacles to stop this being easy of course, so you need to create extra terrain on the game screen to guide the snow to the bottom of the screen. Added some terrain in the wrong place / somewhere that was helpful but isn't any longer? No problem, you can delete it. Oh, and did I mention that there are also different obstacles that will melt your snow?

Many levels contain areas that change the colour of the snow, and you will need to collect a certain amount of each colour to complete the level. As you complete levels, more levels unlock for you to play. The full game will have 100 levels. Every level will be tested by the developer to ensure that it is definitely completable, so if you fail, you know it's your own fault! :-)

You'd think that 100 levels to tease your brain would be quite enough, but no! The game also contains a built-in level editor which will allow you to create up to 100 levels of your own. (Update - 107 levels now, since a few bonus levels have been added.)

The game features 24 pieces of (mostly well-known) classical music to help you chill out a little while you stress out over how to beat a level.

​Playing the game with a mouse is highly recommended, it's designed with precise control in mind which you may find difficult to achieve with a trackpad.
2097090.reviews:
“Snow Problem is an addictive physics puzzle game that's a bit like Lemmings except you're funneling snow down a screen instead of rodents to an exit.”
8/10 – Choicest Games

“Overall, this is a very charming and relaxing game.”
7.5/10 – NekoJonez

2097100.name: Jylko: Through The Song
2097100.about_the_game:

- Multiple Game Mode and mini-game
- 100+ Upgrades, Powers and Spells

How far will you go ?

2097130.name: Sudocity
2097130.about_the_game:
Welcome to Sudocity, where the ultimate city-building and sudoku experience awaits. Build your city, solve puzzles, and rule the urban jungle in this minimalist masterpiece.

In Sudocity, each sudoku number represents a color of building and it's up to you to decide its fate - will it be a residential paradise, a bustling commercial hub, or a factory powerhouse? As you solve puzzles, your city will grow and evolve, and you'll have to manage resources to keep it thriving. But be warned, happy citizens are key to a thriving metropolis and red-faced, "pissed off" citizens can spell disaster.



As the seasons change, a new train will arrive at the station carrying fresh citizens, it's up to you to take proper care of them and make sure they find the right place to call home. Will they work at a commercial building or a factory? This decision is on your hands.

But as your city expands, people will need to use vehicles to work in further buildings. So, manage the flow of traffic to keep it running smoothly. As your city grows and becomes more complex, it will become chaotic, with lots of people and cars trying to get to their destinations.



But don't worry, solving sudoku puzzles can improve working memory and help you manage the complexity of your city. Sudocity offers a unique and refreshing take on city-building and puzzle games. With its minimalist design, challenging gameplay, and endless possibilities, it's a game that will keep you engaged for hours. So, get ready to flex your brain power and build the ultimate city in Sudocity.

2097150.name: Crash & Bump
2097150.about_the_game:
GAME FEATURES

  • Play online with your friends.

  • Try to eliminate other players while dodging obstacles.

  • Get power-ups with each health pack.

  • Customize your character.

  • Laugh with the hilarious physics when eliminating opponents or being eliminated.

Note: Gamepad doesn't work yet. You can play with it in-game (not for menus), but it might not work as expected.

Note From The Developer

Hi everyone! I'm Darian, the creator of Crash & Bump, and I'm thrilled to introduce you to my video game. I was inspired by my love for shooter games but wanted to give it a different twist and thought that adding obstacles would be a fun way to do so, thus Crash & Bump was born.

The entire game has been made by me, and it has taken me over 3 years to develop it so far.

My goal with Crash & Bump is to offer a fun, action-packed gaming experience that puts your skills to the test.

If you decide to purchase a copy, I want to thank you in advance for your support, and I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoy creating it. Thank you for playing Crash & Bump!

2097160.name: Monster Mystery
2097160.about_the_game:
“It’s so much darker when a light goes out than it would have been if it had never shone.” - John Steinbeck

(MONSTER MYSTERY) It is a 3 - 10 player Third Person Survival Multiplayer game where the players take the role of an Explorer or the Hidden.

As the Explorer, the player tries to find out the identity of the Hidden. You do this by fixing Generators around the map that then turn on the Big Generator that reveals the identity of the Hidden.

As the Hidden, the player turns in and out of the Monster forum to try and kill the Explorers without the Explorers finding out who they are.

Vision: The night is dark and your lanterns are dim. You must refuel your lanterns at fireplaces scattered around the map, but make sure to fill them with boards because when they all go out all hope is lost.

ITEMS: There are many items scattered throughout the map that the explorers will need to fix the Generators. These items are the Axe, Toolbox, Batteries, Boards and the Blunderbuss.

The Explorers win by killing the Hidden and the Hidden wins if they kill all Explorers.

2097170.name: Iosis
2097170.about_the_game:
In Iosis, you control the Silver Guard, which protects the base from waves of corrupted metals with collisions. The main source of damage is momentum; the faster you are, the harder you hit. You can die and respawn in combat as long as your base is intact. As you progress through fast-paced runs, you will build your play style according to several aspects such as mobility, self-sacrifice, manipulation and control.

Iosis is inspired from bullet hell and tower defense genres with a special emphasis on customizable runs that allow unique builds. Dying as the Silver Guard is only a temporary setback which unlocks builds that depend on self-damage and unleashes devastating power.


  • Collision-based close combat: The core combat depends on the momentum of the player as the main damage source. Basically, the faster you move, the higher the damage you deal. Becoming a massive object is also a way to increase your damage output but be careful not to restrict your mobility too much.

  • Over 60 collectible upgrades: In Iosis, the collectible upgrades come in various categories such as active spells, passive residues, unique power-ups and Vitriol seals. Residues are of various types; parametric upgrades, periodically activated effects, triggered effects based on collisions and dash-triggered to name a bunch. Spells work like weapons that generally define the core aspect of your build. Unique power-ups are powerful additions offering drastic additions to the power curve while seals offer upgrades to the Vitriol Vessel itself.

  • Challenging enemy waves: The corruption of Aleno conquered all the lesser metals, Copper, Mercury, Iron, Lead and Tin. Increasingly powerful waves of corrupted metals seek to harm and destroy the Vessel. You need to develop defensive mechanisms to negate their combat advantages.

  • 3 linearly progressive stages: Progress through the layers of alchemical space: Gates, Fountains and Towers. You will find the influence of Aleno increasing as you get closer and closer to the final confrontation.

Iosis is inspired from occult alchemy themes where the main goal is to stop the corruption of Aleno and achieve purification through the four stages of alchemy: Nigredo, Albedo, Citrinitas, Rubedo. Protect the base which bears the Philosopher's Stone and undo the corruption that holds captive all metals.

2097180.name: OxU
2097180.about_the_game:

▪ 77 Levels

2097190.name: Astoaria
2097190.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey alone or with friends in this fractured world of floating islands. Thrive by strategically exploiting diverse ecosystems and climates, while surviving, exploring and uncovering the mysteries of this world.

Explore a vast world of floating islands, delving into caves to unearth rare minerals unique to each ecosystem. Discover ancient desert ruins, scavenge remnants of airships, and forgotten machinery and structures as you unravel the secrets of a once-thriving civilization.

Build your airship for islands traversal, defense against threats, storage space, machinery deployment and any other purpose you desire. Enjoy full customization options, but be mindful of energy consumption.

Strategically optimize farming, resource gathering, and energy production by analyzing islands and considering island-specific factors like wind and solar intensity, minerality index, terrain fertility, temperature, and humidity.

Employ suitable machinery on designated islands to maximize productivity.

Ensure you are prepared for extreme weather conditions and consider leveraging them to your advantage.

Other Key Features:

  • Plant breeding: Create new plant species by crossbreeding from diverse ecosystems!

  • Smelting mechanic: Combine various minerals through smelting to obtain new ones with distinct characteristics.

  • Crafting mechanic: Basic and advanced crafting with a crafting station.

  • Blueprint system: Explore to unlock new recipes for crafting, plant breeding, and smelting mechanics.

  • Character stats: While taking care of your mechanical parts and lubrication, ensure biological maintenance of your human arm by utilizing the multitude of organic compositions available.

  • Drone: Deploy a drone to explore hostile or unreachable areas.

  • Defend yourself: Watch out for hostile flora and fauna!

  • Minor mechanics involve mining, locating underground objects, navigation tools, and more!

2097200.name: AntiShatter
2097200.about_the_game:
Welcome Agent,
To the future of humanity, where mining asteroids for Antimatter and precious metals in order to upgrade your spaceship is your calling. Be warned that space is full of many dangers, other than the asteroids flying at breakneck speeds towards your ship. How far can your rocket reach the center of the earth without crashing?

You have been sent from your home planet, Amourium, to planet Tera (aka Earth) - the only planet not yet registered in the Amourian index, yet the Great Prophecy demands skulls of "homosapien origin" and the so-called "humans" are the key. Defy the Limits of Reality and Master Unique Mechanics

2097620.name: Dream Knight
2097620.about_the_game:
A story about this game

This is a fantasy world, thanks to rich minerals and powerful magic. This world used to be peaceful and prosperous, but somehow it was coveted by a different world that controlled the dark power. One day, the dark power that suddenly appeared destroyed the balance of the whole world. The scary thing about dark forces is that they devour life through dreams, no one can stay awake forever, and those who fall asleep will be drawn into the dream world, and those who are drawn into the dream can only survive this dangerous dream through fighting Survive, the winner will return to reality, and the loser will fall into a dream forever!

More and more people are trapped in dreams and cannot return to reality. In order to save the world, the Fantasy Knights came into being. This is a team of people who have the ability to resist the erosion of dark forces. The special ability endowed them with the ability to freely enter the dream world, so they explored the truth of the dream world again and again, looking for ways to defeat the other world.

Game features


This is an ACT+Roguelike game. The game combines the gameplay and style of classic arcade games. Players enter the dream world to fight again and again. The game will have the high replayability of Roguelike games and the refreshing combat experience of arcade games.

Every death is not meaningless. You can bring back some items from the dream to improve panel attributes or activate elf skills to make yourself stronger.

Every time you enter a level, it is a different experience, because the levels and wild monsters in the dream appear randomly, and clearing hidden levels can also bring you unexpected surprises.

four heroes


There are a total of 4 heroes to choose from in the game. Their default weapons are Miao Dao, bow and arrow, battle axe, and lightning whip. The samurai protagonist can also unlock 3 new weapons, giving you more options in battle.

Everett Isle is comprised of Five Main areas the player must progress through to find their way off the isle. You'll need to solve environmental puzzles using your wit and logic to reactivate the isle's abandoned mechanisms, and find more than the original explorers could have. It's a short and sweet adventure lasting around 1.5 hours, as well as hiding a secret ending for people explorative enough to find it.

2097730.name: Nitrous Firetruck
2097730.about_the_game:
Quick Overview

Become part of the fire department that protects and serves both Lence City and Arkdale! Your job is to operate the lone fire engine that must respond to fire calls in both cities, which are 6 miles apart. But today is your lucky day because the cities have finally agreed to put together some funds to install Nitrous Oxide on the fire engine! However, with this new addition they now strictly track your response time and you must get to (and put out) the fires within 60 seconds of being dispatched.

Key Features

  • You will be driving a firetruck equipped with Nitrous Oxide which can be activated once every 10 seconds. However, this boost can be upgraded with money earned from successfully completing calls to last up to 10 seconds.
  • There is a water cannon mounted above the mid section of the firetruck which can be controlled by parking the truck and pressing "V", then using the arrow keys to point the cannon and extinguish the fire(s). The water pressure can be increased resulting in more shooting the water further and faster, or pressure can be decreased which would result in less water being shot at a shorter distance.
  • The firetruck contains a 1000 gallon water tank. The tank can currently be upgraded to hold 500 extra gallons and it can be refilled instantly when driving past a fire hydrant.
  • This firetruck is equipped with heavy duty breaks which can be upgraded to be 10% more effective with each upgrade level, up to a maximum of 50% more effective. Trust me, you'll need these upgraded brakes when your boost makes you go from 0-90mph in seconds.
  • You can purchase power ups to help you out when responding to calls! The abilities vary from freezing the timer, adding more time, giving yourself an extra boost or skipping the call entirely!
  • Your final score is made up of how long you lasted, how many calls you completed and the difficulty of each call you had. You can also see your high score and try to beat it every time you start a shift!

Early Access Notes

I'd like to remind you that this game is being released as an early access game, meaning there are still a lot of ideas I have for it that I would like to implement in the coming weeks/months. I would also love to hear from the people playing this game, constructive criticism and suggestions are greatly appreciated and the easiest way to contact me would be through the discord linked on this page (bugs can also be reported in the discord).

Story

After the death of her only living relative – her mother, this past summer Kei was sorting through her inheritance and learned that her father, who had already passed away, owned an old Japanese mansion in a little-known place called “Hemizuka″.　
Kei decides to investigatein order to determine the prospects of this forgotten homestead.
On the way there, Kei has a strange dream in which a huge tree pierces the sky and a girl named Yumei appears
with a flock of butterflies.
What is the legend of the mountain god and human sacrifice in Hemizumika?
What is the truth of Kei‘s lost memory?
Hemizuka is Kei's birthplace. When the characters come across each other, the wheels of destiny quietly begin to turn...

Main character

Kei Hatō
The main character of the story, Kei is a rather careless person, which is quite ironic considering her favorite phrase is "always be prepared".

Yumei
The mysterious girl from Kei's dreams.

Kei

Aoishiro is a Japanese adventure game.Sets stage in both the modern real world and a mythical world. The game unfolds from the point of view of Syouko Osanai, a girl who is the head of kendo club at Seijo Gakuin.

Story
Syouko Osanai, head of the kendo club at Seijo Gakuin, came

That evening, Syouko and Yasumi Aizawa, the club manager were walking along the beach when they saw a girl lying in the sand. Syouko rescued the girl and found out her name was Nami. Main Character

Osanai Syouko
The main character of this game, a 2nd year student at Seijou Academy. Her nickname is "Osa". She's the well-liked, ace of the kendo team who takes on the role of captain after the former 3rd year captain retires. Since she is the serious and hardworking type, she often gets teased and is on the receiving end of jokes.

Aizawa Yasumi
A first year student at Seijou Academy, Yasumi is delicate girl who is the manager of the kendo team. Although she doesn't have any particular illness, she has much less stamina than normal people, so she finds it difficult to partake in any strenuous exercise. On the other hand, she's extremely determined and diligent about her job as a manager, and she does her best to contribute to the team's success. Momoko and a few others refer to her endearingly as "Zawacchi" which comes from "zawa" in her last name, Aizawa. She has a crush on Syouko which Momoko often makes fun of.

Nami

When she wakes up from after being rescued by Yasumi and Syouko, she is found being unable to speak. However, despite this, she makes up for her inability to communicate verbally with animated facial expressions, giving her a cute, childlike appearance. She becomes particularly attached to Syouko and Yasumi.

Kaya

A young girl with a light, carefree personality who stays over at Shoushinji, the location of the training camp. She arrives there earlier than Syouko and the others. At first glance, Syouko is captivated by Migiwa's beauty and fashionable clothing. However, once Migiwa shows her arrogance, Syouko quickly disbands that thought and categorizes Migiwa as one of those 'hard-to-deal-with' girls.

Kohaku

2097840.name: Co OPERATION: MultiTurn
2097840.about_the_game:
The patients arriving at Lonchester hospital have ongoing medical and life issues. You can help them by administering the right kind of medicines. They will gradually reveal and share aspects of their lives with you.

Coordinate your volunteer medical squad, schedule your turns and enjoy figuring out the optimal strategy to heal each patient. Tabletop gamers might know this as "Action Programming". Decide which hospital equipment to upgrade and where to place items for maximum efficiency.

Dual-Screen

Similar to the Jackbox series of games, only the host player needs to have the game installed. Guest players join an online session by entering a 4-digit room code on their phone, PC or any other device with a web browser. Once connected to a game session, each player controls a character and/or becomes a dialogue writer via their connected device.

You can control multiple players/characters from a single device if you want to:

  • Play in single-player mode or

  • Share your device with a co-op buddy.

Core Experience

  • Turn-based and grid-based.

  • In single player you control two characters.

  • Maximum of 8 players in multiplayer mode.

  • Every round, patients lose health - heal them by using an optimal amount of turns.

  • After earning money from healed patients, decide which hospital equipment to buy.

  • Vote on where to place purchased and upgraded hospital equipment.

  • Improve your patient satisfaction scores and rank to unlock more hospital wards.

  • Deep modding integration: play other people's mods or make your own. 

Types of Player

  • You can have up to 4 volunteer medics and 4 dialogue writers.

  • Volunteer medics play-out the core tactical gameplay.

  • Dialogue writers type the speech-text for patients and medics which is fun for players who want to join a session but are more creative than strategic.

Similar Games & What to Expect

Co OPERATION: MultiTurn is not *exactly* like any other game, so it’s quite difficult to say “it’s like game X but combined with game Y”. Having said that, if you enjoy tactical games where you have to think ahead, like Into the Breach, Wargroove, Shogun Showdown or Monster Train, you’ll probably enjoy this game. Co OPERATION: MultiTurn stands out when you play it with some co-op buddies. Coming up with clever tactics together and working out optimal strategies as a team is a really nice feeling. It’s typically pretty funny when your plans go wrong too.

Science!

We’re trying to make a multiplayer experience that helps people feel emotionally connected to each other. That’s (kind of) been scientifically proven! Groups of Masters level psychology students at Basel University evaluated an early demo and all agreed that it positively affects relationships. Here’s a quote from one assessor: “We felt that our relationship as a group was strengthened and we definitely got to know each other much better because of the game.”

Backstory

Running hospitals is expensive. A clever bean in central government decided that tearing up requirements for medical qualifications would help. Volunteers are now welcome… throughout the country?! 🤷 You decide to enroll and help your local hospital. Find out what the patients need and form a strategy to help them. The more coordinated your team is, the more people you can heal!

Play Online

To play online, screen-share your PC screen while on a video call. Guests join a session by entering the room-code on their web browser/phone. It doesn't really matter if one player has internet lag, the gameplay is designed so that lag doesn’t affect the fun.

Community & Mods

We’re actively developing Co OPERATION: Multiturn. It was in closed-testing on Itch for [far too long] before we brought the demo to Steam. We appreciate all our player feedback and let it guide our plans. Many features were born from votes on our Discord and mailing list. We also have an ongoing collaboration with Plymouth University, with students from Plymouth making mods for Co OPERATION: MultiTurn. You can find them from the in-game modding menu. Documentation on how to make mods is also in-game.

2098160.name: Star Vortex
2098160.about_the_game:
Star Vortex is a top-down ARPG space shooter that follows the formula of classic titles such as Diablo 2. Humanity is fighting wars on all fronts. Suddenly a new threat appears out of nowhere and begins attacking the human forces. Earth must be warned about this new danger and it is up to you to escort the mothership back home to deliver the unsettling news.

You play as a pilot of a fighter ship who must venture out into the space sector to find the gateway keys that will allow the mothership to reach Earth. Throughout your journey, you will gain experience allowing you to level up and upgrade your ship from a small frigate to a massive battleship while collecting equipment that synergizes with your build and playstyle. Explore randomly generated sectors fighting elite enemies and bosses then work your way up through difficulties.

Along with creating an ultimate build to match your playstyle and searching for the best equipment you can visit the shipyard on the mothership to design your perfect ship. Starting with a small frigate, as you gain experience and level up, you can increase the size of your ship, from a small fighter to a destroyer to a cruiser and finally a huge battleship.

Unlock new weapon and equipment slots allowing you to increase the total number of weapons and equipment that you can use at one time. From lasers to projectile weapons to rocket launchers and automatic turrets, the possibilities are endless as to how you fit your ship.

Every aspect of the ship is available for you to design. From its appearance to the placement of the weapons and equipment slots, you are free to design your ship how you see fit. Save your favourite creative designs and share them with friends and the community, with a ship design import and export option.

Randomly generated sectors make every game different but your navigation system will help you plot your course. How you tackle your exploration of a sector is your decision to make. Do you take charge and head directly for the boss or do you take your time and explore levelling up? Perhaps you will take a detour to scavenge for rare and legendary upgrades and equipment. The choice is yours, but danger lurks in every system.

Not all systems are the same, some contain environmental dangers such as heat which without protection will cause your ship to burn, or corrosion that will damage your ship over time. There is also the threat, where the invaders can attack without warning. All could be peaceful as you collect the spoils of battle only to suddenly, be invaded by this strange new and relentless enemy. You must always be alert and prepared, as with great rewards come great risks.

Put your equipment, upgrades, and skills to use and lay waste to your enemies throughout your journey. As you travel through each sector you will find yourself in skirmishes with small groups, rescuing and escorting stranded pilots, intercepting enemy convoys, entering warzones and coming face to face with mighty elites and gigantic bosses.

Each race and faction has its strengths and weaknesses and you must adapt and adjust your equipment to give yourself the advantage. Equip greater heat resistance and non-heat weapons against the fiery Junkers or corrosion resistance against the mysterious Outcasts. Your ability to adapt will make the difference between survival or death.

  • A versatile ship designer allows you to get creative and construct your perfect ship from a vast array of parts, choosing colors and slot placements as you wish.

  • Constant progression grants the unlocking of bigger ships and more weapon and equipment slots as you level up your pilot.

  • Three large upgrade trees where players can create the perfect build to suit their play style.

  • A deep and complex item system, with many possible builds and synergies to discover.

  • A huge array of weapons to use against your foes such as lasers, homing missiles, energy pulses, time dilation, drones, cloaking fields, grapple guns, tesla coils and much more.

  • Procedurally generated sectors to explore, which make every game vastly different from the last.

  • Various difficulty settings to suit all skill levels and a Hardcore Mode for those looking for the ultimate challenge.

Play how you want to play with a huge array of settings. Controls are fully customizable allowing keyboard only, keyboard and mouse, controller, or steam deck.

As a final note, I've tried hard to incorporate as much accessibility into my design as possible. If my efforts do not meet expectations please reach out to me on Discord so I can rectify this.

2098250.name: Shaytan
2098250.about_the_game:
🌟 Shaytan: Descend into Darkness 🌟

Embark on a chilling odyssey through the enigmatic corridors of the human mind in Shaytan, a psychological horror puzzle game that will haunt your senses. As the protagonist, you find yourself ensnared by the malevolent grasp of Shaytan, the very devil who once beguiled Adam into tasting the forbidden fruit in paradise.

🔍 Explore the Abyss Within: Dive deep into the abyss of consciousness, where reality blurs and nightmares thrive. Unravel cryptic riddles, confront your deepest fears, and grapple with sanity itself. Each puzzle you solve peels back another layer of the mind’s labyrinthine secrets.

🌆 Stunningly Dark Atmosphere: Rendered with mesmerizing graphics, Shaytan immerses you in a world of ominous shadows and unsettling whispers. The dimly lit chambers echo with forgotten memories and suppressed desires. Can you withstand the oppressive weight of your own psyche?

2098280.name: The Perfect Garden
2098280.about_the_game:
Have you ever wondered how to make your own dream garden?

Try this simulation-casual game of The Perfect Garden , which gives you the opportunity to feel on your own skin what it's like to plant strawberries or clean up after you've had guests. Your mission is to do all the garden work on time and very good!

Game Features :

- Planting different vegetables that bear fruit

2098290.name: Project R4T
2098290.about_the_game:
Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device capable of shrinking and enlarging the user. You will be tasked with completing tests, all designed around the tester's height and weight. Platform, collect keycards, and fit through small gaps in this short single-player experience.

Features:

You can make yourself larger and smaller with a simple press of a button. With this, you will be able to fit through small openings. However, your size affects your weight, so you must keep that in mind as you might encounter a pressure plate that will take your weight into account. Additionally, your weight determines your speed, letting you jump over large gaps or run through doors before they close.

As you solve puzzles, the Overseer will observe your performance and talk to you as you play. You will get to know him, and the difficulties he faces at the facility.

2098330.name: Percy Parcel
2098330.about_the_game:
There's a new position open in our company, and we're looking for a dedicated worker to take up a role in our freshly renovated warehouse. We need someone who's ready to put in the hard work for big rewards with a work hard, play hard attitude, where the job isnt just a job, it's a lifestyle. Responsibilities include:

  • Scanning incoming packages and items.
  • Placing them onto one of our patented mechanical storage shelves.
  • Sorting items from acceptable and unacceptable stock.
  • Focus on the job.

We're looking for someone who can adapt to different circumstances. Sometimes birds or other creatures may get into the warehouse, and may disturb you and your work, so you'll need a clear head (and a flashlight!) to shoo them away.

Following a successful application, you will have a first day where you learn the role, then either be assigned on day shift or night shift.

Day shift hours are 9:00 to 16:00, night shift hours are 00:00 to 07:00.

Roles are always filled up fast, so dont miss out on this amazing opportunity!


---


This game features loud sounds, depictions of blood, organs, gore, terrible voice acting, jumpy scenes and gruesome violence, as well as implied suffering (And actual suffering, depending on what you think of the game). It should take about an hour and a half to complete.

This game is PC VR only. Make sure you have at least arm-length space. Developed for Index, Rift, and Quest connected to PC, untested on other headsets. Please advise if there are any issues with your game.

Folks with AMD graphics cards have experienced some issues with adjusting video settings ingame. If you use an AMD graphics card, do not change any video settings, or your game will crash.

OVR Advanced Settings has also given some issues for users previously. It is recommended to restart VR without OVR active if something goes wrong.

2098350.name: Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories
2098350.about_the_game:
"Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories" is a series of co-operative escape-room style puzzle scenarios for 1-5 players. In each story, you will face various puzzles that you need to overcome to escape. You must use your wits to their fullest potential to succeed.

In the "Jail Breakout" scenario, you are a burglar who, after an unfortunate turn of events, finds themselves in a jail. Can you conquer the many obstacles that stand in the way of your escape?

Solve Puzzles

From security devices to deductive reasoning, wide variety of puzzles await you in each scenario. They are sure to test your wits and intellect.

Explore and Discover

There are plenty of hidden collectibles for you to find as you make your way through each scenario.

Work Together

Play solo, or work together your friends, in up to 5-player multiplayer.

2098370.name: Apollo's Adventure
2098370.about_the_game:
Apollo's Adventure is a top down educational game, where you take on the role of a wanderer who seeks the Sage of Wisdom. Along the journey you come across many characters and face math, science, geography, history and spelling questions!

The game features 20+ unique levels created by the crew at nonPareil.

nonPareil Institute's mission is to help adults on the autism spectrum grow towards their potential by providing work readiness training integrated with hands-on technical instruction and social engagement opportunities.

2098390.name: Planet Surfer
2098390.about_the_game:
Planet Surfer will have you gripping the keyboard as adrenaline is pumping through your body as you race across galactic landscapes while dodging dangerous obstacles and collecting powerful upgrades.

Planet Surfer is a non-stop anti-gravity survival racer and the ultimate forward scrolling don’t run into stuff game developed as a love letter to the temple run quintet and the early 3d sonic games. Set in the distant future, you glide through obstacle heavy terrain trying to reach the end of 40+ levels while weaving through everything from trees to spike traps floating on lava.


Put your skills to the test and run through our unique forward scrolling universe to save the world from destruction... before it's too late!


Features:

*Explore 40+ hand crafted obstacle dense courses dispersed across 4 different semi-realistic biomes including Earth, a dessert planet, a water dense beach planet, the stories central fire planet, “Voltanis”, plus one unrealistic, meme filled, unlock-able biome.

*New to racer/runner survival games? No Problem!! Planet surfer provides various tutorials and allows for the player to have plenty of room to try and try again until they graduate from cadet to captain and acquire insane reflexes.

*Navigate across the various levels going to any place you have unlocked whenever you desire with an immersive level/planet select menu.

*Participate in a very “meta” story where your character is in a VR space competing in a drone navigation program to get to be the person allowed to take a chance at controlling a real drone on a one time, make it or break it, mission to save the universe.

*Experience the inside of your ship from a first person prospective including your very own living space, hologram machine, and “swively” captains chair.

*Earn coins by hitting all the checkpoints in any given level which are sometimes place in locations requiring reflexes to reach, sometimes placed in locations that require exploration to discover, and sometimes are just a bit of puzzle.

*Spend coins in an interactive upgrade shop on your ship to unlock new abilities, enhance abilities, customize your ship, and unlock bonus levels.

Unlock abilities including (but not limited to):
*Phase Dash: You can literally phase through obstacles in a dashing motion for a limited period
*Jump booster: Once you unlock this the game takes on a 3d platformer element.
*Shrink Drive: So you can fit in the small places temporarily.
*Time slowing drive: For the moments in the game that would be near impossible without it.

Combine your various abilities in unique ways to get through levels in ways that are creative and fit your play style.

Experience alternate endings depending on whether you succeed or fail on your final mission making for a fun story experience. (Players are not intended to succeed on their first try of the final mission but if they do, we want to hear about it!)

Prepare yourself, the late game tracks are extremely difficult and will likely not be beaten by most players due to sheer difficulty. That is OK, the planet surfer program probably should not have entrusted the fate of the universe to gamers.. But, they did.

*Warning: Planet Surfer contains fast moving imagery and various effects such as white flashes that may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

2098450.name: Cardboard Hero
2098450.about_the_game: Play as the hero of a young child’s imagination and fight your way through a cardboard third-person action adventure! Engage in exhilarating combat against a variety of enemies, find potions and reclaim treasures to grow in strength and take on tougher opponents, and explore vast levels, unearthing the ancient secrets of the lands you traverse.

2098470.name: What if George Washington was a Girl?
2098470.about_the_game:
A historical visual novel about history's greatest heroes and villains and their trials and tribulations.

It is important to note that a lot of time and research was put into the writing of this game's story and themes, all historical people and events were heavily studied to make sure everything is accurate. This was taken extremely seriously and any naysay will not be tolerated.

So anyways, the story starts with the Dark Musician (Mozart) plotting to destroy Antarctica. Georgia Washington (George Washington) and Teddy Rosebelt (Theodore Roosevelt), knights of the United Nations were sent to stop the mad musical genius before the icy continent is lost forever.

BUT THEN, more stuff happens and there's intrigue and suspense and penguins? Find out more and meet other historical figures in this first chapter of an exciting new saga, Alter Historia.

Yeah that's right it's only the first chapter, hopefully this doesn't get popular because there will be more if it does.

Game Features

  • Meet several historic figures like Georgia Washington, Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte), The Night Gale (Florence Nightingale) and more.
  • Has an in-game wiki that unlocks exciting info about the actual historic figures as you progress through the game.
  • Features a custom made visual novel engine. It currently has camera effects, map scenes, particle effects and more, with lots of other features being planned.
  • Has an actual plotline. (It's sort of similar to Shonen stuff like One Piece.)
  • Bonny is the best character.

Parental Guidance Suggested, this uses some brief strong language like "Heck".

2098530.name: Intergalactic Panic!!
2098530.about_the_game:
The war is almost lost...

The intergalactic Fuhrgulf empire is about to destroy the rebels, in their last desperate move a suicide raid is sent to the planet Axel, to sabotage the heart of the Fuhrgulfarian war machine.

However, you are the only one who has made it to the planet's surface alive.

Now the fate of the universe is in your hands.

Intergalatic Panic!! is an action-platformer.

Jump, shoot, and sometimes dive through nine challenging levels, but your actions cost energy, so be careful not to run out at critical moments.

Time to suit up!

By defeating the stage bosses, you will receive unique equipment, up to six different weapons to obliterate enemy Fuhrgulfarians or other dangers that cross your path, and up to six different costumes with incredible powers to enhance your combat strategies.

Buckle up, please.

During your adventure you will also find some vehicles, powerful weapons left behind by the resistance to help you in your mission.

Shenanigans...

Speaking of mission, it is not a simple task, destroy eight fortresses used by the Fuhrgulf empire to produce their terrible war machines and each fortress is guarded by a captain of the empire and they will not be very happy with your visit.

2098540.name: 슬픈 가족사 - 산장으로부터의 탈출
2098540.about_the_game:
Sorry. This game is not available in english.

남자와 여자. 두 사람의 딸.
행복하게 살고 있던 가족이었다.
그렇지만, 갑작스러운 교통사고로 여성이 세상을 떠나면서 모든 게 달라져 버렸다.
사고 이후 남자는 행적을 감추었고 집에는 정적만이 남았다.

어느덧 혼자 사는 생활에도 익숙해진 딸에게 아빠로부터 한 통의 메시지가 도착한다.
'이번 주말 동안 함께 지낼 테니 집에서 기다려라.'
잠시 후 소녀를 데리러 온 차를 타고 아빠가 살고 있는 곳으로 간다.

도착한 곳은 어느 산속에 있는 커다란 산장.
처음 와보는 낯선 장소였다.
안으로 들어간 소녀는 가져온 짐을 내려놓고 아빠가 돌아오기를 기다린다.

소녀의 인생에서 평생 잊지 못할 1박 2일이 시작되고 있었다.

슬픈 가족사


이 게임은 카마이타치의 밤이나 428과 비슷한 노벨 타입의 게임입니다.
화면에 표시된 텍스트를 읽어가면서 중간 중간 나타나는 선택지 중 하나를 선택하는 것으로 다양한 전개와 결말을 확인할 수 있습니다.

주인공이 아빠에게 연락을 받고 아빠가 거주하는 산장으로 향하면서 게임이 시작됩니다.
산장에 도착하고나서 여러가지 일이 발생하고...
아무 것도 모른 채로 주인공은 사건에 휘말리게 됩니다.
과연 주인공은 무사히 돌아올 수 있을까요?

3개의 이야기


이 게임은 카마이타치의 밤에서 많은 영향을 받았습니다. 게임 카마이타치의 밤은, 본편의 플레이 타임 부족을 해결하기 위해, 등장 인물과 기본적인 설정만 같고, 내용은 크게 다른 외전 시나리오를 많이 포함하여 볼륨을 크게하는 방식을 선택했습니다.
이 게임도 본편의 매드 사이언티스트 편과는 별개로, 기본적인 설정만 같은 살인 사건 편과 안드로이드 편이 존재합니다.
처음에는 매드 사이언티스트 편 밖에 진입할 수 없지만, 해피 엔딩 (staff roll이 표시되는 엔딩)을 1회 보면, 초반에 살인 사건 편으로 분기할 수 있는 선택지가 추가됩니다. 마찬가지로 살인 사건 편에서 해피 엔딩 (staff roll이 표시되는 엔딩)을 보면, 안드로이드 편으로 분기하는 선택지가 추가됩니다.

각각 내용 전개는 다르지만, 어느 시나리오든 마지막까지 살아남는 것이 가장 중요한 목표입니다.

FAQ


Q : Jump와 Skip의 차이는 무엇입니까? or Jump 버튼을 눌러도 아무런 반응이 없는데요?

A : Jump는 한 번 읽었던 장면을 통째로 넘기는 기능입니다. Skip보다 압도적인 속도로 지나가는 반면, 중간에 취소할 수도 없다는 특징이 있습니다.
완전하게 진행(통상적으로 어떤 선택지부터 그 다음 선택지까지 내용을 확인한 장면)하지 않은 부분에선 Jump를 눌러도 아무런 반응을 하지 않습니다. 반복 플레이를 요구하는 게임인 만큼 재플레이 시 Jump기능을 이용해 읽은 장면, 안 읽은 장면을 분리해서 편하게 진행할 수 있습니다.

Q : O 번 엔딩을 도저히 볼 수가 없습니다. 조건이 뭐죠?

A : 처음부터 시작해서 세이브와 Jump를 이용해 하나씩 체크해보시면, 놓치고 지나쳐버린 부분을 체크하기가 쉽습니다. 도저히 모르겠으면 제작 카페에 질문을 올려주시면 답변해 드리겠습니다. 스팀 커뮤니티는 자주 체크하지 못하기에 가급적 카페를 이용해 주세요.

2098550.name: Hex And Tricks
2098550.about_the_game:

2098590.name: Secret of Rosaria
2098590.about_the_game:
Introduction
You take on the role of a young girl named Anna, who is looking for her brother, Ethan, who has mysteriously disappeared along with other people near the misty forest. After an arduous journey, a passage is discovered that leads to a cursed village, the legendary Rosaria Village. Now your mission is to discover the secrets of the place and save your brother.

Features
- Explore the Village Rosaria, unlock doors, unlock shortcuts
- Meet strange creatures that inhabit the place
- Help people who got lost in the Village
- Break curses
- Upgrade your weapon
- Learn new combat techniques
- Get new gear like: The Elemental Gauntlet, Flashlight, Gas Mask and more.

2098600.name: Kiss the Demiurge
2098600.about_the_game:
Kiss the Demiurge is a dramatic yuri visual novel about magic, delusions, and love.

"For the purification of humanity!"

Kiss the Demiurge follows the story of Minori Nakahashi, a mage who has been tasked by a secret society to hide magic from the world. She feels intense feelings for other girls but has sworn off of love to dedicate her life to her mission, viewing herself as little more than a tool of the secret society.

One day she discovers a ""magic club"" while investigating a high school, made up of three delusional girls who mistakenly believe themselves to have magic powers of their own. One is a shy fortune teller whose predictions always go wrong, another claims she can hear ghosts, and the leader boasts that she's descended from a clan of magic samurai.
Minori is enraged by the very concept of the club, and transfers schools to infiltrate and destroy it. But to her surprise, she slowly finds herself falling in love with the girls of the club and is forced to question her mission and ideals.

The visual novel has three romantic routes and roughly ten hours of reading. There is only one choice, so the reader can simply enjoy the story without having to worry about getting a bad ending.

2098670.name: Steel Guardian
2098670.about_the_game: Steel guardian is an open world sandbox with primary focus on combat mixed with some exploration. 2098690.name: CALME
2098690.about_the_game:
“Embark on an Mysterious Journey into the Uncharted Depths of the Cloud Sea:
A Tale of a Father and Son’s Unforgettable Encounter and Challenge”

Join Vin, a curious young boy from a small village, as he defies his father’s wishes and visits the town of Calme to become a cloud sea hunter. As he meets quirky residents and explores the town and the cloud sea, he faces numerous mysteries. Vin uses his wit, knowledge, and tools of cloud sea hunting taught by his father to overcome the challenges that come his way.

Discover a world full of secrets:
Why did people build towns on cliffs? What do the ruins scattered throughout the cloud sea imply? And what lies at the bottom of the cloud sea? Uncover the truth that Vin reaches with your own eyes.

Explore a world that changes with time:
In Calme, the actions of residents, the town’s activities, and the state of the cloud sea change with time. Trade with nocturnal residents in distress, explore caves that can only be entered at certain times, and conduct investigations… Unveil the ever-changing environments of towns and the cloud sea to uncover the world’s secrets.

Tools that aid exploration:
After equipping the tools of a cloud sea hunter, don’t forget to bring a gas mask. The character’s homemade “Dango” dishes can serve as both a bait in the cloud sea and as gifts for the residents. Use various tools to avoid or repel dangerous cloud sea creatures, decipher codes left in ruins, and explore the unknown cloud sea.

2098820.name: Galaxy Survivors
2098820.about_the_game:
Save humanity from alien invaders - choose between ships, weapons, talents, upgrades, modifiers and perks!

Choices with Depth

Explode the entire screen, shoot out massive volleys in all directions or just dish out massive damage. Every weapon and ship is different and fits some niche. Tailor your arsenal to maximize the fun you're having, as there isn't just one path to victory.

Fun Difficulty

The enemies you'll be facing aren't static. They'll shoot at you, charge at you and in general try to give you a bad time, but the game isn't out there to crush you... unless you want it to try. Every perk in the Command Center will be counter-acted by an enemy perk of your choice - strategize to gain the biggest advantage, or create absolute bedlam and try to survive. After that, how well will you fare in other universes, where the invaders are stronger?

Plenty Of Unlocks

Obtain achievements, upgrade your starting stats, unlock different ships, rank up in the Command Center and climb up the Multiverse ladder to become the ultimate Hero!

Features

  • 11 Unique Ships
  • 30 Perks that heavily shake up the game
  • 22 Modifiers from bosses fitting into many playstyles

Realistic visuals: Brink of War utilizes advanced graphics engine technology to present players with a realistic battlefield environment. The terrain, weather, and lighting effects in the game can all provide players with an immersive experience.

Players can choose suitable weapons and equipment according to their preferences and combat styles, modify firearms to improve various parameters, and dominate the battlefield

Game mode: The game features multiple competitive game modes, such as team death fighting, random weapons, and percentage points, and sets maps with different rhythms. Players can team up with friends to participate in competitions and showcase teamwork and tactical strategies.

Faster paced battles: The game emphasizes a fast-paced and realistic combat experience, where players need to make quick decisions on the battlefield, flexibly use various skills and tactics, and defeat enemies.

https://bfw.framer.ai/

Ranking and Achievement System: The game has a leaderboard where players can compete with other players for honors. Providing players with rich achievements and stimulating their competitive desire.

Regular updates and activities: The development team (i.e. me) will regularly update the game content, introduce new maps, weapons, and modes to keep players fresh at all times. At the same time, various activities will be held within the game to bring more benefits and challenges to players.

2098840.name: Sears: The Sky Frontier
2098840.about_the_game:
Sears: The Sky Frontier is a beautiful and epic real-time strategy game in which you have to lead an army of cute stone men and resist fearsome invaders, carefully thinking through the course of the battle and leading the defense in unique and atmospheric locations.


The invaders attacked the peaceful sky city and want to occupy all its parts. Break their plans and protect your lands wisely using the available resources. Build fortifications, arrange squads of warriors with their unique abilities and upgrade them.


Before the start of the collision, scatter traps, explosive barrels and electrical installations throughout the level, distribute the available troops and think over the course of the battle, adjust to the changing environment and do everything to withstand the defense!

World



All locations in Sears are divided into specific areas with their own visual style and unique atmosphere. You will have to defend or storm enemy positions in various conditions, using all the tactical advantages of specific islands.


By pushing the enemy back, you will eventually get the opportunity to organize and conduct assaults on enemy positions on their islands, and if you're lucky, get weapons from the invaders, as well as call for fire support! Surviving the attack on the most important islands, you will get access to new warriors, buildings and upgrades that will help you in further battles!
