2098930.name: Lucky Pikinini - IMS Death Squad
2098930.about_the_game:
Name: IMS Death Squad, Engine: Unreal Engine 4, Development Time: 1 Year ( 2022 ), Scale: Medium Scale.

STORY:

IMS Death Squad is A Third-Person Story-Telling Game with a 4-Chapter Story Campaign. Its Story Takes place at the same time (2040) and same place (Gemstone Island - Advanced City) as the Events of the Original Super Incursion. This Time You take control of IMS SERGEANT David Grimmes who is leader of IMS Death Squad team and brother of Marcelene Grimmes of the Original Super Incursion, 3 special forces teams are sent out to Advanced City to carry out Operation: Winter Strike by Incursion Military Service (IMS) and Gemstone Communist People's Ministry of Defense They are Specialized Force, Death Squad & Intelligence Corp. At The Start Of Operation: Winter Strike SERGEANT Grimmes Is alerted by one of his teammates that the whole Death Squad team is in danger, their superior officer COLONEL Sebastian Garrett has defected to the Con-Federation of Global Terrorism (CGT) and as part of his entry into the enemy side, He has been instructed by CGT High Ranking Senior Officer MAJOR Nickolai Patrikov, To give out Important sensitive IMS information, murder His entire team (Death Squad) and members of other teams to help sabotage Operation: Winter Strike as his requirements to be fully admitted into the Con-Federation of Global Terrorism, If he succeeds he will become CGT MAJOR 2nd Class, Be granted Lightning powers by CGT SUPREME GENERAL John Voorhies and be trained in sword fighting and martial arts. Now COLONEL Sebastian Garrett is working together with the CGT to sabotage Operation: Winter Strike and kill its participants.

GAMEPLAY:

IMS Death Squad is a shoot'em up action game, where the player has 2 rifles, a pistol and grenades, has to fight off enemies, solve puzzles and loot the world to survive. You start off with the G36C, UMP and USP45 as your primary weapons. The Player has to take cover, sprint away or temporary hide from enemies to regenerate health during gunfights. The environment is overgrown and is explorable with pickups to find, there are text logs explaining background story, medikits, ammo, pipebombs, molotovs, money and more to be found. Exploration is part of the gameplay loop and you have to explore to find resources to help you survive.

VEHICLE GAMEPLAY:

In IMS Death Squad SGT David Grimes will drive IMS Military Equipment from one point to another, This Military Equipment includes Quad Bikes.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES:

After Completing the game you can replay it in NEW GAME + Mode, You can use PERMA-DEATH MODE to increase the challenge and beating the game with this mode enabled, unlocks a golden star in the main menu. Tutorials, Aim Assist, Invert Mouse can be enabled and disabled in game settings.

IMS Death Squad has a beautiful but very dangerous world, where you have to save yourself and your teammates with your superior officer trying to kill you and prevent you from carrying out your Operation.

2099030.name: No men in this house
2099030.about_the_game:
When a widow dies a painful death, she becomes an evil spirit. The ghost wanders around the village, breaks into locked houses, and kills the men who live inside. Does that sound like a creepy fairy tale?

It's a folk belief that runs throughout Southeast Asia. Every year in Thailand, dozens of men die in their beds at night under unusual circumstances: they fall asleep, never to wake up again. Many Thai people think these strange deaths are caused by Phi Maemai, the "widow ghost," who can ravage entire villages.

The "No men in this house" visual novel is based on the Phi Maemai legend. It tells the story of several eccentric tourists trapped on an island in Thailand because of a pandemic. When one of the villagers mysteriously dies, the characters begin an investigation and conclude that the death may have been caused by... a ghost?

Has the legend come to life, or are the creatures of flesh and blood at fault? Could it have been a tragic accident? "No men in this house" is an absurdist detective thriller full of bizarre situations, erratic characters, biting humor, and twists you won't see coming!

2099050.name: Home Deco Puzzles
2099050.about_the_game:
🏡 Home Deco Puzzles

Home Deco Puzzles combines the calming charm of miniature interior design with a clever memory-based puzzle experience. Unpack, decorate, and relax — one room at a time.

🧠 MEMORIZE

Take a good look! Each room is fully furnished for a brief moment. Try to memorize the position of every item based on its surroundings and the subtle differences between similar objects.

📦 UNPACK

Suddenly, everything is packed into boxes. Your task now is to unpack and return each item to its original location — but be careful, not everything is where you think it was!

🪑 DECORATE

Recreate the room by placing items back into their correct positions. Can you restore the room perfectly from memory, or will you rely on logic and visual cues?

✨ Features

  • 🏠 60 handcrafted levels across a wide range of cozy environments

  • 🧩 Four unique room types: Small Rooms, Double Rooms, Penthouse Apartments, and Studio Lofts

  • 🌈 Various themes including Living Rooms, Coffee Shops, Modern Lofts, and more

  • 📋 Daily quests to keep the challenge fresh and rewarding

  • 🎵 Peaceful and relaxing soundtrack for a mindful experience

  • 🧘‍♂️ A meditative blend of memory, logic, and decoration mechanics

  • 👪 Easy to pick up, fun for all ages

Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or simply looking for a relaxing way to spend your time, Home Deco Puzzles offers a soothing and satisfying experience. Perfect for short sessions or long playthroughs.

2099060.name: Rikki Kuu
2099060.about_the_game:
Build yacht-sized space combat drones in a fully-integrated drone builder. With the help of a modular design system, just about any spaceship-looking shape can be built, relying on real physics principles to determine flight characteristics.

Experience smooth zero-g flight mechanics that capture the disorienting thrills of space dogfighting while keeping the controls intuitive, simple and accessible as pure keyboard + mouse. The environment is dusty and atmospheric, which has a profound impact on the space physics involved - drones never come to a stop and are limited in speed only by how hard they can accelerate for their size.

Drone building is engineered with simplicity in mind without compromising player creativity. A Drone design consists of modules and hulls. Modules offer a variety of behavior, such as thrusters and autocannons, that give a drone its basic abilities. The shape of a drone arises from the way its modules are arranged and how they're connected together with hulls.

2099090.name: Alaris
2099090.about_the_game:
A global crisis that only continues to escalate. A dangerous run-in with a shadowy stranger. And a mysterious word that won't stop gnawing at you. How does everything tie together? And what role could you possibly play in all of this? 

Enter a world of magic—of Fae and Dragon.

The Enchanting Prodigy | He/They

"Hmmm... Now there's an interesting question. Maybe if you beg?"

An accomplished Drake with a colorful reputation. Many know his name, but few know his heart. Do you have what it takes to break past their flirty exterior?

The Selfless Martyr | He/Him

"Very funny.... But you shouldn't start something you can't finish."

Strong, protective, and reliable. If you asked the town to describe Druk, these are the three words you'd get.  But everyone, no matter how strong, has a weakness. What's his?

The Shunned Scholar | He/Him

"That's not—It's not for you, it's my job."

The classic librarian: grumpy. And you know what else is classic. Underneath all that grumpiness lies someone a little... less grumpy.

The Burdened Seraph | They/Them

"My arm is here for you should you need it."

The head Wyvern, and a fellow healer just like you. When you meet, there's an instant connection. And yet, for someone who's supposed to be your "partner," Etza seems awfully intent on doing everything themself...

The Shadowed Soldier | He/They

"I do dream of this... Don't you?"

This man seems intent on having you to himself. They lurk in the shadows, haunting the corners of your mind. What could be the reason behind their obsession?

The Haunted Protector | Any/All

"..."

Shrouded in mystery, they seem to want nothing to do with you. And yet, no matter how hard either of you might try to prevent it, you keep running into each other. Why?

  • A Customizable Protagonist: Choose your name, pronouns, and personality

  • Personality: Shape your personality with four different traits (Bravery, Kindness, Wisdom, Charisma) and watch how the world interacts with it.

  • Free Time: Choose from four locations and go on a date of your choosing with any of our love interests.

  • Energy Vision: Tap into one of the MC's special abilities to see the different auras of the cast.

  • Memories: Revisit free time dates and let our love interests woo you as many times as you'd like.

Content Warnings

This game contains mention of mild violence, kidnapping, stalking, and mildly suggestive language; various text and camera effects, such as bouncing and jittering text, shaking camera effects, and flashes; and loud SFX, such as thunder. Player discretion is advised.

2099110.name: The Classrooms
2099110.about_the_game:
The Classrooms

The Classrooms is a procedural, liminal-space, found-footage, survival horror game. In 1996, Robert Chen took his VHS camcorder to the newly condemned local public school to investigate the disappearances of multiple students, including his younger sister. However, shortly after entering the premises, he finds himself lost in a senseless and seemingly infinite maze of halls and classrooms. Discover the contents of the tape he left behind. Explore The Classrooms and discover the various anomalies it contains; from malicious entities to harmless oddities. And remember, it's different every time you play, so your found footage is uniquely yours.

Procedural World

The world of The Classrooms is fully procedural and different every time you play. Billions of possible layouts and procedural elements ensure a gameplay experience that's always full of surprises.

Entities

Watch out for the various entities that reside within the world of The Classrooms. Entities range from harmless to extremely dangerous, thorough investigation into their various properties will be paramount if one wishes to survive. Every entity has a deep and unique set of mechanics that differentiates it from all others.

Features

  • Proximity Voice: Sound from your input device affects the game world. Making loud noise can reveal your location to certain entities, but maybe you can use your voice to your advantage.
  • Inventory: Find and use various different types of items, codex entries, keys, and equipment. The items available to you might not be the same items available to another.
  • Entities: Discover and survive the unique mechanics of each of the entities.

Development Roadmap

We are dedicated to improving the game both in breadth and depth. The procedural levels will be given more details and combinations, and new anomalies and entities will be added as development continues. This will allow for many new gameplay situations to arise. Our main focuses are currently:
  • New Entities
  • New Anomalous Objects
  • Improved Procedural Generation
  • New Levels
  • New Story Elements
  • Improved Gameplay
  • Language Localization

2099120.name: STARR RINGER
2099120.about_the_game:
In the year 1173 GCT(Galactic Core Time), above a distant planet at the edge of the galaxy is an ancient gateway to a pocket universe filled with unimaginable horrors. A dangerous group is initiating their plan to unleash the chaos realm upon the universe and only YOU can stop them! Take up arms and blast your way through the cosmos to destroy the gate and save the galaxy!

Fight off the forces of chaos and bring order back to the universe using 5 unique weapons each with 4 levels of power!
Collect upgrades and destroy the cosmic horrors that are wreaking havoc on the universe.

Play through Hard and Nightmare difficulties to unlock the ultimate challenge! Test your skills and get your name in the top 100 on the leaderboards!

STARR RINGER has full controller support.

Music by Druaga1

2099140.name: Dictator's Creed
2099140.about_the_game:
Like Alice, you will venture down the rabbit hole leading into a world that one dares not to speak of aloud to your friends or family for the secrets of its chaos dare to be too much!

The Dictator gives you the unique chance to throw all your inhibitions away. Dare to push the boundaries of madness. After all, how many atrocities can one dictator commit? As we plunge head first into insanity, from the very first mission of blowing up buildings and homes of the innocent, you will progress through the game by convincing the masses with propaganda and leading to the fall of the people's freedom. Stand on the throats of the weak with drunken power to become the supreme ruler of the hell which only a dictator can fathom.

This project was created to demonstrate a different world, an excitingly terrible world full of violence, madness, and dark humor, which you have never seen or understood before.

- Welcome to the Russian world!

2099150.name: Dark Maidens
2099150.about_the_game:
Story
    As a knight of the Church, Sir Galahad receives a mission to exterminate a group of demons. Through this perilous journey, Galahad will question himself and his faith. Will he obey the orders given to him, or will he fight for the affection of the Dark Maidens?!

Gameplay
    Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. The game offers an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. The same goes for your enemies however. Do not expect an easy win as the in-game enemies fight back hard.

    • 4 Fierce Fully Voiced Bosses
    • 3 Maps
    • 3 Types of Minions
    • Fully Voiced Story
    • 2.5D Animations
    • Adaptable Difficulty

Wavemode
    Also contains a wave mode where you can fight enemies nonstop. Prove you are the strongest and make it to the top of the leaderboard!

Adaptable Gameplay
    Adjust the game difficulty to your liking with 5 difficulty settings ranging from ‘Very Easy’ to ‘Very Hard’. Whether you're a hardcore brawler or casual gamer, you can have loads of fun!

Meet the Cast
    Abigale

      Abigale is a devout follower of the Church who was given orders to keep watch over Galahad and keep his sword loyal to their cause. Though she and Galahad have fought together side by side in the past, she has a cold disdain towards Galahad for having so little faith in the Church.

    Trina

      Once she was a part of the Church, but ever since she was turned into a vampire, she’s been reviled and hunted by crusaders and witch hunters. She still has kept a playful personality despite her past. That is mainly because she has never found the crusaders to be much of a problem because of her skill with a scythe as well as having vampire strength. She is very confident in her fighting skills and is very enthusiastic about finding Galahad, her new play thing.

    Slan

      Of the three sisters in arms, she is the eldest of them. She was born into the world a demon and ever since has been reviled as one. She’s not fond of outsiders, especially those related to the Church. So it’s no wonder that Galahad and Slan really don’t get along when they first meet.

    Gila

      Gila used to be an inquisitor for the Church. She made many a wretched soul pour their hearts out and repent for their actions against the Church. Gila is incredibly sadistic and very much enjoyed her duties, however because of her maniacal and chaotic tendencies to go...lets say...a little crazy, she herself fell under inquisition, accused of being possessed by the devil. She underwent the tortures she herself had inflicted on others and because of that became blind in one eye. She however managed to escape from the Church’s clutches and now turns her blade against her former comrades who did her wrong. She definitely has a hard time trusting anybody, including her newfound sisters in arms and fights with them...a lot.

    Galahad

      Despite not having any faith, Galahad like many had little choice but to be conscripted by the Church to fight in the Holy Wars. Though he achieved great feats in battle, he never was able to raise his rank because of his lack of faith. So he spent his days serving under his commander, Lady Abigale. Now having traveled far out of the Church's domain, will Galahad continue down the burning path of righteous blood and honor laid out for him by the Church, or will he take up the sword and fight for himself and forge his own path?

2099180.name: Kati The Astronaut
2099180.about_the_game:
Help Kati the Astronaut save the universes!

Join Kati in this highly engaging 2.5D adventure game that has keyboard and game controller support.

If you enjoy adventure, mystery, the Sci-Fi genre, and 80s style music, get ready for the PLANETARY EXPERIENCE of a LIFETIME.

Kati explores the unexplored depths of space to find the dangerous creatures that are invading her planet.



Along the way she encounters encouraging friends...



As well as potential adversaries...



Are you ready to save the universes!?

We hope to see you there!

2099190.name: Edge Of The End
2099190.about_the_game:
Edge Of The End is a Short Walking Simulator, Emotional 3D FPS Exploration Game, Where You Play as a young boy who is going back to his beloved boyhood refuge as you go on an emotional trip. Uncover a treasury of love-filled and heartbreaking experiences that are intertwined. Get lost in the complex web of regrets and desire that makes up familial ties. Explore a moving tale as the son navigates the echoes of the past in his quest for closure. Are you prepared to engage in this sincere adventure and see the power of emotions? Unravel the tale to leave you with lasting memories when the voyage is over.

KEY FEATURES
  • Emotional and Heart warming story
  • Explore the beautiful nature
  • Search For Family Memories
  • Short walking simulator experience
  • Explore Houses

2099220.name: Mobmania
2099220.about_the_game:
Find latest news, teasers, suggestions/feedback, FAQ on our official discord!



Enjoy online co-op with up to 4 players!




Fight, level up, buy, survive! Choose from multiple stages! Can you do it? Start off at level 1 with only your character's unique weapon. As you fight mobs, they will drop XP, which you can collect to level up. Leveling up opens up a shop where you can purchase new equips or upgrade your current ones in order to become stronger.




Fight 50+ unique bosses! Explore the catalogue of items! As you play, bosses will appear, each with their own unique attacks and abilities. Each stage has their own set of bosses. The more you play, the more you will become familiar with the available items, increasing your odds of success.



Currently, there are 30+ playable characters. As the game is still in Early Access, we have plans to continually add more and more playable characters, each with their own unique set of skills and playstyles for you to try.

2099240.name: Digital Pierrot Museum
2099240.about_the_game: Digital Pierrot Museum is a free digital museum presenting the experience of navigating through a museum of digital and multimedia art through a virtual setting. This project is designed to give the audience a live adventure of the whole museum experience. This museum will promote digital art, contemporary art and virtual experiences. The floor plan and the architecture of the museum is devised so the audience can fully immerse in the experience, get lost, and interact. It’s an open virtual space in which multimedia artists can join our vision of making art accessible to everyone. Our goal is to promote art, technology and multimedia and to provide an open space to integrate and incorporate these mediums into the virtual experience of the museum. Using Unity Game engine and VR Virtual Reality Headsets technology to power up the museum experience, we are trying to further enhance the interactivity and the adventure of the museum for purely educational purposes.

2099270.name: ProjectZombieSurvivors
2099270.about_the_game:
Level up, learn skills, and beat those zombies!


Level-based x Wave-based Zombie Shooter

This wave-based zombie shooter is a combination of FPS and RPG.
Players gain experience by defeating zombies and gain skill points as they level up. Use the points to acquire skills and enhance yourself!

As the wave progresses, zombies are strengthened and new enemies appear.
If you fail to kill all the zombies in a wave, the next zombie that appears will be permanently reinforced. You must defeat zombies efficiently.。

Various Skills

27 different skills await you, including increased attack power, increased magazine size, adding a certain amount of defense to attack power....
Attack power is essential to efficiently defeat zombies, but if you neglect defensive power, you may be defeated by zombies in an instant.

Powerful skills require more points, but easy-to-use skills require fewer points.
There are also many unique skills such as one-time revival, ranged attacks when using recovery items, and so on.

Strengthen the skills that suit your play style.


Exploration

Various items can be found in the field, which is lined with unique buildings such as a dimly lit shopping mall, an urban area, a mountain forest with a stream running through it, and a palace.

Ammunition boxes can be found in the buildings and can be picked up to replenish ammunition.

Recovery items and experience crystals are also located in specific areas. Players collect these items while fighting zombies
and collecting these items while fighting zombies to efficiently level up.

Weapons with different performance

Weapons found on the field have different stats.

Some weapons increase attack power more, others increase defense power more, and so on. Find a weapon that fits your style of play.
It is rumored that the most powerful weapon is in the room where you can go after defeating all the bosses...

2099280.name: Metro Manager LA
2099280.about_the_game:
**This game is no longer being supported by updates, but it's now free to play!**

Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy.

Key Features:

- Connect over 50 real communities around the Los Angeles area.

- Shuffle workers around your stations and trains to respond to maintenance and crime as it arises.

- Add new cars to an existing train to increase capacity on popular lines.

- Unlock new trains to ensure low wait times for your riders

- Complete in-demand routes to claim rewards and keep your riders happy.

2099290.name: Child of Aether
2099290.about_the_game:
An odd looking forest full odd places, filled with dark corners and many strange faces.
A blank slate awakens on one fateful morning, unsure of your purpose, you take on a journey.
A world full of tales, mystery, doubt. It'll take a detective to figure it out.
A soil of sadness, an intertwined net, the deeper you dig, the grimmer it'll get.

The lay of this land is unfriendly and dark, be sure to prepare for quests you embark.
Doubt not, you'll encounter vast strangers and fiends. Old creatures, unnerved, undead and unseen.
Prevail and survive or turn into dust., make smart use of acquired resources you must.
The day and night roll and with them change tides. By day you must scavenge, by night you must hide.

And still you're a subject of human afflictions, to dig up the story within this dark fiction,
Explore and discover, and harvest and sow, craft tools and brew substance to aid in your goal.
Crawl though deep, glum crevice, reach heights of unseen, engage in a conflict of humans within.
The further you reach the more will story unveil, the more you will find there's much more to this tale.

2099310.name: Guilds n Glory
2099310.about_the_game:
Instead of controlling just one measly unit, you get to be the big boss in charge of a whole army. And it's all happening in real-time. Your army units will be flocking together, following your every move. You can direct them to attack, move or even run to avoid the enemy's attacks. It's like having your own personal army at your fingertips.




Who says war has to be deadly serious? Defeating your opponent's army units means they switch teams and join your ranks. No need for any casualties here! Your goal is to dominate the battlefield by taking out all other opponents.




So, even though Guilds n Glory is all about fighting and battles in a medieval world, there's something pretty adorable about it. The characters move, attack, and even scream in a cute way. And even when they get hurt, they're still cute.




Each guild has a unique normal attack that requires a different strategy to win. But wait, there's more! The special attack is a game-changer. Use it wisely and you can turn the tide of the battle in your favour.




Activate tactical formations in real-time. Timing and strategy are crucial as you turn your army formation on or off to gain the upper hand on the battlefield.




You've got the Knights, Archers, Assassins, Barbarians, Priests, and Guilds. Each one is pretty adorable in its own way, but they all require a different strategy to play.



Our game is currently in the works and we're putting in some serious elbow grease to make it awesome for you. Don't be a stranger and follow us to keep tabs on all the latest and greatest developments.

2099320.name: Pieter Both Village
2099320.about_the_game:
Pieter Both Village is a third-person adventure zombie game that takes you to a remote, eerie village at the foot of the legendary Pieter Both mountain in Mauritius. Inspired by a chilling Mauritian folktale, the game immerses you in a world where myth and reality collide, and the past refuses to stay buried.

MAIN FEATURES

Engaging Storyline: Uncover the mystery behind the curse of Pieter Both Village. Explore a dark tale where every clue brings you closer to unraveling the haunting secrets of the cursed mountain.

Zombie Survival: Face undead villagers and creatures! Use your wits and weapons to survive in a world where danger is around every corner.

Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate through a variety of eerie environments, including the desolate village, the foreboding Pieter Both mountain, an ancient temple shrouded in mystery, and expansive sugar cane fields that hide dark secrets. Each setting is meticulously designed to keep you on edge as you piece together the village’s tragic past.

Challenging Puzzles: Uncover new areas and reveal hidden secrets. Every puzzle you solve brings you closer to lifting the curse.

Mauritian Folklore: Immerse yourself in a unique setting inspired by local legends. Discover elements of Mauritian history, including the legendary dodo and treasures, woven into the narrative.

* Compelling storyline with an ever-changing environment

* Action focused adventure with guns and hand combat system

* Interaction mechanics including jump, jump over, crouch and item pickup

2099330.name: 妖睨之境The Sight of Darkness
2099330.about_the_game:
▌劇情介紹



一名自由接委託的私人偵探，

因為某起平凡的失物尋回委託，

意外放出了封印百年的妖怪。

​
為了避免妖怪帶來災禍，

「我」必須親自找回妖怪。

然而在雨夜的台北市某個角落裡，

正悄悄發生著一場異變。

​
猝死、失蹤案的暴增使得人心惶惶，

而身邊同伴逐漸惡化的異樣，

似乎也指向了一個令人膽寒的猜測。

同時，神秘引線人的出現，

再次將一切推向深淵――


越是追查深入，

真相越是怵目驚心，

封藏於百年歲月的傳說中，

食人妖物的真相到底又是什麼？

而身處其中的人，

又將迎來什麼樣的結局？
​

「人心生妖物。」

「妖怪本身，不過只是人心的投射……」

▌遊戲玩法


◆ 選擇分支
「真相與結局，藏在每一次抉擇之中。」

．根據選擇不同，會出現不一樣的故事走向。
．所有人的結局，以及案件的真相，都握在你的手上。


◆ 搜查現場
「破局的線索，或許就藏在不起眼的角落。」


．搜查現場，尋找破案的線索。
．合成道具，突破環境的限制。


◆ 線索推理
「合併線索進行推測、獲得更多的推論。」

．使用筆記，蒐集在遊戲中獲得的蛛絲馬跡。


◆ 兇手分析
「誰都有可能是兇手，是相信隊友，還是相信自己的直覺呢？」

▌遊戲操作


使用滑鼠左鍵點擊，即可操作遊戲進行。

◆按鍵說明
  • SAVE：存檔並保存目前遊戲進度。
  • LOAD：讀取先前存檔。
  • AUTO：自動撥放劇情，字幕速度可從設置中調整。
  • SKIP：快轉劇情，再次點擊SKIP即可結束快轉。
  • BACKLOG：回顧劇情。
  • MEMU：可調整畫面為全螢幕（按ECSC可取消）、檢視調查筆記、調整音量與播放速度。

◆快捷鍵
  • 空白Space：繼續對話

2099350.name: Fighter X Fighter
2099350.about_the_game:
The ruthless and arrogant enemies have come. All of them are armed with unique skills to make your home in crisis. Summon up courage to fight, you will become stronger, no difficulties can stop you, move forward!

This game is an action role-playing game, including cultivation, platform jumping, maze and other elements. There are many kinds of enemies. Each enemy has unique attack methods. See through their tricks. You can acquire a variety of skills, and choosing skills pertinently will bring excellent results. In addition to skills, there are also opportunities to improve a variety of different talents and make yourself stronger.

In addition, don't think that only you can become strong. When you meet a really powerful enemy, you will understand that the game is just beginning!

2099370.name: PIP

2099390.name: Umbral Omen
2099390.about_the_game:
A game of signs and symbols where you must use your wits and luck to deduce a shadowy omen.

Features:


  • Randomly generated puzzles that use a different list of clues each time.
  • A relaxing and cerebral atmosphere, rich with themes of nature and the occult.
  • A campaign mode, where new modes and modifiers are unlocked as you progress.
  • Optional, high-pressure speed puzzles, where you must solve an omen with a time limit.
  • Additional hand-crafted puzzles.
  • Daily puzzles. Compete against your friends!
  • Unlock new colour schemes and customise your game's look.



This is a puzzle game with simple rules and strategic depth. Your goal is to figure out which symbol belongs in each space of a grid in the fewest moves possible, but you can approach this goal in many different ways. You might, for example, guess only one symbol at a time. This will give you clear feedback about each guess, but might be slower than making several guesses at once. You might focus on a single type of symbol (such as Sun) or try to clear several at once. There are a number of advanced strategies to discover and master as you experiment with the best ways to solve different puzzles.



The modifier levels will force you to develop new strategies or refine ones you have already discovered. For example, in "Stacking" you may only make guesses on the bottom row at first. This means you need to find ways to quickly gain information with small, localized guesses. By contrast, "One-by-one" only allows you to make guesses with a single symbol until you have found all of it's locations in the grid. This modifier requires gaining information about a wide area quickly, but restricts your ability to gather information about multiple symbols at once.

2099400.name: Odd Guy Meets Odd Farmers - Comedy Boys Love (BL) Visual Novel
2099400.about_the_game:
Odd Guy Meets Odd Farmers is BL game filled with comedy, friendship, and wholesome moments!

Torin is a gamer who locks himself in his room to play games all day. His mom, who is tired of his lifestyle, wants him to go outdoors and appreciate nature and hard labor. What's the solution to get Torin to experience all of the above? Send him to work temporarily on a friend's farm, of course! Upon arriving at the rural community, he meets some farmers who are very welcoming. But they're all quite...quirky.

What sort of wacky adventures awaits Torin on his trip to the rural community?
After making new friends and working together with them, maybe farm life and manual labor can be enjoyable.
Perhaps even romance might blossom...




Torin just graduated, so he wants to enjoy his gap year playing video games all day. Too bad he can't now that he's working as a farmhand. Hardly a day goes by without him cursing.


Archie grows various types of crops, and his dad raises livestock. Everyone thinks he's a sweet little farmer, so they're nice to him. But that could be further from what he actually wants. Archie yearns for someone to be mean to him. Someone to put him in his place.


Cam is a rice farmer. When his friends are busy, he plays with the kids instead, making him popular among them. He often overreacts and tells tall tales. Cam is on a quest to make rice the number one staple food all across the world.


Gilbert is an orchard farmer. When his friends are busy, he hangs out with the elderly, making him copy their behavior. He behaves as if he's an old man whose youthful days are gone. Expect terrible dirty jokes from him.



- 43K words
- 4 endings
- 22 CGs
- Clicker mini-games


Music used from Dova Syndrome
Sound effects used from Zapsplat
2099400.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099400/Odd Guy Meets Odd Farmers - Comedy Boys Love (BL) Visual Novel/

2099420.name: Not Alone: Remake
2099420.about_the_game:
Not Alone is a single-player horror simulator in which you play the role of 45-year-old Mortie Jones. You learn that your mother is dead and your father is missing. Your task will be to spend the night in your old family home. During the gameplay you will come across notes left by family members from them you will be able to learn the dark corners of the plot.

You can light your way with a lighter, flashlight or glowstick. During the gameplay you may also encounter lying candles that you can light, they will give a source of light for a limited time.

Features:

  • Multiple endings.
  • Climate
  • Ability to save the game
  • Easter Eggs
  • Suspense
  • Rich storyline

Warning:.

Not Alone contains loud sounds. Enjoy the gameplay.

2099430.name: Dork
2099430.about_the_game:
As a celestial object crashes in the distance the player's character is forced to leave the safety of his village and embark on the perilous journey. By traveling through eight different and unique locations discover the forgotten history of your people and the tragedy that led to the creation of your civilization.
Welcome to the world of Dork!

Dork is platform/adventure game with linear story line spanning through 69 levels spread across 8 locations. Each location features a unique set of hostile creatures and environmental hazards. As the main hero of the story the player will have to collect pieces of the password to unlock the passage to next level and use equipment found along the way to overcome opponents and dangers. Each finished location will reveal another puzzle of the story.

Features:

Story Rich – Uncover the forgotten and emotional story of your civilization.
The Letters – Guess the password by using ancient terminals or collect all letters to open the gates to next level
The Equipment – Use the equipment collected on your way to overcome challenges
Multitude of Foes – Each location has a number of foes unique and specific to the location, learn how to overcome them!
Painted Environment and Characters – Every element of the game was digitally painted by hand.

2099440.name: Bananner Nababber
2099440.about_the_game:
It's a nice sunny day in Neo-Tartaria and ruthless killer Harry Pippels and his pretend friend Humpty-Ho are guzzling down some sprutzels and racking up a debt at the bar. Their life of luxury is soon interrupted however when news about the Elder Demon's crypto schemes becomes public knowledge. Energy generation is diverted from the population into crypto mining, and if no one intervenes then the precious lives of all Neo-Tartarians are upended as the chilling Neo-Tartarian winter draws near. Only one question remains...

What is a Banana Nababa?

GENRE

Bossrush Platformer

GAME INFO

Pick one of six fighters and enter the lands of Neo-Tartaria to do battle against the mystical Elder Demons and their evil schemes. Destroy them all one at a time in an epic 1v1 duel to the death, each one more difficult than the last. Sniff out mysterious hidden secrets to help you on your journey, and hold on to your hat as you witness the heartwrenching lore that will have you reeling for days.

PROS

 6 mildly unique characters

 10 disgusting boss creatures

 Strong anti-crypto sentiment

CONS

 Based on a subpar indie game from aeons ago

 Contains "jokes"

 Retro 8-bit nostalgia childhood graphics and sounds

SOUNDTRACK

You can check out the soundtrack by Kyle Riley & Jacob J Ritz on Bandcamp!

Full description

Present day, New Hope Town – an entire city built by gigantic pharmaceutical corporation “Oceanika”. Dozens of thousands inhabitants lived and worked in the city until a virus outbreak occured. This virus affected people by changing them into zombies and making them much stronger. The “Oceanika” Corp has seen an opportunity – it has launched a survival game, the “City Massacre”, in which an ordinary man can risk his life and fight with zombie hordes to gain money and popularity.

Millions of viewers are watching the game. There are sponsors and organizators who can be either useful or be a death treat for a player!

You have to destroy waves of zombies (solo or with friends), complete sponsor’ quests, unlock and upgrade weapons, increase your wealth and popularity. That’s the only way to earn something worthy for this life!

Features

Real Massacre
Insane arcade battles – shred in pieces infinite zombie hordes increasing in number and attacking you from every side and every corner. Don’t release the trigger!

Horrible zombie
Arm youself versus 45 enraged enemy types and 7 terrifying bosses. Various enemy types range from the clown-bombers and armored rhinoceros to zombie-maklers and everybody’s favorite headless kamikaze!

Cool guns
Have fun with City Massacre classical arsenal including shotgun, Vulcan machinegun, rocket launcher and even cannon – or get a new unical weapon. Throw a grenade in the coming zombie horde and watch it explode into a billion zombie-pieces!

Turrets and mounted guns
Use mighty mounted weapon to annihilate bloodthirsty zombie crowd and operate powerful high-calibre turrets in breathtaking clashes.

Locked’n’zoned city
Each zone of the city provides its own set of quests and missions. The more expierenced player will get access to the more interesting and difficult zones.

Creative cruelty
Use your fight skills to destroy zombies with creative cruelty. We provide you with many ways to hurt a zombie: have fun with our dismemberment system! You’ll get additional points and benefits for the most unusual methods of destroying zombie.

Day/Night switch
Wait for the night to visit the grim lairs of the contaninated. The sunlight forces the creatures to dissipate among the dens, but after the dusk the monsters leave their shelters to hunt.

Game modes: Campaign/Deathmatch
Fight with zombie mobs in coop online as a team (up to 4 friends) and disintegrate anything that moves in 45 levels of chaos or challenge other players in brutal Deathmatch.

2099670.name: Pirates Journey
2099670.about_the_game:
You and your crew have been shipwrecked on a tropical island in the late 1600s. At the beginning of the adventure, you find yourself with only a few basic supplies, including ropes, sticks, and stones.

Set Up Your Camp and Expand: Gather resources on islands and seas. Build new Buildings. Grow your pirate camp by building buildings like Carpenter, Blacksmith etc.

Survive with your crew: As the captain, you must survive first. Build new fields for your crews. Organize and train your crews. Give them tasks.

Raid enemy factions and capture their bases: You are not alone on the islands. Raid the bases of enemy pirate captains. In addition to you, 3 different pirate captains fight among themselves for a total of more than 50 different bases and outposts.

Solve the mysteries of the island and the surrounding seas: You will learn the stories of 7 pirate captains mentioned in the legends. Dig graves, follow the maps and explore the surroundings to find the treasure they hide.

Your first priority is to find food and water to survive. You can forage for berries and fruits on the island, but these will only provide limited sustenance. To truly thrive, you will need to start growing crops and raising animals.
To do this, you will need to clear a field and start planting. You can use the sticks and stones you found to make rudimentary tools, such as a stone ax, to help you clear the land. As the game progresses, you will be able to craft more advanced tools and weapons, including a pirate sword, to help you in your tasks.

In addition to hunger and thirst, you will also have to deal with other dangers on the island. Wild animals, such as crocodiles and bears, roam the land and can be a threat to your crew. And, of course, there are other pirate crews on the island who will stop at nothing to claim the land and resources for themselves.

You will need to be careful and strategic in order to survive. Build a sturdy shelter to protect your crew from the island natives and other dangers. Hunt for food and gather resources to sustain yourself. And, when necessary, defend yourself and your crew from other pirates.

With skill and cunning, you can survive on the island and thrive as a pirate crew. But be warned: the challenges on this island are many, and only the strongest and most resourceful crews will survive.

Basic Features


  • Build shelter by cutting trees to survive on the deserted island. Gather the food and cook it on the campfire.
  • Manage your crew. Give them tasks. Let them work in the fields, build houses. Build a self-sufficient colony.
  • To survive, you must gather, cook, and camp.
  • The island is full of dangers and lost pirate loot to solve the mystery and find the lost treasure.
  • Craft weapons to survive.
  • Unravel the mystery and find the loot.
  • Create tools, hunt with the tools you produce, or trap your enemies.

2099690.name: Dungeons Diced
2099690.about_the_game:
Choices Matter! a Nod to classic Dungeon crawlers, Start off by creating a character, that feels much like a tabletop-style fantasy game.
You Explore a procedurally generated/HandCrafted Dungeon in FPS, with your unique character, Combat is turn-based. but there is a twist. it's not just rolling dice, Based on; your character stats, and equipment. weapons, skill lines, classes, levels, and combat events you have choices in combat to make, from hundreds of attacks. The Attacks arent all offensive, set up your attacks in chains, combos, leveraging positions, and accessing special attacks. From an intuitive combat system, (Specialized Rogue Dagger Attacks being available after doing a dodge, for example) The combat is augmented by dice rolls. Offensive and Defensive attacks, filter through combat, from the current state of the combat, is the enemy charging? is the enemy Stunned? perhaps the enemy is charging a significant attack! you are setting up chain attacks, positioning your character in future attacks, and causing the combat to have a unique feel and be very tactical. Death is permanent. last as long as you can. be the Dungeons Diced Legend!


Turn-based combat is time and event based. choose from all the available actions, based on the combat state, perhaps setting up for counter strikes, or crippling your enemy, play your cards right and unleash devastating attacks.

2099990.name: graveyard keeper
2099990.about_the_game:
This is an ancient and interesting merge type game

Players need to merge three tombstones (or zombies) with the same shape into a higher-level tombstone

When all the squares on the chessboard are full, the game ends and you will get a gold coin reward according to the points

If you encounter difficulties and cannot merge, you can try to use the round universal merge, or use a bomb.


At present, the game is offered to fans as a free product. Therefore, the option to buy gold coins in the game is unlimited (cheating). If you are confused about the difficulty of the game, you can directly buy gold coins in the game for free, and then use gold coins to buy props for customs clearance.


In addition, we have retained some 'back doors' of the game

1. Using the right mouse button in the chess board of the game can directly upgrade the object pointed by the mouse

2. Press keypad 1, and then press the left mouse button to automatically generate a zombie

3. Pressing keypad 2 and then the left mouse button will blow up the object pointed by the mouse

4. Pressing the L key on the keyboard will delete all the contents on the chessboard


You can also try to use this series of commands to construct an 'interesting' level.


Ten years ago, we were trying to make independent games. Unfortunately, the environment was poor at that time, and piracy was rampant. After the game came out, the prison break version was soon released, and the free version was overwhelming. So the game died.

Ten years later, after a lot of things, the game has seen the light of the day again. In order to give back to our friends who insisted on supporting us in those years, and to leave footprints in the dusty past, this commemorative version of the game is specially launched for pure commemoration. The comments on this game will be taken into account in the subsequent reproduction products.

This game is developed with unity3d 3.5.6, and written with ngui and uscript plug-in visual programming. Now the plug-in has disappeared, and this work is also the masterpiece of this plug-in.

2100040.name: Rune Break
2100040.about_the_game:
Welcome to Rune Break, the completely free time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and rogue-lite elements. As a solo developer, my goal was to create a game that everyone could enjoy without any barriers. That's why Rune Break is completely free to download and play, and there is no monetization whatsoever.

In Rune Break, your objective is simple - survive as long as possible and gather as many gems as you can to power up your next character. With over 20 skills and abilities, you must experiment with different builds to upgrade your abilities and go even further on your next run. Face off against challenging bosses, unlock achievements, and use various points of interest to your advantage.

But beware, the game is not easy, and you cannot hide. You must survive, or you will lose everything. However, with every failure, comes new opportunities to learn and try again.

Rune Break V1.0 is finally here, featuring new bosses, new maps, new enemies, and many more surprises in store for you. Plus, with controller support, you can play the game with your favorite controller for a more immersive experience.

Whether you prefer fast-paced action or strategic gameplay, Rune Break has something for you. With its minimalistic design and rogue-lite elements, the game offers endless replayability, challenging gameplay, and satisfying progression. You can unlock new skills and abilities, upgrade your character, and even experiment with different builds to discover the perfect combination for you.

While the game has been thoroughly tested, there may still be a few issues or bugs that need to be resolved. I am committed to resolving any problems that arise to ensure that the game is as polished and enjoyable as possible. Your feedback is always welcome, and I invite you to join our Discord group to connect with other players and share your experiences.

Download Rune Break now for a completely free gaming experience that's all about survival, strategy, and skill.

Find synergies and combine these powers to create the ultimate defender.

Become Stronger!

Find Spell synergies!

Future planned updates

2100080.name: The Last Premiere
2100080.about_the_game:
THE LAST PREMIERE started out as a small detective game and then somehow turned into a 3D action adventure. Now you still need to solve a case but you might use a sword, a hammer or your wing cape before you can even reach your undead witnesses.

The Protagonist of “The Last Premiere” is Julie, A young policewoman investigating a long forgotten murder in an abandoned theatre. Julie gets caught between the real world and the twisted memories of the murdered souls.
Her only way out is to fight the demons haunting the dead and solving the mystery surrounding their untimely passing.
These memories take place in the golden twenties and have a dark and surreal atmosphere.

The game starts with the real theatre falling apart and the various pieces scattering across the realm of the ghosts. This makes for a metroidvania-style world, Where everything is connected and the game opens up to more exploration with every ability the player unlocks. By bringing the ghosts back to their sanity, the player reassembles Julies reality. Only when the pieces align, will the theatre and its inhabitants shine in its old splendor and give way to the living world again.

The Core Gameplay is a mixture of three elements:

  • Action combat system with 3 different weapons that are equally effective for battle and exploration: fast paced sword, slow but brutal hammer and a swift wing-cape with long range projectiles
  • Movement-System with gliding and traditional plaformer-elements
  • Solving simple story puzzles to uncover the mystery that lies beneath the theatre.

2100090.name: Dodge
2100090.about_the_game:

Iron ball, bullet, laser, missile, spike trap and mixed extreme!

2100100.name: Allakin
2100100.about_the_game:
Allakin is a little apprentice magician who one day finds an ancient sealed portal in a remote forest.
Curious as he is, he tries to open it with the help of his magician's book, which he then succeeds in doing, after a few attempts, with the help of a portal crystal.
Courageous and full of curiosity about what is behind the portal, he steps through it and is thereby transported to another world.
But unfortunately it is very difficult for him to get away from there and every new portal seems to pull him further and further into the world.
In the search for new portal crystals there are many dangers and tricky puzzles on his way back home...

Accompany Allakin through his exciting journey in a varied platformer platformer.
Trick your opponents with skill and solve the puzzles to magically advance into new worlds.



Allakin offers everything a great puzzle platformer needs

  • Jump 'n' Run, skill and lots of puzzle elements
  • Hidden secrets and paths
  • Obtain new skills that will take you to new places
  • Lots of different and varied levels
  • A nice story
  • and a lot more...

2100130.name: Territorial Duck
2100130.about_the_game:
You're a duck. 🦆 You have a pond.💧 Life is great. ✨
Except nosy visitors keep trying to come over to look at your pond and pet you!

Over your fallen feathers!

Territorial Duck is a cute 2D rogue-lite where you play as duck with sharing-difficulties.

Chase away visitors

  • Strike terror into the hearts of any who would dare step close to your pond.
  • Steal items to make your quacks more fearsome to any who visit.
  • Create wild builds by carefully choosing which items to steal.
  • Keep your sanity until you've chased away each person and animal.

Customize your pond

    Come over and save this poor duck and their home from nosy animals and people!

2100140.name: Summon Masters
2100140.about_the_game:
This is a card and board game with the following features:

Deck Building: Players can build their own decks to battle with. Depending on different strategies and opponents, players can choose different cards to counter.

Tactical Gameplay: The game uses a 3x10 chessboard, and players can freely place cards to fight. Players need to develop tactics and arrange card positions and usage order within limited space.

Different Professions: Players can choose freely from four professions - swordsman, mage, monk, and archer. Each profession has different characteristics and skills, and players can choose according to their preferences and tactical needs.

Competitive Battles: Players can battle with other players after building their decks, and it is fun to fight with other people. Through battles with other players, players can improve their strength and tactical skills.

Team Dungeons: In addition to fighting against other players, players can also team up with others to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Players need to defeat powerful bosses through cooperation and strategy to get more rewards and cards.

Special Challenges: Players can participate in special rules challenges and use their intelligence to defeat other players. These special rules make the game more interesting and challenging, and players need to constantly think and try new strategies.

Fast-paced: Each game is fast-paced (within 5 minutes), and can be played in short fragments of time. The fast pace of the game allows players to enjoy the game in a short time, while also being able to play at any time and anywhere.

2100150.name: Shadow of the Depth
2100150.about_the_game:
Overview

Dive into Shadow of the Depth, a thrilling action roguelike with top-down perspective and stunning hand-drawn visuals.
Featuring a dark world and five distinct characters, players will explore an ever-changing labyrinth through an immersive combat system that challenges them to create and experiment with all the tools at their disposal. Find your perfect warrior, explore a world caught between light and shadow and see if you have what it takes to survive an onslaught of powerful monsters.

Key Features

· 5 PLAYSTYLES - Multiple outstanding characters for you to choose from, each with unique abilities and characteristics.


  • Arthur, a melee warrior excelling in high defence at the expense of his agility, fights with a sword and shield, an expert in defensive manoeuvres. The son of a blacksmith, and seeking vengeance on the monsters that killed his father.
  • Arya is an agile assassin with dual daggers, dealing high damage from up close, and as survivable as she can dodge enemy attacks. A wandering bounty hunter, often found skulking in the shadows of taverns and the lairs of monsters.
  • Stephanie, an enigmatic sorcerer proficient in fire, frost and lightning magics, boasts powerful attacks at long ranges, but sacrifices survivability and agility. Able to teleport from danger at the cost of mana, she wields a magic orb.
  • Phyllis (archer/hunter), a ranged attacker, is able to summon a wolf, a bear, and two eagles to divert enemy attention as she attacks.
  • Ginzo, a swordsman with an extended attack range, wields a katana, and uses flashing sword slashes reminiscent of samurai.


· HACK N’ SLASH - Intense hack-and-slash action, seamlessly integrated with Rogue-like elements.


· COMBO MOVES - Each character in Shadow of the Depth features their own distinct array of primary and ultimate skills, underpinned by multiple combo options or exclusive moves. Rhythmic combos, which task players with carefully timing their button hits, add depth to combat encounters, encouraging the mastering of all five of the game’s playable characters.


· HAND-PAINTED - Hand-painted visuals help bring Shadow of the Depth’s dark and brooding world to life. Dynamic lighting adds further depth to the world, creating a tangible atmosphere which sits at the heart of every encounter.


·ROGUELIKE - Explore randomly generated dungeons full of challenges, comprising three grand chapters, each culminating in thrilling and tense boss battles.

About Us

We’re a team of 5 people that have been working on SOTD for over 5 years. In Shadow of the Depth, we've crafted a dark and intricate world, and the playable characters are simply tailored for entertaining gamers with various combat mindsets. We hope that you can find enjoyment in mastering your characters and their development, indulging in the pure combat while refining your gaming skills, and perhaps you’ll discover a new combat preference.

You're welcome to join our Discord server or follow us on X (@ChillyRoom) for updates, discussions about the game, and your valued suggestions and support.


Do you have what it takes to conquer the depths?

2100160.name: MotoGP™23
2100160.about_the_game:
Open the throttle, pass your opponents and cross the finish line. Live the dream of being the next champion with the new MotoGP™23, more amazing and challenging than ever!
Choose from the four acclaimed championship classes MotoGP™, Moto2™, Moto3™ and MotoE™, step into the shoes of your favourite rider and head to the track to experience the adrenaline of the 2023 season.

NEW CAREER, NEW CHALLENGES

Embark on your path to set the record: make your debut in Moto3™ and depending on your results, climb the rankings and go up a class.

In the motorsport world, every decision counts! Influence the trend of a season by planning your career in a way that best suits you. Develop your bike to get increasingly improved performance and also keep the most experienced opponents at bay, win your position on the official team by beating the leading rider, or change teams to prove that what makes the difference is not the bike, but you!
Use Social Media during the game to establish relationships between teams and with other riders, but be careful! Any friendly rivalry started in the community will continue on the track.

ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN

The feature highest in demand is now in the game: dynamic weather will not only make the races more realistic, but also more unpredictable. Manage the arrival of rain or of an unexpected clearing up with Flag to Flag: change your bike at the most appropriate moment to get a strategic advantage over your opponents.


MotoGP™23 IS FOR EVERYONE

Discover the new neural aids system that uses artificial intelligence to intervene in the most critical moments of your race and guarantee you a custom-made experience without taking the control of your bike away from you.
Do you want to get ready for the challenges of the 2023 season in the best possible way? Pop over to the MotoGP™ Academy and perfect your performance with specific training for every circuit.

NEVER GO UNNOTICED

Rider stickers, helmet and number: customize your MotoGP™ experience by using four essential graphic editors and show off a unique style to leave your mark as you cross the finish line!

MORE RACING MODES

Don't limit yourself to the AI. Challenge other online players and show them who you are.
The new Ranking system will allow you to face opponents of your same caliber or even stronger. The greater the challenge, the greater the reward!
Challenge your friends from your sofa with the Split Screen mode and celebrate your victory in real time!
Don't miss out on the new LiveGPs: control the race conditions and race every day to rise in the world rankings!

2100170.name: No Way Out
2100170.about_the_game:
NO WAY OUT is a first person psychological horror game, featuring scary and jumpy gameplay and an unsettling and interesting narrative.

STORYLINE

There is now 2 possibilities for a Narrative, maybe more that one ending?

You were driving around and you got lost without signal and No Way of getting Out of the place where you stopped. The only solution is to keep going on foot until you find a place to get away for the rain and thunderstorm. The thing you didn't know is that the house you get into, may not allow you to get out! You start by finding a way into the house, but at the end your main goal is to find Way Out of the house also keeping in mind that you may have NO WAY OUT.

CHARACTERS

You are the main character in the story, other characters narrative is told by papers found in the map or audios/videos.

GAMEPLAY

Use everything that you can to survive this scary story and dive deeper into it.


Develop the photos that you take to find clues or discover more about the narrative.


Unlock door by searching for the key or by solving puzzels.


Use all your equipment to enjoy this terrifying experience.

2100190.name: Divine Duel
2100190.about_the_game:

The game combines fast-paced gameplay with a strategic layer, rewarding players for quick thinking and creative ideas. Duel others in a never-ending struggle for the fate of the Multiverse and prove that you have what it takes to win the Divine Duel.

The glory is yours to take.



Features:
  • Choose your Celestial and duel players from around the world in real-time
  • Use over 40 exciting weapons, spells, and summons (dragons included!)
  • Experiment with your loadout - drop a huge structure on your foe if you have to!
  • Level up and unlock useful boosters that can improve your fighting potential
  • Try multiple game modes - classical duel and card-games-inspired draft
  • Move or die - as simple as that

2100200.name: Idle Zombies Clicker
2100200.about_the_game:
Idle Zombies Clicker is an idle clicker game with enormous amount of game mechanics. Fight against various zombies, buy upgrades and weapons, hire companions and let's see how far will you proceed!

No endless walkthrough and unreachable goals. Everything is completable with guaranteed fun, pleasure and challenging but fair tasks.

Gameplay

Simple but addictive idle clicker gameplay with completable goals

Upgrades

Everything is upgradable! 15 various stats to make your game experience more interesting

Assistants

50 unique assistants can be unlocked and purchased. Let them do your job fighting with enemies

Stats

Track your game statistics to know your strengths and weaknesses

Levels

Game can be completed! Finish all levels and defeat all bosses to unlock new modes and difficulties

Customization

Drag and drop game panels anywhere you want. You can also set preferable FPS

Prestige System

Buy powerful artifacts and restart the game to get significant power boost that will make your further fights easier and more profitable

Leaderboard and Achievements

Will you be able to take the first place in the global leaderboard or unlock all 32 achievements?

Graphics and Music

Fancy low poly graphics and cute background music for your pleasure

2100230.name: Easy Simple Game
2100230.about_the_game:
Easy Simple Game is a short platformer game with high dinamics, a colorful pixel style and a funny story. Go through all obstacles and find out what the Unsuspicious dude wants from you!

Have fun!

2100270.name: Succuquest
2100270.about_the_game:
Fawn is on a quest to impress and seduce the world's heroes. Use your whip to take down foes, glide past enemy attacks, and transform to explore the world to it's fullest. And maybe have a few sexual encounters along the way...



Along the way meet a colorful cast of monsters and lure them in with your power of transformation and seduction. Fawn's taste for heroes must be satisfied, and to impress the other heroes of the world with her many talents.

Will you adventure forth as a sexy Succubus on an action adventure side scrolling love letter to retro gaming and exploration platformers?

2100280.name: World of Tanks: HEAT
2100280.about_the_game:
World of Tanks: HEAT is the first ever hero-driven tank action game. It's high-velocity clashes every single battle. It's Agents with unique abilities operating machines with menacing power. Choose your Agent, personalize your tank, and combine skill and strategy to dominate the battlefield.

In an alternate post-WW2 timeline shaped by rapid scientific progress and global cooperation, humanity’s technological marvels – once symbols of hope – have become strategic flashpoints in an escalating worldwide conflict. 

Elite Agents answer the call. 

Equipped with high-tech tanks and unique combat abilities, they fight a new kind of war – one defined not by borders, but by precision, firepower, and tactical dominance. 

Welcome to World of Tanks: HEAT, a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter packed with explosive combat and non-stop action. 

Battle through intense 5v5 and 10v10 matches featuring fast-paced, ability-enhanced vehicle combat. 

Team up with friends, combine abilities, and dominate in adrenaline-fueled battles that reward timing, synergy, and precision. Choose from a growing roster of Agents, each unlocking new experimental tanks and fresh tactical layers in turn.

  • Competitive teamplay that requires both strategy and spontaneity

  • High-impact PvP modes: Conquest, Domination, Kill Confirmed

  • Agents with unique battlefield roles and progression paths

Your tank is more than steel and firepower – it’s an instrument shaped by your decisions. 

Every upgrade matters. Each vehicle has a strict power cap, so you’ll need to choose your loadout wisely: boost firepower or reinforce armor? The path to victory lies in trade-offs that reflect your playstyle. 

  • Modular systems with meaningful choices 

  • Reactive armor, signature weapons, and active abilities 

  • Unlock, experiment, and hone your playstyle

Team up with friends and combine your strengths to dominate the frontlines. 

Whether you’re coordinating ultimates or reacting in the heat of the moment, smart teamwork always wins the day. 

Go solo and be a hero. Squad up and become legends. 

  • Free-to-Play – Jump into high-octane armored warfare and experience the full game at zero cost.

  • Dynamic PvP Battles – Experience fast-paced, team-based combat in large-scale 10v10 modes like Conquest, Domination, and Kill Confirmed, plus the 5v5 Plant & Defuse mode. Every match is a tactical showdown where coordination and timing are key. 

  • Deep Customization – Build and modify your perfect war machine. Equip unique weapons, enhance armor, and deploy powerful battlefield abilities tailored to your playstyle. 

  • Diverse Battlefields – Fight across distinct environments with varied terrain, structures, and biomes that constantly reshape tactical decisions.

  • Evolving Roster of Agents and Tanks – Unlock and master a growing lineup of Agents and their unique vehicles. Experiment, adapt, and find the perfect loadout for every combat role.

2100320.name: KHATYRKA: Prelude
2100320.about_the_game:
“Gadzhi, are you above shooting a man in the back these days?”

The humble people of Khatyrka Steppe find their peaceful way of life under threat. Gadzhi, a military defector, is on the run. Tricked by the people of Khatyrka Village into helping them, Gadzhi must reclaim his stolen military cargo before his past catches up to him.

Made by the student team behind “How Fish is Made”, we're excited to announce the prelude to KHATYRKA.


  • Ride Cheryoshka, your trusty war horse, through an arid yet beautiful landscape, exploring the strange monuments and abandoned towns along the way.
  • Discover the scattered remnants of the once great Ostravya army, now starved and fortified in the abandoned infrastructure of the steppe.


  • A full narrative experience. You’ll meet a multitude of characters struggling with the after effects of a devastating civil war.
  • Uncover the dark past of Gadzhi, a military defector running away from his wartime actions. The people of Khatyrka Steppe who blackmail him into aiding them at the cost of his own mission.


  • Intense ragdoll-driven shooter combat. Stagger and incapacitate your enemies before going in for the execution.
  • Gunfights are dynamic brutal. Sniping, mounted combat, and armored enemies all play a role in the combat experience with Khatyrka's three major factions.

2100340.name: Liminalia
2100340.about_the_game:
Unravel the mysteries of these forgotten lands in a hand-drawn, narrative-driven 2d action-adventure, as a white-robed girl awakens in the depths of an abandoned world.

  • A narrative-driven, single-player action-adventure game.

  • Hand-drawn artwork in watercolor style.

  • Play as a white-robed girl with mystical abilities trying to find her way out of the forsaken realm.

  • Evolve with new skills and abilities to progress to new areas and defeat difficult enemies in 2d side-scrolling action combat.

  • Uncover the mysteries of this abandoned world and the lore behind its downfall through exploration.

How does a world so grand and majestic manage to fall, with only ruins and broken walls to remind us of its past glory.

How do two inseparable souls manage to drift so far apart until a rift shatters their bond.

It happens not with a crash but ever so gently— like the night falling across the sky in its twilight.

One small mistake, one small misjudgment, one small misunderstanding. Little by little until that dreaded day comes when all is too late— and there is no turning back.

2100360.name: Berlin Maniacs
2100360.about_the_game:
Berlin Maniacs is a top-down 3D story-driven action-adventure.

Players take on the role of the young and impressionable Tina in a fictionalized snapshot of West Berlin in 1968, a time when state violence led to radicalization within the student protest movement.

You decide how to navigate the streets of Berlin - with either discretion or force - and ultimately affect her involvement with a group of protesters that is growing more violent by the day.

Gameplay Features

  • Exploration: Freely navigate a tiny open world, a city district in the grasp of the political tension between the progressive youth and the police.

  • Dialogue: Talk to the inhabitants of the city to understand what drives them. Solve quests and discover the political forces of the young West German republic.

  • Equipment: Fight back with what you can find on the street. Use bottles to distract or attack your enemies, wave a sign during a political protest, and smuggle contraband between factions.

  • Photography: Utilize Tina's instant film camera to document your journey. Pictures expose police brutality and help you to understand your surroundings.

  • Dynamic NPC Behavior: Utilize and experiment with the NPC's dynamic behavior to hide in crowds, lure the police away or escalate protests into an all-out riot.

2100390.name: Zellige: The Tilemaker of Granada
2100390.about_the_game:
Zellige : The Tilemaker of Granada is a meditative and relaxing historical game, set in medieval Al-Andalus, where you play as a skilled tilemaker and design intricate Islamic mosaic patterns to decorate a merchant family's palace.



You will be able to create a various array of mosaics in all styles, following traditional techniques or let your creativity flow !



We really aim to bring you a calm experience, the sort of game you can play to unwind after a long day at work, and to get that sense of satisfaction that comes with creating something of your own. The palace is a fully explorable 3D environment, which you can walk around and admire in first-person. While doing so, you'll be able to talk to its inhabitants, the Dhahbans. They are a wealthy, well-travelled merchant family, and their home is filled with souvenirs and artefacts from across the Islamic world which will help you find inspiration and learn new techniques!

2100470.name: Delivering Letters
2100470.about_the_game:
This is a game about postman who has to deliver last 10 letters.

This game is primarily a "walking simulator" genre you only have to click on mailbox and dont get caught by the enemy.

My idea of the game was to make a small "Party horror game" where you can watch your friends play and compete who can beat the game in better time, but you can also play alone, it's inspired by a game in which you have to collect 8 pages, but instead you are delivering 10 letters which are randomly chosen from 50 overall. Every house has a number and when you click on tab on your keyboard it shows you current letter with the house number and the house numbers are shown on the map. Current letter - TAB
Map - M
Deliver letter - left mouse button (aim on mailbox)
Sprint - Shift

2100500.name: Swimming Poo
2100500.about_the_game: Let yourself be carried away by the incessant pursuit. Play the role of a boy - Simon and show the pool guards who is in charge! Feel the taste of commercial America of the 1960s, blending into a fairy-tale aquapark full of attractions. Demonstrate agility in competition with enemies by farting and polluting pool zones, destroying their filtering pumps. Only this will allow you to recover secret confectionery recipes that will be with you forever. Don't forget about your best friend Poopie, who is always ready to help you come out alive. Have fun!

2100510.name: Cyber Lancer
2100510.about_the_game:
Pilot the Hyper-Advanced, mechanized assault suit: Cyber Lancer.

Purchase and upgrade weapons to take down waves upon waves of enemies!

Feast your eyes on Mind-Melting Sega Saturn inspired graphics!

Cyber Lancer is a third person, wave based, roguelike, shoot em up, where you pilot an up-gradable mech defeating hoards of mechanized enemies.

Choose from several mechs and master the various missions to become the top Cyber Lancer.

2100560.name: Karl Marx and the Ring of Communism
2100560.about_the_game:
As Karl Marx once said: "Reason has always existed, but not always in a reasonable form", and this game is perfectly unreasonable.

Become one and only Karl Marx as you try to retrieve the stolen ring of the communism from capitalistic pigs! Jump as high as he never did, grab onto other people's money as he always told to, and use moving platforms as he totally would if he could witness them!

Face the evilest and richest minds of his world and restore the perfect balance of everybody having nothing, But beware, as the challenge never has been this... challenging.

Features:
- Communism clashes Capitalism!
- Ridiculous, twisted plot full of ridiculous plot twists
- Get into the skin of Karl Marx himself
- Four distinctive worlds and one has male reproductive organ looking clouds
- Three capitalistic bosses: Jeph Bezoos, M-elon Mask and Mark Sugarberg
- Challenging levels with communistic symbols to collect
2100560.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100560/Karl Marx and the Ring of Communism/

2100590.name: Yupi Road 2 World
2100590.about_the_game:
Yupi Road 2 World is a 2D platform game in which Yupi, a kind alien, must save the Earth from a catastrophe.

In Yupi Road 2 World, players take control of Yupi, an alien from the planet Pompastic. Yupi is a member of the Slimers, a race of kind creatures dedicated to helping other planets.

Yupi is forced to land on Earth after a catastrophe at the North Pole releases a large amount of energy. This energy attracts the Bombyx, hostile alien creatures that threaten to destroy Earth.

Players must help Yupi traverse the levels of Earth, avoiding or using enemies to make his way. Yupi can jump, run and use his power boots to launch himself through the air.
