2100620.name: Rusl
2100620.about_the_game:
EXPERIENCE SOMETHING NEW
In Rusl you're playing as a guy named Russel. Your task is to eleminate the last boss.
  • Eleminate bosses in a unique way!
  • Grind through the questline with unique, exciting quests!
  • Obtain rare gear with insane modifiers, be stronger than the monsters!

THE FIGHT SYSTEM
The fighting mechanism in Rusl is unique, and hasn't been seen in any other games. Did you like the old card games back in the 20's? Rusl is for you!

GEAR UP
You can obtain gear pieces in the game, which makes your character stronger by giving you modifiers to your Health, Strenght, and Defense. You can get the
gear by killing monsters, and eleminating bosses after each level.

LEVEL UP
Rusl has an experience system, after every levelup, your character gets primary stat bonuses - in other way - playing more, killing more monsters, makes your
character stronger.

BUILD YOUR HOUSE
In Rusl you can build your house, and customize it in a way you like it. Craft furnitures, paint walls, get stronger doors ... it's all up to your creativity!

UPGRADE YOUR HOME
You can upgrade your house by gathering the required materials for it. Upgrading your house grants you more house inventory space, and you can respawn faster!

GET UNIQUE ITEMS
Killing bosses has never been this good. Why? In Rusl you can get unique items from bosses, granting you unique effects, and bonuses! (Drop chances are random!)

GET PETS
You can get a pet in this game, and customize it however you want. How? You can use the 'Cage' item which is obtainable in-game, and catch a pet in the map.

EXPLORE THE MASSIVE WORLD
Rusl offers a massive playable map with unique elements. Explore it and get rewards!

2100640.name: Wanderlight
2100640.about_the_game:
Embark on a tranquil journey through the enchanting open world of Wanderlight. Explore lush forests, serene lakes, and ancient ruins at your own pace, uncovering the gentle balance of light and shadow. Engage with the land's mysteries and its inhabitants in a world where every path leads to discovery.

Key Features



Expansive Open World: Experience the beauty of Wanderlight's vast landscapes. From towering mountains to hidden groves, every environment is designed for peaceful exploration and enjoyment.

Gentle Exploration: Roam freely across diverse terrains—walk, climb, or glide through the air. With no set path, you choose how to explore the world’s wonders.

Meaningful Interactions: Meet a variety of characters who enrich your journey with their stories and wisdom. Each interaction weaves deeper into the tapestry of the world’s lore.

Relaxing Puzzles: Engage with puzzles that blend naturally into the environment, offering a thoughtful challenge that complements the serene atmosphere.

Harmonious Abilities: Develop abilities that allow you to interact with the environment in magical ways, enhancing your exploration and helping you navigate the world with ease.

Fun With Archery: Discover the joy of archery in a relaxing and enjoyable setting. Perfect your aim, hone your skills, and experience the thrill of hitting bullseyes in picturesque environments.

2100650.name: Tunnel Boat Terror
2100650.about_the_game:
A racing simulation and arcade game based on Tunnel Boats and Hydroplanes. Explore beautiful race locations in a variety of unique watercraft, including some of the fastest and most iconic power boats in the world. Improve your skill, upgrade your equipment, expand your garage, customize your hull, and dominate the competition. A brand-new boat racing experience for enthusiasts and newcomers alike, made in cooperation with the oldest and largest sanctioning organization in the world.

An Outboard Performance Craft is one of the fastest and most agile vehicles on the planet. Weighing under 450kg, including the driver, it can execute a full 180° turn nearly instantaneously, subjecting the driver to 4g's in the tightest corners. Approximately 6½ meters in length, they are powered by a single V6 two-stroke outboard engine and equipped with a three or four-blade supercavitating propeller. With over 400hp and capable of revving beyond 9,000rpm, these boats can accelerate from 0 to 100km/h in under two seconds and achieve top speeds of 250km/h. Hydraulic trim allows the driver to tilt the motor in and out of the water for optimal maneuverability.
An Inboard Hydroplane is a stunning sight on the water, known for its blistering speed, sleek design, impressive rooster tails, and thunderous noise. Powered by a supercharged V8 engine with a staggering 1,400hp and cranking over 8,000rpm, they can reach speeds up to 260km/h. With a load of around 1,350kg, with the driver, and measuring 7 meters in length, these boats demonstrate extraordinary speed and agilty while throwing massive walls of water into the air. To manage lift and stability, hydroplanes use a canard and rely on a skid fin and rudder for turning.

Jetsprint, Unlimited Hydroplane, Mod-V, Super Stock, Tri-Hull, Crackerbox, Stock Hydro, Stock Runabout, K-Boat, Class One, PWC, Stunt Craft

Locate and save stranded vessels, remove debris from active race courses, help crashed racers, or chase criminals while playing as the Coast Guard.

Experience fast-paced, unforgiving, circuit, sprint, and drag racing with real power boats. Overtake opponents with strategic turns, precise throttling, and expert trim control. Execute nearly instantaneous 180° turns, accelerate from 0-100km/h in under two seconds, navigate without brakes or traction to a road, smash buoys, and hydroplane on the razor's edge. Explore the open water, play arcade games, face challengers, discover upgrades, and enjoy boat racing at its finest!

Race against real power boat drivers from all over the world from a variety of classes. Using the latest 3D software we're able to import drivers right into the cockpit. We're working on allowing you to create your own driver as well.

Race on over 50 different wave patterns for both lake and ocean water. Boats, buoys, and debris all interact with the water surface using realistic buoyancy and physics. Rooster tails, wakes, rain, muddy water, thunderstorms, water blinding your vision. It's going to get wet! Developed with Unreal Engine®. Utilizing the Epic Games Water Plugin, Fluid Ninja Live, and custom-tailored by our development team, TBT plans to be an immersive aquatic experience. Dynamic environments where players can race including; the ocean, vast lakes, man made courses, shallow meandering rivers, castle moats and many other unique locations.

Modify the weather, wind, water, and time of day. Race on a dark and stormy night or at the break of dawn with the moon still in the sky. Adjust the strength of the wind or change the waves to make it easier or more difficult to play and race.

Grand Prix Hydroplane, Garage Customization, Quick Pit Performance Tuning, Level Design, Engine Sounds, Steering, Trim, Sinking, Listing, Flipping, Rolling, Crashing & Damage, Pre-Race Setup, Instant Replays, Full Controller Support, Steam Controller Support, Character Creation/Selection, Local/LAN Multiplayer, Steam Leaderboards, Steam Achievements, VR Support, Support for Race Wheels.

Join Discord® or send us your email on the website and get a free Beta Key to start testing and providing feedback right now. Be the first to learn about release dates, news, contests, future DLC, and more.

2100710.name: Ambulance Chauffeur Simulator
2100710.about_the_game:
We know that you've heard the phrase that every second counts.

Ambulance Chauffeur Simulator is a simulation game where your mission is to be an ambulance driver. As a driver you will save lives together with the doctors, making sure that the ambulance always arrives on time.

You have a green light from the police, because you have to break any traffic rule to do your job well. The more lives saved, the cleaner your karma will be. Always be prepared because the call can come at any time!

Game Features :
- More than 10 levels
- 3 equipped Ambulance cars
- Daily Reward
- Missions are on a limited time
2100710.supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

2100720.name: Rat Cage
2100720.about_the_game:
Synopsis
In RatCage, you are a rat who wanders into a suspicious building on a freezing winter night. Hide from the suspicious figures that appear in the building, solve puzzles, and get through the snowstorm night safely.

Overview
The game is a simple side-scrolling 3D action game. You can move forward, backward, left and right, jump, and grab things.
This game was created with the theme of a weak animal wandering into a very suspicious building and getting into trouble.
The building has several areas with puzzles and action gimmicks. As you progress through the game, try to imagine what this building is.

Game features
・Let's capture various puzzles and action gimmicks. The player becomes a little clever mouse and spends a dangerous night.
・There is a scary figure in the building, but the mouse can't go back. Go deeper and deeper and feel the secrets of the building.

2100730.name: Tiles II - Multiplayer
2100730.about_the_game:
Tiles II is a minimalist battle royale where you play as a cube, alone against all or in team, where you must conquer as much territory as possible in a giant arena before your opponents!

The game has several game modes:

  • Normal mode
    Challenge your friends on the arena in a limited time, move freely in the arena and avoid other players from eating your territory.
  • Elimination mode
    Compete in a battle royale where players are eliminated as they run out of territories. Will you be up to it of not being eliminated?
  • Contamination mode
    Survivors, run away from infected players and tiles for as long as possible!
  • Power mode
    Fight in a game where all the moves are allowed with the many power-ups!
  • Arena offensive mode
    Challenge the opposing team by conquering as much territory as possible from each side and earn the most points to win!

The game features a customization system, where you can choose mutators to create the game you like, as well as a simple map editor of 128 tiles by 128.

2100760.name: House of Moiré
2100760.about_the_game:
House of Moiré presents a marriage of op-art and immersion. In this linear, non-game and atmospheric piece, the visitor advances through rooms of an otherworldly home, choosing where to pause, look and listen as the surrounding architecture and sound objects reveal themselves.

FEATURES

  • Transforming optical patterns
  • 6DOF
  • Audio-visual programming
  • Minimalist spatial design
  • Live processed field recordings

TREATING SPACE AS AN INSTRUMENT

House of Moiré is the culmination of various iterations of Moiré, a series of A/V works that explore fascinations with psycho-acoustics, sound spatialization, sensory illusion, and real-time virtual environments. Experimental and surreal, House of Moiré invites a temporary escape into an alternative space. It is made with custom audio software, depth cameras, motion capture, and interactive design principles.

ABOUT THE ARTISTS

Chloe Alexandra Thompson and Matthew Edwards (aka aesthetic.stalemate) are interdisciplinary artists and collaborators. Chloe is a composer and sound designer interested in the physicality of sound and mediation of technology in installation and performance, and Matthew blends installation art, performance and virtual reality.

PART OF MUTEK'S IMMERSIVE COLLECTION

An electronic music and digital arts festival for 23 years, now navigating the artistic possibilities of VR.

MUTEK acknowledges the support of the Canada Council for the Arts.

2100780.name: Spin Time
2100780.about_the_game:
Learn what it truly means to spin in this indie clicker game by Dumb Video Game Stuff. Spin Time is a short relaxed comedic experience where all you do is press a button. Your mission? To help the world's greatest spinner, Horst, in his quest to achieve maximum spin.
Features:
- 5 unique modes
- Voice lines from "Voice of Czath"
- Two live-action cutscenes

2100790.name: FunnyPizzaLand
2100790.about_the_game:
Welcome to the expressive art world of FunnyPizzaLand, a game that was designed to be a playable painting.

You are Pedro, the usually happy owner of a famous restaurant in PIZZALAND.
Business wasn't going well lately, so one day he made the one and only life-changing decision:
...to hunt down the evil GlobalMediaMonster.

Help Pedro on his trip and jump and run through an surreal 3D adventure like you have never seen it before. Meet freaky dudes, misterious creatures and hot ladies and visit places beginning from the darkness of the catacombs to the creepy castle on top of PIZZALAND's mountains.
Are you ready for the final showdown against the GlobalMediaMonster?!

FunnyPizzaLand is a RETRO experience and a real classic. It's a experimental game that was already developed back in 2001 for Windows XP.

. designed to be a playable painting
. Internet classic from 2001!
. surreal, hand crafted art world with dark atmosphere
. original low resolution RETRO visuals
. with possible Happy End ;)

2100810.name: cheesequest
2100810.about_the_game:
Welcome to cheesequest, a game where you have one objective, and one objective only - eat the cheese. But to eat the cheese, you first will need to earn it.



Do you understand?

Survival Card Gameplay


Inspired by games such as Inscryption or Slay the Spire, cheesequest pits the player against an unknown opponent in a series of card battles. The objective is to stockpile food by growing crops or raising livestock, while fending off your supplies from any hostile creature that may be lurking.

Fill your food gauge to win. Be careful - slip up, and you could easily starve.

Gain cards, augment them, and fuse new ones.

Survive. Thrive.

Features

  • Rogue-like deckbuilding
  • Card based battling
  • Creating new cards to aid in future runs
  • More than 8 modifiers that define how a card behaves in battle, with more on the way
  • More than 13 unique cards, with more on the way
  • Farming and sacrifice
  • A dark pixel-based aesthetic
  • Uncovering the mystery of the cheese

2100830.name: The Imaginary Circle
2100830.about_the_game:
The Imaginary Circle is a narrative driven experience, lasting about an hour and a half, about the weight of the law, guilt, making crucial decisions and startling pigeons in which you must find your way around an abandoned prison.
Your decisions matter, whether choosing which items to combine to force open a door or deciding if you should shoot your only bullet.

To reach the root of the mystery you will have to make use of your ingenuity by combining objects to open a way through the four faces of the cube that make up the building.



Enjoy the polished visuals and the carefully crafted animation work.



Combine elements to solve puzzles, decide which ones you should use now and which ones to keep for later, manage your inventory space.

Will You Shoot Your Only Bullet?

2100840.name: Neutrino
2100840.about_the_game:
Neutrino is a minimalist pong-like game with very simple mechanics.



You rotate the aim, click to launch and if you are fast enough to change your mind, reset back try it again!



                    13 levels, each with 10 different rooms - total to 130 puzzles!



Difficulty evolves and new types of challenges are introduced gradually as you evolve further in the game, and if you're good enough o win level 12, you get the final boss to face to and finally escape the black hole!

Controls


You can use Mouse, Keyboard in 2 ways and PS4 Dual Shock, as you wish.

Thank you for playing Neutrino!

2100880.name: Dark Age of Death
2100880.about_the_game: Dark Age of Death is a Singleplayer and NEW Co-OP Game that brings the medieval fantasy to life with stunning Graphics and "Open World" maps you can discover the worlds full with enemies. New adventures awaits you on these cursed lands. With bosses that are challanging to the player and with New Quests, Environments, Characters, Dialogue, Armor and Weapons. You can fight alone, with a small team or in armies for PvE and PvP battles. The players can explore the Ruins, Dungeons, Castles there are Empires that you can join and Raid other Kingdoms with your King, gain fame wealth and items or die in battle and ascend to Valhalla.

2100940.name: Redhot Rabbit
2100940.about_the_game:
Redhot Rabbit is a hand drawn, monochrome, 2D platformer with a rich visual style rooted in the silent movie era.
WASD, spacebar, and Enter keys control running, jumping, attacking from above, and throwing exploding projectiles. Time is a factor so for the highest possible score make your run a fast one. If you don't die much, a run might take about an hour and produce a decent score if it was a good one. Speed running the game will produce a decent score too due to the time bonus. The highest scores can only be achieved through the player's choice of a balance between the two. You'll have to choose what to speed run past and what to play through for points/health. You'll need health. Some bosses you might get past without a drawn out fight. Some you'll have no choice but to fully engage.
Soundtrack features some of the greatest foxtrot and dancehall jazz hits of the late teens and early 1920s. Composers and ensembles include Irving Berlin and the Original Dixieland Jazz Band.

DEV'S NOTE 9/24/22: We have one report that the game wouldn't play on the Steam Deck. We also have one report that it DOES play well on your Steam Deck. TreeofEmber says, "It runs and looks excellent on the Steam Deck. The controls need to be configured to work. I went with: A as jump, B as slam on the ground, R2 as shoot carrots, and right analog stick as left / right."

2100970.name: Curl!
2100970.about_the_game:
Curl! is a first-of-its-kind game, built from the ground up for accessibility including integrated control through brain-computer interface (BCI), switch-access or other input schemes in addition to traditional controllers.


CURLING IN SPACE!?!
It’s a wacky mishmash of strategical sporting action that up to 4 players can enjoy. Slide ahead of your foes with a foolproof strategy. Weave each stone carefully down the ice to land victory in your orbit. Astound the crowd with explodinating, zappifying, and mind-discombobulating uber-cool super-stones! What’s that? Curling doesn’t have explosions? Sure, your primitive Earth curling might not, but Curl! does!


STRANGE PLACES AND SILLY FACES
The galaxy is a huge and wonderfully weird place. A zany lineup of competitors face off on all manner of slick sheets from across the universe! Try to hit the button on the tongue of a gigantic, homely space worm, or speed through the cosmos on the front of a comet!


WANT MORE HUMANS?
Play locally or online with up to 4 players! Form the ultimate duo and take on the galaxy’s toughest competitors, or face off against each other in 1v1, 1v2, or 2v2 action!


INTEGRATED BRAIN-COMPUTER INTERFACE TRAINING AND CONTROLS!
Brain-computer interface (BCI) technology enables individuals to control a computer using their thoughts. Curl! is the first of its kind to enable full BCI integration directly within the game, including headset connection, calibration, training, and direct thought-to-action play. To support community and local play between all players, multiple BCI headsets can be used to control separate characters on the same local computer.


SWITCH ACCESSIBLE MENUS AND UI Menus and UI systems designed for use via switch-scanning selection, compatible with simple BCI alternative access.

BCI Specific Information:

BCI Headset Compatibility - Currently Curl! supports only headsets available through Emotiv. Additional headset support is planned in future updates. Players using a BCI headset should follow their device's specific installation instructions prior to use to use these features.

2100980.name: Barji Kart
2100980.about_the_game: Race head-to-head against up to 9 friends in BarjiKart! Choose from different Items to aid you in finishing 1st place! Race in an arcade-style old school karting game where only one player may remain victorious!

2101060.name: Aphotic Depths
2101060.about_the_game:
Aphotic Depths is a short first-person underwater horror experience focused on exploration, survival, and environmental storytelling.

You pilot a small submarine into an increasingly darker place, descending through a surreal underwater world that mirrors the player’s own mind. Each section of the descent introduces darker environments, and fragments of lore tied to memory, and fear.

Your goal is to explore each area, locate a hidden artifacts, and survive long enough to descend further. Oxygen management, limited visibility, and deadly creatures force you to carefully plan your movement while navigating the depths.

The story is told primarily through environmental details, visual symbolism, and collectible lore elements.

Key Features

  • Underwater exploration using a submarine

  • Multiple sections, each centered around recovering a single artifact

  • Survival mechanics including oxygen management and hostile creatures

  • Environmental horror with limited visibility and escalating tension

  • Storytelling through lore elements and surreal environments

2101070.name: Those Left Behind
2101070.about_the_game:
NOTE: Although this game is fully released, please think of it as an Early Access Game. Only buy this game if you are okay with rough edges and bugs. I'll keep working on making improvements. Expect significant changes to game-play and features

About the Gameplay:

Those Left Behind is an action-horror game set in a city and its surrounding area shortly after a mysterious, global event transforms most people into flesh-eating monsters.

Take control of survivors who must venture out of their safe house every night in search of supplies. As the world becomes more and more dangerous, race against the clock to find a truly safe place.

UNLOCK NEW LOCATIONS

The world has violently torn itself apart, and the blood is still wet. Make your way through dangerous and carnage-filled environments to unlock new locations.

LOOK FOR SUPPLIES... AND OTHER SURVIVORS

Scavenge outside not only for essential supplies such as food and water, but also for materials to build up your home. Find other survivors to join your community and improve your chance of survival.

FIGHT TO SURVIVE

Vicious monsters want to tear you apart from limb-to-limb. Fight back with an assortment of melee weapons and guns, including axes, machetes, shotguns and rifles. Upgrade your community’s combat and scavenging abilities with points earned from felling your foes.

Some Game Features to Note:

  • Survivors have (light) backstories revealed by their "Journal Entries"
  • Survivors have statuses (Injury, Fatigue, Hunger, Sickness)
  • Survivors have traits (e.g. speed)
  • Survivors can equip body armor, shoes, and weapons
  • A trading system
2101070.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

2101100.name: Kaardik
2101100.about_the_game:
Game

Ever wondered what it's like to play a monster-catching game set in the heart of Brazil? Kaardik has the answer! Immerse yourself in regions inspired by Brazil's rich flora and fauna, befriend the enchanting creatures called Kaardiks, assemble your dream team, and challenge other skilled trainers to epic battles. Don't miss this chance to embark on an unforgettable adventure towards the top!

For generations, humans and Kaardiks have peacefully coexisted in the breathtaking Kodumaa region. However, a lurking evil threatens to disrupt the harmony. As a dedicated trainer, you'll unite with others to confront this darkness head-on and protect the region from destruction.

Young adventurers from the Kaardik world set out on journeys to discover and befriend wild Kaardiks, hoping to make them part of their teams. Proving your prowess as a trainer always involves battles, and the quickest path to recognition lies in defeating the formidable leaders of each region. Only the bravest and strongest earn the right to challenge the mighty King.

A true epic battle with Kaardiks involves much more than simple encounters. Over time, humans learned to engrave enchantments on cards, which, when used with their partner Kaardiks, enable them to unleash diverse and powerful attacks against their opponents. Thus, the magnificent Kaards were born!

Embark on a thrilling journey through Kodumaa, a region inspired by Brazil's mesmerizing fauna and flora. Discover and befriend the captivating creatures known as Kaardiks, form a formidable team, and take on the challenges of defeating gym leaders while combating the spreading evil that threatens the entire world.

Engage in action-packed 2v2 battles featuring exciting new mechanics that make each encounter unique and fun. Combine attacks of different types to unleash powerful combos, utilize skillful Kaards to support your allies during battles, or apply cunning tactics with status-effect Kaards to outwit your opponents. The path to becoming a champion lies in experimenting with various Kaardik combinations and building your dream team!
2101100.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese

2101110.name: Touhou SouzinengiV -The Genius of Sappheiros-
2101110.about_the_game:
About This Game
Touhou Souzinengi V is a full-scale RPG that carries on the traditions of RPGs from the good old days.
It was made with the challenge of seeing just how interesting battles could be with standard, 5-character, turn-based combat,
and whether its character growth system would be fun while remaining simple.
It's an RPG where progress involves figuring out enemy weakness and patterns,
then picking the appropriate party members and skills for the situation, as opposed to just bruteforcing by grinding levels.
It's packed with plenty of content to challenge yourself with, too.
If you include collecting all the items and enemy skills, there's over a hundred hours of fun to be had.
Even just reaching the final boss provides you with dozens of hours,
ensuring that it won't let you down when it comes to its volume.

*Touhou Souzinengi V is a Touhou Project fangame.
Touhou Project is a copyright of Team Shanghai Alice.

2101130.name: From Madness with Love
2101130.about_the_game:
Note: You might experience problems with cloud saves when trying to carry over your save data from the demo. Please refer to the instructions in the FAQ section of the following post to learn how to recover your save data.




Welcome to "From Madness with Love", a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with!

2101190.name: ONI : Road to be the Mightiest Oni

＜About This Game＞

■Small-world design by a team of 5
The world of Kisejima Island was created by five artists at KENEI DESIGN over a span of two years. Their goal was to make players feel as if they had jumped into the pages of a childhood picture book!
Kisejima may not be large, but its dazzling green meadows, looming forests, and plains of floating megaliths offer a unique emotional impact unlike any other action game. Its creators have designed a mini-world in which each and every location is marked by its own memorable appeal.


■Mission-driven action
On Kisejima, a demon named Kuuta must hone his strength by undergoing a series of trials. By approaching the phantoms of demons past that are scattered across the island, Kuuta is transported to his next challenge. By completing the trials one after another, new stages are unlocked and Kuuta's strength grows.


■One-of-a-kind, unique action!
The protagonist, Kuuta, attacks the enemy using his club. His partner, Kazemaru, sucks the enemy's spirit out of its body, and by destroying that spirit, Kuuta can then claim victory. Enjoy an all-new, unique co-op experience by playing both Kuuta and Kazemaru at the same time!


■A different way to level up!
Kisejima, where the game takes place, is divided into three areas with a variety of challenges ranging from fighting enemies to escort missions. The player can also level up by running away from pursuing monsters, like a game of tag, and collecting mushrooms that grow in clusters to purchase upgraded clubs.


＜What is ONI : Road to be the Mightiest Oni?＞

■Setting: Kisejima Island
The story takes place on Kisejima, a small island in the middle of the ocean. Here, it is said that the power that lies dormant within the local demon spirits can be drawn out by challenging them to trials, where ancient demons who were once defeated by Momotaro are summoned to battle. However, few have ever returned from Kisejima alive.



■Characters: Kuuta, a demon warrior, and his spirit partner, Kazemaru
Kuuta, the protagonist, is the only survivor of the Demon King's army that faced Momotaro in battle. He and Kazemaru, a mysterious spirit that lives on Kisejima, team up to take on challenges of all shapes and sizes!


■Kanna
A mysterious, yet kind-hearted girl on Kisejima Island. She meets Kuuta, who has arrived on the island to challenge the trials, and the two strike up an unlikely friendship.


■Baby Boar
A wild boar who lives on Kisejima, carrying Kuuta on his back as he traverses the island he calls home.

In the searing light of the far future, one thousand years beyond the fall of Earth

The world ended. The sun itself is dying. Yet among the glowing embers and against all odds, life persists. Welcome to the Eddawielm: An accretion disk formed of the flames of a shattered Solar System, strewn with the tumbling fragments of dead planets, and littered with the defiant remnants of mankind; a new world... with all the old problems.

Pickled gherkins and dead men floating

In this collection of mystery, misadventure, romance and horror, workmen swoop along cables high above a teeming city, praying they don’t plummet to their doom, while below them, a young seamstress sees too much and finds herself threatened by the sordid side of city politics. In the shadows of the deeper streets, an ill-fated academic studies a mysterious artefact, a detective investigates a kidnapping, and farmers tending fields of vat-grown flesh contend with the arrival of bodies in their meaty crop.

Heroes, villains and ghosts

Far from the city and across the burning sea, in a place of great faith and spiritual enlightenment, an unlucky scoundrel discovers that his fate is sealed when he foolishly crosses a notorious gangster. Meanwhile, an archaeological expedition discovers an ancient tomb-ship, a drifting monument to the sleeping dead, set on its endless voyage centuries earlier. Therein the mortal footsteps echo, and something dreadful stirs...

2101650.name: Entanglement
2101650.about_the_game:
Entanglement is a contemplative, non-game, Virtual Reality artwork that aims to sweep the viewer through a 360° view of four different audiovisual sequences. Generative computer graphics and 3D binaural audio craft a radiant and relaxing ride as you sway in the middle of orbiting particles and sophisticated light-play.

WHAT IS ENTANGLEMENT?

When two or more non-interacting particles link up in a certain way, no matter how far apart they are in space, and their states remain linked. They now share a common, unified state. It is an uncanny phenomenon in quantum physics, one that defies explanations.
Einstein didn’t believe in it.



This piece blends scientific research and artistic performance. Adapted from a live audio-visual festival show, Entanglement oscillates between four theories: the fluidity of time, the multiverse, the Copenhagen interpretation and decoherence. These complex notions are translated into a visually and sonically stunning experience guided by science, technology, and sensitivity.

ABOUT THE ARTISTS

France Jobin is an audio and installation artist, composer and curator. Markus Heckmann is a visual artist and Technical Director at Derivative (TouchDesigner).

PART OF MUTEK'S IMMERSIVE COLLECTION

An electronic music and digital arts festival for 23 years, now navigating the artistic possibilities of VR.

MUTEK acknowledges the support of the Canada Council for the Arts.

Plan. Navigate. Conquer.

🛰️ Master the Controls – Use intuitive button mechanics to turn, maneuver, or even fire rockets to clear your way.
🌀 Bend Space & Time – Deploy teleporters to bypass obstacles and access unreachable areas.
💎 Collect & Conquer – Gather all the precious crystals to complete each level—whether by flying through them or blasting them apart!

Use buttons to navigate your spaceship

2101890.name: Zoonomaly
2101890.about_the_game:
Zoonomaly is a puzzle based horror game set in an open world zoo. This is a nonlinear game, so you may take any path to achieve completion.

Welcome to ZOONOMALY!


A zoo has been taken over by monsters and you have been tasked with entering this zoo, finding the cause of the monster infestation, and putting a stop to it. To accomplish this task, you must collect key shards that have been scattered throughout the zoo. To find the key shards, you must solve puzzles within the animal enclosures. Once all the shards are collected, you can assemble the master key to unlock the source of the monster anomalies.

EXPLORE THE ZOO:
You are free to explore the zoo grounds. Find puzzles and mazes, rogue monsters, and immerse yourself in this delightfully disturbing zoo.



STAY ALIVE:
You must attempt to stay alive while inside the zoo. Monster anomalies of all different shapes and sizes wander the grounds and they CAN NOT be killed. Avoid contact at all costs. When in doubt, RUN!



DEFEND YOURSELF:
You have been equipped with a Bloom O'Bang. This deterrent has the ability to stop any monster in pursuit. It also allows you to see the invisible monster aura spectrum around you. Use it wisely.



COLLECT TO WIN:
Only by collecting key shards scattered across the zoo will you be able to unlock the source of the monster anomalies. Key shards can be found inside the enclosures.



SOLVE PUZZLES:
In order to collect a key shard, you’ll need to solve a puzzle inside each enclosure. These puzzles are spread throughout the zoo and must be solved to obtain each key shard.

2101960.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
2101960.about_the_game:
Cronos: The New Dawn is a brutal third-person survival horror where you fight for the future by salvaging the past. Burn monsters before they merge. Extract souls from the living. Adapt or die.

Set in a grim world where Eastern European brutalism meets retro-futurist technology, Cronos: The New Dawn lets you experience a gripping story that straddles the line between past and future.

In the past, you will witness a world in the throes of The Change, a cataclysmic event that forever altered humanity. Meanwhile, in the ravaged wastelands of the future, every moment is a fight for survival against dangerous abominations that will test both your reflexes and your tactical thinking.

You are a Traveler working for the enigmatic Collective, tasked with scouring the wastelands of the future in search of time rifts that will transport you to 1980s-era Poland.

In a desolate world filled with ever-present danger, your survival hinges on your ability to strategize and plan ahead. The enemies you’ll encounter are nightmarish creatures, born from the remnants of humanity – defeating them will require you to make full use of your arsenal.

You can manipulate temporal Anomalies to clear a path through the desolate environment, and will have to scavenge for resources to replenish your limited ammo and supplies. Good preparation is key. Once in battle, split-second decisions can mean the difference between life
and death.

The creatures you kill won’t stay dead for long. Fallen enemies can be absorbed by others — through a grotesque process called Merging — to become faster, tougher, and far deadlier.

The only way to stop them? Burn their bodies. And do it fast.

If you don’t, you’ll face ever-evolving abominations that will push your combat skills to their limits.

Your mission is to locate key people from the past who perished in the ensuing apocalypse. Using your all-powerful Harvester, you can extract their Essences and have them accompany you into the future.

But be wary: these essences have a profound impact on your journey.

The more you carry, the more haunted your suit becomes — increasing your prowess on the battlefield but also bringing with them whispers in your ear and flickers into your vision, edging you ever closer to madness.

2102040.name: My Little Puppy
2102040.about_the_game:
Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi was once an abandoned dog. Judging by his docked tail, someone had once cared for him, but for some reason, he became unwanted. As an 8-year-old senior dog with various illnesses, it was hard for him to find a new family. Trapped in a cage at an animal shelter, each day passed gloomily for Bong-gu.

Then one day, a miracle happened. Bong-gu met a new family. The man who took Bong-gu had a somewhat scruffy appearance and seemed slightly awkward, but Bong-gu loved his scent. From that day on, Bong-gu lived out his remaining days just like any other dog would: playing tug-of-war, running around, eating, and sleeping. In the end, he crossed the rainbow bridge, having lived out a simple yet joyful life.

Sniff sniff… this scent… One day in dog heaven, Bong-gu wakes from his nap to a very familiar scent. Sniff sniff… it's dad!. Though faint, surely it is dad's scent he has been waiting for. Jubilant, Bong-gu escapes dog heaven and embarks on a journey to meet his dad - a journey that may hold unexpected dangers. Just as his dad once found him by some miracle, it is now Bong-gu’s turn to find his dad.

Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

 An adventure in a beautiful world filled with stories of dogs and people

Teetering on the border between life and death, a world outside of dog heaven feels both familiar and strange. Embark on an adventure through beautifully crafted landscapes including deserts, snowy mountains, and beaches. Experience diverse gameplay across adventure, action, racing genres. And remember, Bong-gu is a dog! Actions like sniffing, barking, running, and jumping come with limitations. To overcome his limitations and reunite with his dad, he must meet, give, and receive help from people and other dogs, each with unique stories to share. Unlike cats, there is only so much a dog can do alone!

 In the end, this is a story for all of us

At the end of his journey, Bong-gu finally reunites with his dad. The journey is filled with joy and excitement, but also moments of hardship and sadness. Yet, the ending has always been written: those destined to meet again will find their way back together. My Little Puppy may be a story about a dog, but it is also a story of relationships, farewells, and reunions that speaks to us all. For those waiting to see their once-in-a-lifetime friend or family member again, or those preparing for an inevitable parting that may come, we hope this story brings warm comfort. One day, we will meet again.

2102080.name: Spacetime Dimension
2102080.about_the_game:
Spacetime Dimension is a physics simulator based on NVIDIA engine in Unity3D, Players can build a chaotic system and observe its fantastic trajectory, observe the interaction and gravitational potential energy of planets, place an infinite number of dominoes and connect any number of space triangles.

You can explore an endless range of the world. The terrain is generated by waveform superposition without repetition. You can freely explore the ocean, islands, mountains, and even the solar system, set the direction and speed of the emitter, and place and launch objects.

Build with Joints or Springs and simulate the motion of single, double and multiple pendulums in accordance with Newtonian physics in the real world, or connect objects in arbitrary places such as triangles, triangular pyramids in 3D space, cubes, bridges, buildings, etc. Structures, even the strongest bridges and building solutions can be determined based on how much they bend under increased loads to facilitate construction and presentation in the real world at a true scale.

Soul Journey of Time and Space: You can travel freely in the universe and create your own planets, star systems, etc. You can also observe the gravitational potential energy of celestial bodies and how they bend the surrounding space.with God Mode, and you can simulate collisions between celestial bodies at will. Based on Newtonian mechanics, the motion of planets can be simulated in the infinite environment with gravity/without gravity, which is in line with science and physics, just drag and hold the planet, then gently toss it, and quietly watch the N-body evolution of stars, planets and moons.

You can throw objects, connect objects using springs and sticks and watch chaotic system's fantasy trails,You can build propulsion, clips, or mechanical instruments, or build 1m long, 1/4 or 1/16 long blocks in game, the camera uses a high display range, no matter how far the object is from us From afar, we can all see them.

Simulation capabilities of Spacetime Dimension

Geometry

Build triangular pyramids, cubes, and easily build any complex geometry.

Mechanical

Use springs and ropes to build mechanical instruments, catapult systems.

Astronomical

Simulate gravity, true planetary proportions, and celestial interactions. It also allows you to feel the vastness and magnificence of the universe, the basis for the formation of the solar system.

Domino

Use dominoes, ropes, balls, and blocks to combine to build a domino system of any size.

Chaos

Build double pendulums or arbitrary pendulums, drag celestial bodies to create N-body motion.

Physics

Control objects to observe the motion of pendulums, spheres, and blocks in gravitational and non-gravity environments.

Architecture

Build bridges, frames and perform dynamic simulations of physics.

What has been done so far

Sky Ball, Ground, Player,Pick Up & Throw, Gravity, Inventory, Launcher, endless terrain, ocean, planet impact, Planet, Sun, Halo, Dominoes, Billiards, Spring, light,teleport,Delete Function, Music, Springs with Multiple Stiffness Coefficients,Wooden Ball, Ramp, Block, Airplane Mode, Exit Menu, Exit the game, fixed perspective when opening the bar, mini-block, pick up optimization, pick up an item, 3d text, icon, spring connection, pendulum connection, scene construction, text and other functions.

Some features and improvements we would like to add

Archive function, more celestial bodies, terrain editing, multi-language, coloring function, Fixed Joint And Lope, Electric Charges and Molecules,Light conscious body, Missions and Goals, Location Markers, Thrusters, etc.

2102110.name: Speed the Card Game
2102110.about_the_game:
Speed a card game also known as Spit or Slam, is very fast-paced game and it could result in damage to the cards -- so play this and don't ruin your actual playing cards.

Speed is a game for two players of the shedding family of card games, in which each player tries to get rid of all of his cards. Speed is a game associated with the game Nertz.

Speed supports online multiplayer mode over the internet. Test your speed skills against other players.

Speed is a game for two players of the matching and shedding family of card games, like Spit or Slam, in which each player tries to get rid of all of his cards.

If you have ever played Spit,Slam, or Nerts before you will love Speed.

Controls: Drag the cards

Objective: To play all your cards first.

How to Play:

Each player is dealt five cards to form a hand, and each player is dealt 15 cards face down to form a draw pile. If you are playing with jokers, you use them as wild cards and give each draw pile 16 cards. A stack of five cards, placed face down on each side between the players, serves as a replacement pile. Finally, two cards are placed face down in the center between the replacement piles.

Play cards from your "Hand" to the "Play Pile" if the card is higher or lower by 1 number or value. A 3 can be played on a 2 or 4 and a Jack can be played on a Queen or 10. The Ace's value is 1.

You can block your opponent from playing if you place your card faster.

You can have upto 5 card in your hand at all times. Refill your hand from your "Draw Pile".

First player to play all of his/her cards wins!

2102130.name: Girl And Demon 1

And yet, she must press on, gathering scarce treasures along the way and engaging in turn-based combat that appears deceptively simple but conceals an intricate web of strategies that demand cunning and quick thinking.

2102180.name: Neurosis
2102180.about_the_game:
Join our Discord!


Neurosis is towards the beginning of the development process, therefore it is recommended that you join our Discord server to keep up to date with our current progress, as well as a roadmap and other features. Feel free to leave your input, and we will take everything into consideration during the development of Neurosis.

About This Game


Neurosis is a minimalistic, low-poly first-person philosophical horror game that plunges players into the nightmare world of a lonely child. Solve puzzles and traverse the dream world while revisiting and reliving experiences to overcome your fears. So, will you face your fears head on? Do you have what it takes to complete the puzzles and avoid the dangers within this surreal dream world, and make it out alive?

Gameplay

  • Low Poly Art-style: The simplistic nature of the low poly art-style used in Neurosis creates a terrifying liminal experience, in which your mind is free to fill in the gaps to produce an incredibly unsettling atmosphere.
  • Puzzles: Solve difficult puzzles in order to progress further into the dream world
  • Unique Mechanics: Neurosis keeps you on your feet by forcing you to pay attention to smaller details, such as the fact that you must occasionally crank your flashlight to maintain it's charge, but be careful, this alerts nearby entities.

All footage and artwork shown is from very early development of this game, and anything and everything is subject to change. While admittedly seeming somewhat empty as of now, the game isn't near complete. Before release, we hope to do a full overhaul of the environment, graphics, sounds, UI/interfaces, etc.

2102200.name: Let Chat Guess
2102200.about_the_game:
Welcome to Let Chat Guess, an exciting game where the ultimate challenge is to accurately predict the distance that a catapulted character will travel! Gather your Twitch chat, invite your friends, and let the guessing games begin!

But wait, this game isn't just for streamers – everyone can join in on the fun!

2102230.name: Call to Strike
2102230.about_the_game:
Sit in the cockpit of the first battalion commander of the Tactical Response Unit (T.R.U.), a newly established joint multi-service military task force. T.R.U. stands as a swift and decisive response force designed to neutralize threats efficiently.




Born in the wake of a devastating assault on the United Alliance homeland, T.R.U. is charged with executing a range of search and destroy missions to safeguard our nation's security.

As the commander, you must lead your team with precision and strategy to combat the dangers that threaten our borders.





  • Dynamic Gameplay: Take on daring missions to seek and destroy enemy units, rescue, refuel, and upgrade your arsenal to overcome the odds!
  • Engaging Campaign: Immerse yourself in a fast-paced storyline while mastering new aircraft.
  • Refreshed mechanics: Experience a beloved perspective revitalized with better graphics, more speed, and bigger explosive action.
  • Quick Combat Missions: Jump into fast-paced sorties perfect for players on the move or with limited time.
  • Adaptive Challenge: Enjoy balanced gameplay where enemies scale with your skill level, ensuring an enjoyable experience for both beginners and veterans.
  • Challenge yourself: Test your skills with VIP pickups, total annihilation of enemy forces, or race against the clock for speedrun glory.
  • Dynamic weather: Wind affect your chopper, flares, and boats. Fog and dust obscure visibility, while nighttime operations keep you stealthy, adding unique dynamics to your mission.

2102240.name: Ravage Road
2102240.about_the_game:
You control the direction of the road in this unique spin on the classic tower defense genre: choose where to place tiles, how to rotate them, and when to split your path and how to build out branches to maximize tower efficiency and create brutal death traps to decimate the incoming waves of would-be heroes!


Starting with a hand full of basic towers, it's up to you to use your gold wisely for placing new defensive towers, upgrading the quality of your cards, and buying new cards to gain better allies. From the most basic of goblins to the top-tier dragon towers, it's up to you to unlock, acquire and place your minions to keep your tower safe!


Why let your minion towers have all the fun? Unlock and equip four unique spells to slow and damage enemy units with raging blasts of fireballs, icy blizzards, and bolts of lightning, or give your allies a fire rate boost with the power of magical haste!


With four unique bosses spread out over a hundred waves of enemies, you're sure to come to hate the sound of their spawning music - but with grit and determination and a lot of furiously firing towers, you can bring them down and capture their crowns to turn in for upgrades at the skill tree!


Even if your tower is destroyed, between runs you can spend prizes won during the game to upgrade and unlock new features to make your next run stronger. Gain access to new towers, unlock new kinds of merchant spawns, and even upgrade the number of cards you draw each turn or the amount of gold you start with, and much more!


Make strategic decisions about when to spend money and when to hoard it, as well as the best ways to place towers and how to build to deal with varying enemy types. Do you build a few super powerful towers? Fill the map with more affordable ones? Design your road in a twisting snake, a winding spiral, or a series of branching forks? It's up to you to figure out the ultimate strategy!


With 100 waves to withstand, 20 kinds of enemies to destroy, 8 unique minions to discover and 35 useful skills to unlock, it's up to YOU to build the perfect road!

2102300.name: Eternal Mist
2102300.about_the_game:
You know the enemies. You don’t know the battle.

  • fast units overwhelm your backline

  • ranged threats punish bad positioning

You don’t execute a perfect strategy - you adapt or collapse.

Equipment is not just a stat boost - it defines your tactics.

2102320.name: MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons
2102320.about_the_game:
MISTROGUE is a real-time 3D rogue-like action game originally created as an homage to the “Mystery Dungeon” series. A new map is generated each time the protagonist steps into the dungeon, and players must fight through monster hordes using their chosen skill builds and use “Maze Stones” to pave their path.

Knowing how to build your skill sets and when to use items becomes even more important than your technique in action to beat the game. Utilize the “Skill Book” to find out which skill builds work the best for you.

Characteristics:


  • Explore the ever-changing “Living Dungeon”
    Every time the dungeon is entered a new map is generated, and the protagonist Mist’s level is reset to Lv.1. It’s entirely possible a monster house will suddenly make an appearance the moment you step in!
  • Build your own Skill Sets
    Weapons, shields and bracelets have skill slots that allow skills to be installed into them. With some help from your “Skill Book”, you can find over 80 combinations that can work in your favor. Finding which skills have the best synergy for you to fight difficult enemies is part of the fun.
  • A real-time action system that keeps you on your toes
    There are several tactics you can use. For example, counterattacking immediately after removing yourself from your enemies AOE. When in a pinch, use skills that deal area damage or skill scrolls that inflict negative status effects to your enemies. You can also buff yourself by using items.
  • Maze Stones will help you through gimmicks
    “Maze Stones” can create or remove footholds in the dungeon. It’s a unique system in the game that can help you make your way to treasure boxes in tricky areas, or even save you from difficult monster hordes.
  • Various content
    “Story mode” follows Mist’s journey in the main storyline, while the “Endless Hyperspace” is a challenging dungeon that has to be beat with no equipment or items found in your inventory. The hardest dungeon is “The Battle Road”, which is sure to put your Skill Sets to the test. Lastly, “Memory Treasure” is for the collector at heart, but it also adds more to the main storyline.

Characters




Mist (Protagonist)
The player’s alter ego, Mist is a young man who braves the Living Dungeons alone. He’s from Lootgar, where treasure hunters gather. Mist may seem aloof at first glance, but he’s got a burning determination within him to find his father that went missing when he was a child. After hearing about the Feril Ruins, he’s eager to uncover the secrets that lie within its dungeons. Lupo is his childhood friend.

Lupo (Supporting character)
A merchant from “Lootgar”. Having no fighting skills under her belt, Lupo runs her business by buying items from Mist and other explorers or treasure hunters willing to draw a contract with her. Her family has been in the business for generations, and it show in her money-minded ways. She wears a hood with rabbit ears, which is a symbol of prosperity, and you can catch a glimpse of her long hair from the hem of her clothes. (It’s not a tail.)

Other characters include Rex, who always has a tip on how to fight better, and Latte, who is your trusted warehouse manager. You also get to meet Lukia in the Endless Hyperspace. Whoever you meet, they are sure to add color to your adventures.

The Reaper Survivors – 2D roguelike combined with some RPG elements that takes place in the gothic world. As a reaper of death, you have to fight hordes of dark forces. The tools in the Reaper's arsenal will help you with this: an indispensable scythe and the ability to dominate the «unlife» of enemies. You have to find out if you are as strong in spirit as the legendary lord of death.

On the eve of Halloween, the line between the worlds of life and what awaits after death becomes thinner, which is certainly used by those whose eyes are disgusted by the light of the living. They try to break out of the dark kingdoms in their everlasting hunger for pure souls, threatening all living things. Although this became the normal course of things, it did not suit the one who watches over death. After all, as inscribed by the universe: the living must live, and the dead must remain dead. As long as the edge of the scythe is still as sharp as on the first day of light, the line will not be broken. The cycle of souls remains immutable.

2102400.name: Project Exo
2102400.about_the_game:
Project Exo is a Movement based puzzle, Platforming game. You will be soaring through levels using your rocket launcher and rocket boots to navigate each puzzle. I have gained great inspiration from my favorite games (Portal, TF2, Unreal tournament, Quake, CSGO) and mashed them all together to make something I love and I hope all of you will too.

2102410.name: POP SURVIVOR
2102410.about_the_game: This game is perfect for speedrun, as you have 60 seconds to complete each level. Your goal is to reach the destination of the level as the goal will unveil itself when all balls in the level are popped using cones with matching color. This game requires timing, patience, and critical thinking as you have to figure out a way to reach the destination in under 60 seconds, by efficiently popping balls. Avoid being hit by the obstacles and falling from the stage as you need to  move efficiently to continue to the next level. There are total of 100 levels and you may be expected to finish in 2-5 hours depending on how fast you adapt and if you can figure out the optimal way to move around the stage in order to clear in time. Sometimes, the goal won`t open up unless you drop the cone.

Online Coop

2102440.name: Super Cave Boy
2102440.about_the_game:
Can you make it to the end of the cave with limited actions in this puzzle platformer?

Embark on a thrilling journey into the depths of an underground dungeon in Super Cave Boy! Prepare to test your wits, agility, and problem-solving skills as you navigate through a series of meticulously crafted one-screen puzzle stages.

Use actions like hookshots, explosives, pickaxes and much more to reach the very end of the cave. The game focuses on gameplay and clever puzzles for a challenging experience.

Super Cave Boy focusses on 2d platforming mechanics but with a catch. You may only use a limited set of actions in every stage. For example one stage might only allow you to use 3 x Jumps and 2 x Pickaxe attacks and nothing else. Another might allow you to use 2 x climbing and 1 x picking objects. You will end up observing the stage and finding a way to use your tools in a creative way since they are very flexible.

Edge Hopping

Wall-over-hopping

Double Edge Jump

Embark on a thrilling journey through 75 stages of increasing difficulty. Each level presents new challenges, from intricate puzzles to intense platforming. Can you conquer them all and reach the end? Test your skills and determination in this ultimate adventure!

Each boss battle is a thrilling showdown, requiring you to use every skill you learned throughout the game to your advantage. From slimey kings to gazing eyes, every encounter demands your full attention and strategic prowess.

2102450.name: Enotria: The Last Song
2102450.about_the_game:
"Enotria: The Last Song" is a thrilling Soulsike set in a sun-lit land inspired by Italian folklore and filled with danger.

The world has been gripped by the Canovaccio - a twisted eternal play that keeps everything in an unnatural stasis. You, Maskless One, are the only one without a given role and master of your destiny. Defeat the fearsome Authors that created it and free the world from stagnation, by harnessing the power of Ardore.

Become the Mask of Change.

Summer Souls

Many Masks, One Face

Path of Innovators

Unparalleled Flexibility

30+ aspects to alter your main statistics dynamically

Choose strategically which Mask will face the dangers of Enotria and swap between up to three custom loadouts at any time. Each loadout allows you to try out a new playstyle, without the burden of a respec.

Alter Reality

3 different type of Rifts

Channel the power of Ardore to dynamically alter reality. Swap strategically between environmental states to solve puzzles, reveal secrets, traverse a decaying world and gain a strategic edge in battles.

Awaken your Potential

100+ weapons, 7 different weapon classes, 45 spells, 8 parry modifiers

♦ Strike foes to charge powerful magical Lines

♦ Strategically swap between up to three Loadouts at any time

2102480.name: Biz Builder Delux

2102770.name: EvoLife
2102770.about_the_game:
Genesis

At the start of the simulation cells with random DNA are spawned. 99% of DNA is not viable so most die pretty quickly.

  • Purple gas bubbles, inspired by hydrothermal vents

  • White dead cells, inspired by marine snow

  • Colorful alive cells, inspired by the diversity of unicellular organisms

  • Grey rocks, inspired by rocks, duh

First viable cell

After a while the first viable cells appear. There is a lot of gas everywhere which can be broken down for energy, so the first cells are pretty simple. An organelle to break down gas and a DNA instruction to multiply is all it takes to conquer the world.

Competition

As primitive cells fill the world, competition for gas bubbles increase. Some cells start to break down dead bodies for additional energy. Some grow flagella to fill spaces not accessible by passively riding the water flow.

Swimming upstream

The simulated physics can present barriers for life. Cells evolve to swim upstream, into the dense gas bubble flow, specializing with smaller body size and a stronger flagellum. Life always finds a way.

Stromatolites

First the world created physical barriers, now the cells are making them. Some cells release biomaterials that accumulate, much like real stromatolites. These materials can be broken down, but unlike gas bubbles or dead cells, doing so costs energy. As a result, they build up just like stromatolites in nature.

  • Biomaterials displayed as colorful circles with a square in the middle

Early multicellularity

In a strong current even multiple flagella may not be strong enough. These cells stick together after dividing, relying on each other for support. We are witnessing the birth of multicellularity!

🦠🦠🦠

Steam Workshop

Evolution takes a lot of time. I run the simulated worlds for weeks, waiting for evolution to happen. I implemented Steam Workshop support, so you don't have to! Some Workshop Items are not just a simple savefiles, but sequences of savefiles! Download the sequence and use the in-game "savefile list" feature, so you can step evolutionary time forward by weeks with one click!

Demo

I am just a solo dev, I could test the simulation on an RX 6750 XT, a GT 710 and an NVS 4200M. To remedy this issue I want to provide a free demo you can try out, to check if the game works on your machine.

Please make sure you have the newest drivers installed for your graphics card.

Demo limitations:

  • Only the smallest world size is available

  • No DNA editing

  • No Steam Workshop access

Lore

For this simulation my vision was to simulate a whole ecosystem of cells. There are many grid-like simulations, where artificial life exists in a grid. There are many game-like simulations where whole creatures are simulated. Sadly none of these fills the niche I am interested in.

I am specifically interested in the boundary of single celled and multicellular life. How did multicellular life come to be? How cells work together as an organism? How many ways can multicellularity evolve? There are only theories as the answer lies in the un-fossilized past.

To achieve this I simulate individual cells, and their individual organelles. I do not want to force multicellularity by having dedicated types of cells. Each cell can perform multiple things, can decide which organelles to grow. I want single celled life to be just as feasible and diverse as multicellular. I want the local environment to decide how the most successful life form should look like.

This simulator is my pet project, 10 years in the making! It is running entirely on the video card. You don't need a supercomputer, just a mid range card to simulate hundreds of thousands of cells. The world in the trailer is the result of running the simulation on my RX 6750 XT for a week. Hopefully the advancement of video cards makes even bigger worlds a possibility!

Our goal was to manage the scope and practice developing a game from start to finish without getting lost in the infinite pool of ideas. We set out to make a maze like game with our own twists and atmosphere.
Thank you for checking us out and if you're interested in leaving feedback or following development on this and other titles, be sure to check out our discord (found in the links on this Steam page)!


Gameplay
Players will find themselves trapped in a maze and their only way out is forward. Players must find the hidden objects throughout the maze, locate the exit and escape with their life all while avoiding the hidden enemies within. Being stalked and pursued their lives can quickly become forfeit and death is always around the corner.
We invite you to, Escape.


Key Features

Unpredictable AIs
  • Scattered around each map are various creatures of the night, once triggered there's no telling where they'll end up next
  • The enemy won't always pursue you on the path you run making every turn a potential wrong one

Replayability
  • The location of each pick up changes on every playthrough - creating a new experience each time

End screen stats
  • Compete against yourself to see how quickly you can escape each map with a timer appearing once you escape

Six uniquely crafted levels
  • Each map expands upon the other changing in size, tone, and unknown creatures of the night
  • Each map increases in difficulty as the size and layout become more complex

2102980.name: The Tale of Galariel
2102980.about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to play the villain? Ever wanted to conquer the land? Make allies ranging from Goblins, Kobolds, Dragonkin, and who knows what else. Then this is the game for you! Play as Thrusk, an orc who has lost his tribe and seeks revenge for what the human race has done to his people in this classic RPG/Dungeons-and-Dragons-styled conquest. Obtain a Keep of your own and upgrade it. Craft Potions, Weapons, and Armor to help yourself in combat. Find companions who are interested in your cause and see where they lead you. You can be a benevolent force or a malevolent crisis in this morality system, but it doesn't change the fact: You're a warlord now.




Combat: Enjoy classic turn-based combat, giving you time to strategize between each round and to help you learn from your opponent.

"Linear" World: Galariel is a Small Country in a larger world, with a linear storyline unlocking new areas and new allies to join you in your conquest.

Karma system: Choices in this world matter. Will you intimidate a shopkeeper to give you a discount, or will you persuade him? Both choices help decide if people believe you are a benevolent or malevolent person. Some people may give you special quests or help unlock classes if you are kind to the people around you, while other may find you weak. While if you choose to act like a foul Demon people may close their doors to you, hide within buildings, and close shops, as they fear you.

Loyalty System: Some companions may show loyalty to you by actions you take. Rob a church and your Cleric may think foul of you but a Barbarian may see this as a sign of strength. Run from battles a battle-hungry companion may see you as a coward, while if you fight everything in sight they gain trust in you.

2103000.name: Tropical
2103000.about_the_game:
Tropical is one of the very first virtual worlds created for the general public. This small exotic aquapark is a completely new experience. You don't need to worry about weather, food, temperature, animals - every single aspect of your holidays is simulated to be perfect!

You play as Dominica - one of the four lucky people, who has been chosen to test it!



  • Tropical is an adventure game – in order to progress the story, you need to complete quests. Sometimes they require playing a minigame or solving a puzzle.
  • Dialogs and choices – everything you say affects your relationship with the characters. Everything you do has consequences. Your actions also influence Dominica’s own mood. Take care – you don’t want her to be sad in such a paradise!
  • Explore the world – you have a whole virtual aquapark just for you. Waterslides! Swimming pools! Electric scooters! Exotic animals! Pizzeria! And so much more!
  • Interactive experience - you can interact with everything you see and talk with everyone! Same actions may lead to different outcomes depending on time, weather, nearby characters and many more factors!
  • There is more - you can unlock bonus content with coins that you get for achievements! Wallpapers, concept arts and most importantly – extra cutscenes, outside of the story!
Try the free demo version containing the first 90 minutes of the game!

2103020.name: Frightened
2103020.about_the_game:
FRIGHTENED is a cooperative horror and survival game that can be played with 1-4 players. Your goal is to destroy the evil with your team and leave. Collect items in the area with your team, find the demon's weak spot and destroy it! But don't you dare get caught.

You may want to play the game alone or you can play with your team of up to 4 people. You have to destroy the demon, so find the items that match the symbols in the pentagram and place them in the pentagram. He will be very angry about what you did, but there are two ways to calm him down, either by sacrificing someone or interacting with the objects around him, luckily you can calm him down or make him more angry. In order to save the victims, you need to find the medical bags around and help them. If you're lucky, you can destroy it without leaving anyone behind, but it won't be easy.

How can I stop the demon?

What do I need to do in order to beat it?
  • Find the Enchanted Paper.
  • Find the Ritual Water.
  • Find Creature's Skull.
After collecting the required items, go to the pentagram in the GYM and put the collected items in their spot, after 10 rituals the demon will perish but you need to be careful as it will get more angry after each ritual.

How can I stop the demon?

stopping it isn't hard but finding the correct moment and time can be hard. Use the mices around you to stop the demon when it's angry. go to the basement for mice's pentagram and burn the mices there, but don't forget, doing this ritual when the demon isn't angry will cause it to enrage but if you do it while it's angry it will cause it to calm down

CAN YOU DESTROY THE DEMON?

  • Increasing Difficulty
    The demon will get more angry after every ritual.
  • Replayability
    You can get together with your crew and find new mysteries and have new experiences with randomized items every game.
  • Multiplayer Feature
    You need to work as a team to win the game. Making correct decisions and stopping the demon is in your and your team's hands.

2103070.name: Avani
2103070.about_the_game:
Avani, our furry protagonist, finds an ancient sword in the forest. By accident, they broke its seal, freeing the vile being that it was imprisoning. Join them in this action-adventure game where you will explore this corrupted land, fight the evil that hides within and cleanse it from the spirit before it destroys the world.


  • Isometric-style art and enemy attacks. Three stages: Forest, Fire, Ice!
  • Featured digital art cinematics in-game
  • Enjoy the visually calm feeling of the forest, and then the contrast of the evil's power destruction.
  • Languages: English, Spanish, Basque, Catalan, Galego, German, and Simplified Chinese







Avani is a project developed by Kyuut Katz, a team of 2nd Year students at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao in a 9-month development cycle from the ground up using C++ to develop their engine and game.

2103090.name: Campus Life
2103090.about_the_game:
Create your own path

Some say college is the best time of your life. Is it true? In this game - yes! Even if you graduated long ago, it is never too late to relive the rush of academic life once again. Create your perfect student by choosing the finest set of qualities and skills. An extroverted party animal or a hard-working bookworm - it’s up to you to decide! Step into your character’s final year of college and experience everything a single academic year has to offer. Unpredictable encounters with quirky roommates, thrilling campus events, and long nights of studying before exams - all of this (and much more!) awaits you in this one unforgettable year.

Make Friends and Frenemies!

Networking is the key to successful college life. Being a lone wolf is difficult, so join a fraternity to meet people with similar goals and ambitions. Take part in mysterious initiations, help organize annual events, and make a contribution to a hundred-year-old tradition. If fraternities aren’t for you, just enjoy your ordinary life with other students. While looking to forge friendships, you may find something a little more spicy. After all, being in love isn’t forbidden on our campus…

Discover the holy grail of work – life balance

While trying to survive from day to day, don’t forget to study. Unfortunately, partying isn’t the solution to all your problems. Try to find time to review the material alone or with friends. Attending lectures will actually help you pass upcoming exams. Unbelievable, right?! However, all work and no play makes a student a dull boy. In all this craziness, you have to maintain a balance between draining hard work and a vivid social life. Various campus activities will surely help you with that!

Become a campus celebrity

We almost forgot about the last factor of a successful college life – reputation! Grades, connections, and even graduation don’t matter if your name is nonexistent. There is no point in doing your best if no one knows about you. The conclusion is simple – maintaining your reputation is crucial. Build up your fame by networking with influential students, completing goals and achievements, and accumulating good grades. It’s that simple! Do everything you can to graduate as the most famous student!

Take part in many activities available on campus:

  • Attend classes

  • Explore the various clubs

  • Support your fraternity

  • Throw parties

  • Meet with friends

  • Deepen relationships

  • Work part-time to pay tuition

  • Decorate and chill out in your dorm room

2103110.name: Neko Cafe
2103110.about_the_game:
Neko Café is in development so media on this store page may not reflect current state of game!! To keep up to date why not jump in our Discord, and hey don't forget to wishlist while you're here!

Join Flapjack and Kickflip on their journey to create the perfect Café! Design the menu and craft delicious sandwiches, and customise every detail of your space.
As your café thrives unlock new items, face fresh challenges, and expand your business!
Hire and manage a team, nurture their skills, and watch them reach their full purrtential!

Befriend the Coolest Kitties of New Neko City!

Keep an ear out for Rumors dropped by gossiping catstomers and you might learn how to attract some purrticularly cool cats, who are sure to help build your cafés reputation and maybe even unlock some new styles and decor!

And who knows what kind of mysteries and secrets you might uncover in a city filled with this much curiosity…

Create a café to attract that super ellusive eccentric cat! Create a café to suit the season! Create a café to suit your own purrsonal creative flair! From the floors and walls to the furniture and decor, everything can be customised!

And there is a lot to customise, with over 200 unique items to be discovered!

Café getting a little TOO popular? Thing’s getting too cosy and not enough tables to deal with the ever growing line of cats?

Maybe it’s time to hit up Claw Hammer Construction to upgrade the your kitchen and café floor space, unlock upgrades and features, and purchase new materials to decorate with!

Discover over 60 unique ingredients, and find the best combinations to maximise flavour AND profit, while creating your very own menus!

Master ingredients, and unlock their full potential!

Craft the perfect purrsonalised sandwiches to make friendships for life!

Hire your very own staff, and train them to greatness.. or your very specific need!

Want a chef that will make every last sandwich complete perfection, or that can smash out five plates in the same time? A waiter with the purrfect personality to rake in the tips, or light on their paws and can bus a table in seconds?

Want your front of house in ties and cooks in chefs hats and whites? Set uniforms, or style each cat uniquely!

But also be sure to also manage their needs and expectations! The best workers are happy energetic workers, push them too far and they will quit!

Don’t forget to pay your rent and bills or you might have to take out loans (boo!) to keep the landlord at bay!

Keep track of everything using calendars and graphs and stuff, its all very boring and fun!

Potentially go bankrupt due to being bad at capitalism (see next section)!

Tailor the game to what YOU want! Want the vanilla business management mixed with collecting and decoration? Awesome! Wanna turn off all the rent and bills and just collect stuff and make a cool space? We got you too!

Neko Café wants to be as open to expression and creativity as possible, and that means making our game as accessible for you as possible.

Overview

  • Discover and befriend the Catizens of New Neko City!

  • Unlock over 60 sandwich ingredients.

  • Find over 200 unique items.

  • Purrsonalise everything from the floors to uniforms!

  • Hire, train, and promote your staff to greatness.

  • Play dress ups and boop noses!

2103130.name: Matchmaking Inc.
2103130.about_the_game:
The protagonist, who constantly faces setbacks in life, arrives in the new city of “Queqiao Town” to take over her mother’s matchmaking agency, which is on the brink of bankruptcy. With the help of an unreliable uncle and a diverse group of staff, she attempts to reclaim the top spot in the matchmaking industry in Queqiao Town.

During this journey, the protagonist will encounter five distinct and diverse female leads, each bringing a unique emotional experience to the player. How she manages her relationships with them and tries to solve their problems will determine who she ends up marrying. The choices made will decide which path leads to the altar...Reacquaint yourself with Qiaoqiao Town, which you haven't visited in years. Sharpen your skills and discover any useful helpers or tools that could aid your matchmaking business. Don't forget to take breaks amid the busyness! Enjoy a variety of leisure activities such as fishing, DJing, reading, drinking, and working out.While developing relationships with the five female leads, players also need to manage the operations of their matchmaking agency. This involves meeting single men and women in town, persuading them to become members of the agency, and striving to fulfill their desires for a partner by making suitable matches.

A straightforward and quirky foreign girl who meets someone by chance in a work setting (CV: Abeihua)

Ye Qingyu: The landlord's only daughter, who bears the expectations of her elders—a seemingly aloof yet warm-hearted girl-next-door. (CV：ZhiMao)
Neeko: A “hardcore otaku” server from the bakery next door, a seasoned gaming enthusiast. (CV：XianTaWuTong)Gu Meng: Your childhood friend, with whom you can no longer openly acknowledge your feelings due to differences in family backgrounds as you grew up. (CV：YuXi)
Lin Xi: A doctor you meet through matchmaking, who is a “fearful-of-marriage” woman in her late thirties. (CV：RuoWu)

Customize your own "blind date resume". Show us yourself and tell about your appeal for love with up to 20 labels. Friendship or love may come right to you! Attention: please be cautious with possible SCAM.I used to be deeply moved by the emotions in many movies, TV dramas, and literary works, as if there was a shadow of myself in them. However, there are also many videos on the internet that say "once a day, prevent early love". I have personally experienced several blind dates in the secular sense and have gained some insights: life is only once, and marriage should also be carefully chosen. Therefore, if you can simulate the experience of dating, meeting parents, and getting married in the game, it can also be considered as indirect experience. With this original intention, I decided to turn this process into a game after finishing the production of "Chinese Parents" .
