2103140.name: Magicraft
2103140.about_the_game:
The legend! The one who pulls out the staff will be the brave one who saves the world!

Magicraft is a magic action roguelike game. The game takes the world invaded by ancient gods as the core, creating an aerial magical fantasy world. The player will be a brave man who strays into this world and pulls out the legendary staff, Crusades against monsters, combines unique spells, defeats the ancient gods, and saves the world invaded by the ancient gods!

Wonderful combination of magic world and action roguelike with dark spoof style!

“Magic: An Otherworldly Life from the Toilet?

Setting foot on an otherworldly continent where powerful magical creatures dwell, you'll progress from novice mage to master, traveling through dense forests, purgatory, or gaps in time and space, and across five chapters to battle the Demon Lord.

Evil and magical creatures will put obstacles in the way of your journey, so please save the increasingly corrupt world from the hands of the ancient gods!

Weave your own magic with hundreds of powerful spells!

The battle with the Demon King requires every effort to utilize your imagination and wisdom, you can reasonably combine a total of one hundred kinds of wonderful spells, colliding with unexpected amazing effects and gorgeous magic, summoner, elemental mage, melee mage? Even the producer can not think of your way through!

Rich roguelike elements, enjoyable combat experience!

100 unique attribute staffs, 80 kinds of powerful relics that can bring various kinds of benefits and change the appearance of the character, 9 initial character sets, and even blacksmith forges and stores to strengthen, each game is a randomized and exclusive new experience!

The deeper you go into the enemy's belly, the more you grow, and the more powerful spells you can use to bring fatal blows to the demons, making the battle full of infinite possibilities!

Interesting bonus levels, challenging mini-games to get props!

In addition to intense and exciting battles, the game also sets up a variety of interesting decryption levels, wizards can rely on their own power and wisdom, solve the puzzles in the map, access to new relics and spells!

Battle monsters by solving puzzles and gain the courage to be able to face monsters head on!

Now available!

2103160.name: 我是大官人

Original plot perfectly restore Tang Dynasty heyday elegant appearance, bid farewell to the boring brush monster upgrade, to a bureaucratic battle of intrigue!  All kinds of beautiful women wait for you here;  You can also buy VIPs to bring all the great names in history into your army!  Accelerate the pace of upgrading!

2103210.name: Shutter Labs
2103210.about_the_game:
"What if the companion cube was a dice with abilities on each face?"

... that's what Shutter Labs is.


Work your way through 25 intricately designed puzzles using your trusty Shutter Cube as leverage to reach higher platforms... But keep in mind that each throw, is a dice roll, potentially causing you to swap places with your cube or you know, spontaneously combust!

  • Solve 25 intricate puzzles designed to subvert your expectations
  • Unlock a variety of abilities that can be used at anytime to overcome challenges
  • Uncover a myriad of carefully placed Easter eggs
  • Dive deep into the game's development with the included dev commentary and "Making Of Video"


GMTK Game Jam
This game was originally developed in 48 hours for the GMTK Game Jam 2022 where the theme was "Roll of the Dice". Later on after the Jam deadline, we spent 48 more hours to polish the experience and release it here on Steam. The original Game Jam version is included in the game's folders.

2103230.name: MACROSS -Shooting Insight-
2103230.about_the_game:
Introducing an all-new Macross game, the latest entry in the landmark science fiction franchise!
Embark upon a galaxy-spanning mission to rescue the missing songstresses!

◆Pilots, songstresses, and characters from throughout Macross' history take center stage in a completely original story.
When multiple dimensional folds suddenly occur across space-time, pilots and songstresses alike find themselves inexplicably transported to the Battle 7!
From there, six stories unfold with the fate of the galaxy at stake.

◆Experience a Multi-Perspective Shooting Game featuring pilots and songstresses that have come together across time!
Sortie with pilots from different time periods and play through stages made up of multiple scenes, each with distinct game types that utilize different modes of each pilot's Valkyrie. Stages include multiple game styles, such as Horizontally Scrolling Shooting, Vertically Scrolling Shooting, and 360-degree Scrolling Shooting.

◆MACROSS -Shooting Insight- includes fan-favorite songs from all featured MACROSS series! Use the power of songs to gain an edge in battle!
Synchronize with songstresses while playing stages to activate a variety of buffs and debuffs, such as increased firepower, increased maneuverability, reduced enemy fire speed, etc.

2103240.name: Friction
2103240.about_the_game:
Discord:

The year is 2288, the human race has consumed all of it’s resources and now seeks to expand beyond their home star system. A technology was created which allows interstellar travel once outside the home stars gravitational pull.

Several factions are now in a face to move the unique terraformer off world beyond the inner planets and moons. The humans and the synth AI’s (A combination of human biology and AI machines), both battle to be the first to escape the now barren solar system in search of a new beginning…

However this conflict has not gone unnoticed, a sentient robotic entity empowered with keeping the local star systems in a state of peace has been awakened and is determined to make sureneither waring faction is able to succeed in their quest to spread their clan to the stars.

These events have a cause massive..
FRICTION

–

FRICTION is a fast-paced third person team shooter that adds another dimension of gameplay, the Z axis. Wage war in community favorite game modes such as PUSH where attackers must escort the payload deep into the enemies line before the timer is out, or classic hits such as team deathmatch or CTF.

Friction is an early access evolving game and we invite you to come help us shape it in to what it needs to be!

2103270.name: Pit Stoppers
2103270.about_the_game:
Take your friends and family or go solo, and prepare yourselves for lots of fun in this chaotic couch co-op game!

Pit Stoppers is a game for 1-4 players that shows the less glamorous, but way more chaotic side of racing. As soon as you learn how to change tires and replace broken and used parts, more vehicles come into the pit with even more problems to fix. Remember - every second counts! Any mishap may lead to further disasters, so make sure to coordinate yourselves and in the process become the best racing crew you can be.

THE COLOURFUL WORLD OF RACING

Pit Stoppers is placed in a land that consists only of race tracks. You as a crew drive your van along a seemingly never-ending road that passes all sorts of racing tracks. On the way you will see all kinds of races - with formula, motorcycles, rally and even endurance cars. You choose which race you want to visit, and then the fun begins!

The goal of the game is to unlock and win all races, but don't worry - once you finish a race with flying colours, you will be able to visit even more races, play with new types of characters and add more customization options. Old races will also come with new twists and challenge you even further. You and your friends will always find new stuff to unlock while spending hours on this fun party game.

LET'S FIX IT!

Right before the driver enters the pit, you and your crewmates receive info on which parts need some work. You will be able to change tires and other vehicle parts, refuel, cool down or heat up the engine, change brakes, or even change drivers themselves.

FAMILIAR PLACES

Inspired by real world racing events and tracks, but with a much sillier tone, this game will entertain both racing fans and those who just want to play something chaotic and fun with their family and friends. In the game you can go to ten different locations scattered around the world, each with its own specific obstacles and challenges. Fight against the flood in the rainy North, jump over fancy yachts in the south and find ways to bring your drivers to sleep during lengthy whole-day races.

EASY TOOLS, LOTS OF FUN
As the controls for each player are always visible and simple (players can either pick up, throw or use tools), anyone can join in on the fun. However, to achieve the biggest award in every location, players must sharpen their communication and coordination skills to control the pit stop chaos as quickly as possible.

2103290.name: Anvil Life
2103290.about_the_game:
In this game that offers unlimited fun in Singleplayer, Sandbox game type; You will be able to upgrade your items, expand your military, win loot with quests, and try many combinations to bring the characters to the state you want.

Add new soldiers to your military, start with simple items from the market and do quests. You will improve gradually and you will gain different items. By upgrading these items, you will dress your soldiers and try to catch the best form.

Each Quest will challenge you in different ways. Therefore, strategically choose the items to dress your soldier. When you drop the rarest of hundreds of items, bring it to the highest upgrade rate. Equip your soldiers with the perfect combination.

Manage your economy well, making money will not be easy. Manage your inventory well to bring your items to their best form.

You will make a totem while you are upgrading items everywhere. A lot of items will be wasted in order to reach his highest form. You will constantly learn in the game by trying to upgrade with better strategies.

2103300.name: Molytropia: Dead Stars Still Shine Here
2103300.about_the_game:
Molytropia: Dead Stars Still Shine Here tells the story of events that took place on a winter evening in a small town. A young man meets an unusual girl on the train ride home. As they start talking, they decide to go stargazing together.

Molytropia: Like In That Movie, But Completely Different is fully available in the demo version. The story is told from the perspective of a young man who accidentally meets a paralyzed girl at a video rental store. Over time, their acquaintance grows into a friendship filled with lighthearted and amusing moments, as well as melancholic and bittersweet conversations.

Gameplay:

Similar to most visual novels. You read, click the mouse or press a key, then read again. And so on in a loop.

FINIS is a puzzle game that explores 21 different universes. Each universe offers a different experience, terror, calm, destruction, war, progress... You can choose between 8 completely different paths and each path will take you to a unique ending.

- 8 different paths.
- Hundreds of results..

Once the game is finished, you can play again to discover the other paths and experiences, all of them so different that they will surprise you.

You decide which way to go, do you prefer progress or decline? Utopia or war? Discover that beauty can be anywhere, explore the limits of civilization, how far human beings can progress and how far they can go to destroy themselves.

2103620.name: Age of Gladiators Reforged
2103620.about_the_game:
Age of Gladiators Reforged

is a REMASTER of the original Age of Gladiators released in 2016.

A Potential Scenario

You’re almost out of money. Two more days and you will no longer be able to pay your staff or gladiators. The fight scheduled today will draw exceptionally massive crowds, meaning the fight purse will be bountiful and the opportunity to place a large volume of bets will be high. One problem though: your top fighter is fatigued from his last fight and has a nagging shoulder strain. Plus he has a history of concussions, so it’s fair to say he will not be at full strength if you put him in the arena. But he’s the best you’ve got. The rest of your gladiators are rookies yet; still working with your trainers and far too inexperienced to send into the crucible just yet.

The next fight is a week away and poorly hyped. You cannot wait that long.

If you were of an evil disposition, you could execute your top fighter instead and seize his life savings; with the fight purses you have shared with him through his career, he has amassed a lot of gold. It could keep you going for a month or two - maybe more. Something to consider.

Or if you find that distasteful, you could go to the money lenders instead. But their interest rates have been high these last few days: 30% or more. You could finance present operations with that – but you would suffer in the longer term.

So maybe you should send your top fighter into the arena. He is bruised up and fatigued – but he also is ranked 3rd overall by the so-called experts and pundits of Leptis Magnus, the current city you reside in. You know he is one of the best and might still have a good chance at pulling out a win.

Or he could lose his life.

What do you do?

What Is It?

Age of Gladiators Reforged is a single-player strategy/business management sim set at the height of the bloody gladiatorial games in ancient Rome.

Hire scouts to scour the provinces for potential prospects – once you have recruited your gladiators, you will need to manage their morale and personality while equipping them for battle in the arenas. Recruit support staff, upgrade your stables, partake in side missions, and manage the wealth and reputation of your business as it grows each day.

As your fighters win battles and increase in level, it will be up to you to decide how to focus their abilities by spending attribute and expertise points. Compete, trade, and interact with other in-game bosses as you work your way up from the starting provinces in Africa to the grand coliseum of Rome herself!

Features:

  • Gladiators are born with their own dynamically generated attributes (strength, agility, stamina, dexterity, reflexes, intelligence, and health), weapon specialties, and personalities. It is up to you to hire scouts to locate the best prospects available for recruitment.

  • Manage your stable of gladiators carefully – their morale, greed, injuries, fatigue, and more must be taken into account before sending them to battle.

  • The physicality of your gladiators will increase or decrease with age, depending on if they are in their prime or declining.

  • Fame system: as your gladiators gain glory from battle, they will become more widely recognized and adored by the crowds. Win enough battles and they may even get voted into the gladiatorial hall of fame after they retire (or die).

  • Watch as your fighters climb the all-time records list for wins, kills, and fame - all held by retired and still-active legends in the arena.

  • As your gladiators level up, they gain points to spend on their attributes and expertise. Expertise allows you to build and customize your fighter according to their appropriate strengths.

  • Purchase, sell, or trade fighters with opposing bosses.

  • Rob treasuries, kidnap enemy fighters, assassinate your debt holders and more with the quest system. Increase the odds of success by sending gladiators on the mission as well.

  • Search for deals on weapons, armor, and money loans on the marketplace.

  • Hire staff such as scouts, doctors, trainers and blacksmiths to help your gladiators achieve victory. Your staff will gain experience each day they are employed.

  • Upgrade your stable by improving its food, bedding, shelter, and more.

  • Strive to become the wealthiest individual in the entire Roman republic. There are quick and underhanded ways to make money, but your reputation and fighter’s morale may suffer as a result.

  • Receive taunting letters from opposing bosses as well as various other messages from your fighters, staff members, and different characters as you progress through the game.

  • Rename your gladiators in order to increase your attachment toward them.

  • Bet for or against your gladiator based on the odds generated by bookmakers in-game.

  • Fight purses and betting is based on the hype associated with each match. The greater the hype, the more lucrative the fight purse and betting market will be - but the opposition will also be tougher.

  • Each game is dynamically generated and different each time.

Other

Age of Gladiators Reforged is a twist on sports front office games like Out Of The Park Baseball or the Football Manager series. To continue the analogy, it was designed for people more interested in the strategy behind building up teams and players as a general manager rather than running the games tactically as coach. As well, the strategy element should appeal to fans of Paradox and other franchises in that genre.

2103630.name: 77 Oleander Avenue
2103630.about_the_game:
On July 21st, 2022, a single investigator entered the abandoned home at 77 Oleander Avenue. Two hours afters after her arrival, she lost contact with the outside world. These are the events of that night. These are the remains of a ghost story, told for the sake of a Ghost.

Waking up disoriented and weary, Tabby (Short for Tabitha, but she's not gone by her full name since 3rd grade) wakes up in the parlor of an abandoned house. Her keys, wallet, and phone are missing and she can't remember why she's in such a place... not that it's too far gone from some of the other places she's woken up in over the years.

It doesn't take long for her to meet Evie, a ghost, and this greatly irritates Tabby on account of she was hoping to just grab her things and leave quickly. The Larkspur house on 77 Oleander, however, is not Evie's home. It is not the site of a bittersweet tragedy. It is not the skeleton left behind by a family's unexpected death. Tabby will realize this too late, and then, when she's finally ready to heed Evie's warnings, she will forget.

About the Game

77 Oleander Avenue Ghost House Investigation is a narrative driven Horror Mystery game that follows Tabby, a paranormal investigator who wakes up in an abandoned house with no memory of where she is or why she's there. Through the course of the game you'll learn more about the family that once occupied the home, the mysterious circumstances surrounding their deaths, and ultimately decide what you believe about the haunting of 77 Oleander. Set in a small coastal city in southeastern North Carolina, the game explores deep-seated religious trauma, the nature of ghosts and demons, the way we create narratives of a person's Death, and contemplates the prospect of flirting with a supernatural orb.

Instructions and Controls


77 Oleander is a Visual Novel in which you'll need to explore the rooms and levels of an abandoned house in order to find your cell phone, wallet, and the keys to your truck so that you can get out as soon as possible. It won't be that simple, but let's start there for now. You begin by choosing one of three parts of the house to search, and once you've searched all three areas you'll need to declare your theories and beliefs about the history and the hauntings of 77 Oleander Avenue. Your beliefs, your conclusions, and your view of the family that once lived here will determine the ending you reach.

L3/R3: Opens the Accessibility Menu

Key Features


  • The full game contains 9 endings, multiple routes and at least six ways to die;
  • a complex and insidious mystery, something horrible that may be watching you at all times, dozens of opportunities to flirt with a ghost, and more!
  • Multiple routes, 9 endings, and dozens of very unsafe haunted rooms to explore;
  • A unique system for selecting your final route: Your beliefs and theories about 77 Oleander will determine the ending you reach.

  • And More!

2103680.name: Mediterranea Inferno
2103680.about_the_game:
A treacherous visual novel about friendship, desire, and grief.



What’s better than a sensual summer retreat in the South of Italy? Join Claudio, Andrea, and Mida in their travels as they try to recover from the collective trauma of the 2020 pandemic.



Three young men in their early 20s reconnect after two years of forced isolation, hoping to rekindle their friendship; an exceptional bond that made the trio truly special! A mythological force well beyond the sum of its parts! Or so they think…



As you pick their activities for the day, you’ll discover their darkest fears, their obsessions, and, as the reality of their failed expectations become apparent, their thirst for revenge and retribution.



A lazy afternoon by the pool, a lustful night at the club, or even a morbid visit to the local cemetery: you’ll decide how to spend this summer vacation, but wherever you go, something or someone will be waiting, offering an additional, forbidden trip through the arcane inner spaces of conscience.




Eat the Fruit of Mirages and fight for your endless summer!

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Pick daily activities for the trio and see how they affect the story.
  • A new treacherous drama from the creator of Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.
  • A generational story that is as touching as it is disturbing.
  • With music, writing, and art from the game’s author, including hundreds and hundreds of original illustrations.

A playthrough lasts 3 to 4 hours, reaching one of many possible endings and showing roughly 60% of the game’s content.

2103940.name: Skate Rift
2103940.about_the_game:
YOU CAN PLAY WITH A KEYBOARD, BUT THE GAME IS BEST WITH A CONTROLLER!




This is a minimal skateboarding game with some unconventional features. Skaterift worlds have rifts in them which let you travel across them quickly and form endless loops to set lap times in.



Skaterift is centered around some subtle but finely tuned physics based movement. Pump naturally to gain speed, and maintain control over the wheels friction to keep it. It may take you some time to master these two things but once you do it'll let you flow smoothly throughout the courses and give you loads of airtime. We push things quite big here so you will learn to be comfortable going 100+km/h!

It's designed to be a laid back immersive experience, which is why it is in first person and there is no major HUD; your records will show up in analog form in various places, and if you're good enough, other peoples games too. Competing isn't for everyone though, so you are also free to just roam around explore.. do tricks and grinds where you want to, or master the flow of courses with friends by connecting to the global server.

2103950.name: Kritter: Defend Together
2103950.about_the_game:
Kritter: Defend Together blends tower defense, party game, and roguelite elements. Solo or with up to 4 players, your goal is to protect M. Ark, the coolest spaceship in the universe.

YOUR ROLE

  • Defend M. Ark at all costs against waves of hostile enemies

  • Explore the surroundings, gather resources, strengthen your base, and grow stronger

  • Die. Yes, sorry, it’s part of the deal. But everything you’ve gained will carry over to your next run

Between waves, take advantage of the downtime to gather valuable resources.

  • Find power-ups to craft a devastating build for your Kritter

  • Collect building materials to upgrade your defenses

  • Encounter random events across 3 different procedurally generated levels

According to the Manual, we're going to need resources to craft ramparts, turrets, and traps to facilitate our survival. It also advises staying alert, as certain events might occur during exploration: arena fights, bases containing upgrade chests, patrols offering gold and resources... Well, this Manual knows a lot of things!

Waves of enemies will crash onto M. Ark at regular intervals. Your job is to take them down!

  • Anticipate incoming enemies and make it back to M. Ark in time

  • Fight using one of 4 classes (Defender, Tracker, Engineer, and Ninja)

  • Build defenses (walls, traps, turrets…)

  • The better your defense, the higher your rank—and the better your rewards

During a run, your choices are key to gaining as much power as possible.

  • After each successful wave, choose between 3 rewards: more damage? Repair M. Ark? A small health potion? Your call

  • Upgrade your base buildings to boost your economy and gain more exploration time

  • All run-based upgrades are temporary and disappear at the end of the run… all except Soul Crystals!

No worries, it happens to the best of us. M. Ark will simply trigger a temporal rewind.

  • All your upgrades will be lost except your Soul Crystals

  • Use them to unlock permanent upgrades: a radar, a merchant, a second wall row… and much more

  • Each run helps you improve your talent tree and come back stronger

  • Unlock all items in the game for even more synergies and combos

  • Hardcore mode unlocks after beating normal mode

  • An endless mode with a leaderboard to see who can reach the highest wave in the world

A speedrun mode to find out who’s the fastest

The Kritters will also have the possibility to change model among:

  • The Defender: Melee specialist, more robust. Make pretty windmills with your sword and turn your enemies into salami.

  • The Engineer: Fancy a little extraterrestrial barbecue? With their flamethrower and turret, they are perfect for area damage and covering multiple fronts.

  • The Tracker: The long-range Kritter, specialized in explosives and precision shots! A small mine here, a missile there, and bam, done.

  • The Ninja: Swift and sharp, he doesn’t hold back. Faster than his peers, he dashes through enemies to lacerate them and rains down kunais from a distance. Simple, clean, and lethal.

  • And more to come...

The Manual stops there. It doesn't seem to indicate any other steps... Nevertheless, it offers us "its most sincere condolences" and "will report the loss of you and the Kritters to your families." Nice of it!

Ready, Kritters? TO YOUR POSITIONS!

2104010.name: Elowen's Light
2104010.about_the_game:
A heartwarming story in a world full of discovery


Join Elowen in her journey to restore her companion, and help quirky characters and delicate creatures along the way in this relaxing and accessible game set in a procedurally generated world with beautiful pixel art and calming soundtrack coordinated with the day/night cycle.

Story


The main story has about 1 hour of content, where you help your loved one regain the physical form after an injury. You will need to collect magical power from the environment by collecting glowing orbs and avoiding the critters. As the story progresses, your house expands increasing the opportunities you have to help the creatures in the world. After completing the main story, you gain access to the greenhouse and may collect plant specimens. You will be free to continue exploring the rarer areas, upgrading your abilities, and collecting plants.

Critters


5 critters will gladly donate some magical essence to your cause, as long as you don't disturb them. Avoiding touching the critters brings a challenge to the game, and reinforces oneness with the environment.

Upgrades

Along the way you will meet some curious characters in need of your help. If you choose to, they will assist you in return with increased mobility and magic harvesting. This will help your main story to progress

Mossy: Caretaker of Seedlings

The Mushroom King: Lord of Jumping

The Great Flutterer: Master of Gliding




Additional Key Features:
  • Day night cycle bringing unique creature behaviors
  • Beautiful soundtrack coordinated with the time of day
  • Pixel-painted scenery
  • Cute critters
  • Full controller support
  • Simple control scheme
  • Low difficulty, high skill cap
  • Procedurally generated endless platforms
  • The world scales to your skill
  • Auto saves

Among other things, we at Sweet And Power Sauce strived to create the world's most relaxing ASM-like platformer. Nothing in this game's world is cruel, and you are welcome to learn and explore the world we created for you at your own pace. I hope you enjoy it.

-Doug
Lead Designer

A long and immersive adult visual novel about an ambitious young woman willing to do whatever it takes to land a job in a prestigious office building and become the boss’s favorite.

Things take an unexpected turn when she meets Pamela, the boss’s assistant, who offers a few tips before the interview and then casually unbuttons her shirt, leaving her outfit noticeably more revealing.

Inside the executive office, Mr. Forte is impressed by her resume, but it quickly becomes clear that the position he’s offering may require more than what’s written in the job description.

Follow her journey and discover how each character becomes part of her decisions… and her desires.

2104120.name: Tales of Vaalundr
2104120.about_the_game:
Long ago, evil sorcerers covered the land of Vaalundr in darkness, so that the vampiric clans can reign supreme. However, prophecy tells of one who can reverse the darkness, and defeat the evil overlords once and for all. Could this be you? Trek through the land of Vaalundr as either the fighter, ranger, rogue, sorcerer, mage, druid, or necromancer, each with their own unique weapons and abilities! Collect treasure, defeat enemies, and discover a whole new world inspired from Norse mythology!

7 classes to choose from

  • Fighter
    As a fighter, you are a warrior of Vaalundr, focusing on strength and toughness to overcome your foes. Your main weapon is your sword, and you can throw axes to hit enemies at a distance! As the fighter levels up, his strength and toughness will increase, allowing him to take foes down more quickly, and withstand more damage.

  • Ranger
    The ranger is a woodsman, and a hunter. He has explored the lands of Vaalundr extensively in his travels, and knows them well. As a ranger, you fight with a sword, and can shoot enemies at a distance with your bow. The ranger's toughness and dexterity will increase as he gains levels, giving him more health, and increasing the damage he does with his bow.

  • Rogue
    A master of stealth and guile, the rogue is a master of sneak attacks, and his dexterity allows him to deliver swift blows to vital areas. He has a 25% chance to sneak attack on every strike, for an extra 4d6 damage! He uses throwing knives as his ranged weapon. As the rogue gains levels, his dexterity and intelligence will increase, allowing him to do more damage with his throwing knives, and increasing the deadliness of his strikes!

  • Sorcerer
    Sorcerers of Vaalundr tend to be rather peculiar. Tapping into source energies, they sometimes develop strange powers, such as weather manipulation, healing abilities, seeing into the aether, etc... As a sorcerer, you have the ability to summon a shadow sword from the aether realm, and to call down lightning from the sky, to help you vanquish your foes. As the sorcerer levels up, he gains wisdom and influence, increasing his magical capacity, and the ferocity of his storms.

  • Wizard
    A classic spellcaster, the wizard focuses on shaping arcane energies to blast his foes to smithereens! He uses a wooden quarterstaff as his main weapon, and can shoot magic missiles from his fingertips! As the wizard gains levels, his wisdom and intelligence increase, giving him more magicka, and making his spells more powerful!

  • Druid
    The druid is an ally of the natural world, and a practitioner of green magic. The druids primary power is the ability to heal. Using a spear to keep his foes at a distance, the druid can also heal himself if injured. As the druid grows in his powers, his wisdom and personal magnetism grow more potent, allowing him to heal faster, and more often.

  • Necromancer
    The necromancer is a master of death, and a commander of darkness. His primary weapon is Axe of the Dark Moon, and he can summon ethereal hell hounds from the abyss to devour his enemies. As the necromancer grows in his formidable powers, he gains wisdom and charisma, giving him a greater command over the forces of darkness.
Choose your path, and battle your way through a series of five chapters, to save the land of Vaalundr from the doom of darkness!

  • Deckbuilding: Keep your deck in tip-top-shape through buying, selling, and building a big deck that even the most challenging Clients can't resist.
  • Managment: Take care of your needs, exercise, upgrade your apartment, and upgrade your stats to preform better in the sheets.

2104310.name: Public Land Hunter
2104310.about_the_game:
Public Land Hunter is a retro hunting simulator that let's you hunt on procedurally generated maps and grow your hunting camp with additional hunters, weapons, animals and perks.

Procedurally Generated Maps
Each map in Public Land Hunter is procedurally generated. You'll find yourself hunting dense fall foliage, breezy summer clearings and sparse winter fields. This provides you with a unique scouting experience for each hunt, requiring analysis of the satellite map and looking for sign on the ground before setting up your ambush.

A True Deer Hunting Experience
With the procedural maps and the realistic deer AI, hunting requires strategy and an understanding of deer patterns, all of which are explained in the games tutorial.



Animal Variety
Hunt rabbits, grouse, ducks, pigs and deer, with the potential for more animals in the future. Each animal has its own patterns and AI. Rabbits roam the fields, grouse need to be driven from the tall grass, ducks are called in, pigs roam the woods at night and deer follow realistic patterns between bedding, water and food in the early and late hours.

Speed Up Time
Public Land Hunter features the ability to fast forward time in order to keep your hunts fast and exciting. While sitting in a treestand or a hunting blind can be relaxing when in the wild, no one wants to sit for hours waiting for a deer when playing a video game. The fast forward mechanic allows you to get right to the action once you're set up for an ambush.

Build Your Hunt Camp
Grow your hunt camp with additional hunters who specialize in different animals and weapons. Complete their tasks to unlock perks and additional hunts.



Arcade Mode
Public Land Hunter also features an arcade mode, where players can experience a truly retro experience and go after high scores that will provides even more unlocks.

2104400.name: Salvus: Aries

Waking up after a long stay in purgatory (that she remembers nothing about), she learns that the rest of her sentence is to serve as a Reaper until the powers above have decided she's paid back her sins.

Through her journey after death as a Reaper, she'll seek out the empty gaps in her memory and reconcile her past with her present. Everyone has something to hide, and unfortunately for them, she's the type to seek out answers. But the biggest challenge for the crew will be to save her from herself.

Or they might all just get a one way ticket to Hell. At best.

Features:

  • A story set not only in a modern fantasy world, but will include also beautiful historical settings too.

  • Beautiful artwork, displayed in the sprites, CGs, and backgrounds.

2104430.name: Super Galaxy Games
2104430.about_the_game:
Super Galaxy Games is an online multiplayer platformer that combines the feel of classic 3D platformers with modern visuals and limitless, community-driven content.

Classic Feel, Modern Control

The gameplay is designed to be instantly familiar and fun. With tight, responsive controls that are easy to pick up, you'll be running, crouching, sliding, twirling, and wall-jumping through levels in no time. While the basics are simple, the move set has enough depth to allow for true skill expression and high-level competition in game modes like Race & Survival.

Build. Share. Play.

The heart of the game is its robust in-game editor. We've broken down classic platforming obstacles into their most basic, dynamic components, giving you a powerful toolbox to build with.

2104820.name: Loot, Luck & Levels
2104820.about_the_game:
Luck, Loot & Levels provides a unique co-op multiplayer experience like no other! Are you a fan of dungeon delving, character building, roguelikes, items, and experience? Do you enjoy popular MOBAs with their fun stat and combat systems but long for a cooperative and friendly PvE alternative? Then LL&L might be for you!

Like many rogue-likes, LL&L is run-based, which means certain progress is retained on a session-to-session basis. Upon death, players lose their items and the generated world is lost. However, LL&L's core design revolves around building your character throughout runs. Players retain their character's attributes, skills, crafting knowledge, and ability enhancements. Not a second of gameplay is wasted, as all of your efforts will build to result in a game-breakingly overpowered character to wow your friends and explore deeper into the dungeon!



Players can create any number of characters, but must choose one for each run. For the duration of this character's existence, its stats will be built upon and improved through gameplay. Characters can be one of three classes, Melee, Ranged, and Magic. Each class has its own set of unique abilities and playstyles.



The player's primary goal while playing is to level up by defeating enemies. Levelling up permanently improves your character through rewarding attribute points, and also improves the character for the run by providing base stats and ability points.



Abilities enable the player to enage in combat with their enemies. Ability points can be obtained upon levelling up, and spent on abilities to increase their base effectiveness for the remainder of the run. Each class contains their own unique set of abilities, with the exception of powerful late game items that allow the player to mix in abilities from other classes.



There are four attributes native to each character: Power, Intelligence, Stamina, and Agility.
Power: Increases damage done with all Abilities.
Intelligence: Increases max Mana and Mana regen rate.
Stamina: Increases max Health and Health regen rate. Increases base damage resistance.
Agility: Increases base movement speed, cast speed, and decreases ability cooldowns.



Items are scattered throughout the Dungeon of Depth, and can be either found, crafted, or bought in stores. Items are the true driving factor for a successful run, and can modify the player's stats when equipped. Other items include consumables like potions and food, or placeable items like campfires, crops, and traps. The more items the better, but it is left in the hands of the drop table gods to determine which items you find!



Because more levels means more fun, players also have personal skills to develop throughout runs. Skills are tied closely to the crafting system, and are used to regulate which resources and crafting diagrams the player is able to utilize. The longer you play the more you will accumulate your skill levels, allowing for swifter and more efficient runs.



Players can utilize obtained resources and their skill levels to craft powerful items that cannot be found otherwise. Those who utilize crafting are at an advantage, with access to powerful starting items or destructive late-game items.



The only item that persists across runs is what are known as "Shards." Shards can be consumed and attached to player's abilities or items in order to imbue them with special effects, like Ice or Fire damage. Shards can also be imbued to weapon slot items to enhance the player's basic ability, but this effect would obviously be lost at the end of the run. These are the most highly prized artifact in the Dungeon of Depth.

Pushing boundaries can be dangerous – ensure you keep hazardous activities in check by providing staff with adequate PPE and safety protocols, keep external interference away and if needed make sure your director is on hand to keep any mishaps ‘in house’.

Remember; All’s Well, that Endswell…

Key Features:

Resource Management:

Manage patients, cash flow, risks, and maintenance. Keep your operation running smoothly and without… incident.

Build:

Staff Management:

2104890.name: RoadCraft
2104890.about_the_game:
As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!

You run a disaster recovery company, specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters. Numerous tasks await you and your heavy machinery as you work to restart the local industry: clearing debris, replacing faulty equipment, rebuilding roads and bridges damaged by bad weather, deploying resource convoys to produce new reconstruction materials, and much more!

Experience a new generation of simulation with the brand new engine developed by Saber Interactive, the creators of MudRunner and SnowRunner. Reshape the terrain and ease the movement of your vehicles thanks to your newly-built roads.

Each machine has its own behavior. Use your bulldozer to clear obstructions, your heavy transporter to carry multiple vehicles, or your fixed or gantry cranes to lift containers and equipment. Reconnect a factory to the power grid with your cable layer, lay down hot asphalt with your paver, and flatten it with your roller to create your own roads. Unlock over 40 vehicles as you progress through the story-driven campaign. Visit your garage to customize your machines with your company’s logo and repaint them with your personalized colors.

Whether in the mountains, the heart of the desert, or by the sea, your expertise is needed around the globe! Explore 8 unique maps, each 4 km², with their own biomes and buildings. Choose your itinerary through abandoned factories, submerged dams, or out-of-service solar fields. Search every corner to achieve your goals, and secure new contracts to earn additional funds and XP.

Collect remnants of wood, steel, and cement and transform them into components in your recycling plants, every piece of debris can be used for reconstruction! Supply factories and sand quarries to produce resources in bulk. As the operations manager, guide your transport trucks by plotting their routes on the map and ensure no obstacles block their way!

The world of RoadCraft offers a multitude of activities. Why not complete them with your friends? Set up a co-op session for up to 4 players. Divide tasks or focus together on a single objective. Combine your strengths and ingenuity to find solutions, even the most unexpected ones.

The game is designed for those who want to play lightly, so if you want to play hard or enjoy the story, please purchase the Town Version.

An independently developed battle system

    The "ETS (Emotional Trinity System)" is an exclusive battle system for Tadahito that aims to create a trinity of music, scenario and mechanics.
  • By timing your key press cues with the music it expresses the thoughts of the enemies and characters and the sympathy gauge will rise.
  • Unleash your inner strength to the character's theme and challenge the strongest enemies!
  • Battles aren't just about gaining experience and raising your level. This original battle system (ETS) directly reflects the player's skills and is easy to learn but difficult to master.Select the difficulty level from EASY, NORMAL, and HARD! Every new encounter with an enemy is thrilling and fun!


Original music


Every character in Tadahito has their own unique music not just our heroes, but also for each and every enemy big or small that lurks in the grass or behind the trees.
With every new encounter you'll listen to a song that expresses their character and you'll grow to understand them a little more. As the story progresses, you may even begin to realize It's not just music..


Each of the main characters and enemies has a unique life of their own. Enemies are not just obstacles to be defeated in the game, they are people, with life-sized problems and struggles just like us. Every small insight into their own story progresses the narrative. The story of Tadahito has a dual structure of "life" and the "story of the world" within it.

2104990.name: Garage Sale
2104990.about_the_game:
Welcome to Lettuce Village! You're exploring the tiny forest town's communal garage sale as Juniper, a young resident who's shy yet eager to cure her summer loneliness and maybe pick up a few trinkets along the way.

It wouldn't be a garage sale without lots of treasures! Throughout the game, you'll be able to shop at various garage sales, yard sales, and stores to find storied antiques, homemade crafts, and sentimental trinkets that provide glimpses into their former owners' lives. (And, if you explore every nook and cranny in Lettuce Village, you'll find just enough coins to purchase every item in the sale. You're welcome.)

Lettuce Village is in the middle of nowhere, so your neighbors are... a bit interesting. As you explore the town, you'll have the opportunity to complete small quests to help your neighbors, rewarding you with bits of the town's history, some coins or unique items, and occasionally a lifelong friendship.

Despite its small size, Lettuce Village has quite the interesting history. Take your time talking to your neighbors, exploring every area, and completing as many quests as you can — you just might be able to uncover some of the town's well-kept secrets...

Features:

  • Over 30 unique villagers to get to know through 10+ side quests

  • Over 75 rooms to explore, including houses, forested areas, secret passageways, and some pretty quirky surprises

  • Over 50 items to collect, each with its own backstory that reveals information about the town's residents

  • Tens of thousands of lines of flavor text

  • A heartfelt narrative about the importance of community

  • No timers, no scores, no stress!

2105000.name: Super Choppy Orc
2105000.about_the_game:
Super Choppy Orc is a thrilling 2D precision/puzzle platformer that puts players in the shoes of an Orc on a journey to escape monster-infested caves and rescue his friends.

Gameplay


Master the use of your magical Axe to:
Create platforms and reach higher areas


Double jump and get an extra boost of height and distance


Float and gain an extra level of maneuverability


Destroy your enemies and clear a path to victory

Features


In addition to its challenging gameplay, the game offers beautiful pixel art and retro-inspired music that transport players back to the golden age of arcade gaming.
With its speedrun-friendly design and accessibility options, Super Choppy Orc is a must-play for platformer fans of all skill levels.

Accessibility


  • No use of flashing lights or repeatable patterns, which can be triggering for some players
  • The ability to highlight different walls with the color of the player's choice, making it easier for colorblind players to navigate the game
  • Remappable controls, allowing players to customize the controls to their preferences
  • The ability to slow down the gameplay, making it easier for players with mobility or coordination issues to play the game
  • The option to become invincible, allowing players to enjoy the game without fear of failure or frustration

Speedrun


Join the and challenge yourself to become the best at Super Choppy Orc.
Can you master the power of the magical Axe and emerge victorious?
Play now and find out!

2105020.name: Project XLOWS - Keyboard Apocalypse TM
2105020.about_the_game:
Project XLOWS: Keyboard Apocalypse is a typing game in 3D world space sharing many features similar to rpg elements. Players can use skills, and a variety of selection of characters. This project is made by a single developer with the main focus of gameplay. As the project is currently in an early phase, more updates will be released based on players feedback. Players can expect to jump into the world and start playing as their favorite character.

Backstory:
Monsters have appeared from the underground, and have created a war zone. countless armies got together to seal the entrance, but none has been successful. If this continues, the whole planet will be engulfed in darkness.

Game-play:
Type your way to victory. Type various skill names ("jump left", "teleport", "launch fireball") and press enter to activate the skill. A list of skills can be found on top left screen under "Commands" title. Enter a specific series of sentences to win. Each sentence will be more difficult than the previous. Watch-out for the endless monsters that appear and prevent you from accomplishing your mission. Use your skills to make enough time to type the main quest lines.

2105060.name: Barboozeled
2105060.about_the_game:
What started out as a chance to get out and unwind, ended as a quest to find the door. Navigate your way through the various environments, avoiding not only the tables, chairs, and various furnishings of the local watering hole, but also the patrons and staff. Just be careful not to make too much of a nuisance of yourself, else security will need to take matters into their own hands.

Two dozen unlockable characters, and multiple unlockable levels serve as the basis for the end of the night of overindulgence.

Developer Notes

No epic quest here, just a quick time waster casual game.

2105070.name: Another Space Opera - Episode 1: The Wake of The Giant
2105070.about_the_game:
Another Space Opera - Episode 1: The Wake Of The Giant, is a cinematic action platformer with a fast-paced and immersive feel. Rendered in gorgeous, hand-crafted pixel art and featuring a full cast of voice-actors to bring this immense, epic sci-fi saga to life before your eyes.

At the end of the 23rd century, Earth is united under a gestalt technocratic order - reborn from the ashes of nuclear fire. Now reaching out to explore the stars, humanity finds itself dragged into the crossfire of yet another war: A bloody, supernatural conflict for the fate of the galaxy.

  • Single-player or 2-player coop. Experience the tale of Another Space Opera alone or with a friend by your side.
  • A world rendered in breathtaking pixel art; 12 sprawling levels with painstakingly hand-crafted pixel art environments, beautifully animated characters and cinematics.
  • Procedurally generated loot: Countless weapons with unique stats, appearances, names, and features with which to annihilate your foes.
  • An incredible blockbuster cinematic soundtrack.
  • 30+ unique enemies.
  • Challenging and immense boss-fights with beautifully animated pixel art.

2105090.name: Speedrunners Paradise: Sky is the limit
2105090.about_the_game:
This game is a simple 3D platformer in which you will have to finish some levels which are made to test your patience and mostly, your skill. In each level, you control a robot, named RS-1192018E2119. With this robot, you must finish each level and move to the next one, until you have completed the game. The only controls you will need to use are the WASD movement buttons, or the arrow buttons if you prefer them. Patience is key, as the levels are designed to make this game a hard experience for you, since the goal of the game is to make the player feel the emotions of rage and defeat, until they reach their ultimate goal, the completion of each level. Once you have completed a level, you can always try and speedrun the same level, to see how good you are at winning those levels, compared to other players who are just like you.

This game features:

-4 levels full of adventure and replayability
-Simple controls which makes it easy for anyone to play
-Challenging puzzles
-Adventure
-Bringing the old-school type of game back to life
-Speedrunning tournaments and much more!

2105120.name: College Basketball Manager
2105120.about_the_game:
Embark on the ultimate college basketball coaching journey with College Basketball Manager. This groundbreaking management game allows you to take control of your favorite school's basketball program, whether you're starting small and aiming for the top or stepping into the shoes of your beloved college team to forge a legacy that spans decades. Merge the excitement of college basketball with strategic gameplay tailored to your coaching style. Recruit the next generation of basketball stars, guide your team to tournament glory, and shape your coaching legacy with critical decisions both on and off the virtual court. Manage practices, strategize gameplay, schedule games, run practices, and manage your staff to create a powerhouse. With extensive customization options, this is your chance to leave a lasting mark on the world of college basketball.

Key Features:

  • Execute game plans through a dynamic simulation engine, boasting an array of offensive and defensive strategies.

  • Recruit high school, juco, or transfer players to bolster your team, crafting compelling pitches to sway recruits and outmaneuver your rivals in recruiting battles.

  • Develop your players both during the season and off to align with your playing style and gain a competitive edge.

  • Level up your coaching skills.

  • Comprehensive stat tracking for every player and team.

  • Dive into team and league histories, past game results, awards, coaching careers, and records with just a click.

RECRUIT YOUR POWERHOUSE

College Basketball Manager introduces an innovative recruiting system with thirteen key "pitches" that represent various aspects of your basketball program. These pitches, such as Feeling Wanted, Playing Time, and Proximity to Home, are graded on an A-F scale, providing an overview of your school's strengths and weaknesses. The recruit's perception of each pitch is pivotal, and their knowledge about your program can be influenced through strategic actions like calls and campus visits.

COACH YOUR TEAM

In this immersive college basketball sim, you're not just a spectator but the mastermind behind every play and decision. Craft intricate strategies tailored to your team's strengths and weaknesses, adjusting on the fly to exploit your opponent's vulnerabilities. With every nail-biting matchup, you'll feel the rush of competition and the satisfaction of seeing your meticulously planned tactics unfold on the court.

ADVANCE YOUR COACHING CAREER

In Legacy Mode, the weight of expectations from each school's athletic director hangs heavy as you navigate the highs and lows of college basketball coaching. Exceeding these benchmarks can elevate your reputation, drawing interest from top-tier programs eager to harness your coaching prowess. However, failure to meet these expectations could spell the end of your coaching tenure, adding a thrilling element of risk and reward to your journey towards coaching greatness.

BUILD A LEGACY FOR THE AGES

Every statistical detail and player attribute is meticulously recorded and readily available for analysis. Dive deep into the annals of the sport, exploring the rich history of teams, coaches, players, and memorable games from previous seasons. Whether it's uncovering the secrets behind legendary championship runs or dissecting the strategies of iconic coaches, the wealth of historical data allows you to immerse yourself in the storied tradition of college basketball and relive the magic of past triumphs.

2105130.name: Observo
2105130.about_the_game:
OBSERVO is a love letter to classic survival horror games of the early 2000s, with a focus on atmospheric horror, puzzle solving, and light combat.

You play as Edgar, a man on a business trip to a small town who has to find a place to spend the night at the last minute. He comes across this one roadside inn that, while looking a little worse for wear, it has a friendly manager, clean sheets and warm water, so he doesn't think much of it. However, when strange things start happening around him and Edgar suddenly finds himself in real danger, his next objective then becomes escaping from that place while he still can…

But it won't be that easy.



Explore the mysterious inn as you try to find a way out of there… but beware of what you might run into. If push comes to shove, you will need to fight your way to safety using makeshift weapons, or you could choose a run and dodge approach to deal with any hostile figures you may encounter.



Obtain items, solve puzzles, and collect documents to progress through the story. Your inventory is limited, however, so manage carefully what you’re going to take with you and what you’re going to leave stored in the item box.

KEY FEATURES


  • Puzzles
  • Fixed cameras
  • Light combat
  • Limited inventory
  • Manual saving at save points
  • Original soundtrack

2105170.name: Nature & Wildlife - Jigsaw Puzzle
2105170.about_the_game:
Embark on a captivating journey into the realm of nature and wildlife with this delightful jigsaw puzzle game. Nature & Wildlife Jigsaw Puzzle immerses you in the beauty and diversity of the natural world, allowing you to piece together stunning images of landscapes, animals, and wonders of nature.

Featuring a wide range of puzzle difficulties and various grid sizes, the game offers challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages and skill levels. Dive into the tranquil serenity of nature as you assemble intricate puzzles, each revealing a breathtaking scene filled with vibrant colors and intricate details.

From lush forests and majestic mountains to pristine beaches and exotic wildlife, explore a collection of awe-inspiring images that celebrate the wonders of the natural world. Whether it's a close-up of a majestic tiger, a panoramic vista of a cascading waterfall, or a playful family of dolphins leaping through the waves, each puzzle captures the essence of nature's beauty.

Enjoy the intuitive controls and user-friendly interface as you effortlessly navigate through the puzzle pieces. Rotate, drag, and drop the fragments into place, uncovering the hidden image and experiencing the joy of completion. Take your time or challenge yourself with time-limited modes for an extra thrill.

Nature & Wildlife Jigsaw Puzzle offers a relaxing and immersive gameplay experience. Immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of nature as you lose yourself in the puzzle-solving process. Appreciate the intricate details, the vibrant colors, and the awe-inspiring imagery that celebrates the diversity and magnificence of the natural world.

With a vast collection of puzzles to explore, each offering a unique and enchanting experience, Nature & Wildlife Jigsaw Puzzle is the perfect escape for nature lovers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Unleash your inner explorer, reconnect with the beauty of nature, and embrace the tranquil charm of assembling breathtaking puzzles piece by piece.

Features:

- Every puzzle is unique: Different piece shapes every time!
- Saves all puzzles in progress, so you can work on several at the same time.

2105260.name: Pizza Kidd
2105260.about_the_game:
🔥 Pizza Kidd is now crowdfunding on Kickstarter!
Help us finish the full game and bring the Pizza Kidd universe to life... here on STEAM (Early Access)!

👉 Back the project today — January 6th through February 8th, 2026!

In a world on the brink of destruction, one unlikely hero steps forward. KIDD, a young martial artist as swift with punches and kicks as he is with delivering your pizza, is humanity’s last hope. Pizza Kidd pulses with the spirit and edginess of 90's anime and the grit of classic arcade brawlers of the same era, blending beautifully detailed 16-bit pixel art with fast-paced, responsive combat. This isn’t just another "indie" game—it’s an electrifying homage to a golden era, crafted with love and modern flair to keep things feeling fresh yet familiar.


Santos, the sinister architect behind the city's destruction, now commands an army of nightmares: creepy creature clones, zombified scarecrow ninjas that strike without warning, drone bots that patrol the gates, and towering monstrous behemoths that crush everything in their path. The streets are crawling with terror, but KIDD’s mission is clear—recover the 8 sacred seed stones, harness their power, and put an end to Santos' reign of madness.



Unleash the Action

• High-Impact Combat: Fast, responsive attacks, air juggling, and long chain combos for intense expressive gameplay.

• Side-Scrolling Adventure: Expansive 2D levels with skill-based, fighting-style special moves.

Retro Pixel Brilliance

Sound that Hits Hard

• Crunchy Arcade Sound Design: Satisfying hits with every punch and kick!

• Energized Soundtrack: Original music that amplifies the energy and action — with original compositions by Kevin Ripley, Martin Lande, Yanni Ziangos, Silent Sphere, Dj Spinna, Byron the Aquarius, Rashad "Tumblin' Dice" Smith, Lisa Bella Donna, and other guests musicians.

#PIZZAKIDD

2105360.name: Waifu Fighter
2105360.about_the_game:
Waifu Fighter: The Ultimate Sexy Waifu Boxing Experience

Prepare to enter the steamy world of Waifu Fighter, the hottest PC game to grace your screen! Get ready to immerse yourself in intense battles as you choose from a selection of 12 seductive waifus, each with their unique fighting style. It's time to step into the ring and unleash your inner fighter!

With easy-to-grasp controls and addictive gameplay, Waifu Fighter offers a challenging experience that will keep you coming back for more. Don't be fooled by the game's accessible mechanics; mastering the art of waifu boxing is no easy feat. It's a game that rewards skill, strategy, and quick reflexes. Can you rise to the top and claim victory as the ultimate champion?

Embark on an exciting journey through the game's thrilling story mode, featuring 12 thrilling fighting encounters. Each encounter brings you closer to uncovering the secrets behind each waifu's motivations, rivalries, and hidden depths. Engage in intense battles against formidable opponents as you strive to become the unrivaled champion of the waifu world.

Choose from a diverse roster of 12 alluring waifus, each beautifully rendered and uniquely designed to captivate your senses. From elegant swordswomen to fiery sorceresses, each waifu brings her personality and fighting skills to the ring. 2105370.name: Mortal Fighter
2105370.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mortal Fighter, an epic fighting game that will test your skills and unleash your inner warrior! With its intense combat, gripping storylines, and various game modes, Mortal Fighter offers an immersive and thrilling gaming experience for both casual players and seasoned fighters alike.

Choose from a diverse roster of 15 unique and formidable fighters, each with their own distinct fighting styles, special moves, and captivating backstories. From swift and agile martial artists to powerful and armored behemoths, Mortal Fighter guarantees a character that suits every player's preferred playstyle.

Prepare to battle it out in two meticulously designed environments that will take you from ancient temples to futuristic metropolises. Each environment is rich in detail and interactive elements, providing dynamic battlegrounds where every move counts. Adapt your strategies and make use of the environment to gain an advantage over your opponents.

Engage in 15 thrilling fighting encounters in Story Mode, where you'll follow each character's personal journey and face challenging adversaries. Immerse yourself in a captivating narrative that unfolds with every fight, filled with unexpected twists, rivalries, and alliances. Discover the secrets behind the Mortal Fighter tournament as you strive for glory and unlock hidden content along the way.

Challenge your friends in Player vs. Player mode and put your skills to the ultimate test. Choose your favorite fighter and engage in intense one-on-one battles that will determine who reigns supreme. If you prefer cooperative gameplay, team up with a friend in Local Co-op mode and unleash devastating combo attacks to dominate your opponents.

Take the fight online and enter the competitive arena with Online Multiplayer. Battle against fighters from around the world and climb the global leaderboards. Prove your worth and become the ultimate Mortal Fighter champion as you face off against the best of the best.

For those looking to sharpen their skills or try out new characters, Training Mode offers a comprehensive training ground. Practice your moves, experiment with combos, and master the intricacies of each fighter. Hone your techniques and become an unstoppable force in the arena.

Experience an epic and immersive journey in Story Mode, engage in intense battles in various multiplayer modes, and perfect your skills in Training Mode. Mortal Fighter delivers a fighting game experience like no other, with its diverse cast of characters, thrilling encounters, and engaging gameplay. Get ready to unleash your inner warrior and prove your mettle in the Mortal Fighter arena!

2105400.name: Terrorform
2105400.about_the_game:
Mad scientists have released ungodly abominations from their testing facilities. A security guard put on ice, only to be thawed in case of EXTREME emergency, you wake up with one thought in mind........killing.

With the help of a tech expert, Art, you need to make your way through this lab from the pits of hell and put a stop to these monsters.

CLASSIC FPS CONTROLS

Looking up is overrated anyways. If you are here for a classic FPS feel, you're in the right hands. Don't worry, we took all the feel of a classic Boomer Shooter and jammed packed it with the speed and high paced gameplay of modern shooters. It's a Frankenstein and you'll love it.

FULL ARSENAL

Six weapons with dramatically different mechanics. Wanna shoot grapple lasers? Got it! Wanna unload a full mag into some eyeball? Got that too! What about a tried and true shotgun? Oh you know we wouldn't leave that out.

THREE GRUSOME ACTS

Kick monster ass through three acts, 15 levels, and 3 unique bosses. There is something not right on in this testing facility, will you get to the bottom of it? Who cares, you're here to leave a pile of bodies on your way out.

CHALLENGE MODE

Test your weapon mastery in a challenge mode. Race against the clock to beat a procedurally generated set of 5 levels with endless combinations. Did I mention, you only get 1 weapon.....good luck.

2105440.name: Fall of Bali
2105440.about_the_game:
Fall of Bali is a historical strategy game set in Bali in the 19th Century with a map which covers the eastern salient of Java, Blambangan, Bali island and Lombok island. Many Balinese kingdoms were at war with each other and were spreading their influence out to both Blambangan and Lombok Island. Hence, the realm of Bali had been divided for a long time. The successor to the Bali Empire, Klungkung, was only recognized as the spiritual leader for Balinese kings, which drove the other kings to pursue the highest achievement: the ambition to become the superior ruler of Bali. Meanwhile as time passes on, the growing threat of a colonial power from the Dutch Empire in Java will soon reaches Bali.

There are 12 kingdoms based on 3 main cultures: Blambanganese, Balinese, and Sasaknese.

Each kingdom has its own unique geographical location, culture, troops, diplomatic relations, and economy, reflecting the situation of the real Bali kingdoms in the late 18th Century AD

Try to expand your kingdom, conquer all kingdoms from Blambangan, Bali, and Lombok , and face the Dutch's imperialism !

2105450.name: Flight Level
2105450.about_the_game:
Flight Level is an Air Traffic Control simulator made by real radar controllers to give everyone a chance to experience what the job is like. The game also teaches the core concepts of ATC and lets players work together in multiplayer.

Training Campaign
In the Training Campaign we teach the player the necessary skills and concepts to safely handle traffic in Area Control and Approach Control and also the principles of how sectors are supposed to work together.

Realistic UI
The UI of the game resembles the radar position interface used in many centers around the world. Main interaction is done via aircraft labels, which are small UI elements attached to traffic on the radar screen so it is quite clear which label is attached to what aircraft.
Also provided are helpful tools for measuring conflicts and analyzing the traffic situation.

Simplified interaction
One big skill to learn for ATC is radio phraseology i.e talking in the standard way to give clearances etc. To make it simpler for players to learn about ATC we designed the game so that the player just clicks clearances into the labels and hears the clearances given and pilot readbacks.

Electronic coordination simulation
In modern ATC communication and coordination between sectors is handled by simply interacting with the aircraft labels, sending requests and accepting them via the UI.
This is all emulated in the game, but of course, since situations can get awfully complex, expect to use voice communication as well in multiplayer.

Multiplayer
ATC is one of the most COOP experiences to be had and so no simulation of the job would be complete without working together with other people to safely expedite traffic. Almost all traffic for a position comes from another sector and goes into another. Collaboration with neighbors is often needed to resolve problems in an efficient manner.

Weather
Taking wind into consideration whilst solving problems is a core part of ATC work and hence different winds at different flight levels are simulated.
Another implemented realistic anomaly are thunderstorms, about which the player gets mainly information from the pilots, who request headings to avoid storm cells.

Create your own Airspaces and Scenarios
The game has a built in Scenario Editor for creating your own challenging single or multiplayer scenarios. Also, adding airspaces is possible and documentation for that is provided with the game.

Warning
Do not use this product for actual ATC training or in a professional environment. The experience this product provides is an approximation of real ATC work.

2105460.name: Scorphius
2105460.about_the_game:
You are an Adventurer who have survived the plague. You struggle to gain power that will take you deep into the dungeons and high up into the heavens to put an end to all that is wrong in this world. Created by Indie developer, Scorphius is an online Adventure RPG set in a dark fantasy world. The focus is on the adventure, combat and powerful items and Hives of Minds passive skills which allows character customization. Scorphius will never be pay-to-win game.

Key Features
Survive & Adventure
You have survived the plague and now its time to put an end to it. This is a classless game.

Character Customization
Customize the character when creating the Avatar and during gameplay with combinations from itemized drops and Hives of Minds Passive skill Tree.

Never Pay-To-Win.
This game will never be Pay-To-Win.

Competitive Play.
Fight other players in PvP areas, or PvP activated zones. You can flag yourself on equipping PvP flag items which drops after killing monsters. You will then engage in a brutal combat with any player anywhere in the Scorpion World.

2105470.name: 吃香蕉 Eat Bananas
2105470.about_the_game:
Help Dr. Cow complete his experiments, push the box to the switch and open the cage to eat the nutritious bananas.

What is the purpose of Dr. Cow's experiments, why all kinds of strange things happen, and how to push boxes with notepad and search engines, you will find the answer in the game Eat Bananas

Features
  • Gameplay you've never experienced before
  • Lighthearted and fun plot
  • Think outside the box

There will be some "unexpected" situations during the game, please feel free to play, these are also part of the game.The game will not read your personal information, and will not control your computer.

2105480.name: Soulsland: Last Fight
2105480.about_the_game:
Story:

A new evil enemy army and 4 different bosses have captured the souls again; so, you Lord Barbarus are the only brave hero who can destroy this evil army and release the souls. Souls are captured in the gravestone. On every level you will need to kill the boss to win back those captured souls that are trapped at the gravestones.. There are 9 different maps at this medieval themed RPG game. You player are Lord Barbarus brave hero. Every level your mission is to find hidden gravestones where souls are captured, but opening gate you need kill different bosses at every level. So only by killing bosses souls can be saved.
There are 4 bosses: Ninja Woman, Orc Monster, Ghost Witch and Iron warrior. Every level you need avoid enemy army and find boss who need to be destroyed
There are enemy warriors with different weapons like sword,daggers etc. Player start every level without weapons, and need first fight just bare fists. Collect different weapons like daggers, swords, 2hand swords and shield to protect yourself. Also levels contain health potions which increase player health. Inventory system is also at game. Few levels contains bonus achievements golden skulls which are hidden somewhere in map. Game contains different themed maps, like desert, castle, forest etc

Features:

- 11 different themed maps
- Several weapons like sword, big sword, daggers, shield to protect and also fighting with just fists
-Health potions
- Inventory system
- Enemies with different weapons. Enemies can also use daggers, fists and swords
- Steam achievements
- Hidden achievements
- 4 different bosses:
- Ninja woman: Ability to teleport
- Orc Monster: Ability to jump and hit
- Ghost witch: Ability to use different magic and melee attacks
- Iron warrior: Ability to fight with sword

2105500.name: Mogrimera: Disciple of Order
2105500.about_the_game: Welcome to the world of Mogrimera where nature, technology, and the supernatural combine into one diverse and incredible open-world experience! As a student from the Wizarding School of Order, you must complete tasks given to you by the faculty. Some tasks are difficult, some are incredibly dangerous! But thankfully you will not have to tackle them alone. Animal-like creatures called “grimera” can be recruited to assist you on your quests. Refine their skills in battle and work together to defeat the chaotic and cruel abominations that threaten this world and its creatures!

2105510.name: Cop Simulator
2105510.about_the_game:
Looking for a game that will let you live out your law enforcement fantasies? Look no further than Cop Simulator! In this game, you can play as a police officer, investigating crimes and bringing criminals to justice. Cop Simulator is the perfect game for anyone who wants to experience what it's like to be a cop, without any of the real-world consequences. So come on, put on your badge and get ready to fight crime!

The game will also feature a large open world, and players will be able to explore it freely. There will be plenty of side missions and activities to keep players busy.

2105530.name: Mapventure Story
2105530.about_the_game:
In this Action-Roguelite you create your own map in each run and get to decide whether you want to go straight to the bosses or fight more enemies to get stronger. Collect resources from different biomes to upgrade your village and rescue people to unlock more advantages for your next adventures.

The Beginning of Your Journey

After the last capable hunter failed to return from the ever-changing dungeon a few years ago, you decided to take on this role. Your village consists almost only of empty and collapsed houses, but if you can stand up to the monsters, you will be able to breathe new life into it again.

The Biomes

The dungeon is a mysterious place where one biome follows another. For example, you can go from a lush forest to a scorching desert, or from an eerie graveyard to a crystal plane. Each biome brings you different materials that are important for expanding your village. The further you advance, the more diverse the selection of biomes and materials becomes.

The Energies

To get stronger on your adventures, you can make use of the biomes' energies after defeating all the monsters on a field. There are offensive, defensive and special energies, and when you collect enough of one type, its level increases and you can choose from three improvements associated with that energy. Some of the improvements are passive and increase, for example, your maximum health or your material yield, while others change the attacks or movements you can carry out.

New and Old Acquaintances

During your excursions into the dungeon you will also meet other people from time to time which you can take back to your village. Some of them were already thought lost, others you are yet to meet. If you help someone, they will definitely want to show you their appreciation and support you in their very own way.

The Village

Many years ago it originated as a refuge for lost travelers and has become the home of a small community where everyone contributed something to the prosperity of all. Meanwhile, hardly anyone is left and the village seems lost. Fortunately, there are many people wandering around the dungeon with all sorts of useful skills, just waiting for you to find and save them. With their help, the village can flourish again.

Feature List

  • Reinvent yourself with every run in this unique roguelite.
  • Depending on your selected start biome you start your adventure with different classes.
  • Absorb up to three energies provided by the biomes and specialize in offensive, defensive or special skills.
  • Explore the ever-changing dungeon and uncover all its secrets.
  • Discover numerous biomes with a wide variety of enemies.
  • Each biome provides valuable materials to transform your village from a small refuge into a paradise.
  • Rescue helpful NPCs that will bring you indispensable improvements.
  • Enjoy many temporary as well as permanent upgrades.
  • Prove your skills in battles against powerful bosses.
  • Choose the next puzzle piece wisely to get the most out of your current run.
  • Fill your logbook with countless useful discoveries.
  • Have engaging and witty conversations with your villagers and complete challenging quests.
