2105600.name: RPG Stories
2105600.about_the_game:
Welcome to RPG Stories, where your creativity knows no bounds!

This is the main version of RPG Stories VTT featuring the full version of the World-Builder and the ability to Host or Join Games.

About RPG Stories VTT

Our 3D World Builder lets you quickly and easily create indoor and outdoor environments for all types of tabletop role-playing games—whether Fantasy, Modern, or Sci-Fi.

Once your map is complete, you have two options:

  • Export your maps for use in other VTTs.

  • Play online in RPG Stories VTT with a fully 3D environment and stable multiplayer mode.

Craft stunning worlds, design engaging maps, and embark on unforgettable adventures—all with ease and flexibility!

BUILD WITHOUT LIMITS

-Use auto-building for quick setups or take full control with manual customization—perfect for any skill level.

-Choose from over 7,000 3D models spanning Fantasy, Modern, and Sci-Fi settings, giving you everything you need to bring your worlds to life.

-Discover hundreds of ready-to-use creations from other users in our Steam Workshop.

  • Procedurally Generated Scenes

  • Auto-Room Builder

  • Mass Placement Tool

  • Multi-Level Building

  • Group Objects & Steam Workshop support

  • Ready Buildings

  • Modular Pieces for Custom Builds

  • 3D Characters & Monsters

  • VFX

  • 2D Images Upload

  • Customizable Grid

PLAY LIKE NEVER BEFORE

RPG Stories VTT lets you play on your maps online with stable multiplayer support.

Current Features:

  • Online World-Builder – Move objects or add new ones in real time, enhancing immersion and maintaining full control over the environment.

  • Vast 3D Dice Panel – Roll any dice set from any TTRPG you can imagine.

  • GM Controls – Customize player experience, movement, and spawn points.

  • 3D Characters – Players can walk around as fully animated 3D models.

  • Hero Forge API – Use your Hero Forge minis as 3D tokens.

-RPG Stories VTT users can host as GMs or join as players.

-Unlock unlimited player slots with the Unlock Player Seats DLC, allowing players with the free demo to join your games for life

EXPORTS & OTHER VTTS

  • 2D Export: Capture stunning screenshots from any camera angle—top view, isometric view, or more—up to 8K resolution.

  • Video: Record your screen while moving the camera to create cinematic videos of your scenes.

  • RPGs Export: Export your maps and environments as a special RPG Stories file to share online or upload directly to the Steam Workshop with a single click.

  • RPGe Export: Combine objects to create custom items and share them with others, or upload them to the Steam Workshop for everyone to enjoy.

  • Other VTTs Export: RPG Stories World-Builder allows you export your maps to other VTTs, including all the necessary data for Dynamic Lighting. The VTT Exporter tool uses the Universal VTT (UVTT) file format, compatible with all major VTT platforms.

DYNAMIC VTT TOOLS & FEATURES

RPG Stories VTT offers Game Master-friendly features that enhance both gameplay and world-building, allowing you to elevate theatricality in every session.

  • Quest Writing: Forget third-party text pads—keep everything in your Journal and add Quest Notes directly to your 3D scene.

  • Fog of War: Hide certain areas from your players or lock the camera to their 3D character’s perspective.

  • Tab System: Divide your adventure into different environmental tabs and set spawn points for your players in each.

  • Weather System: Set and change the weather as you play by choosing from 35+ weather conditions, sky types, and auroras.

  • Light Sources: Add light sources and use the full day-night cycle by adjusting the sun in your 3D scene.

  • Camera Movement: Move the camera freely with your mouse or keyboard, switch to Top or Isometric View, or customize the players’ view to see exactly what you want them to.

  • 2D Support: Import 2D images or maps and play in 2D.

  • VFX: Add VFX to your scenes or use them as spells during gameplay.

  • Underwater Settings: Instantly transform your 3D scene into an underwater world with one click.

FOR THE COMMUNITY

Brave Alice Games and the RPG Stories team put the community first.

  • RPG Stories VTT’s exports are 100% commercial-free—yes, you can even sell your maps and scenes.

  • Join our active Discord community to share feedback, connect with other players, and help shape the future of RPG Stories.

2105610.name: Lost in the Void : Chapter One
2105610.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the mesmerizing realm of Lost in the Void —an enchanting isometric pixel art adventure skillfully interwoven with captivating RPG elements. Drawing inspiration from the cherished era of the 80s, this game is meticulously crafted to rekindle the enchantment of your childhood dreams. Lost in the Void unfolds as an episodic journey, akin to your beloved TV shows, with each episode released one at a time, promising a continuous tapestry of immersive storytelling and thrilling gameplay.

Embark on a Journey as a High School Senior


Embark on a transformative journey as a high school senior in Lost in the Void. Amidst the bustling corridors of academia and the camaraderie of your tight-knit group of friends, an eerie voice begins to resonate within your mind. It beckons you toward an enigmatic and shadowy path, compelling you to confront a pivotal decision. Will you succumb to the allure of this mysterious force, or will you resist its persuasive influence, shaping your destiny in the process?

Forge Unforgettable Bonds with Your Companions


Throughout your enthralling expedition, you'll be accompanied by Martin, Sasha, and Aaron – your steadfast friends, each with their own distinct personalities that react dynamically to your choices. Depending on your decisions, their affections for you may blossom or wither away.

Shape Your Character through Skill Distribution


At the onset of the game, indulge in character creation where you allocate points into three primary skills – Fight, Tech, or Comms. These skill allocations will dictate how you navigate intricate dialogues, as combat is non-existent in this enthralling adventure. All in-game situations are resolved through a robust dialogue system, putting the power of choice firmly in your hands.

Unleash Your Imagination in a Narrative-Driven Experience


Lost in the Void is an episodic captivating narrative-driven game that captures the essence of classic pen-and-paper RPG games and game-books. While our pixel art style sets the stage, the game's rich narration vividly paints a detailed picture of your surroundings, allowing your imagination to breathe life into every nook and cranny of this mesmerizing universe.

2105620.name: Sektori
2105620.about_the_game:
SEKTORI

Sektori is an intense, fast paced twin-stick shooter infused with hard hitting techno music. Choose your upgrades carefully and create powerful builds to take on the relentless enemies and epic bosses on a constantly evolving battlefield. Sektori is a game that requires your complete focus, a game where the high-adrenaline visuals, music, and gameplay come together to transport you into another state of consciousness.

Simple, pure gameplay. Quick runs. Lots of challenge and replayability.

FEATURES

  • A five world campaign mode with dynamically changing levels and tons of enemy variation - including epic evolving bosses

  • Alternate ships and configurable upgrade decks to mold your run with

  • Three difficulty modes suited for all players, including a "Revolution" campaign mode for maximal challenge

  • Six alternate game modes, like Classic, Gates and Assault

  • Varied selection of challenges and medals to reach for

DEVELOPER NOTES

With Sektori I wanted to create a shoot'em up where every run feels familiar, but is still completely unique. A game of skill, not memorization. The hand crafted attack waves, levels and even the bosses are combined, randomized and layered with the upgrade systems in a way that creates an interesting challenge for every run. The aesthetics of the game are very much inspired by techno music. Fast, detailed, colorful, saturated, intense, aggressive.

Dive in, take on the challenge as it comes and have fun!

WARNING

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

2105660.name: I live under your house.
2105660.about_the_game:
Point and Click visual novel about a creature living underground.
No one knows where you came from or why, it's dark and dirty all around, you crawl through the tunnels you've dug and enjoy your solitude.
Yesterday you killed a mouse, you enjoyed it, and yet something was missing...
It is a story of madness, loneliness, cruelty and love.

In this game you will be in the role of a creature living underground. What does it live on, where does it come from, and what does it want?
Collect items, move around, and explore different locations inside the underground shelter.

A short horror story.

2105670.name: Single Player: Horror
2105670.about_the_game:
YOU ARE LOCKED IN A HOUSE WITH A PSYCHO AXE KILLER. WHAT WILL YOU DO TO SURVIVE?
In Single Player: Horror you play the role of Sophie a university student hosting a sleepover. At the sleepover are Sophie’s two friends, Heather and Alison. Heather is a kind hippy who looks to you for guidance and Alison is a sporty girl who always wants to be in charge. During the sleepover you play a FMV game called Psycho Axe Killer but the Psycho Axe Killer always wins. In the middle of the night lightning strikes the house and runs in to the paused game bringing the Psycho Axe Killer out of the game and into reality. You are now stuck in a locked house with a Psycho Axe Killer desperate to murder you and your friends.

Gameplay mechanics includes timed decision making on where to go, what weapons to use and whether to save your friends. A maximum of twenty-five minute playtime which can be paused and saved for later play. Over four hours of different scenes to explore. Medal award system at the end of every game that includes the rankings of bronze, silver, gold and platinum.

2105680.name: A.I.T.W
2105680.about_the_game: Play the new version of A.I.T.W Now in URP, rebuilt from scratch, and looking better than ever. can you be the hero we need? jack is back and ready to show of his skills. play threw 7 levels that have been redone and more vibe to them, now with full Xbox controller support, fight different enemy's that will press you without a thought, and watch a story that is senseless but understandable.

2105690.name: In The Darkness
2105690.about_the_game:
What Is In The Darkness?

In The Darkness is a game where you are traveling through a dark maze filled to the brim with monsters that have only one purpose: To eat and kill. If you want to escape this dark land, then you must venture into the maze and explore every corner to discover its secrets. But be careful! The monsters are hiding in the darkness, waiting for the right time to strike! Originally made for the 2022 GeoJam, the Steam release of this game features an expanded map and story, with new secrets and paths to explore!

Art And Aesthetic

This game uses flat, geometric shapes for a minimalist art style. This game also utilises Light and Shadow to create the feeling of a dark and dreary maze that you are trapped in.

UI

I have a strong belief in minimalist design, and this game reflects that. There is no flashy buttons or gizmos to distract you from the game. All you have is your encyclopaedia, and your map to aid you in your journey, each of which is toggled via a hotkey.

Gameplay

In this game, you'll use the WASD keys (or joystick) to navigate around the maze. You will also be able to use the scrollwheel (or joystick) to aim your lantern at your surroundings. Use these tools to journey through the maze without getting eaten. You'll also have your Encyclopaedia of Monsters, as well as a map that fills in as you explore the maze! Be warned though, death in this game is not so kind in this game. There are very few checkpoints, so death will mean restarting entire sections (only your map stays the same). Be prepared for a very difficult experience!

Language support

In The Darkness is officially supported in 2 languages:
-English
-Spanish


The use of controllers is reccomended, but not required. Controller support is tested on Xbox controllers.

2105700.name: Guilded Hearts
2105700.about_the_game:
All things considered, Julian (name changeable) lives a pretty normal life.

He does online university work, is hopelessly single (but has a habit of crushing on cute boys), and spends most of his free time on a fantasy MMO – Lost Heroes.

Little does he know that Lost Heroes will be what pulls him into a new, budding romance...

Whether he pursues the arrogant pretty boy Guillermo, his charismatic roommate Casper, the coy store clerk Archie, or his mysterious guildmate Verdant, join Julian on an unexpected journey of self-discovery, heartache, and love.



  • Genre: BxB, slice-of-life, romance, drama
  • Rating: 18+
  • Length: 116,000 words
  • Routes: 4
  • Platforms: Windows/Mac

  • ​Customizable MC (name, hair/eye/skin/shirt color, chat profile icon)
  • Skippable 18+ scenes
  • Multiple chat styles/interfaces
  • Accessibility options: OpenDyslexic font, font size changing

2105730.name: Riddle of the Jelly
2105730.about_the_game:
Welcome to Riddle of the Jelly, a charming 2D platformer that's perfect for gamers of all ages! Our game features fun and light-hearted gameplay, with simple level design that's perfect for young children and casual players.

Join our adorable protagonist as they frolic through the mysterious world of the jelly, solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles along the way. With a cute character and whimsical visuals, Riddle of the Jelly is sure to put a smile on your face.

This game is perfect for families who want to play together or for anyone who enjoys a fun and engaging platformer. With challenging yet accessible gameplay, Riddle of the Jelly is sure to provide hours of entertainment.

So what are you waiting for? Come unlock the mystery of the Jelly and start playing today!

2105750.name: Secret Summoner
2105750.about_the_game:
- Story -
Little Hero has set out on a journey to teach misbehaving monsters a lesson. Worried for his safety, his mother and trusty canine secretly tag along. But can Little Hero and his clandestine companions truly restore peace to their land? An adventure of mother and child⁠—and pooch⁠—begins...



- Overview -
・Play Time per Stage: approx. 5-20 minutes
・Time to Complete Game: approx. 15 hours"

- Who Will Enjoy This Game -
・Those who enjoy thought-intensive strategy

- How to Play -
Various monsters stand in the way, but Little Hero is much too young to handle them all himself. Support him in being victorious by first weakening the monsters with your summoning powers. Little Hero will gain Confidence to defeat more monsters and grow stronger. Help Little Hero increase his level and prepare for the final boss showdown!"

- System -
◆Partnership Chance
This event increases your chances of landing a contract with a defeated boss, with any remaining HP increasing your chance of success. Here's your opportunity to twist boss monsters' arms into signing away!

◆Contract System
When luck is on your side, you'll get a chance to offer a contract to the monsters that Little Hero defeats at the end of the stage. Monsters who sign can be set in the Grimoire, allowing you to summon them. You'll be able to handle monsters more easily the more contracts you land.

◆Confidence System
Little Hero has a Confidence parameter that increases when he defeats enemies and that amplifies XP. Gain more Confidence to increase the speed at which you level up. The amount of Confidence you earn will depend on how you defeat enemies, so try to gain the most whenever you get the chance.

◆Digest Attack
An offensive method that can be activated when the gauge on the upper right of the screen is full. If you defeat the enemy, you'll earn Confidence according to how many combos you get. When activated, however, you cannot summon or use items to provide support, so be sure to weaken the enemy first to get combos.

2105760.name: Headz Go Racing
2105760.about_the_game:
Pick from your favourite Headz and master your driving style in this stylized cartoon semi realistic physics based racing & rallying game. Best played with a controller.

Try RACE mode against AI cars on stylized racing circuits with very tight corners and limited space or TIME TRIAL without the AI cars for more speed and earning more upgrade points, or go Time Trial rallying on the open world rally map based in Finland & Portugal, please dont take the F1 cars rallying, they really dont like it.. Race against your GHOST car and try and beat your best times.

Whichever you choose its all about putting in the miles and winning races so you can unlock lots of tracks, cars and car livery to apply.


Pick from a selection of great cars, earn upgrade points by putting in the miles and then add the upgrades to further improve your car and bring down them lap times.

The cars are semi realistic physics based cars, which can be upgraded as you progress and beware your starter tyres are pretty worn out so get a few slow and steady miles in and upgrade your tyres as soon as you can. 2105840.name: Order Automatica
2105840.about_the_game:
A dark roguelike auto battler played on a 3×3 ritual grid. Position your units, combine cursed relics, and unleash powerful synergies before the last candle burns out.

Recruit strange allies, position them with care, and empower them with occult artifacts to survive each battle.

Every run brings new enemies, unpredictable events, and the chance to uncover the true purpose of the ritual.

Simple rules. Infinite strategies.

Order Automatica’s battles are fought automatically — your job is to prepare. Spend your gold, place units on the grid, and combine them with items, cell effects, and indulgences to create unstoppable synergies. Victory comes not just from raw strength, but from clever placement and timing.

Dozens of ways to break the game.



Unlock a growing roster of unique units, powerful items, and battlefield effects.
Experiment with countless combinations to outsmart increasingly dangerous enemies. Lose all your candles and the ritual resets — but with every run, you learn new ways to bend the rules.

Key Features:

  • Tactical battles on a 3×3 grid with a unique roguelike progression system

  • Deep synergies and clever unit placement as the key to victory

  • A dark tale of an order and occult rituals full of hidden mysteries

  • Multiple game modes offering fresh challenges and virtually endless replayability

  • Distinct pixel art and a haunting, hypnotic soundtrack that sets the mood

Can you complete the ritual… or will it consume you?

2105850.name: ASTRID: Reverie
2105850.about_the_game:
'ASTRID: Reverie' is a horror-mystery adventure that combines classic 3D gameplay with FMV elements.

Imagine a technology that can digitize our knowledge and memories. Everything from your first kiss to your ability as a guitar player or programmer can be extracted, copied, and sold. In a not-so-distant future, this has become reality in form of the 'Mindscape'. This technology allows a person to enter the depths of their mind and fundamentally changed society.

Two weeks ago, Astrid’s life began to unravel. Overnight she loses her job, her relationships have become strained, she is plagued by excruciating headaches and strange episodes of vertigo.

As her condition worsens, she struggles to continue as usual but feels herself breaking down.

After terrifying hallucinations start to haunt her, Astrid begins to suspect the answers might lie inside her own mind, and running from them is no longer an option.


  • Face your fears and escape the defense mechanisms of Astrid's mind.
  • Solve riddles to help Astrid navigate the dangerous depth of her subconscious.


  • Point and Click: Investigate the world Astrid inhabits and unravel the mystery haunting her.
  • Explore the 'Mindscape' in 1st person: Find out more about Astrid’s life and uncover the secrets of the 'Mindscape'.


  • Influence the story and your relationships. People will react to Astrid’s behavior. Your decisions might change the course of her story for the better or worse.

2105860.name: Station 37
2105860.about_the_game:
Embark on your journey through STATION 37, a nostalgic first-person shooter crafted in the Quake engine.

Immerse yourself in the depths of an underground complex known as Station 37, an abandoned scientific outpost nestled on a distant celestial body. Prepare to engage in intense combat against both the facility's formidable mechanical security units and the mutated creatures that have taken over its corridors. Traverse this treacherous environment, armed with a vast arsenal of weapons and tools, as you unveil the secrets that lie within the abandoned research base.

Key Features:

  • Retro style graphics - Low-Res art style inspired on games like Quake and System Shock 1.
  • Difficult Gameplay - Prepare for a relentless challenge where survival depends on your resourcefulness and strategic use of available tools.
  • Open Source/Modding - Source code will be under the GPL license and supports the Trenchbroom level editor for custom maps.

2105880.name: Kitty's Venture
2105880.about_the_game:
Join the kitty in a challenging fast-paced adventure to hunt for Cat Points (CP). Kitty's Venture is a 2D side-scroller platformer game where you take control of a cute kitty. Play through five different stages with various obscure obstacles, collect Cat Points, and unlock achievements. Can you make it to the end?

Kitty's Venture aims to deliver a challenging yet rewarding gameplay experience. Difficulty is one of the main focuses of the game. Expect the unexpected. Each of the three stages will challenge player with obscure obstacles, and enemies. The only way you can deal with them is by JUMPING. But the player has to be smart, and on point with the timing. To unlock achievements, you have to collect Cat Points (CP), and coins. Some other in-game actions and events will also award you with achievements.

Features:
- Fast-paced gameplay that requires quick response
- 5 different stages (lot more to come)
- 80+ unique achievements featuring cats
- Challenging gameplay requiring patience and precision

Note:
  • Please keep in mind that we purposely made the game a little difficult to deliver a challenging experience. So, expect to *die* a lot the first time. It should be
    easier to beat once you get the hang of it.
  • You will start encountering enemies from Stage 2.

2105890.name: Hours After Midnight
2105890.about_the_game:
Hours After Midnight is a game where you take control of one of the heroes who swore their revenge on Rettam'diov - the Consumer of Worlds for their fallen homelands. Survive everything your enemy throws at you in this roguelike survival adventure! Collect gold, find new allies, craft and upgrade your powers, and destroy all the evil that haunts your new home!




Features
  • Online Cross-Platform Co-Op up to 4 players: PC or mobile, it doesn’t matter - everyone can connect!
  • Procedural Maps: The game features procedural world generation which prevents maps from quickly getting boring.
  • Deity System: Unlock and choose one of many unique Deities available in the game that can bless your run, each offering different bonuses for a price.
  • Elemental Damage: Explore a special damage system with 10 unique elements, fostering countless useful combinations. Strategize and adapt your approach based on elemental strengths and weaknesses.
  • Items and Abilities: A lot of unique items and abilities allow for making every run to feel different - not only because of the general variety of tools, but also because each class has its own set of abilities in addition to the general ones.
  • Boon/Buffs (Status effects): Collect buffs that may sometimes appear on the map. You can also build your characters around them to empower your abilities and support your allies.
  • Achievements: The game implements an Achievement system that allows you to complete collections, unlocking special items, characters, and deities for your future runs.
  • Dynamic Events: A special, condition-based event system that affects the whole map from time to time, making it more challenging to survive but also rewarding if you’re lucky.

*languages with full audio support

2105910.name: Garbanzo Quest
2105910.about_the_game:
GARBANZO QUEST! The crazy bullet-heck platformer where your main weapon is your own spit! Help Garbanzo (and Pinto if you have a buddy) save their Friends from the evil Billi' Bones and his wacky world full of hand-crafted challenges, secrets, and branching paths!

  • EXPLORE a world full of secret branching paths and weird characters!

  • PLAY through the whole game alone or with a friend!

  • FIGHT challenging bosses!

  • COLLECT Badges that give you new Powers!

  • CUSTOMIZE yourself with different hats and color palette swaps!

  • WITNESS a huge variety of lovingly crafted pixel art locales and chiptune music!

  • SPIT on everything?

  • MADE by one person?!? Wow! Are they okay?

2105940.name: Synthalaxy
2105940.about_the_game:
Synthalaxy is a top-down tactical shooter where the enemies have a series of weak points rather than traditional health. The player will have to manipulate their enemies in order to complete complex puzzles; from using enemies as a shield to making them shoot each other. Traverse worlds, take aim, and solve puzzles to save the Synthalaxy!



  • Faced-paced gameplay that will really test your reflexes!
  • Over 20 levels which will put your problem solving skills to the test!
  • An amazing atmosphere inspired by classic synthwave!



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

2105960.name: Beach Island Deluxe
2105960.about_the_game:
Explore the mysterious Beach Island with Beach Guy! Face the many challenges the island holds to collect the many stars needed to open the mysterious Gateway. Designed for both experienced players and those unfamiliar to games, feel free to take it at your own pace, take on the island’s toughest challenges or kick back and enjoy the beach!



  • Retro Open World Adventure! A completely open and non-linear experience in a charming retro 90’s style for beginners and experienced players.
  • Explore and gather all 15 stars in any way and any order you like! There's no wrong way to play!
  • Three additional stars to find! There’s new things to discover!
  • Speedrun Mode offers exactly the same experience but you’ll be timed! While this game might be short, you’ll spend hours perfecting your speedrun!
  • Full gamepad support! With dynamic control support, you can change from gamepad to mouse and keyboard on the fly!





This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

2105980.name: 会计模拟器
2105980.about_the_game:
今天上线，谢谢大家支持。收集了一些反馈，分辨率选择16：9 可以避免界面变形；其他bug也会很快修复。
还在做的内容：模拟经营部分（还没有加入）；剧情增加选择功能（目前没有选择功能，只能看剧情）；创意工坊；中级和注会题库。欢迎大家继续反馈。
新手的话，可以先看看主界面里的会计基础模块，然后再进入剧情。
*******
该模拟器交流群，224501050（第七群），264104381（第六群），946973573（第五群），728518699（第一群），905176322（会计模拟器第2群），913408119（第3群）欢迎加入一起讨论。

《会计模拟器》是一款利用游戏来系统理解会计知识的教育游戏。

目前的会计教学知识点非常琐碎，没有整体性。学生死记硬背，很难理解。而这款游戏提供了一个架空世界的公司，玩家通过管理公司，系统的理解会计概念，能极大提高学习效率，从而提高学习热情。

模拟器有两大模块，游戏和题库。游戏前半部分是新手入门，玩家有虚拟老师指导，不能自由选择业务，主要目的是熟悉业务，包括业务和三大报表动态联系；后半部分，则可以自由选择业务，类似模拟经营，玩家可以自己决策产品等，会有一部分财务分析。

入门游戏：
玩家处于架空的废土世界中，此时是2070年。玩家机缘巧合获得一家名为核平制造的公司，然后再一个向导的帮助下管理公司。向导会介绍各种业务，会有一个dashboard，能够清楚显示会计分录和各种账表之间的动态关系，玩家只需简单操作就可以完成业务，然后填写记账凭证。通过对公司业务的熟悉和理解，玩家可以理解很多会计概念。

模拟经营游戏：
玩家有了更多控制权，可以自由选择产品和业务，在模拟经营的同时利用之前的会计dashboard，理解更加深刻，同时会有一些财务分析内容，对进一步学习CPA也有很大帮助。

*************
11.20更新：游戏22日上架，但是还没有做完，内容也丰富了很多。
游戏方面增加了玩家自制剧本功能，玩家可以根据XML或EXCEL模板自己制作剧本，大大扩展了《会计模拟器》的使用范围。
增加了很多基础知识模板，用来帮助小白理解游戏所需的会计知识。
另外增加和优化了初级会计题库，可以高效率地帮助大家备考初级会计。
模拟经营这一块暂时没有太大进展，目前发布版本中暂时没有模拟经营内容。

2105990.name: Lovebirb
2105990.about_the_game:
Lovebirb is a rhythm-based dating game about finding love one date at a time. Go on Bumbirb and swipe away to meet hot and single birbs in your area! Impress them by showing your best moves to the beat of the music. Sometimes you’ll succeed. Sometimes... it gets a little awkward. But fret not! You have plenty of chances to find your perfect tempo. So keep swiping!

Featuring:

  • A one-of-a-kind dating experience! 💖
  • Lots of interesting and lovely birbs 🦆
  • The sweetest tunes to dance to 🎵

2106030.name: Hoton
2106030.about_the_game:
Hoton is a first-person psychological horror game.
The goal of the game is to get out alive from the labyrinth with puzzles and traps. To escape from different levels of rooms similar to a labyrinth, you will need to solve different puzzles.
You will have to explore every room, look for elements that will help you keep advancing throughout the game and discover new areas, but the further you go, the more dangerous it will be, you must pay close attention to the environment and avoid and run away from monsters if you want to survive .

*languages with full audio support

2106040.name: Panama Canal Clash
2106040.about_the_game:
Memorize the cards. Capture the channel. Win!

"Panama Canal Clash" is a classic memorial game with geopolitical overtones! The Panama Canal has become the scene of a confrontation between the US and China. Choose your side and play out the key events in the struggle for the strategic waterway!

Your task is to find the paired cards that symbolize the influence of your faction. But be careful: memorizing the arrangement of the cards is one thing, but winning the battle for supremacy is quite another!

Key Features:

🃏 Two sets of cards - 5 unique cards for each faction (USA vs China).

🧠 Pump up your memory - classic memory mechanics in a political setting.

⚔️ Choose your side - become the economic wizard of the USA or the strategist of China.

🎭 Vivid cartoon illustrations - memorize events with a dose of irony!

🏆 Compete with friends - who can memorize and find all the paired cards faster?

Who will become the master of the Panama Canal? Everything will be decided in the game Panama Canal Clash!

2106080.name: Infinimine
2106080.about_the_game:
Infinimine is a mining game like no other! Make your party with guildmates and friends to share class buffs and ores gained from mining. Collect 120 unique ore types as you make your way down through the depths obtaining talents, pickaxe and Lantern recipes. Once you have your basic miner leveled, choose between four other advanced mining classes each with their own special skills and buffs. With a max party size of six you too can conquer the mine.

Team Up
- With a party size of six you can fill up with guildmates, friends, or any random player you come across to help speed up your progression.
- Guilds have multiple buffs that will aid you in mining with Pick damage, Pick speed, and Ore Capacity leading the way.
- Multiple advanced classes all with their own skills: Demolitionist, Engineer, Gaetan, and the Geomancer.
- Prefer solo? You can play solo but highly recommended to either join a guild or create your own.

Loot
- Look for ores that will give you pick recipes as well as lantern recipes.
- Sell your ore and excess picks and lanterns to stockpile gold.
- Level up your guild to be able to purchase gear patterns to upgrade your armor.
- Nine armor slots to give you extra stats such as pick damage, laser damage, ore capacity, movement speed and more.

Gameplay Style
- Active: utilizing your class skills with your pick.
- Idle: Idle by letting your laser to the work for you as long as there are ore blocks it can reach.

Progression
- Make your way through the tier by completing the objective will allow you to go to the next tier
- You are able to farm the previous tiers one additional time to give you more of a damage boost.
- Farm your way where you want to work on your talents, guild levels, or for personal gains.

2106110.name: Mafia Pigs
2106110.about_the_game:
Park city has gotten too rich, and the treasures lying around are just too much to ignore. The mafia has other ideas: getting stealthy and stealling the world’s largest Golden acorn would be a real coup! But who are the best thieves in the city?

So begin the Mafia Pigs challenges: test your wits against your friends and other players online to pull off the most daring heists!

But be careful. The city guards REALLY don’t want you grabbing the golden acorn, and they’ll knock you out if they spot you! Stay hidden, avoid their vision cones and get to the prize!



Tired of getting one-shotted in the latest extraction shooter? In Mafia Pigs, use your brains and skill to trick your opponents and grab the prize - no killing allowed. KO’s put you down for a while, but you can always come back and snatch glory at the end!

Use the environment, stealth and tricks on others to gain an advantage. Each match is for up to 6 players and randomizes the goals on the map.

Find all the keys and grab loot along the way to boost your score. Use ridiculous powerups to beat your friends.



With so many thieves and grifters invading their territory, the city guards are on red alert (when not sleeping off a big lunch, that is). Try to sneak around unnoticed, but see where you can slow down your opponents by arousing suspicion, sounding alarms, and setting traps.

No players or guards can be killed permanently … the mafia doesn’t want anyone to get seriously hurt. Just a little roughing up and a few knockouts here and there are fair game!



Play with up to 6-players in cooperative online multiplayer for Mac and PC. Create your own lobbies with friends or play in public lobbies.



Play single-player tutorial missions to learn the ropes and uncover some of the secrets of the Mafia Pigs world.



Find us at the following locations on social media:

2106150.name: 琉奈と悪夢の館
2106150.about_the_game:
STORY

One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.
Inside this house,there are a strange girl and different monsters.
While escaping from monsters, Runa has to solve the mystery of the "Nightmare House",
find out why she is here and why the monsters are attacking her.
What will be her fate?

ABOUT

"RUNA IN NIGHTMARE HOUSE" is a side-scrolling gothic-style horror game.
Your mission is to guide Runa Ichiya to the exit of this house.

SYSTEM

  • Using items, solving puzzles, and playing minigames to open up your future
  • Some items are dangerous. They can bring you instant death.
  • Some monsters will chase Runa. Hide and don't let them find you.
  • There are multiple bad endings, normal endings, and one true ending.

2106170.name: Super Weapon Master 超级武器大师
2106170.about_the_game:
Super Weapon Master is an action rogue-like game where you kill hordes of enemies and face powerful bosses. Choose from powerful relics with their own unique attributes, while acquiring a variety of weapons in different styles. Enhance your character by learning related skills for weapons. Play as a weapon master, strengthen your character with gold upgrades earned each game, and unlock new characters. So as to get a better gaming experience.
-------------------------------------------------------------------

Reasonable collocation

Reasonable mix of weapons, upgrades and relic choices. Cultivate your own unique genre.
。
。
。

Adjust time acceleration at will

Click the left button to speed up or slow down at any time during the battle. Let you get a smoother gaming experience.

Freely set the aiming method of the weapon

Aiming can be set individually for each weapon. Mouse Aim or Auto Aim. Maximize weapon output.

Powerful artifact

Each artifact has a unique effect. The right choice of relics can turn your battles upside down

Super weapon

By collecting specific weapon combinations. Can synthesize super weapons. All kinds of super weapons have the strength to sweep thousands of troops. Try to choose upgrade options for the purpose of synthesizing super weapons.

Before combination

After combination

Game Features

  • More than 20 unique weapons. There are magic, firearms, cold weapons. There is always one that will satisfy you.
  • 10 super weapons. Super weapons have the power to sweep thousands of troops
  • 30+ powerful artifacts. Some relics can turn your battles upside down.
  • Over 80 upgrade options guarantee a completely different gaming experience every game

Author's words：

  • The game is independently developed by the author. A person's personal development ability is limited. But the author will try to collect feedback from players. Strive to satisfy all players' suggestions and opinions. Thanks!

2106200.name: That Golf Game
2106200.about_the_game:
Casual player? Just keep it simple!

But more advanced golfers will enjoy the ability to fine-tune their shots. Use skill points to upgrade your golfer's power, spin, shot shaping, and more!

                         

Gain the ability to fade or draw your ball around obstacles. Play a low, bounding shot if it's windy. Loft it high and spin it back. Or pitch the ball with extra spin and stop it on a dime!

Get in the hole!



If you're like us you've been disappointed with the "feel" of most golf games, especially the putting. We've worked hard on That Golf Game's mechanics, because we want it to feel "right". It should feel solid and satisfying to drop that 15 foot birdie putt!

                                

Different strokes for different folks!



Take your time, relax, and just play the shots. Play solo, or go head-to-head vs. the CPU or friends in local multiplayer. Compete in tournaments, stroke play, match play, skins, best ball, scramble, and more...

Challenge yourself with approach shot, putting, and chipping contests.

Or drive your cart from shot to shot - in timed modes, or with no timer at all... just you against the course!

                

Win medals by scoring pars and birdies before the clock runs out. Drive, run, swim... and launch yourself to cover ground more quickly!

                   

Bombs away!



Pesky tree in your way? No problem! Hit around it with a fade or draw. Or turn that tree into kindling with Bomb Mode!

                         

Gopher the gold!



Gophers are an optional hazard. They'll tear up those greens, forcing you to plan your approach shots more carefully. And sometimes you'll have to ditch your putter and chip over those gopher burrows!

                                             

Zombie mode is also optional. Play your shots with precision, to keep your ball away from randomly placed zombie clusters.

Hit it too close and you'll have to fend them off before your next shot... or try a "Quick Shot" to get out of there as fast as possible, but at the cost of accuracy! Then again, you could always chip a bomb into their midst to clear 'em out, lickety-split!

                        

Build-a-Golfer



Customize your golfer's look, with options including glasses, piercings, and facial hair. Click the "Randomize Face" button, or tweak your golfer's features with dozens of settings.

2106230.name: Vex Clock
2106230.about_the_game:
The king has passed away. The crown now entrusted in the hands of his youngest yet reckless daughter, Emmeline, has plunged all of Vex Clock into turmoil. Betrayal, false accusations and despair has driven our five plucky protagonists into taking matters into their own hands.

Run, jump and blast your way through 20+ oil soaked levels in this action packed thirdperson/FPS hybrid, where your quest for vengeance knows no bounds, but the friends you bond with will shape the final outcome.

Each character has their own weapon of choice, whether it be Lilian's long range pistol, Rosa's close quarters shotgun or Chloe's crowd control railgun. Managing your party and swapping characters during battle is the key to victory.

During your ventures, you'll encounter personal missions. These missions will challenge you by limiting your party count, but completing them will tailor the ending you get. Will you focus on one character's story or try to help as many of them as you can? Who you choose to help in combination with another can make or break their futures.

The fate of Vex Clock rests in your hands...

2106280.name: Moonbriar
2106280.about_the_game:
Rabbitkind is afflicted by the Great Culling—a divine calamity purging them through war, famine, or plague every generation. You play as Fern, a young girl living under the harsh rule of the evil Nightshade. When you're revealed as the potential Seed—chosen to lead rabbitkind through each purge—you must defy the established order and forge a new destiny for yourself and your loved ones before Moonbriar is consumed.


Engage with a diverse cast of over 25 meticulously hand-painted and animated characters in the world of Moonbriar. Befriend, and perhaps even fall in love, with these fascinating individuals. Lushly painted environments depict both the beauty and danger of Moonbriar, immersing you in a captivating world you will not forget.




Every line of dialogue and narration has been brought to life with an all-star cast of award-winning film and voice actors. Led by the voice talents of Ralph Ineson (Game of Thrones, The Green Knight, The Witch), Savannah Steyn (House of the Dragon), two-time BAFTA nominated Simon Callow (A Room with A View, Four Weddings and a Funeral), and many casting announcements to come.


Moonbriar's world teems with political intrigue and peril. You'll encounter Nightshade's supporters, freedom fighters, and self-serving opportunists. Each decision you make sends ripples of consequences throughout the world, impacting friends and foes alike. Your actions will determine not only who ascends Moonbriar's throne, but who survives the Great Culling.


Your decisions carry weight and offer rewards based on your approach. Talk your way out of challenges to gain Diplomacy, architect the uprising to earn Strategy, or display unwavering resolve to acquire Willpower. Level up these traits to create even more powerful, game-changing moments.

2106290.name: BlockUrbs
2106290.about_the_game:
BlockUrbs is a small city builder sandbox toy where you can play freely without worrying about progression, resource management or scoring. You can place variety of structures like houses, residential buildings, commercial buildings, sport grounds, industries, restaurants, trees, hospitals and roads on tiles of various sizes to create detailed and beautiful city section.

There are 3 types of tiles to choose in BlockUrbs
- Green
- Desert
- Cold



You can choose from following 5 tile sizes
- XS (4x4)
- S (6x6)
- M (8x8)
- L (10x10)
- XL (12x12)

Also, you can unlock additional structures by completing the optional objectives.

Please feel free to reach out to me for any feedback or queries. Thanks!

2106340.name: Night Flight
2106340.about_the_game:
Pixel RPG Roguelike Shooter based on ATARI games.

the Game Includes

  • Enemies with different attack patterns.
  • Mini-boss encounters
  • Level up system. Choose your own build. Tank? Glass Cannon? Utility? Your choice!
  • Secret medals. These are like achievements. They are secret.. For each one you find, you get a permanent upgrade on your ship.
  • Leaderboard with the developer's and testers high scores. Can you beat us ?
  • Beautiful and catchy 8-bit music.


Shao Indie

2106390.name: PERCNOPS VIRTUAL RIG
2106390.about_the_game:
Take the gaming experience to a whole new level and bring your favorite PC games to VR, simply connect your HMD to your pc and use your VR controllers to handle one of the virtual rigs to emulate racing wheels, yokes and game specific controllers.

Play your games without a need for game specific patches or mods and enhance immersion with appropriate rigs and virtual simulators.

Enjoy the level of optimisation that allows for use of the app with low spec PCs, discover (and rediscover) the latest titles and the classics under the light of VR.

In the current version, the user can pick an environment, a hand model, a virtual gamepad or a Virtual steering wheel Rig with a number of options, this already allows to enjoy a huge variety of PC games and car racing games, but we aren't planning to stop at that, on a regular basis, we are planning to unveil patches, extra features (game specific mappings; fine tuning of gamepad settings) and DLCs bringing immersive Virtual Rigs for Cars, Motorbikes, Boats, Planes, Helicopters and everything in between, on a quest to unlocking the most rewarding VR gameplay experiences.

Disclaimer : footage of third party games has been used for compatibility demonstration, and suggest no affiliation or collaboration nor are those games included in the product.

English*, French*, Italian*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*
*languages with full audio support

2106420.name: Magic Market
2106420.about_the_game:
Buy low and sell high! Help fund your arch-wizard overlords' research by trading potions and spells on the Magic Market. Use potions and cast spells to manipulate the market and earn even more money. But don't get caught by the Magical Exchange Commission or you'll pay a massive fine and get pushed back even further from your goal. Master this simple, yet fast-paced, strategy game by chaining spells together to maximize your earnings. Do you have what it takes or will you suffer your masters' wrath?

-Fast-paced point-and-click strategy game
-Link spells together for massive earnings
-Earn money and upgrade your spells for bigger combos

2106450.name: Brave survivors
2106450.about_the_game:
At the fairgrounds of Fallingwater in brave land, our princess Lina seems to have had an unwaking nightmare, in which her companions are imprisoned in demonic cages, only by rescuing all your companions and gaining full strength to defeat the Nightmare King can you return to reality and assist Princess Lina! ! Be a survivor! !! !

Upgrade the weapons, choose your favorite skills. Unique combination with skill and role. A 14 minutes roguelike experience, shoot with fantastic and exciting experience!!

Believe yourself and beat the boss!

2106490.name: KANZO
2106490.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding world of "KANZO," a gripping Hack and Slash masterpiece that blends lightning-fast combat with a captivating Sci-Fi Cyberpunk narrative. The once-gleaming city now lies in ruins, dominated by the ruthless organization known as MAVERICK. As KANZO, a disgraced former member seeking redemption, you're rehired by the city's rulers to reclaim control and exact revenge.



Armed with a lethal katana and an arsenal of diverse weapons and skills, KANZO is a force to be reckoned with. Engage in stylish and fluid melee combat that lets you dictate the pace of the battle, whether you opt for surgical precision or unleash a whirlwind of devastation upon your foes. The city's hostile environments are rife with violent opposition, each encounter demanding strategic finesse and a true warrior's resolve.

As the narrative unfolds, prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions and unexpected plot twists that will keep you on the edge of your seat. KANZO's journey transcends the typical revenge tale, offering a narrative experience that is as compelling as the adrenaline-fueled combat sequences. The story's climax promises a revelation that will challenge everything you thought you knew.

In "KANZO," the line between hero and anti-hero blurs as you navigate a Cyberpunk world brimming with chaos and corruption. The immersive visuals and dynamic gameplay create an atmospheric experience that transports players to a future where every swing of the katana carries the weight of justice. Are you prepared to confront the shadows of the past, unravel the mysteries of the present, and carve a path toward redemption in the shattered world of "KANZO"? The fate of the city rests in your hands – embrace the chaos, or forge a new dawn.

FINISHER SYSTEM:




Unleash the artistry of combat in "KANZO" with the Finisher System. Charge your meter through expert combos, blocks, and evasions to execute cinematic, devastating finishing moves. Each unique move, tailored to your chosen weapon, turns battles into awe-inspiring spectacles. Elevate your samurai skills, strategically time your attacks, and revel in the satisfaction of mastering the blade. The Finisher System in "KANZO" transforms every engagement into a thrilling dance of precision and cinematic flair. Are you ready to leave a trail of defeated adversaries in your wake?

HIT REACTION AND EFFECTS




Experience the pulse-pounding combat of Kanzo with groundbreaking hit reactions. In this game, your character responds realistically to every blow, featuring lifelike animations and impactful visual effects. The symphony of audio feedback and immersive particle effects further heightens the intensity, while dynamic camera perspectives and strategic player feedback make each encounter a thrilling, strategic challenge. Kanzo sets a new standard for immersive and adrenaline-fueled gameplay.

GORE & DISMEMBERMENT




In KANZO, brace yourself for a brutal and immersive experience where gore and dismemberment take center stage. With realistic graphics and physics, every encounter becomes a strategically significant act of violence, delivering a dark and intense journey that pushes the boundaries of horror gaming. KANZO is not for the faint of heart—it's a daring exploration into the macabre, offering an unforgettable ride for those who dare to enter its blood-soaked realm.

2106520.name: 私のリアルは充実しすぎている フルボイス版
2106520.about_the_game:
This game, Wataju: My Super Fulfilling Real Life!, is only available in Japanese and Simplified Chinese.
We apologize for any inconvenience regarding limited language support.

2014年リリースのPCフリー乙女ゲームが、フルボイスになって登場しました。
さらにTetraScope発行の「私のリアルは充実しすぎている　ヴィジュアルファンブック」の内容をまるごと移植！
SS・漫画等の追加コンテンツをお楽しみ頂けます。

●ストーリー
難関私立高校に入学して一年と半年。
主人公・姉崎希美（名前のみ変更可）は充実した日々を過ごしていた。

学園では常に明るく、礼儀正しく。
生徒会役員も学級委員長も学外ボランティアも積極的に務め、生徒だけでなく先生からの人望も厚い。

しかしそんな彼女にも、誰にも言えない悩ましい秘密があったのだ――（別にたいしたことではない）

いつも仏頂面で生意気な弟、憧れの生徒会長、突然やってきた転校生……
個性的なメンバーに囲まれて、今日もリア充な一日がスタートする！

●キャラクター紹介
姉崎 希美　※苗字固定・名前のみ変更可（CV.なし）
本作品の主人公。高校二年生。才色兼備な副会長として学園中の生徒から崇められている。
その人望の厚さから、厄介事を押し付けられることも多々あり少々苦労中。それでも笑顔で引き受けるハイスペック女子。

姉崎 隼（CV.大黒雄斗）
主人公の義理の弟。イケメン。
手先が器用で何でも卒なくこなす、クラスでも人気者なリア充男子。
生意気な態度をとることが多いが、基本的に姉には逆らえない。将来の夢は美容師らしい。

倉口 歩（CV.渡部康大）
突然同じクラスになった転校生。イケメン……かどうかは分からない。
いわゆるネクラで転校早々にして孤立気味。
いつもライトノベルを所持している。

星名 穂積（CV.久保拓馬）
瑞穂の双子の弟。もちろんイケメン。
しかし口も態度も悪く、瑞穂とはおよそ似ても似つかない残念な男。
瑞穂とはあまり仲が良くないらしい。

星名 瑞穂（CV.久保拓馬）
一学年上の先輩。生徒会会長。やっぱりイケメン。
いつも笑顔で、物腰も穏やか。とにかく非の打ち所のない２.１次元男子。主人公の憧れの人でもある。
主人公とは学園公認のカップル扱いをされているが、本人にその気は全く見られない。

押井 有（CV.野々井爽）
隼と同じクラスの後輩。
言動が同年代の子よりも大人びていて、主人公へのあたりも紳士的。
成績優秀な優等生。

折笠 未歩（CV.花咲芽依）
同じクラスの友達。主人公とは一年生の頃から付き合いがある。
さっぱりとした性格をしており何にでも寛容的。
わりと洞察力が鋭い。

柊 閑音（CV.清水星来）
お嬢様学校に通う一つ年上の女の子。
圧倒的な美と清い心を持つ女神である。

2106530.name: PUTIN IN JAIL
2106530.about_the_game:
Dictator and war criminal Vladimir Putin is behind bars.
Game "Putin in Jail" is a criminal simulator.
Your goal is to make the main character survive.

About gameplay:
VP has many parameters.
Weight. See that he does not lose weight or gain weight. You can see it visually.
Exercise to control your weight.
Mood. If the character fails at something, he loses points.
Hunger. If you keep him hungry he will hold his stomach, slow and in a bad mood.
Toilet. If you don't go to the toilet, your stomach will hurt and you will be in a bad mood.
If you catch flies and cockroaches, you will be given cigarettes. Smoking reduces hunger and improves mood.
There is a real-time day and night change with the ability to rewind while sleeping.
They give out food 3-4 times a day. If you don't put the leftovers back, the next time the food will be bad.
There is a radio with publicly available music.

2106560.name: Cross Tails
2106560.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the gripping tale of Cross Tails, a tactical strategy RPG set in a war-ravaged world. For over a decade, the canine Kingdom of Ranverfurt and the feline Republic of Hidiq have clashed, their deep-rooted animosity etched in the memories of their people. Now, as a player, you will delve into a story-driven plot playable from both sides that ultimately unravels the secrets behind this conflict and the influence of an ominous third power.



Engage in turn-based battles on a 3D quarter view stage, strategically utilizing the terrain and character orientation. With a vast array of characters, each with their own classes, experience the freedom of character development through class changes, skill trees, and faith selection. Unleash the potential of over 30 classes, from sturdy knights to skilled archers, and strengthen weapons and armor using powerful runestones.



Shape the fate of two nations in Cross Tails, where captivating storytelling meets intense tactical combat!

Features

  • Class Changes: Total of 24 types of classes + fixed class for every main character. Each character can have a main job and a sub class.
  • Skill Tree: All the 24 jobs have a skill tree where skills can be learned or strengthened.
  • Passive Equipment: Passive skills learned in the skill tree can be equipped. The available equippable slots increase as characters increase their level.
  • Equipment Upgrade: Weapons and armor can be upgraded by attaching rune stones that grant magic effects.
  • Faith: Different faiths, from the deity of war to the deity of business, can be selected to add bonus values to stats or special abilities.


Demo Overview

  • You can play until the end of Chapter 6 of the 'Republic of Hidiq' Story.
  • You cannot select 'Free Battles' except for the main story.
  • You can select the level of difficulty to play.
  • Save data cannot be carried over to the full version of the game.

2106590.name: Dyestributor
2106590.about_the_game:
Dyestributor!

From an aspiring duo of game developers comes an Indie puzzler that will make you bang your head against the wall! Starting with a simple concept of connecting two blocks, the game quickly expands and becomes a labyrinth of complex puzzles with branching solutions.

Progress Through Themed Worlds

Solve your way through an expanding list of thematic worlds, each with a special gameplay gimmick that sets them apart from one another. Find yourself gaining confidence in your puzzle-solving skills as you rack up Bronze, Silver, and Gold trophies throughout your playthrough! You may even find yourself high on the global leaderboard if you find a great solution!

Wide Range of Blocks

Refine your movements and navigate your way around obstacles as you master handling each block's unique mechanics, and expand your way of thinking when you come across an especially difficult level! (Yes, we swear they are all possible - we checked)

Have Fun With Custom Levels!

After a brain workout solving normal levels, give your brain a break and have some fun making devilish levels you can use to torture your friends or any unsuspecting strangers in the Steam Workshop. Then when you've mastered all of the game's levels, challenge yourself even further with the community's most complex levels!

Thank you for checking out the games page!

2106600.name: Adventures of Skye the Slime Maid
2106600.about_the_game:
After departing from his old team, the protagonist of the game: Alex Goldstone, is now a solo Adventurer exploring the land of Bromwich. He currently helps the city of Tipton with its new Guild Centre with other Adventurers that complete quests for the community.

After weeks of assisting Tipton, Alex became a respectable Guild member to the townsfolk. He's doing well at his starting point, but everything changes when he encounters a slime.

A beautiful and noisy goddess named Larissa, the goddess of life and fertility, saw Alex save the slime from a wolf attack, and he took it home.

To reward the lone Adventurer for his rare act of kindness, she transforms the slime into a magical humanoid slime maid to serve her new master.

Since it’s Skye’s new dream to be an Adventurer like her master, Alex enrolls her to become a new Guild member for Tipton.

Alex and Skye will have many missions, fight choice-based creatures and bosses, and meet new friends along the way. The bond between Alex and Skye will grow into a romance, and we'll learn more about Alex's past in this comedy-romance, drama, fantasy, and fake RPG themed visual novel. Join their quest!

2106610.name: The Smile Alchemist
2106610.about_the_game:
In Polta Kolta, a town where humans and beasts live together, the young Nayc becomes an apprentice and is training hard under the famous alchemist.
His aim is to become the best alchemist in the world for a promise made with his precious friend, but a matter of great concern is worrying him...



The Smile Alchemist is an alchemist simulator containing the fun elements of character development, collection and above all not to forget alchemy!



Features:
- An entertaining and heart-warming story driven plot
- Many characters and subquests appearing during the main story
- Additional side story besides the main route
- Collection and completion elements throughout the game based on fictional alchemy recipes and synthesis simulation
- Develop and run your alchemy listing in the shop
- Funny mini-game to collect materials, and more!

2106620.name: A Tale of Saviors: Garuda Academy
2106620.about_the_game:
A Tale of Saviors: Garuda Academy is a 2D turn-based RPG with narrative storytelling. Set in a modern world 10 years after the mystic beast war.

The world story

Ten years after a mysterious gate appeared over the world and monsters appeared in the human world called the mystic beast. Their appearance only brings chaos and destruction. After that, all countries agreed to establish an organization called SAVIORS which is gathering all mystic power users all over the world and with this the mystic beast war began. With immeasurable sacrifices and they succeed to end the war. Even so, the SAVIORS are still preparing for the worst thing, which is that 10 years ago happened again. Therefore SAVIOR prepares young people with talents and has the power of the Mystic Arms gathered in one place, namely the academy developed by SAVIORS. One of them is Garuda Academy which is in the republic of Aethos.

Game Features:



Emphasizes the importance of using strategy and making informed decisions in a turn-based battle system in order to triumph over obstacles and difficulties. Players are encouraged to take full advantage of the mechanics of the turn-based system to achieve success in their battles.


By introducing the cooldown feature for skills, players cannot spam their strongest skills, but must carefully consider their actions and choose effective skills to use at the right time. This can add challenge to each battle, and players must plan their next move carefully to win.


Every time you level up you will get bonus points to strengthen your character by distributing them. It should be noted that the points that can be distributed can be rearranged if they are not as desired and do not match the situation in the game.


If you want more skills, you can buy a mystic crest (magic) for your journey to defeat enemies.


No more random encounter battles.


Collect materials from mystic beasts, shopping, etc. to craft your items through the crafting system, This is to save you money and some of them are very useful.

2106650.name: DIVISION
2106650.about_the_game:
DIVISION is a 2.5D side-scrolling sci-fi adventure game that tells the story of a girl named Yi, who embarks on a journey to find her family as the world falls into ruin.

The home we once knew is now being devoured by an unknown force.

Mysterious mechanical beings have descended upon the land, and familiar life has been shattered in an instant.

Faced with these sudden invaders, Yi has no choice but to leave the land that once sheltered her.

She doesn’t know how difficult the journey will be;

She doesn’t know the outside world is far more chaotic than she imagined;

She doesn’t know what truths lie behind the unknown.

All she knows is that she must find her family.

Game Features

🌌 Sci-Fi Adventure in 2.5D

A fresh side-scrolling experience that blends classic controls with innovative mechanics.

🎨 Unique Art Style & Immersive Puzzles

Striking visuals combined with deeply integrated environmental puzzles create an immersive journey of exploration.

🧩 Carefully Crafted Levels & Mechanics

Every element is designed to feel distinct—no repetition, no filler—ensuring a constantly fresh and challenging experience.

💭 Emotion-Driven Narrative

Through subtle storytelling and atmospheric presentation, players are drawn into Yi’s inner world and emotional journey.

🎮 Minimalist Controls, Maximum Focus

No complex tutorials—progress through intuition and observation. Just focus on the experience.

🌍 Explore a Bizarre and Surreal World

Confront the unknown, witness surreal marvels, and gradually uncover the secrets behind this collapsing world.

All settings and worldbuilding in this game are fictional. Locations and events depicted are purely imagined.

2106670.name: Gatekeeper
2106670.about_the_game:
The Heart of Time has been stolen by Chaos’s most powerful minions.

You must follow its trail, reach the Throne Room, and face Chaos in battle. But the path won’t be easy: before the final showdown, you’ll have to defeat Chaos’s elite Sirens and the endless legions under their command. Experience sharp, unexpected thrills in this action rogue-lite!

Choose Your Gatekeeper

9 playable characters, each with unique skills to match your playstyle.

Team Up with Friends

Invite your friends to join you on this epic power-fantasy adventure!

Endless Combinations

Gain experience to fully unlock each Gatekeeper’s potential and combine their abilities with powerful artifact effects.

Find and Collect 100+ Power-Ups

Over a hundred unique artifacts with game-changing effects. Combine them into Triads and endlessly grow your combat power.

Unique Objectives

Each location features one of four mission types — complete it to summon a Siren for an epic battle.

Unique Biomes

5 distinct planets, each packed with diverse enemies and powerful bosses to defeat!

2106680.name: UnHappy Place
2106680.about_the_game:
UnHappy Place is a game that concentrates on depression. The main goal of the state is to better the main character's mental health by doing simple things, such as cleaning the apartment.

As game progresses, you will gain more energy to do more tasks at your home.

When sleeping, you might see nightmares and need to fight your bad thoughts.

To socialize your character, you can read and answer to in-game text messages.

You can also find various collectable items from your past life!

Your home and life might look more bright and colorful than you remembered when your mood is better!

2106720.name: Port Cranes : Container Age
2106720.about_the_game:
" If you're interested in wasting time, getting lost in repetitive tasks, or loading powerful weapons, you've come to the right place! "



Welcome to the crane cockpit!
Piloting a giant crane in a port is everyone's dream job.
In the 20th century, the invention of containers transformed the lives of mankind.
The giant cranes supported the container revolution behind the scenes.
Enjoy to your heart's content the dream job that changed the world!

Game Modes

In the campaign mode, you play as a crane operator in a historic port and deal with a variety of challenges.
Load all containers onto the ship within the time limit. Bad weather, military supplies, and more!
In Quick Mode, you can play Time Attack. Train your skills as an operator!

Game World

Includes multiple ports inspired by the real world!
In addition, day/night cycle and real-time weather changes are included to recreate a beautiful yet harsh world.
Enjoy the sights from the crane's cockpit 60 meters above the ground!

2106730.name: Phantom Hellcat
2106730.about_the_game:
All the world's a stage

A mysterious theater holds a sinister secret: demons imprisoned inside, guarded by a lonely overseer. When one of the seals loses its power, evil forces abduct their guardian to another dimension. All that's left behind is her rebellious daughter, Jolene.

Though her mother's craft is a tough act to follow, Jolene must master it in no time. She must use magic masks to navigate through different deadly plays to upstage a mysterious Trickster and save her family.

Break a leg

Jump into dynamic hack-and-slash combat in vibrant but treacherous fantasy worlds interwoven with a theatrical setting. Slide, dash, and push forward to reach a grand finale.

No time for stage fright!



Key features:

  • Engage in visceral combat with laser-sharp controls—ensemble powerful combos to take down enemies in epic boss fights, and use your surroundings as a weapon
  • Disguise yourself with upgradeable masks—their power will give you new abilities
  • Experience platforming from different angles—3D and 2D perspectives mix on every level
  • Traverse various stages inspired by pop culture—visit a dark Transylvanian castle and more
  • Discover the secrets of the theater—replay levels to find collectibles and hidden treasures
  • Grow in power—use a skill tree and choose your strategy

2106760.name: The Burrito Quest
2106760.about_the_game:
THIS IS A SHORT GAME

You are high and your burrito is gone.
Why is there a party in your house?
Meet a whimsical cast of charachters to unravel this mistery and achieve your juicy goal.

Burrito Quest is a short comedy game where you have to find a burrito by exploring a house full of silly NPCs.
In this first person game you are able to walk and talk, like in real life yoh.
Navigate your way between colorful dialogues to unlock your final reward.

2106770.name: Morris Cave
2106770.about_the_game:
This is a retro-style 2D platformer with suspenseful elements. You must find the way out of this cave without getting caught by the monsters and traps that appear unexpectedly with each new level.

Main objective is to share a little about the sensations experienced by a person suffering from panic and anxiety disorders as a form of empathy and awareness (based on my personal experience).

Easy to control

It's better to look around!

Agility and precision

Checkpoint System

Features

  • There are 20 levels with different enemy and trap combinations
  • Each level has a timer to record your best times
  • Torches are used as checkpoints to help you out
  • Special effects of lights and cameras
  • Alternate controls (using WASD or Arrows)
  • Two types of jumps: normal and double
  • Various enemies with different moves
  • Beware what comes from the darkness, there are hidden traps!

2106810.name: The Forest of Drizzling Rain
2106810.about_the_game:
■ABOUT THIS GAME
First released on "Freem!" October 11, 2013, the exploration horror game The Forest of Drizzling Rain is now coming to Steam with a full remake!
Playing as Shiori Kanzaki, you will get to enjoy her visit to Azakawa Village, right up until you are plunged into a world of fear.
Every aspect of the game, from the story to the visuals, has been updated in this compete remake of the original from nine years ago.

1) More endings to choose from, including bad endings with story lines at every turn, even from very beginning of the game. There are additional late game ending routes and even a special scenario for players who conquer all of the endings.

2) A second chapter has been added in the middle during which you can freely walk around the map of beautiful Azakawa Village. Chat with some of the more colorful villagers, or spend your time fishing in one of the minigames while enjoying this new scenario.
Who knows, maybe Shiori's accomplishments during the day will have an effect on her nighttime conversations with Suga.

3) Meet new characters with new story lines. There are many completely new additions to the story that never appeared in the manga or novels!

4) Enjoy the same polished finish and delicate attention to detail found in later titles such as Angels of Death, with newly rewritten conversations and events, and a complete remake of the map.

5) the Taking Spirit is a shocking new scenario which paints a deeper picture of the sad truth that has haunted Azakawa Village for the past several hundred years.

And that's not all. This full remake definitely has plenty to offer.
Even veterans of the original freeware version are likely to find themselves repeatedly diving in to enjoy the refreshing new gameplay.

One unassuming female college student, one tiny village, and one long night filled with incomprehensible fear.
Why don't you try exploring Azakawa Village, and perhaps you can expose the hidden truth while you're at it.


■STORY
All alone following the death of her parents, Shiori Kanzaki happens to run across an old photograph in their bedroom. In that photograph, which bears the unfamiliar inscription "Azakawa Village," is a young Shiori with her parents, along with another man old enough to be her grandfather.

Shiori goes looking for that village and pays a visit to the local museum, where she meets Kotaro Suga. Suga, the museum curator, strongly urges her to leave the village immediately.

When Shiori continues exploring Azakawa Village, a secret truth gradually comes to light. What will her reaction be once all is fully revealed?


■PROFILE
Makoto Sanada
Makoto Sanada is a Japanese video game designer. His debut title, The Forest of Drizzling Rain, drew lots of attention when it was first made available on the Internet in October of 2013. And it continued to grow in popularity as translations appeared from volunteers in countries all around the world. His next game, Angels of Death, released in installments by Game Magazine (formerly NicoNico Game Magazine) starting in August of 2015 and continuing until the following February, saw an anime adaptation and went on to become a big hit. Together, both titles have garnered a wide fan base of all ages with their various multimedia releases including novelizations and comic adaptations.
Crossing the boundaries between entertainment and literature with their sensitive character portrayals and bold plot lines, Makoto's stories have become hugely popular among fans both young and old.


■Remake Version of The Forest of Drizzling Rain Streaming Guidelines
Game Magazine shall support secondary creation activities, such as the creation and distribution of manga, illustrations, original products, novels, and live videos, regarding the products made by vaka, Inc (hereinafter "the Company"). Through the secondary creation activities by fans, we wish to disseminate the attractiveness of individual products to many people.

Therefore, we do not require individuals who perform secondary creation activities regarding the products made by the Company, which are general fan activities, not for profit (creation and distribution of self-published magazines, the posting of works on video or illustration sites) to obtain advanced confirmation from the Company or to inform it thereof. In addition, we do not require individuals who register secondary created products for the creator encouragement program (Niconico), or use on paid channels and YouTube channels obtaining advertisement profits to obtain advanced confirmation or to inform it thereof.

Individuals or companies considering secondary creation activities for profit, which are not applicable to the above, shall inform us thereof via the Game Magazine Inquiry Form in advance.

We sometimes receive requests from people to regulate specific individuals' secondary creation activities. Please understand in advance that we use such opinions as reference; however, we are unable to promise a response or reply to individual requests.

2106820.name: Picot Ether
2106820.about_the_game:
プレイヤーは『Ｒ－ＢＯＷウイルス』が蔓延した都市の診療所医師となり、抗ウイルス薬の開発に勤しみます。
日々進化続けるウイルスは、その特性も様々。
患者の治療には効能の高い薬を投与するだけではなく、その変異に応じて適切な処方箋を用意する必要があります。

まずは冒険者を雇い、探索地から素材を取ってきてもらいましょう。
それらの素材で薬を調合し、診療を行えば少しずつお金が貯まりますので、
病床の拡張や素材庫の拡張など、各種アップグレードに使用して、経営を軌道に乗せます。

調合レシピを見つければ、より多くの薬を調合できるようになります。

薬は投与実績を伸ばすことで『スロット』が開放され、
その特性を一部、他の薬の空きスロットに継承することが出来るようになります。

こうして自分オリジナルの薬をデザインし、その時の流行ウイルスに対応した万能な薬を調合していきましょう。

市中に蔓延するウイルスの終息には時間がかかるかもしれません。
効率的に診療所の運営と新薬の開発を行い、一日も早く、元の平和な世界を取り戻しましょう！

ストーリー


Ｒ－ＢＯＷウイルス―

かつて世界に蔓延したと伝わる災厄が、ここ海洋都市イシュワルドにて流行の兆しが見え始めました。
街の医師として働くユメルシアの診療所には今日もひっきりなしに感染者が訪れます。

『先生、熱が出て身体がダルく……』『先生、身体が痛くて夜も眠れません……』

ウイルスは変異によりその特性を進化させるため、症状も様々。
ユメルシアはこの国の一大事を、なんとかしなければと考えました。

そうして、家の書庫から代々伝わる古文書を引っ張り出してきたのです。
この古文書にＲ－ＢＯＷウイルスを終息させるヒントが隠されているのだとか……
そう、彼女の祖先もまた、かつてＲ－ＢＯＷウイルスと対峙した医療従事者だったのです。

『私が抗ウイルス薬を作り、みんなを守らないと！』

古文書に書かれていた名前は『ピコエーテル』。
それはその昔、今世のウイルスから世界を救った、調合薬の名前でした。

2106840.name: PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo
2106840.about_the_game:
Solve an ancient mystery in this horror-adventure visual novel game

PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo

How far would you go to bring someone back from the dead?
In Japan, whispers surround the tale of the "Seven Mysteries of Honjo."
A mysterious 'Rite of Resurrection' leads to conflict between those who have the power to curse...


This unsettling tale takes place in the Sumida Ward of Tokyo, Japan, in the late 20th century.
Unravel the hopes, dreams and fears of these unique characters who find themselves in the grip of deadly curses, as their motivations intertwine in a story that twists and turns.
Lead the story to its conclusion by your own hand!


Shogo Okiie, an ordinary office worker, visits Kinshibori Park in the dead of night with his friend, Yoko Fukunaga, to investigate a well-known local ghost story: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo.
Shogo doesn’t quite believe Yoko when she talks about how the Mysteries are connected to the Rite of Resurrection and doesn't pay it much mind - that is, until strange events begin to unfold before his very eyes.
Meanwhile, several others are making their own investigations into The Seven Mysteries...
Detectives investigating a series of strange deaths, a high-school girl seeking the truth behind her classmate’s suicide, and a mother who has sworn revenge for her lost son.
Their desires and motives intertwine and interplay, with the Seven Mysteries of Honjo at the core, leading the story towards a battle of wits and curses.


◆ Conduct investigations in Showa Japan; depicted through immersive, ambient 360 backgrounds.
With the full support and cooperation of Sumida City Tourism Division, the local museum, the tourist association, and the local community, real-life scenery from Sumida has been photographed with a 360° camera and recreated as photo spheres that cover the entire sky and surroundings.

◆ Unravel the mysteries of Honjo through investigation and conversations with many interesting - and suspicious - characters.

◆ Be sure to pick up all crucial clues, and choose your movements carefully - or you may just meet your demise!

◆ Explore a story that twists and turns through multiple points of view and find ways to reveal new pieces of information.

◆ Navigate strategic gameplay and choose to either deploy your curses at the opportune moment, or risk being cursed yourself.

2106910.name: Gods Of Defense
2106910.about_the_game:
Gods of Defense is a Roguelike Tower Defense set on a procedurally generated map.

Every run is new

The God stands at the center of the map on top of a Temple. Enemies spawned from the gates will attack the temple. You will build towers to kill the enemies. After every wave you will push the enemy gate farther into the unknown revealing more of the map.

Deck building

Every few waves you will receive Boon cards from the Goddess of Fortune. These cards will give you new towers or extra perks that boost your defense.While you want to collect as many Boon cards, you want to avoid Curse cards. These are invoked by the Evil through the Corruption mechanic.

Some enemies carry corruption trails that infect the towers on the way. When Corruption exceeds certain limit, the evil will invoke Curses. You must learn to avoid corruption or to mitigate the consequences of Curse cards. This aspect brings a novel variation to a typical tower defense strategy.

Roguelite Progression

When enough enemies have breached the temple, it will fall. Whether you win or loose, you can keep the Faith you've earned during the run. You can use it to unlock new towers and boost their abilities.

Gate Bosses

In each run you will face a number of bosses, once you have pushed the enemy gate far enough. As you reveal the Gate Boss, it will go berserk and spawn a torrent of enemies. Each gate comes with its unique challenge. You can choose to engage immediately or postpone it if your defense is not ready for it.

Resource Management

The gameplay also involves production and management of resources which aid your defense - Gold, Mana, Prayers, Matter. Each feeds into a different strategic device and opens up numerous possibilities. After you've mastered the art of defense, you will learn to build beautiful Monuments. This will exercise your resource management skills.

Variety

There are 40 battles to play. Each battle happens on a new map every time you play it. You can replay each battle to earn extra rewards and win Trophies by completing challenges. At any point, you have multiple options to make progress. This eliminates the typical grinding.

Extra fun

GoD also features two fun mini-games. A physics based mini-game lets you earn extra faith by using the surplus resources you collected during the run. A jigsaw puzzle that helps you compose the final vision.

2106930.name: SOULHOT
2106930.about_the_game:
SOULHOT is a high-octane action game that blends parkour and FPS elements, putting you in the shoes of a relentless individual who refuses to bow to a corrupt system. He will stop at nothing to bring it down.


Soulhot is a physics-driven adventure set in a mysterious dystopia. You hold a personal vendetta against the Zen Corporation — a force that controls the world and has driven humanity into starvation. You’ve infiltrated their towering headquarters, completely alone. To survive, you'll need to rely solely on your weapon skills and intelligence. Good luck!

  • MASTER THE PHYSICS SYSTEM

    Every object and weapon within the Zen skyscraper operates under an advanced physics system. Be creative, manipulate your environment, and find clever ways to traverse between floors.

  • DEFEAT RUTHLESS SOLDIERS

    Each floor is guarded by elite forces equipped with heavy weaponry. Use the physics system to your advantage and outsmart your enemies with skill and ingenuity.

  • UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES

    You've made it deep into Zen Corporation’s headquarters. Now, you're completely on your own. Each floor reveals new experiments, hidden secrets, and psychological challenges. Are you ready to face the truth?

Fly, Build & Share! Take control of a paper plane and soar through a variety of levels that will challenge your skills and reflexes. The gameplay is easy to pick up, but difficult to master - so get ready to put your skills to the test!
