2107030.name: Block Fortress 2
2107030.about_the_game:
BUILD A FORTRESS, AND DEFEND IT TO THE END!

Block Fortress 2 lets you build an impenetrable fortress in almost any way imaginable, then puts you in the action trying to defend it! Place walls, turrets, traps, and tons of other specialized defenses to build your base. Choose from dozens of guns and equipment, build an army, and join the fight to defend your stronghold! Put your skills as a builder, commander, and fighter to the test as you try to fend off the relentless enemies of the Blockverse!

BUILD AND DEFEND YOUR BASE!

Build your base using dozens of different turrets, walls, and other special blocks. Defend against attacks from four different enemy races!

JOIN THE BATTLE!

Choose your equipment, build an army, and join the battle in action-packed first- or third-person combat!

CREATE AND SHARE YOUR OWN LEVELS!

Set up massive battles or intricate stealth missions. Build obstacle courses or giant worlds to explore. If you can imagine it, you can build it! Then share your creations and download others for endless replayability!

CONQUER THE BLOCKVERSE!

Build a home on your command ship and explore 10 different planet types, each with unique dangers!

FEATURES

  • A unique mix of block-building, tower defense, and FPS/TPS gameplay!

  • Complete freedom to build your base however you want, from towering fortresses, to sprawling castles!

  • Build more than 200 different block types, including powerful turrets, shield generators, farms, land mines, teleporters, zip lines, and more!

  • Equip your character with tons of weapons and items, including a rocket launcher, mini-gun, plasma rifle, jet pack, and more!

  • Choose and deploy an army of specialized soldiers to help you fight!

  • Survive a dynamic day and night cycle, severe weather, lava, acid, alien monsters, and other environmental hazards!

  • Several game modes, including sandbox, missions, and survival 

  • Extensive mission builder allows you to create and share your own levels!

  • 10 different planet biomes to conquer, each with their own hazards!

  • Take a break from combat and get creative building a home on your command ship 

  • Upload and share your creations and download others!

2107090.name: KitHack Model Club
2107090.about_the_game:
Welcome to KitHack Model Club! From the creator of the original Kerbal Space Program and a tiny team of just three dedicated developers. KitHack Model Club combines state-of-the-art physics with endless customization options that will see you and your friends bringing your wildest RC creations to life.

With the opportunity for limitless adventure and built from the ground up for multiplayer, KitHack Model Club is the ultimate model-building platform.




Be it a plane, boat, car, or an ingenious hybrid of all three, you can construct anything you can imagine by simply attaching parts together in the Vehicle Editor. Give it wings, wheels, engines, rockets, paintball guns and more; then really make it your own by adding paint and decals.

And your every design decision counts! Even the slightest tweaks you make on your vehicle will influence how it handles, as the simulation takes its actual geometry into account for aerodynamics, buoyancy, wheel friction and everything else.

Show off your creation by taking it into multiplayer matches with up to 16 players, or share it on the Steam Workshop, to join an ever-growing collection of player made vehicles.




Explore the diverse and colorful landscapes of beautiful Wirraway Bay. Test your mettle with challenges, or free roam with friends across the island with your unique creations. The ideal environment in which to perfect your craft awaits the adventurous modeler. Just watch out for traffic and pedestrians!

Play KitHack Model Club exactly how you want to play. Craft your own missions and challenges with the powerful Scenario Editor - a fully-featured gameplay authoring tool which gives you complete control to create your own game modes. In fact, this is the same tool the developers themselves use to create missions.

Challenge community members and flaunt your ingenuity by publishing your missions on the Steam Workshop, or just explore the limitless gameplay possibilities from the community-made collection.




KitHack Model Club was built from the ground up to support modding. You can add custom content including new parts, maps, and even entire new features, then share it with the community via the Steam Workshop.

To help you get you started, we’ve got an SDK package including tools and examples, plus an amazingly friendly community where you can chat with other players, creators and even the developers themselves.

Have fun out there, KitHacker.

2107100.name: Quantum Gravity
2107100.about_the_game:
Get ready for an electrifying space adventure with Quantum Gravity! This neon-styled bullet hell action game will have you blasting your way through space, using your wits and skills to survive against all odds. With a variety of game modes to choose from, Quantum Gravity offers a thrilling and unique experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.



For the ultimate test of your skills, try Infinity Mode. With infinite levels that increase in difficulty, Infinity Mode is perfect for players who want to push themselves to the limit. Battle against a wide variety of enemies, including bosses and tough melee combatants, and see how far you can make it in this hardcore game mode.


Customization
Quantum Gravity offers an extensive customization system, allowing you to upgrade your health, ammo, and damage with in-game credits. You can also choose from over 15 different skins to personalize your gameplay experience.


Let's check out something else too...



Gravity Mode adds a whole new dimension to Quantum Gravity's gameplay. In this mode, you can invert the player's mechanics and the gravity of the objects around you. This creates a uniquely complex experience that requires careful planning and strategy. You'll need to stay on your toes as you navigate this treacherous environment and face off against enemies that can move in any direction.


Multiplayer Mode
Challenge your friends and compete in thrilling PvP rounds with up to 7 players. The rules are the same, but the action is always different, making for a dynamic and exciting gameplay experience. The mode is fully customizable and can be modified by each client to create new and interesting game modes.


Campaign Mode
Embark on a challenging campaign featuring unique and engaging levels. From defending hostages to destroying targets and solving puzzles, Campaign Mode offers a wide range of gameplay experiences that will put your skills to the test. You'll have access to all the equipment of a bullet hell shooter, and the action never stops – with every update and event, the Campaign Mode changes to suit the occasion, making the experience infinitely replayable.

With simple controls and logic that anyone can understand, Quantum Gravity is the perfect game for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun way to pass the time or a hardcore gamer looking for a challenge, Quantum Gravity has something for everyone.

So what are you waiting for? Blast off into space and start your adventure with Quantum Gravity today!

2107130.name: BirdsBorough : Town of Alchemy
2107130.about_the_game:
*THIS GAME IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED, unfortunately this game did not receive the funding we needed to continue working on it and bring it to the quality we wanted. We appreciate everyone who supported this project and we're still proud of our first commercial release. BirdsBorough has been made free for anyone who enjoys the game or is curious to continue playing.*

After mysterious events a run-down potion shop has found it's way into your possession! The people of BirdsBorough have many unique problems for you to solve but you can create just as many unique potions brewed with various properties and powers. As you grow close to the people of BirdsBorough you may learn more secrets of this mysterious town you find yourself....

Combine 27 unique potion effects using a colour mixing alchemy system. All effects have can be combined by matching their effect colours in the cauldron and mixing them all together! All potions drastically effect those who drink them!

Solve NPCs unique problems, all NPCs have procedurally generated dialogue, so they'll always have something unique to say and unique problems to solve! It's up to you to figure out which potion would best help each NPC.

Build your own potion store with various decorations and structures, in whatever way you want! As you collect funds from potion sales you'll be able to build you're own store in a large plot of land in the town, however you see fit, will you create an ominous monolith? A simple market stall? Or something else entirely! It's all up to you!

Grow and harvest multiple unique plants, from elder trees to death blooms, all of which will affect your potions in different ways!

2107150.name: SlaveCorporation

"Justice" was her calling.
And she also had another mission, to find her missing "friend".
　
One day, she gets some intel on her friend, but then...


● "Kaori Saionji"

If she takes too long or fall for a trap...
She'll be taken in for questioning... Then...

If she gets caught, there's no way out...!
Will she succeed and come out on top, or fail miserably? Only time will tell...

2107170.name: Beyond the Mountains
2107170.about_the_game:
Uncover a vast land filled with secrets, monsters, and ancient myth in BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS, a top-down action RPG about a lost soul who uncovers a mysterious secret. Stranded in a foreign land and armed only with your wits and curiosity, you will collect items, unlock secrets, and fight ferocious monsters.

Fifteen years ago, King Leo braved Zanarik, Brother of Darkness, atop the Tower of the Gods. Where King Leo disappeared to is anyone's guess. Will you be able to solve the mystery?

A STRANGE LAND

As Peter, you will slowly uncover a vast mystery as you attempt to save the world of Evalon from unthinkable destruction.

EVERY INCH UNCOVERED

Use every item you can find in dungeons, caves, and the large handcrafted overworld to map an entire continent full of secrets. With dozens of enemy types and hundreds of puzzles, you will have to use every trick in your arsenal to stop evil forces and save the world of Evalon.

A COLORFUL CAST

The world of Evalon is stocked with colorful and crazy characters, each with their own unique desires and motivations. It never hurts to talk to each person you meet!

WHAT LIES BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS?
  • Explore a handcrafted overworld filled with intricate caves, tunnels, hidden paths, and overarching dungeons
  • Fight multiple enemies and bosses using a variety of weapons and items you will collect on your journey
  • Explore beaches, towns, deserts, mountains, swamps, and a city of the dead
  • Battle your way through a volcano, flooded lighthouse, abandoned factory, and much, much more
  • Take a break from the action with fishing and minigolf minigames
  • Get into shenanigans with a goofy trading sequence
  • Immerse yourself with an original soundtrack of over 50 songs and hundreds of unique sprites and tiles
  • Choose from Super Easy, Hard, and Speedrun game modes

BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS is a passion product of over a decade. I have lived with these characters and concepts for many years, and am excited to finally share the world of Evalon with you!

-Eric

2107180.name: The Hungry Fly
2107180.about_the_game:
Once upon a time, in a swampland dreary, a fly awakened, weak and weary. Possessed of hunger, it set out on a search to find a morsel, a corpse, to stop starvation. But there was no death to be found in the swamp, only tormented life. It journeyed on, meeting strange creatures living in the swamp, ever sadder and more tortured, until, by chance, it happened on something delicious. 

You are the fly. Play as the dirty, filthy, corpse-eating fly on a mission to devour a monster living in a bath in a house far away.

Meet grotesque, surreal inhabitants who will ask you to do surreal and horrible things. Do them and eat horrific things to sate the fly's hunger for dead flesh. Then restart the tale and choose a different path through the story, eating your way to three different endings.

Be the fly. Explore. Meet depressing caterpillars. Experience a disturbing tale of existential horror. Welcome to the next brainchild of the creators of The Repairing Mantis.

• Skill-based combat system with dozens of spectacular execution moves

• Swords, spears, bows, axes, maces, magic wands - an arsenal of weapons and armors

2107270.name: Closed Island
2107270.about_the_game:
Closed Island is a classic RPG.

Emmeline, a young graduate of the school of magic, is waiting for her first real test: frightening rumors come from the distant Mareon about monstrous monsters and rising undead.
And as it turns out, those rumors were true...



Many residents have fled their homes, hoping to find salvation, and the few who remain speak of terrible things happening all over the island.
This test will not be easy...



Help young sorceress Emmeline overcome her first real test! Fight hordes of monstrous monsters as you roam the cursed island of Mareon, where danger can lurk at every turn! You have to embark on a long and dangerous path, step by step clearing the cursed island from evil. And she will be helped in this by witchcraft and the remaining daredevils, ready to share supplies or valuable information. And yet, more than once she will have to risk her life...




- Complete the quest chain;
- Collect coins and upgrade Emmeline's abilities;
- Kill monsters and free the island from evil!

The player gets under his control a character who explores the location. On his way there are obstacles in the form of opponents (monsters) of varying degrees of complexity. By destroying opponents and collecting valuable items (coins), the player can improve the characteristics of his character. The goal of the game is to clear the island of monsters and complete the quest chain.


And remember: the legions of the undead will do everything they can to stop you.
Head to Mareon, and don't forget to take your magic gear with you!

2107280.name: LAZ3RZ
2107280.about_the_game:
Join the Discord! -

The Future

2107290.name: Pixxxel
2107290.about_the_game:
Pixxxel is a game where you can immerse yourself in the colorful world of platform games, but far from simple ones. You have a huge number of obstacles that will not leave you alone. Unique levels and traps, time dilation mechanics - what else do you need to enjoy the game?



You will start the level again over and over again, but doesn't the difficulty make it more fun to complete the level? Of course it is! Four types of locations and constantly emerging new traps will never let you get bored.



Start your passage and try to keep within the shortest period of time, will you succeed? As the saying goes, you never know until you try.
good luck with your passage!

2107300.name: Back to Home
2107300.about_the_game:
The game tells the story of Mila, a wolf-dog who wakes up one day in a cold gorge on top of a mountain without remembering how she got there and has to find her way back home, fighting not only against the hordes of monsters that will stand in her way if not also with her own fears and instincts, which will put her to the test in order to achieve her goal.


Back to Home is a game that mixes the best of classic games like castlevania and souls like, with a touch of RPG elements, where the combat is challenging and will make us die over and over again without mercy.
Travel alongside Mila through fantastic lands between ancient frozen caves, sinister swamps and deep lakes drawn by hand in a “dirty-pixel art” style.

Characteristics


  • Brutal Combat: Slay enemies with the power of your mighty claws, or unleash devastating new special moves to annihilate the threats that come your way.
  • Non Linear: Freely explore the vast world among forgotten paths, and mysterious places through which you will find your way home.
  • Epic Boss Battles: Going home is tough and in order to make it you'll have to defeat particular giant and ominous creatures that will try to stop you. Study and learn their movements to achieve victory over them.
  • Search and find: The world is full of hidden treasures, some will undoubtedly support you on your journey and thanks to Mila's refined sense of smell you will be able to get hold of some to make your journey more bearable.
  • Lean on your Dog Tags: Plates that provide strange powers and abilities. Choose them well to be even more powerful!

Projekt Everblood is a 2D top-down action game set in an alternate World War 2. You control an escaped prisoner of war who was experimented on by enemy scientists. Exact brutal revenge on those that took you hostage using your vampiric abilities of flight, feeding and deadly fury.

English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*

2107460.name: Steel Wound
2107460.about_the_game:
Kill monsters, earn money and experience, spend money on better gear and experience on better stats, then crush your friends or the AI and try to win before they can.

Step into the waraji of a samurai from a minor clan, sent out by his daimyo to slay the evil corrupted dragon that has stirred up the yokai and caused chaos in a small province of fantasy Japan. A wealth of honor will be bestowed on you and your clan should you succeed, but failure equals cold, hard death. Between you and the dragon stands a horde of yokai, bandits, ninja, and even rivalling samurai who want nothing more than to step over your dead body and beat you to the goal.

Features:
  • Play solo, or with up to four players in local or online multiplayer
  • Earn xp and money to level up your character to be able to take on bigger challenges
  • A variety of different items and services that can help you, or hinder your enemies
  • Visit one of four different locations in which you can spend your money on equipment, healing, items, and other services (or just gamble it all away)
  • 17 different enemies, including three boss-type encounters

2107470.name: Zero to Hero
2107470.about_the_game:
Embark on a journey from Zero to Hero in this exciting and challenging turn-based tactics game. Set in a 1960s game show, you'll be armed with powerful superpowers, facing a series of obstacles and overcoming challenges along the way. Emerge victorious and keep your powers for good.

Each game offers new strategies to explore, with a vast array of upgrades to choose from. Take a chance by engaging in battles without upgrading, or play it safe and upgrade to increase your chances of survival. Make the most of one-time use potions to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Create your own legend by generating comic books that capture your heroic exploits. Take your skills to the next level with incredible mutations that offer new ways to play.

Step up to the challenge and become the hero you were meant to be in Zero to Hero, the turn-based tactics game with infinite replayability.





Each run, your character will gain different superpowers. Test your skills and challenge yourself to win with each power, or go for an even bigger challenge and try to win with all combinations. With over 100 combinations to discover, the possibilities are endless. The powers work differently, and your strategy will depend on the strengths and weaknesses of your two selected skills. Make clever use of mutations to modify your powers and enhance your abilities.



Embark on a journey of endless possibilities with the unpredictable mutations in Zero to Hero. Transform your powers and abilities by unlocking new and diverse mutations that can drastically alter or enhance your existing powers. With each new run, the mutations available to you will be different, forcing you to adapt, improvise and make the most of the mutations you receive. Experience a game unlike any other, where every run is a unique and thrilling adventure. Get ready to face the unknown and become the hero you were meant to be.



Beware of the game show hosts, who will stop at nothing to prevent you from becoming a hero. Each host has a unique arena with custom mechanics, and you'll need to improvise and adapt to overcome their challenges. Whether you're on the defensive or pushing your advantage, the excitement never ends in Zero to Hero.

2107480.name: Hypogean
2107480.about_the_game:
Welcome To Hypogean! Prepare For War!

Hypogean is a 2D action rpg with a heavy emphasis on story that bolsters a unique combat system allowing for flexibility and player expression. With the ability to sacrifice subordinate's, equip core's like knockback or stun to your sword and shield allowing for creativity in your future boss encounters.

Protect Your Kingdom Against Invaders! Pick From 6 Different Cores!

With 6 different cores Slow, Stun, Fire, Poison, Stat Up, and Knockback available your gameplay style is always changing. Spend your free time exploring the city and world while completing mini games bettering the life of your citizens or going on social events with your subordinate of choosing.

Hypogean, a community of humans that have lived peacefully underground until they received an offer from a neighbouring kingdom Avian relating to their abundance of energy sources that could lead into war! Use the cores given to you by those who have put their faith in you to succeed.

Sacrifice Your Subordinates Or Fight Alongside Them!

A world only has limited resources, yet those of us living would rather lead a life of comfort compared to one of reservation. When those limited resources start thinning out only those with a strong will and army can survive.

2 Different Endings!

It is up to you, the Prince of Hypogean to decide whether protecting your people’s resources is priority or to sacrifice their leisure lifestyle for the benefit of others. Traverse the crumbling lands learning skills from those around you while also befriending the animals in the wild in this 2D RPG, develop yourself into one who could even defeat a Hero.

2107520.name: Krimson
2107520.about_the_game:
Krimson is a challenging gritty rhythm platformer featuring heavy electronic metal music. You're an unknown spawn moving through a hellish world as it shifts rhythmically to the music. One wrong move means death but the checkpoints are often, and death is very short.

Hell hath rhythm and only the ones who can dance with it can conquer it. Platforms, obstacles, hazards, objects, and rules change in synch with music, the heart of this game. This game is an interactive industrial electronic techno dubstep metal album so prepare your finest headphones for this one; your ears will thank you for it!



The game takes place in four settings;
A blood-soaked organic and demonic setting filled with red all over, complemented by dirty distorted electronic tunes,
A sharp, filthy, grungy, and ruthless industrial setting accompanied by grungy industrial musical madness.
A psychedelic LSD-fueled acid trip that just gets trippier with techno, acid and dubstep beats to bang your bloody head to 'till you don't feel your neck.
And a brain-melting, eye-piercing, hot molten metal madness of fire and lava with the most brutal destructive devastating argent metal to melt your eyes too.


You will not get comfortable. The game demands your attention. It's a challenge of your skills, your mind, and sometimes, your patience. Get comfortable with not being comfortable. But that's a price worth paying for those willing to conquer hell itself.

2107540.name: Seafrog
2107540.about_the_game:
Seafrog is an action-platformer mashed with the movement of lite-skateboarding. Grind, kick-flip and find the flow with a rocket-powered wrench that moves smoother than a buttered beluga!

A SEA-SLICK PLATFORMER

String together combos by using a simple auto-trick system, landing grinds on enemies and rusty pipes to fuel up your rocket-wrench! Use the fuel to boost through enemies, fly straight up walls, and stick to ceilings in order to complete over 100 handcrafted challenges!

EXPLORE RUN DOWN SHIPS

Each chapter in Seafrog is based on a ships theme. Battle vengeful Viking ghosts aboard the Sea Dragon. Dig in for an unsavory meal aboard the Chunky Chacken, where you’ll discover a man-eating chicken outbreak. Finally, get ready for some monkey business at The Sweater Factory, an abandoned workshop run by an unexpected crew of apes causing all the ruckus. Each chapter holds a Master Gear, guarded by an ultimate boss.

MASTER GEAR, HO!

Battle the legendary Skraken, Metal Beak the Momma Chacken, and... Gerald. Face these colorful 'n crusty foes to retrieve the Master Gears and repair your cannon. Blast yourself to a stranded seaplane to escape the seahole, a mysterious sinking hole in the ocean… before ye end up in Davy Jones' Locker!

FEATURES LIST

  • 10-14 hours of story campaign featuring three boss encounters to test your moves.

  • Interact with a colorful cast of characters suitable for all ages.

  • Collect and Combine 24 Mod Chips to customize your play, adjust them for a more relaxed experience or crank up your stats for more speed and challenge.

  • Scour every room to uncover over 120 hidden Snakestones.

  • 16+ hours to 100% item collection in every map location.

  • Full controller or mouse and keyboard support.

  • Optimized for the Steam Deck.
2107540.reviews:
“Seafrog is the kind of indie gem that dares to do something different, and totally sticks the landing”
Ladies Gamers

“Inventive gameplay, charming visual style, and brilliant level design”
33bits

“A frenetic action platformer, packed with content, full of charisma”
Criticas Frikis

2107550.name: Valley Peaks
2107550.about_the_game:
Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and climb once in a while, you could miss it.

Get Roped In

Escape the daily grind and journey to Valley Peaks where you can soak in the serene mountain landscape, set in a miniature open world. Climb Mount Shroom, the tallest point in Valley Peaks, or take a stroll through Roston Ranch where the geese may even let you pet them!



Between climbing sessions you can get cozy with colorful froggy friends and enjoy minigames like Mortimer’s Boat Race or head to Bone Hill and partake in a Pumpkin Hunt! Or even explore the world collecting Golden Mushrooms - they gotta be used for something right?

Peak Performance

Challenge yourself to a new climbing mechanic that tasks you with honing your skills to overcome various challenges, such as swinging spikes, prickly vines, and much more. Don't worry - if a frog can do it - you can too!

Go Go Gadgets!

Unlock an array of gadgets, including a Glider that lets you soar from one peak to another or a Specialized Tongue to help you stick to those hard to reach spots. We don't recommend trying to talk when you've got a mouthful of mountain though. Use with caution.

Highland High-Fives

Valley Peaks is created and developed by Thomas Crowe and Jack Chateau-Loney, two Scots passionate about frogs. “We are excited for players to hop in and embrace the froggy lifestyle. Because let's face it - life's too short to NOT be a frog!”
2107550.reviews:
“There's something intensely satisfying about climbing, and Scottish indie devs Tub Club have bottled that up in Valley Peaks.”
PC Gamer

“Valley Peaks is a special game that you think is over quickly, but keeps on going”
Six One Indie

“Valley Peaks features an adorable, hand-drawn, and very colorful art direction, with cute frog inhabitants”
8/10 – Couple of Gamer

2107580.name: Amazing Maze
2107580.about_the_game:
Amazing Maze brings new elements and challenges to the classic "roll a ball" genre, in a colorful, fun and pleasant experience, where you must capture the crystals and find the way out, in beautiful 3D mazes. Use your creativity and logical thinking to overcome obstacles or use them to your advantage. Be quick and put your name on the top of the leaderboard!


Transform your sphere to gain special abilities like a speed boost, jump or climb walls. Each level will require one or several skills and you'll need to know which one to use and when


You are not reading this wrong! Perform wall run and wall jump feats with your sphere and overcome obstacles in style :)


There can be several ways to complete the same level, one of them is through physical interactions: push, break, accelerate, fly...

2107590.name: Magic or Machinations?
2107590.about_the_game:
Design your own character and choose their personality with a dialogue between you and a sentient AI drone in the middle of space. Then wake up in an open-world desert and try to find your way home by discovering new abilities and using them to cross time and space.

Find the passcodes and where to submit them to progress in the story.

How the story unfolds will be left entirely in your hands. So choose wisely.

2107640.name: Bleeding Metal Rainbow
2107640.about_the_game:
WARNING: Bleeding Metal Rainbow contains flashing images. If you experience epileptic seizures or blackouts, immediately stop playing Bleeding Metal Rainbow and consult your doctor before resuming.



Hi I'm Travis. I made this video game. I'm publishing this unfinished before the company I once worked for distorts and redesigns my work, making it totally unrecognizable. Long story short, before planning to put in my 2 weeks notice, I decided to pitch a big project of my own. Shovel Software loved it so much they gave it full funding and with me in control of production. I started fleshing out the concepts and designs, then started programming the game. Two weeks into the project, all of sudden I get called in the office and the boss fires me. This left me no choice but to delete everything but the final level, leaving it unfinished. It was the only level they'd seen and I didn't want them to finish what I started.

I worked for Shovel Software for 13 years and was immediately terminated two weeks after pitching this project. I wonder if its because they found my resignation draft in the actual project. I've programmed and designed hundreds of quick-money grabbing games for this company, making them millions and I'm the clown thinking working above and beyond gets me up the chain. You can work hard and dedicate all your energy to a place that doesn't care about you. I should've known this was going to happen. They can't win this time. I can't let them. They may have all my ideas and projects but I'll fight till the end! I for once am taking control of me, my life, my soul. I gave them my time, my energy, my money. I'm all I have left.

This shoot 'em up piece is about focus, and not giving up. Not much to say about gameplay, but do notice the patterns, learn to dodge quickly, and position yourself for some sweet strikes! Oh, and there's also a time score to see how fast you completed the game!

2107650.name: Guardian of the jungle
2107650.about_the_game:
About this game


This game is a kind of tower defense Beat'em Game. The core game is the horizontal shooting game of tower defense. Players need to choose the direction of team growth, allocate resources to improve team growth, and all character attacks will consume ammunition. They also need to consume resources to provide ammunition support for each team member, so as to maintain a stable fire output. Kill monsters in a limited time. The less time it takes, the higher the reward. There are many kinds of ammunition to choose from in the game, It's the most refreshing place in this game to dump ammunition and bombard the enemy

Interactive communication


You are welcome to leave your comments. I will carefully listen to the comments and feed them back to the subsequent game production. You can also add friends of the author. Other works of the author will be presented and distributed irregularly through this channel

2107710.name: Flowers of Satsunai
2107710.about_the_game:
Flowers of Satsunai is a simple yet challenging puzzle game embraced by gorgeous artworks, melodic songs, and charming tales. Enjoying the delightful adventure in story mode, combining careful planning and swift executions in survival mode, and cherishing the romance of your beautiful companions in memory mode, the choice is yours.

Journey to a fantasy Japanese-inspired world

A simple escort quest with the enigmatic priestess Kyoko nearly costed two young hunters, Kichiro and Nanami, their lives. A bloodthirsty mutant was the last thing they expected along the way. Joined by the greedy doctor Yui and the stoic samurai Akane, the party traveled to Satsunai searching for an artifact to subdue the monster. What they found in Satsunai was beyond their wildest imaginations.

Indulge in the vibrant canvas

Lovingly painted and carefully selected, the arts and music worked in harmony to bring the colorful world of Flowers of Satsunai to life. From the intrigued samurai armors to the subtle sound of shrine's bells, every little details were cared for.


Achieve the true ending with your skills

Increasingly challenging puzzles will be overcome by planning on what powerful spells to get, casting and combining spells, and making cleaning chains with swift reactions. Each maiden in the party had her own motivations and reasons to participate in the adventure. Your excellent puzzle-solving skills will uncover the girls' feeling and unlock one of the six possible endings.

Replay to your heart content

The tale might end, but the fun has just begun. With enough affection earned during the story mode, your lovely companions will let you know more about them and allow you to relive your special moments in the memory mode. In the endless survival mode, you can enjoy the adrenaline rush against time while putting your puzzle-solving skills to the test.

2107740.name: Freestyle Mage
2107740.about_the_game: In the Farend Neverland, the line between the Inworld and the Outworld is becoming more and more unstable because of some mystery power. The Ancient Crack Guardian 'Mornode' is missing, and you as the only student of Mornode will take the responsibility to stand up and break through the attack of Crack Devils. Dive into the Inworld to trace the footprint of Mornode, build your own magic combo style to fight, reveal the mystery of Cracks, and make use of your own battle style to challenge strong and unique Crack Lords.

2107770.name: First Time in Hawaii
2107770.about_the_game:
Say 'Aloha' to Hawaii!

Kate and Nicole Robinson hit up Hawaii for a very special occassion: the wedding of their good friend Stella!

Kate’s journey to Hawaii is more than just a vacation—she’s on a mission to help Stella have the most unforgettable wedding ever! Explore stunning Hawaiian locations, uncover hidden objects, and participate in fun mini-games that capture the spirit of the islands. Whether you’re discovering local secrets or helping with wedding preparations, every moment in Hawaii is a new adventure.

Features:

  • Unlimited Mode: Revisit your favorite Hawaiian spots anytime.

  • Achievements: Unlock and showcase your progress.

  • 30+ Mini-Games: Enjoy a variety of tropical challenges.

  • Downloadable Extras: Get wallpapers and the full soundtrack.

  • Hawaiian Fun Facts: Learn interesting trivia as you play.

Discover the handcrafted hidden object locations and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of Hawaii in First Time in Hawaii. Embark on this tropical journey and explore all that the islands have to offer."
2107770.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Portuguese - Portugal
2107770.reviews:
“I consider the First Time series that BoomZap has developed to be a pure HOG.”
Mause Reviews

highlighted.localized_name: I Came, I Sightsaw, I Wrote
highlighted.name: I Came, I Sightsaw, I Wrote

2107780.name: Sokoboxes Duo
2107780.about_the_game:
Sokoboxes Duo: True Cooperation & Puzzle History

If you’re a puzzle fan, you probably know Sokoban. It’s one of the simplest logical games ever created, yet surprisingly challenging.

What happens when a fan decided to expand the game’s core nature to a warehouse that requires two workers to organize? That’s where Sokoboxes Duo begins—taking the genre into brand-new territory.

🧩 Puzzles with Two Buddies

In Sokoboxes Duo, the 115 duo levels were built from the ground up to require two workers. The second character is always a buddy who helps you, never an obstacle that gets in your way.

  • 84 levels by the legendary Aymeric du Peloux.

  • 31 levels by other expert authors.

This is a true novelty: puzzles that demand real cooperation where every character has an essential role.

👁️ Proper Visuals for Focus

When a puzzle is easy, graphics don't matter. But when you hit a “knot” and try to solve it, distracting visuals can make your head spin.

  • Built for Focus: Our graphics are clean and optimized to be easy on your eyes.

  • No Eye Strain: Everything is clear at a glance, so you can focus on the logic without getting tired.

📖 A Story with Heart

Inside the game, a high-quality comic tells the story of our characters: the lovable Penguin, the peaceful Bear, and the agile Neko. You'll learn how they met and why they decided to work together in the warehouse. It adds a sense of adventure to the logic.

🎓 The "Solo Path"

We’ve included a collection of 522 solo levels as extra content. I brought them together so you can play all of Aymeric’s levels (both duo and solo) in one single game:

  • 223 levels by Aymeric du Peloux.

  • 262 levels by Evgeny Grigoriev.

  • 37 levels by other expert authors.

🎯 Why is it fun?

After you solve a puzzle, the game saves your step count. Later, you can watch your solution again and try to beat your own record.

The real joy comes from finding solutions with fewer paths and breaking your own record. You aren't racing others—you are refining your own logic.

✅ Why Sokoboxes Duo?

  • 115 Duo + 522 Solo Levels: Enough content to keep you playing for over a year.

  • For Every Skill: Levels are sorted from "Beginner" to "Ultimate."

  • Made by Fans: A love letter to Sokoban.

2107800.name: A Halloween Valentine
2107800.about_the_game:
A Halloween Valentine is a puzzle-adventure pop album set in a haunted amusement park on Valentine's Day. Solve logic puzzles while bopping along to original songs with lyrics to find the way back to the love of your life!

  • A myriad of logic puzzles akin to those in Zelda games
  • 10-track pop album soundtrack by Monster Mansion
  • A spooky amount of puns!
  • An adorable and charming 3D art style
  • Comedic dialogue and characters
  • A queer love story
  • Up to 3 hours of playtime





The soundtrack is by the game's Creative Director Jacob Leaney, aka synth-pop artist Monster Mansion. The first single 'Call On You' is OUT NOW on all music streaming services!

2107810.name: Marine Survivors
2107810.about_the_game:
Marine Survivors is survival game. maybe.
Just try to survive from alien's invading. If you withstand enough time.
If you're lucky, HQ might come to your rescue. Or not.

Please Join Discord Server for feedback!
Check Discord Server link on the right of store page.

Contents in the Early Access version.


Only support Mouse and Keyboard.

Use Right Mouse Button to Aim. and WASD for moving.

Each weapon was designed for a different purpose.
So, Try to find good weapon combinations.

Tips.
  • Move efficiently in the beginning. Don't waste your bullet.
  • Get EXP Gem right away after killing alien.
  • You may need knockback weapon to avoid aliens approach.

2107820.name: NULL [Remastered]
2107820.about_the_game:
You are trapped in a mansion with 8 other people and forced to play a game with some "Werewolf/Mafia" elements except the consequences are very real. But wait, that's not all, every time you die in the game you are sent back to the start of the loop forever trapped in a hellish game with no means to escape.

But fear not, you're not alone. "CC", a strange girl who seems to also retain her memories after each loop, is also seeking an escape.

Would you two be able to escape this hellish nightmare or would you be forced to repeat the same loop over and over again for all eternity?

Who's this "Zero" person and why is she forcing you to play this sick game? Why does your character have hollow creepy eyes and barely talk?

Discover not only the truth about this twisted game and your universe but also the terrible truth about "YOU"!

2107860.name: Yggdra Union
2107860.about_the_game:
"Yggdra Union" released in 2006
It has evolved with each release on various platforms, and finally appears on STEAM! !

Adjust the operation method and functions according to the PC!
Added new features for the PC version! !

[Game contents]


■ Story
The Kingdom of Fantasinia is ruled by a royal family that inherited the blood of the gods who built up a stable era.
However, the Kingdom of Fantasinia fell under the attack of the Empire of Bronquia.
Meanwhile, Yggdra, a lone girl who escaped
With her kingdom's last hope in hand, head to the remotest land on the southern tip of the continent.
She arrives and meets a boy, the king of thieves, Milanor.
The battle to liberate Yggdra's homeland begins with that encounter...



■Collaborate with allies! "Union system!"
A battle system that allows up to 5 people to participate in battle at once depending on the character's position!
Let's fight together with allies to defeat the powerful enemy!

■One-shot reversal tactics card!
Use the power of cards with special moves to defeat your enemies!
Skillfully use various effects and face difficulties! !


《Added content in the ported version》

[Porting additional function]

  • Added a rewind function (you can undo your actions as much as you like)
  • Added auto save function (Even if you quit midway, you can start from your favorite turn)
  • Added conversation log function
  • Added item hints to EXTRA content (Hints are given on which stage the item is on)
  • Addition of battle speed adjustment function (you can play at up to 5 times speed from the beginning)
  • The unit [Flunky] will participate under certain conditions! (What if Flunky achieved results in the first stage...?)
  • Sound set function! (You can play by choosing from 3 types of sound sources)

[Trick function]

  • A function that makes Milanor look like Cruz (Milanor will play an active role as a hunter)
  • Enemy/Allies no critical function
  • Skill gauge MAX at the start of battle (skill gauge starts at MAX state only for own army)
  • Formation type reversal function (Male and female formation types are reversed)
  • The trick function is to press a specific button appear. The appearance method is described in the manual.

《PC Version New Features (Additions and Changes)》
  • Japanese voice / English voice can be switched (easy to switch at any time during the event)
  • Addition of free save (You can now save freely during battle)
  • Infinite use of items in EASY mode (Items can now be used indefinitely only in EASY mode)
  • Equipment removal (equipment can now be removed in the middle)
  • Adjustment of Itmbreak (weapon does not break with Itembreak and is unusable)
  • Completely compatible with in-game mouse/keyboard/controller
  • You can adjust the layout of the keyboard buttons.

2107870.name: Jade's Adventure
2107870.about_the_game:
Jade's Adventure is a fantasy turn-based strategy game.
The player has to become the main character Jade and build an army of various monsters through farming, production, and trading.
In limited time and resources, defeat the enemy with various armies!

The main character Jade falls into Midgard while stealing Asgard's stuff.
We don't know what she stole, but everyone in the world is sending troops for her.
To survive, she tries to form an army of monsters in various ways to cope with enemies chasing her.

Farming, producing, trading, and ingratiating with monsters! Offer what they like, and they'll join your army.

2107920.name: Mystery Solitaire. Dreamcatcher 2
2107920.about_the_game:
One girl dived into the world of dreams and visions to uncover the secrets! But the world of dreams is not as simple as she imagined... This is boundless and dangerous place! If you don't wake up in time, you can get stuck there forever. Help the sleeping girl protect herself from evil spirits, explore fantastic locations and find out all the secrets of the dream world!
An unforgettable adventure with lots of complicated card layouts awaits you! It requires some effort but you will do it!

- Prove yourself, do your best to complete all levels!
- Solitaire card game – collect chains of cards!
- Never a dull moment with super exciting levels!
- Vivid graphics and a Pirate soundtrack make this Solitaire a win-win!
- Get rid of cards faster with jokers, and increase the combo multiplier to earn more coins!
- For daring players – special tasks and over 15 colorful trophies!
- Let the fun take over!

2107930.name: Star Spectre
2107930.about_the_game:
Star Spectre is a single player space combat game with tons of exploration and numerous RPG elements.
You will be free to explore and trade, as well as fight in a vast galaxy.


“Little is known of what led to the destruction of the Earth, save that a terrible war swept the face of the planet and reduced the entire landscape to ashes and rubble. Billions perished, and the survivors found themselves desolate. The only structures to survive were the great space stations located off-world. Over time, over the years, search parties were sent down to gather up the remainder of humanity. Engines were built, and one by one, starship after starship left for uncharted space.
When the fledgling colony ships came again into habitable space, the innumerable colonists were more than ready to settle down. Planets were settled, terraforming operations began, and civilization exploded. Cultures were formed, some grown from memories of Old Earth, and some created fresh for the new galaxy. It was a time of peace, a time of exploration, a time of wonder, and a time of joy.
Once more, time passed. Soon enough, the galaxy began to fill up. Rival cultures that had once been able simply to avoid one another began to bump shoulders once again. Conflict came again to the galaxy… And like Old Earth before it, no one knew quite how to handle the upcoming war.”
You will play as a “Freelancer” in a post-colonial era space. As the game progresses,
you will gradually learn about what is happening within and between the numerous factions.



Fast and furious battles play a main role in Star Spectre, which can let you experience the large-scale interstellar combat you ever dream about.
Combat takes up a large proportion of the whole game, the smooth combat process, the choice of various fighters and the different scenery of each galaxy make the whole game fun to fight.


Star Spectre offers you a huge variety of space fighters.
Each faction has its unique fighters, which you can make your choice base on your personal preferences.
And with different weapons and equipment, you can play through the game with your personal style.


The game has a perfect trading system with hundreds of goods.
Travel as many locations as you can through the universe and try to be a slick space trader.
The principle of trade is as simple as you can imagine, buy low and sell high.
Each space station has different kinds of goods and different prices, and if you have been to enough places, the price differences among places will at a glance.
Trading between different factions is the most profitable way. But of course, it also means you're taking greater risks.



You are free to choose between the various factions. You can either choose to help the four major galactic governments to fight the crime, or you can also be the crime itself. Of course, you can also be uncontested, maintain neutrality and focus on trade.
During the game you will receive quests from one of those factions, after completing them, you will increase your relationship with that faction. However, you need a neutral position to keep receiving quests, and you can always look for a hacker to modify your evaluation record. Of course, this will cause you a certain amount of money.
Many of those factions are connected to each other, if you have a friendly relationship with a faction's alliance factions, the relationship with this faction will also improve, and vice versa.
Therefore, it is impossible to keep all factions stay friendly to you.

2108060.name: The Ramsey
2108060.about_the_game:
The Ramsey is a 2D platformer with cute squirrel characters living on a planet comprised of six huge islands. Players can explore various areas by solving mazes and puzzles using the Cotton Gun, a special weapon wielded by the playable squirrel Ramsey that makes objects float in the air. Ramsey came to Earth aboard a Space Running Wheel from the faraway planet of Chipmars, and now shares tales of his adventures back home with his hamster friend, Cheese. Climate change caused by the greed of the evil inventor rendered all of Chipmars near inhospitable to the native rodent population. Find out how Ramsey fought this catastrophe, and why he came to Earth.


- A 2D platformer with exploration and solving puzzles using various weapons.


- Unique gameplay utilizing the state-of-the-art Cotton Gun from Chipmars.
2108060.supported_languages:
Korean*, English, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

2108080.name: Anant Shrankhla
2108080.about_the_game:

2108180.name: Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy
2108180.about_the_game:
Swordhaven is an old-school cRPG inspired by classics such as Baldur's Gate, Arcanum: Of Steamworks and Magick Obscura and Gothic, combining modern quality-of-life features with a strong focus on player freedom, complex roleplaying, and a deep, lore-rich story set in a low-magic world reminiscent of 17th-century Earth.

Shipbound and travelling to Nova Drakonia, a mysterious, dinosaur-infested frontier of the Empire, you soon find your journey is anything but ordinary. A chance encounter with a fellow passenger entrusts you with a mysterious, possibly arcane artefact, gradually turning your mundane voyage into an exploration of your world's hidden past and leading you towards decisions that may shape its future.

Swordhaven's setting is crafted with meticulous attention to detail and realism, weaving a rich tapestry of lore that gives the world a truly lived-in feel.

From the sprawling politics of the colonisation-driven Empire to the local rivalries of nobles, clergy, and restless natives; from centuries of forgotten history to intricate religions and cults; from unique cultures to elusive races long thought to be myth; and from otherworldly plots to secrets yet undiscovered... everything awaits you, if you choose to seek it.

What makes Swordhaven unique, beyond its world-building, are the systems we've honed over ten years of indie RPG development.

The classless roleplaying system gives every stat and skill a meaningful niche, allowing for limitless character builds. Extra treasure and hidden secrets reward the observant; dialogue and lore favour the clever; intimidation and brute force empower warriors; and rogues have countless opportunities to bluff, steal... and more.

The battle system can seamlessly switch between classic turn-based strategy and dynamic real-time with pause, letting you play your way. Over a hundred weapon techniques, both readily available and hidden, as well as hundreds of weapons, armours, and unique artifacts provide for an astonishing number of builds.

The world features hundreds of original NPCs, each with their own portrait and extensive branching conversations written with wit, style, and personality.

The party system lets you recruit colourful companions, each with their own dialogues, skills, and personalities, ensuring they have something to say about most of what you do. Make poor choices, and some may even leave your side!

Craft weapons, potions, armour, and more, or hunt for rare recipes hidden across the world. Hundreds of weapons, pieces of armour, and other items await creation by you or your handy companion.

The UI blends classic design with modern customisation and attention to detail. Every item, from legendary artefacts to mundane gear, features hand-painted icons and lore-rich descriptions.

Explore countless mechanics: dig, mine, brew, craft, learn from books, roleplay through storybook-style text encounters, battle savage monsters, study combat techniques, discover artefacts, sneak, pickpocket, pick locks, and more... enough to keep you on your toes for 85+ hours of gameplay.

The world is vast, varied, and non-linear. Forge your own paths across the continent, explore the frontier city of Swordhaven, lose yourself in the wilds, delve into ancient dungeons, or open gateways to strange dimensions; all without ever feeling constrained by plot rails. There are dozens of distinct locations to discover and explore!

Adventure calleth, and Nova Drakonia awaits!

Venture forth and see it for yourself.

We shall expect you on these yellow sands…

2108800.about_the_game:
As a small Indie multiplayer game, matchmaking with a small player-base is always a challenge. That is why Synchronicity implements "Cloud Turns". When playing matchmaking games, do not expect to play them in one go, but rather over the course of a couple of days.

You will get notified whenever there is a new turn for you; as will be your opponent. That is not to say that there won't be the occasional match that is played live, but it probably will be the exception.

For playing live games, I encourage you to invite your friends or join the discord and find people to play with that way.

Synchronicity is a tactical turn based game. Maneuver your Units to outsmart your opponent and use their special abilities to the greatest effect. The game is split into two phases, planning and execution:

Each round you can plan up to 3 actions for each of your 3 Units. Have them move across the map, Shoot along a certain path, overwatch a specific area or use one of their special abilities.

Once both sides have submitted their plans for the round they get executed at the same time. Then you'll find out how well you anticipated your opponents moves of it its all falling apart.

Any online game you start, both Matchmaking games or custom private matches, can be played synchronously as well as asynchronously:

  • Synchronous gameplay is what you expect. Both players are online at the same time. Whenever both sides have submitted their turn you get to see the result can plan your next moves.

  • Asynchronous gameplay means that your opponent does not need to be online for you to play. Any plans you submit are saved in the cloud. If your opponent has already submitted their turn you get to see the result and can submit your next turn to the cloud.

       

  • Notifications are send whenever it is your time to make the next move. You can register for either notifications through Steam or Discord.

  • Synchronous turns: Plan 3 steps in advance while your opponent does the same.

  • Asymmetrical multiplayer: Opportunistic hackers vs righteous megacorp? Idealist revolutionaries vs malevolent corporate overlord? Pick your side!

  • Destructible and penetrable environments: Predict enemy positions and just shoot through the wall! Need a different angle? Breach some walls!

  • Instant Replay: Missed something? Look at what happened in the last round again. Any detail can give you an edge!

  • Practice Puzzles: Get to know the special abilities and mechanics with fun little Puzzle levels!

  • Practice AI: Want to get used to the game without pressure? Try practicing against the AI!

  • Cloud Games: Turn any game into an asynchronous cloud game. Don't have time to finish the game in one go? Come back later, the game will be waiting for you.

The game was developed over the course of >5 years by me and myself: Simon

Special Thanks to Jazz Mickle (queenjazz.gay) for allowing me to use her track "super violence" in the Trailer

and also a huge thanks to all my playtesters for the great feedback!

2108840.name: REDDOOR
2108840.about_the_game:
In REDDOOR, the player is immersed in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. The objective is to survive solo against endless rounds of the undead by strategically opening and clearing doors and using a variety of weapons, perks, utilities, and power-ups. The player earns points from killing zombies, which can then be used to purchase guns, perks, and unlock new areas, or turn on the power. The zombies enter the player's space through special "RED DOORS", and the game will end when the player dies.



To make the rounds a bit easier, the player can occasionally find power-ups such as resupply, nuke, max ammo, time skip, instakill, rapid fire, and shadow upon the death of zombies. These power-ups can give the player an edge in survival. The player can also upgrade their guns using the upgrade station and rarity station, making them stronger for high rounds.

10 Power-ups:
Max Ammo: Refills all ammunition.
Nuke: Instantly kills all zombies on the map.
Shadow: Grants temporary invisibility.
Resupply: Provides a full resupply of grenades.
Time Skip: Skips forward in time, advancing a round.
Rapid Fire: Temporarily increases firing rate.
Instakill: All shots are instant kill for a duration.
Vampyrism: Killing zombies restores health.
2x Points: Doubles points earned for a duration.
Sale: Temporarily reduces the cost of items.



Additionally, the player may stumble upon hidden Easter eggs scattered throughout the map, unveiling special abilities or secret weapons that can turn the tide of the undead onslaught. These hidden gems, when discovered and activated, add an element of surprise and excitement to the gameplay, rewarding players for their exploration and keen observation.



Randomly the undead will drop scrap, which the player can use for ammo or upgrading a weapon for a better rarity. As the increasingly challenging waves of undead become more formidable. Its important that you upgrade your weapons to the best rarity to not only enhances your survivability but also ensures that you are well-equipped to face the evolving zombies. In addition to upgrading weaponry, wisely allocating scrap for ammo becomes crucial, especially during intense rounds where ammunition conservation is key.



Players can also find the mystery box which is a random weapon generator. It contains 40 weapons at 5 different rarities. When bought a random weapon is rolled it also encourages players to take risks and adds strategic depth to their decision-making, as they must adapt their gameplay style based on the weapon they receive. Whether it's a powerful legendary firearm or a more common weapon, the mystery box introduces an element of chance that keeps the survival experience dynamic.





40 Weapons: A diverse arsenal of 40 different weapons.
Weapon Upgrade/Rarity System: Weapons can be upgraded and have different rarity levels.
Weapon Skin Customization: Players can customize weapon skins with 200+ weapon skins dropped randomly from leveling up.



6 Maps:
ENIGMA
DEMO
REDFALL RETREAT
REDFALL
STALK
ARTEMIS



5 Gamemodes:
Survivor: Standard survival mode.
Gungame: Progress through a series of weapons.
Timed: Survive with a timer.
Speed+: Enhanced zombie speed.
Chaos: Start the game with 25000 points and at round 10. But be aware there are twice as many zombies.



11 Perks:
Life: Second life.
Health: Improves overall health.
Reload: Reduces reload time.
Agility: Enhances player movement speed.
Spread: Affects weapon spread.
Damage: Increases weapon damage.
Blast: Explosive resistance.
Trigger: Improves firing rate and makes single fire / burst weapons automatic.
Magnet: Attracts nearby scrap and power-ups.
Vision: Highlights enemies.
Frenzy: Increased melee damage and reach.



2 Different Currencies:
Points: Earned from killing zombies, used for purchases.
Scrap: Secondary currency for specific upgrades or purchases. Drops randomly from zombies.



5 Grenades:
Standard Grenade: Basic explosive grenade.
Impact Grenade: Explodes on impact.
Distract Grenade: Distracts zombies to a location.
Frost Grenade: Freezes zombies in an area.
Fire Grenade: Deals fire damage over time to zombies in an area.

2108950.name: Mice Tea
2108950.about_the_game:
Mice Tea is a story-driven visual novel full of emotion, romance, and a woman turning into a mouse. Or sometimes a mink. Or sometimes... well, there's a lot of different things she and her friends turn into.

Margaret de Campos is a young clerk at a local bookstore who needs some change in her life. Her job feels like a dead end, her love life is in a rut, and she's not happy with how she looks. All of that is upended when she stumbles upon a box of magical tea with the tendency to transform people into anthropomorphic animals. Depending on your choices, the lives of Margaret, her friends, and her coworkers are irrevocably changed as the story leads to several wildly different paths. Help Margaret find love and a deeper understanding of herself and her... proclivities by reading Mice Tea!

Features

  • Four romanceable characters, both male and female, each with multiple transformations and multiple endings

  • Tons of fetishes including anthro transformation, gender bending, body expansion, size play, bondage, exhibitionism, femdom, and more

  • Over 100 fully-illustrated images of transformation, intimacy, and action

  • Fully expressive characters, each with multiple outfits, including shoes. They're off screen most of the time, but trust us, they're there!

  • Original soundtrack with over two dozen tracks

  • Loads of accessibly options, including screen-reader support, content guidance, and SFW toggles including the ability to skip sex scenes

  • This VN is super queer

  • There's also a straight guy. He's really nice!

2109010.name: 求闻编年史 ～ Gensokyo Recollection
2109010.about_the_game:
游戏交流QQ群：915841393

这是一部怎样的作品？

这是一部集成了东方正作、东方旧作、蓬莱少女绘幻想、西方系列等ZUN各个时期的作品的世界观，以九代阿礼少女为主角展开的宏大叙事向东方同人RPG：
拥有过目不忘能力的稗田阿求因一场噩梦丧失了所有前世的记忆。
为了探寻自己的记忆，稗田阿求跟随幻想乡众人踏遍幻想乡的每一个角落，重新见证幻想乡的历史。

如何操作？

方向键移动：支持八方向
鼠标左键/Z/Enter/Space：确认/对话/调查
鼠标右键/X/ESC：退出
shift：奔跑或缓行
D：查看图鉴
P：打开凭依界面
Q：查看任务
F：合成
Tab：打开小地图（方向键移动）
ctrl：快速对话
A：自动对话

战斗机制介绍

本游戏战斗使用半即时制，伤害使用物理/魔法百分比减伤。
敌人一回合能够行动多次，技能以角色物理/魔法数值的倍率为主。
存在完全凭依、光环、倒计时、瞬发、弱点等多种机制，等待玩家探索。

为何免费发布游玩？

本游戏目前为抢先体验，从剧情展开上计算仅为预计最终成品的五分之一。
其美术、音乐、程序的工作量远不是一人能够在短时间内完成，目前还有很多素材仅允许免费游玩。
笔者希望能够尽快完成这个游戏，因此发布抢先体验版，让感兴趣的朋友能够看到本游戏的概念与潜力，加入到我的开发团队中。

最后，感谢您能阅读我想讲述的故事。

2109030.name: Don't Fraud My Heart!
2109030.about_the_game:
Don't Fraud My Heart (DFMH) is a visual novel made entirely in Microsoft Powerpoint. It is a romantic, financially literate adventure that brings you into the exciting world of tax auditing. You play as the newest member of the tax auditing team, identifying occurrences of fraud, waste, and abuse! As you endeavor to make the world a better place, will you find true love amongst your office equipm- coworkers?

Your choices include:

Sepia-chan (pronounced like CPA)
Rorodexu-chan (based on a Rolodex)
Shiaru T (Based on a CRT monitor)
Emily Fox (Based on a fax machine)
Kakuro-tan (Based on a calculator)
AND FEATURING: Bernadetta Madon

Each girl has her own challenge associated with her, making every choice a unique adventure!

Sepia-chan

Sepia-Chan is a dedicated financial employee. Though she lacks the aptitude for identifying many instances of fraud, she is intimately familiar with the many of the filing and administrative SOPs. She has several reports of unprofessional conduct, but her willingness to oversee new hires until they are placed in specialty departments makes her an invaluable asset. Her peers consider he one of the warmest and most inviting coworkers. Most forgive her for her lack of propriety.

Kakuro-tan

Kakuro-Tan is widely regarded as one of our best employees across all manner of testable standards. Though she has been noted to have a snappy retort here and there, she is extremely dedicated to her work and her behavior is generally accepted as a biproduct of her zealous commitment to tax fraud. Able to juggle managing her team of supervisors and heading a specialty department by herself, she has been recommended for advancement on more than one occasion. She has declined every offer for promotion extended to her. Kakuro-Tan insists on continuing her father’s work in the company. She is the daughter of the late Abakassu-San, one of the founders of the company.

More biographies to come in the next few months~

“Don’t Fraud My Heart” was in made in collaboration with our dear friend and incredible artist David Loebman. You can check out more of his work on his Facebook or Instagram @ArtofDavidLoebman!"

2109060.name: Magenta Horizon - Neverending Harvest
2109060.about_the_game:
"Soar over Purgatory and reap all the foes."

From solo developer Maddison Baek, Magenta Horizon is a fast-paced 2D action platformer, with gameplay inspired by spectacle fighters, and a world designed to look and feel like a living prog-rock album cover. Test your skill with it's vast, stylistic, expressive combat options!

Act 1 out of all three acts is freely available as a demo.

The save file is transferable to the main game.

  • Combat Freedom: Begin with a fully unlocked melee system. Learn at your own pace as you master expressive, stylistic combos and unique playstyles.

  • Perfect Positioning: Juggle and pogo enemies, while utilizing environmental hazards for efficient crowd control and maximum lethality.

  • Risky Maneuvers: This game encourages an aggressive approach. Keep moving, weaving in ranged skills and healing bombs to mitigate damage taken.

  • Spectacle Fighter: Earn style points and aim for the prestigious Triple S rank by slaying enemies swiftly and creatively.

  • Difficulty Options: Choose from 5 escalating difficulties transforming stage layouts and enemy compositions to push yourself to the limit.

  • Personalized Playstyle: Experiment with the flexible Necklace system to further cater to differing combat preferences.

  • Dangerous Denizens: A volatile and diverse roster of horrific enemies and bosses ensures fresh and challenging gameplay throughout.

  • Exploration: Features large, intricate, surrealist arenas with fluid movement tools for traversing challenging terrain.

  • Soundtrack: A highly varied OST blending prog-rock/metal with jazz, disco, and orchestral influences to compliment the intense action and surrealist environments.

You play as Gretel, a reaper in this twisted purgatory, exiled for 200 years. After being freed from her sarcophagus by a wandering soul named Archibald - Gretel seeks purpose in her afterlife - guiding Archibald back to the sanctuary she was long ago exiled from. This journey will be along a perilous path, fraught with all manner of grotesque demons starving for souls.

2109270.name: Preserve
2109270.about_the_game:
Preserve is a puzzle nature-building game that takes players on a journey into a harmonious ecosystem. The objective is to foster and sustain a thriving and diverse biomes, where each component coexists in a symbiotic harmony. By utilizing strategic thinking and a keen eye for balance, players are granted the power to position a wide array of plants and animals, curating an environment that caters to their preferences and aspirations.

In Preserve, you can expand the map not only horizontally, but you also posses an ability to stack layers of nature, forming a vertical network of interconnected habitats.

From alpine forests and savannas to carribean reefs, each biome will have its own unique set of plants, animals, and environmental challenges to discover and overcome.

Besides regular harmony and puzzle game modes, creative mode lets you build the land without limitations and photo mode allows you to capture and share your creations at the end of each session.

Nothing can beautify your map more than natural wonders like the snowy Alps, lavender fields or redwood forests, which you can acquire thanks to a unique Card Upcycle System

2109330.name: 仙侠世界
2109330.about_the_game:
《仙侠世界》是巨人网络旗下王牌研发团队自主研发的一款仙侠风格的大型MMORPG。现诚邀所有喜爱PK的玩家来体验这场别开生面的战斗盛宴，无论是跨区战还是本服对战，无论是个人战、小队战亦或是大型团战，都应有尽有！让你感受无时无刻都有架可打的激情！

【中国传统神话，拟真实景呈现】

《仙侠世界》以中国传统神话故事和民间传说为架构，将人、仙、魔三个不同层次空间一一展现。游戏采用了拟真实景制作手法、清新典雅的画面风格来打造出纯正的修仙世界，再配合悠扬中国古韵BGM，让玩家可以享受一场极具上古仙侠风情的视觉盛宴。

【战斗玩法丰富，满足不同人群需求】

《仙侠世界》共有百余种PK玩法，给予不同需求和喜好的玩家，各自喜爱的战斗方式。在游戏中，玩家可选择1v1对决、组队PK、小团体GVG战斗、结拜战、宗门PK、仙府争夺战、神秘岛激战、幽州城争夺战、比武岛混战，沧海岛阵营战、跨区战场、炼心岛速夺战、野外战等多重多样的战斗玩法。让喜爱PVP的玩家们，可以在游戏中随心所欲的战斗起来，充分感受战斗的刺激与爽快！

【GVG战斗更激情，随时随地想战就战】

不同于大多巨人游戏的国战游戏设定，《仙侠世界》主推GVG模式的战斗玩法。相比较于人海战术的国战类玩法，游戏推崇的GVG抱团战斗方式则更注重玩家的操作能力与多人之间的相互配合。而为了让玩家能够更好的在游戏中进行小团队的组建，《仙侠世界》还特别设定了有益于小团队组建的各类日常活动玩法。例如：无尽之塔、秘境、乾坤盘、十二重楼等丰富的副本玩法。再搭配上结拜与宗门相关的或任务、或战斗的玩法，更让小团队之间的成员关系更为团结密切。

当固定的团队形成之后，玩家就会自然而然的进行抱团式战斗了。当团队中的某一位玩家与其他玩家产生了冲突时，往往以约架为主的GVG战斗便会产生。而在宗门复活法阵和队伍传送法阵的加持下，玩家将不再畏惧高成本的死亡成本。只需点击复活或传送，即可瞬间返回战场，继续在前线进行激烈厮杀。也正是如此，战斗双方轻易不会认输。于是乎，类似这种多达数小时的激情战斗在游戏中总是四处上演。

2109370.name: The Great War: Western Front™
2109370.about_the_game:
The Great War: Western Front is the definitive World War 1 strategy game from Petroglyph, the makers of Command & Conquer™ Remastered & Star Wars™: Empire at War. Play a deciding role in history with this real-time tactical experience as you take charge in the pivotal Western Front from 1914 to 1919.

Pick your faction and lead your forces to victory, by directing your armies in gritty real-time battles and by guiding high-level decisions in turn-based strategic gameplay. Dig detailed trenches, research new technologies such as poison gas and tanks, and make decisions that will have a profound and lasting effect on your success. Think like a Commander to either relive history - or redefine it.



Discover unparalleled levels of strategic choice as you step into the role of both Theatre Commander and Field Commander.

As Theatre Commander, experience enthralling turn-based grand-strategy as you direct the deployment of forces, perform research and carefully consider how you disseminate your resources across the Western Front in a war won by inches. Alongside this, take up the mantle of Field Commander in dynamic real-time battles as you direct units to defeat your opponent, build trenches and perform direct assaults by sending your infantry over the top. Pick your battles and fight them your way to shape the course of history.






No play through is the same as you make decisions great and small to change the outcome of the war. Introduce new military technologies earlier in the conflict depending on your advancement of the tech tree, or change pivotal moments in history to alter the outcome of the war.

Play your way with four deep and compelling modes. Experience the unfolding saga of World War I in the Campaign, relive iconic moments with Historical Battles, create your own battles in Skirmish or test your strategies against others in memorable Multiplayer action - your journey through this enthralling conflict is unique to you.






As you continue your push across the Western Front, you will revisit previous battlefields which will, over time, bear the scars and destruction of earlier encounters. Once lush countryside will degrade into a quagmire, marked with colossal craters left by your undermined explosives.

Carve your strategies into the landscape by creating complex trench networks which will remain upon your return, as you seek to push the enemy back inch by inch. Shifting weather also plays a role; as the months draw on in the conflict, you’ll encounter weather changes such as snow and rain which will affect things like artillery performance and unit movement. To secure victory, you’ll need to carefully consider your strategy depending on the conditions.






Revel in an authentic historical strategy game that captures the gravity and intensity of The Great War. Partnering with the Imperial War Museums, their expertise enables us to accurately portray these pivotal moments in history.

Choose true-to-life infantry, weaponry, artillery and tanks of the time and get into the mind-set of a WW1 Commander as you employ considered tactics and deploy your army across the Western Front.






Play as either the Allied Nations or the Central Powers as you make tactical and strategic decisions to earn victory both on the battlefield and in the overarching theatre of war. Both factions have unique abilities and gameplay styles for you to discover and wield.

2109510.name: CyberTD
2109510.about_the_game:
Think you have what it takes to save cyberspace? Mutant viruses have invaded its core and are threatening to destroy it. It’s up to you to take on these waves of viruses and defend the core of cyberspace in a way that prevents any of them from reaching it. But there’s no need to fret – you'll have countless upgrades and a split-personality killer drone to (more or less) help you out!

Innovative tower defense experience


CyberTD takes the classic tower defense experience and combines it with roguelite elements, creating a captivating mix. With each level-up, you'll unlock new upgrades and gain access to more options for customizing your defense according to your own unique style.

Easy to learn, tough to master


Though learning the game's simple mechanics is easy, you'll need to come up with an elaborate strategy if you're looking to reach high-score territory. You'll be entertained for plenty of time in your hunt for better upgrades and tactics – and you’ll get some questionable support from a retired killer drone with two feisty personalities.

Various game modes


You'll always find yourself facing new challenges through these different game modes:
  • Single Player: Viruses charge at you, wave after wave, with mutations that boost their strength and endurance – but you, too, have access to a growing range of effective defense mechanisms designed to stop them.
  • Co-op: Face the waves of enemies as a pair and work together to fight them off for as long as possible.
  • Versus: Face the waves of enemies side-by-side and compete to see who's more successful at fighting them off.
  • Weekly Challenges: A different set of special challenges each week for experienced players – tougher rules come into play here!
  • Community Clash: Fun and exciting games for streamers (Twitch) where your chat takes control of a second player in co-op or versus mode, or determines how the rest of the game unfolds for you through choices!

Endless possibilities


You have the power to choose what you need to defend against the enemy effectively. Looking to inflict heavy damage or trigger nasty status changes? Eager to level up your weapons or gain powerful abilities? Over 170 different upgrades await you in four different levels of rarity, ready to be unlocked and built to a powerful deck. You can choose one upgrade per enemy wave from a random selection in this pool – so no two games will ever be the same!

Direct link to the developer


Feel free to contact us – we appreciate any and all feedback! Join the community, share your thoughts and requests, or interact with other players.
