2109700.name: Temple of Horror
2109700.about_the_game:
Your soul, just like many others before, has been trapped in the Temple of Horror. It is an unreal place, filled with evil monsters, lost wandering souls, and forgotten evil that are trying to make their way out of the temple.

Escape the dangerous beings lurking in the dark, dodge countless deadly traps and slowly unruffle the secret of the Temple of Horror while not just trying to survive but to find your way out of this hell.

Will you be able to escape this scary action adventure?

Are you ready too...
- Rescue countless lost souls
- Survive the attack of the undead
- Hide from the evil and escape the dungeon
- Solve scary environmental puzzles
- figure out the skilles of every enemy in order to escape
- dodge countless traps
- Find your way through a deadly maze

2109710.name: M.U.D.S.: Mean Ugly Dirty Sport
2109710.about_the_game:
Jump into gridiron mayhem with M.U.D.S. (Mean Ugly Dirty Sport)! This hilarious and violent top-down action rugby-style game is full of cutthroat gameplay and kooky fantasy characters.

Lead a team of 13 condemned creatures to victory by any means necessary. Pick a fight, buy or sell players on the market – or bribe the opposing team, the referee or the fish serving as the ball!

Win the game by scoring at least 7 out of 14 goals – or by killing enough of the opposing team. Tackle, pummel or throw players into the moat… but if you get thrown in yourself, get out before the shark-like monster eats you!

As a manager, you’ll control the team funds – by booking hotels in the cities you visit, paying for drinks and using bribes to your advantage.

As a coach, you’ll train your team of misfits to use tactics and fighting moves and throw the other team on their backs.

As a player, you’ll run, foul, jump, tackle, bite, kick, cheat and do whatever it takes to fight your way through every match.

M.U.D.S combines all of the best aspects of rugby, RPG character development, management simulation and strategy into an original fantasy sports game that you’ll have trouble putting down.

And remember – the only way to win is to PLAY DIRTY!

2109720.name: Roam Survival
2109720.about_the_game:
Roam Survival


Survive and Repair Your Plane on a Danger-Filled Island!

In Roam Survival, your plane has crashed on a remote island full of mysteries and threats. As Sam, a plane mechanic, your mission is to survive in this hostile environment while seeking the resources needed to repair your aircraft and escape this terrifying place.

Key Features:

Extensive Exploration: Explore a vast open world filled with unique details, from dense jungles to ancient ruins, every corner of the island is packed with secrets and surprises.

Resource Management: Collect and manage vital resources for your survival. Build shelters, craft tools, and keep your basic needs covered while facing the island's challenges.

Intense Combat: Face a variety of enemies, from wild creatures to hostile tribes. Develop strategies to overcome dangers and protect yourself as you explore.

Construction and Customization: Design and upgrade your shelter and gear. Use the resources you find to build structures, create useful items, and personalize your island life.

Graphical and Audio Immersion: Immerse yourself in a vibrant environment with detailed graphics and an immersive soundtrack that further enhances the survival experience.

Are you ready to face the island's challenges and repair your plane? Adventure and survival await you in Roam Survival!
2109720.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America

2109750.name: Passion Eye
2109750.about_the_game:
Using our industry leading character maker, you can realize your full creativity, making the girl of your dreams come to life and enjoy a passion filled night indulging in your shared desires~


Let go of the leash on your creativity, and let it all out in the included Studio, where only your imagination puts brakes on what you may create. With our permissive license model, you may take your created scene from this game and use it to make derivative products! (*)


Passion Eye is built, from the ground up, to facilitate the ultimate in user creativity, modding. This game comes with everything needed to create mods, and to manage installed mods. With our permissive policies regarding distribution of mods (*), you can allow your users to support your work on creator support platforms.

* - Subject to Terms of Service
2109750.supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Italian, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese

2109770.name: Kingmakers
2109770.about_the_game:
You’re the last hope in a dying world. Travel back 500 years, to medieval England, in order to change the course of a bloody war and maybe, if you’re lucky, stave off the apocalypse. Can you tip the scales of history and create a new timeline?

Each battle you engage in runs as a fully real-time simulation with thousands of soldiers fighting at the same time. Every soldier on the battlefield is controlled by a next-gen multi-threaded AI which controls their decision-making, pathfinding, and loyalty. This, combined with a unique procedural animation system, allows Kingmakers to offer an unprecedented level of character and combat fidelity.

How many swordsmen do you think you could take out with an AK-47? This is your chance to find out. Use assault rifles, shotguns, grenade launchers, armored SUVs, bikes, attack helos, air strikes and more to make sure the history altering goes smoothly. Put your sharpshooting skills to the test and wreak absolute havoc on the battlefield.

4 players can join together in the online co-op. Work together to break down the enemy castle’s defenses or defend allied strongholds against hordes of opponents. Prepare for an epic medieval multiplayer experience like no other.

Seamlessly switch between combat and issuing orders, at any time. While the system is easy-to-learn and simple to use, the strategic possibilities are endless. Directly issue orders to the warriors or leave it up to your petty officers, allocate legions of archers, swordsmen, spearmen, and cavalry, build fortifications, and plan your next move before diving back into the fray.
2109770.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

2109800.name: My Dear Sister
2109800.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO FELLOWS FAMILY MANSION

After 10 years, Alice receives a letter from her lost twin sister Astrid, and now she stands in front of Fellows Family Mansion.
She looks at the letter and the family photo under the heavy rain, her childhood memories are so dark.

Why she lost her twin sister?
What was the secrets of Fellows Family?
Why did they leave her to a foster family after Astrid’s disappearance?

On a dark November night, Alice should solve Astrid’s puzzles to find the answers of these questions.

My Dear Sister
It is a single player story horror game.
It is a game where players will progress by solving various puzzles and solve mysteries.
2109800.supported_languages:
English*, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

2109830.name: Immortal Guns
2109830.about_the_game:
Immortal Guns is a new FPS game with a powerful level editor. The game offers multiple game modes, maps, and weapons that can be fully customized with an intuitive drag & drop interface. The level editor is a powerful, easy-to-use tool with a terrain and object editor that lets you build, share and play your levels with friends.



Immortal Guns is currently in early access. We are actively developing new maps, adding new weapons and game modes. Our vision is to enable players to play and enjoy the levels they build with their friends online.

✔️Online multiplayer
✔️Powerful level editor
✔️Offline custom levels with bots

Game Modes

Team Deathmatch
Kill enemy players in a fight for domination. The team with the highest number of kills at the end of the round wins.

Free for All
You’re on your own! The player with the highest number of kills at the end of the round wins.

Zombie Horde
Play co-op with friends and try to survive against waves of zombies.

The Level Editor

Forge your own levels
Create custom terrain with a powerful terrain editor and add objects to make your own levels. Go further by tweaking engine settings like run speed and game modes.

Add vehicles and jump-pads
Add vehicles and jump pads to your levels to create a fun and wacky experience.

Upcoming Features

More weapons

More level editor assets
Unique game modes
Character and gun skins

2109840.name: the Shadow of Swallow
2109840.about_the_game:
Immersive Visuals

Experience ancient China in a visually stunning, realistic side-scrolling 3D action-adventure. Play as a master swordswoman, a deadly assassin fighting for justice.

Engaging Gameplay

Engage in thrilling stealth and combat. Infiltrate heavily guarded palaces to eliminate key targets, using stealth or brute force to overcome obstacles.

Engage in dynamic sword fights, showcasing your mastery of combat.

Explore diverse environments, from misty mountain forests to tranquil temples, each filled with danger.

Varied Environments

Journey through vast deserts, barren landscapes, and treacherous canyons.

Explore intricate indoor levels with fluid parkour mechanics.

Navigate deadly traps and hidden passages, requiring both skill and cunning.

Breathtaking BOSS battle

2109850.name: Barbershop Simulator VR
2109850.about_the_game:
Become the best Barber in town! With advanced hair interactions, wash, cut and style hair to give your customers the look they deserve. Get a detailed score for what you do from a powerful evaluation system. Decorate your shop to match your own style. Upgrade your shop by purchasing appliances or tools that will make your customers happier. Keep your shop and tools clean to maintain a good hygiene score.

Features

  • Realistic hair interaction system

  • Hair Washing

  • Evaluation System

  • In game purchasing portal that lets you customize and expand your barbershop (using in-game money)

  • Coffee brewing and serving

  • Sandbox mode only for practicing without hurting your shop's rating

Advanced hair interactions that lets you accurately brush, trim, shave and color customers' hair to match their requests.

Decorate and customize almost every color and texture in the barbershop to make it your own.

Purchase appliances, tools and expansions to unlock new mechanics to make your job easier and also give your customers the best experience.

Becomes a magician! by purchasing the magic wand, you'll be able to revert back the hair to undo mistakes!

Maintain your barbershop by regularly cleaning your tools and hiring cleaners to deep clean the shop to get higher hygiene rating and a higher tip!

2109860.name: The Bounce House
2109860.about_the_game:
When June is given the chance to take over her uncles gentlemen's club in the city of Dungburg it is the opportunity of a lifetime. Despite its name, The Bounce House is in bad shape and has very little bouncing happening. Now it's up to June to find the funds to bring it back to life. She gets tangled up in the criminal underworld to find the money needed to get her strip club bouncing again!

Explore the open world environment and make your club the best in the city by hiring dancers and staff members, as well as upgrading every aspect of your club. Destroy rival clubs and drug operations to make that cash! Buy new weapons and find upgrades for your character.


Pros:
Shoot a buttload of bad guys
Boobs, lots of boobs
Neat sci-fi weapons because regular guns are boring
Sometimes this game is funny
Good graphics

Cons:
Made by only one dude in his garage
Also has bad graphics
The use of foul language
Nobody ever reads the description this far. Why are you doing this? Just buy the game already!

2109870.name: Absolution’s Apple
2109870.about_the_game:
Read it your way: Includes standalone .epub and .pdf versions!

One thousand years beyond the fall of Earth, the past plagues the future

Behold the Megalith: A city carved from the slag of worlds, home to the many sins and rarer virtues of humanity. Therein lives an orphan named Haz, cursed with the ability to hear what others cannot... the whispers of thought and fate. When Haz stumbles upon the secrets of a dead man, he hears the call of opportunity. From the corpse he steals a map, and with it, the hope of fortune and freedom.

What is old is new

A man named Absolution drinks alone in a seedy bar, waiting for opportunity to call. When a grubby street urchin arrives at his table with a treasure map in hand, Absolution smells trouble, but can't resist. Finding treasure is his talent and trade; with a rugged old ship and a loyal team of scoundrels at his disposal, he has the means and the motivation to find whatever the map points to, and a gut feeling that tells him it's valuable. But before he can set sail on his latest venture, he must contend with the city itself: For between him and the open sea stands an army of angered mercenaries, and a gang of thugs who serve a woman scorned.

What is life brings death

In the streets not far away, Julia Delacroix studies a body covered in the unruly blossoming of an unidentifiable fungal growth. As Site Coordinator for the Office of Public Health, the responsibility to quarantine the neighbourhood falls on her, along with the ensuing investigation. It soon becomes apparent that hundreds have been exposed to the spores; that thousands may yet die if the infection spreads. Her only lead? An orphan seen robbing the dead, and a team of salvagers about to set sail on a long journey to the Rim...

What is lost may be found

Please Note: This product is a digital book, packaged and presented via a game engine. Its interactive elements are limited to book and menu navigation.

Sample the first hundred pages in the demo, along with samples of other upcoming works.

2109880.name: Memory Puzzle - Futanari Gym
2109880.about_the_game:
Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of a Futanari gym trainer and her trainee, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match.
Flip two cards, and if the numbers on them match, they will be removed from the board, gradually revealing a unique image.

Features:
  • 12 different adult images to reveal at high resolution
  • Cards are shuffled randomly at each game, for maximum replay value.
  • Timer, to see how long it takes to solve a puzzle
  • Gallery where you can view all the puzzle images you have solved.
  • Relaxing music.

Be among the fastest players to achieve a top spot in our Leaderboards and unlock various achievements.

2109930.name: From the Deep
2109930.about_the_game:
Something lurks beneath the depths of the Cosmic Shoreline…

Confront and survive a twisted, cosmic horror isolated at the edge of universe. From the Deep is a survival horror game set inside an abandoned Monastery built upon the Cosmic Shoreline at the universe’s edge — a liminal space at the threshold between Cosmos and Nothingness. Unravel the mysteries of what befell this once beautiful place while avoiding the evil that stalks you within. Will you survive to tell the tale, or will your fate be sealed inside these hallowed halls?

Harness the psychic powers of the Cosmic Waters

Forage for Cosmic Waters, a magical resource that flows from the Axis Mundi at the core of the Monastery. Your only hope of surviving the supernatural horror within is to use the Waters to power your surroundings, solve puzzles, and fend off an unassailable foe.

Evade and escape a relentless pursuer

Adapt and survive as you are hounded by an interdimensional monster known as the Entity Beneath Things. With its dynamic behavior, the Entity will disrupt even the most carefully constructed plan, forcing you to make choices under duress and balance your progress through the Monastery with your very survival.

Discover the myths and secrets of the Soul Divers

Immerse yourself in the faded world of the Soul Divers. Explore the Monastery to find notes, artifacts, legends, and more detailing the history of the Soul Divers and the events preceding their untimely demise.

The Seeker, a lone pilgrim, has been recalled before their appointed time. Upon their return to the Monastery there is no welcome, no restoration of their clouded memories, nothing at all. As they search for signs of life the Seeker discovers, too late, that everything has gone horribly wrong. A being from the deep, the Entity Beneath Things, stalks the Monastery, consuming and distorting all it touches — and it is hungry…so very hungry.

Forced deeper into the Monastery to survive, the Seeker must now discover how to banish the Entity to avoid assimilation with the creature — a fate they will find is worse than death.

2109950.name: He's Nut Your Princess
2109950.about_the_game:
Story
A College couple gets their afternoon interrupted by a giant Brazilian nut in a suit. And what was once a chill study sesh has now turned into a kidnapping rescue mission with a dash of mistaken identity. Join June through a world of large legumes as she per sues love in both a literal and metaphorical sense. Chasing after her boyfriend while experiences a new definition of a long distance relationship through social media status updates and regular dm’s from her dramatic dude in distress.

Multiple Endings
Whatever course of action you choose to take throughout this story may alter the overall outcome of your ‘happily ever after’. With a total of 12 different endings including 3 secrets endings and 1 true ending.
If make any less than nice decisions, whether on accident or on purpose, be prepared to taste the consequences of your actions.

Side Quests
In addition to the main story if you explore enough you’re bound to stumble upon one of the many side quests and side stories. Helping friendly nuts with their daily lives and reaping the rewards from your good deeds.

Gameplay
Gameplay is your standard metroidvania setup. Start with a single jump, base attack and WASD movement controls. From there progress through the story to gain new abilities that will then forth help you to further traverse the world.

Combat Stickers
Combat Stickers unlock new attacks for a dynamic combat system that allows you to switch fighting styles mid battle. Battle Bosses to accumulate combat stickers, whether it’s a main story boss or an area boss, all of them drop their own unique combat stickers.

2109980.name: Apostate
2109980.about_the_game:
In Apostate, battle as a magical champion, created and trained by a cult of powerful wizards. After witnessing the devastation caused by this cult, you realize the true horrors of their magic. Choosing to run away, you are soon deemed an Apostate and must now escape their ever expanding grasp. Fighting your way through the monsters and demons of the cult, you must strategize and sharpen your magical abilities to gain your full potential and possibly freedom.

In this top down, action roguelite, choose from a vast selection of spells, augmentations, items, and stats to create your own unique custom hero every playthrough. Discover synergies and unlock builds as you compete against your foes. Choose from a wide variety of spells with different status effects and interactions. Augment your champions weapons and armor to change how your spells function. Through a variety of items and stat modifiers you can further customize how your magical hero performs. Combine all these choices to create a variety of different powerful builds.

Battle your way to freedom in either a solo or co-op campaign mode. As well as the ability to challenge others in a streamline pvp mode, where you can fight against the hordes of monsters and compete to see who can create the ultimate custom hero and escape. Watch out though, only one Apostate can make it out alive, and the others will do their best to stop you.

Please check out our development roadmap to stay updated and informed on future content and demos!

2110000.name: All Systems Dance
2110000.about_the_game:
Don't believe their messaging... THIS is the true face of Woosh.

We Are Being Watched. We Have to Fight Back. And We Have Discovered their Weakness…

ALL SYSTEMS DANCE

DANCE IS THE ANSWER!

The World is Your Dance Battle Arena

Robots are waiting everywhere and they aren’t going to hype themselves! With tons of enemies to try your best dance moves on, the world is filled with different arena environments to let you experiment with your flow and get creative in combat.

Your Moves Can Hack the System

Hype the robots using creative combinations with a total of 48 moves in custom loadouts! Dance, dodge attacks, and use chained or freestyle combos to build more hype points against the system. Just be careful not to get bonked.

Express Yourself & Start a Revolution

Join The Movement and stand up to corporate greed using dance moves in strange places. Activate special abilities, unlock secrets, and discover a heartfelt story where dance is the key to disruption.

You just have to DANCE!

2110110.name: Motherless - Season 1
2110110.about_the_game:
Motherless - Season 1 includes: 11 chapters

  • Season 1 is composed of over 10,000 renders, animated scenes, 178 videos, sounds and mini-games that you can play.
  • You can enjoy over 8 to 10 hours of gameplay totally free of charge!
  • Get your harem of beautiful women!



Motherless is a captivating, narrative-driven visual novel intended for mature audiences.

It follows the story of Sunny, a young man who was separated from his loved ones at birth and raised with little knowledge of his origins.

Join him on a journey of self-discovery, as he reconnects with people from his past and uncovers the secrets of his forgotten childhood.



  • In this game, you will witness the journey of a young boy who runs away from his private boarding school in search of his childhood memories. During this quest, he will unwittingly find employment with someone from his past...

  • You can play the intro or choose to ignore it... We recommend you play it!!!!

  • You will be able to choose through the relationship manager if you want to follow the path of any character.

  • The characters in the game have different ethnicities and personalities, so you will be attracted to some of them. Will you be able to ignore them?

  • The further you advance in the game, the more you will get caught up in the story and each character with their different needs.

  • The game is a visual novel that becomes more interactive through fun mini-games and hilariously awkward events.
2110110.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America

2110150.name: Thesis of Love 心动论证
2110150.about_the_game:
Meet Shizuki (changeable name), a sociology student who joins the Computer Science master's program at Chishima Institute of Technology hoping to become worthy of her crush. There, she finds herself in the same research group as Masaki and Tetsu, plus their teaching assistant Yonhi. She has no idea what unexpected journey lies ahead...

Chishima is a massive artificial island nation in the Pacific Ocean. Founded by East Asian immigrants, this young nation actively embraces Western culture and values. Like everyone else growing up on the island, Shizuki comes from a traditional Asian family but receives Western education. These two distinct cultures interweave deeply in the islanders' daily lives, profoundly influencing how young people view love and relationships.

Features

  • 40+ CGs and 20+ endings

  • All of the love interest are trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to different paths.

  • Pursue two characters at the same time to unlock the unique “Love triangle” routes

  • Experience the complete journey from first meeting to falling in love

  • Easy-to-learn school simulation system

  • Inventory, cooking, dating, dressing and intimate interaction system

Love interests

Your friendly and outgoing labmate who's always easy to talk to. Though smart, he takes a laid-back approach to his studies. He has a long-term girlfriend but often struggles with important life decisions. Lately, something seems off about his relationship…

A dedicated overachiever in your lab who takes his research seriously. He's strict about time management and can seem unapproachable, but beneath that cold exterior is a caring heart that can't help but worry about his friends. Sometimes he's spotted having lunch with a mysterious girl. Who could she be...?

Your lab's teaching assistant and the professor's postdoc. He seems indifferent to everything, even dozing off during group meetings. Word is that he published many breakthrough papers during his PhD in the US, but now he just seems to be slacking off. Though he wears a wedding ring, he never mentions his married life…

2110240.name: PUCK RUNNER
2110240.about_the_game:
PUCK RUNNER is a challenging endless runner inspired by air hockey. Physically hit the puck to with your mouse to avoid obstacles, with your control of the puck being constantly threatened by ever-increasing speed and complexity.

TACTILE GAMEPLAY

Everything in-game from the puck, obstacles and even the mouse is a physics object with tactile, satisfying interactions and sounds.

TIME MANIPULATION

Puck Runner is simple to learn but tough to master, with a very high skill ceiling, Collecting energy allows you to slow down time to alllow you to regain control if you're in a tight spot, or speed up time to reach greater distances faster.

STEAM LEADERBOARDS

Compare your best distances and speeds with your friends and the community on Steam. Can you beat the rest?

2110300.name: Spike Mtn
2110300.about_the_game:
Spike Mtn is a challenging 2D precision platformer with fast and fun movement. To overcome the challenges on Spike Mtn, you will need to swing back and forth on your grappling hooks, building momentum to launch yourself great distances with speed. Mastering movement will give you the speed and precision you need to climb Spike Mtn!

Features include:
  • over 50 challenges;
  • movement that's tough but rewarding to master;
  • fun and colourful art; and
  • an original soundtrack.

2110320.name: Ash Battle
2110320.about_the_game:
Ash Battle is a Sci-Fi minimalist survival game with a Bullet Hell style.
Ash is on an unknown planet and has found many enemies who didn't like his visit. Prepare yourself and be ready for battle, because they come in huge numbers.

Goals:
Try to survive the large amount of enemies, they will chase you wherever you go. You will not be able to escape them.


Weapons
Use your sword and your weapon to fight your enemies, each of them has a special ability that you can take advantages


Map
Use a map to navigate and evade your enemies if you can!


Rank
Get points with each game and try to overcome your limits.


Boss
Face the most powerful enemy on this inhospitable planet and try to defeat him.

2110390.name: The Celestial Seeker
2110390.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic intergalactic adventure in this space faring Metroidvania! Irata, a skilled bounty hunter and unlikely hero, is tasked with saving the solar system from a menacing federation of hostile species. With your blaster and a thirst for adventure, explore three diverse planets filled with bounties, upgrades, civilizations, hidden secrets, and dangers.

Eons ago, the Eternium core, an advanced chipset with the power to link all intelligent systems, was created in a last-ditch attempt to ward off the first coup of power organized by the Federation. Moments before defeat, the planetary alliance activated the Divine Architect, a sentient artificial intelligence that was designed to control the Eternium core.

The war was won but, in its wake, left a thirst for power. It was no longer just the federation that wanted control. Insiders within the planetary alliance from all corners of the solar system tried their hands at gaining control.

It was then, that the leaders of the 3 planets agreed to give the Eternium core its last instructions, to separate in 6 and have its pieces be spread equally across the planets.

Peace was restored. The legend of the Eternium Core faded to myth. And the Divine Architect laid dormant. Until now.

Our protagonist is one of the many space bounty hunters domiciled on planet metropolis. During the first insurrection, the bounty hunters of planet Metropolis were all too eager to help the cause and fight the federation. However, today’s bounty hunters have been born into a world of self preservation. A trait that our reluctant hero will battle with.

You will chart your own course… Will you help civilians along the way? Or will you focus on what pays the most? Some seemingly helpless civilians may be worth more than the credits they can provide. Only you will be able to decide the best course of action.

Will you focus on purchasing what you need from your home planet, or will you conjure a more natural path to acquire what you need on planet Verdanterra?

Explore a Solar System teeming with wonder and danger, where each planet holds secrets waiting to be uncovered:

1. Thermaridia:

- Descend into the molten heart of Thermaridia, where lava caverns stretch like fiery veins beneath the surface. Beware the searing heat and unpredictable geysers as you seek ancient relics hidden within the liquid rock.

2. Verdanterra:

Inhale the sweet scent of Verdanterra’s lush forests, where towering trees intertwine like ancient storytellers. Atop the trees and below the surface you will find civilizations in worlds of their own. Here, life thrives in harmony. At least it use to…

3. Metropolis:

Amid the dystopian cityscapes of Metropolis, neon signs flicker above crowded streets and Hovercars hum between skyscrapers. This is where you will be able to purchase most of what you need, but remember, credits are in short supply. Navigate the urban maze that is Irata’s home planet.

Your starship awaits—its engines humming with potential. Assemble your crew, upgrade your vessel, and chart your course. The Solar system is vast, and your choices shape its destiny.

2110430.name: after the meteor shower
2110430.about_the_game:
In "Space Adventure: Ship Rescue," you play as an astronaut who, after an accident during a meteor shower, crashes on an unknown and hostile planet. Your mission is to explore this mysterious world, face alien monsters, and collect scattered parts and screws to rebuild your ship. With dynamic platforming and shooting gameplay, three difficulty levels, simultaneous saves, and a unique black-and-white cartoonish art style, this game offers a long, fun, and challenging experience. Assemble your ship and get ready for a triumphant return home, with your performance determined by the number of screws collected. Are you ready for this epic adventure?
several different enemies, monster bosses, etc...
3 difficulties that can be saved simultaneously.
68 passages approximately
2110430.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal

2110440.name: ARROW
2110440.about_the_game:
THINK BEFORE YOU MOVE

You can’t move freely.

Every move depends on the direction of the arrows.

If your input doesn’t match, nothing moves.

Sounds simple? It quickly becomes a real challenge.

HOW IT WORKS

Move the arrow tiles and collect all the dots.

But there’s a rule:

Only tiles with arrow directions that match your input will move.

This creates puzzles where:

  • Direction matters

  • Position matters

  • Every move matters

IT GETS MORE COMPLEX

What starts simple quickly turns into challenging puzzles that require planning and careful thinking.

You’ll encounter mechanics like:

  • Teleporters

  • Rotators

Each level builds on the previous one, introducing new ways to think about movement.

FEATURES

  • 1900+ handcrafted puzzles

  • 3 game modes: Easy, Hard, Relax

  • Minimalist and clean visual style

  • Hint system to help you when stuck

FOR PLAYERS WHO ENJOY

  • Logic puzzles

  • Strategic thinking

  • Minimalist design

ONE SIMPLE RULE

Match the direction… or you don’t move.
2110440.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese

2110460.name: Cursed 3
2110460.about_the_game:
In 2009 a girl named Jennifer was lost in an abandoned mineshaft. She was rescued by a brave man who studied the mine's history, but she was changed. That man disappeared without a trace...

In 2019 Jennifer's friend Randall came back to their hometown only to find it in shambles. He took down an evil cult and the demon they were attempting to resurrect. He and Jennifer fled to find a new life elsewhere.

Now in 2022, Jennifer is restless about her destiny. Why did this all befall her? How was her family related to the ancient past? Jen sets off alone to her great-grantparent's abandoned house. Her father grew up in that house, and it may hold the answers she seeks.

She will discover far more than she bargained for...

The final chapter of the CURSED trilogy! This game has a ton of new features!

-Same distinctive art style, but now in Widescreen and up to 120hz supported

-Investigate the house in any way you choose. Non-linear progression with tons to discover

-Look around every room and fight hideous creatures in full 360 degrees of rotation

-A fusion of combat and world. Everything is now real-time, so fight or flight, it's up to you

2110510.name: DREAM LOGIC
2110510.about_the_game:
WHAT IS A LIMINAL SPACE?:

When someone enters a space that is outside of typical space and time, they are said to be in a condition of liminality. These people straddle the boundaries set by law, custom, and convention for the typical roles, behaviors, and positions.

TRUE DREAMLIKE EXPERIENCE:

  • Fly through real-time generated clouds.

  • Solve puzzles to advance.

CUSTOM ENTITY MODE:

2110520.name: Find Me In The Maze
2110520.about_the_game:
Find Me In The Maze is a heart touching 3D platformer featuring a dead warrior revived again to restart his journey.
Unique and challenging levels
In Find Me In The Maze you will get across an abundance of unexpected obstacles , angry dragons , giant birds , forest fey , and pirate clothed skeletons.
The game is developed my a one person studio. He is about to take you on a wonderous journey where one thing is for sure: Find the hidden story behind this maze.
A hidden tale to be discovered
Discover a touching and heartfelt story told by the characters along the way. Try to match all the puzzles of the tale and find your own full version of the story.
Changing hero every level
The hero you are playing with can change from an assassin to a devil to a pirate skeleton depending on the level environment.

2110540.name: The Suits Have Gone Mad!
2110540.about_the_game:
The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand new episodic horror brought to you by Blank Dream Studios. Unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into a dull world.


Learn about the daily life of an employee at Blake & Whitley. Everything will be okay as long as you work hard and stay out of trouble...




A business behemoth in the world, dominating the market in tone production and distribution. Employees are pushed to the limits with little reward.




Theo Blue, an ordinary senior innovator at the company unexpectedly discovers color while working on a typical day. Executives witness this discovery and mysteriously demand for his apprehension.




Business suits search floor to floor, persistent in your capture. Avoid them in any way possible.




From the disappearance of a co-owner to the malicious business ethics, the company has a deep and dark history that they have been hiding...

2110550.name: eXecutor
2110550.about_the_game:
Ancient military robots were discovered after archaeologists excavated the site of an old city on a deserted island. The robots seize power and start a full-scale war, repairing each other and building new ones.

Your mission, as part of a large special operations force, is to gain full control of the island before it's too late. Humanity can't take it anymore. CO2 emissions are too high and we can't take it anymore. Our planet is almost on fire. Robots are involved in all kinds of criminal activity, from cryptocurrency mining to drug and weapons production. Use any weapon you can find.
Stay sharp.

2110600.name: Merchant's Rush
2110600.about_the_game:
Merchant's Rush is a roguelike merchant simulator.

Take the role of a desperate merchant, purchasing and selling goods in an effort to make a profit in a world on the cusp of War.
Figure out your own trade routes and make massive profits, forge uneasy alliances with the factions that control the lands for safe passage and build a competent crew by hiring professionals to assist you in your work!

2110610.name: Open Air
2110610.about_the_game:
An escapist game about very important topics: finding yourself, gaining confidence and knowing your inner world.

Get ready for a magical journey! In the game, you'll become an adorable little owl, dreaming of flying but lacking this gift. Meditate near owl altars, unlock incredible abilities within yourself, use ancient mechanisms, and make friends!

Embark on thrilling trials, uncover the mysteries of the island, and help its inhabitants find happiness and joy. Explore enigmatic astral places, complete quests, and enjoy breathtaking views.

Friendship, adventure, magic – all of this awaits you on our island! Make the hearts of the inhabitants flutter with happiness – in your feathers! Prepare for takeoff and join us on a journey to the astral world right now!

Look into the world of spirits

Explore the night world to understand yourself. Read the minds of others, jump high and believe in yourself!
From the moment you spread your wings as the adorable little owl protagonist, the island becomes your playground, enticing you to soar through lush forests, soar above serene lakes, and glide over rolling hills.



Explore the island
An open world in front of you, small and compact, but still open!
The island's open world invites you to set your own pace. Whether you wish to dive headfirst into quests or lose yourself in the thrill of exploration, the choice is yours.



Make new friends
Communicate with the islanders and help them to solve their problems.
In a world where magic, exploration, and growth intertwine, the friendships you make are the heart and soul of the experience. As you explore the island, remember that each new connection enriches the tapestry of your adventure.



Search for treasures
There are many secrets and easter eggs hidden on the island, can you collect them all?
Every path you tread, every riddle you solve, brings you closer to unveiling the treasure's location. The island becomes your canvas of discovery, each landmark a clue waiting to be deciphered.



Enjoy the music festival
Hippies, punks, anarchists, rockers and metalheads, we have a riff for everyone!
The festival isn't just about the music; it's about the emotions, memories, and sense of togetherness it evokes. As you wander through the festival grounds, you're surrounded by the exuberant melodies, the infectious beats, and the sheer joy that radiates from the characters you've met along the way.


Learn something new about yourself
Meditate at the altars, discover new sides of yourself.
The journey towards self-discovery is not a linear path; it's a series of encounters, challenges, and revelations that gradually shape your character's evolution. Through interactions with the island's inhabitants, you'll glean insights into your own strengths and vulnerabilities.



Made by a small team
We are not a huge team, we were afraid for a long time to make a "dream game". But here it is in front of you, what do you say?
Each member of the team infused a piece of themselves into the game. The art reflects the artist's emotions, the writing echoes the writer's experiences, and the music resonates with the composer's soul. This synergy adds layers of authenticity, elevating the game beyond mere entertainment to an experience that leaves an indelible mark on players.

2110630.name: Chernobyl Again
2110630.about_the_game:
Chernobyl Again is an adventure game created in virtual reality based on various realities of Chernobyl, which tells a story of fear and conspiracy. The protagonist Olena tries to prevent a nuclear catastrophe. Olena travels through numerous realities in order to find a way to rescue her own world. You play as a doctor Olena Ponomarenko, a scientist working on space and time travel, but not everyone likes this. The top secret and dangerous mission can't wait. Is there any way out of this situation? She has to find out! Change the history and face the challenges you will meet in Chernobyl and Pripyat... You can't fail because the price is too high.


Rescue Your Reality


It isn't easy to live without parents. Our main character - Olena Ponomarenko, knows it best. She has always wanted to see her parents again to tell them how much she loves them and that is why she is in a place like this. As a scientist, she tries to find a way to travel in time. Is it possible? She doesn't know it yet, but maybe she will find it out in the upcoming future. Could you help her? It would be great to go on this adventure together!

Describe Your Enemy

As you may know - not every person is trustworthy. Some people might not have as good intentions as you think. It will be important to carefully observe the situation. You never know where you can find help and who can be trusted. Maybe you are not just a tool in somebody else’s hands. You have to look out and think reasonably.

CORE FEATURES

A grim story about conspiracy, crime, and an attempt to rescue people's lives. Delve into a complex and terrifying story about the place and the people suffering from the consequences of the catastrophe. Of course, you can't believe everyone, but it is up to you who you trust.

Story based on Chernobyl localization
The game has a unique photorealistic feeling of the environment thanks to photogrammetry scanning. Our experience as developers who visited the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone several times let us create an immersive world full of emotions and secret meanings. Visit the most well-known places in Chernobyl and find a way to rescue it.

Interact with objects and the environment


You will have the opportunity to use many futuristic devices to travel in time and space! Your interactive watch will help you navigate and discover the dark secrets of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, and your special suitcase will help you explore various realities!

Immersive gameplay


Virtual exploration of Chernobyl has never been so exciting! The correlation between the story and Virtual Reality technology draws players deep into the game's world. Every single move has an important influence on the evolution of the story.

Interactive puzzle mechanics
VR controllers will allow you to interact with the environment and solve the problems emerging on your way! Not everything is as simple as it looks. You will discover a lot of riddles that will help you find the path to a better future! But, are you ready to uncover the truth?

Unique assets necessary to time travel

Your suitcase is a unique object. You need to find a way to figure out how it works. Once it’s done, you will be ready to explore space and time! Will it be enough to solve this conspiracy? You need to find out!

2110840.name: Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees
2110840.about_the_game:
Overview:

Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees is a classic western RPG inspired by the games from the 90s like Might & Magic, Wizardry, Ultima, the Gold Box series and others. Using the classic first-person perspective, over grid movement, turn-based system to travel in an open world with fast travel options and a quick combat.

You lead a party of 7 adventurers, manually assembled or pre-made, on an epic adventure to fight the evil which lurks in Amberland. It's light, fairy tale, epic, heroic and slightly humorous. It does not take tons of hours to complete or require an endless grind to progress. Basically, it's a love letter from the 90s, the golden era of RPGs.

Notable features:

  • First person perspective, 90 degree rotation, over grid movement (like in the 90s).
  • Turn-based (both combat and exploration).
  • Party-based (7 heroes, either predefined or manually assembled upon new game).
  • Fast paced combat, especially blazing fast against much weaker enemies.
  • Quick travel to reduce backtracking.
  • Easy inventory management with separate personal equipment encumbrance system and an infinite magic bag of carrying for items not equipped at the moment.
  • Open world with a big overworld to explore.
  • Quests (including both main storyline quests and side quests).
  • Rich world lore (spanning between all games of the series, but no knowledge of prior games required).

Technicalities:

The game was designed to look and feel like one of the old games while working flawlessly on modern machines, especially on very high resolutions. It has very low hardware requirements and should run on even very old machines.

About the relation to other games in the series:

The Legends of Amberland titles can be played in any order you wish. They share the same world and lore (historical events) but each has a separate and self-contained story. There might be some mild references to events in the previous titles of the series, but more like a flavor, so it does not hinder the ability to play those in any order.

2111020.name: Edge Islands
2111020.about_the_game:
Edge Islands mixes the gameplay of a Colony Sim with Tactical RPG elements like turn-based combats and heroes to level up.

Inspired by classics of the genre but more accessible, manage a team of adventurers landing on a procedural island, and explore dungeons while taking care of their needs, moods, traits and social interactions.

BUILD YOUR COLONY



Gather resources from your environment to build a colony for your heroes and prepare for their adventures. Make them cosy to improve their mood, farm and raise animals to provide food while facing changing weather and seasons. Then, when you are ready, recruit new members and expand until building a massive fortress. You will find many items and customization options to create a unique base!

ENGAGE IN TACTICAL COMBATS



Take part in turn-based tactical combats with your heroes. Use skills learned in the colony and earn XP to level up. Experience fast-paced combats with teams of 4 and based on placement and synergies between units.

EXPLORE & LOOT DUNGEONS



Explore procedural islands with points of interest and resources to improve the colony. Prepare and send groups on expeditions into procedural dungeons to retrieve loot and gold, allowing you to recruit new heroes and unlock new constructions.

TRAIN & MANAGE YOUR HEROES



Prepare your heroes for battle by building training facilities to unlock combat skills based on their classes. Craft them better equipment, potions, and items. But be careful: Training and fighting take time, and they also have other duties to perform for the colony!
And don’t forget to take care of their mood, ambitions and relationships to maximize their combat efficiency.

FEATURES


  • Endless Replayability: Maps, dungeons and heroes are procedurally generated to make every game unique and full of new adventures.
  • Heroes Customization: Personalize your heroes with classes, skills, and items to create unique fighting styles.
  • Management & Combats: A balanced system where you need to build to improve your combat skills, and you need to defeat enemies to unlock new constructions for your colony.
  • Accessible & Deep: Easily build an efficient colony, but don’t hesitate to optimize it thanks to advanced light or temperature propagation systems.
  • Custom Pacing: Progress by defeating dungeon bosses with increasing difficulty, but you can take your time to strengthen your heroes and develop your colony.
  • 3D Graphics: Discover simple yet beautiful 3D graphics combined with advanced lighting and atmospheric effects, which will make you enjoy decorating your base even more!

2111060.name: The Longest Walk
2111060.about_the_game:
The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical walking simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression and suicidal thoughts. The game was created using audio recorded from a 54-minute-long interview that I conducted with my dad, which was then edited into this approximately 9-and-a-half minute long playable experience.

The aim for this game is to help reduce feelings of isolation and encourage those who are struggling with depression or experiencing suicidal thoughts to reach out for help. Through my father's sharing of his personal experience in an open and frank manner, this game seeks to raise awareness of and provide an insight into what it is like living with depression in order to provoke discussion and help tackle the stigma about opening-up about mental health issues.

Whilst my father's experience and the locations depicted in the game are specific to him, the thoughts, feelings, and message conveyed through his recollection of lived experience are universal.



The Longest Walk is now playable on Steam Deck! Please use the following settings for best performance and subtitle readability:
- Subtitles: Standard
- Graphics: Optimised

Players using a gamepad or Steam Deck can invert the Y-Axis by holding LB (L1) and tapping RB (R1) on the gamepad.



This free game is part of a series of documentary-inspired biographical game prototypes that I am developing for my PhD at Abertay University - Funded by The Northwood Charitable Trust - and was inspired by games such as Dear Esther (The Chinese Room), Actual Sunlight (WZOGI), and That Dragon, Cancer (Numinous Games). This game is published under the Abertay Game Lab practice-based research group by Somewhat Unsettling.

2111090.name: Let's! Revolution!
2111090.about_the_game:
Rise up in Let’s! Revolution!, a roguelite puzzle mashup that builds on the classic rules of Minesweeper with procedurally generated mazes and turn-based tactics.

Choose your hero from six unique classes, each with their own playstyle and abilities, including:

  • The Charger, a powerhouse who unleashes devastating attacks but must keep charging into hidden tiles to gain energy.

  • The Shadow, who uses cunning items like Smoke Bombs and Sleep Darts to outwit and outmaneuver enemies.

  • The Oracle, a master of perception magic who adds extra information to navigate the mazes with superior logic and teleportation.

PEOPLE TO MEET: From the King and his cronies to the Shopkeepers that help you along the way, you’ll encounter a diverse cast of memorable characters brought to life through expressive animation and cheeky dialogue.

KEEP IT SIMPLE: Say goodbye to tiresome calculations and obscure probabilities. Board-game-inspired mechanics keeps the focus on learning abilities and strategic gameplay.

GO DEEP: With 5 levels of NG+ to unlock for each class, expert players can expect to have their skills put to the ultimate test.

OR CHILL OUT: Take a break from the challenge with Easy Mode, perfect for more casual players or those who want to overthrow the monarchy at their own pace.

Establish your homestead

Raise cute animals that reward your affection with handy produce that is perfect for recipes, as gifts or sold for a profit at your very own market stall. Fall in love, start a family and build precious memories

This reimagined version of A Wonderful Life brings all of the heart and charm of the original to a new generation as the definitive experience of one of the most cherished entries in the long-running farming series.

2111440.name: Orbital Patrol: The Lani Goodspeed Story

Lieutenant Lani Goodspeed, callsign "Tango-2-6," of the First Squadron, Third Orbital Defense Regiment, graduated with honors from the Earth Alliance Space Forces Flight Academy.

Upon graduation, she joins her unit aboard the carrier called "Star Carrier" to begin her service.

Three days later, she embarks on her first combat mission…

  • Gameplay
    Implementation of planetary and space battles in 2D side-scrolling shooter mechanics. You will experience various flight modes, high-speed maneuvering through obstacles, aerial and space combat, engaging enemy forces, providing cover for allied troops, and storming fortified enemy positions.

  • Storyline
    An alien race of mechanoids has invaded Earth, dragging humanity into a space war for its own planet. The campaign follows strike pilot Lani Goodspeed from her first combat sortie to the final decisive battle against the alien aggressor.

  • Missions
    Military command has devised a plan to liberate the Solar System. Several strike groups, supported by regular army forces, will engage the enemy over the course of five missions. The primary objective of the units is to prevent the enemy from gaining a foothold on our planet and in near-Earth orbit.

  • Enemies
    At present, we have identified the primary hierarchy and classification of the enemy's frontline forces:

    Class 1 & 2: standard assault squads that operate alone or in small groups.

    Class 3: transport units that deploy assault troops and serve as heavily armed, reinforced combat units in their own right.

    The enemy possesses technological superiority over humanity, advanced weaponry, modular interchangeable structures, and a complex unit hierarchy. Every battle against them is a serious test.

  • Bossfights
    Class 4—Titan Class: resource extraction stations. Complex structures consisting of multiple Class 3 units. Defeating them requires identifying their weak points and employing special tactics.

  • Fighter
    The SRJF S-600 M23 "Interceptor" is a cutting-edge short-range jet fighter. It serves as the primary combat unit of orbital defense and can also fulfill a support aircraft role. Capable of operating both in the atmosphere and beyond, though only within a limited range of its carrier ship.

  • Weapons and bonuses

QUANTUM POWERS

With the help of her friends and some new quantum tricks up her sleeve, Mittens must puzzle her way through the secretive research facility, uncover the truth, and make it home before breakfast.

The game is based around a central quantum mechanic — at the press of a button Mittens can split into two cats, who can each be controlled to solve puzzles and cause trouble.

BUT THERE’S A TWIST

The quantum superstate obeys Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle - when nobody is looking, Mittens could be in either location. If she’s observed however, things get theoretical…

🚪 Pass through doors (that could theoretically have opened).

🚓 Avoid security detection (you can’t see what doesn’t exist).

🧵 Quantum mechanics plus cats. No strings attached!

Use your powers to access the inaccessible, evade the inevitable, and heist the unheistable to become Schrodinger's Cat Burglar!

A QUANTUM ADVENTURE THAT'S ONE OF A KIND!

Play dress-up and choose custom hats, cat breeds, accessories and of course - level of cat chonkiness.

🤫 Unravel The Secrets of The Lab

What is this shady facility researching? What are the pest-control robots protecting? And who is this mysterious Shadow Cat…? 

🏆 Expanded Gameplay

Hidden areas, sneaky mouse-bots and tricky quantum shards for the more advanced puzzle fans out there – or if you just want to knock coffee off desks, you can do that too… 

🎮 Top Secret Cheat Code

Rock Paper SMASH is a unique spin on the platform fighter genre combining strategy, chaos, and humor. Anyone from seasoned veteran to complete novice can have a blast with the core mechanic: the only attack options are Rock, Paper, Scissors.

While the core attacks are always Rock Paper Scissors, all characters feel unique and add their own distinct flavor to the game. Meet some of the iconic cast:

FRIDGE

Big and very slow, but get too close and you're toast. Fridge has huge attacks with huge damage. Holding the jump button allows Fridge to slowly blast-off like a rocket.

MARK

Mark boasts disjointed sword attacks and has unique movements when attacking; Scissors performs a forward dash, Paper is akin to an extra jump with an uppercut motion, and Rock does a downward fast falling dive.


CAR

Heavy but with super fast movement speed, Car can follow up on attacks that others can't. Jumping with Car creates a physics-based ramp which works based on how fast you're moving.

FOX

Having both photo-realistic and cartoon skins, Fox attacks quickly enough to keep anyone on their toes. Fox is sure to distract everyone with his shiny blue taunt!

And many more ...

Taunting with Rock-Paper-Scissors

Taunting is an important part of any fighting game. Rock Paper SMASH features a normal taunt on each character, but also every character can do a "Rock" "Paper" or "Scissors" taunt for added mind-games and tricks. Tell your opponent "I'm going to rock" repeatedly, then, maybe... still go Rock!

Time your dodge-rolls and reloads to stay one step ahead of a horde of hungry monsters. Back against the wall? Pop off with a special ability… or grab a melee weapon and smash your way out.

CUTTING-EDGE TOOLS TO MASTER

2111990.name: Lose Ctrl
2111990.about_the_game:
Lose Ctrl is the debut title by berlin based studio Play From Your Heart Ug (haftungsbeschränkt) and with such a competent CEO such as Martin J. Apple himself, it’s no wonder the game has already won awards and gained recognition from big industry names.

Want to break out of the normalcy of the rest of life and experience true chaos? Not the regular chaos, but the kind that makes your keyboard betray you, your mouse rebel, and makes you want to rewire your brain? That’s what Lose Ctrl has in store for you. A game where the only thing you can count on is that you can’t count on anything. One moment, left is right. The next, up is down. And that’s just the tutorial.

Lose Ctrl is basically a life lesson disguised as a video game—an existential, audiovisual rollercoaster that explores infinite possibilities through a meta-level narrative. Oh, and as if that wasn’t enough, we also threw in a couch co-op mode so groundbreaking, it technically didn’t exist until we made it.

Billy’s life is very ordinary. He drives to work, fills out spreadsheets and goes grocery shopping. Super exciting, right? Slowly, but then suddenly not so slowly, things stop working as they’re supposed to. Once Billy’s life spirals out of control, so does your ability to navigate the game. Are you gonna be able to help Billy get through the day when every button you press does something you don’t expect? Probably not but that’s alright. You’ll still have fun trying.

Sick of your friends beating you at video games? Don’t worry! Even with up to 5 of your friends that are really good at games, the real challenge here is figuring out how to play.

  • Race against your friends in vehicles you definitely don’t know how to drive.

  • Play Segway Golf and try to hit a hole-in-one while battling your own muscle memory.

  • Attempt Segway Basketball, because regular basketball wasn’t confusing enough.

  • Compete in Fall Folks, a game mode where falling is not the intended goal—but good luck avoiding it.

No one has an advantage. No one knows what they’re doing. And that’s the beauty of it.

Lose Ctrl is many things, but one thing it is not: predictable. Its a mixture of many things and evades classifyability. But fear not! It will all make sense in the end as the games development is supervised by CEO Martin Apple. His vision ensures the quality of the product.

2112290.name: Tide of Thieves
2112290.about_the_game:
Fight your way through the defenses of a scurvy rival to claim back your stolen treasure. Collect new weapons and ammunition along the way, solve puzzles, discover secret areas, all the while, defending yourself from a mercenary armada and their strange contraptions.




The journey would not be the same without company so, you'll be joining Hayes, the captain, Cassandra, the cartographer and last but not least, Jerad, the cannoneer. Experience the story (and a lot of chit-chat) through their humorous interactions while dodging traps, cannonballs and heavy fire.




There's more than cannonballs in Jerad's disposal. From flame throwers, roaming rockets and machine guns to flaming bottles of rum, mines and ray guns. Burn, wreck, electrocute and sink the enemy's defenses. But use your weapons wisely, unlike cannonballs those are not so easy to come by!




During the adventure you can collect Doubloons. As long as you can afford it, with these shiny little golden coins you will be able to recover your ship even from the bottom of the sea! You also have the option to spend your hard earn Doubloons on conquered checkpoints to buy weapons and ammo, but choose wisely, or your journey will be over!


Fortresses are scattered all around the world. From sunny equatorial heat to the icy cold winds of the north, in total there are five unique and vibrant environments to explore and plunder. Plus, here there be monsters! Keep your eyes peeled for five mysterious sea creatures who are all waiting to drag you down into the depths of the sea!

Not everyone is an enemy though, watch out for friends and they might bestow gifts on you, or slightly change the playing environment sometimes for the better sometimes for the more annoying.

2112360.name: Droneboi: Conquest
2112360.about_the_game:
Welcome to Droneboi: Conquest, the ultimate open-world sandbox space drone building, exploration, and multiplayer vehicle combat game!

Multiplayer combat in space

Engage in thrilling multiplayer battles, showcasing your combat skills with a diverse range of weapons and equipment.

Explore the Realm

Embark on an epic journey through the vast universe, exploring space stations, asteroid belts, factions, and alliances.

Build and customize

Create your dream space drone using a variety of cool parts and gizmos, from powerful thrusters to devastating weapons, mining equipment, and advanced logic components.

Spacelings and space stations

While not exploring, enjoy some peaceful moments and visit and roam around stations as your very own Spaceling. Upgrade your character with new outfits and equipment, chilling out in the station's lounge to discuss the latest faction wars with fellow adventurers.

Mining and asteroids

Explore asteroid belts, mine and process materials, and sell them at stations for a profit.

Sandbox

Tired of mining? Play Sandbox to instantly unlock all components and a variety of extra world settings to experiment and customize without limits in a larger build area.

Advanced boolean and numerical logic mechanics

Call yourself a true engineer? Dive into the world of computing and connect various logic components to automate processes and interact with mechanical components. Don't ask me how, but this guy made a literal Snake game. If he can do that, you can certainly learn how to make a GPS auto-aiming turret in no-time!

Trading and economy

Still want to earn a credit but not a big miner? Become a merchant trading and manage supply and demand chains of various station types scattered across the galaxy.

Online vehicle workshop

Browse literal thousands of player-made vehicles on our very own in-game (Steam) vehicle workshop to learn the ropes of various game mechanics quickly. Or check out the presets vehicle list to get solid starter vehicles for your early days.

Challenges

Try and master a set of challenges, testing your vehicle building and flying skills through missions with advancing rulesets and timings.



Still not convinced? I am happy to answer any questions you may have about the game over at support@rizenplanet.com, or on the Discord linked on this store page!

The first mmorpg-f that will give players a whole new, unique experience and absolute freedom in the world of Yggdrasil.
Yggdrasil, a world that will have to be shaped by the players themselves, be it economically or otherwise, absolute freedom will be granted and it will be up to the strongest to make the law.
Whether for good or ill, the future of the world of Yggdrasil will depend on the will of the players. Become an emperor, an adventurer, a mercenary or a simple merchant.
Steal money and other items from your comrades, slaughter your prey, or bring justice to the edge of your sword.
In Yggdrasil, death has an impact and consequences, and every action must be carefully considered, especially when visiting the many deadly trap dungeons...

2112380.name: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room Prototype
2112380.about_the_game:
Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room Prototype is a free, first-person, short medical horror experience that is an early rendition of the prequel we envisioned for Negative Atmosphere. While no further updates are planned, it remains available as an archival piece.

In this prototype, you control the S.P.I.D.E.R. (Surgical, Procedure, Intervention, Diagnostic, Emergency, Response) robot aboard the TRH Rusanov. You’ll perform two distinct operations: an autopsy on a cadaver to gather evidence and a surgical procedure on a pineapple.

Guided by Medical Officer Samuel Edwards, you’ll gain an understanding of the core systems that have been substantially expanded.

2112420.name: Pillazon: MMO Drug Lord Tycoon
2112420.about_the_game:
Pillazon is a company management simulation game. Your job is to be a CEO who is eager to grow your small company. With a small investment, you'll build a great website to compete with other players in hopes of building the most valuable drug empire in history.

Website Management


Your success depends on your website. So, ensure you have enough servers and max your features' levels as soon as possible.

Employee Management


Your employees are the key part of your success. As you grow, you need to keep hiring more people. Your employees may lose morale over time, make the necessary expenses to prevent this, and make bonus payments to them if necessary.

Office Management


You have to rent more offices in order to hire more employees. There are many different kinds of office space, choose what you need. Decorate and make the necessary expenses to increase your employees' morale.

Server Management


You have to rent the most effective servers to run smoothly your website, otherwise, you will start losing users. Be aware of overload on servers to prevent this.

Risk & Finance Management


Sell or buy bitcoins at real-life prices to manage your finance. Make investments to clean your money otherwise, police will arrest your employees and close your properties. Be careful, other players can do research and find your investments to sabotage them with help of the mob. Level up your investments as much as possible to prevent them from being sabotaged.

Rank Management | Zone fights


Capture zones as much as possible, more zone means more rank up. Ranks will get you different benefits such as;
  • More office capacity
  • Speed buff for Employee Point Producing

PvP


Do DDoS attacks with your Attack(Hack) points, and defend your website with Defence points. Do Research about of target player's investments to sabotage it with the mob.

  • DDoS attacks
  • Sabotage investments
  • Zone fights

Zone Capturing


The first order of transportation to a zone will start a battle for that zone. The battle will conclude after 24 hours. Meanwhile, players are able to send more troops. At the end of the battle time, the player who has more troops in the zone captures the zone.

Kaiju Klash is a turn-based fighter where you build your own giant monster and fight to climb the ranks of the arena against other perilous, and sometimes wacky, opponents. Combine the legs, arms, and torso of the monsters you choose to get just the right build. With each monster part offering unique stats and abilities, there's no shortage of ways you can go.

Arena Mode

2112570.name: Zombies TD
2112570.about_the_game:
Zombies TD is a tower defense style game with some differences. Amongst them:
-The game is not based on rounds, zombies will be born all the time, faster and stronger.
-The game ends when time runs out or the objective that must be protected by the player is destroyed by them.
-Also, a level system is built into the game which increases after a certain amount of enemies are killed.
-Every time you level up, the player will be able to choose from three rewards that are chosen at random.
-Soldiers: they are the main defense, they all come equipped with a weapon and can only be placed on specific turrets or objects. Also, they can be removed or replaced with another one instead.
-Towers: are objects that, in addition to blocking the passage of enemies, serve so that soldiers can stay away from them.
-Barriers: in addition to blocking the path of zombies forcing them to find another path, it also decreases their health and speed. Both barriers and towers cannot be removed or replaced, so think carefully before placing them. In addition, they can only be placed in a predetermined area.
-Zombies do not follow a specific path, they aim to destroy the target and will do anything to achieve it.
-Every time you receive the rewards, you will only have five seconds to choose one of them.
-Finally, some random events will happen, examples: an extra horde of zombies, stronger enemies and faster enemies, so be aware and prepare for them.

2112580.name: Elite Forces
2112580.about_the_game:
Elite Forces redefines the tactical shooter genre through a fusion of cinematic immersion and elite-grade gameplay. This is not an arcade distraction—it is a precision-oriented, skill-driven battlefield designed for operatives who demand perfection in every mission.

Players assume the role of specialized operators navigating a high-stakes warzone where every decision has consequences, and survival is dictated by skill, awareness, and tactical execution. Built on advanced mechanics and refined over multiple iterations, the game now enters a new era with its most significant update to date.

Key Features:

  • Cinematic Combat Architecture
    A new era of visual fidelity. Dynamic lighting, high-definition effects, and immersive soundscapes create a battlefield experience that borders on realism.

  • Tactical Core Mechanics
    Every movement, shot, and decision matters. The core gameplay rewards intelligence, positioning, and precision under pressure.

  • Evolving AI Threat Matrix
    Engage against enemies that adapt to your behavior. Advanced AI systems create unpredictable challenges that escalate with your skill.

  • Multiplayer and Solo Mission Structures
    Whether you operate alone or with a squad, missions are structured to test strategic thinking, reflexes, and leadership.

  • Cross-Platform Expansion
    With this latest release, Elite Forces is now fully supported on macOS, enabling a broader community of operatives to join the mission.

  • Cinematic Launch Update
    The latest version introduces enhanced effects, refined mechanics, and a complete audiovisual overhaul, premiered in the newly released official cinematic trailer.

Elite Forces is not merely a game. It is an operational simulation for elite minds. Tactical thinking is no longer optional—it's mandatory.

2112610.name: Last Stand

Thin the zombie horde with explosives devices such as land mines, bazookas and air strikes.   Upgrade your squads skills and arm them with powerful weapons and armor.

2112680.name: Darkness Revenge
2112680.about_the_game:
Jill and Nathan are two special agents. The two agents, are on the verge of framing notorious billionaire Donald Patterson. Things go awry, however, and the two are killed.
When it all seems to be over, the vampire Laura decides to save one of the two agents.
Thus begins the revenge.
Darkness revenge is an adult visual novel where you can play as Jill or Nathan.
After the introduction you will then have to choose whether to play with a female or male role.
There will be many choices to be made throughout the story, choices that will serve to change the story itself as well as the endings.
You will be able to use your vampire powers, which, however, will not be infinite. In the statistics screen you will be able to read how many vampire points you get back. Once you run out, you will have to kill in order to get them back.
Be very careful and save often, as some choices will prevent you from pursuing other stories! Some choices will lead to character death.
Darkness revenge is thus a choice-based sandbox with multiple endings.


Features:

- 4300 Full Hd Images
- 87 Full Hd Animations
- 91000 Words
- 681 Possible choices
- Music & Sound Effects
- Multiple endings
- Replay Gallery
- 40 Steam Achievement
- Ren'py Engine


Who will you choose? The sexy and brave Jill? Or the bold and determined Nathan?


Amanda Patterson is the daughter of well-known industry magnate Donald Patterson. Her role in this story is pivotal. Something connects her to Laura, what is it?
Laura is the vampire lady who will save Nathan or Jill. Why did she do that? She seems to be hiding something. Is she really as good a person as she says she is?


Isabelle is the sister of the late Jill (she will appear only in Nathan's story). She is beautiful, but she could bring a lot of trouble....
Annie will be in charge of giving the first nurturing to Nathan. She would seem naive and carefree, but, inside her, a deep dark force is ready to come out.



SOME OTHER CHARACTERS:
Gilbert: One of Laura's vampires.
Donald Patterson: Jill and Nathan's murder mandate.
Liam Patterson: Donald's psychopathic son.
Vanessa Reeves: Patterson family lawyer.
Allison: Chain's Den mistress.
Clara: One of the prostitutes at the Chain's Den.
AND MANY MORE!

2112740.name: Humanica
2112740.about_the_game:
Ancient world

It all starts in 10,000 B.C. You will have to go through a difficult path of human development - from the Paleolithic to the Iron Age. The game features a massive technology tree, the progression of which will change your play style from time to time, forcing you to adapt to new conditions. Meanwhile, your settlement will grow, becoming larger and more technologically advanced.

Everyday life of settlers

You will be building, gathering, crafting various items, farming, animal husbandry and smelting bronze and iron. In the beginning you will not have an abundance of resources, so in the first years the main goal will be to survive. After all, the settlers must be fed and clothed.

Turn-based gameplay elements

The game process is divided into days. Each day is an iteration of a cycle, or turn, within which the settlers will have time to do a limited amount of work. Therefore, you should strive to keep the settlers working as efficiently as possible. As the saying goes - “Just One More Turn!”.

World map

You will have to explore a turn-based hexagonal world map. You can find useful resources on it: new seeds to grow, new animals to breed and much more.

Construction and landscape

The game features an unusual construction grid of irregular randomly shaped quadrilaterals. The landscape is editable, and consists of large square squares. If you suddenly dreamed about it, you will be able to dig out a mountain, or on the contrary build it!

Settlement Defense

Evil wild animals and nomads will want to stop you from prospering. Arm your settlers and build walls with towers to defend your settlement.

Other key features

  • The world is procedurally generated. At the beginning of the game you will be able to choose the desired landscape to your taste.

  • A system of laws and annual plans that will add to the game the ability to customize your playthrough style. Available annual plans can drop randomly, adding light rogue-like elements to the game.

  • The quality of tools determines the acceleration of certain jobs for residents. Go ahead and create iron and bronze axes and pickaxes!

This game is made by one person with love! I hope you will enjoy it!

He will fight against the "Nushi and their servants," who control the various levels of hell and try to prevent him from escaping.

2112820.name: The Godfeather : A Mafia Pigeon Saga
2112820.about_the_game:
From the creators of Puffington, Nippy Cats and Inflatality comes The Godfeather - a savage tale of feathered vengeance from the pigeon underworld.

Used to be an honest boid could make a living... now your enemies have moved in and flocked up the whole operation. The Godfeather tasks you with taking back the old neighborhood- one borough at a time. It’s time to send a message… FROM ABOVE.



Use all the powers of pigeon persuasion to dominate the neighborhood. When HQ radios in with your next target, you’ll wanna pay a visit as soon as possible. SWOOP to strike fear in your enemies and POOP to take out your targets from above.

Loot dumpsters to reload your poop ammo and scour the neighborhood for the fabled Golden Twigs of Pigeon legend.

It's time for payback on all enemies of the organisation. Whether it's tree snitches, diners at brunch, enemy birds, rival suppliers, fleeing informants or fresh laundry just waiting to be redecorated - they all gotta go.



The enemy has spies everywhere. Get spotted by a cockatoo lookout and they’ll call in the heat instantly. Once that happens, you've got seconds before a drone comes to capture you. Find a tree or a dumpster to hide in until the heat's off, because once you get pinched- it’s game over.


Drones aren’t the only thing a boid has to worry about - cats stalk the rooftops, lawn Karens have garden hoses with your name on it and deadly owls are just waiting to swoop you at sunset.



Even soldiers need their down time. Visit the roost between runs to get fitted out with the very latest in boid technology. Upgrade your abilities, equip gadgets to give you the edge or get a whole new look to keep your plumage looking tight out there.



The Godfeather challenges you to survive brutal procedurally-generated neighborhoods from the suburbs to the boidwalk to the city - each filled with unique targets, hazards, increasing difficulty and deadly area bosses.

You mail fail, but dust off your feathers and take another run at victory. As you succeed, your legend grows and you edge closer to uncovering the dark secret at the heart of the pigeon mafia. Could you be the next Godfeather?

2112830.name: Idle Space War
2112830.about_the_game:
About the Game:

Your state must seem legitimate according to your culture. Let that legitimacy hit zero and you lose the game. Build temples, win wars and build monuments to raise it. You will have to manage your elites and be sure to maintain their loyalty.

A world of constant difficulty

Small kingdoms and huge empires don't play the same. Try to expand and survive as a small nation, using warfare and diplomacy as you primary tools. Maintain your rule as a huge empire, with your scheming elites, foreign clergies and populations who don't want your rule, and dreams of liberty.

Fourteen startdates, from 3400BC to 1450BC

Unify the chiefdoms of Egypt, take sides in the war between Horus and Set, see the rise and fall of the Old Kingdom or rule as the New Kingdom and conquer Nubia and the Levant.
