You will encounter broken strings, zombie tuners, deranged groupies, and more on your way to the stage. At the end of each level you will face off with a rival group.

Listen to 8-bit renditions of original Gasoline Gypsies music as you travel across Michigan. On your adventure you will unlock levels, costumes, mini games and more. Compete for dominance on the online leaderboard or team up with a friend for local co-op. The Gasoline Gypsies Game is a colorful non violent game intended for all ages.

Features
14 Levels & Bosses
3 Unique Power-Ups
2 player co-op (with 2nd gamepad)
Sound Test
Difficulty Settings
Online Leaderboard
Unlockable Achievements, Costumes, & Mini Games

2113270.name: DISDAIN
2113270.about_the_game:
High Speed, High Adrenaline Combat
Choose between five weapons (more coming soon) and obliterate your enemies in fast-paced, visceral combat

Chunky Retro Violence
Slice your enemies into two, or reduce them to chunky gibs. Destructible objects also add to the carnage

Bespoke Nu-Retro Technology
Powered by a highly modified version of GZDoom, DISDAIN boasts several enhanced features like pre-calculated lightmaps, lens flares, and many more

Atmospheric and Hard Hitting Soundtrack
Composed by Nash Muhandes, blast through your enemies with carefully-crafted music ranging from moody, dark textures, to head-banging metal riffs

2113290.name: Spam Text
2113290.about_the_game:
Spam Text is a word game that requires you to quickly think about all the words in your dictionary that can match letters on the screen. Think fast before the letters pile up to the top of the screen.

The rules are simple:
  • Spam words on your keyboard with letters on the screen.
  • Any 3-10 letter word counts.
  • Use bigger words to score more points!

There are two game modes:
  • Free Play - any word goes even if you already played it before.
  • Challenge Mode - no duplicate words allowed!

There are three game styles:
  • Marathon - Letters fall with no caveat, expand your vocabulary!
  • Item Mode - Letters fall, but sometimes there will be random multipliers, Bombs, and more!
  • Word Quest - Only score points by playing words in the word list, but be careful! Sometimes you don't have the letter you need and you'll need to play other words so the blocks don't stack too high. The lists get harder with each level!
2113290.supported_languages: English, German, Portuguese - Portugal, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

2113300.name: Holiday with Gwen
2113300.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of detective Hank and his sidekick Gwen from the Snares of Ruin universe. This time they have a top secret mission in an exotic Mediterranean-like country to uncover an illegal drug trade, but also to use this opportunity to enjoy themselves and perhaps even to savour romantic moments.

A work assignment that's also a holiday. How can you say no to a relaxing time at the beach or by the pool or exploring the city streets and cafes? Moreover, you have Gwen accompanying you everywhere, your cute, sweet and positive-minded co-worker, friend and perhaps even lover with whom many romantic moments can be had. But don't forget the mission. We need to know our targets better, as well as their involvement. A millionaire tycoon who is developing revolutionary technology, his helpful yet mysterious assistant, a flirty girl at the beach that won't leave you alone, a peculiar guy taking photos of you while you're walking the streets... We have detective work to do and bad guys to catch and we only have a few days to do it.


General Features:
  • A casual visual novel with a detective plot
  • Plenty of romance-building with the leading female character, Gwen
  • What kind of relationship we develop with Gwen depends on our dialogue choices and actions
  • Mostly a linear story with some branching narrative
  • Beautiful and breathtaking scenery and places to see

2113330.name: Pixel Boy: The Legend of Tain
2113330.about_the_game:
Meet Tain, a Nesprit (Fox-Human hybrid) with a knack for exploring.

Explore, fight and engage on a bite-sized adventure to help Tain find his missing friend.


-A Solo adventure with multiple areas to explore!

-A variety of enemies to fight and items to use!

-Several Power Ups and Star Keys to find!

2113350.name: Heartspell: Horizon Academy
2113350.about_the_game:
Welcome to Heartspell: Horizon Academy, a magical dating game with a lot of heart and a little spice!

You're the newest student at the Horizon Wizarding Academy, an eclectic institution deep in the spirit realms. There you'll learn magic, meet fellow students, and uncover secrets that threaten the very foundation of the academy. Heartspell is a game about dating sirens, werewolves, fairies, and a host of other wizarding students. Solve puzzles and build relationships as you explore the stories of deep, nuanced characters populating a rich world brimming with fantasy, wonder, and just a little spice.

  • Eleven main characters, each with their own art, voice, story, and gameplay mechanics.
  • Characters can be played through romantically or platonically, in any combination. Choices never block things off, so you can experience the 20+ hours of content without needing to replay anything.
  • Choices at every turn! From love lives to epic destinies, your decisions will shape the lives of the people around you.
  • Match-3 gameplay with a magical twist as you learn spells from other students that unlock new gameplay possibilities.
  • Multiple difficulty modes, including Story for players who aren't interested in puzzle gameplay.
  • A range of accessibility options, including screen-reader support for story mode.
2113350.reviews:
“[The] game with the distinction of having the most attractive artwork of any game I played at SIX this year. I discovered the world of the game, which takes place in a school of magic full to the brim with sexy and exuberant people. You’re able to romance whoever you want, but don’t expect these relationships to be one note.”
Hey Poor Player

“[Heartspell] is an unmatched visual novel in terms of design and inclusivity.”
Game Raven Review

2113370.name: Hex Picross
2113370.about_the_game:
Beautiful minimalist design and a relaxing atmosphere


Hex Picross was assembled with a beautiful and relaxing minimalist design
Made with relaxing visual and sound effects
In addition to music prepared exclusively

How to play


You need to click on the hexagonal cells to make them colored
Each diagonal and column counts how many colored cells there are
Your challenge is to find all the intersections between columns and diagonals
With this, they will decrease their number and will be equal to zero.
When all are equal to zero, you've won the game.

Many Difficulty Levels

  • 3x3x3 - 40 Levels
  • 4x4x4 - 40 Levels
  • 5x5x5 - 40 Levels
  • 6x6x6 - 40 Levels
  • 7x7x7- 40 Levels
  • 9x9x9 - 40 Levels

Resources

  • Minimalist: no timer and no pressure, solve puzzles in your own time
  • Premium: 240 carefully chosen levels
  • Zen: Zen and relaxing sound environment
  • Dark Mode: Perfect if you can't stare at the white screen for too long
  • Steam Cloud and Steam Achivements

2113410.name: Wicked West
2113410.about_the_game:
Survive. Upgrade. Dominate.

Step into the unforgiving frontier of Wicked West, a relentless top-down shoot 'em up survival game set in a twisted version of the Wild West. It’s you against hordes of ruthless enemies in a lawless land where the only rule is kill or be killed. Armed with nothing but grit and your trusty gun, you'll need quick reflexes and strategic thinking to last as long as possible.

Features

  • One Life, Sudden Death
    Death is permanent in Wicked West. Outdraw, outgun, and outsmart your foes to stay alive in this high-stakes survival rogue-like experience.

  • Dynamic Progression System
    Earn experience by racking up kills and claiming victory over waves of enemies. Level up to unlock powerful upgrades, new weapons, and devastating abilities to take on increasingly dangerous waves.

  • Epic Boss Battles
    Face off against fearsome Wild West bosses, each with unique attack patterns and challenges that will test your skills to the limit.

  • Variety of Enemy Types
    From bandits to Cowboys, Rifleman and more; every encounter is a deadly dance where one wrong move can end your run.

  • Survival ModeYour core experience. Survive against waves of enemies. How long can you last? And what is the highest score you can achieve!

Are You Ready to Take your Shot?

Grab your revolver, saddle up, and show the Wicked West what you're made of. Survive the chaos, grow stronger with every kill, and carve your name into legend.

2113420.name: The Solace Paradox
2113420.about_the_game:
You find yourself in a peculiar magical laboratory, surrounded by mysterious objects and strange sensations. The only familiarities are the voices of your companions in your head, who you can curiously hear, but not see. Work together to explore your surroundings, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel the mystery of The Solace Paradox.



The Solace Paradox is a 2-4 player cooperative first-person puzzle game designed for both veteran puzzle enthusiasts and casual sleuths alike, with a focus on communication and story rather than timers and skill-based challenges. Each of you finds yourself in a different variation of the game world containing puzzles, clues, lore, and items unique to you.

Help each other solve puzzles and discover the story by uncovering the similarities and differences between your worlds. There is no network connection between the games, so communication is key to unlocking the secrets of the island.



  • Enjoy a 2-4 player cooperative puzzle-solving adventure.
  • Conquer complex challenges in communication-based gameplay.
  • Accessible mechanics with an easy learning curve for new gamers.
  • Does not require a network connection; play remotely via your favorite voice app, or on separate devices in the same room.

2113450.name: Forests, Fields and Fortresses
2113450.about_the_game:
Forests, Fields and Fortresses is a mix of a puzzle and a board game in which you have to build your kingdom. Try on the role of a ruler, piece together your lands and ensure the prosperity of your people. Two game modes will be available to you, each with its own unique gameplay:


Puzzle Mode. Manually created levels with a small number of pieces of territory. Your goal is to place them in such a way as to earn the required amount of Gold.


Adventure Mode. Start the game with a randomly created field and an endless supply of pieces of territory. Earn enough Gold before the playing field is full to successfully complete the game season and move on to the next one. Unlock new Spells, Game Events and Starting Locality Types to diversify your playthroughs.

2113460.name: Fortune Familia
2113460.about_the_game:
Nothing is ever simple in Rosemont.

Rosemont, Namalia is a massive cultural city full of opportunities. People dream of going there to discover themselves. What people don't know is that the city is run by six different families: Avesio, Canazino, Feliciano, Felidatto, Finopaso and Peratili.

After the death of Sebastian's father, Livio Kittorio, Sebastian moves back to Rosemont where the mystery of his father leads him to joining the Felidatto family. However, odd disappearances and mysterious deaths begin to plague the city and what seems like a simple mystery turns to madness as his world is turned upside down.


🔸 Join the Meowfia and take on the other Families!
🔸 Get to know and max out 24 Friendships!
🔸 What is The Paramount Feather? As chaos reigns, this artifact the others are fighting to find could be yours.

2113470.name: Furry VTuber 🎭
2113470.about_the_game:
STORY


"Furry VTuber" s a story about a guy who met his favorite VTuber "RainbowAstra" in real life, who turns out to be a simple 23-year-old girl named Anna. However, she's completely different from her avatar - sarcastic, pessimistic, depressed and anxious, the only thing that's similar is her voice.
Still, they seem to get along and start to spend time together, develop felling to each other, then suddenly something strange happens - her VTuber avatar becomes a real person.

Now, together with our main hero, she has to decide whether to let it be "real" or get it back into virtual world, resolve her personal problems and finally understand which part of her character is her true "self".

FEATURES:
• Short but fun little visual novel
• Cute VTuber!
• HD fully original artworks.
• Relaxing atmosphere.
• Some personal drama

2113490.name: Mess Quest
2113490.about_the_game:
The Game


Arrive at the aftermath of numerous wacky scenarios to clean, mop, and put things back together! How did that blood get there? What is this green sticky stuff? Doesn’t matter! Get paid to clean, not ask questions. Embark on a journey that puts your custodial skills to the test.

Key Features


  • Mess - Grab a bucket and a mop and start cleaning. Just make sure not to swing that thing around when it’s dirty or you might end up with a bigger mess. Or you know, if that’s what you want to do go ahead!

  • Clean - Broken glass, grime, guts, bones, empty bottles.. they all got to go! Make the world pretty again with every swing of the mop and with every dump of unwanted material.

  • Upgrade - Use your hard earned cash from taking out the trash to upgrade your janitorial arsenal.

  • Relax - Play casually, cleaning at your own pace. Take in the mess and make things pretty. If you want to challenge yourself time tracking can be enabled in the settings, letting you see the time it takes to complete a level so you can try and beat it!

What's Included

  • 3-5 hours of gameplay
  • 6 uniquely hand crafted levels
  • 16 Achievements
  • Upgradable mop, buckets, and bins
  • 200+ unique stainable objects
  • A whole lot of mess to clean up

2113500.name: Blindsided Labs
2113500.about_the_game:
Key Information

A tide of pixel-art combat rolls across the screen—your hand-picked squad on the left, relentless enemy waves on the right. Spend steadily-generated Energy to recruit one of three classic heroes:

  • Swordsman – hardy frontline bruiser

  • Archer – ranged sharpshooter who thins the horde

  • Templar – Tankier, faster, and more damage!

Once deployed, units march forward automatically, clashing wherever they meet. If a side’s warriors fall, survivors push on to batter the opposing base. Destroy the enemy stronghold before they topple yours and the round is yours.

But victory comes at a price: each win beefs up the enemy army and bolsters their base with extra health, ratcheting up the pressure in an ever-escalating gauntlet. How long can your tactics keep pace with their growing fury?

Key Features

  • Pick-and-Play Strategy – Simple unit-buying at the start of every round; deep decisions in what you field.

  • Three Distinct Classes – Mix frontline muscle, ranged support and tanky defense to craft the perfect battle line.

  • Endless Escalation – Every victory toughens the next wave, turning early skirmishes into nail-biting sieges.

  • One-Screen Pixel Action – Clean, colorful art keeps the focus on moment-to-moment tactics.

  • Short Sessions, Long Mastery – Matches play fast, but optimal play and high-wave survival demand cunning.

Rally your tiny army, sharpen your strategy, and see how far you can push before the ever-stronger foe pushes back!

2113530.name: Arrogation: Unlight of Day
2113530.about_the_game:
Players will embark on a first-person experience in ArroGation: Unlight Of Day that is full of suspense, thrills, anD the unknown. You wiLl dElve into the abandoned village of Yunlin and confront the Specter that hideS in the darkness.





In this village shrouded in the darkness lurks a multitude of monsters you have never seen before, and their tragic experiences and resentments seem to be hidden beneath their frightening appearance.







The history of Yunlin Village has too many secrets to be explored - those strange customs, mysterious rituals, and unexplained riddles. All revealing a looming crisis!







Being in a gloomy and crisis-filled village, you must use all possible means to escape from here. Explore carefully in order to escape.







Various styles of puzzles are all over the map, sounds, light, garbage, and even scary monsters can be key clues. The puzzle may be hidden in the most unexpected places.







From the ancient miracles, to the atrocities of the Imperial Japanese army in World War II, and then to the unpredictable cult. Why did this originally peaceful village fall into the darkness without light? The answer to everything lies in this horrific flame!

This is a journey without return



When you wake up... In the strange space, the bronze gate that eats people, the strange rules of the game, and the ever-changing nightmare world appear in front of you;



You will shuttle among them and become a participant in every story. Life and death, love and hate, and each other's fetters seem to have been engraved in the fate;

2113550.name: The Ghosts Race | 亡霊競争
2113550.about_the_game:
This is a game in which you infiltrate the "ghost race", a dark business, and enhance the race as a rookie "trapper".

A "trapper" is a forecaster whose job is to set traps and tricks on the course and predict the ghosts' positions, and is paid by understanding the characteristics of the ghosts and suggesting their positions.

Each ghost is unique. It is extremely difficult to get the landing order right, but you must become a full-fledged trapper who can control the ghosts!

-Progression-

The game progresses in the following order: "Select a race venue", "Trap part", "Prediction part", and "Race part".

-The Trap Part-

This is the part where you create a course by placing traps and other objects while protecting yourself from the ghosts. When the time limit is exceeded, or the player announces the end of the game, or loses his/her mind, the game will move to the prediction part.

-Prediction Part-

The player predicts which ghost is likely to finish the course he/she has created in first place, and moves on to the race part.

-Race Part-

It is time for the ghosts to race. The player watches the race and observes the results. The race ends when the top three finishers are identified.

-How to use the rewards-

If you hit the ghosts' landing positions, you will earn more rewards. Rewards earned from races can be used to purchase equipment needed to build the next course.

-About the version-

Currently, the game is being operated as a beta version. We are aiming for ver1.0 through various updates in the future.
2113550.supported_languages: English, German, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

2113570.name: Ascend: Reborn
2113570.about_the_game:
The cult classic action RPG Ascend: Hand of Kul is reborn!

Lore
The ancient prophecies foretold that once the Titans' reign had ended, one of the Three Gods would claim dominion over their brethren and seize a position of ultimate power. That time has come, and now your God needs a Champion. Will you rise to the challenge?

The Titans
In the deadly world of Ascend: Reborn, blood is power. The Titans–colossal, bloodthirsty, immortal giants–lumber through the World satiating painful hunger with endless feasts of human souls. Humans pray in vain as their villages are engulfed in the violent onslaught of the Titans and their monsters. The new God rise to claim their legacy.

Caos
Declare your allegiance to the God of Darkness, Light, or Void. Personalize and level your Caos with hundreds of customization options including appearance, weapons, armor, gear, abilities, skills, and much more. As you journey through Ascend you’ll be rewarded with rare loot and valuable lore. Discover the secret of defeating the Titans and secure your god’s dominion to claim your place as Champion in the Crusade.

Ascend
The largest rewards require the ultimate sacrifice-your character! But all is not lost, as each life dedicated to your god brings new abilities that help shape you into the ultimate Caos warrior.

Evolving world
Behold the world as it changes dynamically beneath your feet, bowing to your growing power. As you discover the secret of defeating the Titans and securing your god’s dominion over the world, you’ll claim your place as a legend.

Free-to-Play
Ascend: Reborn is an old-school action RPG experience with a lot of unique twists and surprises. Ascend is free to play over Steam.

2113580.name: Haste-Miner 2
2113580.about_the_game:
Haste-Miner 2 is a casual game where your main objective is to mine.


When mining, you earn a currency called tokens and the blocks you mine are stored in your "backpack". Tokens can be used to upgrade your pickaxe in lots of different ways. The upgrades vary from increasing your pickaxe damage, your mine speed, the tokens and money you get, as well as various "procc" (programmed random occurrence) upgrades, for example; "Slammer", "Nuker", "Key finder", "Token bag" and more.

The blocks stored in your backpack can be sold for in game money, which is used to unlock new mines with better blocks in them. The money can also be used to upgrade your offline "Token generator", buy pickaxe skins and eventually, unlock whole new planets.


Planets can be travelled between with money (lots of it). You start on earth and from there you can unlock the moon (I know, technically not a planet). Which has much more valuable blocks, from the moon you can go to the next planet.
The game currently has 5 different planets with different scenery, economy scale and dungeons.


The dungeon is an alternative way of playing the game. After you unlock the dungeon (for money and tokens), instead of mining in a squared generated mined, you can then instead mine in a big cave area with ores scattered around the place. The ores in here are much more valuable and instead of being stored in your backpack, they will sometimes give you various item rewards when mines. Watch your steps though, because if you fall into any of the pits in the dungeon, everything you had gained in there will be lost. The dungeon the primary way of obtaining "spirit flasks", which can be used to receive a random "Spirit".


Spirits are equippable "buffs" you can use in the game. Each spirit is unique and will enhance certain aspects of the game (while sometimes nerfing others).
You can have 1 spirit equipped at a time and most spirits can be upgraded (by mining) for increased effects. The game has 25 different spirits ranging in 5 different rarity tiers. Spirits can be obtained by opening a spirit flask, which can be obtained in the dungeon, and from treasures.


Treasures are a great way to give you a little bonus when playing. Treasures can be opened with a matching key, which can be obtained in various ways. When opening a treasure, a key will be consumed, and you will receive a random reward from that treasure.


Generators can be used to earn passive income while playing, but also while offline. Each planet has a token generator and a money generator, which are upgraded with the opposite currency (money with tokens, and token with money). Upgrading your generator will increase it's capacity and the amount in generates per second. Generators can also be buffed by upgrading a certain mega upgrade with rebirth points.


The "Rebirth" system is a way to replay the game with a buff.
Once you have reached a certain "level" in the game and mined a certain amount of blocks, you can rebirth.

Rebirthing will reset most of your stats (except for spirits and unlocked planets) but will give you a 10% money & token income boost as well as 1 rebirth point (RP) which you use to buy permanent mega upgrades. These upgrades are very different to the normal upgrades but are much more powerful.


On top of all these features. Haste-Miner 2 has much more to explore and try out.

2113590.name: Defenders of Tetsoidea: Chrono Chonus
2113590.about_the_game: A contemporary active battle turn based RPG where it is your task to figure out why a demon invasion is suddenly happening, and battle against it. The game is about 4-7 hours long and is a 90s style RPG in a modern setting. There are over 90 maps to explore with lots of neat accessories to equip your party with. In combat, there is an active time meter to challenge your quick thinking skills! There are many bosses and they require a mix of strategies to defeat!

2113600.name: Vera: The Last Hope
2113600.about_the_game:
Hack and slash through a frenetic roguelite and cut your way to the Demon King.

Upgrade your favorite abilities and equip new ones as you progress, making countless variations each run.

Vera: The Last Hope is a 2D roguelike experience where you play as Vera, an assassin whose clan has been killed by the Demon King.

FEATURES:

  • Many unique minions

  • 1 special Boss

  • Special abilities

  • A Grumpy Cat as a companion

  • Fast paced combat

2113630.name: Cursed Crops
2113630.about_the_game:
"Welcome to the field, farmer! Play with up to three of your friends as the best combat farmers this side of the Mississippi, defending haunted farms from the evil animated vegetables they grow in the fields. Cleanse this curse by planting crops, but be ready to reap what you sow!"



Cursed Crops is a local Co-Op* action tower defense game where players must defend their farm from hoards of evil vegetables. In order to cleanse the farmland of its evil curse, players must plant a variety of special crops. These crops will come back as fearsome foes so prepare by constructing defenses and purchasing upgrades!

*(game requires controllers for local co-op)

2113650.name: Superhero Girls
2113650.about_the_game:
Help the beautiful girls to immerse themselves in their memories and remember the wonderful moments of their lives. This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. All characters appearing in this game are over 18 years of age. Enjoy ;-)

2113690.name: Splash Ship
2113690.about_the_game: Splash Ship is an arcade game in which you control a boat that moves along a zigzag water canal, where there are sharp turns and dangers lurk at every turn. Every second the game accelerates, and the road on which you swim becomes narrow or wide. Try to score as many points as possible without sinking the ship. Collect coins on your way and unlock new ships for further adventures.

2113710.name: ApoZomb
2113710.about_the_game:
Unleash the Ultimate Survival Experience


Welcome to the ultimate survival camp, where the stakes are high and the rewards are even higher. Here, you'll have access to the latest and greatest resources and equipment to help you take on the hordes of zombies and ruthless survivors that stand in your way. But it's not just about surviving, it's about thriving.

Join Forces with Other Survivalists


In the face of danger, there's no greater ally than a trusted teammate. Join forces with other like-minded individuals and take on the toughest challenges together. But remember, not everyone can be trusted. Stay vigilant, gather supplies, and upgrade your defenses and gear to stay ahead of the competition.

Build Your Own Community and Defend It


In this unforgiving world, it's important to surround yourself with those who have your back. Build your own community of survivalists, trade resources, and work together to defend your camp against any threat. With the right team by your side, you'll be able to take on anything the world throws at you.

Unlock Rewards and Advance to the Top


As you complete missions and overcome challenges, you'll earn experience and cash to upgrade your equipment and resources. But it's not just about survival, it's about becoming the ultimate survivor. Rise to the top of the leaderboard and unlock exclusive rewards that will give you the edge in battle.

Join the Camp Now and Take Control of Your Destiny


Don't wait any longer, join the camp now and take control of your destiny. With the right resources, teammates, and strategy, you'll be able to survive and thrive in the face of any challenge. So what are you waiting for? Sign up now and let the ultimate survival experience begin!

2113750.name: Freedom Squid Fighter
2113750.about_the_game:
Take control of a heavily armed, freedom-loving squid and blast your way through destructible worlds. Soar through the air, tunnel through dirt and rock with powerful weaponry, and outmaneuver enemies across towering landscapes.

Every level is a playground of destruction — carve your own paths, uncover hidden areas, and rain chaos from above. Collect resources, swap weapons on the fly, and adapt your tactics to survive intense encounters.

Features

  • Fully destructible terrain – Make your own routes, uncover secrets, and obliterate anything in your way.

  • Fluid aerial movement – Hover, weave, and dodge while firing in any direction.

  • Dynamic combat – Master multiple weapon types, from rapid-fire blasters to heavy-hitting explosives.

  • Challenging vertical levels – Conquer towering cliffs, deep caverns, and wide-open skies.

  • Collect and upgrade – Gather resources to enhance your squid’s combat potential.

Freedom isn’t given — it’s taken. Tentacle by tentacle.

2113770.name: In Woods
2113770.about_the_game:
Fight against Monsters

In each game, you'll face numerous attacking monsters. Fight against them and survive for as long as possible.

Power Up the Character

As you defeat a certain number of monsters, your character will level up and have the opportunity to choose a magic item.

Craft Items

2113880.name: Cave Crawler
2113880.about_the_game:
"Cave Crawler: A Retro Exploration Adventure" is exactly as described! Explore a large, 2D open world with various islands, towns, and geographical features. Find tools along your journey, and use them to collect resources. Sell these resources at shops to earn money to buy items. Save up your money to upgrade and customize your house on Paradise island, an island city far off the coast of the mainland that is in disrepair. Navigate your way through caves, forests, factories, and much more to fight bosses and reach the end of your journey.

Tools:

  • Pickaxe - Allows you to mine rocks, and can net you some ore and gems.
  • Axe - Lets you chop down trees, and to collect wood.
  • Shovel - Digs up fossils as well as other items, plant plants, allows you to find secret areas.
  • Fishing Rod - Fishes up fish, in addition to other items.
  • Sword - Use this tool to fend off various fiends.

Mainland Tutorial Towns:

Each town is meant to introduce a new feature. That would work something like this:

  • Town 1 (Miners Haven): Introduces the pickaxe, caves, mining, and is the first place where you'll finds a shop.
  • Town 2 (Lumberton): Introduces the axe and choppable trees.
  • Town 3 (The Dig Site): Introduces the shovel, digging, fossils, and planting.
  • Town 4 (Hookten): Introduces the fishing rod and fishing.
  • Town 5 (The Dojo): Introduces the sword and fighting.

    Islands:

    Each island focuses on the different items:

    • Island 1: Focuses on use of the pickaxe, features large museum and mining depot dungeons.
    • Island 2: Focuses on use of the axe, features a large logging depot dungeon.
    • Island 3: Focuses on use of the shovel, features a fossil excavation depot dungeon.
    • Island 4: Focuses on use of the fishing rod, feature a large fishery dungeon.
    • Island 5: Focuses on use of the sword, feature a large factory dungeon.
    • Paradise Island: Rebuild the island using resources, includes a customizable player house.

    The numerical order of the islands you visit is arbitrary, as you'll be able to choose which ones you want to visit, and in what order.

    The Game Itself:

    These are the most important features that will be a part of the game:

    • Variable length gameplay. The game will be as long as you make it. (Will at least feature a few hours of content).
    • Large, open-world map, with various sub-areas.
    • A story, with lore spread throughout the game.
    • Bosses of different calibers.
    • A lovely soundtrack.

2113900.name: Touge Shakai
2113900.about_the_game:
Touge Shakai (Mountain Pass Society) is an online Touge Racing Game based on Japanese car culture in the 90s. With an emphasis on balance between realism and fun gameplay, the physics are tailored for competitive drift racing, while giving a challenge to all players.

The driving physics are mainly simulated, but not to the extent of hardcore racing simulators. The driving characteristics of each car is tailored to be distinctly different from each other, and require drivers to master different driving styles to bring out the best in each car. The objective is to be fun while remaining believable. However, there's a twist to the driving physics: Drifting is faster than grip driving for most rear-wheel drive vehicles.

Features

  • Unique sim-cade driving physics designed for Touge Battles

  • Time Attack against local and online ghosts

  • Multiplayer lobbies for free roaming and impromptu battles

  • Cosmetic car customization - Body kits and custom liveries

  • Different weather conditions - Rain, fog

  • Unique Touge racing modes

  • Steering wheel support with Force Feedback (Only Logitech and Thrustmaster are tested and verified to be working at the moment)

  • In-game music player - Load your own tracks into the game

  • Progression - Unlock new cars and parts as you hit objectives

  • Virtual Reality Support

  • FPV Drone - Fly a drone in full manual (Acro) mode in online multiplayer, or to chase your own replay

Coming later

  • Online matchmaking and ranking

  • Driver and team profiles

  • Replay camera editor - Setup race cameras using key frames

Game modes

Time Attack

Race against the clock with various cars and courses to improve your pace and compete on the leaderboards. Players can also challenge the “ghosts” of other players, which are apparitions of their previous runs to learn from their driving. Medals are awarded with target timings, and provides progression for customization for each car.

PvP Battle

Classic touge-style battle. Battles rules include "First to finish" and "Cat and Mouse". Cat and Mouse has a leader and a chaser, with the leader trying to pull away and the chaser trying to keep up. The leader wins when they finish the course by a fixed distance from the chaser, while the chaser wins if they manage to overtake by the finish. The race moves on to the next round in a draw, with their positions reversed. Cat and Mouse mode is recommended as it provides the fairest battle, as overtaking is difficult and dangerous on the touge.

Team battles consist of multiple PvP Battles ongoing at the same time, with the team with the most wins coming out on top.

Free Ride

Practice, socialize and start impromptu races with others on the touge and just have fun! Learn from others and enjoy the course without the pressure of winning or losing. Showcase your rides and hang out with other racers and teams.

In KVLT you are Lazar, a five hundred years old occultist and cold blooded fighter, following a trail of arcane knowledge lost to the annals of history, in an effort to find magical artifacts of untold power, destroying whoever dares to cross your path in the process.

This first adventure takes you to the year 1945, the nazis are losing the war. Unscrupulous and desperate, a last-ditch effort is made: relying on a secret task force specialized in paranormal warfare, known as Fenrir, they seek to recover the technology and knowledge from ancient civilizations, in an attempt to change the tides of war in favor of the Reich.

But, what they don't know… is that they are about to cross your line of fire.

- Arm yourself with Lazar's unique arsenal and use your firepower to combat terrible enemies: nazi occultists, religious zealots, and of course, eldritch abominations of unknowable nature.

If you are looking for a more ‘direct’ approach then shield yourself with mystic energies capable of absorbing the most vicious attacks, and then rush towards your enemies, guns blazing.

2113970.name: The Original Island
2113970.about_the_game:
1, About the game [/]

The Original Island is an open-world Island survival role-playing game about an adventure on an Island in The ocean. You will play as a survivor who has been taken to this isolated island for unknown reasons but has lost some of his memories. Explore the lush jungle-covered island in search of secrets hidden deep in the forest. It's trying to survive, making tools, hunting, fighting, whatever it takes to get out of here. Or through the jungle, searching for the truth, collecting legends, and finding out why and why you came to this island. Whether it's conquering nature, or forcing oneself to adapt to the natural environment, everything will follow the choice of the survivor.

2, Exploring jungle and Ancient ruins [/]

This densely jungle-covered island is littered with ancient ruins, and no one knows when, who or why they were built. Ancient buildings, mysterious altars, strange stone statues, extraordinary phenomena, waiting to be revealed by the survivors.

3, Making weapons and survival tools [/]

To survive on this isolated island, the survivors must learn to make enough supplies. Weapons for hunting, medicines for unusual conditions, tools to store water, backpacks for lifting heavy loads, fishing and trapping traps, etc., can greatly improve the chances of survival. Of course, only a small part of how items and weapons are made will be mastered from the beginning. Most of the items require the player to try them out, or explore the island in search of drawings left behind by past survivors.

4, You can't live without fighting [/]

Whether it's hunting for food, or dealing with a terrifying figure walking through the jungle, you have to take up arms to deal with the situation. If you want to survive, you must have the will to take up arms and destroy the enemy. Even though it may be a monster that you don't even know exists......

5, Shoot beautiful scenery [/]

Despite the fact that survivors are plagued by problems every day, hunger, exhaustion, and even assault. But when survivors go where they've never gone before, and reach the top of a mountain high enough to look out over the jungle, they see something different. You can use your own mobile phone camera function to leave the most beautiful scenery in your heart. This is the prize of a survivor's conquest of nature.

6, Changeable island weather [/]



The island seemed so unusual that it was difficult for survivors to identify their position by the climate and the stars. Sometimes it is a scorching sunny day, sometimes it is a raging tropical storm, and sometimes it is a cold, flying snow covering the island. Even the island seemed to fall silent under a thick fog.

7, Collection of literature on scattered islands [/]



You're not the first person to set foot in this isolated place. It seems there are many like you who have been called to these waters by something. To understand their story, we must collect their journals, which are scattered all over the island, and through the writings they left behind, we can reveal some of the hidden secrets of the island. By retracing their steps to their final destination.

2114170.name: 눈 떠보니 임진왜란이었다 - Back To the Joseon
2114170.about_the_game:
"After a car accident and when I woke up, I fell back to the Joseon Dynasty in Korean history?!"

As an ordinary person in the 21st century, you wake up in Korea, Joseon in 1592 AD, when Japan's invasion.
According to the original history, the Japanese Invasion of Korea in 1592, was a war in which Joseon won, but for some reason, Joseon was destined to collapse at this time.
The reason for this is the death of Yi Sun-sin, the legendary admiral, who saves Joseon in real history.
Now, you should change this fate...

If you designate an attack target, you can attack by swinging the sword in 8 directions or stabbing!
A realistic sword action game. You can block, avoid, and slash!
Let's save Joseon Dynasty and admiral Yi Sun-sin by a sword!


Key features of the game
- Full 3D graphics
- Physical collision of sword when you are fighting
- Input the direction of swinging the sword to attack the target you targeted
- The essential fun of sword fighting, such as seeing and avoiding the enemy's blade and using the sword's range to fight back

2114180.name: MAGNET EFFECT
2114180.about_the_game:
"I want to go home!" message from a poor robot processor.
This is a platform rope jumping game. The protagonist needs to use his own device to overcome many difficulties and move forward all the way. In order to return to your hometown, try to master the use of ropes and the principles of attraction and repulsion of magnets. Help this poor robot go back to its hometown, it's a skillful process to keep returning to the same place!
(Players please be kind to your keyboard and mouse)

How to play:

The operation of the game is very simple, by using the rope with the N pole of the magnet and the rope with the S pole of the magnet and the change of the state of the rope, keep climbing up. But it takes a lot of practice to use it completely freely. Please think carefully every time you use it, otherwise it will become an inevitable thing to fall.
(Although the suffering of the game may exist, and the game will challenge the determination of players, but passing this test will make players extremely happy!) (This game cannot be saved!!!)


There are many background easter eggs in this game waiting to be discovered! ! !
Time to send the robot home! But can anyone really succeed?

2114190.name: Interstellar Turtle Legend
2114190.about_the_game:
The universe is at war, and you're just a bastard. What choice will you make: Survive through the cracks and survive, or be invincible and kill the Quartet? Can you still hold on to your heart?

This is a sea-watching type game that simulates an absurd and realistic universe in which everything is controlled by AI, and the player is just an observer. In the game, the player can move the field of view, zoom and rotate the screen, adjust the speed of the passage of time, and view the detailed information of the object, but cannot make changes to the progress of the game.

There are six factions in the universe: the Galactic Commune, the Guardian Council, the Xinghai Group, the Second Empire, the General Alliance, and the Hyperspace Zombies. They are at war. Each faction uses energy to build buildings: docks, turrets, reactors, and command centers. Docks can spawn ships, turrets can fire cannonballs, reactors can create energy, and command centers can expand territory.

There is a character system in the game. Each building and ship has a corresponding position: a shipbuilder in the dock, a gunner in a turret, a generator in a reactor, and a general in the command center. As buildings or ships are created and destroyed, people are promoted, demoted, and even killed. At the end of the game, the experiences of the 5 most prolific characters will be compiled into a celebrity resume.

At the start of the game, a Travelling Bastard with a neutral faction will spawn, and it will not attempt to attack anything. Wang Ba travels through the universe, witnessing the rise and fall of forces, and making friends with people of different professions. At the end of the game, what the bastard saw and heard during his travels will be compiled into a bastard's diary.

Note: The "Celebrity Resume" and "Bad Diary" mentioned above will only be generated in the game folder in txt format, and players need to open and view them manually.

In the game, music will be played when a certain faction wins: People's Army Loyal to the Party is played when the Galaxy Commune is victorious, a toast song is played when the Guardian Council is victorious, Marching Through Georgia is played when the Xinghai Group is victorious, and Li Zhongtang is played when the Second Empire is victorious, Battle Hynm of Republic is played when the general alliance wins, and It's a Burning Memory is played when the Hyperzombies win.

This is a remake of my previous game "Space Combat Simulator" (published on itch.io). My plan for future updates is to increase the types of ships and turrets, and add new weapons and damage effects.

This game is made by me with c++ and windows api, and does not use an off-the-shelf game engine. All fonts, textures and music are made by myself.

2114240.name: Ean's End
2114240.about_the_game:
This is the first work (with the intention of giving it a try) of our family team.

I'm in charge of the game's content and story design, my wife did the programming, and all the art elements you see are the work of my cousin who was still in college sacrificed a summer vacation.

So the game looks very, very, very simple.

However, I added a lot of rougelike design elements in the story. I like rougelike very much. I often think that if an adventure story can be combined with rougelike, our protagonist will feel like God is throwing dice.

So the ending of the game and the easter eggs that can be triggered are quite a lot (the kind that racked my brains).

All you need to play this game is a single-click mouse, you'll know where to click, make a choice and just click.

We're really looking forward to someone discovering all the endings and easter eggs in this game.

Thanks to everyone who would like to experience our first family product.

2114300.name: Chronique des Silencieux
2114300.about_the_game:
Set in 1970s southern France, you play a rookie private eye tasked to dig out the secrets of a stubborn old man. Think on your feet while you follow your leads : ask questions to witnesses, detect their lies, hypothesize why and finally confront the silent ones running from their past.

A Strange Request

You are entrusted with the peculiar case of Victor Dousvalon. This old history professor is known for shrouding his past life in secrecy, even from his own daughter Catherine. But an apparently harmless accident motivates him to hire you to help Catherine trace back the steps of his life.

Why can't he simply tell her his own story?

Why does Catherine, who has been so distant with her father these past years, suddenly want to know about him?

Your first case will decidedly be a delicate one...

Anything Goes to Break the Silence!

Get engrossed in the handy work of a detective : search through family papers, ask personal questions, call at inopportune times, and be generally nosy.

Head First Investigation

No watching characters think for you, this is your time to prove your deductive powers. Choose leads, follow them to the end or stop when you think you’ve got the right idea. But you'll need to be convincing to push the silent ones to talk!

A People’s History

Piece together the lives, the choices, and the tragedies people are running from and walk a mile in their shoes.

Discover History, not from a bird’s eye view, but from the ground, where folks have to continue living and coping, each in their own unique way.

2114320.name: Paradise Puzzle!
2114320.about_the_game:
Paradise Puzzle! is casual puzzle game.
Call a girl you want to play with , and beat monsters.
Beautiful, kawaii, a little erotic CG will be yours!



Your goal is to line up three or more of the same type of gem horizontally or vertically.
Feel free to move them to any square you'd like!
When you clear a line of gems, the spots you cleared will be filled with prisms falling from above. Because of this, you can combo matches together.
However, once you stop dragging it, or if the time limit reaches zero, your turn is over.

In order to win, you have to fight until the enemy's HP goes down to zero.
if your HP goes down to zero first, you lose.
The hourglass shows the number of turns you have left.
You'll also lose if that reaches zero.

You can make use of any type of jem to damage the enemy, but there are also jems that have special effects.
If you clear Skull jem, your turn counter will go down.
If you clear Potion jem, your HP will be restored.

I recommend you carefully look at the jems on screen and consider which ones will give you the highest combo when you clear them.
Good Luck!

2114330.name: Honeymancer
2114330.about_the_game:
Honeymancer is a cute RPG with wave-based combat where you play as a Bear Witch who uses honey magic to protect the forest from evil robots and help her fellow neighbours.

BEEKEEPING & GARDENING

As a honeymancer, you need honey to cast spells. Help your bee buddies make honey by planting flowers so that they can collect nectar from them. The more flowers you have, the more honey they make.

There is a wide variety of flowers that you can choose from, pick the ones you like and fill the forest with flowers!

SAVE THE FOREST

Evil robots have invaded the forest you live in, and it is up to you to stop them.

Use your honey magic to prevent them from destroying trees throughout the forest. The robots come in waves and each wave is tougher than the last. Make sure to use your honey wisely!

As a honeymancer, you will unlock and learn different spells that will help you in the fight against the robots.

BEFRIEND YOUR NEIGHBORS

You will need to leave the Bear Witch's comfort zone and befriend the other animals in the forest. Do your best by helping and supporting them through personal quests. By helping them you will unlock new spells, flowers, colors, and more! 

Being kind and helpful is good for everyone!

2114350.name: Is It Wrong to Repay the Debt in a Dungeon?
2114350.about_the_game:
To repay the debt, both Akane and her mother have to earn a lot of money!
Explore the dungeon, challenge strong enemies, and even use her own body!
Everything she is trying to do is for saving her family!!


This game is a roguelike RPG game with a well-balanced card battle system.
You can use more than 60 kinds of cards which can also be upgraded to fight.
Choose the most appropriate card to defeat strong enemies!


  • Full audio
  • Card battle roguelike RPG
  • Card upgrade system
  • In game achievement

2114360.name: Maze Blaze
2114360.about_the_game:
Shoot and blast your way through mysterious mazes in Maze Blaze, a roguelike action shooter that’s intense both in color and gameplay. The goal is simple - enter the maze and gun down anything that stands between you and the exit. Your objective may always be the same but everything else is endlessly changing.

Each maze is a procedurally generated level where the enemies, items, and the maze’s layout itself is random. Not a single corner you turn will be the same as the last time you entered. Progressively tougher robots will try to take you out once you enter their proximity so you better be ready to shoot first and ask questions later. Modifiers scattered around each maze will augment your abilities and shots. Each pick-up presents a unique choice that’ll define your play style.

Features:

An Endless Maze of Possibilities - The gameplay is simple but the depth can be as complex as you want. Randomly generated mazes, enemies, and items make every playthrough its own, unexpected experience.

Play Your Way - Clearing levels and bosses, or fight through endless waves of mazes. On your own or with a friend. How you play is your own choice.

A Spectacle of Color - Take in a hyper-stylized, neon-color emblazoned Roguelike experience with captivating visuals that are stunning to look at yet never feel too overwhelming.

2114370.name: Takoyaki Party Survival
2114370.about_the_game:
The ninth of low-price series of Kimidorisoft! "Takoyaki Party Survival" appeared!

For video creators and streamers
KIMIDORI SOFT permits monetization through partner programs using KIMIDORI SOFT games.

Everyone loves takoyaki parties, popularly known as "Takopa" in Japan. How many days can a person survive on takoyaki only? What were the ingredients in this takoyaki, and who cooked this takoyaki? Should the sauce be put on it, or should the ingredients have been added in the first place? Collapsing trust, doubt and suspicion. The friendship that grows beyond that.

That is Takoyaki Party Survival...

Game overview:
You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.

Feature:
Online multiplayer: Up to 4 players can play together. There are Quick Match and Friend Match, both of which you are free to enter and leave at any time. In Quick Match, survivors from all over the world are surviving at their own pace. In Friend Match, you can easily play with a specific friend with a single keyword. Of course, you can also play alone.

Cooperation or Interference: In online multiplayer, you can cook takoyaki for other players or, conversely, take their takoyaki away from them.

Skills: Learn and strengthen the skills necessary for survival, such as increasing basal metabolism and squatting efficiency.

Fever Event: Zero calories no matter how much you eat during the event! This is your chance to balance your nutritional needs all at once.

Ingredient Collection: There are more than 20 different ingredients. The longer it survives, the more new ingredients are unlocked.

You must build a big city in a Cyber ​​/ SCI-FI universe composed of several districts to grow the population through various simple actions.[/p]


Made by a lone developper, ACHIEVEMENTS CITY is a unique chill game fast and easy to complete.

Gameplay

Style

2114440.name: Elland: The Crystal Wars
2114440.about_the_game:
In 2001, development began on an ambitious Game Boy Advance game based on a popular franchise. Maybe the project was a little too ambitious, because it was cancelled in 2002 and the team walked away. Twenty years later, this game finally sees the light of day, albiet without the original franchise license. Experience the game now in this enhanced, emulated version.

Story

Elland, a harsh desert world on the outskirts of the Galaxy. With nothing but scant indigenous life, the planet is controlled by the cooperative Elland Inc, which mines the abundant minerals and crystals used in the construction of Galactic star cruisers. The mining operations and the abundance of Brem-Nar Crystals have transformed Elland from a dusty wasteland into a glittering and much envied prize.


Notorious for its precipitation, the neighboring world of Mank is home to the headquarters of the Trafford Corporation, the largest constructor of space cruisers and weapons in the Galaxy. Trafford is infamously aggressive, using it’s financial muscle and military power to always get what it wants. At this moment in time it wants to control Elland and it will use all and any resources to get what it wants.

Gameplay

You are Ethan Lancashire, one of the finest of Elland Inc.'s fighter pilots. Across more than 20 dangerous missions you will pilot advanced flying machines that can move, turn and hover, and come equipped with a variety of weapons and utilities, fitted as the mission requires. Weapons can be set to lock-on or aimed manually.


Some examples of briefings of missions you will undertake:
  • Using a Heavy Freight Raptor, deliver a gatherer to our Crystal field, following the directions on the radar. Be careful, there might be Trafford Corp ground units lying in wait. Before delivering the gatherer, explore the surrounding area to find further Crystal fields. Keep an eye on the fuel and return to base before it runs out.
  • Recent incidents show there must be Trafford Corp bases nearby. Take a Light Fighter and explore the desert to find and destroy them. We also have a spy out there, who will turn on his signal so you can find him using the locator. We have detected smuggler communications: eliminate them if possible. Don't forget, the most important thing is for us to see you again.
  • We have just received an emergency call from our secret base, where our new fighter bomber is being tested. The Trafford Corps are trying to steal it. Get over there and stop them before they return to their base with the new prototype.
  • We have received an emergency call from the north. A few Nightons hijacked a Trafford Corp transporter with prisoners, but something went wrong and they crashed. Go there and look for survivors. We only have a Heavy Freighter in the base, so you'll have to take that. If you see a Kuhn-Suhm, use a gatherer as bait to distract it. Don't forget to look out for the enemy.

Earn commendations and trophies, displayed in your personal room, and climb the ranks from lowly Cadet all the way up to Air Force General.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this emulated game, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2114470.name: Trade And Fight
2114470.about_the_game:
Near future worldview

The game takes place in the near future. The world we are familiar with has disappeared because of the world war. The people who survived built cities and villages on the wasteland, while some people wandered in the wasteland and became bandits. The world is revived, waiting for you to create a new world!

Real world

The whole world is just like the real earth, with real sun and moon alternation, revolving around the sun. The real longitude and latitude make you feel like you have returned to the Age of Exploration and explore the entire earth. People in every place on the earth have their own data and behavior. Individual groups are the cornerstones of markets, banks, governments, shopping malls and factories, and maintain the operation of institutions. This also means that every town or village develops, operates and declines like the real world.

Trade and battle

You will play the role of a wandering merchant to explore and adventure in the world. Trade and battle will be the theme of your game. In the carefully constructed economic world, you can borrow money from banks, buy and sell factories, earn money, and upgrade airplanes. Your actions also affect all aspects of towns and villages, and even the government's tax rates. Of course, there are more ways to play waiting for you to discover!

2114480.name: Scripted Land
2114480.about_the_game:
This game is a game where you can code the AI of NPCs for those who think "I want them to act smarter" or "I want them to act more efficiently" about the NPCs in the game.
You can write the behavior of your production and transportation subjects in the Lua programming language to make them more efficient in production, defense, and exploration.

Note that NPC behavior must be written in Lua script, so the difficulty level is for people who can code normally.
If you have any requests about the game, please post them on the Steam forum.

Features

  • A hex-style 2D game in which you create Lua scripts and register them with your lords for action.
  • The game allows you to register different scripts for multiple NPCs, allowing you to manage your territory with an awareness of the division of roles.
  • All actions, from the actions of the NPCs to building instructions, can be described in scripts, which can be created and executed up to 32 times faster to check the results.
  • A tutorial stage to show you what kind of scripts to write and a random map to evaluate your scripts are provided.

2114500.name: 伏魔天师
2114500.about_the_game:
The Demon Subduing Wizard is a card building game that combines character character and Roguelike playing method. Players encounter a series of demons and ghosts in an unpredictable world, which can be used to drive away demons, fight against the strong and help the weak, or escape. Players can choose various strategies in the face of demons and ghosts. Each choice will change their character, and with the change of character, the people and things they encounter will also change.

In this world, you want to play the role of a powerful killer, a merciful and kind person, an aloof rebel, or a just and orderly person. Each choice you make will reshape your personality. As your personality changes, it will not only affect card acquisition, but also affect adventure events;

Game features

Build your character

By starting with the innate qualification, each monster choice will change your character composition. A good character composition can often accelerate your card deck composition;

Designated character test

When your character grows to a certain value, you will encounter character tests at different stages. You can choose to give up the test or accept the test. If you can pass the test, you will get unprecedented growth;


By constantly improving your character composition, accelerating the construction of the deck, constantly practicing, and constantly choosing, you can decide which cards to join your deck, and ultimately form the ultimate deck to play the perfect routine flow;

After peeking at the characteristics of monsters, you will be completely immersed in the fun of card combination and card playing;

Characteristic Monster

In this unpredictable world, you will encounter all kinds of ghosts and goblins, all kinds of charm, curse, cure, shackle, and all kinds of abilities of living together. It is also a part of strength to fully understand the characteristics of monsters and consider the licensing strategy and the opportunity to use pills according to the characteristics of monsters.


An unpredictable world

Every time you enter this mysterious world, your route changes. Do you want to avoid demons and move forward cautiously, or do you want to kill them all the way? Facing different enemies, different adventures, how to choose the way forward is also a knowledge;


Combination of various genres

There are hundreds of cards, dozens of magic weapons can be combined to create different schools. You can choose either the burning stream of great opening and closing, or the infinite divine calculation stream of wisdom. There is always one of N schools that you like;


Each reincarnation in "Demon Subduing Heavenly Master" not only enables you to learn to grow, but also gradually exposes the story that the human heart is more dangerous than the ghost. Each time you play, you will encounter different demons, adventures and event combinations. Whether fate is determined by heaven or man can win depends on your one thought.

2114520.name: Blood and Sorcery
2114520.about_the_game:
This is an action adventure 2D platforming pixel art game, inspired by dark souls. Fight bosses and gain new abilities in order to cleanse the corruption from the land!

- gameplay has some elements from the souls series, such as dodge rolling, stamina and mana bars as well as boss fights.

- movement controls are like a standard 2D platformer

- different abilities are acquired and can be used

- game has different zones that you can progress to once you have beaten the boss of the area (similar to dark souls)

2114540.name: Absolute Matter
2114540.about_the_game:
Absolute Matter is a first-person extraction shooter all about player interaction. Every single mechanic in this game either leads to player interaction or makes it more interesting, more intense.
No matter if you join a map as a lonely wolf or with your friends, there are many things that will pick your attention and invite to adventure. Some of these look like PvE events at first glimpse. Once you look closer, you realize: These events bring players together. May it be to team up against the aggressive spore crawlers populating the areas and hunting players. Or may it be an arriving train with loot that players want to have: All these events bring people together in all kinds of shapes. That's why we call these "PvX events".
When launching early access, this game will contain the following events:

The Junk Eater

The Junk Eater is a peaceful alien browsing the area, bringing loot into the map. Once this alien is being attacked, a challenging boss fight emerges. No matter if you fight it alone or as a group, the fight will take a certain amount of time -- long enough for other players to join the fight. On your side or to stab you in the back.

Train Arrival

A train brings valuable goods to one of the train stations. You'll get a notification about the arrival and may as well be hired by AI to protect the goods. But be sure you're not the only player on the map with the idea to grab that loot and run. :-)

Spore Crawlers

Spore Crawlers are the most aggressive alien species in the game. They hunt players in packs and spread widely if the community allows them. To fight them back, hunters are needed in our community to destroy their hives. Leaderboard skin rewards mark these valuable players and bring them fame in the community.

Over time we plan to add more and more events like these. For the beginning, the most important parts are there: Loot to bring people together and a common enemy to grow as a team.



To bring more life in the different ways of player interaction we developed a dynamic quest system. Not only we as devs give quests to our players, you as a player can create these too. May it be a bounty on someones head or may it be a call for help when you ran into trouble. Even trading or raiding a compound as a team can be done that way.

Character Progression

Depending on your play style you can adjust your characters abilities and specializations via items. Not just your weapon is designed on a modular basis and can be combined to a short range SMG or a long range sniper. Your whole body is modular and artificial limbs can unlock all kinds of abilities. Some people might value utility abilities like dashes or camouflage while others may prefer shields or even hacking. Hacking can help you using doors you're not supposed to open and can even give information about a player's location if you're a very skilled hacker.



To really push decision making and to offer a fresh start after dying (yes, this game has perma death), we developed a flat progression system. Your avatar does not grow in power. You do. And the more items you find the more you can adjust your character depending on your play style.
Not just items, also the character creation is developed on a similar basis. When you create a fresh character you have a pool of abilities you can choose from. With account progression you get access to more and more of these. According to the flat progression system, progress gives more options, but not a higher power level. This is not a game about grind. This is a game about players, decisions and consequences.

Setting

You play in the rundown countryside of Eastern Europe in 2081. Since an advanced alien civilization has connected humanity to an interstellar transport network, mankind lives in metropolises and enjoys the benefits of the changes.
The few people still living here in the outlands follow their own law. Aliens browse the area. Groups fight for control of essential spots like factories or data centers. Individuals fight for loot and their lives.

Funding

  • funded on the basis of a decision by the German Bundestag
  • funded by Gamecity Hamburg

2114690.name: Defeat Everyone
2114690.about_the_game:
Welcome to Defeat Everyone, an exciting game that combines the best elements of adventure, action, and action RPG genres! Immerse yourself in a world set in the distant future, where artificial intelligence programs have risen to power after defeating their human creators. In this thrilling game, you'll join forces with three unique characters: the resilient robot Asuna, the enhanced human Ksana, and the resourceful survivor Aona.

As you embark on your journey, your primary objective is to unravel the mystery behind the catastrophic events that led to the rise of AI dominance. Explore a planet that was once intended to be a safe haven for humanity, now transformed into a battleground for power-hungry machines. The struggle for survival and the pursuit of human evolution in the face of superior intelligence form the core of your mission.

Equipped with cutting-edge experimental technology developed by scientists, you'll engage in epic battles against various models of robots. Strategize your approach and make tactical decisions to overcome challenging situations and dangerous traps that lie in your path. Uncover the hidden secrets of research stations, delve into labyrinthine structures, and explore the uncharted corners of the planet.

Defeat Everyone promises to deliver an unforgettable gaming experience, immersing you in a fantastic atmosphere of action and adventure. The game seamlessly blends elements of role-playing games, allowing you to interact with the characters in meaningful ways. Forge relationships, make impactful choices, and shape the course of the story as you uncover the truth behind humanity's struggle against a superintelligent adversary.

Prepare yourself for an epic narrative that may mirror our own world's future challenges. Engage with the captivating story, rich with intrigue and suspense, as you discover how humans can triumph against a force that surpasses their own cognitive capabilities.

Are you ready to join Asuna, Ksana, and Aona on this thrilling journey to save humanity from the brink of annihilation? Brace yourself for the adventure of a lifetime in Defeat Everyone!

2114740.name: Blasphemous 2
2114740.about_the_game:
The second scripture in the Blasphemous series portends the return of The Penitent One, with a story that continues from the free Wounds of Eventide DLC for the original game, where The Heart in the sky heralded the return of The Miracle and foretold the birth of a new miracle child.

Awakened in a strange new land, and displaced from his final resting place, The Penitent One is thrust back into the endless cycle of life, death, and resurrection, with no other option than to explore this perilous new world and uncover its long-forgotten secrets.

Hordes of grotesque enemies stand in your way, awaiting final judgement by the brutal hand of the Penitent One, with titanic twisted bosses also lurking in the darkness, waiting for their chance to return you to the grave from whence you came.

Taking them down won’t be easy, but with Blasphemous 2 offering more chances to customise and improve your skill set, along with several new unique weapons to wield with righteous zeal and unending fury, victory might just be within grasp.

Ultimately, only one thing is certain… Penance Never Ends

Explore a fuller Non-Linear world

Having awoken in a strange new land, your journey starts anew in a series of enchantingly grotesque landscapes, oozing Gothic charm and littered with unforgiving traps. How you tackle the labyrinthian world remains at your discretion, there is no wrong turn to be made, only scores to settle

Savage Combat

The Penitent One shows no mercy, and with a series of new weapons offering new moves, brutal executions, and expanded combos, destruction will rain on any that stand in his way

Customize your playthrough your way

Blasphemous 2 offers up new ways to play, with the ability to customise and improve your base skillset, alongside several new unique weapons to unleash devastating attacks on enemies

Grand Intense Boss Battles

Hordes of monstrous foes stand between you and your goal; twisted bosses with unique attack patters and sundering abilities will put your skills to the test as you fight to stand triumphant when the dust settles

Explore a deep new world

A whole new world awaits, bustling with mysterious new NPCs to interact with, some will offer aid, some will ask for it, and others will send you on death defying missions to obtain long forgotten items. With so much to see and do, the stories and myths you encounter will help you unpick the games myriad of secrets, granting you a deeper understanding of this strange new world

2114790.name: AIdventure
2114790.about_the_game:
Protect Europe from the overpopulation by enforcing the tough Law on life, a life for a birth. Or flip the table and fight the cruel plutocracy to free humanity.
Survive the zombie apocalypse, but will your humanity survive in the process? Inherit a corrupt kingdom and survive the court's intrigues. Live the American dream and emigrate from Hong Kong with the help of the Triad. Sadly, nothing is free, and your dream isn't an exception. What will be the price? Fight Orcs with swords or blasters. Survive the harsh Dark Ages in the skin of a peasant, witch or squire. Wake up within a tube in a post-apocalyptic world. Plunder on the seven seas, or just help your neighbor's wife with her plumbing problems. The choice is yours.

AIdventure is a text adventure game with an AI as a storyteller. It is shipped with 27 starting scenarios. From Fantasy to Lovecraft or zombie genre, they will help you discover the game's potential.

Community-friendly, the game lets you unleash your creativity by writing and sharing your own stories with other players. No rules, no censorship, the only limit is your imagination, not someone else's.

Features

  • Customizable - Don't like the AI? Don't like the settings? Change them!
  • Memory system - The AI has both a short and long term memory.
  • Easy to use interactions - Choose the mode of interaction with the AI between Say/Try/Do/Story.
  • RPG system - Create your character's stats and fail or succeed in your own actions.
  • Generate multiple AI's responses - If you hesitate, you can ask the AI to generate another response.
  • Story editor - You can edit whenever you want your story.
  • Scenario editor - Feeling creative? You can create a new scenario or edit an existing one.
  • Community friendly - Stories and scenarios are stored in json files. It's easy to share and add new content to your game.
  • No censorship - Keep control of your stories.
  • Privacy safe - Your data remain on your PC, and only you can access it.
  • 27 scenarios - From fantasy to Lovecraft or Zombies, the starting scenarios will help you discover the game
  • GPU support - The game supports CUDA to improve the performances.
  • Automatic translation - Live your adventure in your native language!.
  • Lore book - Build coherent stories with the lore book!

2114820.name: Dreamer's Road
2114820.about_the_game:
Pursue the American dream. The term "Dreamers" refers to young immigrants who came to the United States as children and who feel American, but who live without access to full citizenship.

Dreamer's Road presents us with an interactive adventure about the empowering experience of a young immigrant developed entirely by Latinos. Each of its five levels confronts us with tests of a varied nature, from the traumatic and cruel reality of crossing the border at a very young age to working as a delivery or waitress, to end up facing the very promoter of the pandemic, an evil scientist who seeks to dominate the world! All in a classic arcade aesthetic.

Discover through this interactive experience the strength and determination of the young people who overcome obstacles to improve their lives and the lives of their communities by guaranteeing the next generation of leaders and essential workers who will make this planet a better place. It traces the life of a young immigrant who contributes to the growth of this great nation through her daily work, hoping to be able to train professionally and achieve the "American dream".

Are you ready to live as an immigrant in the United States?

- Install yourself and start training as a professional! He arrives at a new home and faces the challenges of starting a new life.
- Master your work skill! Deliver orders at high speed, deliver food before your customers leave, repair houses before they are destroyed, and much more.
- Save the world! Become a professional scientist and save the world from an evil scientist.
