2115930.name: Go Nutz
2115930.about_the_game:
FAST-PACED PLATFORMING ROGUELIKE

Play as a squirrel that can stop time. Dash, glide, bounce, and fight your way through collapsing forests while mastering momentum-based movement and combat.

Enter Hyper Focus to freeze time mid-run:
reposition, avoid attacks, chain abilities, and turn chaos into control.

THE FOREST IS COLLAPSING

Something is disturbing nature.

Blizzards strike without warning.
Floods swallow the roots.
Fire tears through the trees.

Each biome changes how you move, fight, and survive - culminating in a boss encounter.
Reach the Edge and uncover what's causing the collapse.

EVERY RUN EVOLVES

  • Procedurally generated forests

  • Dynamic weather and day-night cycles

  • Arena encounters that push movement and combat to the limit

  • Boss fights at the end of each biome

  • Skill drafting and build variety

  • Permanent upgrades between runs

Collect nuts during each run and deposit them into squirrel holes before pushing deeper into the forest.
Fall, adapt, and return with new builds and stronger abilities.

REACH THE EDGE

As you push deeper, trees grow sparse.
The sky darkens.
Life fades.

Nature gives way to something else.
Discover what waits where the trees finally end.
2115930.supported_languages: English, Polish, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Slovak

2115980.name: Super Bull Knight
2115980.about_the_game:
So, you just saw the banner and probably thought to yourself “this looks bad” but wait! This is not what it looks like, it’s much worse!
In this platformer, you try to climb a tower while your character cracks the worst jokes you’ve ever heard.
You can’t die, you just fall down. Yes. It’s that kind of game. You die only on the inside. And that is mainly because of the terrible jokes.



Don’t hate it enough? There is also a dark level. (Could be worse, could be a dark + water level) (you’re welcome.)


But it’s not all suffering, there are parts where you can have fun! YAY!

(Legal disclaimer: This single section only)



Don’t worry too much there is a way to take out your anger sometimes.


You are not always the one laughing though.



Every level usually has different paths to clear. But not to worry, we will take your hand so you never get lost, no matter your IQ!



Come explore the secret of the elder elephant and get surprised for it!
(no money back please don’t email us)

2116000.name: 阴桃花 (The Flowers of Yin)
2116000.about_the_game:
纯文字互动小说，2000字，7个结局。

有爱情，有现实，有可能超自然的现象，有科学，还有最重要的——你的选择。

剧情提要

我在湖边见到一个淡蓝色头发的女孩子，她居然想加我微信？！

等等，我醒了，原来是梦啊。

……哎？今天又梦见她了？

DLC

中元篇 - 同名小说；

梦桃花 * 2 - 与恋人邂逅前的小小巧合；

魇桃花 - 让人困扰的睡眠瘫痪。

即使不安装DLC，仍然可以在游戏界面中阅读DLC，安装DLC后可以获得相关txt文件。

FAQ

问：为什么没有图像和音乐？

答（2022版）：梦中的少女有着随心所欲的幻想完美，她的完美只存在于玩家的想象中，任何具体的图像和语音将使她的形象黯然失色，同时为了不喧宾夺主，我们也没有加入背景音乐。

答（2024版）：专注文案是作者（Snowy）的职业规划，暂时没有精力为图像和音乐分心。

2116040.name: Gloomscape
2116040.about_the_game:
Gloomscape is a crafting, survival, exploration FPS where you're sent to explore the foggy, unknown world, and unlock its many secrets.

The world of Gloomscape offers an eerie immersive sim where small choices can change the ecosystem around you. The level of Gloom can be lowered or raised through direct intervention, or through the ecosystems interacting with each other

  • You will be able to grow and harvest crops, which you can use to feed wildlife or use them to craft items.
  • Fight creatures that will drop items you can use for crafting new equipment.
  • Help others who are trapped in Gloomscape, or bring about their demise.
  • Explore strange locations, record audio logs, and unlock the mysteries that Gloomscape has to offer.
  • Watch as the changing Gloom levels trigger new behaviors in the wildlife, enemies, and even the environment.

2116060.name: Epic Auto Towers
2116060.about_the_game:
Epic Auto Towers is a single-player turn-based strategy game combining elements of autobattler, deckbuilder and roguelike. Purchase uncommon and rare Towers and build the strongest combo to withstand the monster assault! Discover unusual Tower combinations as you come back for more.

PICK YOUR STRATEGY


In Epic Auto Towers you buy, drag and drop your Towers on the field from the Tower Store. The field has limited room, so your choice of Towers matters, as does Tower placement. For example, a Cat Tower gets bonuses from milk, so it makes sense to put it next to a Milk Tower.

CONSTANT UPGRADES


All Towers destroyed during battle are fully restored next round, keeping all received bonuses. Don’t hesitate to invest in Tower upgrades, they stay forever!

STACK TOWERS


Combine Towers of the same type to stack them higher. Taller Towers have improved stats and stronger unique abilities!

AUTOMATIC BATTLES


Press “End Turn” and watch the Towers vs. monsters battle unfold. Did you prepare well?

Game features:

  • Common, uncommon and rare towers, each with their unique abilities!
  • Unique-looking Towers: Cat Towers, Frog Towers, TNT Towers, etc.
  • Build your economy: certain Towers, like the Chest Tower, give you gold each turn. Strike a balance between economy and battle Towers.
  • Beautiful 2D graphics, fun-looking Towers, monsters and bosses!
  • Epic synergies: Tower combinations, placement, and Relics all come together.
  • Random generation: Random Towers are added to the Tower Store each turn. Adapt your strategy around what you can buy here and now, or take the risk and wait for the Tower you want! Either way, no two runs will be the same!

2116080.name: Borrowhelen
2116080.about_the_game:
Grab your weapons and get ready to battle against cultists and mythical creatures in a 90s-style first-person shooter set in a fantastical realm like no other. As the brilliant scientist Ordin Gilbellt, what will you do to save the world from the evil cultists?


In the year 1015, in the Republic of Cyptnnia...

A few hours before dawn, Ordin Gilbellt visits a graveyard, carrying a bouquet for his younger brother, Yannis Gilbellt, who died in the great fire of Cyptnnia in 986 at the age of five. Although 29 years have passed since the tragedy, Ordin has never forgotten the pain of losing his only brother.

In the still of the night, his prayers are interrupted by the sound of a bell. But this time, it doesn't ring just to announce the time; it tolls loudly and repeatedly, signaling that danger is coming to the city.

Soon, Ordin realizes he is being ambushed by an unknown army. He must return to the city to save his homeland and find answers: who is attacking him, who leads the cult, and why do they want him dead? Little does he know, this is only the beginning of his longest nightmare.


  • True 2.5D Reloadless First-Person Shooter
    Borrowhelen is a first-person shooter game featuring 2.5D graphics and no need to reload. Powered by a customized GZDoom engine, it's fully moddable.

  • Build Engine-Style Interactive Levels
    Explore over 30 interactive levels, including climbing ladders, exploring underwater areas, activating switches, and destroying walls. The game includes four episodes with 33 dramatic and exciting levels designed for a rich single-player experience.

  • Unique and Powerful Weapons
    Every weapon has a purpose, as they were designed by Ordin Gilbellt himself. Control every situation with 10 powerful weapons, including the Poison Crossbow, Spear of Thunder, Hell Siphon, Hornet Sphere, and the Collapsar.

  • A '90s-Style Shooter with a Rich Story
    Who demands Ordin's death? Why does the cult murder people? And what is the cult's true purpose? Uncover these mysteries in the game.

  • Classic 256-Color Graphics and Voxels
    Borrowhelen uses the original 256-color palette, just like legendary '90s shooters.

  • CD and MIDI Music Options
    Enjoy over 30 in-game tracks available in both CD and MIDI music formats. Experience the music on your GS-compatible MIDI sound synthesizer, module, or card.

  • In-Game Customizable Achievements
    34 challenging in-game achievements await players, and Borrowhelen allows you to create and add your own achievements to your custom mods.

2116120.name: Incursion Red River
2116120.about_the_game:
RECENTLY ADDED - FEBRUARY 2026

Patch 1.3.0.0 brings a completely new dimension to the gameplay with several progression-based additions, including Act 1 of the Campaign, Safehouse upgrades, player leveling, and an overhauled economy. With this, we bring a sprawling map, Delta, alongside minor reworks to Quarry and Bunker. Several mechanics have been added to support these systems, such as a rework to the Black Market, markable resources, and grenades.

This patch represents a major step in the direction we plan to continue with as we exit the Alpha stage of development.

  • New Completely Reworked AI by Solarint
  • Story Campaign Act 1 of 3: 23 Missions, voiced by Jane Perry
  • New Map: Delta
  • New “Extreme Weather” Systems: Rain, Thunderstorm
  • New In-Raid events & side quests
  • New Safehouse Upgrade system
  • New Boss: Monstera
  • New Loose Loot
  • New In-Game VOIP System with realistic occlusion
  • New Faction: IGC (Iron Guard Corps)
  • New Voice Lines: IGC and VLF factions
  • New Improved Lighting on all Maps
  • New Steam achievements
  • New Resource system
  • New Repair system
  • New Grenade system
  • Newly Added Vaulting/Mantling
  • Overhauled Economy
  • Overhauled Recoil/Stats
  • Improved Sounds & Ambiences
  • Improved Performance/Optimization
  • Engine Upgrade from UE 5.4 to 5.6

New Weapons:
  • SR-25
  • Galil Ace 2
  • M9A3 Beretta
  • Saiga 12
  • Sig Sauer MPX
  • Norinco CQ

YOU ARE NOT IN KANSAS ANYMORE




Incursion Red River lets you engage with up to 3 of your friends as squadmates throughout a destabilized Vietnam. Complete Operations and Tasks for 3 diverse factions throughout several detailed maps to increase your reputation and rewards. Shoot and loot your way through immersive tropics against deadly AI encounters to gain influence, wealth, and uncover dark mysteries, or die trying and lose it all.

PLAN AHEAD FOR YOUR DEPLOYMENT




The goal is to provide a balanced first-person experience that feels realistic, yet fun.
Equipment and weapons influence ergonomics and combat playstyle, so you will need to pick your loadout carefully. Access the Marketplace to purchase limited quantities of weapons, medical equipment, gear, and ammunition. Whether you prefer to scope in from afar or keep things close and personal, loud or quiet, day or night, rain or shine - you choose how you get the task done. Simulated ballistic systems affect weapons and have unique characteristics that can be adjusted with attachments. Bringing in the right gear, having a proper plan of attack, and emphasizing tactical plays will maximize the success rate for deployments.

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR OWN STYLE




Select and fully customize a wide variety of weapons and gear. Swap out barrels, handguards, foregrips, stocks, sights or magazines and turn your trusty Kalashnikov from a close-quarters menace, into a deadly accurate long-range rifle. Utilize the Gunsmith table to save & load your favorite presets.
However, the customizable experience doesn’t stop at your loadout. Play to your strengths or call out your weaknesses by adjusting or fine-tuning AI difficulty at any point to ensure you always have the right level of challenge.

WHY ARE YOU HERE?




After nearly 20 years, the People’s Liberation Army repels the invasion of Vietnam, and with continued Soviet Union backing, arms manufacturing and exports prosper along with the country as a whole.

Another 20 years go by, and the Soviet Union collapses. Vietnam then reluctantly finds its new source of stabilization from the eager West.

Years pass and Western influence spreads until the rebuilt Russia helps fund a new political party in its own image, the Vietnamese Communist Union Party (VCUP). Following a heavily tampered election VCUP wins against the old government, who doesn’t go willingly.

The less-than-fair election sparks a quiet civil war, both sides fought for by local citizens, and backed by foreign nations in the shadows. A year of “civil war” trudges by slowly.

Eventually, Russia grows impatient with the transfer of power and allies itself with North Korea for more direct action, sending in the Iron Guard Corps (IGC). Western nations respond, providing “humanitarian aid” via United Intercontinental Security (UICS), and sick of endless imperialism, the Vietnamese Liberation Front (VLF) rises among the local population to free Vietnam.

The tense calm that followed the unjust election quickly falls apart as each faction redoubles its efforts to gain control, ramping up their military forces.

Amidst the noise, historic and renowned black-ops corporation FANG has given YOU a promotion. YOUR new operation is to get to know the factions, covertly carry out their tasks against each other, and figure out why you are really here.

All you know is that if FANG finds what they are looking for, you will save untold lives.

WHO ARE THE PARTIES INVOLVED?


UNITED INTERCONTINENTAL SECURITY (UICS)
UICS is a semi-neutral European organization that offers humanitarian aid to the locals. Some in their ranks, however, have ulterior motives of violently purging the East. They have established a strong presence, setting up in abandoned military bases and widely expanding their ground.

VIETNAMESE LIBERATION FRONT (VLF)
The VLF is a growing local movement with new leadership and intentions of liberating Vietnam from foreign influence once and for all. Using their knowledge of the area and lingering connections, their strategic and violent raids continue to succeed against the invading factions.

IRON GUARD CORPS (IGC)
The IGC, formed by Russia and North Korea, sits in the seat of power, militarily propping up a sympathetic government. Better for Vietnam to be supported by neighbors than the capitalist West. In order to avoid a full world war, the IGC must balance military action and accountability but has no intentions of stepping back.

2116150.name: The American War
2116150.about_the_game:
The American War will explore a different side of the Vietnam conflict including the horrors of combat as well as some of the lesser-known ramifications.

The narrative is told from the perspective of a US Veteran recounting his experience. The accuracy of this account is dubious, twisted by trauma and the use of military prescribed stimulants. Gameplay will be intercut with comic book style panels to tell this story.

In terms of gameplay The American War is an old school style shooter. Stimulants will be a twist on the gameplay offering an opportunity to get an edge and recover health in combat while on the other hand blurring the lines between reality and visions.

There are collectables scattered throughout levels that will unlock historical information in the Museum based around what you experience.

2116170.name: Out of Jail
2116170.about_the_game:
Out of Jail is a multiplayer game that is in development, where the objective is to escape from prison together with other players by solving different challenges in each match. One player in the match will take on the role of the prison guard and must prevent the players from escaping the prison.

So, how you and your friends faced these challenges

(3-8 players)

Prisoners vs Guard

While you try to find a way out of jail, you need be careful with the prison guard. NPC guards aren't as well paid as player prison guards, so they won't do you anything, but beware, who knows who is player or NPC.

Playing as prison guard role will have some disadvantages.

Features


  • Different challenges each match
    Each match is different from the previous, the ways to escape are different, you'll need to break your head together with your friends.

  • Nearby VOIP
    You hear who's close, you can scream - but be careful, the guard can hear.

  • Craft items
    Using creativity and improvised pieces found or traded with other inmates (NPC), you will create items to help solve the challenges.

  • Who is player?
    NPCs simulating other players will confuse the prison guard, you can take the opportunity to provoke a riot and go unnoticed by the guards among the NPCs

Prison Guard
  • Cameras
    Monitor the complex's security cameras and try to identify any suspicious activity.

  • Security room
    Sound the emergency siren, close all cells, send everyone to their cells, all from the security room.

  • Eletric chair
    Is someone doing work? How about taking him to the electric chair, but be careful, other players will be able to save before the chair is ready.

2116180.name: Cats Hiding in 3D
2116180.about_the_game: Walk around town and go find the 100 hiding cats. Relax to the music while you simply stroll and reveal the location of the kittens.
2116180.supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*, Japanese*, Korean*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

2116190.name: Live Shiver
2116190.about_the_game:
In this game you are not the typical hero or survivor but instead the architect of fear itself. Roles are reversed!

Your mission is to manipulate every element of the game world to orchestrate spine-chilling moments.

Your target?

A very popular streamer who is bravely playing the game.

It's a completely fresh take on the horror genre, where your success hinges on your ability to terrify the streamer. If you're intrigued by the idea of becoming the horror itself, then wishlist now!

Control anything

In this game, you can interact with nearly all in-world objects as well as many more stuff to create the perfect scary moment!

Observe the streamer closely

Be a good game and improve the streams success

You start with a set amount of energy. Your job is to strategically build up tension to then scare the streamer. When you have a good harmony of tension and scares, the viewer count will increase for the streamer. With more viewers, you can get more energy to continue the game.
2116190.supported_languages:
English*, German
*languages with full audio support

2116200.name: ECO BREAKER
2116200.about_the_game:
ECO BREAKER is a role-playing game inspired by the Japanese classics of the '90s.
Board your Mobile Gun mech unit and explore, liberate regions and assemble an army to fight against the Mad Ruler of Gebronia before the world is brought to an end.



Fast paced, Turn-Based-style Battles.
Battle your enemies in Mobile Guns and on foot, level up and upgrade your mech. Use the ACTION Gauge to gain a tactical advantage over your opponents, allowing you to attack faster or avoid oncoming attacks entirely.

An epic, world-spanning story.
Explore the world and assemble your party as you help liberate regions oppressed by the Gebronian Empire and uncover their world-ending plot before it's too late.

Look and feel inspired by the Classics.
ECO BREAKER is a love letter to the JRPGs of the PlayStation, with a story, look and sound reminiscent of the early days of 3D console role-playing adventures.



ECO BREAKER is currently in development and release details are to be announced at a later date. Please feel free to wishlist and follow to stay updated on ECO BREAKER's development.

2116210.name: Devil Peach Soda
2116210.about_the_game:
Devil Peach Soda is an action/puzzle roguelike, centered around fast-paced gameplay inspired by classic arcade puzzle games like Magical Drop and Puzzle Bobble, along with character building inspired by other modern roguelike hybrids like Gunfire Reborn.

Fight your way through a labyrinthine manor to reach the devil that trapped you here – a huckster named Peaches. To get to her, you’ll have to carve through a variety of human and devil opponents. It’s not an easy feat though, and they’re contractually obligated to come back to life if you’re defeated.

Fine-tuned and snappy puzzle combat

Match your attack’s color to an object to deal damage and build up mana for your weapon skills, or purposefully “miss” to put an orb on the board to reach something with a cleaving attack. With quick wits and good usage of your weapons, you can cut through and dismember a chunk of the game board, destroying a massive cascade of orbs.

To defeat your enemy and move on, you have to destroy all of their hearts on the game board -- while avoiding their own attacks and keeping yourself alive, of course.

Deep mechanics

Parry enemy attacks with your own well-timed attack. Match your attack's color to a falling object to 'Split' it, hitting the object beyond it. Switch weapons to get around or through obstacles. Devil Peach Soda's built around being simple to control while giving you enough depth to reward you for exploring the game's mechanics. Feeling spicy and you don’t see a color match to parry off of? You can throw a line of missed attacks at the board to cycle your weapon color and then dismember your column of misses to split them!

Combine character classes, perks, and items to support your playstyle

Take a shortsword as an Assassin and tunnel your way through the board to a priority target, or slowly build up an array of destructive spellbook sentries as a Librarian... or just take a heavy greataxe as an elemental Sorcerer, you can probably make that work!

A rich (and ignorable) story

Human or devil, whether they willingly serve Peaches’s machinations or are forced to fight, each enemy in the manor has several dialogue scenes to unlock over the course of the game. Don’t like words? Just don’t hit the button to talk to them before a fight; hide the button with an option if you’re dedicated. For the real word-heads out there, though, there’s a Story-Time difficulty and an option to unlock dialogue scenes faster.

2116250.name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2023
2116250.about_the_game:
Prepare to lead your favorite school to championship glory as you experience the most realistic college football simulation on the planet. Customize your game world to suit your desires - change everything from the team names and logos all the way to the custom playoff option! Do you wonder what a 16 team playoff would look like? Make it happen with DDS:CF23!

Create custom plays and playbooks, get immersed in the game world with the in game media news and magazine options and do what it takes to lead your favorite school to a championship! Link your DDS: College Football 2023 game world to our Draft Day Sports: Pro Football series for seamless integration of the two games for the ultimate football universe!

New to this year's version are updating recruiting features including the transfer portal and players decommitting from schools. New trophy and awards pages to better track the history of your school and its star players, revamp and additions to the depth chart packages, usages and weights, updated substitution logic and a host of other engine improvements in addition to the aforementioned custom playoff options.

2116260.name: Relic Dudes
2116260.about_the_game:
Defeat hordes of enemies with up to 4 friends on the multiplayer mode:

Gather relics, get stronger, and create builds to synergize your powers:

Features:

• Single player or Online Multiplayer with up to 4 players

• More than 30 unique relics and 10 passive upgrades.

• Multiple stages and bosses.

• Unlockable characters.
2116260.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese

2116290.name: Soda-Powered Penguin
2116290.about_the_game:
Soda-Powered Penguin is a fast-paced, momentum-based precision platformer featuring a destructive penguin strapped to a soda bottle. The soda bottle enables dashes, double jumps, and generally lots of speed- all of which is used to conquer hand-crafted challenges.

Features
  • Colorful hand-pixeled levels set in a soda-centric world. Wreak havoc as a chaotic penguin!
  • Hundreds of unique platforming challenges
  • Find secret areas by squeezing into tiny gaps!
  • Collect unique bottlecaps from a variety of brands
  • Unlockable challenge levels for those who want to explore the game's limits
  • High replayability through discovering a bounty of shortcuts and techniques to whittle down level clear times
  • Fully remappable controls and plenty of accessibility options
  • Penguin honking

2116300.name: Epic Survivors
2116300.about_the_game:
Inspire by many time survival games.

Legend Looper travel different world to complete missions.

20+ Characters with their own ability and characteristic
50+ Abilities



Use your orginal skill and learn more abilities against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you.




Try get as much Loop Point as possible.Unlock and power up.
2116300.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

2116350.name: Build-a-lot Big Dreams
2116350.about_the_game:
Work your way up the ladder of real estate success in Build-a-lot Big Dreams! Developed by HipSoft, the makers of the original Build-a-lot series, Big Dreams is a build and time management game that incorporates both new and classic gameplay features to build, buy, sell and flip properties. Each neighborhood brings new levels of fun to explore with exciting goals and challenges to complete as you build the foundation to your very own street of real estate dreams! New to the Build-a-lot game genre? Don't worry! Free tutorial levels are available and helpful characters greet you in each new neighborhood to offer tips and advice for reaching each set of goals!

Tutorial Levels Teach the Mechanics Of the Game
50 Levels Spanning 6 Different Locations
15 different structures to build including houses, parks, and services
Complete optional goals or find the Garden Gnome on each level to earn Bonus Points
Spend the Bonus Points to gain an advantage on challenging levels
Try the first five levels for free

2116380.name: Forgotten Lands: Online
2116380.about_the_game:
Forgotten Lands: Online is a free online multiplayer RPG.

  • Explore an open world without much limitation.

  • ﻿Customize your character appearance through character skins and vanity items!

  • Collect and compare hundreds of combat items to perfect your character build.

  • Create a party, join a Guild, and befriend special players you encounter along your journey!

  • Battle through hoards of combat NPCs, and encounter strong bosses for loot and prestige.  

  • Battle other players in the PVP Zone for a chance to nab their equipment and prove your strength.

  • Participate in mini-games that happen at certain times of the day!

  • Strut your stuff by reaching the top of the rankings! (Displayed on the main website)

The game was released in an alpha state, and is under active development.

  • The game is updated approximately once per month.

  • Max character level is 35, but is planned to be expanded to at least level 100.

Server Reboot Schedule...

The server will automatically restart itself every day.

  • Resets everyday @11:59 (UTC)

  • The server may be offline for up to 5 minutes while it reboots.

*The server also checks if it is offline, so if the server were to ever crash, it will automatically reboot itself. Just please wait a few minutes if the server goes offline.

Important Note About VPNs and UDP Connection...

The game requires a UDP connection, which may cause issues if you are using VPN services. As a result, you likely will not be able to log into the game when connecting through a VPN connection. If you are able to launch the game but cannot log into the game, it is likely that you are using a VPN service or a TCP connection.

Controller, Gamepads, and Steam Deck...

You can play the game using a controller, gamepad, or the Steam Deck. However, you may need to map buttons. Button mapping can be done directly through the Steam Input controller configuration, or it can be edited in the game settings (options menu -> controls). Most controllers and gamepads have enough buttons to map all essential game controls. However, controllers and gamepads cannot be used to navigate game menus, and there is no built-in keyboard which would allow you to type text into the chat box or other input fields.

20 years ago, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion emerged as a smash-hit genre fusion, casting fan-favorite protagonist Jack Briar in a fast-paced puzzle adventure.

8 years ago, Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 was announced on the biggest stage in gaming.

What is this?

  • A match-3 metroidvania--or matchroidvania --exploring the development of a sequel to a game series that doesn't exist.

  • Another wild genre fusion from the developers behind Clickolding, I Am Your Beast, and Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

2116850.name: Another Farm Roguelike
2116850.about_the_game:
Another Farm Roguelike is a 2D farming & crafting game with rougelike elements where your job is to earn as much money as possible to pay the rent.

  • Grow crops
  • Build different buildings to get the most value
  • Create tools to make your work easier
  • Recycle your resources to make them more valuable
  • Gather a variety of resources
  • 30 Different Buildings
  • 250+ Different Items



Start from scratch and build the most profitable farm you can make as soon as possible. Work hard to be able to afford the rent.

2116860.name: Crimerunner
2116860.about_the_game:
Do you have what it takes to run the city? Let’s find out! Start your journey as a teenage gangster in a dangerous city district. Run simple jobs: pickpocket, act as a courier, pick locks, all under the police’s nose. Earn respect with the city gangs and don’t let the cops catch you!

Choose where you belong


Choose what you want to specialize in. Do you wanna steal from cars? Deal drugs? Or maybe burglary is your thing? There are three prominent gangs in your city and each is a master of its craft. It’s your choice which one to start with.

Work your way up


Run jobs for the gangs to increase your influence and standing within their ranks. As your reputation grows, so will the difficulty and prestige of your tasks. High rank comes with many perks, like talking your way out of trouble with the police. But remember, reputation can be lost.

Take over


The more you do something, the better you become. Run, jump, pick locks, steal, parkour your way around the city and increase your skills in all that you do. Increase your reputation with the gangs… And take over!

Features:

  • Do quests and earn reputation points with all gangs
  • Hide in the shadows and avoid being detected by the police
  • Use the verticality of the terrain and parkour around the city
  • Play lockpicking minigames with either a lockpick or a crowbar
  • Gain access to and decorate your own hideout

2116920.name: Runic Survivor
2116920.about_the_game:
Survive the Onslaught!

Fight through hordes of monster to break the seals and defeat the guardians before it is too late!

Craft Custom Spells!

In this game you do not unlock weapons or skills as you progress, instead, you unlock powerful arcane Runes.

Runes can be used to craft spells on the fly and can be changed and modified to your hearts content!

Craft a spell shooting fiery bolts that split off into massive explosion every time they light an enemy on fire. Or an aura that knocks any enemy that approaches you back, at least until the hordes of enemies overwhelm you. The only limit is your creativity... and your mana.

Unlock new equipment!

With every death you get stronger, earning gold that can be used to purchase passive abilities and bonuses to increase your chances next time.. And when you get a hang of it, increase the difficulty and face even stronger foes!

2116930.name: Mozart Requiem
2116930.about_the_game:
It's 1788 and Mozart is in Prague. He is giving the inaugural showing of his famous opera, Don Giovanni. The plaudits he receives are universal, but very quickly the events that are shaking the capital of Bohemia will take his mind off the music.

Far from the footlights, a terrible conspiracy is underway, designed to de-throne Joseph II, Austro-Hungarian Emperor and Mozart's benefactor. Left bereft and manipulated, the musical prodigy finds himself plunged into the heart of a grand conspiracy!

With murders, sinister intrigue and occult ceremonies going on all around, only his genius will allow him to get to the bottom of this hideous plot!

Join Mozart as he must find his way through 18th century Prague, find the clues and solve the great mystery. Displayed in stunning 3D third person, Mozart will need to use all his genius to uncover the various plots, discover how and who has committed various crimes and clear his name before he is charged with Murder!

Key Features
  • Full 3D third person gameplay with portions in first person.
  • Features the historical city of Prague modeled accurately on period maps.
  • Actual characters, personalities and intrigue from historical records.
  • Dozens of puzzles to solve.
  • Complete dialog development and intelligent conversation while interacting with the characters.
  • Player must finish writing some of Mozart’s masterpieces to eventually solve who is behind the murders.
  • Conduct the Prague Symphony as part of the gameplay with a 3D controller.
  • Features licensed and original scored music of the master Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
  • Designed as the first in a series of “PERSONA INTERACTIVA” products.
  • Mozart has 24 hours to unravel one of the greatest mysteries ever.

2116950.name: Tiny Solar System
2116950.about_the_game:
A single player space game where you fly a rocket around a tiny solar system with realistic physics, including take off, orbiting, orbital transfers and landings.



No time limits, no stress. If you crash you just get rescued.

It's a relaxing game. Very low stress.

Do little missions to help your friends out or just fly around and explore. Help terraform Mars. There are computer controlled pilots flying around too. Sometimes they break down and need rescuing. Don't worry about crashing into anything, you'll get rescued.

On harder modes you have limited fuel so you will need to find efficient ways to reach other planets (watching the computer controlled rockets will help).



Suitable for kids (my 6 year old plays), gameplay is completely free from violence., it is all about helping your friends.

2116970.name: StarStruck
2116970.about_the_game:
A workplace accident marks the start of your journey and soon after you’ll be met with your first real choice of consequence. Nearly every choice impacts your journey as you navigate overlapping dimensions, space pirates, mad scientists, eccentric duos and a psychotic villain bent on wiping out everyone and everything.
Make friends, uncover the past, learn their secrets and embrace your new powers as you are thrust into the middle of it all.
You are the key.
The fate of the universe is in your hands.



But StarStruck is not just about the action and the mayhem. When things quiet down for a spell you will find yourself with a brief moment of peace and the opportunity to learn more about your companions. Nearly every character has a backstory they are willing to share, but not with just anybody. Be careful however, one wrong turn can forever destroy your chances of hearing these stories. At least until the universe loops again. Can you win them over and uncover it all?



Some choices are purely there for a little bit of extra content with no repercussions, most of them change the story in some way, but every now and then you will get a choice that changes the flow of the story completely. If you go one way, you wake up in a mad scientist's laboratory. Choose the other option and you end up having to face off against space pirates. Nearly every chapter has an alternate story just waiting to be told. And the icing on the cake; you can get to the true ending regardless of which route you pick.



Are you tired of characters wearing the same outfit throughout a visual novel, even if it doesn’t make sense? The knight gets an audience with the king in the royal court, while still wearing his pajamas (King, knight, or both, take your pick). What about a hunter out in the wilds searching for the lost city of Kala-something-or-the-other, wearing a black tux with fancy dress shoes?
Well then, fear not! In StarStruck the story makes allowance for story driven attire. No longer will you have to suffer a businessman dressed like he just went through a cement mixer unless it’s part of the story! Most of the main cast come with a change in costume where appropriate, while several other characters have an outfit or two waiting to be unveiled as the story progresses.



Length of several novels
Good for more than one playthrough
Sixteen (16) memorable characters to interact with
70+ locations
In-depth affection system
Multiple story arcs
Multiple endings

2116980.name: The Hideaway
2116980.about_the_game:
The Hideaway is an exploration and discovery low-poly game with realistic survival game mechanics.



Year 3515 in Earth's referential, all humans have left the earth hundreds a few years ago.
You're a member of an exploration team and part of the last humans there are still in the galaxy, researching about the lasts traces of humans on other planets including the Earth. Due to a lack of maintenance and strange magnetic events, your ship on-board computer failed. Forced to land, you end up alone in various harsh environments. From there you will now have to survive, and use what's left of your instincts and abilities to understand your needs and your environment.

Gameplay



In The Hideaway Exploration mode, you'll be able to explore and discover many different biomes and microenvironments, from fauna to flora, with realistic meteorological events, sounds and much more, in a calm and soothing experience. Trying to find a way to extract from your environment

However, if you play in Survival mode, nature will exercise its rights over you and may become either your home or your worst enemy. In the survival mode of The Hideaway, diseases, global energy, hunger, thirst, body temperature, exterior temperature, blood pressure and volume, poisonous plants, and much more will make the wilderness a harsh place,

Features



  • Explore : Explore freely different beautiful and lively environments, from small forest biomes to large islands and deserts

  • Observe : Many sorts of animals will be surrounding you during your journey from hares to deers

  • Experience : Mother nature can sometimes be really impressive and beautiful, from tornadoes to snow storms to rarer events like eclipses, full moons, northern lights, starry nights and many more.. Experience pure nature

  • Survive : You will have to explore the wild in order to find food, water and avoid poisonous plants in order to survive

  • Permanent Death : Your only way to return home is to survive, if you're dead, you've failed. No question of holding your hand

  • Face the elements : Body statistics are realistically simulated in The Hideaway. In survival mode, you will have to regularly check your vital signs, from blood volume to body temperature, energy... in order to stay alive

  • Build : You will be able to build many types of wooden structures with logs / wood pieces that you will need to find in your environment

  • Customize : You will also have access to a relatively large choice of furniture to completely customize and personalize your buildings

  • Listen to nature : Simply listening at the different atmospheres, music, water drops, rivers, wind, seas, weather events and the different animals sounds will make you feel the environment like never before

  • Minimalistic UI : The UI Is very minimalistic, it's only here to tell you what you need to know and can be completely hidden by pressing the Tab key by default

  • Procedural worlds : Each game will be different. As the weather and sky events are procedurally generated, animal proportions and pickable wood quantities are evolving perpetually, a game can easily turn from a walk in the forest to a survival challenge.

How to play in Survival mode ?



Well, the survival mode of The Hideaway keeps it's secrets, however, playing the Tutorial may be helpful !

2117020.about_the_game:
Farm Wars the farmer's wrath is a survival roguelike where you protect your farm from an alien invasion by shooting them and sometimes get temporary weapons or recover your health to continue your battle against the aliens.

2117110.name: Trail of Toads
2117110.about_the_game:
There is only one goal: reach the end of the Trail of Toads.

Trail of Toads is a hard, semi-linear 3D platformer that challenges your precision, timing, and perseverance. The trail itself is a hostile path filled with demanding platforming sections, environmental puzzles, deadly traps, and aggressive raven enemies determined to knock you off course.

You play as Kaeru, a nimble toad equipped with a versatile movement set. Using your sticky tongue, you grapple across gaps, climb vertical spaces, and chain movements together. Dash, jump, stomp, slide, and strike enemies as you push forward — failure is expected, mastery is earned.

Collectibles and hidden paths reward skilled players who dare to deviate from the critical route, but the focus remains on overcoming the trail itself.

  • CHALLENGING, SEMI-LINEAR PLATFORMING

A tightly designed path built around precision movement and deliberate level design. Progress forward through handcrafted challenges instead of roaming an open world.

  • TONGUE-GRAPPLING

No tree is too high and no chasm is too deep. Explore vertical levels and reach unfathomable heights with your sticky tongue. Grapple, swing, and recover using Kaeru’s sticky tongue. Mastering tongue momentum and timing is essential to surviving the trail.

  • JOY OF DISCOVERY

Explore three unique worlds which can be accessed through a network of roots. Jump and grapple freely around and discover new adventures around every corner.

  • SLAP-A-THON

Slap the soul out of every corrupted foe that gets in your way. Make wacky combos and battle your way through a variety of enemy types.

  • SPIRITED STATUES

If you find one of the legendary toad statues, it may have a long-forgotten secret to reveal. Listen to the enthralling legends among toad-lore.

2117160.name: Dead Age: Survivors
2117160.about_the_game:
In the Indie Survival RPG Dead Age: Survivors, you will experience a dramatic story filled with dangerous quests and turn-based combat. As the leader, you will set up several camps, and conquer or defend survivor territories in order to protect yourself against up to 7 greedy factions. If you manage to keep your companions alive, you can even pursue a romantic relationship. But at night, the undead will come to feast...

IMPROVED SURVIVAL MANAGEMENT

Loot various locations to find equipment and resources. You’ll need these resources to build bases and craft equipment. Pay close attention to levels of food, water, stress, and morale. You can do this by building a water treatment center, a canteen, a bar, or a relaxation center. You can also keep livestock and care for them on a farm in order to get eggs or milk, and slaughtering the animals provides additional food and leather which you’ll need to craft gear. Iron from mines will allow you to make even better equipment.

Sometimes survivors will want to experience a little luxury in the form of fresh meals that you can prepare using various ingredients, but none of this will be of any use if you are not carefully monitoring the amount of fuel needed to power your essential generator.

RPG STORY WITH DECISIONS AND ROMANCE

Dead Age: Survivors is not just about setting up camps, stories and quests play an important role. The story takes you deep into the abyss of a human civilization left behind after the apocalypse, into a world of seedy human trafficking, extortion, and murder. The story focuses on your companions; your actions support them, and the decisions that you make may impact your camp. Will survivors die? Or can you save them? You can even become romantically involved with story survivors as time goes on.

FAST-PACED AND STRATEGIC BATTLE SYSTEM

The turn-based party battle system ensures nail-biting action while allowing for strategic attacks. You’ll need a small group of daring adventurers while scouring the world for resources and equipment. You can now fight with up to 10 survivors into a battle of conquest.

TRAINING SURVIVORS

You can find new survivors through radio transmissions, poach them from the factions, or they will join you as a reward for completing quests. You first need to build a training center to train your survivors as workers or soldiers. You can give workers different abilities so that they can work as miners or equipment suppliers. There are different classes of soldier that survivors can specialize in. These range from martial artists to guardians with an axe and shield, and death commandos armed to the teeth.

2117170.name: Kardun
2117170.about_the_game:
Kardun

Kardun is an experimental, up to 36 button menu only, combat game.

Gameplay

The core of the gameplay is the combat, in which you fight against a foe by choosing the moves both for yourself and the foe. In short:


  • You and your foe have up to six moves
  • Moves have to be charged before use
  • Once charged, moves have to be used
  • Using moves charges other moves
  • Defeating a foe allows taking its moves

Visuals

The game can only be interacted with using menu screens of visual buttons.
Progress bars and text are its primary ingredients. The visuals can be altered using the following features:

  • A number of distinct color palettes
  • Screen filter with 8 tune-able parameters

The game is best played pretending you have never seen a video game before.

2117180.name: Gulu: A Tail's Journey
2117180.about_the_game:
Who wouldn’t want to spend some time going on quests as a lovely villager cat wearing traditional clothes? Who wouldn’t like to experience all the ups and downs that a cute little cat can have to survive? You can experience it all by playing as Gulu. Gulu is a beautiful ginger cat on a story rich adventure. You can get a chance to play as a humanoid cat to explore this epic story from Gulu’s perspective.
As a little cat in the wild, life can be tough. Gulu, a little cat living in the wild, did not like to work or live with others in the village. He would run around, play and annoy other villagers. When he was hungry, he would steal other’s food, but his life took a turn and he had to prove to everyone that he could live as an honest and friendly cat.
In this 3d-platformer game featuring a cat named Gulu on his journey in the stylized wild nature and villages, you will Solve puzzles, find the hidden keys to each level, evade traps, collect the bottles of milk, cross the mountains and rivers, and reach the end of this epic story!

2117190.name: Spliced
2117190.about_the_game:
Spliced is a hybrid roguelite deck-builder. Play as a symbiotic ooze, taking the parts and abilities of enemies you defeat, in the form of cards and add them to your deck. Use an exploration deck to manipulate and explore the biome environment and a combat deck to fight enemies.

Features
  • Stability Bonuses: Collect enough cards with a common type to achieve powerful synergistic bonuses.
  • Card based interactions: The game is largely interacted with through cards, how you fight enemies, travel through biomes, make choices in events, everything is done through playing cards to make decisions.
  • Deck-building: You will have both a combat and exploration deck that you draft cards for over the course of a run. You will need to be selective in which cards you pick to form the best synergies and meet the requirements for stability bonuses.

2117200.name: Future Knight (CPC/Spectrum)
2117200.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1986, this fiendishly difficult platformer for home microcomputers from British developers Gremlin Graphics saw players take on the role of Sir Randolph as he quests to free the fair maid Amelia from the evil clutches of Spegbott the Terrible. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Contains both the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions.

Gameplay

Progress through twenty gruelling levels, fighting your way through the wrecked space cruiser. Defend yourself against the Berzerka Security Droids, to finally reach the planet's surface where you must do battle against mystical creatures to ultimately reach Spegbott's castle, where you will find your beloved, guarded by the awesome Henchodroid. Defeat him in mortal combat to ultimately release the beautiful Amelia.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options
2117200.reviews:
“If you are after mind numbing, high speed action then FUTURE KNIGHT will not appeal to you, but if you like a medium pace, thought provoking game that also offers action then go out and get it.”
73% – Amtix! (January 1987)

2117210.name: Underfoot Queens
2117210.about_the_game:
Underfoot Queens is an ant themed 4x where you will lead your species across generations. Explore, forage for food, expand your colony, fight off competitors, and survive the elements on your path to evolution. In the end, only the most adaptable species will survive.



  • Explore and gather resources - Carbohydrates, proteins, water, building materials... Your colony will need them all and you must explore to make sure you don't run out of stocks.



  • Manage your colony - The population inside your nests will grow from egg to worker stage without your intervention, but you need to control their growth and guide them through food shortages, diseases and other dangers.



  • Fight for food, fight for supremacy - Fight other insects, both wildlife and rival colonies.
  • Adapt and Evolve - Every species you see in-game has a dna code. You can improve or worsen yours by breeding during the nuptial flights, starting a new game from scratch with your new genes.



  • Permadeath - How far can you lead your colony before it succumbs? Will you risk another year or reproduce as soon as possible to avoid uncertain doom?
  • Unlock new species! - Not all progress is lost when you lose your game: While playing you will get achievements that will potentially unlock new species. These new species will be fresh starting points for your journey, each with their own strengths & weaknesses.



This is Underfoot Queens roadmap to the Demo, the roadmap shown here will change once that milestone is reached. Keep in mind some of this features will not completely be finished when released, I'm a big fan of iterative work and later updates will either polish or balance said mechanics and add more content tied to them.

I have divided the core features I want in the game in 4 big updates:

  • The Foundation Update - This update introduced core systems to the game such as saving/loading, settings, translations and also reworked the whole breeding phase to give the player more agency. It wasn't a very meaty update from a gameplay perspective but the game is more solid now!



  • The Regional Update - The big feature here is, like the name says, the regions. A lot of this feature is not clear (I don't know what's feasible yet), but fear not! This update will also bring a lot of minor mechanics that will make the management part more interesting, like diseases, freezing and rain. You know, fun stuff.



  • The Warfare Update - Are you tired of predating on those poor aphids? Is the world to tame for you? Don't worry this update will bring PVE to the table so you can lose your game to a full ant invasion!



  • The Biomes Update - Biomes! More species! More mechanics related to those species! This update will add a lot of content to previous established mechanics and polish before the demo release.

2117230.name: Night of the Wererat
2117230.about_the_game:
The Night of the Wererat is a short horror game with rats, rats, and more rats! You have been called in to exterminate the pests within a foreclosed home that was abandoned by its prior owners. A house can't be sold with rats in it, but what you may find will challenge even the best exterminator like yourself.

  • Collect normal rats in your job as an exterminator.
  • Find tools to use in your job such as a crowbar and keys.
  • Three unique endings!
  • Explore the nooks and crannies of a desolate home.
  • Face down a wererat in the final stretch of the game.

How will your night with the wererat change your fate?

2117240.name: Quantum Coherence
2117240.about_the_game:
Temujin Corporation must be stopped!

Quantum Coherence is an upcoming narrative space action-adventure game with psychedelic twist, that takes place in the future of our universe. You are a spy who has infiltrated the evil Temujin corporation and must harvest Qiyou, the resource that powers space travel.

Use your spaceship & equipment to purify Qiyou into energy within the BLINC engine of your ship. With the power of this energy you can teleport to safety (with some degree of certainty) and may be able to restore all the planets destroyed by Temujin corporation and save the universe itself…

Explore philosophical concepts like panpsychism, consciousness, intelligence, and agency in this space action adventure game!

With its 3D space action adventure gameplay and deep exploration of some of humanity's most fundamental questions about itself, Quantum Coherence promises an immersive narrative and an exciting space combat experience.

The universe is about to collapse, and you're the only one who can stop it.

2117290.name: Gordian Rooms 2: A curious island Prologue
2117290.about_the_game:
Welcome back to Gordian Rooms!
On one sunny day you were strolling down your newfound mansion and successfully stumbled into a yet undiscovered part of it.
Just as your luck would have it the door closed behind you before you could escape, like in the good old days...
Once again you were left to your own devices to challenge your uncle's final surprise!

The prologue version of Gordian Rooms 2: A curious island aims to bridge the events between the prequel and the sequel.
You will be able to experience all the new features that we have worked on but in a different location than the Isle of Lye, namely a yet unseen part of your uncle's mansion.

We improved nearly every aspect of the game since the first episode's release.
Here are some features you can definitely expect:
  • Free roaming movement
  • Redesigned User Interface and User Experience
  • Vastly improved visuals, powered by Unreal Engine 5 and Lumen
  • Full controller support

The rest you need to find out for yourself, well only if you can escape...
2117290.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Hungarian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian, Korean

2117300.name: Gang
2117300.about_the_game:
Step into the gritty shoes of a notorious gangster navigating the treacherous streets of a sprawling metropolis. Drawing the relentless attention of law enforcement, your only objective becomes clear: evade capture for as long as humanly possible.

Your arsenal is your lifeline in this unforgiving cityscape. Utilize a diverse array of weapons, ranging from pistols and shotguns to high-powered assault rifles, to fend off waves of pursuing officers and rival gangs seeking to capitalize on your predicament. Your survival depends on quick reflexes and strategic thinking.

Vehicles are your ticket to freedom. Commandeer a variety of cars to outmaneuver your pursuers and make your daring getaway. With its adrenaline-pumping action, and relentless pursuit mechanics, it delivers a gaming experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.

2117320.name: Fungal Descent
2117320.about_the_game:
Your ship is falling. Something wants you here.

Fungal Descent is a first-person roguelike shooter where survival depends on how you build, adapt, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

You awaken to alarms. Your ship is going down.
What waits below is far worse.

Fight to Survive

Crash-land on a hostile world overrun with mutated creatures, ancient technology, and aggressive fungal lifeforms. Every run is a battle through unpredictable environments filled with danger, secrets, and escalating threats.

Build Your Weapon

Your gun is more than a tool—it’s a system.

  • Collect and attach mods that transform how your weapon behaves

  • Change projectile types, effects, and firing patterns

  • Experiment with order-based combinations that create entirely new outcomes

No two builds are the same. The right combination can mean the difference between survival and collapse.

Adapt Every Run

  • Discover items and upgrades to shape your strategy

  • Loot cargo pods and uncover hidden areas

  • Use resources to unlock new possibilities for future runs

Each attempt expands what you can become.

Face What’s Waiting

Battle a wide range of enemies—from massive mutated creatures to hostile machines and fungal horrors. Each region introduces new threats that demand new approaches.

Uncover the Truth

Something happened here. And something is still happening.

Scan your surroundings, piece together fragments of the past, and uncover the story hidden beneath the surface. The deeper you go, the more the world begins to reveal itself.

Descend Further

Procedurally generated levels ensure every run is different. New paths, new encounters, new opportunities—and new risks.

Push deeper. Learn more. Survive longer.

Escape… or Become Part of It

Recover the missing transmitter and call for rescue.

If you can make it that far.

2117370.name: Mad World Survivors
2117370.about_the_game:
Mad World Survivors is a fast-paced rogue-lite shooter where you battle relentless hordes of monsters in a world consumed by chaos. Players must survive intense combat where every decision could be their last. If you enjoy quick action, unique character abilities, and ever-changing battle conditions, this game is for you!

What to expect:

  • Non-stop action with countless enemies and powerful abilities.

  • Procedurally generated runs: every attempt is unique, adding endless replayability.

  • Progression system: choose your hero and upgrade abilities.

  • Affordable price and regular updates crafted with community care.
2117370.supported_languages: English, Russian, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese

2117400.name: Splittown
2117400.about_the_game:
Splittown is out of Early Access — bigger and better than ever!

  • 30+ Achievements to collect.

  • Full controller and Steam Deck support, fully revamped keyboard & mouse hotkeys.

  • DLC-sized chunk of new content, with multiple new areas and storylines.

  • Tons of new dialogue, animations, gags and music tracks.

  • In-game hint line and item highlighting via Wimp-Vision™️

  • Hundreds of bug fixes.

Splittown is our love letter to the golden age of point-and-click games. Between the sardonic humor, an eclectic soundtrack, and wonderfully crooked art, any fans of early 90s PC gaming will feel right at home. However, it's got a few more tricks up its sleeve: With a world and story that reacts to player choices, Splittown offers a familiar yet fresh take on the classic point-and-click.

Splittown embraces the absurdity and whimsy of 90s point-and-clicks, while also drawing from the rich world-building, branching narratives, and player agency of classic CRPGs. Characters you meet aren't there just to be joke dispensers; they have their own motivations, backstories, and arcs. And despite the humor, we've tried to make your actions carry real weight in a world that feels lived-in and authentic.

Every nook and cranny has been crafted with care over nearly a decade, resulting in a game world brimming with life and interactivity. Whether you’re delving into lore, engaging in unexpected side quests, or simply experimenting with the environment, you’ll find that the world reacts to your actions in surprising ways. It’s a dense and layered world, packed with achievements, collectibles, easter eggs and hidden gags.

We've set out to create a narrative filled with genuine moments of suspense, sadness, triumph, and everything in between. The world of Splittown might be absurd on the surface, but for the characters living in it, their struggles and victories are just as real.

2117430.name: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos
2117430.about_the_game:
Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos blends chaos, absurd humor, and real co-op gameplay, defining its own quirky genre - the “Goofylike”. It’s a messy, magical, cat-filled adventure where teamwork, creativity, and a bit of madness are required to survive (and clean).

🧹Clean, Cast, and Cause Chaos

Half cleaning sim, half fever dream, Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos drops players into a world where mops meet magic and every mess hides a story.

Explore the Police Station, Streamer House, Wizard’s Home, Underground Tunnels, the Burnt Dragon Battlefield, and even a forest ruled by a very polite deer.

 

Your mission? Make it shine. Or at least make it less disgusting. Along the way, you’ll fight Toiletmort, purge computers of digital curses, do laundry, and pet an unreasonable number of cats.

🧽Tools of (Un)Sanity

  • Players can switch between absurdly satisfying cleaning gadgets, including:

  • Pressure washer, vacuum, sponge, spray, and a magic wand

  • Color-coded trash bins (for those who still believe in order)

  • A plunger-on-a-rope, a chip bag for collecting chips, and the legendary Poop Stick™

  • Crafting and melting stations to upgrade your cleaning empire

 

In the Trashyard Sandbox, players can wash procedurally generated junk, earn resources, and build the ultimate recycling fortress.

 

🧼It’s More Than Soap and Water

  • Open world packed with story missions, secrets, and garbage,

  • Talking cats that hand out quests (and occasionally life advice),

  • Buffs and debuffs like cringe damage, electric shocks, and healing kisses,

  • Magic meets mess — clean with wands, defeat bosses, solve weird puzzles

  • Co-op or solo play — teamwork makes the dream clean

 

🐈A Chaotic Co-Op Comedy About Cleaning (and Cats)

Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos isn’t about perfection — it’s about embracing the chaos, laughing at the mess, and celebrating every half-clean corner.

 

It’s Goofylike, it’s absurd, and it’s waiting for you. Grab a friend, pet a cat, and get your wand ready. Because in this world, cleanliness might be next to catliness — but chaos is never far behind.

2117440.name: Lollypop
2117440.about_the_game:
Explore new worlds in Lollypop, the colorful action platformer originally released in 1994 by legendary publisher Rainbow Arts®! In this adventure, you’ll play as Lolly, a windup doll that mysteriously comes to life with one goal – to free the world from the evil clutches of Sugarbaby, who is tormenting the land with hordes of quirky enemies. Along Lolly’s journey, you’ll travel through 8 unique worlds – each one with its own distinct vibe and sound.

Fight through obstacles and enemies all attempting to stop Lolly’s crucial rescue mission! Attack enemies and gain treasure by throwing lollipops, and increase health and points by consuming a variety of candies.

Build up your candy arsenal by collecting extra abilities and power-ups along the way to prepare yourself for boss battles!

In this side-scrolling action platformer, energetic gameplay is sweetened with a vibrant yet ominous soundtrack and highly-detailed environments that fill the game’s landscapes.

2117450.name: Forbidden zone
2117450.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the dangerous and thrilling world of the Forbidden Zone, a vast open world multiplayer survival game where your main objective is to outwit and outlast your opponents.

Whether it's by building a community, crafting weapons and items, or using stealth gameplay to evade danger, your chances of making it out alive will hinge on your ability to adapt and overcome. So, are you ready to put your survival skills to the test?



Never before a player can be a creator. He makes his own rules. Join the Forbidden Zone and meet the legends.

2117520.name: ENGLISH A-GAME
2117520.about_the_game:
English A-game is a comprehensive English course in the form of a video game.
It is a fun English language game to teach you basic English (level A1) up to upper intermediate level (B1 – upper B2) and to boost your vocabulary and skills like listening, reading, and writing in English.
Included are an in-game user guide and English grammar tutorial for self-study. Designed for Polish learners of English.

In English A-game, British English is predominantly utilized in spelling and this game is narrated by a native United States speaker.

This lively interactive learning game transports students — especially kids and youngsters — into a fantastical, futuristic world where they build their English skills by conversing with robots and visiting a zoo, where they learn all about the animals and come face to face with a talking troll, who can answer their questions and model correct English pronunciation. Violence-free, the game offers also familiar features of popular video games, such as an endless runner and a shooting ground — where the player targets English words instead of adversaries.

This game was specially designed for Polish learners of English and immerses users in the experience by allowing them to select their character’s gender and choose first- or third-person play. They will progress through six levels of difficulty, from very easy to challenging, and there are even two levels for pre-readers. Included are an in-game user guide and English grammar tutorial for self-study.

Filled with riddles, fun tasks and entertaining exercises, this game is an ideal way to help users master the basics of English or refresh their knowledge at home, but it can also be used as a supplementary educational tool in a school setting or during private lessons. Learning English through play makes it a pleasure instead of a chore!

English A-game is a fun and exciting English language game to boost not only your vocabulary but skills like listening, reading and writing in English by completing different exercises through easy to understand instructions.

Suitable for ages 5 to 105.

2117790.name: Crash Override
2117790.about_the_game:
The mainframe has been infected, and you must surf the neon corridors of the cybernet, or risk a total system crash. Collect your arsenal, rezz, power up, battle hordes of glitches, and overpower the virus.

Play Crash Override as one of 6 unlockable avatars against a horde of enemy glitches. Experience the cybernet with its procedurally generated levels, neon visual style, and driving soundtrack.

Key Features

Reputation - Gain reputation to secure contracts to have access to new mainframes.
Strategy - Decide what mainframes to contract, and where to slow the viral infection.
Weapons - 12 weapon programs to collect - choose which to mix and match.
Onslaught - Shoot, dash, and maneuver to take down hordes of enemy glitches.
Salvage - Access RAM, data and upgrades found in the cybernet.
Upgrade - Wide variety of avatar and weapon upgrades.
Survive - Collect enough weapons and upgrades to derezz any opposition.
Randomized - Cybernet map, mainframe runs, and upgrades will be different each time. No two play-throughs will ever be the same.

2117930.name: Drakkon World Builder
2117930.about_the_game:
Drakkon World Builder is a comprehensive tool for generating, creating and roleplaying with your favorite table top roleplaying game systems. It comes with a world generator, solo-play oracle and dungeon mapper, and a variety of other helpful tools to let you roleplay solo, as a duet with a friend, or with a full party.

Features list:

  • Highly customizable world generator: Creates an interative, zoomable map with cities, points of interest, NPCs, adventure hooks, threats, and more!

  • "Oracle" system that can help solo players and groups without a DM play their favorite TTRPG

  • An extensive Dice roller

  • A real-time Dungeon generator and mapper

  • Helpful generators for: NPCs, adventure hooks, weather, relationships, treasure, and more!

  • World notes and location-specific notes so you can track your adventures

  • User-created points of interest and map markers

  • Multiple map graphics themes

  • PNG export so you can print or share your world with others

  • Modding support

  • 3D mode to enhance your gaming experience

For feedback and to view the roadmap, join me on Discord! Even if you haven't purchased it yet, I'd love to hear your input.

2117940.name: The Slush Force
2117940.about_the_game:
Aliens have invaded, and you, caught in the middle through no fault of your own, must stand against them. It’s up to you to expel these extraterrestrial interlopers from your home. The Slush Force blends methodical turn-based strategy with high-intensity real-time tactical combat, demanding quick thinking and combined arms tactics to defend the world against a relentless enemy.

Story-Driven Campaign

Step into the shoes of Slush, the titular character, as you defend your home against an inexplicable and relentless alien threat. While the aliens seem to be a superior ground force, they exhibit strange inadequacies in other areas...

When unexpected opportunities arise, the choices you make will shape the future.

Multi-Layered Ground Combat

Engage in a dynamic mix of turn-based strategic planning and real-time close-quarters combat.

Clean up alien forces across diverse landscapes, from forests to roads to plains.

Your positioning on the strategic map dictates the conditions of the ensuing battles. Attacked an enemy vehicle without anti-tank weapons? Tough luck... Adapt or face the consequences.

Deep Combined Arms Tactics

Facing a merciless foe, close cooperation between different units is crucial. Is the enemy overwhelming?

Maybe an airplane can lend a hand with a 500 kg bomb or two, or perhaps rocket artillery can neutralize enemy firing positions. Make sure your support units are positioned wisely...

Physics-Driven Battles and Destructible Landscapes

Experience action on a physics-driven battlefield where projectiles follow ballistic paths, objects are fully destructible, and armor can deflect impacts at oblique angles.

Use the environment to your advantage, or risk falling victim to it...

Thought-Provoking Tactical Flexibility

Arm yourself with a range of weapons, from outdated rifles to modern tanks, or even captured or reverse-engineered alien technology. A plasma rifle in the 40-watt range? With so many options, there’s no “right” way to play. If it works, it works.

What will you do?

2117960.name: Slay The Zone
2117960.about_the_game:
Survive the Chaos!

In this Roguelite action game, survive as long as you can, face hordes of enemies that progress and multiply at each stage and the longer you survive the greater the amount of enemies you will face. How many stages can you survive?

Skills & Upgrades.

With each defeated horde, you will select new skills or upgrades that will help you in your quest. From a damage boost upgrade, to a black hole that sucks up and defeats enemies in an area, there are more than 20 upgrade options that will make every match unique.

Select your Heroine!

Each heroine has a different weapon and stat that offers a variety of gameplay experience.



Free background music from MusMus.

2118100.name: OKUBI
2118100.about_the_game:
DIVE INTO INTENSE, HIGH-VELOCITY COMBAT

Step into adrenaline-filled arenas and wide, chaotic battlegrounds where every second matters and every choice can change everything. OKUBI’s combat mixes smooth aerial movement with sharp ground attacks, letting you chain combos, dodge fire, and pull off clutch plays that feel incredibly satisfying. From last-second escapes to big, gravity-defying finishes, this is competitive action reimagined — fast, fluid, and unlike anything you’ve played before.

REINVENTING THE WAY YOU FIGHT

OKUBI introduces a revolutionary wings-based PvP combat system that shatters genre expectations. Master insane vertical mobility, slip into dynamic mid-air maneuvers, and dive into hard-hitting ground engagements that demand both mechanical skill and tactical finesse. Soar above enemies, strike from impossible angles, then slam back down to the arena with devastating precision. It’s easy to pick up — but only the truly dedicated will ever touch the ceiling of mastery.

EXPLORE A DYNAMIC WORLD

From intimate 1v1 duels to coordinated 2v2 and high-intensity 3v3 battles, every match is a test of adaptability. Venture into large-scale extraction zones where players clash over rare loot, moving caravans, and high-risk objectives. But you’re never fighting just the players — you’re fighting the world itself.
Unpredictable Yōkai disturbances tear through the map, warping the battlefield with dynamic events that force immediate adaptation. A safe route becomes hostile. An ambush turns into an opportunity. The terrain itself becomes an enemy — or your greatest ally.

FORGE YOUR LEGEND

Across the galaxy lies a wealth of rare minerals, volatile energy sources, ancient blueprints, and exotic tech ripe for the taking. Trade, barter, or extract them through danger — then use your haul to craft powerful gear, refine your weapons, optimize your loadouts, and carve out your identity in the galaxy’s most competitive arenas.
In OKUBI, your build is your story, and each crafted piece pushes you one step closer to domination.

IMMERSIVE SOCIAL HUBS THAT EVOLVE WITH YOU

Explore lively hubs filled with players, activity, and constant movement. These social zones offers traders, crafting stations, unique mini-games, and different community events each cycle. Team up for PvP or open-world hunts, craft powerful gear, refine your builds, or simply hang out and meet new players between matches. Each hub feels like a thriving outpost in a living galaxy — a place where stories begin, squads are formed, and the OKUBI community comes to life.

QUESTS, MISSIONS & PLAYER-DRIVEN DISCOVERY

Take on quests that send you across star systems, into dangerous territories, and through evolving conflicts shaped by the world’s lore and the players within it. Missions introduce new mechanics, rare enemies, and unique rewards, all woven into a universe that feels vast, alive, and full of secrets waiting to be uncovered.

ELEMENTAL SKILL TREE

The game’s deep skill tree lets you channel the Five Elements, each representing a distinct combat philosophy. Infuse your weapons with elemental power, unleash specialized abilities, and shape a refined fighting style that reflects your mastery.
Whether you overwhelm enemies with raw force, control space with tactical abilities, or strike with precise elemental triggers, every fight becomes a high-skill, high-strategy mind game.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION THAT MATTERS

Build your character your way. Upgrade stats, enhance gear, unlock elemental modifiers, and equip dynamic trigger buffs that amplify your abilities when conditions are met. Every choice impacts your flow, your combos, and your dominance in combat — giving you endless room to express your creativity and outplay your opponents.

JOIN THE OKUBI COMMUNITY

OKUBI is being crafted by a passionate solo developer — an entire universe built with heart, dedication, and the support of its players. Join our Discord community where development is transparent, collaborative, and alive.
Playtest early builds, offer direct feedback, vote on new ideas, and help shape the systems that define the future of the game.

This isn’t just a community — it’s the forge where OKUBI is born.
The journey is just beginning. Jump in and become part of what comes next.

2118110.name: Catlike Magic

You wake up one day feeling a sharp pain through your chest. All of a sudden, your senses start to betray you. Your innards feel as if they were on fire, girls appear cuter the more you look at them: you have been cursed! Delve into the dark depths of the rainforest and find the crypt from which your enchantment came!

Catlike Magic is a top-down auto-shooter bullet hell game where you play as a tiny cat mage trying to rid herself of a curse.

Features

  • Special modifiers that significantly improve or change the function of your abilities.
  • Goblins that send you flying across the screen.
  • 30+ unique items that increase your stats and give you special effects.
  • 4 different playable characters, from tiny cats to bigger cats to goblins.

2118120.name: Kind Words 2 (lofi city pop)
2118120.about_the_game:
Kind Words 2 is a place to be yourself without worrying about fitting in. It's a social space with no followers, no likes, no subscribing.

These are real people making each other feel seen, heard and less alone.



Kind Words players have written each other over 5 million letters, expressing worries and comforting each other. It won a BAFTA and is one of the best reviewed games on Steam.

Kind Words 2 includes an improved version of the original and a whole lot more!



Tell a neighbor how your day is going!



Get all dressed up!



Attend a poetry slam at the coffee shop!



Tell stories! Swap recommendations for music and shows! Write extra long letters! Trade life tips! Make wishes on the night sky stars!

Backwards compatible!


Kind Words 2 includes a re-made version of the original Kind Words. Every room has been polished and the UI has been redone for much greater accessibility. If you played Kind Words, all your old letters and favorites are waiting for you in Kind Words 2.

It all runs on one big, happy server. Swap letters and stickers with players of either game!

Ready to be kind?


This is a chance to care and be cared for by real people in a video game.

Sometimes all you need are a few kind words.

2118130.name: Chicken Feet
2118130.about_the_game:
You are a new intern at GOOBER Laboratories, a world-renown research center for genetic engineering. After a giant chicken breaks out of its containment and kills dozens of workers, you are sent in to subdue it. Guided by a voice over the radio, you descend into the facility, luring the Chicken to a place where it can be safely captured. However, the plan quickly goes off the rails.

You have no way of defending yourself. Your only choices are to run, hide, or die.

This Game Features:

  • A deeply atmospheric and terrifying world.
  • A compelling and interesting story.
  • No loading screens between levels.

Run For Your Life:

  • The Chicken may be faster than you, but you're smarter.
  • Use your wits to cut corners, slide into small spaces, and evade the Chicken.
  • Darkness is your friend. Embrace it, and maybe the Chicken won't see you.

Explore:

  • Travel into the depths of the facility and visit unique locations that challenge your wits.

Uncover a Mystery:
