Chess for idiots - a discipline of intellectual sport, invented and initiated by Ozjasz Goldberg. Seemingly chess for idiots resembles regular chess. The game is played on the same board using the same pieces. However, this is where the similarities end, because everything that would discriminate intellectually against players was eliminated from the rules. Therefore, there are practically no rules, and players can make any move with any pieces and capture any number of opponent's pieces. The victory is determined by the IQ (the lower, the greater the chances of winning) and the decision of Ozjasz Goldberg.

Weapons:
  • Blowing
  • Arrow
  • Invisible hand of market
  • Brushwood+
  • Wozdoopy Grenade
  • Inflation
  • Hot Sauce
  • And more...

True story:
When I was going to primary school, there was this guy named Paweł, and during breaks I played a game with him which involved blowing own coin in turns to land on the opponent's coin. Years later, I met Paweł and we remembered about this game, that day I couldn't sleep and I decided to copy this game to the computer. In addition to the coin mode, I added a chess mode and posted a video from a very early version of the game on a certain Facebook group where someone commented that it looked like Chess for idiots - it is a Polish political meme referring to a certain statement of a controversial politician, then I decided that this game will be a political satire. The game is therefore simultaneously a recreation of a physical game from my childhood, a parody of chess and a Polish political satire.

2121170.name: Hero Fodder
2121170.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME



Hero Fodder pulls the player into the lives of the lower-level monsters; your Slimes, Goblins, Skeletons, and Giant Rats. In a world where the heroes invade the monster’s castle and come out overbearingly victorious, it’s now up to the generally weak monsters to fight back against the heroes and reclaim what was once theirs.

This game was created as a student project, and is still in a beta state.

LEAD YOUR TEAM



Command your band of undesirables as they crawl their way through randomly generated battles, enchanting potion shops, and haunting sacrificial altar rooms, all in the hopes of reclaiming their home.

REDEFINE DEATH




Dying is not so much a setback as it is a boon. To die is not to lose, but to allow for your brethren to learn from your experiences, and shape your team into something even stronger.

DEFEAT TERRIFYING FOES



Take on enemies much greater than yourself, and conquer the heroes' most powerful forces, drawing out the best in your team at those crucial moments in heated combat.

2121180.name: BQM - BlockQuest Maker Remastered
2121180.about_the_game:
BQM, the dungeon creator where you can make and play original mazes is back with new and improved graphics! You can now turn your ideas into playable dungeons like those in puzzle RPGs, without the need for any complex knowledge. Endless adventures await you in this remastered version!

There are so many elements you can use! Switches, doors, NPCs, currency systems, and more! How will one level up when playing your dungeon? Pushing boxes around? Dodging traps? Defeating monsters? It's all up to you!

The game includes some premade challenge dungeons, and of course you can play dungeons created by people from all over the world as well as have them play your own! You don't need to know how to write code—even the most complex systems are easy to implement. The only limit is your own creativity!

The remastered version also includes all parts from BQM's two DLCs: SAMURAI ERA and CYBER CENTURY.

See the table below for the list of playable dungeons included in the remastered version.
2121180.supported_languages: English, Polish, Japanese, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal

2121190.name: Hermit Home Designer
2121190.about_the_game:
Yamasen-Chan's Hermit Home Designer is a hikikomori themed visual novel and designing game. Yamasen-Chan is a hikikomori who lives in isolation and never leaves her home. She really wants her home to look great!

Will you help her make a stylish and comfy home?

Features:
  • 6 unique homes to design
  • Complete Visual Novel Narrative
  • Over 100 items to design with
  • Original Soundtrack

2121210.name: Femboy Bangers 2
2121210.about_the_game:
Femboy on Male

Friday night at 10pm and you feel like getting out of the house.

A drive around town looking for an open pizza place will have to do, but your search is soon interrupted by a bright pink light.
Like a moth to a flame, you are drawn to a banner that reads: "Femboy Bangers".

With your curiosity piqued, you decide to investigate and see what's on offer.

Read through an exciting story as well as some pretty raunchy(erotic) dialogue, accompanied by spicy nude depictions.

Gameplay

Kinetic Visual Novel

H-Scenes
~4K words

2121220.name: Psion Protocol
2121220.about_the_game:
Gameplay:

Face endless waves of enemies in Survival Mode, earn as much experience as possible and survive for as long as possible! Pick a Psion with a unique passive skill and starting power, unlock Powers and Gear by completing Achievements! Control the movement of the Psion and it will unleash the powers you choose for them in each build, mix different Psions with different Powers and Gear each time you play!


Story:

Join the Psion Rangers in the defense of Earth from the endless waves of Nightmares!

In the future, humanity has harnessed the power of the mind and with the use of the technology known as Psi-Tech, they have unlocked unprecedented ways to manipulate reality. But the prolonged use of this technology has weakened the Psi-Field stability, "Nightmares" creatures born of negative human emotions pour into Earth's surface, it falls to the Psionic Heroes to be humanity's shield, elite combatants with oustanding potential, aided by the power of the Psion Protocol Masks.

2121260.name: My Mad Scientist Roommate Turned Me Into Her Personal Robotic Battle Maiden?!?
2121260.about_the_game:
Sam has had a run of bad luck lately. After inadvertantly upsetting their mad scientist roommate, their consciousness is downloaded into a robotic battle maiden known as a S.E.R.A. unit. And yes, they're now a female robotic battle maiden. If that wasn't bad enough, they've now been dragged into a magical dimension known as The Frakk and forced to take part in a civil war between opposing monster girl tribes.

Being a robotic battle maiden is honestly kind of cool, once you get past the abject humiliation of the whole situation. Being forced to obey the orders of your criminally insane roommate is a bit of a drawback though, as is being forced to refer to her as 'Mistress Ellie' due to some obstructive programming in your new robot body. Will Sam find a way to return to their original human body, or will they be spending the rest of eternity as a glorified appliance?

Features
  • A Life-Sim/Visual Novel/RPG hybrid!
  • Voiced Combat Sections starring professional Australian voice actors, including Aimee Smith (Freedom Planet and Smite), Rhiannon Moushall (Age of Darkness: Final Stand and CrisTales) and Allanah Fitzgerald (Kiss Off and Crush Crush)
  • A massive full length story following S.E.R.A.'s adventures in The Frakk that bridges the gap between Max's Big Bust - A Captain Nekorai Tale and Alluna and Brie.
  • Dozens of unique enemies across multiple varied biomes.
  • Explore The Frakk, which features multiple unique islands with their own shops, activities and battle maps
  • Gorgeous character art. S.E.R.A. has a bunch of cute outfits!
  • An overhaul of the combat engine from Alluna and Brie featuring better responsiveness and improved feedback.
  • Many unique characters to romance and hang out with through the Heart Beat friendship system
  • Massively updated life simulation elements, such as an improved Morale meter to quickly gauge S.E.R.A.'s mood and easier ways to find Heart Beat events
  • Ashley and Chloe return with brand new episodes of Max Heart Minute, an in-game news show that lets you know which stores are holding a sale
  • The same humour you know and love from the author of Max's Big Bust - A Captain Nekorai Tale, Alluna and Brie, Max's Big Bust 2 and Gender Bender DNA Twister Extreme
2121260.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121260/My Mad Scientist Roommate Turned Me Into Her Personal Robotic Battle Maiden?!?/

2121320.name: TimeLost
2121320.about_the_game:
TimeLost is a Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time.

Prepare for Battle

Enter the arena equipped with two distinct weapons, each offering unique skills. Your selections not only define your combat style but also impact your health and dodge capabilities. Strategize and customize to dominate the battlefield.

Master The Art of Defense

Defend with precision by balancing blocks and dodges. Absorb damage with well-timed blocks, but depleting your stamina leaves you exposed. Evade strikes and debuffs with perfectly timed dodges, gaining brief invulnerability. Strategy and reflexes are the keys to dominating the arena.

Intense Combat with Endless Strategy

Engage in fast-paced battles where strategy and precision are key. Compete in ranked arenas, skirmishes, or control points—each match brings new challenges. Customize builds to heal allies, debilitate enemies with status effects, and turn the tide of battle.

Visit the Black Market

The Black Market is the in-game shop where you can purchase new Weapons, Stimulants, Upgrade Chips, and other visual aesthetics to customize your character and weapons. You can acquire currency from competing in matches.

NO MICROTRANSACTIONS!

2121350.name: ALPHA BOX
2121350.about_the_game:
Game content:
ALPHA BOX is a 3D action platformer that's easy to learn, exciting to play, and deep enough to challenge the greatest gamers. You'll be rewarded by manipulating a block to run through the game, this fast-paced game is heartbreaking yet engaging and addictive. Enjoy extreme speed, sprint forward and master the movement. In ALPHA BOX, response and timing are key.
Get ready for impossible challenges and push your skills to the limit. The pacing of the obstacle avoidance game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. .

operate:
Right W or D Left
Avoid kaleidoscopic obstacles and pick up energy balls along the way
The difficulty of the game increases as the game progresses

feature:
* Difficulty progression.
* Two game modes.
* Competitive, challenging and stimulating
* There is no limit to the level of the level. Try as many times as necessary.
* Simple controls.

2121360.name: 东北之夏
2121360.about_the_game:
what Kind Of Game Is This?


DongBeiZhiXia (a summer in the northeast of China)is a free visual novel, which tells the story that the protagonist followed parents' wishes to make one's living in Shenyang, met two online anchors Huniu and Daojiang by chance, and experience affairs one after another with Shamate.

What are the highlights of this work?



During preparatory stage, I selected CVs suitable for each role from more than 20 CVs registered

Among them, there are some veteran voice actors who have been in their career for more than ten years, and there are also some interns in the dubbing studio.

And some of the voice actors are native northeasterners of China.

Most of the backgrounds images in the game were illustrated according to the landscape of Shenyang.

Compared with the previous video version, the game includes additional scenes, CG, and enhanced visual effects.

More stories behind the scenes about the game can be searched in Bilibili
2121360.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

2121370.name: rotatePDF: A Corporate Tale
2121370.about_the_game:
Taking the role of an employee, explore a strange company that has you... rotate documents? Surely this must be a joke, you think, and begin to investigate. Switch between 2D exploration, physics simulation and puzzles in this enigmatic art game.



Features
  • Paper Physics
    * Calm, Liminal Atmosphere
    * A short, linear Story



And lastly, a word of warning: O player, who seeketh for polished and complex games - turneth thy heel and flee, for thine search is in vain! This game is a single-developer Indie title and tries to make up for this with heart and humor, but it way not always succeed.

2121390.name: Dice Guy
2121390.about_the_game:
You are Dice Guy.


You're a hero with many FACES. 6 faces to be exact. Some might consider this a handicap, but you turn this to your advantage. You can equip items on any one of your faces. When you ROLL a random equipped item automatically activates.

Evil inanimate objects have taken over the world.


EVIL MOUSE GUY has "Combobulated" inanimate objects and is CONTROLLING THEIR MINDS. To bring PEACE back to the world you need to "Discombobulate" enemies so they SNAP OUT of the mind control.

FARM plastic crops.


Life is not all about fighting and saving the world. Sometimes you just have to relax and farm some plastic vegetables. Plastic is the crafting material of the world and luckily IT DOES GROW ON TREES.

AUTOMATE factories to refine the plastic into weapons and armor.


Of course raw plastic has little real world use. To convert plastic into usable and useful ITEMS you have to REFINE it and after that you can CRAFT your first weapons and armor.

FIGHT enemies and bosses.


Once you are armed and ready it's time to set out and journey forth into the wide OPEN WORLD. There's danger and reward around every corner. If things get too hard you can always go back to your farm and craft more powerful gear.

While doing all this you might find a secret or two...


Not everything is as it looks in this world. If you're extra perceptive you might discover a hidden SECRET.

2121430.name: Fall Minamo
2121430.about_the_game:
This game is about you, Minamo-chan, being swept away by a waterfall.

Game Features

.The object of the game is to survive as long as possible, avoiding the attacks of the ferocious creatures that live in the waterfall.
The longer you survive, the better your score, and you can enjoy a cute multi-ending based on your score.

There are only two basic controls. Even beginners can enjoy the game casually.
"Move"... Move left and right with the directional keys.
"Swim"... Swim as hard as you can to raise your stamina a little. If you run out of stamina, you can't swim!

Leveling up is important to defend against progressively more intense attacks.
Collect Japanese confectionary to gain experience and strengthen your skills strategically.

What is Minamo-chan ?

Minamo-chan is a normal, cute girl who yearns to be an adult. She is unsociable, but she loves her friends.
By nature, she is loved by all the water in the world.
Minamo-chan is prone to flooding because the water wants to be friends with Minamo-chan.

2121440.name: Monster Slayer Extermination
2121440.about_the_game:
Monster Slayer Extermination is the first chapter of the saga, and in its Tournament edition you will be able to compete with other friends to see who is the best exterminator. You will be able to see a wide variety of enemies in advance of what the next update will bring as we prepare for the story mode. In this installment you will be able to start the adventure in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to escape from a destroyed city full of enemies in which the action is currently taking place.

This chapter lasts half an hour, which is just the time it will take for the city to be destroyed and you with it, so hurry up because you do not have much time before they launch the missiles that will destroy the city.

FEATURES



► 3D third person shooter.

► Tournament edition with ranking and classification. Be the best monster slayer!

► This is the first chapter of the saga in which you will have to survive the zombie holocaust that has been unleashed in the city.

► Management of ammunition, inventory and weapons to be able to survive.

► Aggressive mechanics and hostile creatures.

► Epic boss battle.

2121450.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
2121450.about_the_game:
Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog is a top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by true events in Bangkok, Thailand 2017. The game lets you experience the harsh life of a homeless man who tries to cope with his mental struggle of the cruelty of the world. The story is framed by an interview he gives to a famous blogger, about how a chance encounter with a stray dog made him regain his sense of self once more.



What could make a man homeless? Is it one's family's financial situation? Is it the government? Is it because of our friends? Or... is it because of oneself?

Explore a journey from his childhood to the present. Unravel what made a man lose everything.

Features

  • Experience the struggle of a homeless man's and a stray dog's life.
  • Traverse the life of a homeless man through his past in Thailand's rural areas.
  • Show different ways to show affections for the dog.
  • The game tells thought-provoking ways of how to live a proper life.
  • If you are sensitive about animals, friends, or family, I can't guarantee that you won't cry.

2121480.name: The Silent Huntress
2121480.about_the_game:
Today I want to tell you a tale...dark as the night itself.



"The Silent Huntress" is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. A young girl named Gerda tracks down the Monster to revenge him for killing her younger brother. On the way, she meets fantastic creatures she has never seen before and in whose existence she did not believe. But this does not shake her determination to hunt down the Monster.



The story takes place in the universe of "Unroaded": you will meet familiar characters and learn more about their lives and the historical events of the universe. The order of the games' walkthrough is not important.



The novel has three main endings and many of their variations. Also, during the story, the protagonist can find love: if you pay attention to your allies, some of them can give you their hearts: a young girl and a young man.



"The Silent Huntress" is an introvert story about struggling with personal trauma from the past. Not only the development of events will depend on your choices, but also the conclusions that the main character makes about her life and the world around her.



Features:

📝the game contains 52k words;
📝21 variations of the three main endings;
📝the nature of the story's development and the main character's worldview depend on the choices;
📝two romance options: a female character and a male character;
📝hidden achievements in Steam;
💀Ben and Bean;
📝eight ways a heroine can die—be careful!
📝animated backgrounds;
📝the atmosphere of dark fairy tales.

2121490.name: Otome Legends
2121490.about_the_game:
A visual novel where the routes are not routes, the endings are not endings, and your choices are not real choices.

STORY:

Your friend recommends you to play a dating sim that she's been obsessed with lately. After playing it, you reflect on your life and realize that you wish you could live your life as the main heroine of a dating sim. The next day when you tell your friend at school about the game, she comes up with a mischievous plan to turn you into a real life otome heroine and things go terribly wrong.

PLAY MINIGAMES:

Each route comes with 2 - 4 cute mini games throughout the story including but not limited to point and click adventures, clickers, and rock paper scissors!



Remember! Solving puzzles is a part of finding love.

ROUTES:

Each route takes 1.5-2 hours to complete.
There are 4 routes (plus a secret route) making it 5 routes in total.




DESCRIPTION OF GAMEPLAY:


~~Select routes and earn hearts to clear each route! Earn 3 hearts to end up with your favorite love interest!~~



I lied. You don't actually have a choice.

TRIGGER WARNING:
This game contains themes of suicide and depression, graphic imagery of blood and gore, and themes of violence. Please play at your own risk.





SPOILER WARNING: (ONLY READ IF YOU ARE STUCK IN A PUZZLE NEAR THE END OF THE GAME)

Hint: If you are stuck in the game and you really want to, just poke him in the eyes and the game will close. You won't win but it will close the window.

2121510.name: Tenebris Somnia
2121510.about_the_game:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.
2121510.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America

2121530.name: Primate: Father of Universe
2121530.about_the_game:
Primate : Father of Universe is a third-person shooter action shooter,
with a little hint of adventure based game.
You will imperson Loru, a monkey trapped in an unknown world.
Help him reconciliate with his species, but stay alert, many difficulties will arise along the way.
Get a taste of this amazing adventure!!!

2121550.name: ToyBox Security
2121550.about_the_game:
ToyBox Security is a team based online multiplayer FPS with no guns, only traps. Play as a kid hired by ToyBox Security, Inc., a home security company ran entirely by kids, and set booby traps to defend the home from burglars while the owners are out of town. Or play as the robbers and steal everything that isn't nailed down while avoiding the kid's traps.

PLAY AS THE KIDS


As an agent of ToyBox Security, you must defend the house, find components, craft, and place traps in order to thwart the dimwitted burglars. Don't get caught by the robbers or it's all over. Oh, and avoid causing too much damage to the house, it's coming out of your pay!

PLAY AS THE ROBBERS


Steal everything from TVs and VCRs to toasters and toothbrushes while avoiding the kid's traps. Be quick about it, the police are on the way. Just be sure to keep your shoes during the robbery, losing them exposes you to additional traps (rat traps, anyone?).

PLAY ONLINE

Play online with up to 4 players per match. Choose your team, character, house, and let the hilariousness unfold. Work together as kids to chain your traps together and inflict maximum pain on the burglars. Cooperate as the robbers by throwing loot to each other for faster stealing and extinguish each other if you get set alight! Take on AI bots in Practice Mode to hone your strategies and skills, or squad up with your friends.

KEY FEATURES

  • Up to 4 player team-based online PVP
  • Plenty of minigames (safecracking, lockpicking, and more)
  • Large and regularly updated list of traps and valuables, including holiday themed!
  • Innovative shoe system

FREQUENT AND HOLIDAY UPDATES

ToyBox Security is regularly updated with free updates that bring new traps, components, valuables, and even houses. Holiday updates are massive and are sure to hype your holiday spirit. Currently included Holidays: Christmas, Halloween, and St. Patrick's Day.

2121570.name: SCP: Infohazard
2121570.about_the_game:
SCP: Infohazard is a survival horror game based on the stories of the SCP Foundation, where you take on the role of a test subject who becomes the survivor or a reality-bending disaster. To survive, you must restore reality fragments around the facility while avoiding some of the most dangerous monsters and anomalies that they contain. You must navigate through the high-tech facility and to find a way to stop what might just be an end-of-the-world scenario.

SCP: Infohazard immerses you in the inner workings of The SCP Foundation like never before, with breathtaking details, clever puzzles, heart-pounding stealth, combat, and more. Use the environment to your advantage as you avoid detection, shoot around corners, distract the monstrous anomalies, and more.

Infohazard includes collaboration from voice actors, writers, and artists from all over the SCP community, bringing the Foundation to life like never before.

Featured Contributors and Partners

The Infohazard team includes experienced and well-known writers, artists and content creators of the SCP Foundation Community!

TheeSherm (Site-42)

Sherm, better known as Theron Sherman of Site-42, is a prolific member of the SCP community, creating content for over 3 million Tiktok followers as well as nearly a million subscribers on Youtube. Sherm produces high quality SCP Content, including SCP Reading Audio Podcasts, Video Readings, Livestreams, and independent films.

The Desk of Alto Clef

Born of the primal fires of Mordor, The Desk of Alto Clef was forged via ancient blood rituals of the daevite (the SCP GOI) people. This not only makes The Desk nearly indestructible but allows him to bend reality and space time itself. (Joking aside he is the quindecinnial Alto Clef with works ranging from Cosplay, Voice Acting, Gaming and is considered by most to be the real life embodiment of the character itself!)

SorsHasOars (Overseer_O5_1)

SorsHasOars is a seasoned digital artist with 15 years of experience, known for their captivating portrayal of Overseer O5-1. As an O5-1 cosplayer and SCP content creator on TikTok, they produce engaging videos that resonate with the SCP community. Currently, they are working on a 72-card tarot deck featuring fellow SCP TikTok creators and developing a collaborative video series centered on the O5 Council.

Leeman Kessler (Mayor Lovecraft)

Leeman Kessler, better known as Mayor Lovecraft, is the real-life Mayor of Gambier, Ohio and a prolific content creator in Lovecraftian horror content.

2121590.name: Astrofall
2121590.about_the_game:
[[ //TEXT TRANSMISSION// ]]

ASTROFALL

Can You Survive the Astrofall?
ONLY ONE WILL MAKE IT...

Astrofall is a online multiplayer survival platformer, where players compete to make it to the rescue shuttle first to win.
Created to be a fast and fun multiplayer experience, Astrofall is perfect to load up for a quick session to test your reflexes against friends and foes.
Inspired by the likes of “Mirrors Edge” and "Fall Guys" Astrofall looks to fill a gap in-between casual competitive fun set in real world settings. Providing yet another light-hearted thrill to the finish line.

The perfect way to competivly settle a score, in-game.

2121610.name: The Events at Unity Farm
2121610.about_the_game:
On a strange and forgotten farm, a teenager uncovers an inter-dimensional battle between an occult scientist and an insidious global corporation that unleashes the Multipocalypse.

In EVENTS AT UNITY FARM, you will prevent the future Multipocalypse by engaging in riveting spell shooting combat, solving puzzles, crafting and gathering. This open-world virtual reality game pits you against advanced enemies in an ever-expanding story universe that mixes the best of dark fantasy, with elements of Lovecraft and a dash of steampunk for good measure. But beware! Monsters lurk around every corner and some of them are human. The nefarious Graumann Company has also taken up residence on Unity Farm with the intention of using the farm's powers for their own sinister ends.



Pick up and wield spells from your magical spell book. Grow your arsenal of elemental magic and harness unique spells to fight enemies and solve puzzles. With a spell in each hand combine different elements together to create devastating combo attacks. Tap into ancient places of power to improve your combat skills and purchase spell upgrades.



You’ll have to use all your skills to survive against a number of formidable enemies and bosses. Beware as creatures from myth, legend, technology and human experimentation gone wrong lurk around every corner of the farm. Outwit their tactics and find their weak spots. THE EVENTS AT UNITY FARM employs an advanced AI technology generated through evolutionary computing to create unique groups of emotionally driven and tactical enemies.



Use the tools you acquire to solve puzzles and gain clues to achieve your ultimate goal: reawakening an ANCIENT PORTAL to help a mysterious ghost girl trapped on Unity Farm. Search around you for useful objects, peer through your enchanted Magnascope to reveal things unseen to the naked eye and utilize your arsenal of spells. You’ll have to use all the tools at your disposal to decipher the puzzles left by your ancestors to uncover the secrets kept safe from the prying eyes of the Graumann Company.



In EVENTS AT UNITY FARM, you will step into the shoes of Ruth Bowie, to uncover the mysteries of your family’s magic and the ancestral land where it was first activated. To do so you will travel back in time to a crucial moment in your family’s history. But, upon arriving in the past, you quickly discovers that something has gone terribly awry. Your grandmother Alliss is dead, the farm is under attack and the Multipocalypse is nigh.

The deeper you dig into the family secrets that led you to this moment in time, the more you must rely on the gadgets and spell book left behind by your great grandmother LIV BOWIE, in order to ward off THE RISEN DEAD, the bosses that control them, and the PORTAL CREATURE lurking in the lake. All the while, hearing whispers from relatives you've never met. Are you going crazy? It is a side effect of time travel? Or, perhaps, magic? Should trust the information you're getting. Will it lead you to success or into danger?

And to make matters worse, You find yourself slowly being erased from the timeline by the dark presence responsible for these discrepancies in history. You've got to reawaken the Ancient Portal and resurrect Ghost Alliss before you too become an eternal captive of Unity Farm….



The farm is teeming with ancient magic and steampunk gizmos left by your ancestors. You’ll have to search every nook and cranny of this Alberta farm to discover all of its secrets and collect the remnants of information your family left behind for you.



  • Persistent enemies and epic Souls-like boss battles
  • Numerous spells, upgrades and combinations
  • Immersive built-for-VR gameplay with movement-focused action and physical menu systems
  • Dynamic 2SLGBTQIA characters who are women of color
  • A large variety of potions to craft that enhance combat, and provide unique skills
  • Evocative cinematics, illustrated and animated by hand in VR
  • Gorgeous environments based on a real world locations in Alberta, Canada
  • A ​rich original score, balanced to key story moments and gameplay, accompan​ies you on your journey
  • Environmental and spell-based puzzles
  • Hidden collectibles and secrets
  • Customizable comfort and accessibility options for VR with different movement options
  • Customize your story experience with different navigation modes

2121620.name: Memory Puzzle - Futanari Massage
2121620.about_the_game:
Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of a Futanari masseur and her client, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match.

Alpha Periphery is home to a desert planet, an ocean world, and its icy moon. These worlds function as tracks of an EP, composed of purely synthesized music and sounds, which evolve and react to your input in real-time.

Synthesize new abilities

You start with nothing but a terrain scanner and limited cargo space. By collecting materials, you can unlock new abilities and enhance them further. When fully upgraded, you command these worlds in every dimension.

Uncover a mysterious past

Alpha Periphery is also home to many secrets. With the terrain scanner, you discover new destinations with hidden structures and artifacts to examine. Together, they reveal insights into the true purpose of your expedition.

Stay for a while

With zero combat or risk of death, you are free to linger or experiment. As you catch your tenth sunset on Alpha Periphery C, you wonder how high the sky goes, or what happens when you dive into the water at orbital speeds.

An accessible experience

2122090.name: Forgotten but Unbroken
2122090.about_the_game:
Forgotten but Unbroken offers a unique perspective on the WWII turn-based strategy genre. Inspired by real stories and events, the game introduces fresh mechanics never before seen in the genre. Players will experience defense missions, historical characters, and unique "micro" features based on reality. From the special abilities granted by wearables to the absence of magical healing, "Forgotten but Unbroken" provides a realistic and immersive gameplay experience.

Elite enemy units, such as the feared SS troops, are designed to spread fear among players, affecting their aiming and overall performance.

Additionally, the game allows players to forge strong relationships with allies, who may send elite soldiers to assist in battle for a limited time, adding a strategic layer to gameplay.

Deep and Complex Experience

Forgotten but Unbroken delivers a deep and complex gameplay experience by intertwining historical events with personal narratives. Players will encounter a newspaper feature that reports on real events from WWII, such as the Battle of Kursk or the assassination of Reinhard Heydrich. These global events are presented alongside the personal story of the main character, Commander Martin, whose life is profoundly impacted by the events of the war. This dual narrative approach not only provides players with a rich historical context but also immerses them in the emotional journey of the main character.

Real Protagonists of WWII

The game features real characters of WWII, carefully & respectfully selected for their legacies. Players have the opportunity to meet and interact with these protagonists for a limited time during the game, adding a layer of authenticity and reverence to the gameplay experience.

Soldier Management

The game features six classes of soldiers, each with unique abilities and perks. Players can customize their soldiers and manage their traits, which affect their performance in battle. Traits such as "Iron Will" can significantly impact a soldier's morale, while physical traits like "Sickly" can affect their disease susceptibility.

Base Management

Base management is a crucial aspect, allowing players to heal, train, and maintain the morale of their troops. Structures such as hospitals and armories can be built to improve various aspects of the base and troops. Additionally, players must consider factors such as weather and disease, which can impact the effectiveness of their base and troops.

Region and Campaign

Forgotten but Unbroken is set primarily in central Europe, with a focus on Czechoslovakia. This region's strategic importance during WWII makes it an ideal setting for the game, as players will navigate the complex political and military landscape of the era.

Diplomacy/Politics

Forgotten but Unbroken incorporates a diplomacy and politics system that allows players to impress allies through successful missions, thereby increasing support. Relations with allies can impact the type and level of support they provide, adding a strategic element to player decisions.

  • Level them, awaken and power them up
  • Gather items and equip them on your heroes
  • Breeze through story with handwritten dialogues
  • Climb in the arena to claim the number 1 spot

Battle through 40+ story chapters with unique story completely new made just for this game. Each stage contains a turn-based battle between your party of up to 5 heroes battling versus up to 5 enemies. Deplete their health bars to finish the stage. Any casualties on your side will cost you a star our of 3 possible stars for each stage. Special currency used in gacha can be acquired by clearing stage stars for the first time and daily/weekly missions.

Game contains specialized summons where you can acquire heroes. There is a hard pity of 30 summons for a classic legendary hero. There's also a special darklight summon that contains more powerful or unique heroes. This summon comes with a special currency and a hard pity of 50 summons. Every character in the game can be obtained by a f2p player after some saving up.

Not revolutionary by any means, and barely hitting the minimum standarts of a gacha hero game, but made with love and care!

Game contains possible events for seasonal times like winter holidays and halloween.

Gather completely unique streamer heroes, train and awaken them and upgrade their weapons. Also possibly with battlepass and pay to feed devs darklight battlepass. However you can collect all the heroes and beat everything in the game for completely free!

Free to play
*In-game purchases are available

*Please read the End-User License Agreement (EULA) from the in-game menu before playing

* Saves from mobile version are not compatible with the steam release

2122170.name: MEGA
2122170.about_the_game:
This is a short story about humanity's last attempt to resist nature. Cities lie in ruins, there are traces of huge claws everywhere - once disturbed by people, giants began to wreak havoc around the world. But is there a solution?...
This is a survival horror game in which you will have to secretly move around the destroyed city, thinking over your route, in search of the necessary keys to complete the mission. Everything is complicated by the presence of a huge monster that is hunting you.

Take control of the commander of the emergency response unit James Ward and find the lost "weapon" of the ARK_TECH corporation, which can help in the fight against monsters.

Use everything you find in the ruins to survive. Don't forget to change the filters in your respirator.

And most importantly: don't get in the way. It's easy to see you from a height, so the best tactic is not to get into trouble.

2122180.name: OrbHand
2122180.about_the_game:
OrbHand is a card management game where you help a wizard build his magical tower and defeat the demons, while building a beautiful village in the process.

The game begins with a Wizard card and an Orb card. Make the Wizard ponder the Orb and start generating Mana, the most basic resource in the game. You will use it to purchase booster packs, to make new buildings and resources and to create spells.

Stack

Stack your cards to create new buildings, and assign resource cards to them to create more powerful characters and spells.

Make new allies

Recruit new characters to help you produce resources, fight enemies and cast spells. Each one has it's own unique capabilities!

Cast spells and fight enemies

Produce and cast spell cards that can greatly impact the gameboard.

Fight goblins, elves and other creatures that invade your town. Defeat five bosses and survive the last encounter against the Demon hordes.

Characteristics

- 🃏 Drag and drop cards to stack and assign them 🃏

- 🧙‍♂️ Make allies and fight evil cards 🧙‍♂️

- ⚡ Create and cast spells ⚡

- 🏛️ Make new buildings 🏛️

- 🔎 Unlock recipes 🔍

- 💰 Complete objectives to receive rewards 💰

- 🏯 Build the Tower 🏯

- 😈 Defeat the Demons! 😈

2122190.name: From atom to modern
2122190.about_the_game:
This is a scientific evolution resource management, click game. Manufacturing can be done with the simple click of a few buttons.

The main categories are
Atom
Hydrogen, helium, lithium, beryllium, boron, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, fluorine, neon, etc. need to be unlocked in sequence, and the unlocking difficulty gradually increases, and the role of each atom will be displayed on the right side.

Molecules
Hydrogen, Oxygen, Ozone, Water, Carbon Dioxide, Calcium Carbonate, etc.

Early Earth
The hydrogen molecular cloud, the sun, the protoplanetary disk, the inner core, etc. are also unlocked in sequence according to the real situation we have learned so far.

Life
The earth is gradually evolving, and now life is starting to be born gradually unlocking oceans, amino acids, pyrimidines, purines, ribose, blue cells, humans, etc.

Stone Age
Gradually unlock wooden sticks, wooden spears, stone axes, etc., not to mention spoilers.

Ancient Civilization
Progressively unlock charcoal, blowers, early smelters, copper swords and more

Modern Civilization
Step by step to unlock nuclear weapons, rockets, gene editing, computers, artificial intelligence.

From making single atoms to making modern tools.
You can also unlock technology and upgrade the crafting process to increase production volume and production speed.
Email bug feedback 314599782@qq.com
2122190.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

2122210.name: Battle of Vukovar: Rain of Steel
2122210.about_the_game:
This strategy wargame takes you through a real-life map of the city of Vukovar during the 90s and the fight for it's liberation. You can join the historic fight by playing with your team against another team of players or by yourself against bots. Communicate and coordinate with your team players to accomplish your goals using real weapons used during the war.

Game Mode


Choose one of the several modes in PLAY TRAINING to play against other players or an AI:

  • CONQUEST: control the objectives to earn points over time, the more objectives you control the faster your team gets points
  • RUSH: destroy or defend the objectives, if the attacker team runs out of reinforcements, the defender team wins
  • KILL CONFIRMED: kill players of the opposing team and collect the dogtags to earn points, you can also collect dogtags from your team to deny the points for the other enemy team
  • TEAM DEATMATCH: kill the enemy players to get points. Team must reach 100 kills to win the match
  • CAPTURE THE FLAG: capture the enemy flag and bring it to your own base to make points, if the enemy team has your flag, you will have to retrieve it first
  • FREE FOR ALL: kill every other player to get points

Training Mode

  • ALL MODS INCLUDED
  • FRIENDLY FIRE
  • ENABLE BOTS: enable 2 teams of bots, both offering a maximum of 16 of them
  • AI DIFFICULTY: RECRUIT, REGULAR, VETERAN

Historic Features


The map used in the game accuretly represents the city of Vukovar during it's occupation in the 1990s. Choose on whose side you're playing by picking either the ZNG RH that is defending the city or the JNA trying to seize it. Support your team by picking one of the three classes. Attack your enemys and accomplish your objectives using real weapons and equipment from the war:
2122210.supported_languages:
English*, Croatian
*languages with full audio support

2122230.name: Glass Bridge
2122230.about_the_game:
Background

Several people, struggling with their lives, took part in the life-and-death game for a $30 million prize.

Features

It's a Roguelike survival strategy game that relies on chance to pick the right glass and strategy to use skills.

The bridge is made up of 18 pairs of glass, each containing a piece of ordinary glass and a piece of reinforced glass. The reinforced glass can bear the weight of multiple people, while the ordinary glass cannot bear the weight of a single person.
Walk across the bridge, reach your destination and win.
Select a contestant and click Prepare.
Click on the glass in front of the contestant and jump forward.
If you jump on ordinary glass, the glass will break and the contestant will fall.
Pick another contestant and get ready to jump.
A skill point is awarded for each correct choice of a reinforced glass. Players can unlock a contestant's abilities.
Finally reach the opposite platform, the victory.
If there are no contestants left and the finish line has not been reached, the game fails.

Terrorist

The terror of survival, especially when falling can be felt more.

Real

Close-up of movie footage, the game has better authenticity and enjoyment.

2122360.name: Giant Wishes
2122360.about_the_game:
After being disrespected countless times in her village, Runi, a young florist, decides to seek out a mysterious giant woman who desperately needed help taking care of her garden.

Runi’s goal was simple: help the giant in exchange for learning how to earn the respect she had always been denied. Everything begins to change when she meets Lady Blerog, a fierce retired warrior who possesses a secret “whey” capable of transforming any human into a giant.

What Runi did not expect was that such an intense transformation process would lead her to gigantic experiences, far beyond anything she had ever imagined.

This game contains comedy and macrophilia stuff.

✿ Follow Runi’s journey as she transforms into a giant;

✿ 4 different endings (2 bad and 1 good. After completing these three, a secret ending is unlocked by replaying one of the bad endings);

✿ Exaggerated comedy, after all, everything is bigger when the girls are giants;

✿ CG Gallery;

✿ Around 1–2 hours of gameplay;

✿ Steam Achievements.
2122360.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

2122430.name: Renai X Royale - Love's a Battle
2122430.about_the_game:
"Renai Royale - Love's a battle" is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by ASa-Project, a Japanese developer of romance visual novels.



STORY


I, transfer student Hanamaru Mari, love you, Komachi Hiro-kun! Please go out with me!
Our protag, Komachi Hirotaka.
Every day, he goes through the motions-- dodging his cunning underclassman's advances, accidentally hitting on the student council president, and chasing idols.

But one day, he gets a sudden confession!
With that one declaration, she sparks a blaze of conflict around the protagonist, thawing his long-frozen heart.
How could you cast me aside and get all lovey-dovey, flirty-dirty with some random woman~!?
Do I mean nothing to you now!?

Senpai... Renna will listen to anything you say, okay?
There can only be one reason why Nii-san won't love me: those harpies swarming around him. Right?
Unbeknownst to the protagonist, sparks fly as the girls engage in a battle royale over his engagement.

All is fair in love and war, doubly so in a love war!
But who will the goddess of victory smile upon in the end?
There can only be one!

2122470.name: Grumpy Gumphrey: Supersleuth (CPC/Spectrum)
2122470.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1985, this puzzley action game for home microcomputers from British developers Gremlin Graphics saw players take on the role of Gilbert 'Grumpy' Gumphrey, veteran store detective. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. Included are the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC versions.

Gameplay

Gumphrey has a number of different timed tasks to perform, from rescuing children, to shooting ducks, to putting out fires, to getting the boss a nice hot cup of tea! You will need to manage your time carefully - failure to perform any of the tasks could lead to Gumphrey getting the sack!


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options
2122470.reviews:
“The game invites comparisons with Pyjamarama and the like and comes off well [...] For you gamesters who love making maps, Supersleuth will put your skills to test, without one, you might as well give up.”
72% – Computer and Video Games (December 1985)

2122490.name: 机械兽：进化（Mechanical beast: Evolution）
2122490.about_the_game:
This is a survival game that simulates mechanical beasts. By fighting with other mechanical beasts and absorbing their corpses, you can obtain evolution points. Together, evolution, mutation evolution, deformity mutation evolution, and alloy evolution can greatly affect the appearance and attributes. If you are not satisfied with the evolution attributes and appearance, you can choose to degenerate. After accumulating evolution points, you can evolve again and finally grow into the strongest mechanical beast.

Heat energy: survival needs heat energy, which will continue to decrease, but running can increase heat energy.

Electric energy: walking requires electric energy support, and electric energy can be absorbed through the current river.

Eating: You can obtain heat energy, electric energy and evolution points by eating and absorbing.

Mutation: Eating genes of other races will affect the evolutionary path and cause mutation to other races.

Deformity and variation: every evolution may lead to deformity and variation, which may be positive or negative, and will affect the attributes of mechanical animals, and mechanical animals will also have special changes.

Fight: One of the ways to get energy from corpses.

According to incomplete statistics, there are more than 300 million changes in evolution, variation evolution, malformation variation evolution and alloy evolution of mechanical animals. The more evolution, the greater difference. Please take a journey of evolution of mechanical animals.

The current version has 3 mechanical beasts online, which are beta versions and will be updated regularly. Currently, they do not represent the final quality.

2122550.name: Mushroom Card RPG
2122550.about_the_game:
An RPG/visual novel engine.

Visualized and no-code.

Story Visualized


Combat System

Create character, item, and skill

Copyright

Publish games made with Mushroom Card RPG (together with the engine the game runs in) is FREE and you DON'T need a license from me. However you shouldn't redistribute Mushroom Card RPG along as a engine.

2122570.name: Wrangel Island
2122570.about_the_game: Wrangel Island is a survival game set in the Ice Age where players can choose to play as the various factions in the game. They can play as the herbivores which work together to survive and defend themselves from the various predators on the island. Then there are the carnivores who relentlessly hunt down the inhabitants of the island for food and may work in packs to fight even the largest of threats. Finally the players can choose to play as the humans on the island, every skill available to get the upper hand on the animals that they hunt, or hunt them.

2122590.name: Call of Dusk
2122590.about_the_game:
Call of Dusk is a multiplayer first-person game, in which the player will impersonate a citizen of a town called Baffakur, a place where the forces of evil have found a way to suck human lives and those caught by the curse also crave flesh human. As one of the few remaining survivors, the player will have to explore, create strategies to survive and face creatures that haunt there, all to recover the parts of the seal that was broken and save his soul from the curse. The player will have at his disposal a variety of weapons such as revolvers, rifles and snipers, as well as melee weapons.
A challenge in the immensity of the night where only the strong will reach salvation and the weak will perish.

2122640.name: a survivor girl
2122640.about_the_game:
The Girl Who crashed into exoplanet is going to be chased by various extraterrestrial life on that planet.
Will the girl would be able to escape the exoplanet safely?

This game is a survival PRG game, Every night, somewhere on the planet, extraterrestrial life will attack you suddenly.
You should grow fast to confront those alien creatures that become more violent as time goes on.
Defeat the final boss called Drackmahre and escape from the planet as soon as possible.

Killing those alien creatures make you have experience points and gold. In addition, you can also acquire skills through the level-up. So, you can make items and enhance them with Gold accordingly. Please survive with the good combination of different skills and items until you escape from this planet.
2122640.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

2122680.name: Duct Tape Simulator
2122680.about_the_game:
Duct tape - it is the first thing that comes to mind when something breaks.
First aid, reliable assistant. This is what you will be playing in the Duct Tape Simulator! Fix what's broken, strengthen what's fragile. and remember - If you can’t repair something with duct tape, then you need more duct tape!

Gameplay
In this game you act as duct tape and you have to fix cracked and broken things.
Search the room for damaged items and repair them to fill up the integrity bar.
Improve your performance and unlock new types of sticky tape.

2122700.name: TK-cosgan
2122700.about_the_game:
Space.
Fluctuations..
Time...

TK-cosgan is a hyper-casual game with a special attitude to the surrounding sounds.
Simple gameplay - moving around the universe, interact with other cosmic entities. But remember that the interaction of objects in the universe occurs without your participation.
Self-setting the time of the game session will allow you to relax - play for just a minute, or try to survive in cold space for more than an hour.
To complicate the game session, additional features are provided - add new planets to the game universe.

Have fun!
2122700.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal

2122770.name: Kings and Catapults
2122770.about_the_game:
A 2 player turn-based strategy game with hack n slash element in a fantasy setting.
Players secretly set up their pieces and terrain tiles on their half of the 8x8 battleboard and once both players are ready play commences. Pieces move and attack in a fashion similar to Chess, white moves first then black while other pieces impede your movement. Pieces capture other pieces by moving to occupy the enemy square and removing the enemy piece. Capturing is always the end of your turn. Whoever captures the opposing King first wins however there is no check as in Chess.
Tiles
Mountains x 4 (red)
This tile is impassable to all units except Dragons. Only Crossbowman may attack Dragons that are on mountain tiles. Players may not have more than two contiguous mountains. To prevent mountains from being built into impassable walls.
Water x 2 (blue)
Water stops a unit’s movement once they enter it. (That unit can not be moved next turn and must wait until that turn is passed before it moves again.optional) Trebuchets, Catapults, Crossbowman can not attack while they are in this tile.
Forest x 6 (green)
A forest tile diminishes a unit’s maximum range by one upon entering it. Catapult shot cannot penetrate forest tiles.
Fortress x 1
The King begins the game in the Fortress but once the Fortress is attacked and “ruined” the King is free to move.
Pieces
Rank Piece Move Special .
I Rabble 1 One block ranged ability that "ruins" home fortress.
II Spearmen 1 *Blocks Cavalry.
III Crossbowman 1 Ranged attack one block radius.
IV Light Horse 3 Cavalry
V Heavy Horse 2 Cavalry
VI Elephant 1 Cavalry
VII Catapult 1 Two square range line-of-sight.
VIII Trebuchet 1 Three square range in the direction it was last moving.
IX Dragon 4 *Blocked by Forest, Fortress, and Trebuchet.
X King 2 Can capture or be captured by any piece but suffers
no terrain penalties.
Ranged units can capture normally by occupying enemy square or using their ranged ability. *Blocked units can’t capture indicated pieces.

2122780.name: ITribe
2122780.about_the_game:
Player will be owner whole a island to build a town and try to survive.

  • Mining a resoures for building. Its require for increase your population.

  • Open new tech for new buildings or buy extra resources for mining. It is provide more a resources

  • During mining the enemies can attack to your workers. Should to defend their

  • Enemies will try conquer your tribe. Build a towers, walls for effective defend

  • Every unit in the game requires a food. Take it from animals, trees, farms (player can spawn a animals there)

  • Game have different types of units. Player can combine units with constructions or each other

2122810.name: Alpaclands
2122810.about_the_game:
Alpaclands is a relaxing strategy game about creating unusual landscapes. You have to place colourful plants on small grey islands, gradually returning the colour to them. Place the plants and you collect points that can be used to place even more plants, while also repopulating the islands with cute alpacas.
The game doesn't rush you, allowing you to take your time, review the results of your work and think calmly about your next move.


As you score points, you get coins with which you can unlock new plant species that give you more points. This lets you fill up your islands with more variety!
2122810.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese

2122830.name: Venus in Furs: Sensual Pleasure
2122830.about_the_game:
Wanda Kurtz, also known as Venus of the Furs, built a sexual empire along the legendary River of Pleasure. For years, she was the most influential figure of the High Libido Command in that region. However, after discovering a psychotronic technology capable of converting explicit sex into energy, Venus decided to abandon her position and create her own business model. During her spectacular escape, she attracted the attention of sexual addicts with the bioenergetic potential of this new technology.

With this innovation, sexual pleasure is not only intensified; users can now manipulate human nature in unprecedented ways. Venus discovered that the human body, at the height of sexual climax, releases a vast amount of bioelectric and psychic energy. This energy not only affects the body but also influences surrounding energetic fields, such as electromagnetic waves and quantum fields. Thus, a new technology called Sexual Psychotronics was born, where futuristic devices capture the bioenergy generated during sexual acts and amplify it for various purposes, from creating powerful psychic weapons to enhancing mental abilities.

The devices, connected to the partners’ bodies, channel this energy for diverse purposes, converting excitement and climax into psychokinetic or telepathic power. Among Venus’s inventions, the most impressive was a teleportation machine activated by sex, which transported her to the headwaters of the River of Pleasure, beyond the reach of the High Command. However, the machine malfunctioned upon arrival, causing Venus’s ethereal fragments to be scattered across the Valley of Pleasure.

Now, her loyal lover must use the same psychotronic technology to reassemble Venus’s fragmented body, which remains trapped in a quantum limbo. The Valley is saturated with traces of her presence, and only psychotronic sex can bring her back. Sexual Psychotronics have amplified Venus of the Furs’ powers, allowing her to manipulate reality itself – even foreseeing her nemesis in the not-too-distant future.

This is a first-person game with URP quality, where the player assumes the role of the extraordinary Lingam, the skilled lover of Venus of the Furs. Your mission is to recover the fragments of Venus scattered throughout the Valley of Pleasure, using the technology of Psychotronic Sex. In addition to his own knowledge, Lingam will rely on Venus's psychic guidance to lead him on his journey. He must also search the valley for retro-technological relics, created during the failed attempt to reintegrate Venus's body.

Explore every corner of the Valley in search of artifacts, using a psychotronic tracking device. The collection of fragments will be manual, and the player must gather everything at the teleportation machine, which still needs repair. Store items in your inventory and collect as many clues as possible. Listen to Venus through various means: she has become omnipresent, even without her body fully restored. To progress, it will be necessary to interact with spectral projections of Venus, which appear in brief bursts of psychotronic manifestation.

The game features an inventory system and quality settings, FPS options, and other resources that enhance the experience in this quantum event.🤩

2122840.name: Fast or Dead
2122840.about_the_game:
Welcome to the dark world of «Fast or Dead VR» solo-developed game!
Humanity is dying out after a global epidemic. Most of the infected have turned into zombies or mutated. Scattered communities of survivors are preoccupied with two things: survival and plunder.
You are a free mercenary, plowing the wasteland in your four-wheeled wreck. Use any opportunity to earn extra money.
And remember - any means are good for survival!
You'll find an upgrade and customization system, angry zombie pedestrians and surviving car owners, and much more!

Virtual reality (VR) helmets are supported.

2122860.name: Tales of Tsuki - Moon Guardians
2122860.about_the_game:
Tales Of Tsuki - Moon Guardians
Discover the Mysteries Of the Moon Goddess

Follow the journey of Miyuki and her fellow priestesses of the goddess Tsuki on an exciting adventure through the lands of Getsuga, fighting fierce monsters and exploring the locations and meeting the characters in this mystical land full of mysteries and wonders where an ancient evil roams the shadows trying to destroy this world.

Meet the inhabitants from Gestuga




Determine the direction of the story through dialogues


Overcome the various challenges ahead of you through combat minigames.

2122880.name: All Hands on Deck
2122880.about_the_game:
Play together as Lefty and Righty!
In this playful and wholesome 2-player co-op adventure, all the plushies in the day-care have gone missing! You get to play as the hands of each kid searching for their furry friends in their own fantasy worlds. Can you find out who or what caused this strange event? Jump, Snip, Grab, Punch and High-Five your way through three worlds filled with puzzles, secrets and challenges!

  • All Hands on Deck!
    Experience a playful 2-player co-op adventure where you and a friend lend each other a hand. Whether you choose to play it, online, locally or with Remote Play Together*, you can experience All Hands on Deck with a keyboard and controller or with 2 controllers. All that without using split-screen! 
    Note: For online you both need a copy of the game!

  • Handy composure!
    Your appearance changes how you can interact within these imaginative worlds... With Rock you can Punch obstacles in your way or become Paper to Grab items and High Five! The trio is not complete without Scissors to Snip your way further!

  • Co-op tools!
    Various tools can be found across the playful worlds, like an Extendable Arm to reach higher places. A Rubber Band to become a slingshot together or mix and match Paint to traverse through paint splotches. Most tools can even be combined with others! Use them to save all the missing plushies!

  • Customisation is at your fingertips!
    Many secrets and additional challenges are spread throughout each world. Buy cosmetics and jump on paint tubes to change your appearances. Can you find them all?
2122880.supported_languages: English, French, German, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
2122880.reviews:
“You won’t be left feeling disappointed by what this indie gem has to offer.”
8/10 – GAMINGbible

2122890.name: BONERDALE - 2022 Edition
2122890.about_the_game: Bonerdale is a graphic point and click game that features hidden objects, dialogue choices and minigames that help you, the player, explore the beautiful suburban town of Bonerdale. Meet its lovable and sexy residents while you and your friends are trying to find a job and uncover the mystery of the murders that are taking place in the town. The player can explore more than a dozen locations and items to point and click to. Explore the quirks of even more characters to talk to through choose your own adventure text format and minigames to overcome. The development team republishes the game after putting the project on hold due to conflicting schedules and personal drawbacks. Some of the original members are back, and we are looking forward to completing 'Bonerdale'!

2122910.name: Fishori
2122910.about_the_game:
Explore and discover a peaceful idle fishing game set on a marooned island in the middle of nowhere. Recruit a team of shipwrecked heroes, plunge into the deep seas, and fish your way from rags to riches.



  • A fully fledged peaceful idle fishing game that is both single and multiplayer, with a charming cast of characters and diverse stories
  • An easy to learn, hard to master fishing system with over 50+ different types of fish, loot, and surprises to hook up on your rod
  • Friendly townspeople and traveling merchants give rewarding quests and sell fascinating goods
  • Over 2 hours of original music with beautiful orchestrated piano and catchy beats
  • Cake

The controls are simple and accessible - moving, interacting, and fishing - but with layers of expressive depth to master, where the pro fishermen are separated from the casuals. New and better equipment will help you to uncover the mysteries of the sea and brave your way to the realm of fishing legends.

Time to fish yourself a new story.

2122960.name: Cyber Attack VR board game
2122960.about_the_game:
Be prepared to hack the ship AI and return yourself and your team back to the ship.
This is the game where players can be at the same time inside and outside of the board game and have different gameplay, but it still will affect the gameplay for the entire team. Hack robots on the board (space ship rooms) and collect enough data to perform the Cyber Attack, but be cautious because the main computer (M.A.Z.E.) can hack you back and you will need to grab the gun to protect yourself. Robots that can explode and 3D puzzles will create tight situations, so be ready for it.

2122980.name: Monkey Party
2122980.about_the_game:
Get ready to unleash the adorable monkeys in Monkey Party! This charming puzzle game invites you to merge balls and set these cute critters free. Combine them strategically to build the ultimate tower of monkey fun!

Key Features:

🐵 Monkey Mayhem: Release playful monkeys from their colorful balls! Watch as they join the party and bring a dose of adorable antics to your tower.

🎯 Precision Puzzling: Hone your dropping skills to create perfect combinations. Every move counts as you carefully place balls to maximize your monkey party!

🌈 Whimsical World: Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with cheerful monkeys and lively colors. Monkey Party is a cheerful celebration for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages!

Join the Monkey Party today and let the cuteness and fun overflow! Merge balls, free the monkeys, and build a tower that's the life of the party!

2123000.name: Save and Conquer : 8 Years
2123000.about_the_game:
"Due to climate change, the Earth in 2027 has run out of energy resources. In Korea, batteries charged with a set amount of power are provided to all individuals, companies, and national organizations to guarantee the minimum right to live. War is taking place around the world to scramble for energy resources. We must protect the batteries in the military installations from intruders trying to take them away.

You're the commander of a military unit being invaded. Use battery power properly to protect the battery by preventing enemies from attacking 10 times in total."

As you can see in the title, this game is a 2D defense game that was developed for 5 months inspired by Command and Conquer. In-game music, illustration, and scripting(Except for some sound effects) are all being developed by one person. The game that I used to make as a practice gradually developed and participated in the BIGS 2022(Korean indie game show), and as a result, it was released on Steam.

The game depicts the future of climate change. The time remaining before the increase in carbon emissions affects humanity has been set as a subtitle of the game, and the game is intended to remind gamers of the dangers.

There are still many bugs in the game and there are many shortcomings. We will continue to develop and update continuously even after the release. Please show a lot of interest. Thank you.

2123020.name: Across The Globe
2123020.about_the_game:
Across The Globe

A grand Strategy Game Set In 19th-century World.

Play The World

  • Detailed world map, with five different projections to choose from.
  • World wide trade network, witness globalization at its onset.
  • Multi-thread optimized game engine, fast load and fast turns.

Dynamic population

  • People reproduce, age, die, migrate and change jobs.
  • Government, economy, military are all fueled by your people.
  • Different ideas steer the course of society.

Realistic Economy

  • Prices respond to demand and supply.
  • Producers expand and shrink.
  • Elastic demand depending on income and prices.

Great Power Diplomacy

  • Land and naval combat to conquer foes.
  • Influence lesser nations to enforce free trade.
  • Intervene in wars to contain your rivals.

2123030.name: Idle magic herb
2123030.about_the_game:
This game is a hang up game that integrates elements such as cultivating immortals, farming, playing strange things, and collecting cards. Protect the liver and protect the liver.



Game features:
1. Simple on hook game. With a simple click, you can realize easy cultivation, farming and other game contents.
2. The aura in the game is obtained by farming. At present, there are 243 kinds of fairy grasses.
3. Fairy grass is divided into 5 grades. Higher quality can obtain more Reiki.
4. In terms of cultivation, it is divided into realm breakthrough, magic cultivation and demonic elimination tasks.
5. When you have enough aura, you can try to break through the realm. When you need to pay attention, it is likely that the upgrade will fail. At present, the highest level is level 19.
6. There are 19 spells in the game. With the prompt of the realm, you can also use multiple spells to attack the enemy at the same time. Spells can be upgraded by attacking monsters. Each spell can be upgraded to 100 levels.
7. In addition to demons, there are 30 monsters waiting for you to kill in the game. The higher the monster level, the stronger the fighting power. Note that if your combat power is lower than that of monsters. Each attack will deduct a certain amount of aura.
2123030.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

2123050.name: TAKIBI
2123050.about_the_game:
The game itself is a very simple mechanism.
During the day, you gather resources, and at night, you connect your life with the flame.
If the flame goes out at night or if the fire is not lit by night, that's the end of the game.
You can use the points you earn to upgrade your equipment to make it more survivable, and then try again.
You can try to see how many days you can survive.
Or just stare into the flames.
It is important to take time to quiet your mind and forget the fatigue of daily life.
This game provides players with such time.

2123070.name: Nun with a Gun
2123070.about_the_game:
You are a kick-ass nun, armed to the teeth with an automatic weapon and accompanied by an adorable kitty cat. The world has gone to hell, and all sorts of demons and ghouls come out at night. Wolves, Zombies, Vampires -- it makes no difference to the nun with a gun. Luckily, you only have to survive the night, as these beastly bad guys can't survive in daylight. Help your tiny kitty cat get to the quarantine zone and blast these maniacs' heads off ... In the Dead of Night!

  • Vertical-scrolling bullet hell madness across multiple game modes with local co-op

  • Battle classic movie monsters and ghouls in a hand-drawn art style

  • Five playable characters with unique weapons and abilities, each with their strengths and weaknesses

  • Heart-pounding carnage and blood-splattering chaos on every level

STORY MODE

Character is contextually selected according to what is happening in the story.

Collect coins to upgrade key items and skills

Collect cat food to unlock new game modes and characters

Unique levels and bespoke moments.

Drop-in/drop-out co-op (P2 is mirror character)

ARCADE MODE

Compete for the high score and get as far as you can with 3 lives

Shops provide your choice of random upgrades

Extra long levels

Super hard bosses

Custom difficulty settings

Drop-in/drop-out co-op (Each player can select their own character)

ENDLESS MODE

Survive endless, randomly generated levels

Only one life (Perma-death)

Each character begins with a unique loadout

No two runs are the same

Couch co-op for fun with friends

Random boss every 500 kills

Random upgrades every 200 kills

Power-ups carry over

Casual co-op in all game modes

  • Drop in or drop out at any moment in the game, any mode, any time

  • Get the benefit of having multiple characters on the screen

  • Mix and match characters to combine special powers and abilities

  • No penalty for activating co-op, just more fun

  • Individual settings and options allow each player to play how they want

  • Multiple and split paths make co-op a unique experience

Caution Although debug keyboard bindings are available for keyboard they are for testing purposes only thus not documented or tutorialised in-game. Controllers are suggested for local co-op at this time. This will likely change by the time of release to facilitate all players.
