2123090.name: Bloodpire
2123090.about_the_game:
* Screenshots are a work-in-progress and not reflective of the final product.

Bloodpire is a medieval fantasy roguelike top-down action game currently in development.

2123100.name: Kitty May Cry
2123100.about_the_game:
• Genre: A fun, feline, pussle-solving adventure game.
    You, a little black kitty cat, must traverse a mysterious island and its ancient puzzles.
  • Dev Team: Kitty May Strike


  • With adorably novel graphics you'll love at first sight, set off by the protagonist's raven shade and white cat backpack!




  • The map's big enough for any cat to get lost in. It's a haven for curious kitties, the perfect place to satisfy that exploring urge.
  • What's more, you'll find loads of stuff to interact with as you travel around the map.




  • Immerse yourself in Kitty May Cry's laid-back, quirky dialogue that's packed with personality.
  • Let's take a look at our protagonist—a little black kitty cat who's fallen from the skies and landed here, an island most mysterious. Having recovered their white cat backpack, our feline friend sets off on a journey to retrieve their lost batteries and find their way back to the rocket.
    We start off in a coastal area, where our protagonist collects a shell or two along their way. Then they find a tram station that's caught up in a bit of trouble. Once everything's been put back in order, it's a short tram trip to the mountain path on the other side of the island!
    Here lies a new town: Archipelago. Our kitty pal will have to lend a paw to the locals, who need to get their ceremony back on track. The next stop is the Snowy Peaks where that rocket's located—if our furry friend can make it through the wondrous paths that lead there, that is.
    Wading through thick snow is a right pain in the tail. But our kitty cat's not alone! With their backpack, a few rocket researchers, and a signpost or two, that rocket's finally within reach! Hurrah!


  • Head Designer, Lu Sui: Right, first off, I'd like to say "Meow, meow. Meow meow. Meow!" (Rough translation: Well, if nothing else—we finished our game!)
    Head Coder & Technical Artist, Bot: Meow meow meow. Meooow, meow... (If development went on any longer I'd run out of hair to pull out.)
    Artist & Map Designer, Yume: Meee-yow, meow meow! Meow! (Nice work, everyone! You did great!)
    Code Migration, Laplace: Meow! Meow, meow meow! (Yeah, great job! Hope you're all still alright out there!)
    Designer, Fried Rice Guy: Mrrow? Meow meow, meow? (So, are we finally free now?)
    Sound Effects, Chuanyi: Me-yowwww! (Yahoo!)
    Stage Design, Homeworker: Meow meow! (Nyantendo FTW!)
    We hope everyone has a brilliant time adventuring with all the characters spread across Kitty May Cry!

2123110.name: Space Bot
2123110.about_the_game:
Risk of Rain meets Noita.

Space Bot is a strategic roguelite where your environment is fully desctructable, and out to get you. Travel with your friendly spaceship as you hunt for 'GELD' on far away and mysterious planets.



  • Procedural Planets Have a different experience each time you play with procedurally generated levels
  • Unique Enemies Fight increasingly difficult and creepy enemies as you rush to escape
  • Find Upgrades Increase your stats as your progress through the game. The better you play, the more upgrades you can use!



The longer you stay on a planet, the more enemies will appear and attack you. Try and get your Geld and get out!

Space Bot is currently in development by Incinious. Let me know your thoughts and suggestions on twitter @Incinious!


Inspiration for this game was drawn from:
  • OpenLiero-X
  • Motherload
  • Binding of Isaac
  • Risk of Rain
  • Terraria
  • Noita

2123120.name: Ultimate Protector
2123120.about_the_game:
Players of Ultimate Protector need to protect a goddess statue from a large number of monsters which attempt to destroy it. At the meantime, in return of the protection, the goddess will offer “gift” which is able to upgrade the skill and weapon of the avatar.

There is no complicated control on this game, use WSAD to move and doge the monsters, all weapons are used automatically.
Sword
Thunder
Potion
…

Destroy the monsters and the experience gems will be collected by the goddess automatically and when it reaches a certain amount, the goddess will send out a “gift”, move close to it and upgrade the weapons.

There is 10 avatars to be selected, with different original weapon carried.
J. Torrance
Gregor
Shiranui
….

Meanwhile, there are 5 elements and to combine different element with weapons, super weapons will be created. Also, if you are lucky enough, some super weapons are able to combined again and generate HPYER weapons.

Choose your avatar, pick the ‘gifts” , upgrade the skills, discover super weapons and protect her!

2123140.name: The Scarlet Demonslayer
2123140.about_the_game:
As the skies tear asunder, dimensional rifts appear throughout the land. They flood the world with powerful miasma, turn wildlife into demonic aberrations, and threaten mankind. Only the fabled Demon Annihilators, righteous warriors chosen by the gods, can harness enough power to fend off hordes of demons and obliterate the core of the rifts to cleanse the land.

Agnis Flarebyte, the most powerful of a long line of Annihilators, loses her power at the hands of a greedy, corrupt Prime Minister of the kingdom. He vows to keep her magic energy hostage until she meets his demands, thus endangering the integrity of the nation as the looming threat of the rifts continues to grow. Agnis must find a way to regain her lost power with the help of her assistant's magic-gathering strategies, then finally end the rift's menace and the Prime Minister's ploy.

2123150.name: Somerholm
2123150.about_the_game:
Somerholm is a photography based island generator with a focus on customizing the islands you explore and having control over numerous camera options. Discover various points of interest while exploring islands you create and take photographs along the way to fill your photo gallery.

FEATURES
  • Numerous Generation Options
    Whether you want to change the overall island height or just how many trees are generated the choice is up to you. Of course you can always leave everything completely randomized for a fresh experience.
  • At Least A Few Camera Options
    Change the brightness, contrast, field of view, saturation, color depth, resolution, and more in real time while taking photos to get the perfect shot.
  • Intrigue Awaits
    Discover various Points Of Interest while exploring the various islands of Somerholm; ranging from fire pits, to buildings, to watchtowers, and more.
  • A Unique Art Style
    Explore islands in a charming simplistic view, reminiscent of limited color depth stock photos of the wild.
  • Discovery A Left Behind Story
    While exploring islands, come across and purchase locations to notes that are left behind by others. Piece together a story that happened before your appearance on the islands.
  • Photo Gallery
    View taken photos while exploring the island or view all photos taken of your previous journeys in your journal.

2123230.name: They Come At Night
2123230.about_the_game:
Explore an abandoned island, scavenge for resources, keep the fire alive, and hide from a deadly threat. Good luck, and beware of the dark.

Survival


Survive on an abandoned island. Gather wood for your fire, find food to avoid starvation, watch your temperature so you don't freeze.

Horror


A dangerous creature lurks in the dark. Use fire to bide your time, or to fight back.

Dynamic systems




Time of day, rain and snow, and heat sources all effect your temperature. Seek shelter if you don't want to freeze, and make sure your fire doesn't go out. Weather systems like rain and snow dynamically change the environment.

2123290.name: Wheel Of Naughtiness
2123290.about_the_game:
The erotic story of the president and 6 girls, the urban love is now presenting!

Encounter with 6 girls, decide the happy time with them through the wheel of naughtiness
Satisfying the girls will trigger cutscenes~
You can also unlock the gallery and review the good times with the girls~

Game Features
Unique Visual Novel
Random wheel spinning
Nudity and partial nudity
6 girls with different Dragonbones interactive animations

highlighted.localized_name: Ah shxt, here we go again
highlighted.name: Ah shxt, here we go again

2123300.name: Catch Flex: Dance
2123300.about_the_game: Dive into "Catch Flex," the dance game where professional choreography meets advanced AI motion tracking. Just use your iPhone or Android camera – no extra gear needed! Mimic our dance coach's moves for scoring and calorie counting. Perfect for solo fun or group enjoyment with friends and family. Get ready to dance, shine, and stay active!

2123320.name: ClearIt 13
2123320.about_the_game:
"ClearIt 13" is a large and bright game that includes over 220 multiple levels of various complexity with Match3 gameplay.
A large and bright game that includes multiple levels of various complexity. Shoot with the balls located at the edges of the field and hit the center. Your task is to place the balls of the same color next to each other. This will make them disappear. There should be no balls left on the field. Then you will proceed to the next level. The game time is unlimited, but the complexity grows with the levels. There are five games modes .

2123330.name: PECK'EM - Bird Brawlers
2123330.about_the_game:
PECK'EM is a chaotically casual multiplayer 3D arena fighting game featuring cute pigeons and over-the-top fight sequences! The game is set in a future where humans have left for the stars and made pigeons the custodians of Earth.

Gameplay

Ever imagined what it would be like if birds could use magic?

Or if they could wield weapons like... a katana?
Well, that's precisely what you can expect in PECK'EM!

Choose from 4 unique Pigeons, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles, and brawl it out with your friends! Every bird in the game will boast a unique signature ability that will (literally) blow your opponents away. And all it takes is just a single button press! So grab your "non-gamer" friends and have them give it a spin too!



* PECK'EM will feature a number of different game modes upon release. Currently, only Versus (1v1 and 2v2) are available.

Setting

In the distant future, human technology has allowed for the cybernetic augmentation of biological life. Humans then choose pigeons to watch over Earth while they went off to explore the depths of space.


The game's plot centres around the fictional city of Singacoop, which features urban landscapes highly-inspired by the city of Singapore.

Explore the iconic (and reimagined) Toa Payoh Dragon Playground as a Pigeon and visit other iconic tourist hotspots of Singacoop!

TLDR


  • A 2v2 3D party brawler where players brawl it out as unique Pigeons!
  • Simple controls! Anyone, regardless of age and skill level can enjoy it.
  • A wacky and loveable cast of Pigeon characters for players to get to know.
  • Each Pigeon boasts an epic signature ability that can potentially turn the tide of battle!
  • Set in Singacoop, a city inspired by the diverse, urban environments of Singapore.

2123350.name: Hero's Journey
2123350.about_the_game:
You play as an unnamed Hero who's fighting to save the world from the evil that lies within it. Collect the coins, open the chests and save the world! Travel on a dangerous adventure as you battle goblins and potato men.



  • 7 Maps
  • Fight with a gun or a melee weapon]
  • Coins, chests and running!

2123380.name: MOBIUS BAND*
2123380.about_the_game:
Game Feedback

QQ group 73580810
Note that QQ is a IM software hosted by a China mainland company, tencent, if you got any issue registering, please use the steam community instead.

Game Introduction

With the dramatic end of World War III and the experimental application of quantum technology,
Humanity has entered a brand new industrial revolution, known as the era of quantum change,
At the same time, a new Cold War era has also begun. The CES, formed by the merger of multiple countries, has become the largest country,
However, it cannot conceal the high crime rate caused by the rapid development of technology, the widening wealth gap, and religious issues.
The government buries chips in the bodies of citizens to monitor criminal activities.

Those arrested suspects and spies from other countries will be sentenced unilaterally,
Bring death by the executor of the court.
The government, which hopes to have a deterrent effect, will broadcast the entire execution process live,
But as time goes by, the public seems to gradually view it as an entertainment program.

In 2054, during the visit of Philia von Kristian from the Federal Republic of Frank,
Sergeant Lilia Seth, trained by special institutions of the military headquarters, was assigned to the Independent Force Third Squadron under Izak,
Execute the task of protecting Philia.
However, due to an accident during the mission, Lilia Seth began to have doubts about her own existence...

Voice acting

2123390.name: CyberBlocker Complete Edition
2123390.about_the_game:
Overview

A block breaker + shooter game! The player's ship can always fire a shot, so combined with power-ups, it is an offensive block breaker.

The player can move freely within the screen, eliminating the frustration of conventional block breakers such as not being able to break the one remaining block.

The various boss battles that appear in each of the five stages are also a highlight.

There is also a score attack mode called "Challenge Mode.

CyberBlocker was originally developed for the Nintendo Switch software, smile basic4.

The game has been ported as a Complete Edition with additional stages, additional aircraft, a challenge mode, etc., and enhanced graphics.

Story

A world where science and technology have become dramatically advanced.

AI technology has progressed remarkably, and the developed AI called itself the Messiah and declared war against mankind.

The use of any AI technology was banned.

Miraculously preserved in a stand-alone state, the Cyber Blocker, a reflective bomber equipped with combat-support AI, makes full use of it to launch a sortie with the last hope of mankind on board.

Game System

This is a block breaker with a gauge type power-up system.

You can acquire power-up capsules and use various power-ups to advance the game to your advantage.

The faster the ball speed, the higher the score. Aim for a high score!

The difficulty level changes depending on the machine you select.

Operation Description

  • Move your ship: Arrow key / Cross key / Left stick

  • Shot: Z key / A button

  • Speed: X key / B button

  • Power Up: C key / RB button

Button placement can be changed in the in-game options.

Mouse operation is also supported.

  • Move your ship: mouse

  • Shot: left click

  • Power Up: Right click

2123410.name: Seven Dwarfs: Legends Untold
2123410.about_the_game:
Seven Dwarfs: Legends Untold is an epic co-op roguelike set in a dark fantasy realm, centered on intense, action-packed combat. Join forces with a team of up to 4 players, each taking on the role of one of the 7 dwarf warriors, each with unique abilities. Embark on a quest through a kingdom dominated by the ominous presence of the Evil Queen, where darkness and fear reign. Work together to overcome adversaries and ancient, powerful creatures. Upgrade your character with mighty weapons and spells, and reclaim the Kingdom from the grip of darkness.

A DARK REALM TO EXPLORE AND FEARLESS ENEMIES TO ENCOUNTER

Travel through the vast and captivating biomes of the Kingdom, and face hordes of different enemies. Experience epic battles against a set of diverse, powerful dark entities, full of unique challenges.

WORK TOGETHER TO SAVE THE KINGDOM

Experience the fantastic world designed to bring you and up to three friends together in an epic fight. Harness the individual skills of your team members and work together in complex assaults on the enemy.

NO NEED TO BE A SKILLED SWORDSMAN TO START YOUR QUEST

With easy to pick-up controls, you and your friends are ready to embark on an epic quest. But be warned: only the bravest and most determined Dwarfs are likely to succeed, as the path ahead is filled with danger and challenges.

GROW ALONGSIDE YOUR FELLOW DWARFS AND ASCEND TO LEGEND

Embark on an epic journey through challenging levels, battling enemies and collecting Souls to strengthen your characters. But be warned—you only have one chance as a team. If you fall, you'll start from the beginning, so work together, strategize, and make every move count!

2123420.name: Vilomah
2123420.about_the_game:
"No-one knew what horrors awaited Jake inside that House of Nightmares. Only God knows what he must have been feeling on that horrific night..."

The Story


Play as Jake, a teenager working the late shift in "Sal's Pizzeria" - until he's called to deliver to the HOUSE OF NIGHTMARES! Avoid this TERRIFYING KILLER in an abandoned Farm House, filled with Challenging Puzzles, Deadly Traps and Hidden Secrets!

The Hag

Stay quiet and out of sight! She can sense when you're nearby, using her heightened senses... use your Stealth Bar to stay hidden, out of light and using cover to your advantage - otherwise she might just CATCH YOU!

Try to survive and escape in this fully explorable house - search in drawers for items, keys and more! Try and find out what happened here... but be careful - the hag is always watching your every move!

Key Features:


  • Terrifying AI
  • Retro Inventory
  • Challenging Puzzles
  • Tense Stealth Mechanics
  • Outstanding Sound Design
  • Classic PS1 Visuals
  • Togglable VHS Effects
  • Horrifying Original Soundtrack
  • Frightening Survival Horror
  • 1+ Hour Gameplay
  • Lots of Hidden Secrets!

WARNING


This game contains scenes which many may not find suitable. This includes: Blood, Excessive Gore, Body/World Horror & Loud Noises. Please keep this in mind prior to purchasing.

2123430.name: BULLCRAP!
2123430.about_the_game:
BULLCRAP is a game of lies, poop and deceit!

Play online with up to Four of your friends, with 14 different types of Multiplayer games.
Or, play solo over 8 Chapters of increasingly fun and challenging levels.

FEATURES

  • Meet Bucky the Bull and his untrustworthy farmyard friends!
  • Call BULLCRAP! to punish your friends!
  • Bend the rules of the game with Wild Cards!
  • Combine Wild Cards to Power Up!
  • Unleash Chaos upon the farm!
  • Things are going to get messy, it’s time to play Dirty!

GAMEPLAY

The goal of the game is to get rid of all of your cards.

You can do this by Lying, or telling the Truth!
When you think someone is lying, call "BULLCRAP!".
If they were lying, they have to pick up all the cards.
However, if they are telling the truth you pick up all the cards.
Bluffing and taking a Risk is all part of the fun!



Wild Cards add an element of chaos to the game,
meaning you'll need to switch up your strategy and learn new tricks!

Inspired by the classic bluff turn-based card game sometimes known as Cheat or Bullsh*t!
This is a game for the Deceitful, Courageous and the Bold!

2123450.name: Blade-Shift Rage
2123450.about_the_game:
Blade-Shift Rage is a stylish combo-chasing 2D action platformer, with one hit kills and deaths.


Teleport to dodge attacks, slash and shoot anyone who stands in your way



Play as Blade-Shift Delta, the latest in a new breed of super soldier. With lightning fast reflexes you're able to Blade-Shift to instantaneously teleport.


Use this ability to dodge attacks and dash to overcome platforming challenges. Armed with a sword and revolver you'll need to perform combo kills to reload and chase the highest scores and rankings.


Kill all who oppose you as you rampage through the city to discover who betrayed you and why.


Trust no one, kill them all.

2123460.name: Auto Chess Souls-棋魂之弈
2123460.about_the_game:
Auto Chess Souls is a casual strategy adventure game that combines auto-chess and roguelike elements. Through consecutive choices, your team grows increasingly stronger. Explore the unknown tower, collect powerful equipment, uncover mysterious relics, and create unique powerful combinations. Embark on this exciting adventure now!

Beginner's Tips

  • Two identical low-level tools can be combined into one high-level tool.

  • Two identical low-level chess pieces can be combined into one high-level chess piece.

  • Collecting a full set of items will activate set effects.

  • Relics provide global effects that apply to all your chess pieces.

2123510.name: LocoMotion
2123510.about_the_game:
Locomotion is a Action, Platformer Game Inspired by many other Games out there. This game has a fascinating story behind it! Play it to find out what secrets the Acidic Waters have in store for you!
You play as a crash test dummy, and the people who made you need to test your strength.

Now in 2.0!

Features Included In-Game

2123530.name: STELLABITS
2123530.about_the_game:
It is a puzzle game that aims to clear levels by capturing various gimmicks while operating 4 characters.
At first, the level is very simple, but gradually the types of characters and gimmicks that can be controlled increase, and eventually it becomes quite difficult.
Each character has different performance, and the key is which character to move in which scene.
Collect all the stars in the field to clear the level, and clear a certain number of levels to advance to the next area.
With over 100 stages awaiting, only those with exceptional thinking skills will be able to reach the ending.

2123540.name: Guitar Zeros
2123540.about_the_game:
Guitar Zeros is a narrative deck builder where your goal is to help a DIY Punk band survive their road trip on the way to the Battle of The Bands.
Draw cards against story situations on the road with a unique system that mashes up deck building, narrative & blackjack! Hit me baby one more time!

Improve Your Band & Deck

As with any band just starting out, you’ve got your problems, and this is reflected in your deck at the beginning of the game…it sucks. Beat challenges to gain powerful new cards with various effects.

Story System

Your wins and losses are tracked to create the unique story of your band's tour.

Boss Battles of The Bands

Go up against rival bands, each with their own killer soundtrack and design.

2123550.name: Road Frog
2123550.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1983, this was one of the very earliest releases from Ocean Software, which would go on to be one of Europe's biggest game developers and publishers of the 1980s/90s. Road Frog is a simple riff on an arcade classic, released for home microcomputers. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version.

Gameplay

Guide a small frog across a busy road, then across logs floating in a river, to reach safety on the other side.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2123560.name: Frenzy
2123560.about_the_game:
Originally released in 1983, this was one of the very earliest releases from Ocean Software, which would go on to be one of Europe's biggest game developers and publishers of the 1980s/90s. Frenzy is a simple riff on an arcade classic, released for the ZX Spectrum. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version.

Gameplay

Search the labarinthine levels for the exit, while surviving an ever-increasing onslaught of deadly robots.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2123630.name: HackingBul
2123630.about_the_game:
!BETA! - I will add something new every week!

A 2D platformer is a type of video game that involves navigating a character through a series of levels or stages by jumping and running on various platforms, while avoiding obstacles and enemies. The game is viewed from a side-scrolling perspective, with the player's character typically moving from left to right across the screen.

The levels in a 2D platformer are usually designed with a variety of obstacles, such as pits, spikes, and traps, that the player must overcome using their character's jumping and movement abilities. In addition to platforming challenges, players often face enemies that must be defeated in order to progress, using various weapons or special abilities.

2D platformers often include power-ups and collectibles that enhance the player's abilities or unlock new areas of the game. These can include health boosts, temporary invincibility, or extra lives. Some 2D platformers also incorporate puzzle-solving elements, requiring the player to use their wits to progress through certain sections of the game.

Overall, 2D platformers provide a fun and challenging gameplay experience that requires both skill and strategy to succeed.

2123640.name: Hollowbody
2123640.about_the_game:
It's a Shipper's biggest fear. You're grounded in the exclusion zone, twenty miles of death and decay sealed off by the towering, suffocating walls erected after the collapse.

Alone, stranded, and with limited resources at your disposal you'll have to push your way through the zone, solve environmental puzzles, manage resources and fight for your life as you try to find a way to escape beyond the wall.




Play as Mica, an unlicensed black market shipper who will stop at nothing to find her missing partner.

It’s been 12 days since Sasha left.

You talked about it, you argued about it and you even laughed about it. Anybody in their right mind knew going to that place was a death wish, a one-way trip to the end of the line. But Sasha wasn’t one to scare easily, she wanted answers and there was only one place those answers held any truth. Her mind was already made up, you just didn’t expect her to do it without you.

Twelve sleepless nights later and you finally get the call. Tax has found someone, A border security suit looking to make some extra credits on the down-low. He can get you clearance, a two hour window to fly into the zone, find Sasha and get the hell out of there.

You make your way across the exclusion zone but something’s wrong. The nav's running in circles and you're losing altitude. Before you know it a blinding white fills the sky. The dash goes dark and your hover drops out of the air like a lead balloon, slamming into the paved streets below.



You wake to the acrid smell of an electrical fire, rain pounding on the cracked windshield. You're surrounded by the crumbling remains of what were once considered homes.

You need to find a way out. Call for evac, scale the walls. Something. Anything. Survive.

FEATURES:


  • Classic survival horror gameplay inspired by early 2000s horror titles.

  • Cinematic blend of dynamic and fixed camera angles.

  • Logic puzzles, resource management and limited combat with a focus on narrative and exploration.

  • Full voice acting.

  • An emphasis on strong world building set in a dystopian near-future.

  • Carefully paced save points ensure tension is maintained whilst respecting the player's time.

  • Difficulty options to aid players who prefer exploration over combat.

  • Post-game unlocks and features.

2123650.name: Deception
2123650.about_the_game:
Deception: Unveiling the Haunting Secrets

What is Deception?

Deception is not merely a game; it's an immersive dive into the realms of psychological horror, where players embark on a chilling journey through the forsaken corridors of an abandoned apartment, shrouded in mystery and laden with secrets waiting to be unearthed.

Experience the Unseen

Step into the shoes of a daring explorer, navigating the eerie confines of the deserted apartment, where every shadow conceals a sinister truth and every creaking floorboard echoes with the whispers of the past.

Thrills and Chills Await

Prepare yourself for an unparalleled gaming experience, where the line between reality and nightmare blurs, and the fear of the unknown grips your very soul. In Deception, you're not merely a spectator; you're an active participant in a spine-tingling tale of terror and intrigue.

Master the Art of Multitasking

In the heart-pounding gameplay of Deception, players must not only confront their deepest fears but also tackle the challenges of multitasking, as they navigate treacherous obstacles while unraveling the mysteries that lie within.

Dare to Discover

Are you ready to confront your darkest fears and unlock the secrets hidden within the walls of Deception? Prepare yourself for a journey into the unknown, where every step could lead to unimaginable horrors or breathtaking revelations. Enter if you dare...

2123680.name: Tabula Sono
2123680.about_the_game: Tabula Sono is an online, free-to-play 3D virtual tabletop. No ports, servers, or firewalls to manage. Play any grid-based RPGs like DnD, Pathfinder, Lancer, and Monster of the Week with your friends online. Sono is inspired by that in-person tabletop experience — sitting around the table with friends, whiteboard markers, and miniatures.

2123770.name: Distraction Machine
2123770.about_the_game:
ABOUT


Caught in the crossfire of warring cults in the midst of an undead apocalypse, a community of survivors perseveres through the power of music!

Welcome to Island City, a bustling metropolis that’s fallen prey to feeders, undead hordes who feast on the living. Government and its military have been wiped out leaving survivors to fend for themselves. The Children of Arms carve out their territory, mowing down the living and undead alike. The Purified seek to rid the world of feeders and humanity itself through fire. The Marauders wreak havoc, taking what they want and partying ‘til the end of it all. And the Quartier is one of too few fortified communities forced to endure the chaos. But this microcosm is exhausted, depressed, overwhelmingly on the brink of collapse. Its survivors could use a distraction.

You are The Distractor, the Pied Piper of the Undead, and the master of the Distraction Machine, a musical device cobbled together with bike parts & found objects that seems to control feeders. It also has the power to soothe, embolden or manipulate the living. The power and mystery of this machine can only be wielded by You.

Will your music save your people or lead them to ruin?

FEATURES


There are two major ways to play Distraction Machine - the story-driven Chronicle Mode and the open ended Conductor Mode for you to explore.

The apocalypse has destroyed the Old World. Survivors cling to hope, scavenging for supplies, and reclaiming territories full of resources. Each group survives in their own way resulting in turf wars with casualties swelling the feeders’ fetid ranks. Caught in the crossfire of warring cults, a community of survivors perseveres through the power of music. In Chronicle Mode, your choices and the music you create have the power to change people, their relationships to each other and how the community as a whole functions for better… or for worse.

  • Diverse cast of characters with a wide variety of wants, needs, and ambitions
  • 2.5D Animation - A comic book art style allows for the characters to pop out on the screen and contribute to the DIY aesthetic
  • Puzzles - Fulfill musical requests from NPCS in your community and beyond using a set number of instruments, themes, or music box configurations with creative puzzle solutions

In Conductor Mode, endless music creation with no narrative elements, allowing you create and share your music with friends.

  • Loop Library - A collection of music loops from drum beats, melodies and soundscapes you can mix and match give you the power to create complete original music easily
  • Playsheets - Grid assigned to each instrument where loops can be loaded to or individual notes can be placed.
Both modes will allow for sharing music and give you the opportunity to remix songs by your friends!

Other features:
  • A storyline that connects with the world from our Z'Isle comic series
  • Choices within dialog
  • Diverse roster of characters with full backstories to make them multidimensional
  • Unique cyclepunk aesthetic
  • Unlike most music games (that are rhythm based) musical composition is key to gameplay
  • Playable on Windows

Support needs?
Reach out to us on Twitter @Misc_Studios for questions, comments, concerns, or just to join our vibrant community! 😉

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS


  • OS: Windows 10
  • Hard Drive/Storage: 3 Gb of storage

2123800.name: TheTravelGame
2123800.about_the_game:
You are in a mysterious room with little Rita.
There is only one door, and Rita knows what's on the other side.

"I'll give you a hint, try to guess what's behind the door !"
Rita has set up a quiz game for you !
Rita lies only once.
Let's find out and get to the answer.

... but you can ask questions other than quizzes.
Never ask scary questions.
Because something is really going to happen in this place....

=====

A short quiz/horror game that takes only a few minutes to play.
Your questions and actions will change the story.
Multiple endings.
How will you and Rita end up?

The two female owners have their own corresponding endings. The player can decide the route of the endings from the first person perspective through options.

However, although we have known her for nearly nine years, we have hardly communicated with each other, and the atmosphere between them is very awkward.

However, after getting along with Xia Xiaomeng for a period of time, I found that I had an unexpected chat with this quiet girl, and the relationship between the two people gradually became better.

2123850.name: PuckIt Deluxe
2123850.about_the_game:
A mini golf x airhockey game that is totally off the rails.
- Use your paddle to beat your puck through levels to find the gold token and get to the goal slot.
- Find a secret in each level that unlocks a secret cheat
- Complete each achievement to unlock a super secret special level 👀
- Share levels with your friends using the level editor

- Comes with 2x backgrounds with no watermarks as seen from the Lite version
- Awesome soundtrack

There's no randomness, only pure skill.

2123920.name: Defend Your Base
2123920.about_the_game:
Defend your Base! Play this thrilling arcade shooter to survive as long as possible while always racing to red squares as fast as possible to heal them before they turn black and are lost forever.
Play this game if you enjoy limited play-time before you eventually lose. It is impossible to survive forever but with skill and persistence, you can greatly extend your survival time.
Play this game if you enjoy a simplistic action game that runs on every device and that looks retro.
You may enjoy that this game offers no distractions and no phony content, it is all about it's core action.

Gameplay: You navigate your "soldier" square around the board using the ARROW-Keys and get to red "infected" squares as fast as possible. If red squares turn black, they are lost forever. You lose the game once all squares are black.

2123940.name: Sector 666 - The Forgotten Zone
2123940.about_the_game:
Sector 666 - The Forgotten Zone is an open-ended cyberpunk RPG.

Sector 666 wasn’t so bad at one time….
Corporations took interest in the city for its thriving economy.
Soon their interest turned into greed,
they took every opportunity to extort the working class.
The Government was quickly corrupted,
and as a result propaganda is spewed through every outlet.
Everyone’s happiness soon dissolved to nothing.
Will you join the fight and find happiness once again?

Features :

  • Energy : Feeling tired? I bet you are! Get energized with a nice Moon Mist, and maybe enjoy a pizza or a bag of chips! There's dozens of food items that can be bought, and used.
  • Drugs & Alcohol : Remember that bit about finding 'Happiness'? Well some people in Sector 666 prefer to engage in the use of alcohol and narcotics to boost their moods, abilities, and energy. Those same people also might-kinda suffer addiction issues, but hey who are you to judge?
  • Tons of Useable Items : Need a hacking device? Maybe a sledgehammer? Well whatever it is, search the shops and find what you need! There are dozens of useable tools / items current available.
  • Weapons : Going 'Hunting'? Or maybe you just need some personal protection...Well too bad! The corrupt Government has banned all weapons in an effort to suppress the citizens from fighting back. Don't get it twisted, criminals still find ways to smuggle weapons in but it'll take some searching. There's a few weapons currently available to purchase / find.
  • Legal Jobs : Is living the straight & narrow your type of life? Or maybe you're just tired of bashing police drones for their parts. Either-way, check the job listings for work. Some will pay better than others, but you know what they say...."Find a job doing something you love."
  • Illegal Activities : There's numerous ways to break the law, but only so many are profitable! Bash police drones - steal their expensive parts and sell them to the black-market, maybe selling narcotics or illegal items is your vibe. Just watch out, too much attention will surely be bad.
  • Missions : Fight greedy corporations, and avoid the Government at all costs. Find some friends along the way, its always good to have someone watching your back in this city. Talk to people and help them with their own issues, you never know what you'll get in return. Start your pursuit of happiness, find love and fulfillment. Most importantly....SURVIVE

Early-Access & Development :

  • Interested in supporting the game?
  • Want early access to the game?
  • Want a cool role on discord with special access to the development section where you can suggest new features or ideas for the game as it progresses?

Become a supporter today by purchasing the game in Early Access :)

2123990.name: Shift of War
2123990.about_the_game:
As a retired mercenary you decide to set up your own company to take on covert missions commissioned by governments and secret organizations.
Get ready to do all kinds of jobs like eliminating the most wanted terrorists or recovering vital merchandise.
All represented in this top-down shooter game where you can play alone or with up to 4 friends in local multiplayer mode.
Each mission will test your ability to dodge, cover or even orient yourself through maps generated almost procedurally where each game will surprise you.
By successfully completing missions you will get rewards in the form of money in the game, with which you can strengthen your team by hiring better soldiers and equipment.
Also if what you want is just shoot and shoot and keep your position you can go directly to survival mode and you will face hordes of enemies
enemies that will try to leave you at the bottom of the leaderboards.
What are you waiting for to form the best mercenary team and start your shift of war!

2124000.name: Garden Business
2124000.about_the_game: Garden Business is a relaxing farming simulator. In Garden Business you can create your own huge farm. Start the game with just one vegetable garden. Grow produce and sell it to buy more land. Buy pesticides and fertilizers so as not to lose your crops, fight pests that will destroy your products. Build your own house and upgrade it.

2124010.name: Eternal Seas
2124010.about_the_game:
Eternal Seas is an open world pirate RPG inspired by classic pirate games, and is set in a fictional tropical region with islands to explore. Command mighty vessels and lead your crew across the high seas and through lush jungles.

A New World Awaits
Enter the world of Odora, a tropical island region inspired by the Caribbean islands. Despite what the sunny weather suggests, Odora is far from a paradise as the region is currently the centre of a far-reaching and deadly war between the world´s nations. Discover a detailed island region full of secrets and oddities. Visit bustling handcrafted towns and meet its savoury or unsavoury residents. Leave the civilised world behind and tread into ancient and mysterious jungles. While you may find ancient relics and hidden treasures in these untamed lands, you are never truly alone…

Lead
Take on the role of captain in command of your own ship, and find crew members to sail it with. However, keep in mind that your crew bring mouths to feed and pockets to fill. Take good care of your crew and your ship will be unmatched on the waves. Otherwise, you may find a pirate’s loyalty can be a fickle matter.

Rule the Seas
Encounter a wide plethora of ships ranging from small traders vessels to mighty warships. Each ship has its own strengths and weaknesses, and you must carefully choose the ones that suit you best. Take on mighty ships in epic naval battles. Batter their hulls, shred their sails, or decimate their crew. Choose from a variety of lethal melee weapons such as swords, axes and spears and take the fight to a more personal level, or keep enemies at a distance using powerful ranged weapons such as pistols or rifles.

Customise your character
Clothes make the captain in the region of Odora. Choose from different hairstyles and outfits to express yourself while roaming the high seas, and invest in skill points and abilities to suit your playstyle.

2124040.name: Department of the Devil
2124040.about_the_game:
Department of the Devil is a first-person escape room game in which you must escape from The Devil's office and get out of hell. Bureaucratic hell, specifically.



You'll need to explore the office, searching for hidden details and secrets. The Devil also has many locks for all of his important files, which you'll need to access if you want a chance to escape. Solve puzzles, riddles, and other secrets - but make sure to put everything back before The Devil returns!



You'll only have a limited time in his office, so make sure to leave no trace - or he'll take notice, and take countermeasures for the next time you have an appointment with him. Will you be able to sneak past The Devil and escape from hell?

2124050.name: Zaxoid
2124050.about_the_game:
Face an alien onslaught in Zaxoid, an adrenaline inducing, twin-stick mayhem shooter! Defend the galaxy from relentless invaders by upgrading your ship or fortifying your city with strategic choices that make every run unique. Wield dual joysticks for precision chaos, transform into tank mode to repel surface invasions, and protect your population. Intense gameplay that takes you back to the golden years of gaming.

Precision Combat, Pure Adrenaline

Grab your gamepad and lock in for an old-school, twin-stick adrenaline rush. Snap-tight controls, razor-sharp movement, and nonstop enemies combine to recreate the feeling of standing at a neon-lit arcade cabinet. Every encounter becomes a test of timing, twitch reflexes, and pure arcade instincts.

Endless Combinations, Infinite Chaos

Score epic upgrades for your ship and city, crafting a unique build every run. Augment your systems with experimental tech, channel energy through exotic weapons, and reinforce your city’s defenses with an evolving suite of enhancements. Adapt fast or get overwhelmed.

Hold the Line Against the Swarm

Build turrets, cloning facilities, and space programs to protect your population. Strengthen your city one structure at a time, layering automated defenses and powerful upgrades to withstand relentless enemy assaults.

Conquer the Stars, Hold Your Ground

Take on missions that shift between intense space dogfights and heavy ground combat. Pilot your strike ship in orbit, then roll out in a fortified tank for planet-side warfare. Each mission tests a different skillset as you battle across both fronts.

2124070.name: No:Worse
2124070.about_the_game:
Our upcoming VNs:





Natsu Kashigaru learned at a young age that justice is often elusive.

He is about to graduate from Tokyo University of the Arts, but he has no job prospects or solid plans for his future. Natsu has no idea what to do now, but despite that, he longs to pursue his passion for art, but his insufficient funds prevent him from doing so.

Fortunately, he has four wonderful girlfriends who support him in his endeavors. But also, Natsu can't let them live in poverty. Suddenly, life offers him an opportunity to turn his situation around. His alma mater, Tokyo University of Arts, is hosting two alumni art competitions, which could be the chance he needs to make a name for himself.

"No:Worse" is a beautiful love story unfolding between two vulnerable individuals with kind but fragile hearts. Throughout it, you will encounter moments of despair, heartbreak, and deceit. And conquering these flaws lies entirely in your hands.

The game takes around four to five hours to complete with over six endings. The characters are brought to life with animated sprites and CGs, featuring lip-sync, breathing, chest physics, and a vast range of emotions.

2124100.name: Transience
2124100.about_the_game:
In Transience, you become the hunter - an Accountant. Armed with the latest weaponry and tech, your job is to keep the books balanced... By any means necessary. Only this time, you are the intended target.

Single-Player Campaign

A story told through the lens of Eli Reed, an accountant-for-hire who ends up on the wrong side of the gun. Redlisted and on the run, you must uncover the mystery of who placed the bounty and why. Utilize near-future weaponry to take out your enemies as you take steps to clear your name.

Heavily inspired by gritty narratives we played growing up, the story unfolds in a way that keeps you at the edge of your seat. 9 missions spread out over 9 incredible hand-crafted environments, telling the story of one mans journey out of Transience.

Fully Voiced Dialogue
Combat and Stealth Gadgets
Multi-Approach Maps

Tactical Stealth Action

Inspired by many tactical games from back in the day, we aimed to combine the maneuverability and fluidity of a Third Person Stealth game, with the slower pacing of a First Person Shooter. Become the spectre in the walls, the shadow picking off survivors one by one. Sometimes staying out of sight is only one way to complete the objective. Sometimes a more active and aggressive hand is required. Transience offers the player a ton of ways to approach objectives, from Stalking in the shadows, Running and Gunning down corridors or a blend of both. Utilize an arsenal of customizable weaponry to make your enemies fear your presence. You are the accountant.

Deep Weapon Customization

Powered by NWS™ (New World Systems) this industry-wide standard has allowed weapons manufacturers to interchange attachments and core parts at will. Take an SMG and turn it into an Assault Rifle or take an Assault Rifle and modify it into a DMR. Throughout the story, you will find attachments and weapons via stashes found around the environments that allow you to build and customize weapons on the fly. With 13 base weapons to discover throughout the campaign, NWS™ makes your survival odds that much easier.

A Whole New World

Take on the city of New Houston in the year 2056. Peace has been torn apart by a sudden conflict overseas, resulting in war-time prosperity. Government contracts are king, and advancement at any cost for the war effort drives industry in America. Corporations have gained so much influence from the new status quo that they have become the de facto law of the land. Currency is shifting towards digital under the government’s nose, funded by the innovative new technologies in their most dangerous forms being researched and shipped out to the war. Propaganda insists that the scraps of progress trickle down to the citizens, a half-truth. Access the advanced technology of corporate influence, from shrinking forms of medical tech to quieter suppressors and magnetic subway lines, the city is full of gadgets to use and weaknesses to exploit.

NNCG "Eclipse" Suit

Developed by NOVASKIN™ - This Nitro-capsule Gilded Undersuit was initially built for the war efforts overseas. The suit provided the wearer with solid kevlar-superior protection for quick engagements, featuring lightweight armor panels attached to a thin form-fitting undersuit. Powered by N-caps, this low-energy-consumption equipment is one of several premier front-line suit designs in existence today, always outperforming its competition by a country mile. The secret is in the underlying layer of specially developed Non-Newtonian Colloid that temporarily provides the wearer with reactive armor. Hardly anything can pierce this extremely effective protection whilst it's active. This suit will also give you access to a number of gadgets to help you along your journey: from a distraction tool, to a Flash Pulse for blinding enemies. And, of course, Night Vision.

2124110.name: Vortix
2124110.about_the_game:
What do you get when you combine marbles with a battle royale ring and PvP? VORTIX!

VORTIX is an online competitive game where the objective is to knock your opponent or opponents out of the shrinking ring!

Community Feedback

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join us on Discord or Steam Discussions and let us know what you think.

2124120.name: SULFUR
2124120.about_the_game:
Plan ahead, outsmart enemies and progress a world of dark creatures and cunning evil. Utilize playful and tactile weaponry in visceral and intense combat. Create unique builds by combining weapons, gear, tools, and enchantments to suit your playstyle. Whether you’re a gun-blazing risk-taker or a careful strategist, the choice is yours. Adapt your approach, experiment, and survive the dangers of Sulfur.

Enter a world packed with relentless action, powerful firearms, and dynamic FPS combat, where unpredictable enemies lurk in every shadow. Arm yourself with an array of weapons that can be modified and enchanted with a vast range of attachments and effects.

As you explore, uncover hidden secrets, collect valuable loot, and discover rare treasures – but tread carefully. Every decision counts: the gear you bring may be lost if you fail, and the equipment you leave behind won't be there when you need it most. Risk and reward are tightly intertwined in every choice you make.

Experience the atmosphere, suspense and tribulation of a world in redemption. What happened? And why? Travel through eerie caverns, sordid Black Guild shanties, putrid sewers and pass through castle walls and beyond. Go deeper, head on. Answers come to those who listen.

Explore, discover, uncover. On your adventure you encounter strange creatures in unexpected places—pay attention to their warnings. Whether they despise, admire, or ignore you, your path is yours to forge. Stay alert; these encounters may offer insights, but ultimately, it’s up to you to push forward and find the answers you seek.

A bloodstained white collar

Dirt on your shoes

Your shoulders are aching

Is this but a ruse?

A coven is suspect

A church is aflame

Who is the culprit?

Who is to blame?

Ocean screaming,

Twisting turning

Mouth is dry,

Eyes are burning

But you must tread on,

There is no remorse

Brush the saltwater film

off your Palehorse™

2124150.name: Skirmish Mayhem
2124150.about_the_game:
Skirmish Mayhem is an action strategy game where you upgrade your arsenal, construct a base and build an army to defend against waves of enemies. Unlock more maps, commanders, weapons, units and buildings as you conquer the galaxy.

Battle as the bio-science obsessed Virid, Conquer as the holy order of Sanctul or sew chaos as the demonic legion of Matulis. Each faction comes with their own unique commanders, units, buildings, weapons and passives with focuses on different playstyles.

Destroy your many enemies alone or fight alongside your own forces. Defend not only yourself, but your buildings so you can gain the advantage on the unrelenting waves of enemies.

Equip your commander with a multitude of weapons such as snipers, shotguns, lasers, shields and grow stronger over the course of a battle. Then outside of the battlefield upgrade a faction's tech tree increasing the stats of that faction and unlocking stronger weapons, buildings and units.

Along with the unique enemy units on each level requiring different strategies to defeat, each world has multiple bosses for you to conquer; these range from giant alien mutants to enormous machines.

As you play you unlock new maps to fight on, new weapons, passives, commanders and new difficulties.

2124200.name: Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Chapter IV: "Sacred Feathers"
2124200.about_the_game:
Welcome back to court in the world where all anime genres exist at once in NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, CHAPTER IV: SACRED FEATHERS, the hotly anticipated follow-up to NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, SEASON ONE and next chapter in the NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE story!

Step into Nina Aquila's shoes once again in a thrilling mix of Visual Novel and Adventure game, and continue the fight for justice in a world where all anime genres exist at once!

  • Play a part in an exciting mystery story told over 6+ hours

  • Investigate crime scenes & interrogate witnesses from a top-down perspective

  • Defend your client in court with evidence & cross-examination

  • Become the Valkyrie! Transform & fight off enemies in scrolling fighting game sections

  • Customise your experience with accessibility; reduce visual intensity, turn off minigame difficulty and more!

  • Sleuth out a plot that celebrates the Magical Girl anime genre

Experience Nina Aquila's greatest adventure yet!

It’s been several months since Nina defended the Rostro Racers in court, and Fledge City residents eagerly anticipate the next season of the home-grown streaming show hit: the magical girl sensation, Valkyrie: Sacred Feathers!

But when an on-set lover’s tiff takes a dark turn, Nina Aquila is tasked with defending Millia Nordin, the lead actress, in a murder case that defies explanation, even by the defendant herself.

North of the city, dissent grows as the Bikers of the Wastes are vanishing without a trace. Seeking answers, a lone rider saddles up for the long journey south, seeking the one man who she knows can help her.

With Millia in custody, tension on the streets of Fledge City rises as each night brings with it unnatural, unexplainable events; disappearances, explosions, tales of monsters sighted in dark alleyways. Set on a journey where present fiction echoes the truth of the past, can Nina find the strength buried within herself to search for answers, and rise as the hero that Fledge City needs?

Lore meets the law for a war-between-worlds, with Fledge City’s courtroom as the fulcrum about which fate will turn!

Feathers will fly, wings unfurl, and light will shine amid the darkness… But before that, there’s gonna be magic, monsters and a whole load of sparkles.

Valkyrie… Transform!

  • Hybrid VN/Graphic Adventure gameplay with 6+ hours of story-driven content

  • Pacing, presentation & tone that celebrates the Magical Girl anime genre

  • Defend your client in court by cross-examining witnesses

  • Investigate crime scenes and search for clues

  • Explore Fledge City's Mode7-style overworld

  • Fight off enemies in 16-bit-style scrolling fighting-game sections

  • Accessibility features, including options to reduce effects for photosensitive users, and an "always-win" option for minigames to facilitate casual play

Now, step into court once again as Nina Aquila, and defend your clients in a world where all anime genres exist at once!

2124210.name: Orebody: Binder's Tale
2124210.about_the_game:
Orebody: Binder’s Tale is a run and gun shooter that takes place on the alien world of Orebody. Built using the constraints of classic 8-bit games, Binder’s Tale provides an authentic old school experience for young and old players alike. As an orphaned battle bot named Binder, players run, jump, and blast their way across Orebody in order to reach the Floating City of Galvanstad, a hovering A.I. fortress, to confront their makers and avenge the death of their mentor.

But that’s not all! The Steam version of Binder’s Tale contains a bonus 8-bit game experience, Orebody: Sand Ripples. In this short box-pushing puzzle game, players control a sand squid that is trying to save the Great Sand Sea Solorus from the destructive mining practices of the SolarSeed corporation.

With the Steam version of Binder’s Tale, you get it all! Play through the game’s campaign in Novice or Advanced difficulty modes. Try to beat every one of the game’s bosses in a row using only three lives in Boss Rush mode, or simply sit back and jam out to the game’s soundtrack in Jukebox mode.



This special release of Orebody: Binder's Tale will have additional extras such as achievements, rumble support, concept art, the official soundtrack, a high-quality in-game scan of the manual, and much more in the game to view!



Orebody: Binder’s Tale is part of the larger Orebody transmedia narrative universe. On the planet of Orebody, life is a struggle, alien factions quarrel, and power comes from deep in the ground.



  • Fast-paced run and gun gameplay!
  • Expand your move set as you progress!
  • Traverse unique alien environments, from burning forests to city slums to floating robot fortresses!
  • Wield multiple weapon types!
  • Battle 15 vicious bosses!
  • Uncover the secrets of Galvanstad!

2124300.name: Shopping Spree: Extreme!!!
2124300.about_the_game:
Shopping Spree: Extreme!!! is made for casual gamers looking to have a good laugh (solo or with up to three friends!). Make your way around the shopping center to collect items on your randomly-generated shopping list. But be extremely careful; one slip up and you'll be paying for a broken item! Avoid absurdly grumpy shoppers or simply shove them out of the way! Various other obstacles get in your way as you carefully fill your cart and make it to checkout without amassing a huge amount of debt!


(Up to 4 players)

PvP Mode

Grab as many items as you can from your list and make it to checkout before other players! You can checkout at any time, but players with more items will score more than players who checkout early!



Shove other players and NPCs! Make sure you don't push them into items though! You will have to pick up the bill!

Co-op Mode

Work together to fill your group cart with all the items on your extra large shopping list. Each player has their own budget, and players that go over their budget will get knocked out!


Bring other players back by stealing money from nearby NPCs and make it to checkout together!

Key Features


Carefully maneuver your arms to grab items on your list and add them to your cart.


Push your cart around the store as you collect items.


Shove employees and other shoppers!


If you manage to completely fill your cart with the items on your list and make it to checkout while maintaining enough money to pay for your cart, you win!!!

  • Operate a massive arsenal of 30+ weapons.

  • Master every weapon's primary and alt fire.

  • Create your own flow with an array of weapons, skills and artifacts.

  • Speedrun through Lush Jungles, Ancient Temples, Neon Cityscapes and bonus Secret Levels.

2124380.name: Super Lesbian Animal RPG
2124380.about_the_game:
Melody Amaranth recently came to two important realizations about herself. One: she's deeply in love with her best friend, Allison. (The feeling was mutual.) And two: if Allison has her heart set on being an adventurer, then maybe Melody can join her. As a healer.

It all seemed perfect. And then things got weird.



Super Lesbian Animal RPG is a game about love, anxiety, and fighting funny looking monsters in dungeons. It follows the stories of Melody, her girlfriend Allison, and their friends Claire, a rule-bending witch, and Jodie, a dependable knight. Over the course of their journey, our inexperienced heroes will meddle with forces beyond their control and find themselves responsible for the fate of their hometown. They'll also fight some spherical frogs, travel to a forgotten land in the sky, befriend a robot or two, and piss off the local librarian. But that should go without saying.

FEATURES:


  • A 16-bit-ish RPG inspired by classics like Final Fantasy, Mother, and Paper Mario, with modern sensibilities! (ie: no grinding required, no random encounters)
  • Explore the Sapphire Islands, meet their colorful inhabitants, take on story-driven sidequests, and uncover secrets big and small
  • Tackle four main dungeons filled with treasure, monsters, and drama
  • Learn more about the blossoming romance between our protagonists, Melody and Allison
  • Freely customize your party with Spellbooks that teach them a wide range of new abilities
  • Enjoy a killer original soundtrack by composer Beatrix Quinn with over 80 tracks
  • An easy mode that can be enabled at any time for players more interested in the story than the combat
  • There's a unicorn!!! Wow!!!!!
  • You can make them kiss
  • Playthrough length estimate: roughly 20 hours

(SLARPG contains mild suggestive humor, PG-13 swearing, alcohol and tobacco use, mild fantasy violence, some emotionally intense scenes, depictions of anxiety, a few secondhand mentions of transphobia, sequences of unreality, and may cause eye strain issues in some parts due to highly saturated colors.)

2124390.name: Flagi
2124390.about_the_game: A capture the flag style game where you fight other players in multiple unique, fun maps. As you fight your way through the enemy team you unlock cosmetics and new weapons to fit your playstyle. You kill enemies in a multiplayer match where you can grab flags from their base back to yours. As you run across the unique maps you can use the gun of your choice to fight your way to the other side.

2124420.name: Fate Seeker: Journey
2124420.about_the_game:
Fate Seeker: Journey is an action role-playing game that combines random elements of Roguelite. You will be the hero Zhuge Yu who falls into unconsciousness in one accident. After waking up, you find yourself in a mysterious place and though the guidance of mysterious power gradually retrieve the lost past memories. By passing the stages, you will continue to collect talents, obtain items, combine skills, form different kinds of martial arts, experience different level routes and battle rhythms, and finally defeat powerful enemies, retrieve memories and embark on the journey of return.




A mysterious power guides you forward. Before entering each level, you must face an unknown choice: should you choose to retrieve the fragments of his memory? Or choose to strengthen abilities and defeat the enemy? And every time you enter a level and end the battle, the talent you choose and the item you collect will help you to finally defeat the powerful enemy and retrieve the lost memory.




When fighting against different enemies, you need to master the timing of moves and dodges and cooperate with the random moves and talents obtained to win the battle. It is worth mentioning that in addition to improving combat capabilities, some specific talents can also add dazzling effects to weapons and equipment such as swords and spears, bringing strong visual effects and a refreshing combat experience!




Though surmounting numerous difficulties, you, as Zhuge Yu, go through layers of trials and finally defeat the powerful enemy. In the process of constant battle, the memory of the past is gradually recovered, but what follows is the unpredictable and heavy truth, you can only go forward bravely, and embark on a journey to turn the world again and again...

Follow us here

2124440.name: SIC-1
2124440.about_the_game:
SIC-1 is a programming game where the computer only understands a single instruction.

  • Learn an esoteric assembly language.
  • Implement programs to unlock more impressive job titles.
  • Optimize your programs to climb the leaderboards.
  • Sacrifice your personal life for the good of the company!

It's an assembly language zachlike for everyone! New programmers will appreciate how few unique instructions there are to learn (just one!), and experienced programmers will appreciate how poorly suited this one instruction is for writing straight-forward programs.

If you're ready for a challenge, respond to this job posting from SIC Systems:

SIC Systems is hiring engineers to produce highly efficient programs for our flagship product: the Single Instruction Computer Mark 1 (SIC-1).

The SIC-1 represents a transformational change in computing, reducing complexity to the point that the processor only executes a single instruction: subtract and branch if less than or equal to zero ("subleq").

Enter the brave new world of single-instruction computing and invent new ways of implementing programs that would be trivial on a conventional computer. Don't adjust the technology to match how you think, adjust your thinking to match how the SIC-1 operates!

2124460.name: Asteroids and more asteroids
2124460.about_the_game:
In a game inspired by the classic "Asteroids", you'll play with a small spaceship in order to score more points and beat all records!!

Asteroids and... more asteroids, this game is a mix of "Asteroids" and rhythm, match colors to the same colors and avoid the different ones.

-Online ranking to prove to your friend that you are better than him!
-CO-OP for two players, each one controlling a color.
-There are asteroids, many of them...

2124480.name: Respark
2124480.about_the_game:
A New Kind of Fireworks Action Game Arrives with a Bang

Handheld sparklers, poppers, firecrackers, bottle rockets, and even skyrockets—
Respark arms you with eccentric weapons known as Hanabi (fireworks) to take on 2D platformer courses in a way you’ve never seen before.

Roguelite System for Endless Replayability

Respark adopts the modern roguelite framework, ensuring that each run feels fresh. Procedurally generated terrain, enemies, and items change every time, keeping the challenge dynamic. (Certain structural elements such as course connections and difficulty tiers remain fixed.)

Will you boost your health?
Expand your collection of Hanabi?
Or take on tougher foes to level up your fireworks?

The progression path is entirely up to you.

And yes, Respark embraces the roguelite essence of permadeath. When your health hits zero, all stats reset and you’re sent back to base. (It’s called “permadeath,” but your character doesn’t actually die—only your progress resets.) It’s a demanding system—but there’s a twist.

The Bow-Down Training System

Lose to a boss? In Respark, you can bow down before them—literally. Do so, and you’ll unlock unlimited-health practice sessions against that boss.

This isn’t a continue; after practice you return to base. But the combat experience you gain is yours to keep, every time. Failures become training, and training becomes progress.

A boss familiar with roguelite hardships might just grant your request…

Animaria

The setting is Animaria, a civilization reclaimed by animals. It's a world full of talking animals.

You'll control Hanaby and Fusey, two squirrel pyrotechnicians. Their abilities are identical, but choosing between them adds a subtle personal touch.

Roguelite × AAAA Music = Synergy

Roguelites often lean toward darker atmospheres due to permadeath and punishing mechanics. Respark counters this with bright visuals, a lighthearted story, and a full soundtrack by pop composer AAAA. The synergy creates a play experience that feels distinctively upbeat, even within the roguelite genre.

Demo Version

Respark offers a special demo. Out of the eight worlds in the full release, Worlds 1, 4, and 7 are playable. That means you can push well into mid-game content and even challenge the World 7 boss.

Story progression, suspend/resume, and permanent stat saves are not included, but the demo still provides substantial gameplay. Aim for the World 7 boss and see what Respark has to offer.

2124490.name: SILENT HILL 2
2124490.about_the_game:
Having received a letter from his deceased wife,

James heads to where they shared so many memories,

in the hope of seeing her one more time: Silent Hill.

There, by the lake, he finds a woman eerily similar to her...

"My name… is Maria," the woman smiles. Her face, her voice... She's just like her.

Experience a master-class in psychological horror―lauded as the best in the series―on the latest hardware with chilling visuals and visceral sounds.

High-end Graphics and Sound

With ray tracing and other cutting-edge technical enhancements, the world of SILENT HILL and its unsettling ambiance is even realer than before.

And with the inclusion of new, immersive soundscapes, you'll feel like you're standing in the thick of it.

Larger Environments

Explore locations and buildings that were once inaccessible, or are newly added in the remake.

Enjoy the same acclaimed story, even while you experience the town of Silent Hill with fresh eyes across an expanded map.

Over-the-shoulder Camera

The remake moves from the original's fixed-camera viewpoints to an over-the-shoulder perspective, putting you closer to what James sees, for a more thrilling, more immersive experience as you explore the town and come face-to-face with monsters.

Evolved Combat Gameplay

Familiar weapons like the steel pipe and handgun make their return, but now with an updated combat system.

Avoid attacks with carefully timed dodges, aim down sights, and more, making monster encounters more engaging and nerve-wracking than ever.

2124500.name: Forlorn Memories
2124500.about_the_game:
Forlorn Memories is a story-driven, old-school inspired 3D steampunk fantasy RPG with monster catching and life/dating sim elements, where your choices shape the world and its inhabitants. Some consequences are immediate, others only reveal themselves as your journey unfolds, leading to different endings.

What you do with the life you’ve been given is up to you. You can chase your lost memories no matter the cost, or choose a cozier path, finding love, friendship, and letting the world move on. No choice is the wrong one.

“Memories are fleeting - what are you willing to sacrifice to remember?” 

  Will you play as Gavin or Aria?  

Strangely, both carry the same emptiness within them: missing memories, and for some time now, they’ve been trying to recover their past lives and uncover the truth behind it. 

Neither protagonist is a silent character. Gavin and Aria have their own voices, react to events, and actively comment on what’s happening around them. Each has a distinct personality and backstory, yet you can rename and fully customize them so the character still feels like your own. And the protagonist you don’t choose doesn’t disappear, they remain part of the world, and may even cross paths with you later… or join your journey.

Forlorn Memories features a cast of playable characters — potential party members who can optionally join you if your goals align, you earn their trust, or you convince them in your own way.

Along the journey, you’ll also meet a variety of non-playable characters. Every character has their own backstory, personality, goals, dreams, class, hobbies, and daily routine.

  

Once someone joins your party, you can switch between party members at any time and take direct control of them. Whether you turn these characters into allies, friends, partners, or even enemies (or choose to avoid them entirely) is up to you!

Forlorn Memories uses two different graphic styles, the anime-inspired Chibi style (SD) used for the exploration part and a more detailed, non-chibi-style graphic style for the game's battle scenarios and story sequences designed by talents such as Yoshitomo Ikawa (Mistwalker).

When words fall flat and conflict escalates into combat, experience an accessible yet deep combat system where you identify and exploit your foes’ weaknesses.

Key Features:

  • Elementtypes with clear strengths and weaknesses.

  • Weakpoint targeting: aim at specific limbs to disarm foes and restrict their moveset and ability pool.

  • Up to 3 active party members.

  • Swap party members anytime, overworld and mid-battle.

  • Character-specific Ultimate skills.

  • Mounted combat (horseback).

  • Summon captured monsters (Beasts of Yhag & Spirits) during battle.

Detailed interactions and relationships between playable characters and NPCs. This can even optionally lead to friendships, romantic relationships, marriages and other peaceful couple activities.

Step into Legica, a vast, sprawling world filled with forgotten history and hidden truths. Every region holds unique lands, factions, and cultures shaped by conflict and ambition. Explore its wild frontiers, fight in its wars, or carve out a quiet life of your own as you run, dash, swim, dive, grind on rails, set sail, fly, drive, and ride across an expansive fantasy realm teeming with captivating events and stories.

Legica doesn’t just threaten you with its inhabitants. Blizzards, heatwaves, and hostile terrain demand careful planning, so bring the right clothing and equipment and choose your route wisely to overcome environmental hazards.

Venture into forgotten depths where ancient ruins hide secrets, treasure, and horrors best left undisturbed.

Legica is shaped by rival factions, each driven by its own traditions and agendas. Forge alliances, keep your distance, or stand against them. Your choice defines your journey.

Your choices have consequences. Some are immediate, others only reveal themselves later in your journey. They can even shift the balance between factions, for example if you trade too much with one group and help them gain more resources and better equipment.

In extreme cases, your actions can go so far that even former companions may end up standing in your way.

Mix potions and medicines, dig for buried treasure, craft armour, clothing and weapons, catch bugs, mine ores, go fishing, cook various foods and create and repair your own automata. How you achieve your goals is up to you.

Give abandoned pets a new home. Adopt pets like cats, dogs, horses and more. (Yes, you can pet them and name them!)

Grow different types of plants. Gift them to NPCs, sell them, use them as a crafting ingredient or use some of them in battle. Or you can grow tiny sprout spirit creatures that can help you on your journey and evolve over time to learn new skills.

The world of Legica is haunted by a phenomenon known simply as the Yhag Curse. It slowly but steadily transforms any living being that spends too long near the so-called Beasts of Yhag. The first signs are faint, glyph-like markings spreading across the body, followed by changes to skin, eyes, and hair. Over time, the curse causes severe physical and mental distortion, until very little of the victim’s former self remains.

Rumors speak of rare individuals who resisted the curse, and who were even able to tame these beasts. They now seek to uncover the origin of the creatures, and the truth behind the curse.

Conquer the skies with your own airship and destroy enemies with your mech in the game's fully optional Shoot 'em up and Top-down Shooter sections.

Starring Caitlin Glass, Alan Lee, Xanthe Huynh, Lindsey Vega, Deneen Melody, A.J. Beckles, Kristen McGuire, June Yoon, Vanille Velasquez, Anairis Quinones, Chris Okawa, Sarah Anne Williams and many more.

Original soundtrack composed by Alec Shea, Bryan Valenzuela, Morgan Cosseron, Jeremiah George, Raúl Sangonzalo, Dale North and more with vocals performed by Emi Evans (NieR, Terra Battle, Dark Souls) and Nami Nakagawa (NieR, Demon Slayer, Drakengard 3).

Please keep in mind that the game is still in development and the footage shown is not final.

2124910.name: Runeseeker
2124910.about_the_game:
Runeseeker is an adventure RPG in the tradition of text adventures and story-heavy RPGs, with a small influence of retro Japanese RPGs.


At a Glance:
* Unique, retro-inspired gameplay
* A story where there is no chosen one and your choices do make a difference
* Adventure RPG where you can create your own character
* 17 party members who you can add to your party, featuring 2 secret characters
* Elements of rogue-lites and tactics-based RPGs, such as permadeath.
* A battle system where party synergy is important
* Beautiful and whimsical art
* Wonderful and catchy music
* A post-game featuring a unique dungeon
* Conversation system - talk to people in the tavern to learn the world around you
* 28 classes, each with their own unique style of gameplay and mechanisms. No two classes are completely alike.
* 101 traits
* Be able to switch your party member's classes and traits
* Customizeable difficulty - turn off permadeath, make enemies brutally hard, etc.
* Easy to play - requires no intense reflexes

Story:
In the world of Europa, six empires rule the world. The leaders of each empire climbed up the completed Tower of Babel, and drank from the waters of the Oasis, transforming these men and women into godlike beings. The empires are ruthless, always at war with each other and oppressing their people.

When you were young, your mother read you bedtime tales about mythical runes that were vital for the balance of the world and its elements, and gave their owner unbelievable power to change the world. It was heresy at the time, but your mother wanted to give you hope in such a broken world. Yours was a happy childhood, until your hometown was invaded by Gaulian troops. You were sent into the basement while your mother and father tried to defend their house, costing them their lives. You eventually ended up in the town of Kastelgrad, a city in the Neutral States, that are self-managed by mercenaries and adventurers, trying to make ends meet.

On the sunset of your 18th birthday, you have the opportunity to become an adventurer in your own right, and you decide to see if this heresy you grew up with is true or not.

Setting:
Runeseeker takes place in Europa, an alternate history version of Europe, Western Asia, Northern Africa and the Middle East, where the Tower of Babel was completed an old empires from the old age never died, with some fantasy elements.

Gameplay:
Runeseeker is a dungeon crawler akin to older text adventure games, as well as the more modern Etrian Odyseey and Persona Q games. Using a style more akin to a board game, you travel across the dungeon, getting into battles, solving events, getting items, hearing exposition, and collecting items.

Battles are akin to the Dragon Quest game with a unique twist - the actions that you and your party can take are given to you each turn in a hand of cards. Deck Management is an important part of the game.

You and your party members can be one of 28 classes. Each classes have their own passives and actions, which are given through level ups. Each character has one trait. You can create your character, choose a starting class, as well as any of 101 traits.

You will get items, equipment and special items called relics which you can equip that will give you more actions during battle, can change your stats, or can completely change the game in some cases.

  • Battle spirits in boss fights
  • Secret retro themed levels
  • Many secrets to find
  • Handcrafted levels for you to perfect
