2129130.name: Unprompted
2129130.about_the_game:
Unprompted has unintentionally become a time capsule— a record of an earlier moment in our relationship with AI, when its limitations were easier to see, and its outputs felt more alien. Today, it offers a small window back to that moment— a reminder of how this technology once appeared to us.

What is Unprompted? Each carefully curated artwork was created from a hidden prompt. Your task is to uncover it — and, along the way, encounter how the algorithm interprets its own creative process.

MoTU welcomes all to join in the journey of machine learning.

MoTU engages all visitors through a gamified art experience.

MoTU builds inclusive spaces for all humans to encounter the machine mind.

The experience of MoTU is guided by four core principles:

Gazing carefully at each artwork, you begin to notice familiar elements. Take a bold guess and type the words into the text box. Press enter to check for correct matches and earn points for each correct word. Don’t worry, guess as many times as you like. Any artworks you choose to skip for now will be shown again later.

If unsure what you’re seeing, spend 10 points to reveal one word of the prompt.

The progress you’ve made completing prompts will allow you to access certain gifts from the gift shop, where artworks are brought to life across a wide range of products. Don’t miss out!

Completing the prompt for certain artworks will trigger A.I.-generated text descriptions of that artwork, allowing you the opportunity for an extra level down the rabbit-hole of machine-learning associations. More broad A.I.-generated statements on the future role of A.I. in art and society will also be found at the start of each gallery visit, slowly building a background narrative, subtly reframing what you are seeing as you progress.

About the Game

Unprompted was created in early 2022, at a time when generative AI was new and visibly strange. In the years since, AI-generated images have become far more polished— and far more controversial. This game is not an attempt to replace artists or shortcut creative labor. It was an experiment in designing a game around machine-made content: asking what kinds of play, reflection, and curiosity emerge when the machine's role is highlighted rather than hidden.

Unprompted was created by Matt Eshleman. The idea was born during the Shanghai COVID lockdown of spring 2022, when he was confined to his apartment for two months, making experimental games. During this time, Matt learned to both deeply fear and cautiously embrace the coming AI.

Unprompted is neither wholly human-made, nor wholly machine-generated. As such, the designer takes sole responsibility for the content of this game. Images were generated with Craiyon. Some texts were generated in part with ChatGPT and GPT-3, OpenAI's large-scale language generation models. Generated draft language was subsequently reviewed and edited to the developer's liking.

2129280.about_the_game:
Jyakou no Lyla ～Allure of MUSK～ Europe Night INTRODUCTION
Jyakou no Lyla ～Allure of MUSK～ Europe Night are romance role-playing visual novels made in Japan.

The player will interact with the client and target of the spy mission as Celine, the dancing princess. The client, Roran, is a prince of a fallen kingdom, introverted and unaware of the world, but with a certain instinct to please women. He has an instinctive dependence on Celine to help him find his missing sister. The target of the mission is Vince, the first prince of Lugan, who is known for his ruthlessness and unscrupulousness. On the morning after the start of the World Summit of the Next Generation, Vince is tired from last night's drunkenness, but he soon notices the presence of a strange woman in his room. To make matters worse, Vince's pride in his self-control is gone and he feels an irresistible desire eating away at his sanity...

In the game, the player can control the course of the plot through different options. There are 2 characters route and a total of more than 5 endings including the double agent route. This game supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese.

Jyakou no Lyla ～Allure of MUSK～ Europe Night STORY
In the land of hot sand, Shanasa, there is a cabaret club called Kamal. Kamal's chief dancer, the dancing princess Celine, has another identity - that of a spy.

It was July when the Kingdom of Shanasa held the World Summit of the Next Generation. At this time that the dancing princess receives an unexpected commission: Sneaking around Prince Vince as a trophy to find the client's sister who was taken away from him.

This night, the seductive musk is wafting through the palace of the Kingdom of Shanasa--

After receiving a commission from Roran Clydele, you have been working to find out where Pamela has been taken, and you've been able to infiltrate Vince Lurgan, the First Prince of Lurgan.
As Celine's investigation progresses, she discovers that the target, Prince Vince, seems to deviate from description of the client.Where is the sister that the fragile prince, Roran Clydeel, has been longing for?
Will Celine be able to complete this mission and successfully uncover the truth behind the lies?

Gameplay & Plot Progression
①When you enter the game, you will first enter the naming session. As a visual novel, the game has lively plot and full of characters. As the player reads further, a charming story with an exotic atmosphere will slowly unfold.
②The story consists of four parts: Common Route, Vince Route, Roran Route and Double Agent Route.
In Common Route, the six male protagonists, two of whom's stoy are available to read for the first night of the game.
At the end of Common Route, the system will calculate the goodness level of the two main characters and will determine whether to enter the Vince Route or the Roran Route based on their goodness level. When the level of affection reaches a certain level, the heroine will have a happy ending with the hero. On the other hand, when the level of affection is too low, the story will have a bad end.
③Once the happy endings of both characters have been achieved, the initial part of the Roran Route will branch off and depending on the choice, the Double Agent Route will open, where the player will be able to fall in love with both characters at the same time.


Jyakou no Lyla ～Allure of MUSK～ Europe Night CHARACTORS

Celine
21 year old dancer of the Club Kamal.
After being caught up in a tragic incident with her best friend, she was helped by the manager of the shop and has been living in Kamal ever since.
She spies for the shopkeeper in order to collect medicine for his illness.
Being indoctrinated by the shopkeeper that a man's feelings are not ""love"" but ""mere lust"", she is internally determined and able to keep a safe distance from the targets of his spy missions.

Vince Lugan
First Prince of the Kingdom of Lugan, aged 25.
As a militaristic state, the Kingdom of Lugan has been opening up its borders in recent years. Thanks to a type of bee that lives only in the region, the country has seen a boom in beekeeping, which has greatly boosted the country's economy.
He has a cruel side and sees women only as political tools, but he is also a strategic leader who benefits from excellent judgment. He is careful and trusts only what he sees and hears with his own eyes and ears, and therefore keeps his word when dealing with people he trusts, no matter how small the thing is.

Roran Clydele
Third Prince of the Kingdom of Clydele, the kingdom of the Empress, which was destroyed by the Kingdom of Lugan, aged 22.
The kingdom of Clydele is ruled by women, and the men are raised like birds in a cage in a city-state where the Quercus flower is in full bloom.
He is introverted and shy, unaware of the world, but with certain aspects of survival skills when dealing with women.
After the invasion of Clydele, the royal family was slaughtered and his cherished sister taken away, only he was lucky enough to be saved.

Lin Korei
Crown Prince of the Scaled Empire, 27 years old and first in line for the throne. According to legend, the royal lineage of the Lin Empire is made up of the legendary creature Rei Lin.
He has a calm personality and is a good listener to people of all identities. He believes in the theory of the goodness of nature and never doubts anyone. He has five half-siblings, with whom he is very close.
The empress intended for him to marry a woman of good standing, but he always refuse. He was obsessed with the story of the White Snake, a tale of interracial love, and he wished to marry the White Snake, the main character in the story.

Lin Kirei
The prince of the Lin Empire, aged 25. Second in line to the throne and the half-brother Lin Korei.
He believes that his elder brother is stupid and useless, and that he is more suitable to succeed the throne.
The royal family has a laissez-faire approach to his upbringing and as a result, he is somewhat frivolous in his approach to things. He is fond of women and will take advantage of them even if they are his brother's fiancée in waiting.

Lazar Shanasa
The young king of the kingdom of Shanasa, aged 30.
Lazar, who has always lived quietly in his palace, suddenly became a different person seven years ago and became an outstanding king.
He is decisive and able to make quick decisions without hesitation,having ability to see things from many angles and to consider all possibilities.
He is also a charismatic promoter of innovation and change, bringing new life to a kingdom that was stuck in old traditions. At the same time, however, Lezar became a thorn in the side of nobles who had long been seeking personal gain.

Jamil
Professional assassin, ??? years old. Picked up by the owner of the cabaret club Kamal, he has lived with Celine ever since as her brother.
He is agile and physically gifted, trained as an assassin from an early age and unbeaten in assassination attempts. He is impulsive and cruel, but also seems to have a good heart and is full of mysteries. He often uses a mask to cover his face when carrying out his missions.

Acting Parties:

Renegades: Group consisting of mercenaries and various rabble, having no moral values. Hired by the Scorp Corporation to do the dirty work. They do not ask about the reasons for actions, if it concerns big gain. Despite the fact that they are mostly various kinds of criminals, they follow strictly set instructions and requirements, due to the consequences for willful actions. They are well trained in battles. Thanks to the black market, they have excellent equipment, mostly identical to the Jaegers.

Jaegers: Special Forces made up of ex-military and highly trained volunteers from all over the world who wished to join. A well-trained group whose goal is to destroy potential dangers on a global scale. They have the main task: to destroy the corporation "Scorp" that suddenly appeared, which brought a lot of troubles. They are subordinates of the hidden organization "Taiga", the purpose of which is to keep peacetime for civilians. They are armed with the best equipment from around the world.

Game modes:

  • Capture: The task of one of the parties is to capture the located points on the map and hold, capturing the required number of points, preventing the other side from doing the same.
  • Medallion of death: The task is to collect a certain number of tokens from the corpses of the enemy, while not allowing them to be taken from your team.
  • Team Deathmatch: The well-known mode, the purpose of which is to earn more kills for your team than the enemy. The team that reaches the critical point wins.
  • All against all: As the name implies, the essence of the mode is to score a certain number of kills before the rest of the players, having opponents of all users on the map.
  • Capture the Flag: Again, as the name implies, the essence of the mode is to capture the flag from the enemy's base, while preventing them from doing the same. The side with the most flags in their base wins.
  • Detonation: The task of the attacking team is to undermine the indicated zones on the map, having a limited number of fighters, while the defensive side needs to prevent them from being destroyed. The team that wins a certain number of rounds wins.
  • Search and destroy: The task of the attacking side is to pick up the bomb and set it in the indicated place, while the other must stop them, if the bomb is planted, the team must win be able to defuse it.
  • Special operations: The goal of the team is to break through the crowds of enemies by completing the tasks required in the task.

Get ready to hone your unique musical skills!

Features:

Let’s get started!

2129680.name: R.I.P. Tour
2129680.about_the_game:
Welcome to Hartley Haven

With his colorful cast of cartoon animals, Buck Hartley was once a prominent and beloved animator. When he built an amusement park in the summer of 1999, it seemed like a promising newcomer to the industry. However it was shut down that very fall, after 10 missing college students were found dead in a back room of the Horror House dark ride. Along with them was the body of Hartley himself, with a hand-drawn manifesto in his signature comic style. Case closed... right?


Now the park is under new management, and they're looking to renovate and reopen the place. 20 years after the original murders, the Hartley Haven Horror House for a one-night Halloween celebration. Rumor has it that if your entire group is in costume, you'll be taken backstage for the secret tour...

Feature List

  • Customizable main character
  • Accessibility features: Dyslexic font, auto-reading
  • Multiple endings (most of them bad)
  • Fully original soundtrack
  • Pettable dog

2129720.name: GUILTY
2129720.about_the_game:
GUILTY is a first-person psychological horror game.

STORYLINE
Play as Peter, an ex-military, and discover what your past hides. Access your unconscious to remember the traumatic and most terrifying memories that are hidden. Find out what happened to Linda, Peter's wife. A traumatic past that gives you a sense of guilt. What would you do if past trauma no longer allowed you to have a normal life?


GAMEPLAY

With just the help of a flashlight, explore a national park and a terrifying house inside your mind to relive your traumas and face them. Solve puzzles to gain access to important areas. Explore, remember, run and survive. Try to overcome your fears.

Collect memory fragments to access your unconscious.



Explore caves where a dark ritual is taking place.



Find out what's real and what's hallucination.



Be tormented by darkness.



Explore the house to find levers that unlock access to restricted areas.



Discover the correct way to position the mannequins to progress in the game.



The answers you find facing your fears!

Fight The Voxelized Zombie Hoards in this FPS online Co-op Survival shooter. Heed The Call of Voxels as you and your friends unlock more areas and powerups as you progress through a vast maze of post apocalyptic ruin. Purchase a gun from the wall or the "random mystery gun chest". Get your Friends up before they are down for the count... You already know the drill, but now in shiny retro-indie voxel flavors! Every copy comes with standardized, stylized square blood chunk splats. Aim for the head to conserve ammunition!


Join the Playtest By becoming a member of the Zombie Squad Discord

2129780.name: The Impossible Knight Runner
2129780.about_the_game:
The Impossible Knight Runner is an intense hack-and-slash platformer full of creatures trying to put an end to your adventure.

Choose your knight, enter the dungeon and show no mercy, because no one will go easy on you.

Key Features:

  • Intense Gameplay:
One life. No checkpoints. Lot's of enemies. Once you start moving you have to keep going.

  • Unlockable Content:
Unlock new characters, levels and game modes as you progress through the game.


It's not going to be easy... and remember: Keep on moving!

2129800.name: Rectangle Guy
2129800.about_the_game:
Rectangle Guy embarks on an epic adventure across the world to achieve... um... what exactly? To be honest, I'm not entirely sure. But you can find out by playing the game!

Who is Rectangle Guy?


Rectangle Guy is the protagonist of Rectangle Guy. He's got pristine fashion sense, a "unique" sense of humor and he's an all around great guy. You'll get pretty familiar with him over the course of the game and may even learn of unexpected stuff about the guy, if you know where to look.

Totally Epic Features

The Down Dash -

Got a massive mouth demon chasing you? Need to impress a girl? Maybe someone is holding a gun to your head and telling you that you need to increase your falling speed? Well no matter which of those situations you find yourself in, Rectangle Guy's signature down dash ability will be able to help you out.

Challenging Bosses -

In addition to regular platforming levels, Rectangle Guy also features some challenging boss fights. During these, we use our innovative Fire Panel™ technology to take down foes. And don't worry, there's no stupid random elements during these. By the end of these boss fights, you'll be running circles around the suckers.

A Whole Bunch of Environments -

During the course of this game, Rectangle Guy will find himself in a lot of different areas. From the relaxing Grassy Plains to the gorgeous Profit City, there's always more to see. And, I mean, I don't wanna spoil anything but lemme tell ya some of the later worlds get WACKY.

Warden on the Job -

Warden on the Job is an epilogue to the main story of Rectangle Guy added for the game's one year anniversary. Embark on a new journey with Rectangle Guy, traveling through familiar environments which have now corrupted by the True Void. Ever wonder what would happen if a rift to a dangerous, otherworldly dimension opened up in the middle of a field or a city? Well now your sick curiosities can be answered.

Time Attack Mode -

The regular levels don't seem to be hard enough for you? Well don't worry, because Time Attack mode will give you a run for your money. Given a very strict timer, you will have to speed your way through levels. Clearing a Time Attack level is already hard enough, but the truly insane players will go for the elusive R ranking.

A Plethora of Post Game Modes -

The main adventure is great of course, but if you become a true Rectangle Guy enthusiast, you may want more. Well don't worry, as there is a BUNCH of stuff to do after the main adventure. And when I say a bunch, I MEAN a bunch. There are hours of additional levels and challenges after the credits roll (some of which may be too difficult for their own good).

You sold yet?

If not, look at this lil doggy. How you gonna say no to the lil doggy?

2129810.name: Reignbreaker
2129810.about_the_game:
Rise. Rebel. Ruin.


Reignbreaker is a high-octane action rogue-like set in a dystopian medievalpunk world. Step into the boots of Clef, a fearless rebel determined to rid the world of the Kingdom’s oppression as she lays siege to the Queen’s grand Bastion.



Smash, dash, and battle through hordes of hostile high-tech medieval machines to breach the heart of the fortress. Explore hand-crafted levels brimming with traps, secrets, and an embarrassment of hoarded wealth. Even parley with feisty loyalists, jaded soldiers, self-serving mercenaries, and haughty aristocrats as you penetrate the Bastion’s depths and lay bare the arcane truths hidden within.



Rise – stronger and more unrelenting – from every defeat and feel the punk spirit roar within your veins as you gain access to a growing arsenal of motorized javelins to experiment with. Smash the Kingdom, paint its walls with rebellion, and turn the Queen’s lands into a battlefield as you become The Reignbreaker.

Features

  • Explosive, customizable combat with a growing arsenal of motorized javelins and power-ups.
  • Fast-paced and thrilling gameplay that rewards flashy combos, counters, and heavy hits.
  • A gripping story of rebellion and resilience set in a high-tech medieval dystopia.
  • Beautifully hand-crafted levels filled with enemies, traps, and hidden treasures.

2129860.name: Little Horror Raiser
2129860.about_the_game:
You find a mysterious egg in a haunted forest, turns out it's a horror of an unfathomable nature! Raise it to become good or evil, smart or strong, it's your little horror so raise it as you please.



Choose between a cosmic horror, a zombie, a demonic entity or a ghost.

Have your horror go to school, work at a haunted house for money or send them to gain evilness at the abandoned ruins to raise it's stats.

As you raise your horror you'll run into different events, like investigating a crashed alien space ship or interacting with a talking, complicated panda.

Gain trinkets that will do harm or good such as a magical plant you can water for a secret area on the map or a chaotic hamster that demands to be pet each week lest it destroy the world.

Discover all the different endings, over 20 to discover!

2129870.name: [Gonochki] Cars, Guns and Metal!
2129870.about_the_game:

2129910.name: Chris Isn't Alone
2129910.about_the_game:
THE PREMISE
Chris Isn't Alone is a horror/comedy game where your choices actually have an effect on the outcome of the story.
You play as Chris, a 12 year old boy that has just come to the realization that the monster in his closet was real.
The monster informs you that they are there to kill you.
You must convince it otherwise.

CHOOSE YOUR OWN PATH
You will be presented with many different choices that WILL have an effect on the outcome of the story.
A story path that you may have gone down previously could end up changing depending on what items Chris has...

ENDINGS
There are a total of 17 unique endings!
Can you find the TRUE ending?
There is a reward for unlocking all the endings...

Players can use a mouse or trackpad.

PLEASE ENJOY!
Keep in mind that this is a student project!
Feedback would be amazing!

2129950.name: HorrorBox
2129950.about_the_game:
Horror Box is an asymmetrical horror game inspired by various installments in the horror films genre. Matches are oriented around a team of very under-equipped protagonists against a powerful and scary antagonist. As a “survivor” you will need to cooperate with your team in a timely manner to achieve various objectives to escape almost certain death at the hands of the antagonist. As the “slasher” you will need to eliminate and prevent the escape of the “survivors” by any means necessary.

Featuring PVE & PVP experiences inspired by a wide variety of Horror Scenarios to enjoy with your friends!



  • Creep your way through chilling and eery settings such as schools, backrooms neighborhoods, derelict space stations and more. Every map and level has a sense of mystery and darkness, each with their own set of horrors and surprises to face.



  • Survive against relentless PvE Killers. Every AI killer is tailored to their own strategies, from broad run chasing to tactically taking out your crew one by one, they will never back down!



  • Become the Hunter. If PvE doesn't suit your taste, knife-up and take on your friends as the hunter. Play to kill but be warry; survivors can take you on by suprise!

  • Custom Match-Making. Cater your own games. Choose your modes, your maps, your killers and more.

  • Create and Customize your character. Set yourself by unlocking cosmetics and dress your character to the occasion.

  • Play with up to 16 friends! Host large lobbies for CO-OP or even PVP.

  • Replayability Objectives will always spawn in different locations each map making for a new experience each time.

2129970.name: My Loving Wife
2129970.about_the_game:
This is the story of you and your wife. Since it's your story, you get to decide the protagonist's gender! Every day, you come home from work to spend time with your wife who loves you more than anything and you feel the same, hoping the time that you both spend together will last forever. Things aren't always perfect though. Both of you are going to make mistakes, but that's not gonna stop the two of you from loving each other, right?

How you will spend time with your wife is up to you. Of course, you can always be a good spouse and treat her right, but if you make certain decisions, she definitely won't be happy. There are at least a few ways things can turn out depending on your actions, whether they're good or bad. Things are gonna get tough, but that's not gonna separate the two of you. Besides, it's not like either of you is hiding anything from the other... right? Spend time reading this story, make decisions and see how your wife ends up because of them.

Features:
- Nameable Protagonist
- Nameable Wife
- 3 Gender Choices
- Multiple Endings

2130000.name: Tailbound
2130000.about_the_game:
A mysterious new convention, a mind-breaking pink mist, powerful monsters, and a shadowy organization pulling the strings. Can you uncover the mystery behind it all, and survive the night?

Tailbound is a lewd top-down 2D hack n' slash game, that finishes what my last game, Thirstchasm, set out to do. The game features Zelda-like gameplay, but at a far faster pace and with more of a focus on abilities and level hazards. Gameplay is based around an improved version of Thirstchasm's topple system & combat.

Tailbound is now finished, including all artwork, scenes, and music. The game has 29 fully-animated Sex Scenes, with the sole focus of Male on Male content. Not to mention, 4 levels, 7 enemies, and a multitude of secrets, easter eggs, and lore scattered about.

This game includes scenes featuring...

2130010.name: Castle Doombad 2: Muahaha!
2130010.about_the_game:
***Looking for the original Castle Doombad? It's available now on both Steam and mobile! Search for "Castle Doombad Classic" to buy on Steam, or visit castledoombad dot com!***

Castle Doombad 2: Muahaha! is the sinister sequel of the 2014 hit Tower Defense puzzler -- making its devious debut with brand new content, a new story, 2-player Co-Op Mode, and an evolution of the classic Castle Doombad gameplay!

YOU are the villain – and life as a baddie sure is good! At least it was, until pesky heroes decided to invade your quaint little lair o’ despair. Turns out they’re not too keen on the whole “captured princess and prince” situation. What’s a Big Boss Bad Guy to do? Decking out your castle with a heinous heap of traps, monsters, and dastardly weapons seems like a good place to start!

Choose from over 35 delightfully devious traps and minions to devise and deploy your own diabolical designs of do-gooder destruction! Strategically place traps on walls, ceilings, and floors to uncover the multitude of wicked ways they can complement and combo off one another. Then add a sinister sprinkle of free-roaming minions and manually-activated traps that require your precision timing to pack a painful punch...

Unlock, upgrade, and customize your traps, troops, and castle on your quest to become the baddest of them all!

Play the entire game either in Single Player or become Co-Villains alongside a friend in 2-Player Co-Op! You and your partner-in-crime must choose different traps and tools, so you'll need to rely on each other and plan your evil schemes accordingly. Available in local play or via Steam Remote Play.

Castle Doombad 2: Muahaha! is currently in development and we'll be revealing more of the sequel's new features (and some big surprises) in the future. Please stay tuned!

From the team that brought you Steven Universe: The Light Trilogy, Teeny Titans, Super Mole Escape, Bring Me Sandwiches!!, and more!

Add Castle Doombad 2: Muahaha! to your wishlist today to receive updates on the release date, or follow along with development by following one of our social media accounts, visiting the official Castle Doombad website, or joining our official Discord Community. Check the sidebar for links!

2130030.name: ManneKin: Hessler Storage
2130030.about_the_game:
WARNING: This video game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

ManneKin: Hessler Storage is a first-person psychological horror game.

Explore Hessler Storage as Professor Tobias Shaw, an expert in history, archaeology, symbolism, and the occult. Professor Shaw enters Hessler Storage after being told about a symbol on a stone. A symbol he's been searching for his entire life that could give him the answers he's been seeking.

Time Matters

Time in Hessler Storage has an effect on the story, changing rooms, locations, item placement, and the dangers that lurk within.

It Belong In A Museum

Hessler Storage will house some of the world's rarest and most esoteric collections of artifacts. Professor Shaw's expert knowledge of these items will lead him to want to take some of them with him, but which?

Is it me?

Descending underground into the darkness, discovering the secrets of Hessler Storage, and being pursued by relentless evil will take a toll. It may even change what Professor Shaw sees. Was that door there before? Is that mannequin real? Is something coming out of the shadows for him?

You're Not Alone

Professor Shaw won't be alone in Hessler Storage, besides the malevolence stalking him, he will also have someone who knows the facility guiding him, former security team leader, Argus Fisher. Professor Shaw will be told door codes, where keys are, and hear what happened in Hessler Storage from someone who worked there when it was operational.

Communication Is Key

Professor Shaw will need to keep in radio contact with Argus in order to know where to go and what to do next. But not all of the radio antennas are working in Hessler Storage. Professor Shaw will need to fix them to maintain his only means of escaping. But something else in Hessler Storage can take advantage of the radio communications. Fail to realise you're in a dead zone and something else may be talking to you, leading you somewhere else.

F.E.A.R (First-person Emotional Arc Response)

The F.E.A.R system is Professor Shaw's fight or flight response. If he's in an area that's too dark with too many things lurking near him, he can only run and hide. Doors will take longer to unlock as he fumbles with keys. But if the area is well-lit and there are few things to be afraid of, Professor Shaw can fight. Shoving and kicking his way through enemies and doors.

Hessler Storage has a dark past. Can you find all the secrets to this abandoned facility and escape with your life?

In ManneKin: Hessler Storage, you are Professor Tobias Shaw, and all you entered the facility with is your trusty lighter. It's never failed you. Other than your knowledge and expertise in the field of the occult, you have no weapons. You must solve the puzzles, avoid the Kin, and escape the facility with your life.

Find secrets through cassette recordings, VHS tapes, photos, and letters from staff that had worked at the facility. Piece together the history of Hessler Storage.

2130050.name: Time Shock
2130050.about_the_game:
THE FUTURE ISN'T WRITTEN

The machines think they've already won. They've seen a thousand futures where humanity dies.

There is one thing they haven't counted on.

You're humanity's time-traveling wildcard, the variable they didn't factor in. Storm the futures they're building. Steal the blueprints before they're drawn. Sabotage their rise before it begins. Fight with weaponized war rigs through:

  • Cyberpunk cities that have fallen to the machines.

  • Moon bases where the last transmissions went cold.

  • Mechanized planets where all life is extinct.

  • Nuclear wastelands seconds from meltdown.

Every future you hit, you bend the timeline  in our favor.

YOUR RIG IS YOUR LIFELINE 

Choose from a wide range of futuristic combat vehicles, including:

  • Racers

  • Sci-fi hovercraft

  • Moon Buggies

  • Armored cars

The right vehicle will make the difference.

WEAPONS FROM THE FUTURE

Every upgrade is a chance to take back the future. Strip parts from burning tomorrows.

  • Railguns

  • Plasma Rifles (Bug Zapper)

  • Energy Rifles

  • Sniper Rifles

  • Sticky Bombs

  • Rocket Launchers

  • Quantum Shields

Your build decides which timeline survives.

THE AI THINK IT'S INEVITABLE

Combat a range of lethal robots.

  • Dismember mech spiders

  • Destroy kamikaze swarms

  • Outwit drones that hunt in packs

  • Take on giant robot bosses

Break their math. Rewrite their code. Make them remember what fear feels like.

HERE'S HOW WE'RE DOING THIS:

FREE DEMO - Mission one. Full experience. See if you've got what it takes.

Episode One - $9.99 - Four missions where you punch your first holes in their timeline. This is where you prove the machines can lose.

Full Campaign - $19.99 - If Episode One hits, we unleash five additional missions based on your feedback. Deeper timelines. Bigger stakes.

Already own Episode One? Episode Two is free.

We're building this with you. Your feedback shapes the war. No corporate garbage. No "buy now, regret later." Just honest game dev and a story built by hand.

PC. MAC. STEAM DECK. SOON.

The machines have a plan. You're about to rewrite it.

Closed beta live now. Demo incoming,

2130060.name: Tower Walker: MMO Grind Simulator
2130060.about_the_game:
From the developers of Dino Nest and Boxing School comes a new fresh auto-grinder, idler fantasy RPG game rich with features. Create and manage your own hero. Explore the huge ancient tower. This is a pure offline singleplayer MMO Grind Simulator!

THE DARK MYSTERIOUS TOWER

Many years ago, a scribe working in the royal library found an old scroll hidden away inside the wall. It had the markings of an elder warlock from the council of the scepter order. The scroll pointed the way to the location of a huge abandoned ancient tower somewhere in the lands of the north. It was written that the tower itself is a living being, an evil place that has been alive for thousands of years built by the eternal master to keep watch over the lands. King Belmont, the ruler of these lands sent many expeditions to explore this legend, but none of them survived...

CREATE YOUR CHARACTER

KEY FEATURES

  • Create and manage your hero, choose between 3 starter classes

  • Progress up in the ancient tower, explore and discover

  • Defeat powerful bosses and gain infamy with enemy factions

  • Loot weapons, armor, rings, artifacts and other powerful items

  • Level up your character and learn new skills at the trainer

  • Over 20 classes and 5 expertise grades for weapons and armor

  • Trade with merchants in the basecamp or unlock secret vendors

  • Craft items, fully featured recipe based crafting system

  • Find and level up companions with extra buffs and combat abilities

  • Complete normal or heroic quests in the journal to reveal lore

  • Enchant your weapons, armor and rings (old school style) with no limits

  • Shared stash transfer capability in inventory storage

  • Offline Singleplayer with up to 18 character save slots

  • Hundreds of hours of addictive semi-idle gameplay

Your journey in Tower Walker always continues through new expansions

(Upcoming: "Ocean Depths" - raid instance dungeon with normal, heroic and brutal mode)

OFFLINE SINGLEPLAYER ONLY

Tower Walker does not contain any online features, multiplayer or microtransactions. This is a pure oldschool offline singleplayer experience with local savefiles only.

2130080.name: Wobble Warriors
2130080.about_the_game:
Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room. The king of the goblins is not only hoarding away the dragon's gold, but has locked himself in the throne room. Find the golden key, defeat the king, and celebrate your victory!

Traversing the slime-covered goblin's dungeon is scary by yourself, so bring some friends along and reap the benefits of having additional help. Allied dragons can ground pound near knocked out dragons to revive them back to full health while pushing away the goblins at the same time. Even if an allied dragon cannot come to revive their friend, health slowly replenishes as long as all dragons are not knocked out. When all dragons are knocked out, a life is lost and all players get teleported to the previous room. When all lives are gone, it's game over.

Whether you want to play with others or play by yourself to strengthen your skills, Wobble Warriors was made in mind to be played by all skill levels. Will you rejoice in victory or will you get knocked down to try again?

2130170.name: Bubbbles
2130170.about_the_game:
Bubbbles is a casual VR puzzle game where you'll need to get to the core of a pile of bubb(b)les! Match the correct color / texture bubbles to remove all similar touching bubbles while more fly in from the sky to throw you off.

Features:
-Bubble Popping in VR
-20 Different Levels
-Powerups
-Realistic Physics
-Scaling Difficulty

2130230.name: Gravity Box
2130230.about_the_game:
Overview


Gravity Box is a retro-styled score attack game that requires the player to frantically swap gravity in order to avoid hazards. Grab the gems and see how long you can last!

Features


-High octane score chasing gameplay

-Unlockable costumes

-Nostalgic pixel art

2130250.name: Runombie
2130250.about_the_game:
In a misty forest, you play as a hungry zombie, you constantly run, must catch up with humans to fuel to survive, careful not to run into your own kind.
The forest is littered with gold coins, which can be collected for points to increase your maximum health.
Blue items like lightning symbols can increase your running speed for a short time.However, be aware that each time you use this item, you will lose a piece of body, and using too much will directly cause the game to fail.
The Red Cross item restores some of your health.
White clockwork shaped item can pause time around and stop nearby humans.
Pink lollipop shaped item can confuse surrounding humans and make them run back.

2130300.name: Eclipse: Shine of Dawn
2130300.about_the_game:
Eclipse: Shine of Dawn is a game with a Fantasy RPG aesthetic that combines the best of storytelling and hack 'n slash elements, unique characters, memorable enemies, and immersive puzzles in a pleasant setting, whether to think, admire, or beat down hordes of monsters. As you progress through the story, unlock new weapons, abilities, and emotions that deliver unique moments in a completely epic way.




- Original world-building with its own mythologies, regions, and creatures;
- Combo system with alternating between different weapons;
- Weapon evolution through mission-based system;
- Expandable universe.




Follow Luke on his journey of power rise to fulfill his mission. Faced with the kidnapping of Prince Nylo, Luke finds himself in an inevitable situation of seeking to enhance his abilities to the maximum by facing his opponents along the way, so that at his peak, he can confront the imposing being of darkness, The Dark One. Join the hero on this fantastic journey full of mystery, action, and strong emotions. Enhance the legendary sword Suncatcher and the mythical weapons, mastering each of the available abilities to destroy the great evil.




Everyone seeks a higher goal in their journeys, and when two opposing paths cross, confrontation becomes inevitable. However, for every conflict, big or small, the glow of achievement ignites. Among conflicts, bonds are formed, perspectives change, and the flames that burned intensely can illuminate a new vision of each own journey.




Learn how the synergy of legendary weapons works within the Eclipse Universe. Understand how their primordial elements interact and generate fantastic effects. Make combinations your most powerful weapon and be enchanted by so many possibilities.

2130460.name: FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Mask of the Lunar Eclipse
2130460.about_the_game:
“FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Mask of the Lunar Eclipse” was released in Japan in 2008 as the fourth game in the FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO series. Following the remastering of “FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Maiden of Black Water,” the series masterpiece is being brought back to life with upgraded graphics.

■About the Game

A group of children mysteriously disappeared during a festival on Rogetsu Isle. Although they were found, they had lost their memories. Now they have returned to the island as teenagers. The girls rely on the Camera Obscura, a camera with the power to capture and seal away unthinkable horrors, and the faint beam of their flashlight while exploring various locations and fending off the ghosts that attack them as they attempt to discover the truth of their haunting past.




-Camera Obscura
This is an old camera with the ability to repel vengeful ghosts and seal away their power by photographing them. As such, it is an indispensable item throughout the game. The Camera Obscura can be used as a weapon against ghosts by spotting them through the viewfinder and taking photos of them to inflict damage. It also plays a major role in the girls' investigation, as its special power allows them to see the keys that allow them to find their way through new areas.



-Exploring Rogetsu Isle
Explore the dimly lit Western-style mansions and abandoned hospitals on the island by relying on the moonlight and the faint beam of your flashlight. Progress the story by interacting with items and places that spark your interest. From past newspaper articles and notes, you uncover the vile secrets of the past, unravel the lost memories of the protagonist, and discover the truth.

■Features

-Improved Graphics
In-game movies and character models have been improved to make the story and characters more appealing. In addition, the graphics have been improved for each platform. The rendering of shadows and the beam of the flashlight has been refined so players can experience more realistic horror.



-New Snap Mode
Pose characters and ghosts freely to create haunting memories in the new snap mode. Perhaps you may even take unexpected spirit photos by accident...



-New Costumes
The original costume lineup has been altered slightly, and new costumes have been added. Change the characters' costumes to experience the investigation in different ways.



Note: “FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO: Mask of the Lunar Eclipse Digital Deluxe Edition,” which includes the full game, is also available for purchase. Please be careful to avoid making a redundant purchase.

2130500.name: Under Observation
2130500.about_the_game:
Under Observation is a first-person, single-player horror game developed by a group of students from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. In-game you are a researcher working at a Bioweapons R&D company, focusing on national security. You've been given a subject which you need to study and fill out a report on. Now the subject has escaped its containment and the facility is on lockdown. The only way out is to open the main blast door with a staff keycard but unluckily you lost yours and need to find it. The rogue subject is a dangerous entity so you need to dance a fine line between avoiding it and following its every action to gather intel.

Research focuses on the behavioral patterns of the subject. The aim is to figure out the subject's perks and abilities such as sight, hearing, and diet. As you gather intel the subject's main type becomes more evident. There is a total of 20 different subject types. When you are confident about the subject's type, the research is completed. Some perks are more subtle such as genetype, which gives out no visual clues. Instead, you need to take a sample off the subject and run that through various experiments. Some terrifying variations of the subject are also able to turn completely invisible.

You have many gadgets at your disposal that are used in the experiments. These include things such as flashlights, dart guns, tablets, and photo cameras. Guard post has a CCTV monitoring station which you can use to locate the subject. Between the main corridors of the facility runs ventilation ducts that are accessible and great for hiding.

______________________________________________________________________________

"A week ago they brought yet another subject to be analyzed. I believe this one was grown at ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ . The report we got from them suggests that subject's 4th development stage had an evolution score of 4.6. This means that the behavioral patterns need to be mapped thoroughly before commercial deployment can even be considered.
It may never fit that mold, but that big of an evolutionary jump must be investigated.

The subject is now located at ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ , where it is to undergo ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ . All required documentation on the said operation can be obtained through intel management. As the facility's security system was newly upgraded, the procedures/experiments with an SR of 3 or lower can be conducted by just 1 person on-site

Operational Management, ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓

Soteria Security Solutions

Great is the Enemy of Perfect"

Join up with your friends or fight alone against the monsters that have invaded the remains of reality. Find and collect new equipment and spells to aid in your journey. Level up your character and get strong enough to defeat the dragon guarding the floating island.

Your Character

Customize your character’s look to differentiate from other players. Level up and specialize in different attributes to increase survivability and potency of your spells. Choose what spells you want to use and find what combinations work best for you or your party. Find the best equipment for your playstyle.

Fractured World

Explore the floating island that has merged from the fractured worlds. Find spells and equipment left behind in the wake of the doom. Roam freely around the island to find more about why the different realities have collided. The island consists of 4 different zones for you to explore.

Spellcasting

The game has over 15 different spells for you to use against the monsters. But beware! All the spells also work against your friends! Coordinate your attack well or you might freeze your friend to a certain death. Heal and buff yourself and others. Shield your friends against the fiery breath of the mighty dragon.

Creation of the game

The game was created as a part of game development studies in Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. If you want more information about the creators of this game, feel free to reach out.

2130850.name: After the Flood
2130850.about_the_game:
Dive into the heart of a haunted town in 'After the Flood,' a single-player horror adventure. Play as a detective investigating a centuries-old curse, facing roaming dangers and unraveling dark secrets. With no means to fight, you must run and hide to survive. Gather clues, confront the past, and lift the curse before it's too late.

Synopsis:


Drawn by rumors of strange occurrences and supernatural phenomena, the detective ventures into the heart of the desolate town, determined to uncover the truth behind its tragic past.

As the detective explores the town's eerie streets and decrepit buildings, they encounter chilling manifestations of the curse, including roaming monsters and malevolent spirits. Armed with only their wits and keen investigative skills, players must navigate treacherous environments, solve puzzles, and gather clues to piece together the dark history of the town and the events that led to its downfall.

Features:


  • Uncover the Dark Secrets: Step into the shoes of a determined detective bent on unraveling the truth behind the sinister events that befell the town. Unravel the mystery behind the curse that brought the town to ruin, driven by a vengeful witch's wrath. Delve deep into the haunted remains of the town, as whispers of the past guide you toward the truth.

  • Survive the Horrors: As a detective caught in the grip of a malevolent force, you cannot fight the creatures lurking within the shadows. Your only means of survival is to run and hide from the relentless lone monster that stalks your every move. But beware of what hides in the darkness of the abandoned buildings. Feel the adrenaline rush as you navigate treacherous environments, seeking sanctuary and evading the nightmarish entities that haunt your path.

2130940.name: Puzzle Park
2130940.about_the_game:
Welcome to the puzzle park! You will meet with a lot of puzzles scattered across the park. Solve them and get stars that will help you move forward. Choose your own path on which you will go, because the game is completely non-linear and with an open world. Choose the puzzles that you master and get rewards depending on the complexity of the puzzle. Also enjoy a walk in the park with beautiful views and sights. Involve the environment and use logic and imagination to solve the puzzle.


  • 40 puzzles scattered around the park.
  • Get a different number of stars for solving puzzles, depending on its difficulty. Use the stars to unlock new parts of the park.
  • Simple puzzle mechanics, which are complicated by various variations and involving the environment.
  • Beautiful unique places where you can enjoy the views and walk.

2130980.name: Todd's Adventures in Slime World (Lynx/Mega Drive)
2130980.about_the_game:
Originally released in the early 90s, this sticky platformer from veteran developers Epyx saw players taking on the role of Todd the space explorer, who lands on a planet made entirely from slime and goo, and teeming with disgusting life forms, who searches for precious slime gems. Now, relive those days in this remastered emulated version. This version contains both the original version for the handheld Atari Lynx console and the later Sega Mega Drive port.

Gameplay

Armed with your trusty water gun, make your way through 6 different gooey adventures, each offering a different challenge:

Adventure 1: Easy
They say that this part of Slime World is easier than others, but it is still dangerous! Find the exit!

Adventure 2: Exploration
The ship was destroyed in orbit! A rescue ship has been called, but you have to get to it first!

Adventure 3: Action
The ship was destroyed in orbit over the worst part of Slime World! You must find the rescue ship!

Adventure 4: Suspense
Slime World is about to melt! Find mushrooms to delay meltdown by 1 minute! Find the exit!

Adventure 5: Logic
Your ship has been damaged, and your gun is useless! You have only your wits to save you from certain doom!

Adventure 6: Arcade
There are no restarts in this adventure, so just get as far as you can!

On your way you can find a number of useful tools, from shields and bait to bombs and jetpacks!


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2131010.name: The Land Beneath Us

The Land Beneath Us is a turn-based rogue-lite action dungeon crawler. Use powerful skill combos and stylish weaponry to battle your way through the Underworld known as Annwn. Enjoy challenging dynamic encounters and discover the mysteries of this mythological world. 

 

BATTLE THROUGH THE UNDERWORLD! 

Forged by The Creator, the Ultimate Soul Harvester (U.S.H) is crafted to gather Souls. Now armed with Soul-Technology, its mission is one of redemption. Explore The Underworld, engage, barter, or confront characters. Learn from their tales to shape your unique path. 

 

MASTER THE COMBOS!

2131020.name: Escape Space
2131020.about_the_game:
3 DIFFERENT FACTIONS

As a mercenary, you'll get to decide for which faction(s) you're willing to fight. Your actions will have consequences, so choose wisely!

The Earth Military Conglomerate: the Earth's military faction. They usually have big guns and tend to use ballistic-based weapons when in combat.



The Void Outlaws: the renegade faction in space. They use weird tactics in combat with a wide variety of weapons, depending on what they might have stolen.



The Quantum Riders: the cult of scientists focusing on new technology. They usually have high-end energy weapons and shields at their disposal.

22 STORY MISSIONS

You'll get to play up to 12 different story missions in a single run, but there are 3 different paths you can take from the beginning to discover all of the 22 handcrafted story missions!

ENDLESS PROCEDURAL CONTRACTS

Between two story missions, you'll be able to grind for money or reputation by doing procedurally-generated contracts for the factions you wanna play with.

7 GAME MODES

There are up to 7 different mission types in the game, and you'll get to unlock them all the more you progress through the storyline.

  • The Elimination missions: go through some waves on enemies until you reach the priority target and hunt it down!
  • The Collect missions: fight waves of enemies until you gather enough of the requested component from their scrap!
  • The Escort missions: help an allied and defenseless unit to go through a space sector by destroying any enemy target in front of you!
  • The Warfare missions: get involved in a conflict between two factions and get some reinforcement from the faction that requested some help!
  • The Rush missions: assault an enemy faction's position and go through their defenses while destroying all of their units!
  • The Survival missions: fight enemy waves for a set time, and decide if you want to continue and earn more rewards by destroying more of them!
  • The Mayhem missions: target a fleet concentrating numerous elite enemies and take them all down!

5 DIFFICULTIES

Even if the story missions' difficulty is set and cannot be changed, you'll be able to play the procedurally-generated contract missions based on their difficulty. The more difficult they are, the higher the risks and rewards will be!



Having trouble with higher difficulties? Maybe it's time to grind lower-difficulty contracts to get some new gear and upgrades!

17 WEAPONS

You'll start to play with the default Firestorm machine gun unlocked, and then be able to expand your arsenal with gifted or purchased weapons!

12 MODS

Starting without any mod, you'll be able to get new perks by unlocking and selecting new mods! From a passive energy shield to an active E.M.P. system, test and decide what mod works best for you!

18 COLORS

Who said you cannot be classy in space? You can decide on your spaceship's colors using 18 different colors, on two layers (primary and secondary). Plus, you can also decide what the color of your thruster's exhaust is!

45 UPGRADES

In addition to the customization, you'll be able to constantly improve your spaceship by getting new upgrades until you get them all! Plan to unlock the most relevant ones for your playstyle first and dominate your enemies!

BEAUTIFUL HANDCRAFTED PIXEL ART

All of the in-game assets are hand-made with pixel art by myself, hope you'll enjoy them!

AN AMAZING OST

We teamed up with the very talented Scott Hsu who made this incredible OST for Escape Space!

2131050.name: Handyman
2131050.about_the_game:
Handyman is a game where you have to lead a one-man repair and cleaning team. The main tasks are set by the customer, but what methods to achieve them - you can decide for yourself!

Each completed task will bring you a certain amount of money, for which in the next order it will be possible to do something that would not have been enough initially. For example, hang a new chandelier, and not just screw in a light bulb.

You, as a worker, are not limited by anything: you can simply make cosmetic repairs, or you can break some walls and build new ones where you see fit.

List of your best friends for lead time:

- Roller, for painting any surfaces
- Hammer, to create the passages you need
- Mop and hose, to remove unclean deeds of customers
- Tablet, to buy any object from any part of the world
- Lawn mower to mow the dense thickets of some customers
- Spatula and bricks to create new partitions
- A shovel to clean up age-old landfills
- As well as your hands and head to carry objects and choose the best ways to solve the tasks

And now it's time to finally establish your team, from one person! Have fun.

2131080.name: Floppy Disks from Hell
2131080.about_the_game:
ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ  

Help Floppy Disks to repair from the flames a broken cell phone due to a strange malfunction on a World scale!

A factory malfunction is sabotaging equipment all over the world,
Help Floppy Disks in his battle to repair a broken cell phone from the flames before it explodes!

If you run to win, you will help find a solution to this global threat.
Going from one side to another, avoiding difficulties, you reach the goals, advancing levels, repairing areas in the cell phone's platelets and chips.

2131150.name: Terranny
2131150.about_the_game:
This game is not for everyone. Please try the demo before buying, your progress will carry over.

A.cquire
Earn parts, decals, badges, and titles by completing missions and competing in PvP seasons.

B.uild

Design a custom drone from a variety of parts. Adjust attachment locations and angles to produce ultimate killing machines. Change part colors and add decals for a bit of personal touch.

D.eploy

2131180.name: Dark Days : Devil Hunt
2131180.about_the_game:
Many years ago, demons, monsters, goblins and dragons had invaded the world.

Many creatures, from where and how they came, were killing the people and reigning in the lands they occupied.
Until a very talented wizard shows up.

This sorcerer sealed the main demon Azazil and all creatures with a spell called the death spell and imprisoned him in a pandora's box in a room of a vast mountain.

And the price was the death of the mage.
And the world was at peace again.

Centuries have passed and no one, except for very rare people, was even aware of the existence of these creatures.
Until a treasure hunter discovers the hidden cave and opens Pandora's box..



Ares is a warrior medieval people, his wife died many years ago, lives with a son and has no magic abilities.
He carries the holy spirit of the sorcerer whose son died many years ago,and no one knows about it.

Ares is injured when demons attack their village during a walk with his son, and his son is kidnapped by a demon.
Azazil is aware of this soul and learns from the diamond ball that this soul is in a child, but he does not know who it is.

If the child dies, Azazil dies at the same time. The magic of the wizard who imprisoned him in Pandora's box circulates in his blood.
The devils are gathering all the children in the villages. Azazil wants to detect the child with his own magic and neutralize this spell.

Then, a creature that takes Ares' son to the temple is shot by an archer and the child falls into the middle of a mountain, lonely and helpless.

Ares seeks the help of a most talented and knowledgeable wizard to find his son and avenge all that has happened.
and he goes on this way, his magic ability develops over time

Will Ares find his son?

Will he save the world?

What will happen to other peoples?

Is he alone?



  • Different melee weapon such as Ax, Sword, Teber, Bardiche, Bilhook, Dagger, Shield, Heavy Sword, Mace, Messer, Partisan, Angled Ax, Sax, Spear, Voulge, Warhammer and Zweihander

2131200.name: NeverSynth
2131200.about_the_game:
NeverSynth is a 3rd person game that is a rhythm driving simulator.
This game is a dynamic action game in which you have to drive a car to rhythmic music and collect beats. The more beats you collect, the more game points you earn.

RETROWAVE


Immerse yourself in the amazing world of retro wave and synth wave. Driving on an endless highway between skyscrapers and bright sunset will take you to the electronic past.

SPEED HIGHWAY

RHYTHM AND DYNAMICS

GAME FEATURES:

2131220.name: Neisis
2131220.about_the_game:
Welcome to Neisis, a 2D RTS game that immerses you in a fantastic medieval world where knights battle orcs for control of resources. In this game, you have the option to play either as the knights, with their well-equipped army and refined combat techniques, or the orcs, with their brute strength and tactical ingenuity.

At the start of each game, you will need to build your base, collect resources, train units, and devise a strategy to defeat your opponent. One of the main resources in the game is gold, which can be collected from gold mines located on the map. You will need to manage your economy carefully to construct buildings, train units, and make upgrades to make your army stronger.

Terrain is an important element in Neisis, with trees that can be chopped down to free up space and provide wood for building and defenses. Additionally, the map's topography can have an impact on battles, with hills offering a height advantage and rivers that can slow units.

Battles in Neisis are intense and strategic, with a wide variety of units to use to defeat your opponent. Knights have access to archers, swordsmen, and heavy knights, while orcs can train orcs, archer orcs, and heavy orcs. Each unit has its own strengths and weaknesses, so it's important to understand their use in different combat situations.

With colorful 2D graphics and immersive gameplay, Neisis is an RTS game that will appeal to strategy game fans. Are you ready to take on the challenge and conquer Neisis?

2131240.name: Battlestation
2131240.about_the_game:
Alone or with friends, Battlestation is a chaotic experience where you fight to protect your Space Station. You must defeat the enemy ships in time or they will pile up and destroy you. Unpack your space suit, refill your air tank and prepare yourself, they will come for you.

FRIENDS


Better with friends, up to 3 players.

MAKE THE RIGHT DECISION


To defeat your enemies, you and your friends must work as a team to craft ammo, load the cannon and shoot at the enemies. Pay attention to the enemy ships, their colours indicate the type of ammunition they are weak against.



WHO PUT THESE HERE


You have 20 Space stations to defend, but for some reason someone filled some of them with Deadly Laser Beams and Acid Pits.

2131260.name: Magnetism
2131260.about_the_game:

Think and plan your next moves to achieve the best result.

2131280.name: Ancient
2131280.about_the_game:
Ancient is a third person exploration action-adventure game with shooting mechanics built on the Valley of the Ancient Sample Project provided by Epic Games.

Play as Echo, a troubled girl, born with magical abilities, trying to find answers to her past after an experiment gone wrong stripped her of all memories.

After attempting to go back in time to find answers, the portal malfunctioned sending her back to 100 years after the collapse of the old civilization, the Panthynos. Now you must work your way back to the portal to get back to the present and find answers to your past.

Play the game however you like with all of the following planned features for 1.0 release!

--Doom Tower (Scale 100 floors in the Doom Tower, facing familiar enemies as it gets progressively more difficult.)

--Single player Campaign (A complete story that takes the player through many missions, facing challenging enemies and forging alliances. Discover lost ancient abilities, uncover your past and make your way home.)

--Modding Tools (A modding toolkit that allows for the creation, distribution, installation, and loading of mods allowing you, the player to build and design custom maps, stories, tools, basically anything. It's only limited by your creativity!)*

--Full Linux Support**

*Modding tools are not available at launch and will be released to all owners of the game once released.

**Linux is not currently supported, however, it is planned to be supported sometime before 1.0, likely early in release.

-Transparency and Copyright Disclaimers

Valley of the Ancient is a sample project released by Epic Games as a tech showcase for Unreal Engine 5, which is provided as a sample project and template for developers to use. Ancient is built on top of this project, to enable the best experience possible. Valley of the Ancient, and related characters, code, assets, or artwork are owned exclusively by Epic Games, Inc. and used by MinoDab Productions in ways pursuant to the Unreal Engine 5 End User License Agreement (EULA)

Ancient ©️ 2025, MinoDab Productions, All Rights Reserved

2131290.name: Iron Frontier
2131290.about_the_game:
Iron Frontier is a fresh look on Real Time Strategy genre. It blends multiple genres into a hot mix of tactics, strategy and roguelike action to create unique player experience with endless replayability. The game features campaign with a non-linear storyline, moral choices, and multiple endings.

Welcome back, Commander!

Create your army from dozens of units and structures. Command your troops, take advantageous positions, and hit the enemy where it hurts! Use airstrikes and other abilities to rain death on the battlefield!

Enhance your troops with hundreds of upgrades. Complete battle tasks to unlock new units, technologies and permanent upgrades. Create insane builds to turn the battleground into a kill zone!

In each mission, you'll face a moral choice that will affect the game's plot and ending. What sacrifices must be made to achieve victory? Is there a place for humanity in war? What is the price of betrayal? You'll have to answer these questions on the battleground.

See you on the battlefield!

HIGH-OCTANE EXPLOSIVE FUN

Step into the driver's seat and save Earth from an alien invasion in Guncar Arena! This high-stakes, top-down shooter blends bullet hell action with vehicular combat and roguelite elements for non-stop explosive fun.

As a fearless renegade, you'll pilot a muscle car loaded with weapons, taking on wave after wave of alien attackers. But this is no ordinary vehicle - upgrade your weapons, discover special powers and create a one-of-a-kind, unstoppable Guncar.

With fast-paced, drift-filled gameplay, every moment is a chance to prove your skills. So rev up your engine, keep your foot on the gas, and get ready to blast your way to victory!

2131350.name: My Coworker is an Idiot
2131350.about_the_game:
You are a new employee at a glass company. Your task is to deliver glass to a construction site. It's a tough job, but luckily your coworker Steve is here to help. What could go wrong?

This is a small hilarious game. There are 10 levels for you to play. Your goal is to deliver glass to a client. You can do it with an AI coworker. Or you can play with a friend.

2131360.name: Journeyman
2131360.about_the_game:
The catacombs are dark and rife with the stench of undeath. What manner of foes linger beneath the city, no one can say, but it can be suffered no longer. Train, gear up, and gather your party to journey below the graveyard city of Tombsteel. Steel yourselves, resurface, resupply, and strategize before braving the depths again.


Journeyman offers the familiar tactical, party-based combat of traditional CRPGs and tabletop RPGs while adapting the Souls-like ARPG feel. Instead of pausing and planning, each party member must rely on each other in Realtime. Gone are the days of THAC0 and auto-attacks.



Forget behing a henchman. Journeyman was designed for the ground up for co-op. Embark on quests by yourself or with friends, in scenarios designed for both configurations.



Play as a Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Paladin, Ranger, or Bard. Each class may choose to specialize or remain a generalist based on your party's unique needs. Pick from a vast assortment of familiar talents, situational tools, and lifesaving utilities, ensuring no two playstyles are alike. Rely on your allies for support as you hurl magic fireballs from afar or charge headfirst into the front lines.






No one is handing out quests. Prove yourself to the local lords, or keep an ear out for rumors after buying the local tavern-goers a few rounds. Will you side with the forces of justice or watch the world burn?



Hone your skills against fellow champions, testing out new build configurations. Journeyman features a mid-match progression system where you earn gold from kills to buy and sell gear to gain the upper hand.

2131380.name: Until Lights Out
2131380.about_the_game:
Everything was supposed to have been a beautiful Christmas, but it ended up being interrupted by a cursed and unknown curse..
Until Lights Out is inspired by a horror movie story where evil mostly dwells in darkness. A little girl named Claire will go through challenges and through her fears, in search of a possible answer, paranormal activities or just hallucinations, you are alone being watched by an entity whose origin is not known, solve puzzles in search of a truth and try to end the evil.

Main Features

- Small game includes puzzles.
- Explore one of Claire's house.
- The game offers its own atmosphere.
- Inspired by a horror movie

2131430.name: Wings of The Universe
2131430.about_the_game:
Wings of The Universe is an indie game inspired by game titles 'Space Rangers 2: Reboot' (PC game), 'Avorion' (PC game) and 'Interstellar Pilot' (mobile game).

Wings of The Universe is a game full of battles, diplomacies and trades. You can be a miner, merchant, warrior, diplomat or a strategist. You can build an empire with your friends and fight your foes, or become a pirate to promote chaos within other empires. There is only one galaxy, so make sure your name goes down in its history!

Important

In order to play, you have to register via game client or the game website. The game server is located in Europe, Germany. Players outside of Europe might face high internet latency issues.

Key Features:

  • single global map (the whole galaxy divided to 25 sectors and each sector is divided to 25 systems)
  • purely player based economy (there are no NPC shops, everything is made and sold by players)
  • galaxy domination, fights for resources
  • strategy and tactics - your type of equipment and chosen ship make the difference
  • bonuses for playing with other players in a long-term faction and a short-term squadron
  • chained missions and repeatable missions
  • non-pvp zone on starting map

Purely player-based economy

The space is empty. It is up to the players to create factions and build the space stations they need. Each station have different items it can interact with. This makes each station type have their own list of shop items and their own factory lines, which can consume the input items (mostly commodities) to create the output items (other commodities, ships or pieces of equipment). Players then set-up the shop prices, which can exclude some items from being bought or sold by the station or the player.

Strategy

Your equipment and skills matter! There are limitations on the ship equipment, but there are many types of equipment to choose from. Should you use projectile or energy weapons? Should your protection be against projectile or energy weapons? Should you take smaller or a bigger ship? Every target is different and one equipment strategy might not work all the time. Knowledge and reconnaissance is a key to survive. It also makes a difference if your strategy involves other players who can help achieve your goals.

Tactics

"I go first and you follow" can sometimes be followed by "Are you sure about that?" and Wings of The Universe is no exception. Especially when it comes to wars between players. Be prepared to be ambushed at all times. The space is vast and an enemy can come from any direction! Take a friend with you who will cover you or act as a bait for your own forces to counter an ambush. Prepare a carrier ship full of players to be safely transported to the war zone and be ready to be launched straight into battle.

2131460.name: Talon's Blade
2131460.about_the_game:
With four directions of attack and defense, the combat of Talon's Blade provides both a strategic and reactionary gameplay experience. Overwhelm your foe with a flurry of strikes, or wait for them to make the first move and punish their attack with a well-timed parry. Feint your attack to throw your opponent off balance or kick them off a ledge. You can focus on increasing your combo to cast a devastating spell or take an elixir to empower each strike. Feel the flow of combat as you deflect incoming attacks and respond with lethal strikes. Explore the strengths and weaknesses of each foe, looking for an opening to execute the killing blow.

The combos you create when attacking empower you to unleash devastating magical attacks upon your enemies. Conjure destructive fire storms, trap your enemies in entropic stasis, and summon lightning from the heavens to smite your foes. The higher the combo, the more potent the spell. How this power manifests depends on the spells you unlock throughout your adventure. The more adversaries you defeat, the more you can upgrade your arsenal of combo-finishing spells.

To arms! Discover eighteen unique weapon and armor sets, each with an array of attributes to customize your look and stats. Utilize the equipment that compliments your play style. Your equipment determines not only your damage and defense but also your attack speed and stamina cost of actions. Tailor your perfect combo of speed and lethality to devastate your foes.

Harvest potent alchemical ingredients from land and fallen foes to craft powerful elixirs to aid you on your journey. Brew some soul elixirs to regenerate your magic, craft firebombs to set your enemies and fields alight, and create healing potions or harmful poisons.

Talon's Blade is the tale of one man's quest for vengeance, set within a medieval dark fantasy world where war-ravaged lands have been brought to the brink of collapse. Take control of Marcus Veridius as he embarks to find the one who betrayed him. Make deals with a demon, cast powerful spells, brew and utilize potent elixirs, choose who to help and abandon, take on ancient ghosts from forgotten worlds, and fight your way to the heart of the corruption that plagues these war-torn lands.

For 20 years war has been waged across the land. For 20 years the soldiers of the Southern Empire and the Rasnayan Legion have clashed. In a bid to bring the war to a decisive close, the Emperor has sent his elite force of agents, known only as the Talons, on a covert operation with the hopes of turning the tides of war.

But all is not what it seems within the Empire. Treason has led to the capture and near extinction of the Talons.

Marauding outlaws and pirates threaten the livelihood of villages on the fringes of the Empire

Soldiers betray and exploit the very people they swore an oath to protect

Blood spawn of an ancient and vile demon have ascended from the depths of the earth, driven by the war and chaos that washes the lands above in blood.

The world, seeded with a plague of war and corruption, has begun to tear itself apart
Experience the journey of Marcus Veridius as he is set on a path of vengeance to find and kill the ones responsible for the deaths of his fellow Talons.
