2131500.name: Waifu Packer
2131500.about_the_game:
Waifu Packer is puzzle game where you try to fit tiles into boxes by moving them around on a grid. Each level you unlock an image of a beautiful waifu which will be waiting for you in the gallery!

Your goal is to fit all the tiles into the game area, avoiding possible obstacles. You can drag and drop tiles and rotate them in space. Each level you will unlock new tiles with various shapes. The game escalates in complexity, in the first levels you will learn how to play (no boring tutorial needed) and in the later levels you will scratch your head and ponder!

  • Lots of different waifus, both cute and nude!
  • Game area with increasing sizes and obstacles
  • 40 levels with increasing difficulty
  • Fun and polished gameplay (we mean, really fun!)
  • Authentic hentai female moans
  • Different levels with different tiles, obstacles and game area size
  • Increasing difficulty from absolutely trivial to challenging

How does the game work?

When you start a level, there will be lots of tiles placed out randomly over the game area. To make the level more interesting, the reward image of the girl is presented as a blurred background which will sharpen when you complete the level. Some of these girls are regular women, some are sexy maids, others are magical nymphomaniacs, but they all come in different body

We've built a custom puzzle engine from scratch that allows for very highly polished gameplay and fine control over the smallest details and game feel.

2131510.name: Distorted Echos
2131510.about_the_game:
After crashing into an Alien planet called Yolk, You find yourself oblivious and left alone with your AI companion , Find your way through the unknown, discover the mysteries of Yolk and find out what happened to you and everyone else!

In this action-adventure experience, players find themselves stranded in an alien planet called Yolk,
The main objective of this game is to survive harsh threats of the Yolk and uncover the protagonist's lost memories, players will face numerous threats including Alien species ,Cyborgs, Drones, Anomaly entities, Corrupted Robots which once were used to serve human scientists on Yolk research stations. Moreover, there are numerous unknown mysteries and hidden threats waiting to be discovered.



In Distorted Echos, Players can find and use various tools and equipment, Including Weapons, crafting materials, Scanners , explosives and etc. this game supports inventory management system which allows the player to carry, craft ,consume and manage different items depending on their goals. Also players occasionally need to solve puzzles and challenges such as Security hacks and overriding control panels to proceed forward in the story.



The environment in this game includes vast terrains with abandoned research stations, Mysterious Monuments, and structures with secret obscurities. Throughout the story, player has an AI companion named F.L.A.R.A which assists the player with her tips and helps to narrate the story during the gameplay.

This game is currently in development stage and yet to be released, according to the game's road map ,further features have been planned to be developed in future design pipeline, including more environmental Threats and events such as Acid Rains and Meteor showers, Player Buildable structures such as Tents , Shelter and extended levels and environment design.

2131520.name: Bottle
2131520.about_the_game:
Bottle is a 2D pixel-based platformer, that may or may not have rage-like elements (depends on how good you get at it).

Features:
  • Multiple bottles to choose from, with different jump powers and centers of mass.
  • Collect coins to permanently gain max hearts.
  • Definitely no secrets in this game. Don't even look for any!

Trailer Music by AleXZavesa from Pixabay

2131530.name: Lewd Guest NTR 🍓
2131530.about_the_game:
Lewd Guest is a visual novel about a guy who lost his job. Eventually, he can't afford to rent his apartment anymore and is forced to move out, but gladly his ex-colleague Steve invites him to live in his apartment until our hero finds a new job.

He accepts the offer and moves to his ex-colleague's apartment, but as it turns out Steve doesn't live alone. He has a girlfriend named Chloe, who turns out to be a very beautiful woman who has a lot of things in common with the hero. And for some reason Steve is completely okay with them being alone together while he goes to work.

Will he accept the upcoming changes in his relationship with Chloe, or will he break up with her and let you to be together - depends on your choices...

2131550.name: Fishing Online
2131550.about_the_game:
Fishing Online lets you explore the joy of fishing in beautiful natural settings—online. Join friends or global players and experience a relaxing fishing life together.

■ The Fun of Fishing

Your fishing journey begins! When you hook a fish, the real challenge begins as you battle to reel it in. Simple controls meet unique fish behavior patterns that deliver that satisfying fishing thrill.

■ Stylized Cartoon Graphics

Experience nature brought to life through warm, cartoon-style visuals. Rivers, lakes, and a wide range of unique fish await you.

■ Cooking & Gathering

Raise your catches or turn them into tasty meals. Collect ingredients from the wild to cook dishes that provide helpful fishing buffs. You can also craft your own tools.

■ Online Play

Connect with friends or players worldwide. Explore maps inspired by locations around the globe and enjoy the game together.

■ Frequent Updates

We're a small indie development team, but we're committed to listening to player feedback and providing regular updates.

Fish Encyclopedia: View your catches, records, and rankings.

Personal Pond: Raise various fish and decorative species.

Fishing Tournaments: Compete globally and earn rewards based on rank.

Fishing Area Expansion: Plans to expand from freshwater to ocean fishing.

Co-op Play: Raid content to catch special fish with friends is in development.

2131620.name: Don't Hide
2131620.about_the_game:
Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely.

Don't Hide offers a horror experience where you're forced to manage the monster and explore the surroundings. Nothing is easy to find, as you'll always be surrounded by dreadful darkness. You'll be left searching for five barely illuminated keys, all scattered around the maze. However, your time is limited, as the creature trapped in the maze with you will will eventually catch your scent. Be sure to run away when close, and if it hasn't fully caught your scent, hide to get it off your tracks.

Don't Hide offers 6 different levels, all with varying difficulty and predetermined initial key, object, and exit door locations. A 3 star system will help rank your performance in each room. At least one star is required to progress to the next room.

Developed in Godot, this game was a side project of mine that I learned along with Godot. Updates may proceed the release with more levels, objects, or features. Its more than likely that I will release balance changes as well as more and more people play the game and test out the ranking system as well as the minor and major time (scent) limits.

Controls:
WASD = movement
Space = hide
Escape = open/close menu (pauses game), or go back to previous menu
Enter/Left Click = Select

Objectives
Find all five keys
With 5 Keys, find the exit door
Don't get caught by the creature

Credits
Sole developed: T0rt1z (Shawn F.)

2131630.name: METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version
2131630.about_the_game:
Released in 1998, this was the first 3D title in the METAL GEAR series. The game pioneers 3D stealth action against the threat of war and global nuclear weapons, using live action footage, cinematic cut scenes, interwoven with innovative gameplay.
The storyline, a whirlwind of intrigue and betrayal, has been hailed as the greatest story of the 20th century and was the third title in the METAL GEAR series to become a hit in subsequent years.

Also included: Metal Gear, Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake, an exclusive digital Screenplay Book and Master Book that details the story and characters in Metal Gear Solid and Metal Gear & Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake.

2131660.name: Call of the Golden Valley
2131660.about_the_game:
Call of the Golden Valley is a thrilling true crime-like mystery game with an immersive narrative set in a charming but eerie Australian country town.

You play as Danielle, an American tourist travelling to an old town in the Australian countryside to visit her friend Marisa. Upon arrival, you discover that Marisa is not only nowhere to be found, but that she’s actually one of the many people who have recently vanished without a trace from this seemingly harmless small country town.

In order to save your friend, you must search the internet for clues, solve mysterious puzzles and uncover the conspiracy behind the vanishing hikers of Golden Valley.

Find Evidence

Piece together the story by solving compelling puzzles, deciphering clues contained within objects you find and conversing with the quirky townsfolk of a small country town in the Australian outback.

Build your Theory

Use your deduction board to connect the dots between the evidence you’ve gathered through searching the in-game internet and by exploring the local environment. 

Uncover the Conspiracy


Discover all of this seemingly innocent country town’s secrets and solve the mystery of Golden Valley’s vanishing hikers before it’s too late to save your friend’s life.

Call of the Golden Valley takes most players between 5 and 10 hours to complete.

The game features six levels. In each level you will gain a new ability, which is required to reach the primary exit. Each level has also a hidden collectable (a cat). Find all the collectables to unlock the final exit and win the game! Some levels will need to be revisited after gaining abilities in order to reach the cat.

2131680.name: METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake
2131680.about_the_game:
Metal Gear
The first title in the METAL GEAR series, released in 1987. This praised game series was born from the idea of avoiding combat and infiltrating enemy territory undetected, a complete reversal of common action gameplay resulting in the creation of a brand-new game genre: stealth action.

Please note that certain parts of the game have been modified from the original for better payability and adjusted difficulty levels, while maintaining the gameplay as it was back then.

Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake
This is the second title in the METAL GEAR series that establishes the basic mechanics of the series, such as crouching to avoid detection, intentionally attracting enemies by banging on walls, enemies reacting to Snake's footsteps, a radar to detect enemy locations, actions and movements.

It also depicts the motivations behind BIG BOSS' actions, the fate of soldiers with no nation left to fight for, and a complex narrative that has become an iconic characteristic of the series.

2131700.name: Infinite Miner
2131700.about_the_game:
“Infinite Miner” has two elements. First is Rogue-like. Destroy a large number of asteroids with a spaceship, collect resources, level up, strengthen weapons, and defeat enemies repeatedly to clear the stage. Second is Hack and slash. After clearing a stage, player can use the points earned to strengthen their equipment and clear the next stage. You can experience the exhilaration of defeating a large number of enemies and powerup weapons.

Key Features


Reroll equipment for power up in between stages

　Reroll equipment using points collected during stage play. Repeatedly reroll to create your own equipment to Aim to clear the next stage. If you want to attack a large area, repeat the whole reroll until you have multiple mods for range expansion, then reroll only the value of the mod. It is a fun way to reflect one's individuality in one's equipment.
　The maximum value of mods is increased by craft level. The crafting level is increased by the resources spent on rerolling, so the more you reroll, the better equipment you will get. This is why it is “Infinite”.

Overwhelming volume of enemies
　As in some balloon game, when a higher level rock is destroyed, a lower level rock appears. That lower level rock will cause even lower level rocks to appear. ...... Anyway, destroy a lot of enemies!

2131780.name: Pure-hearted Gyaru and the Shape of Happiness
2131780.about_the_game:
"純情ギャルと幸せのカタチ ～Shape of Happiness～" is a novel game in which the protagonist, is troubled by the gap between the past and the present of a childhood friend whom he has reunited after several years. Seeking an answer to their relationship.
This Bishojo Game released in 2018 under the "Gold Drip" brand has been reworked for the "CS Novel Club" platform for players of all ages worldwide to enjoy.

◆ Introduction
"... It's a promise! I am going to be Yota's wife!"
Several years later...

"... Is that you, Yota? You haven't changed at all.Oh, you know who I am, right?"
The childhood friend I was looking forward to seeing again is now the complete opposite of what he expected...

◆Synopsis
"... It's a promise! I am going to be Yota's wife!"
When the protagonist "Yota Kawara" was young, he promised to marry his childhood friend in the future.

Several years later, Yota returns to the place of his memories at Shiou Gakuen.
"... Is that you, Yota? You haven't changed at all. Oh, you know who I am, right?"
Yota's excitement about his new life at school is in disarray, when he is reunited with his childhood friend who is now a "Gyaru"...

◆Characters
・Michi Haneda
Yota's childhood friend.
Although she looks like a "Gyaru", she is rather intelligent.
She remembers her promise with Yota even to this day, and will often introduce him by announcing "This guy right here is my fiance!!".
Not only does she excel in her studies, even entering Shiou Gakuen, but she is also great at cooking and housework.
She is in love with Yota and tries to take care of him in his daily life.

・Mayuki Itoi
Michi's friend.
A "Gyaru" who sounds simple-minded when she speaks.
She is an energetic mood maker.
Her stylish outfits are often very revealing.
Studying is not her strong suit, but she somehow manages day by day.
She is the one responsible for transforming Michi into a "Gyaru", and even taught her how to dress and "Gyaru" fashion.

・Natsuko Harekawa
Yota's classmate.
She has many hidden fans due to her beautiful appearance.
However, her gloomy personality leads the people around her to leave her alone. She is often reading books by herself.
She is perplexed as to why Michi is constantly trying to talk to her.
However, she is actually very kind-hearted and not just gloomy.

・Yota Kawara
He is slightly advanced in studying since Shiou Gakuen is rather a top-tier school.
Rather than doing sports or anything outdoors, he prefers staying indoors.
He hasn't forgotten his promise with Michi, but he becomes more shocked seeing her transformation.

2131800.name: Gimmick! Special Edition
2131800.about_the_game:
An old-school challenge enhanced for the modern player


SUNSOFT's NES™ classic Gimmick! returns in this long-wished-for Special Edition from City Connection. Experience a stunning physics-based platformer with updated features like online leaderboards, achievements, a time attack mode, save and quick load, a rewind function, a gorgeous gallery (with cartridges, art, and scanned manuals), and more.

Stellar platform physics with a bouncing star


Explore a physics-based playground that was way ahead of its time. As the cute youkai Yumetaro, use your star-summoning powers to tackle complex challenges with creativity and finesse. Your wonderful star will help you reach hidden spots, traverse cliffs, and pull off trick shots that outwit even the toughest baddies!

Discover a hidden NES™ treasure


Gimmick! was exclusively released on Famicom™/NES™ in Japan and Scandinavia in the early ‘90s. It pushed the console to its limits and the Japanese cartridge featured SunSoft 5B, a custom sound chip that let Masashi Kageyama compose a star-studded soundtrack. Gimmick! remains one of the most valuable (and rarest) NES™ cartridges ever made. The Scandinavian version was called “Mr. Gimmick”.

Uncover secrets in a race against time!


Gimmick! Special Edition features a time attack mode for speedrunners, and completionists can hunt for secrets all throughout the game. Unlock a wonderful surprise by finding everything. For a hard-core challenge, disable all quality-of-life features in "Serious Mode" to crank up the excitement!

Modern enhancements:

  • Achievements
  • Time Attack Mode
  • Online Leaderboards
  • Save and Quick Load
  • Rewind Function
  • Gallery mode
  • Sound test

2131860.name: Ashfall
2131860.about_the_game:
GAME FEATURES

Embark on a Unique Adventure

Step into an Eastern-inspired wasteland overworld. Brave the dangers of what remains of civilization, exploring every zone in search of the Core of Creation. Immerse yourself in a rich storyline with diverse equipment and a robust talent system at your disposal.


Find Your Combat Style

Ashfall features 9 distinct shooting styles, each born from a unique blend of talents, equipment, and visceral shooting mechanics. Encounter Friends and Foes

The wasteland needs not to be a lonely place. Fortunately for you, you can team up with your friends, build your guild, and undertake uniquely designed challenges, together! But be aware – you may also face off against other Wanderers in blood-pumping PvP zones.


Explore the Secret Realms

For Wanderers who want to venture beyond the boundaries of the overworld, there is more to experience in the Secret Realms, with expansive territories (over 200km!) to explore. You will find intricate puzzles, intense combat events, and many challenging medium- and large-sized bases waiting to be occupied. With a high degree of freedom and combat strategy, the Secret Realms promise a unique gaming experience.

2132080.name: Vexation: Hand Crafted Hell
2132080.about_the_game:
Vexation is the only rage game that's fun to play!

Every level is a different genre and art style all packaged within their own little pockets of terrible game design. But while fun, it's still a rage game...


The entire idea of the game was to remove the issue of players who don't want to have to repeat the same sections of a game over and over again due to its difficulty. That's why the order of levels you play is different every time you die and there's plenty of content to be seen outside of the main ten levels.

However, all that considered, it is still a rage game. I've tried my best to create a fun environment; but there's a big difference between playing a game and trying to beat it.

The challenges that you will face on your journey.


Ten levels, each with a collection of the worst tropes from across gaming history! You will need to complete all of them in a row without dying to claim victory over this ultimate challenge. Learn the levels, the tricks, the specific setups and attempt to overcome them all!

  • Snooker Sneaker - The broken controls, physics based, escort level.
  • Reactive Reactor - The clunky UI, quick time event, reactionary level.
  • Coffin Climb - The ice physics, darkness, platformer level.
  • Drawn Out Battle - The slow, repetitive, boring, RPG fight level.
  • Speed Dating - The tight timed, ratchet movement, pushing level.
  • Catch the Wave - The resource management, tank controlled level.
  • Harold Hunt - The needle in a haystack, distraction filled level.
  • Slide Tide - The underwater, sliding puzzle, fetch quest level.
  • All you can do is Jump - The invisible object, lack of control level.
  • Don't Point Blanks - The fast paced, limited bullet, shooter level.

The Digital Palace that you will explore throughout your experience.


This is the central hub for accessing everything in the game. You get to choose how many spaces to move so you can plan accordingly to overcome the board. Travel to levels, collect harm cards and visit the shop! Find your way through to the exit by beating every obstacle!

  • Level Space - Allows you to access one of the ten levels you have to beat!

2132160.name: Mistress vs Slave
2132160.about_the_game:
Due to being born a girl, you were denied your birthright of becoming the ruler of your kingdom. All is not lost, however, as you make your intention known to become the queen. It's not an easy path, and you will have to maneuver politically between the royalist Summer Party that support your cousin, the duke, and the Winter Party that seeks more power to the common noble. Not only this, you'll have to balance your influence among the general populace, the military, and even the church, if you are to win the coveted throne and become the heir.

Your trump card is the elf princess that was captured during the war and sent to you as a gift. Your goal is to train her and make use of her politically, as she may hold the key to making the difference between failure and success.



But all is not peaceful in the kingdom. If you make poor decisions, you may doom your kingdom to defeat by the vicious orcs that threaten the southern border. You may even end up as a prisoner slave in one of their camps, where you'll be paraded as a trophy and worse. In such cases, you will have to use all your ingenuity and skill to make your escape and change your fortune.



Of course, if you're politically savvy and make good decisions, you can defeat the orcs and even enslave one of their leaders. Training a powerful orc to be your slave could raise your prestige and may offer your unique opportunities, both financially and politically.



But again... if you make the wrong decisions, you may have the tables turned on you and find yourself becoming enslaved.

To sum, "Mistress vs Slave" is a mix of political sim with visual novel elements, coupled with role-playing, and sexual content.

2132190.name: Capoeirogue
2132190.about_the_game:
Capoeirogue: Dandara Cordão de Ouro
is a Roguelike about capoeira that mixes afro-descendant culture in Brazil and fantasy, through the game mechanics you will experience elements that were of great importance to our history. Capoeirogue is inspired by acclaimed games of the genre like Bastion, Hades, Zombies ate my neighbors and other giants of the genre;

Features

  • Fight over a procedural generated map in this topdown action roguelike;
  • Rescue prissioners to increase your power;
  • Get Random Blessing Capoeira moves and Make your own build;
  • Survive to enemies waves.

Fight for freedom
The protagonist Dandara is based on the real Brazilian heroine who fought against slavery until the end of her life, was considered queen of Quilombo dos Palmares, the largest quilombo that existed in Latin America; In addition to being a great leader, hunter, mother, Dandara was also an excellent capoeirista.

Orixás
Exú, Ogun, Omulu, Xapanã or Abaluaiê, Xangô, Yasan, Oxossi, Nanan, Yemanjá, Oxum, Oxunmarê, Ossain and Oxalá. The orixás here will give aid and axé to Dandara, taking into account its unique characteristics. There are thousands of viable Character Builds to discover as you progress.


Capoeira
Capoeira is a cultural representation that mixes sport, fight, dance, popular culture, music and games. It is characterized by agile and complex movements, where feet, hands and gymnastic-acrobatic elements are used. A skill tree based on real capoeira movements is the main differential of the game, here you can try different combinations of blows that will make each run unique.

Environment
The game takes place in Brazil in the 1600s, bringing several elements of our culture that were directly influenced by the African culture in our country.

2132220.name: Polestar
2132220.about_the_game:
Polestar is a classic Turn-Based RPG set in a fantasy-western world. Boasting a unique hand-drawn style, you'll battle enemies with Timed-Hits to delay their attacks, decide between keeping equipment or breaking it down to harness it's latent abilities, and decipher the mysterious insignia that seems to be following our hero, Hale, across the continent of Graydon.







Dive into a fully illustrated world inspired by classic japanese role playing games of days long gone! Investigate the painted landscapes with 2D animated characters while traversing the vast sun-kissed deserts, beautiful coasts and decaying waterways of the world of Polestar.





A modern twist on the traditional Active Time Battle system offering the ability to disrupt enemy attacks with devastating Timed-Hits. Battle against a diverse array of ridiculous enemies, frightening foes and threatening bosses!





Saloons, Locomotives, Wanted Posters and Stoats. Polestar is a world overlooking a precipice of change. From cowtowns like Haevstock, looking back on it’s golden years with mournful eyes, to Beckbrum, a dazzling city filled with new technology and illicit undetones – There’s plenty of room for misadventure.





Join our protagonist Hale on his journey and meet a wild ensemble of characters. From sleazy merchants and notable thieves to murderous bounty hunters and worst of all - government officials.

2132260.name: Eight Dragons 2
2132260.about_the_game:
Eight Dragons 2 is an action-packed arcade beat-'em-up for up to 8 players. Build your crew and take on the gangs that rule the city in this side-scrolling brawler, fighting waves of unforgiving enemies in a vibrant 2D world!

Ultimate 8 Player Co-op

Join forces in local or online multiplayer for chaotic cooperative gameplay, coordinating epic takedowns in increasingly huge battles. Mix and match up to eight players in any combination of local or online players across all platforms.

Retro Arcade Action

Dive into classic side-scrolling combat, blending nostalgic arcade vibes with modern mechanics and stunning pixel graphics. Drop-in/drop-out multiplayer, with progress automatically saved as you play so your effort is never wasted.

Dynamic Characters

Choose from 8 unique characters, each with distinct fighting styles and special moves. Learn their strengths and weaknesses and play as whichever best suits your style!

Solo Multiplayer

Even playing a solo game you don't have to take on your enemies all by yourself. Recruit fighters to join your team - you never have to fight alone!

Thrilling Environments

Fight through four diverse districts, from neon-lit streets to gritty slums, crushing enemies and brutal bosses with fists or improvised weapons.

Classic Side-Scrolling Combat

Smash through enemies in vibrant 2D pixel art, with intuitive controls for any controller or keyboard.

Choose Your Path

Fight your way around the city or test your skills and go straight for the final boss - the choice is yours!

Enjoy the chaos of massive battles through the streets as you fight to reclaim them, solo or with your crew!

Eight Dragons 2: Fight alone. Fight together. Fight everybody!

2132270.name: Robotization: The Last Human
2132270.about_the_game:
2018.

A secret organization has completed the construction of a complex for space exploration, as well as for the development of technology to robotize humans for military purposes.

At this time, strange meteorites fell to Earth, and no one suspected that they contained something terrible inside.

2019.

The virus in the meteorites began to spread rapidly, taking over the mind and body of almost all people. Through this process, robotization broke out beyond the walls of the complex, threatening all of humanity.

It won't let me die...

Robotization: The Last Human - a first-person survival-horror game in which you have to survive in a world full of horrors. Be afraid of unknown creatures and lose your last hope for salvation.

Survive in this scary world where you are completely alone...

Immerse yourself in the story of Alex, the character you will play as. Fight with your sanity, save resources, create items, defend or escape, explore a variety of locations, trust no one.

Will you remain the last person who cares about everything?

You survived for a reason. Someone or something desired it. Someone or something sought to destroy humanity.

Survival

You will be able to find various items that will help you create things for defense, distraction, and healing. However, remember to conserve your resources - they will not be enough. To increase your ability to create items, you will need to find a workbench.

Combat System

It's not always possible to hide and run, so all that's left is to try to fight back. Find bricks, stones, bottles, sticks and pieces of pipes or create explosive devices from the resources you've collected. Use these opportunities only as your last chance to escape.

2132310.name: Caveshifter
2132310.about_the_game:
Fight in the shifting darkness

  • Fight your way through a living, mysterious labyrinth where danger lurks in every corner.

    Engage in combat which blends fast-paced hack’n’slash action with the weight and precision of souls-like games. All this served in classic roguelike fashion.

Craft your power

  • Find gear, enchant weapons and make your artifacts more powerful.

    Dive into deep itemization systems - Caveshifter is designed around build variety, character customization and meaningful progression. Your inventory is limited to a weapon and two powerful trinkets, so... choose wisely and take good care of them.

    Craft your... dungeons?

    • Use powerful runes to shift the path ahead. Choose your rewards, alter enemies, or summon new rooms. Embrace the Caves - decide if they oppose you or serve you.

Explore the unknown

  • Every run is different - new rooms, new choices, new rewards. Explore a large ever-changing network of caves and uncover all of its secrets. This game is built around replayability as a core design pillar.

2132350.name: Train World
2132350.about_the_game:
Train World is a railroad simulation game set throughout the ages of the railroad. Test your railway network against the passage of time as you continually upgrade your trains from basic steam locomotives to complex, multi-engine haulers. Transport passengers, move thousands of tonnes of cargo, and manage your increasingly busy network as the centuries fly by!

DESIGN A RAILWAY NETWORK THAT CAN WITHSTAND CENTURIES



Can you build a rail network that can withstand centuries? Plan your network, build new stations manage your train lines, and research new technologies and train types! As you continue to expand, unlock new regions - allowing you to grow your network and access beautiful locations and additional passengers and cargo types!

Train World features multiple types of bridges, tunnels, and tracks - as well as more than 30 different types of cargo to transport - meaning that you can truly build the network of your dreams!

LOGISTICS AND STRATEGY WITH QUALITY-OF-LIFE FEATURES!



Train World features logistics and strategy - from a fully-fledged research system spanning 3 time periods, dozens of different locomotives and wagons to build your own train sets, and a dynamic economy system - whilst retaining all the quality-of-life features you could need!

Feeling impatient? Speed up time! Need some direction or extra cash? Train World features an achievements system, giving you optional objectives to complete. Want a high-level view of your network? Choose between a classical top-down view or a more detailed view upon zooming in.

SPACE FOR YOUR CREATIVITY



Train World features maps ranging from small 33X33 km (20X20 miles) to huge 197X197 km (120X120 miles), with plenty of room to build your railway network. Different biomes and relief types provide beautiful scenery.

Maps are divided into regions that can be opened during the game. Each region has its industry, adding another strategic component to the gameplay.

FEATURES

  • Dozens of locomotive and car options to build your train sets!
  • A research tree that spans 3 time periods, each with distinct visuals, trains, and infrastructure.
  • A dynamic economy system, featuring over 150 unique types of cargo to transport.
  • Multiple types of bridges, tunnels, and tracks are used to construct your network.
  • A passenger and cargo system, each with its own stations and infrastructure.
  • An optional objective system for earning cash - and providing direction if needed.
  • Beautiful maps with plenty of space for your rail network.
  • Choose between a high-level top-down view, or a more zoomed-in, detailed view!

2132370.name: Suns of Wiraqocha
2132370.about_the_game:
Suns of Wiraqocha is a 2D adventure game where you must help the great God Wiraqocha to recover the suns stolen by the evil gods Yanañamca and Tutañamca, lords of darkness and night as they were known in the ancient Inca legends. You will be able to select one of the Auquis or minor gods to help the God Wiraqocha recover the suns that are found in the different dimensional labyrinths where the evil gods Yanañamca and Tutañamca, lords of darkness and night as they were known, have hidden them. in ancient Inca legends. When you collect all the suns in a level, you will be able to access other levels through the Great Gate of the Sun to continue recovering all the hidden suns and thus save life in the Milky Way. As you advance in level, you will release new Auqis that will help you recover the stolen suns.

The Auqis on Earth take the forms of various creatures of the earth that are represented in the famous Nazca lines in Peru: the monkey, the hummingbird and the spider. In Suns of Wiraqocha you can play with some of these Auquis such as the monkey, the spider or the hummingbird. Now, your mission will be to choose one of the Auquis and recover the suns that have been hidden in the different worlds.

As you recover the lost suns, you will see how the great Puerta del Sol will light up again. And legend says that when you finish releasing all the suns, the great God Wiraqocha will return to the Andes and prevent a new darkness from withering life on Earth.

Suns of Wiraqocha is the first video game designed under the pixel art pattern on Netdreams. Based on the legends and myths of the Inca and Tiwanaku cultures that were located in present-day Peru and Bolivia.

Myths and legends behind the video game

The game represents the eternal fight between light and darkness that exists in all cultures of the world. In the world of the Incas, the champion of light is the great God Wiraqocha. This God usually works accompanied by his minor gods known as Auquis. Wiraqocha and his Auquis protect the light of the sun, a light that helps life develop and drives away evil spirits of the night. The Auquis, whom humans frequently saw on earth, were represented in multiple ways in the astronomical calendar of Nazca, known as The Nazca Lines, that great astral calendar located in southern Peru.

The darkness was the territories of the great Gods Yanañamca and Tutañamca, lords of darkness and night as they were known in ancient Inca legends. These great Gods are Wiraqocha's enemies not only on Earth but throughout our multiverse and their fight has cosmic dimensions.

Old legends say that when man appeared on Earth, our planet was still a cold and dark place and the forces of light and darkness were in constant conflict. One day, the great God Wiraqocha appeared in the Andes and illuminated the skies with sunlight. In the Tiwanaku region, The Great Gate of the Sun was created, a dimensional portal for the gods that the inhabitants used as a place of veneration when the first rays of light that the God Wiraqocha offered to the world arrived.

However, in the heavens there is still a great rivalry between light and darkness. For this reason, the God Wiraqocha had to head to other dimensions to keep the light victorious. The evil gods Yanañamca and Tutañamca, Wiraqocha's great enemies, took the opportunity to take revenge by stealing the suns of the Milky Way. They both stole all the suns in our galaxy, leaving our world, Earth, in deep darkness. Both gods are represented by the two most dangerous creatures of the Andes: the Puma, the big cat of the Andes that is characterized by its strength, and the great snake Amaru, the anaconda of the Andes. These demons roamed the Earth and other living worlds to prevent either the local residents or the Auquis from being able to recover the suns.

The darkness had no end and men prayed to the Great God Wiraqocha for help, hoping that he would not let life on earth wither. Wiraqocha took pity on the men and sent the Auquis to him. The Great God Wiraqocha sent them with the mission to rescue the stolen suns to prevent life from withering on Earth and the other worlds that could be accessed through the Great Gate of the Sun.
2132370.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal

2132380.name: Book of Korvald
2132380.about_the_game:
Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.



Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...



- Over 50 different female characters complete with sexual encounters. All raw, hot and fully animated.




Maps / Environments / Areas:
- Each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning over 30 areas. Starting in Denmark near the city of Ribe, drawing inspiration from the conversion to Christianity that took place around the 9th century in Scandinavia.

Weapons:
- 200+ different weapons to find or buy from various shops. Axes, Swords, Maces, Whips, Spears, Flails, Daggers, Shields, and Books (yes books).

Artifacts:
- 30+ different artifacts and special off-hand weapons to equip. You could raise the dead Templar knights as zombie minions, inflict plagues on nearby enemies, and even cause certain NPCs (and even some enemies) to strip naked (because... why not?).

Runes:
- Korvald will discover the true meaning and origin of runes and runestones. Utilizing his unique insight into this powerful language, he will gain the ability to harness many destructive and helpful forces. Unleash flaming cyclones, lightning storms, arctic blizzards, healing waters and even summon eldritch creatures to aid you in combat.



Even More To Behold
-A talent tree comprised of 15 different talents that you can customize
-Over 30 unique boss battles
-Minigames (fishing, farming, ale brewing, drinking contests, arena battles)
-A repeatable roguelike dungeon system
-Unlockable galleries for repeat viewing of cinematics and sex scenes
-Fully voiced characters

2132410.name: Absorption Battle Racing
2132410.about_the_game:
Ultra high octane racing where you must absorb your fellow racers with your body! Absorption Battle Racing takes sexy girls and puts them in futuristic racing combat in trubite to games such as "Wipeout" and "Sonic Riders" but adds a twist of sexiness to the track. By absorbing fellow racers or being attacked by hazards on the track such as orcs or alien plants, this is racing like you have NEVER seen before!



Nattou Bomb joins with Shady Corner the creator of "Shady Lewd Kart" the worlds first lewd Kart racer to bring this Japanese take on lewd racing to steam! Now in English and Japanese!



-Take on the lewdest battle race in Championship Mode
-Explore themed tracks that will twist, turn and dive!
-Go head to head in Time Attack to break the clock...maybe even a womb.
-Over 30 racers on the roster to choose from!
-Use your skills to take down fellow racers and mess them up with sexual traps and moves!
-Create your own custom waifu to race around and "absorb"
-Loads of costumes, hairstyles and color schemes for you to customize your racer!
-Buy upgrades such as costumes, engines and custom sex positions for your girls!
-Direct sex scenes and absorbing modes in Gallery mode with dozens of unlockable positions and animations!
-Japanese and English text for the first time!

(All characters in game are 18 and over)

2132430.name: XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX
2132430.about_the_game:
XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX

XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX is your classic too-hard-to-actually-enjoy-it horror hacking game in the likes of Welcome To The Game, featuring a motel room, a computer, a hacker and a few dozen dark web pages for you to explore.

To complete the game, you must explore all 100 dark web pages and complete all three NSA hacking minigames.

Anxiety

As you explore The Dark Web, your anxiety increases. High anxiety causes your paranoid mind to experience more severe hallucinations. To relieve some of the stress and afford your medicine, you need to earn money - either by scamming people, managing a botnet, finding hidden links or beating hacking minigames. If left unmanaged, the monsters appearing in your hallucinations will kill you.

Hitmen

You are hunted by hitmen, sent by your former coworkers. You must utilize intelligence gathering websites you've found on The Dark Web to gather enough information on the hitmen to get rid of them before they get rid of you. Investigate your enemies by searching their phone number, online usernames, cryptocurrency addresses and other Personally identifiable information.

Roguelike

Every time you die, your whole progress is reset and you have to start over. A successful run takes around 90 minutes. Every death gives you detailed explanation and there are only minimal luck-based mechanics.

Upgrade

As you browse The Dark Web, you will gain experience. You can spend experience and money on your tools' upgrades, increasing their efficiency. It's up to you to prioritize which tool to upgrade.

Hardcore

This is a tough game and you will die many times. A combination of ever-increasing cost of your medicine, constant stream of hitmen trying to hunt you and terrifying hallucinations caused by your worsening mental state will put you under constant pressure and challenge your skills.

2132450.name: Spectator
2132450.about_the_game:
You are a spectator, working remotely to monitor a CCTV system for suspicious activity. However ordinary the places you monitor might seem, they are sites of paranormal phenomena. Your job is not just to watch, but to identify anomalies that happen and apply the proper countermeasures. Be cautious: Whatever lurks out there will eventually notice it's being watched - and when it starts staring back, it might be too late...

  • Set in unsettling, everyday places, Spectator taps into the chilling world of creepypasta, drawing inspiration from stories like Slender and the Backrooms to create a deeply disturbing, eerie experience that keeps shifting just when you think you're safe.

  • Six distinct environments to monitor and observe. Each level can have over sixty different anomalies, generated procedurally to guarantee unpredictability.

  • Every playthrough is uniquely challenging and scary. Miss too many of the anomalies before 6 AM comes around and whatever's out there will come for you.

  • Spectator supports ultra-wide screen resolutions, touchscreens, and controllers out of the box, complete with a realistic visual style to enhance the experience.

  • Community translations were integrated into the game, allowing Spectator to support over 29 languages!

2132460.name: Mr. Healer
2132460.about_the_game:
Become the greatest healer in all of the land! Gain levels, master various healing classes, find epic gear, recruit unique and powerful friends, and defeat devastating bosses as you progress through more challenging levels!

Features

  • 18 worlds and over 180 levels
  • 9 playable classes each offering unique styles of healing
  • Nearly 200 pieces of equipment to collect
  • Recruit-able friends with unique talents and abilities
  • Simple story line set in a fantasy world that unfolds throughout the game
  • A difficult 'Hard Mode' for those seeking the ultimate healing challenge

2132480.name: Touhou: Fading Illusion
2132480.about_the_game:
Touhou: Fading Illusion is a visual novel set in Touhou Project universe that comprehensively describes Gensokyo and its inhabitants. Get ready to meet many of the series' iconic characters and travel to various locations in the Underworld, Gensokyo, Heaven, and even Outside World!

Synopsis:

Throughout the ages, excessive curiosity has had a cruel cost. Once, the urge for the unknown made humans superior to animals, but the fear caused by this urge gave birth to the youkai, creatures that rose above mankind itself. Although both species have managed to find a way to coexist peacefully, even today modesty is still not in high favour. While technology is advancing at a rapid pace in the Outside World, the Gensokyo sages are falling deeper and deeper into the illusion of their own power, not realising that there may be something very different, deep, and extremely dense that even they should not touch. With each passing day, the prospect of its coming to light is gradually becoming a question of time.

Reimu is enjoying a warm spring day at her shrine, but her rest is interrupted by Yukari, who, in her manner, shows up unexpectedly and gives the shrine maiden an urgent task: Yukari wants Reimu to follow Sumireko at the festival at the Myouren Temple. The matter concerns the Hakurei Barrier, so Reimu has no choice but to go to the base of her rivals and hope that in the evening, Yukari deigns to explain everything that is happening.

Game Features:

  • Suitable for people unfamiliar with Touhou Project! A brief introduction to the universe in the free Prologue and an extensive in-game dictionary will keep newcomers from getting lost.

  • Non-linear plot! You have access to many choices that can dramatically change the plot. Currently, you can play Prologue, the first three days of the Destitute Chapter and the first day of the Underworld Chapter. That's about 10-15 hours of reading.

  • Journey through the vast world of Touhou Project! Visit the Former Hell, Netherworld, various parts of Gensokyo and even beyond!

  • Over 50 characters from Touhou Project series! You will definitely find someone you'll like.

2132510.name: 32 in 1 Game Special
2132510.about_the_game:
Contains some content that may offend some players....... fantasy violence,killing
nudity,revealing outfits,sexual innuendo,crude language.



Why Play 1 Game When You Can Play 32?

Try you skills in a variety of game genres . This 32 in 1 collection will test your abilities in puzzle games, FPSs, shooters ,beat em ups and many more!

Short But Sweet..sometimes....

Most on the collection are more akin to arcade style play length for quick sessions, while others provide a lengthier challenge for those looking.

Scores,Speed Runs, Survival

Can you get the best possible score? How fast can you beat a game? Can you make it without losing too many lives? A little something for everyone.

Bla Bla Bla Anything Else?..

A salute to those cheap shareware and multi cart cartridges sold years ago that some of us have a bit of a soft spot. With nods
to the styles and quality of both, a bit of unusual humor and a few references you just might get, its possible you may enjoy yourself... or mabe you wont..I dunno...whatever..

2132520.name: The Magic World
2132520.about_the_game:
You start in the dungeon of the Stone Castle. The castle is surrounded by the enemy army of King Livard. Your teacher, the Grand Magist of water Magic, Nikolai Theron, has ordered you to come to him to receive your first instructions...

Destroy a lot of monsters

The castle and the surrounding area are teeming with the most unimaginable monsters, generated by it is not clear what. Hordes of monsters can attack you from anywhere!

Explore mysterious mazes

Traps, mazes, riddles, the castle is filled with many dangers and treasures. And what happens if you pull this lever? Somewhere in the distance, the sounds of a stone slab rising can be heard...

Save the kingdom!

Only you can save the kingdom from the attack of the terrible King Livard and his army. The eastern city of Tilkenburg turned into ruins, leaving only the last monument of the kingdom - a Stone castle.

This is a party RPG!

You play as a young magician Egor, who is a student of the Grand Master of water magic Nikolai Theron. Assemble a team of fighters, develop their abilities and skills. A weak squad will die from a single blow of a dead frog, and a strong one is able to destroy several red dragons…

Magic

Learn magic, develop your magical powers! Ball lightning or fireball? Or maybe you are an adept of the world and want to develop protective and healing spells? The choice is yours. But remember, the monster that is a dead monster is good.

Inventory

Find or buy items, from weapons to magic potions. You can use rings, tools, armor, scrolls, potions. ingredients and many other useful items in the game. Keys open doors, letters contain important information, a magic potion restores magic, and a hammer breaks through the head.

Visit shops, taverns, churches and residential buildings

Trade, communicate, complete tasks and quests, study.

Dolby Digital 5.1 / 7.1

The game supports surround sound environment, be sure to try to play it using 5.1 speakers, then you will fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a scary dungeon...

Controls

  • WASD or Keyboard arrows - party moving
  • space or A - attack
  • mouse - click everything
  • ENTER - turn base battle
  • 1,2,3,4 or click on party head icon - choice party man to open door or chest

2132530.name: Last Order
2132530.about_the_game:
An abandoned Automata 'Yukiwari' awakens at the end of the sewers, in a graveyard of discarded Automata. Having lost her memory, she still embarks on a journey to reclaim the light her heart longs for - the 'Last Order.'

'Last Order' is a 2D action game with pixel art graphics and high difficulty.
Utilize a variety of wire actions to recover the Last Order in a devastated world.

Offensive wire action

In Last Order, wire actions are not just about movement.

  • Swing Wire
Swing wire is an action for movement and attack with wires strung across the ceiling.
Wires can cut off the enemies by passing, so it will be the primary means of attack.



  • Dive Wire
Dive Wire is an action to move at high speed to scaffolds and to enemies by elastic wire.
You can break away from danger or Dive into the enemy freely.



  • Shackle Wire
Shackle Wire is an action to entangle and throw enemies or shells.
It can be used not only to shoot down enemies in the distance., but also as a defense to catch shells.

Growth to match your style

Grow yourself according to your play style.
Power if you prefer short term battles, or resilience if you are prepared for long term battles.

Customize ability to fit situation

Equip the order chips you obtained to gain new abilities.
Use the order chip according to the situation and your style.

Exploration

Items are hidden in the stages where automatas are abounded.
Exploration will help you find a key to your journey.

Tense boss battle

Bosses with a wide variety of actions are powerful, but they are not overpowered difficulty.
Spot the pattern, bring down them with your skill and strategy.

2132540.name: Mr. Run and Jump
2132540.about_the_game:
In this electric 2D platformer, help Mr. Run and Jump defeat the terrifying Void and collect all the Power Gems from the Realms of Color! Joined by his trusty pal Leap the Dog, the duo must venture through a dazzling and dangerous world, dodging countless enemies and conquering hundreds of fierce platforming challenges to save the day!

Mr. Run and Jump draws you in with precise level design, free-flowing gameplay, and formidable challenge. Silky controls encourage players to run, jump, dash, double jump, and roll to clear levels with style, making it a speedrunner’s dream. Collectibles hidden in tough-to-reach spots demand players use their wits as well as their dexterity. Dynamic Assistance options allow players to set the level of difficulty they want. No matter how you play, Mr. Run and Jump offers engaging gameplay options to players of varying skill levels and approaches.



Key Features
  • Precision Platforming: Bound over obstacles, dodge deadly enemies, and collect all the power gems before it’s too late!
  • Realms of Color: Each world has its own distinct style, with a beautifully illustrated visual aesthetic bursting with vibrant neon graphics.
  • A Dangerous World: A wide variety of treacherous enemies, each with their own patterns and personality.
  • Hours of Entertainment: Challenging levels, collectible orbs, and Time Trials offer 30+ hours of gameplay.
  • Save your Dog, Save the World: Experience an original story of a transformed world, a devouring Void, and all the wonders of the Realms of Color.
2132540.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America

“The experience truly sings, and I feel unstoppable”
8/10 – Game Informer

“Mr. Run and Jump is a title I couldn't recommend more to platformer aficionados.”
10/10 – Game Grin

“Mr. Run and Jump is a highly entertaining yet very challenging platformer!”
9.5/10 – Game Tyrant

2132560.name: On Your Tail
2132560.about_the_game:
Welcome to Borgo Marina, the perfect summer haven where sun-soaked days and sparkling nights promise the perfect getaway. You are Diana, an amateur writer looking for inspiration after the rejection of her most recent piece. But beware— an enigmatic thief is causing trouble, and it’s up to you to crack the case!

Investigation! Start!

The locals are plagued by the phantom thief. Engage with different villagers to receive quests and uncover their own unique storylines. And who knows, maybe you’ll discover key insights and clues into the case.

Uncover Clues

Time is your friend, detective. Use the magical device known as a chronolens to investigate crime scenes and view things how they were before the crime took place. Use this unique information to make your deductions and get to the bottom of the crime!

Recreate The Crime 

Once you’ve gathered your clues, it’s time to get down to business. Utilizing a unique card system, you must uncover the correct series of events and reenact the crime scene! Watch the crime play out in real time with a diorama of the crime scene that reacts to the clue cards you play.

Build Relationships

What’s a vacation without making some new friends? Borgo Marina is filled with locals who are looking to strike up a conversation, play some games, or even looking for something a little bit more than friendship?

The Cozy Life

Solving puzzling crimes isn’t all you’ll do! After all, you came for a vacation! Kick back and relax solo or with villagers in a variety of fun mini-games around town. Cook some food, go fishing, play marbles on the beach, go swimming, or play at the arcade. If you’re looking to bring in some extra cash, you can also pick up part-time jobs like serving gelato to earn some money for spending. How you spend your vacation is up to you!

90 – KeenGamer

2132570.name: Total Factory
2132570.about_the_game:
Game description:

You are a robot with unrealistically advanced artificial intelligence on a previously unknown planet, people created you for one single purpose - to ensure the automatic production of the necessary resources and their dispatch. It would seem that what could go wrong?

You start the game from your base, your creators - the CosmoDoc Corporation - gave you the starting amount of the necessary resources and a couple of robots to protect your base from enemies.

Complete tasks from the task center to unlock new machines for automation and advance further in the game.

In the game, you can not only automate your factory, but also ensure its protection with the help of automatic turrets and allied robots.

Game Features:

  • Play with enemies present or choose peaceful mode where you can build out your factory without threat of attack
  • Quite a large procedural generated world
  • Upgrade system
  • Combat robots and robots engineers
  • 4 different biomes: Tundra, Meadow, Desert and Jungle
  • More than 150 different game items
  • Dynamic change of day and night
  • Mining
  • Growing and caring for vegetables and fruits grown from seeds
  • Protection of your factory from enemy units ready to destroy everything in their path
  • 6 types of mined ore: Iron, Aluminum, Copper, Gold, Coal, Quartz
  • Supply electricity to automated machines with solid fuel generators, the game has a whole power grid system, don't forget to take the wires!
  • There are many machines in the game to automate the process, ranging from the simplest conveyor belt to an assembly machine
  • Isometric graphics

2132610.name: Thanks for the Soup
2132610.about_the_game:
Our customers are craving some soup, can't leave them hanging can we? Go around town at night delivering soup to our customer's homes until they are satisfied. If they get hooked, and they will, you will be returning the following nights to share more of our wonderful soup!

The more and faster you deliver, the more money you will make. So make sure to give everyone a taste, and soon they will all be thanking you for the soup.

You deliver soup from 5pm to 1am, outside of those hours are considered your own free time. You can fill in those hours however you want. Explore and find secrets. Go around shopping. Decorate your home. Go gambling. Or simply relax at home with your cat. Fill in those hours however you'd like.

Just remember to stay out of the kitchen.

Unfortunately, we cannot be out delivering soup all day. So make sure to get all the rest and proteins you may need outside of working hours. Only a healthy deliverer will be able to satisfy our customers. The local shops are open during the day, so feel free to get your fill out of them when you can. That way you can perform at peak performance during your deliveries.

2132680.name: Universal Truck Simulator Tow Games
2132680.about_the_game:
Explore the roads of Europe and deliver with Tuck Tow Simulator Europe various broken cars across the continent while driving legendary European trucks! This game takes you on a journey through immersive landscapes and rich environments!
Do you think you have what it takes to be a trucker? Try out your abilities by pushing your skill and performance to the limits! This game features a big open world map, based in Europe! The game includes top graphics and visuals, realistic physics and amazing sound effects! Be a driver of one of the many trucks available, Get behind the wheel and experience the game for yourself!!!

2132690.name: Vivat Slovakia
2132690.about_the_game:
Vivat Slovakia is an open-world game set in the newly independent Slovakia, a country on the dividing line between East and West. As remnants of communism linger, weakened institutions allow corruption to thrive, and power falls into the hands of the highest bidder. Fueled by money and violence, the “wild '90s” era brings a city steeped in intrigue and danger.

Explore the gritty charm of '90s Bratislava as an undercover cop posing as a taxi driver. Roam 10 km² of faithfully recreated streets, landmarks, and real-life locations in a city torn between communism and capitalism. Dive into a raw, dynamic open world and witness Slovakia’s capital in all its untamed, Slavic glory.

Drive over 50 vehicles—from rugged socialist workhorses to rare luxury imports—that capture the style and class divide of early '90s Slovakia. With realistic physics and authentic detail, every car brings you closer to the streets and stories of the era.

Experience a story inspired by real events—one of loyalty, corruption, and power plays in ‘90s Slovakia. Unravel shifting alliances where politics and crime collide, with missions rooted in historical conflict and brought to life by professional voice actors.

'90s Bratislava is a warzone—where gangs rule, cops look the other way, and violence erupts in broad daylight. Vivat Slovakia drops you into this chaos, armed with historically accurate weapons that defined survival in a world where “you don’t have what you don’t steal.

2132710.name: SokoMelody
2132710.about_the_game:
This Sokoban-styled game is all about placing the correct notes in their respective spaces on the map, forming the songs that you will hear throughout the adventure.
Designed with an old school feel in mind, SokoMelody's intent is to make you feel like you're playing on a Game Boy.

Levels

The game consists of 100 hand crafted levels, that are divided on separate music genres:
  • Rock'n Roll / Pop Rock
  • Classical
  • Jazz
  • Disco / Dance

Each one thought to be a complement of the other with creative design and interesting mechanics

Story

In the game you're part of a band and you, and your friends, are trying to compose some songs to play on the show. To "compose" the songs you have to pass through all levels and unlock the songs so you'll be able to play them.

Mechanics

2132770.name: Labyrinthatory
2132770.about_the_game:
The great robot creator Steven Wernicke has passed away in the year 3086. His niece, Roxanne, is tasked with uncovering his life’s most important work. Along the way, she must solve puzzles and riddles, collect items, and interact with Wernicke’s robots as she uncovers the mystery in this puzzle-based top-down collectathon adventure made for children who got old!

Features include:
  • Over 80 unique puzzle experiences with billions of possible variations
  • Customizable difficulty settings for most puzzles (Normal, Hard, and Stupid Hard)
  • Item collection and area progression (Rad boots!)
  • Hints, quick travel, autosave, and other player helps
  • Quirky, funny dialogue with lovable characters
  • Possibly too many pop culture references

Take your puzzle experience to the next level from familiar, simple puzzles to absurdly difficult ones, all at your option.





Hours of puzzling. Brain building. Laughing. All in a laboratory labyrinth-type place. Or Labyrinthatory, if you like a good portmanteau. Come for the puzzles, stay for the weirdness, and leave with a fondness for toast.

2132840.name: Deliverance & Reign
2132840.about_the_game:
Engage in a gothic battle where Good defies Evil using roguelike deckbuilding mechanics, built for hardcore fans and newcomers alike!

Choose your path: bring Deliverance from Alaric’s terror, or turn into the tyrant himself and defend his Reign.


Deliverance & Reign is a complete and complex experience, split into two hugely different game modes: Deliverance and Reign.

Each mode is unique and feels like an entirely new, interconnected game!

Switch freely between them at any point, with separate Saves, Progression and Achievements to ensure the integrity of your progress.

With a giant variety of cards and play styles, choose your own path by upgrading and expanding your deck.

Built for beginners and hardcore fans of the genre, Deliverance & Reign is the perfect entry into the Roguelike Deckbuilding, yet also challenges veterans with its multiple Hell Layers – difficulty modifiers that will test you to the core!

DELIVERANCE

Become a brave hero and assault Alaric's castle, fighting through his horde of vicious monsters in your quest to put an end to his reign of terror.

Advance through dangerous halls as you make your way to the top floor, where his throne awaits.

Pick your class and your starting cards with caution! Your survival depends on how well you can manage your strengths and weaknesses - you must learn what to take and what to leave behind.

Keep in mind that each Class has its own unique buff, debuff and resource!

At the end of each floor, choose to retreat and keep all your treasures to strengthen yourself for another attempt, or brave forward for greater rewards… at enormous risks.

There are 4 floors to conquer, each culminating in an unique Boss Battle, where your strategical mind will be tested to its limits.

But beware: If you waste too much time, the most hideous beasts will crawl out of their lair and tear you to pieces!

Those brave enough to defeat Alaric at his weakest will unlock Hell Layers, difficulty modifiers that are sure to bring even the most hardcore player to their knees.

Deliverance Features:
  • 6 Classes, each with 37 Skills and their own loadouts;
  • 25 Weapons and 53 Artifacts;
  • 25 Blessings;
  • 40 enemy Minions and 7 bosses;
  • 15 Hell Layers (additional difficulty modifiers);
  • 29 Achievements;

Can you bring Deliverance from Alaric’s Reign of terror, or will his castle’s halls hear your dying breath?

REIGN

Corrupt yourself and take control of the tyrant Alaric himself!
A group of foolish heroes are about to invade your castle, and you must do everything in your power to stop them.

Forge a Bond with one of the 6 malevolent factions to protect your castle against the intruders, each with their own strengths, weaknesses and quirks!

Enslave a legion of minions and distribute them between three different floors (Lanes) as your enemies charge towards the top, where your Throne Room resides.

The choice is yours: go slow and strategically, utilizing every card at your disposal to defeat your enemies, or surround them with minions and destroy them with your spells!

Each Boss Battle is unique and requires a different approach to overcome. Find the correct synergies and strategies to obliterate the pathetic heroes!

Reign Features:
  • 6 factions, each with 9 Champion variants, 31 units and spells, and 22 upgrades;
  • 34 enemies and 14 bosses across 14 battles;
  • 17 Mysterious events to discover between battles:
  • 15 hell layers (additional difficulty modifiers);
  • 29 achievements;

It is time you rise up from your Throne and obliterates the foolish invaders that seek to end your Reign!

2132850.name: Rabbit and Steel
2132850.about_the_game:
RABBIT & STEEL is a co-op action "raiding" roguelike focused around fighting challenging bosses alongside your rabbit-eared friends. Fight foes, gather loot, build your character, and work together to overcome obstacles on your way to the Moonlit Pinnacle.

Combat is deliberately similar to tab-target MMORPGs, being based around global cooldowns, effective skill usage, gear effects, and resolving boss mechanics through teamwork.

This isn't an MMO, though; it's a roguelike!

Start a run, pick a class, invite friends to your lobby and you're raiding in seconds. Anywhere from 1 to 4 rabbits can embark together. If you venture out alone, mechanics that normally require cooperation will be replaced with intense bullet hell attacks.

Of course, it isn't always as simple as slapping down the enemies that stand in your way. Building your character with loot and upgrades you find along the way is key to success. Certain sets of items combo very well together... so make sure your allies don't roll on something you really need!

A few months ago, all contact with the Moonlit Kingdom was lost.

Reports indicate that the city's denizens attack outsiders on sight.

Investigative expeditions are repelled or go missing.

A colossal white tower now manifests in the city's center each night, stretching skyward towards the stars.

Something must be done. The rabbits will take care of this.

The night is short. Move swiftly.

  • Up to 4 players can play together locally, online, or a mix of the two

  • A plethora of bosses, stages, and challenging bullet-hell patterns to conquer

  • A single player story campaign where you chat up your enemies to uncover the mystery of the Moonlit Kingdom

  • Over 100 random loot items to power up your character

  • You can kill your friend by clipping them with a "spread" marker for laughs

  • Honestly they deserve it for rolling on the Darkstorm Knife even though they don't need it and it's SO good for your class

  • Supports playing with keyboard, mouse+keyboard, or with a controller

2132890.name: Possessor(s)
2132890.about_the_game:
Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side scroller with combat inspired by platform fighters, a story told through dangerous characters, set in a deep interconnected world ready for exploration.

Play as Luca, the host, and Rhem, her less-than-cooperative counterpart, as they explore a quarantined city ripped apart and flooded by an interdimensional catastrophe. Their only hope of survival is by learning to co-exist.

A Fractured World

Possessor(s) takes place across the interconnected sprawl of a destroyed mega-city, from collapsed skyscrapers to an abandoned aquarium, all riddled with secrets. Hauntingly beautiful 3D environments form a stunning backdrop over which hand-drawn and animated characters, and mysterious sci-fi horror action take center stage.

A Complex Narrative

Choose multiple paths in an open-ended world structure as you look to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe. Meet a cast of engaging characters, each with their own heart-breaking story to follow in the aftermath of the devastation.

A Precision Engagement

Gameplay is centered around tight, fast-paced platforming with a range of unique movement abilities that extends to its tense, precise, combat. Balance ground and air attacks, replete with combos and juggles as you encounter a variety of deadly enemies and challenging bosses. Find and unlock a wide array of powerful weapons and upgrades to bolster your arsenal and explore previously inaccessible areas.

2132900.name: /Conspiracy/ Girls >The Madness of Madison Delaroux
2132900.about_the_game:
/Conspiracy/ Girls is a visual novel about cute and funny girls who go around exposing conspiracies, and get into all sorts of trouble for doing so!


I wrote it to the length of roughly six anime episodes. (if you are a Spee D. Reader)

But why go fast? Breath in, and inhale the EXQUISITE memes in /Conspiracy/ Girls!



Madison Delaroux, the [Exposer of Conspiracies] has finally come back to New Coimbra. Dragging her accomplices, Ayano and Sachiko along, she seeks to expose (((Those))) who seek to rule the New Continent in secret!

Fed up with Madison's meddling, glowie agents and secret cultists have teamed up to rid themselves of the [Exposer] once and for all...! Will (((they))) succeed in party vanning her, or will Madison eternally BTFO those-who-glow-in-the-dark with no rematch?










Domo, domo, Author-kun des.

It's finally here. More than a year after the demo, /Conspiracy/ Girls is out. In the year I worked on my visual novel, it morphed from my original vision of a C***** P**** tragedy to its current slice-of-life of a comedy featuring cunny and conspiracies (laugh). Madison is still exposing (((them))), Ayano is still denying the existence of conspiracies, but their circle of friends (?) is larger now, so their (((enemies))) have grown in number as well.

What hasn't changed are the feelings that made me write this gigantic shitpost of a visual novel. To quote a fellow author, "I wrote this for those who are like me." And as events in the last few years have revealed, there are a great deal of those who are not our kind of people. Even if you told them the ex-president is reading their emails, or that the government takes in cute girl orphans and turns them into killers in school uniform, they wouldn't bat an eye. Among other things.

I think my technique has greatly improved over the past year! The original /Conspiracy Girls/ pilot looks so oddly antiquated compared to >Madness. If anything, >Madness is good for a laugh! I know I was laughing a lot when I put in all the little secrets inside the book, so I hope you will too. I found myself rereading the cute girls doing cute things parts to cheer myself up whenever the glowies decide to turn their 5G towers in my direction, so I know it's good!

And above all, I would like to thank the people who worked with me for >Madness, especially my artists in Stefan, Kat, ruvikvik, Fachru and k_uaci. I probably gave them hell as art director, with some really impossible requests along the way, but if it weren't for them, the characters wouldn't have turned out as pretty as they did.

I also chose a large selection of comedic music from Kevin Macleod and Alexander Nakarada, who I consider both to be the fathers of internet music, you probably have heard their work before (monkeysspinningmonkeys.mp3) but never realized it. They are really talented musicians, and many a sleepless night was spent listening to their tunes while trying to get a scene right. A full list of tracks is listed inside the game's ending credits.

And lastly, I wrote this for the witch who taught me to write. It's been many years since I first met her. I've also since stopped yelling her name in front of her portrait. There are very little people who would hide an entire treatise on magickal theory within a mystery novel, but I understood her message. This book is my message bottle to you. Perhaps by some small miracle you will read this and go "hah" with narrow eyes as we used to do when we were younger.

I've said all that I can say, buy /Conspiracy/ Girls! If my little isekai into this world doesn't work out, there's always wageslaving at a meido cafe somewhere!

Laugh, it's fun!
Arthur Delaroux

2132930.name: Paragonian 3 : The Warrior of Light
2132930.about_the_game:
Paragonian 3: The Warrior of Light is an ARPG that plays alone. Explore the Oriental World!
Paragonian 3: Kwang, the light warrior is a 3D ARPG game. Eliminate enemies to raise levels and use a variety of weapons.
Enjoy the story of the game and watch a variety of cinematic videos. Explore the oriental world and enjoy the game!

On his way back home, he meets Raizin, the god of thunder, and starts an inevitable battle.

2132950.name: Slim Chance
2132950.about_the_game:
Be a part of the greatest adventure you will ever take! In this first person survival game you will be challenged to build a base and defend it against other players. Attack other players for a chance to steal some of their loot or venture towards AI controlled monuments to obtain your own loot. Need some help? Build bases.
